papers.title: AutoDesign: Meta-Harness Optimization for Long-Horizon Agentic Design
papers.abstract_en: Transforming multimodal sources into condensed and structured media outputs can be fundamentally conceptualized as a long-horizon agentic process centered on a model-harness system. While an ideal harness system should align with human design priors and accumulate reusable experience through empirical exploration to drive recursive self-improvement, existing paradigms remain static and fall short of this capability. In this paper, we present AutoDesign, a framework that aligns with human design priors, where a meta-harness optimizer guides a code agent to recursively improve harness based on rollout feedback. To instantiate and evaluate this framework, we focus on the academic paper-to-poster generation task and introduce PosterBench, comprising a 100-paper Main Track spanning five disciplines and PosterBench-mini, a shared 10-paper subset for controlled evaluation. On the PosterBench Main Track, AutoDesign achieves the highest score of 78.32, surpassing the closed-source commercial system Claude Design by 7.45 points. Across seven controlled code-agent-model configurations, integrating the learned DesignHarness consistently improves performance, increasing the average PosterBench Score from 54.99 to 67.39 (+12.4%). In a fully autonomous long-horizon loop, it executes 253 tool calls and 11 editing turns within 40 minutes for under $3, reaching average conference-poster quality in human evaluation. A system-blind human study further demonstrates that AutoDesign achieves the highest human preference among evaluated systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AutoDesign，一个针对长时程智能体设计流程 (long-horizon agentic design) 的元管理优化 (meta-harness optimization) 框架：由元管理优化器引导代码智能体基于 rollout 反馈递归改进模型-管理 (model-harness) 系统。作者将该框架实例化到学术论文转海报生成任务，并构建 PosterBench 基准（100 篇论文的主赛道与 10 篇论文的受控子集），在多个配置下验证了学习到的 DesignHarness 能持续提升生成质量。
Motivation: 现有的管理 (harness) 系统是静态的，既不能与人手设计先验对齐，也不能通过经验探索积累可复用知识来实现递归自我改进；作者认为将多模态源转化为结构化输出本质上是一个围绕模型-管理系统展开的长时程智能体过程，因此需要一种能自我优化的框架。
Method: AutoDesign 的核心是用一个元管理优化器 (meta-harness optimizer) 指导代码智能体，根据 rollout 反馈递归地改进管理组件，从而让系统在探索中积累经验并与人类设计先验对齐；论文以论文到海报生成任务为验证场景，并引入 DesignHarness 作为该过程学习到的产物。
Result: 在 PosterBench Main Track 上，AutoDesign 取得 78.32 分，超过商业闭源系统 Claude Design 7.45 分；在七个受控代码智能体-模型配置中，集成学习到的 DesignHarness 将平均 PosterBench Score 从 54.99 提升到 67.39（+12.4%）。全自主长时程循环在 40 分钟内、成本低于 3 美元时执行 253 次工具调用和 11 次编辑回合，达到平均会议海报质量；系统盲测中 AutoDesign 获得最高的人类偏好。
Conclusion: 作者认为 AutoDesign 展示了通过 meta-harness 优化实现递归自我改进的可行性，重点验证场景是论文到海报生成；摘要未涉及该方法在其他设计任务或更广泛模态上的泛化情况。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OmniScientist: An Omni-Modal Omni-Discipline AI Scientist
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in foundation models have enabled AI scientists to automate increasingly complete research workflows, from hypothesis generation and code execution to manuscript preparation. Yet workflow coverage alone does not provide access to the full evidence on which scientific discovery depends. Existing systems typically reason over text, code, labels, or precomputed summaries, leaving scientifically decisive spatial, temporal, cross-channel, and procedural relations unavailable to the agent. We introduce OmniScientist, an end-to-end, omni-modal AI scientist that conducts multidisciplinary research directly from heterogeneous raw evidence. A perception layer and 3 autonomous agents for ideation, experiment, and writeup operate within a deterministic pipeline, allowing observations to shape research questions, experimental decisions, and final claims throughout the research lifecycle. By running idea, rigour, and claim checks in code, the system enforces novelty screening, statistical validity, execution provenance, and numerical traceability. We evaluate OmniScientist on 36 real-data cases spanning 5 discipline families, 4 families of scientific evidence, and modalities including images, signals, audio, video, 3-D structures, trajectories, tables, formulae, and graphs. The system completes the full path from raw data to a compiled manuscript in all 36 cases and achieves a mean overall paper score of 6.3 with the reference reasoning backbone. In paired comparisons against a blind variant that receives only precomputed scalar features, direct perception improves all 7 evaluation dimensions and wins 85% of head-to-head judgments. These results show that lifecycle-wide perception is essential for evidence-grounded scientific discovery and provides a practical path toward broadly capable AI scientists.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 13 figures, 19 tables. Project page: https://omni-scientist.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OmniScientist，一个端到端、全模态 (omni-modal) 的 AI 科学家，直接从异构原始证据（图像、信号、音频、视频、3D 结构、轨迹、表格、公式、图等）开展多学科研究。系统由一个感知层和 ideation、experiment、writeup 三个自主 agent 组成，在确定性流水线中运行，并用代码执行 idea、rigour、claim 检查来保证新颖性、统计有效性与可追溯性。作者在 36 个真实数据案例、5 个学科家族上评估，系统全部完成了从原始数据到成稿论文的流程。
Motivation: 现有 AI 科学家通常只能处理文本、代码、标签或预计算摘要，无法访问科学发现所依赖的完整证据，尤其是空间、时间、跨通道和过程性关系，限制了证据驱动的科学研究。
Method: OmniScientist 采用感知层加三个自主 agent（ideation、experiment、writeup）的确定性流水线；感知结果直接塑造研究问题、实验决策和最终主张；同时通过代码运行的 novelty、rigour 和 claim 检查实现新颖性筛选、统计有效性、执行溯源和数值可追踪性。
Result: 在 36 个真实数据案例上全部完成从原始数据到编译手稿的完整流程，参考推理骨干下平均论文总分为 6.3；与仅接收预计算标量特征的盲变体配对比较中，直接感知在全部 7 个评估维度上提升并赢得 85% 的头对头判断。
Conclusion: 摘要强调贯穿研究生命周期的感知 (perception) 对于证据支撑的科学发现至关重要，并指出该工作为通用 AI 科学家提供了可行路径。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: V-RAE: Rethinking Video Latent Spaces for Generation
papers.abstract_en: Latent video generation relies on autoencoders to define a compact space in which generative models operate. Although video autoencoder architectures have evolved substantially, their latent spaces are still optimized primarily for pixel-level reconstruction and provide limited high-level semantic organization. A reconstruction-optimal latent space, however, need not be well suited to generative modeling. We propose V-RAE, a video representation autoencoder that builds compact generative latents on top of frozen vision foundation model representations. A lightweight temporal pooling module removes temporal redundancy while preserving semantic structure, and a video decoder reconstructs continuous motion from the compressed features. We evaluate V-RAE with four representative frozen encoders on video reconstruction, semantic probing, and class-conditional generation. V-RAE achieves 2.13 rFVD on K600, outperforming all evaluated large-scale pretrained video VAEs. Its latents retain substantially more semantic information than conventional video tokenizer latents. Under matched generation settings, our best variant achieves gFVD scores of 117.86 and 19.16 on UCF101 and K600, respectively, while converging up to 6x faster}. We further show that reconstruction quality alone is insufficient to characterize generative utility and introduce tFVD, a temporal-coherence diagnostic that correlates more reliably with downstream generation quality. Beyond video generation, V-RAE also improves future video prediction on Cityscapes over the Wan 2.2 VAE latent space under matched prediction settings. Taken together, the experiments show that frozen semantic representations can support video reconstruction, generation, and predictive modeling. The project page: https://v-rae.github.io/.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 8 tables, 13 figures, project page: https://v-rae.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 V-RAE，一种视频表示自编码器 (video representation autoencoder)，在冻结的视觉基础模型表示之上构建紧凑的生成式潜在空间，并用轻量时间池化模块去除时序冗余、用视频解码器重建连续运动。在 K600 上 rFVD 达 2.13，优于所有被评估的大规模预训练视频 VAE；在匹配生成设置下，最佳变体在 UCF101 和 K600 上分别取得 gFVD 117.86 和 19.16，收敛速度最多提升 6 倍。作者还提出 tFVD 作为与下游生成质量更相关的时序一致性诊断指标，并在 Cityscapes 未来视频预测上优于 Wan 2.2 VAE 潜在空间。
Motivation: 现有视频自编码器的潜在空间主要按像素级重建优化，缺乏高层语义组织，而重建最优的潜在空间未必适合生成建模，两者之间存在 gap。
Method: 在冻结的视觉基础模型 (frozen vision foundation model) 表示之上叠加轻量时间池化模块以压缩时序冗余、保留语义结构，并由视频解码器从压缩特征重建连续运动；实验采用四种代表性冻结编码器进行评估。
Result: V-RAE 在 K600 上取得 2.13 rFVD，超过所有被评估的大规模预训练视频 VAE；匹配生成设置下 UCF101/K600 的 gFVD 分别为 117.86/19.16，收敛最多快 6 倍；在 Cityscapes 未来预测上优于 Wan 2.2 VAE 潜在空间，且潜在表示保留的语义信息明显多于传统视频 tokenizer。
Conclusion: 研究表明重建质量本身不足以刻画生成效用，tFVD 与下游生成质量的相关性更可靠；冻结语义表示可以同时支持视频重建、生成与预测建模。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: HumanTracker: Towards Comprehensive and Human-Aligned Motion Tracking Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid motion tracking is central to teleoperation and whole-body imitation, yet evaluation often disagrees with what people perceive in videos. Kinematic errors average per-frame pose differences but miss the physical artifacts that matter most, particularly unstable support and incorrect contacts such as foot skating and mistimed touch-downs. Meanwhile, widely used test suites are small and lack the diversity needed to stress contact-rich, long-horizon behaviors. We introduce HumanTracker to make humanoid tracking evaluation both perceptually aligned and scalable. The HumanTracker benchmark contains approximately 153 hours of optical motion trajectories from multiple professional performers, organized into four motion families with text labels for fine-grained diagnosis. We further propose HumanScore, a preference-aligned metric trained on 12K motion pairs containing 24K motions. Across representative state-of-the-art trackers, HumanScore better predicts human preferences and reveals contact and stability failures that kinematic metrics often miss.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HumanTracker，一个用于人形运动追踪评估的基准，包含约 153 小时来自多位专业表演者的光学运动轨迹，组织为四个运动家族并附带文本标签以支持细粒度诊断。同时提出 HumanScore，一种基于 12K 运动对（含 24K 个运动）训练的偏好对齐指标。在代表性 SOTA 追踪器上，HumanScore 比运动学指标更好地预测人类偏好，并揭示运动学指标常遗漏的接触与稳定性失败。
Motivation: 现有人形运动追踪评估多采用逐帧姿态差的运动学误差，但这类指标会遗漏视频中人们最在意的物理伪影，如不稳定支撑和错误接触（脚部滑动、触地时机错误）；现有测试集规模小且缺乏多样性，难以覆盖接触密集和长时程行为。
Method: 构建 HumanTracker 基准，收集约 153 小时光学运动轨迹，划分为四个运动家族并配以文本标签；提出偏好对齐的 HumanScore 指标，在 12K 运动对（24K 个运动）上训练以预测人类偏好。
Result: 在多个代表性 SOTA 追踪器上，HumanScore 比运动学指标更能预测人类偏好，并能揭示运动学指标经常遗漏的接触与稳定性失败。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作使类人运动追踪评估在感知上与人类判断对齐，并具备可扩展性，便于发现接触与稳定性问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Defensive Boosting for Online Probabilistic Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: We study online probabilistic forecasting of binary outcomes chosen by an adaptive adversary. Given an online learning algorithm for a weak hypothesis class $H$, we would like to efficiently obtain two incomparable guarantees that existing online boosting techniques provide separately. Online gradient boosting competes in Brier score with the best predictor induced by the span of $H$ on every sequence, but promises nothing when the span does not contain an accurate predictor. Online weak-to-strong boosting drives classification error to zero under a weak-learning condition, but promises little when that condition fails. We give a simple defensive forecasting algorithm, the Defensive Booster, that obtains both guarantees. On every adaptive sequence, its Brier score is competitive with the best prediction induced by the span of $H$ at the same rate as online gradient boosting; simultaneously, whenever the realized transcript satisfies the smooth weak-learning condition, its Brier score and randomized classification error satisfy the same rate guarantee as online classification boosting. This is achieved by operationalizing the "dual view" of boosting: When the algorithm's randomized classification error is persistently high, its mistake weights form a smooth reweighting on which every weak hypothesis has low edge, yielding an ex-post hard-core certificate that the weak-learning condition fails. We also develop a strongly adaptive variant, which satisfies both guarantees on every time interval. The Defensive Booster is very efficient: it accesses just one weak-class learner, whereas the prior online boosting methods we compare against maintain large weak-learner ensembles. Experiments on synthetic and real data streams demonstrate its strong predictive performance (sometimes substantially improving over all prior baselines) coupled with orders-of-magnitude faster runtime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究自适应对手选择的二元结果的在线概率预测，提出防御式提升算法 Defensive Booster。该算法能在同一条自适应序列上同时获得两类互不可比保证：与在线梯度提升相同速率的 Brier 得分竞争性，以及在平滑弱学习条件满足时与在线分类提升相同速率的误差保证。实现上利用了提升的“对偶视角”，仅访问一个弱类学习器，实验显示预测性能强且运行速度快数个数量级。
Motivation: 现有在线提升技术分别提供了两种互不包含的保证：在线梯度提升在 Brier 得分上与 H 的 span 诱导的最优预测器竞争，但当 span 中不存在准确预测器时没有保证；在线弱到强提升在弱学习条件下将分类误差推向零，但当该条件不成立时缺乏承诺。论文希望用单一算法同时获得这两种保证。
Method: 提出 Defensive Booster 防御式预测算法，通过操作化提升的“对偶视角”：当算法随机分类误差持续较高时，错误权重形成平滑重加权，使得每个弱假设的边缘都很低，从而提供事后 hard-core 证书证明弱学习条件不成立。此外还开发了强自适应变体，在每个时间区间上都满足两种保证；算法只访问一个弱类学习器，而先前的在线提升方法维护大型弱学习器集成。
Result: 在每条自适应序列上，算法的 Brier 得分以与在线梯度提升相同的速率与 H 的 span 诱导的最优预测竞争；同时，当平滑弱学习条件满足时，其 Brier 得分和随机分类误差满足与在线分类提升相同的速率保证。合成和真实数据流实验表明其预测性能强（有时大幅超过所有先前基线），运行速度提升数个数量级。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 Defensive Booster 以单个弱学习器的高效率同时获得两类在线提升保证，并指出实验验证了强预测性能和极快运行时间。其范围限于二元结果的在线概率预测与自适应对手设定。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: PlayWorld: Benchmarking World Models with Agent Players over Long-Horizon Objectives
papers.abstract_en: Video world models simulate future states conditioned on current observations and user actions. Recent systems have demonstrated impressive video consistency and action controllability over long sequences. However, fairly comparing these interactive models remains challenging. In practice, a human player typically evaluates a world model by pursuing long-horizon objectives through interaction. For example, a user may turn around 360 degrees to see whether the environment remains consistent, or walk into the water and inspect whether realistic water ripples are generated. The action sequence required to achieve the same objective may vary substantially between models, making fixed action-conditioned evaluation unsuitable for cross-model comparison. To address this, we employ multi-modal Agent Players to interact with world models toward specified long-horizon objectives. Building on this paradigm, we introduce PlayWorld, a benchmark providing 171 scenarios, each with a specified objective. To evaluate performance thoroughly, we assess models along four core dimensions: geometry consistency, interaction fidelity, out-of-sight evolution, and insight evolution. In addition, we incorporate basic ability metrics for video quality and controllability. Experiments across nine state-of-the-art world models reveal that current models remain unreliable on long-horizon interactive objectives, particularly in maintaining spatial consistency and persistent state evolution. Code and data are available at https://github.com/kxding/PlayWorld.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PlayWorld，一个基于多模态 Agent Players 与世界模型交互、完成长时程目标 (long-horizon objectives) 的评测基准。基准包含 171 个场景并指定目标，从几何一致性、交互保真度、视野外演化 (out-of-sight evolution) 和洞见演化 (insight evolution) 四个维度评测，并纳入视频质量与可控性的基础能力指标。在九个 SOTA 世界模型上的实验显示，现有模型在长时程交互目标上仍不可靠，尤其空间一致性和持久状态演化方面表现不足。
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型评测多采用固定动作条件序列，但同一目标在不同模型下所需的动作序列差异很大，难以公平跨模型比较；而人类玩家通常通过交互追求长时程目标来评估环境一致性等能力。
Method: 采用多模态 Agent Players 与世界模型交互以完成指定的长时程目标；在此基础上构建 PlayWorld 基准，提供 171 个场景，并从几何一致性、交互保真度、视野外演化和洞见演化四个核心维度，以及视频质量和可控性基础指标进行评测。
Result: 在九个 state-of-the-art 世界模型上的实验表明，现有模型在长时程交互目标上仍不可靠，尤其在保持空间一致性和持续状态演化方面表现不足。
Conclusion: 摘要强调当前世界模型在长时程交互场景下可靠性不足，并指出 PlayWorld 提供代码和数据以支持更公平的交互式世界模型评测。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Exponential Convex Calibration Dimension for the Multi-Label Jaccard Measure
papers.abstract_en: The per-instance Jaccard score, or intersection over union (IoU), is standard in multi-label classification and binary segmentation. With $s$ labels, its loss matrix has $2^s$ outcomes and reports. Under the convention $\mathrm{Jac}(\varnothing,\varnothing)=1$, we prove that the Jaccard score, shifted-loss, and ordinary loss matrices are nonsingular and that the loss columns have affine dimension $2^s-1$. The proof combines a finite MinHash Gram representation with Boolean Möbius inversion. For exact calibration, we prove $2^{s-1} \leq \mathrm{CCdim}(L^{\mathrm{Jac}}) \leq 2^s-1$. The lower bound uses a factorially weighted distribution with $2^{s-1}+1$ supported outcomes and Bayes-optimal reports. Consequently, every exactly calibrated convex surrogate requires exponentially many prediction coordinates. We also give two polynomial-dimensional approximation guarantees with explicit regret transfers. A new $F_1$-to-Jaccard transfer turns an existing $(s^2+1)$-dimensional $F_1$ surrogate into a polynomial-time rule with asymptotic Jaccard regret at most $3-2\sqrt{2}$. For any $α>0$ and $0<ρ<1$, a MinHash square-loss surrogate attains Jaccard-regret floor $α$ uniformly over arbitrary conditional label distributions. With probability at least $1-ρ$, the direct construction has dimension $O((s^2+s\log(1/ρ))/α^2)$, while a signed variant has dimension $O((s+\log(1/ρ))/α^2)$. Thus zero-regret calibration requires exponential dimension, whereas every fixed additive regret tolerance admits polynomial prediction dimension.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多标签分类中 Jaccard 分数（intersection over union）作为损失函数时的凸校准维度。在约定 Jac(∅,∅)=1 下，作者证明 Jaccard 损失矩阵、平移损失矩阵和普通损失矩阵均非奇异，且损失列的仿射维度为 2^s-1；精确校准的凸代理需要指数级预测坐标，而固定加法遗憾容忍度只需多项式维度的代理。
Motivation: 多标签分类和二元分割常用逐实例 Jaccard 分数作为评价指标，但对其凸代理的校准维度缺乏理论刻画。该论文旨在给出精确与近似校准的维度上下界，回答零遗憾校准是否必然代价高昂的问题。
Method: 证明部分结合有限 MinHash Gram 表示与布尔 Möbius 反演，建立损失矩阵的非奇异性和仿射维度。精确校准的下界通过因子加权分布（支持 2^{s-1}+1 个结果）和贝叶斯最优报告构造。近似校准部分给出 F1 到 Jaccard 的遗憾转移，以及两个 MinHash 平方损失代理的显式维度构造。
Result: 摘要报告精确校准维度满足 2^{s-1} ≤ CCdim(L^Jac) ≤ 2^s-1；F1 代理可转化为多项式时间规则，渐近 Jaccard 遗憾至多 3-2√2。对任意 α>0 和 0<ρ<1，MinHash 平方损失代理在任意条件标签分布上实现 Jaccard 遗憾下界 α：直接构造维度为 O((s^2+s log(1/ρ))/α^2)，带符号变体为 O((s+log(1/ρ))/α^2)。
Conclusion: 主要结论是：零遗憾校准需要指数级预测维度，而任何固定加法遗憾容忍度均可由多项式维度的凸代理实现。该结果为 Jaccard 度量下的凸校准复杂度提供了完整刻画。

papers.title: QuoteBench: How Matched Scores Can Hide Command-Path Failures
papers.abstract_en: LLM coding agents issue Bash commands through interfaces that may serialize, wrap, and reparse model output. Matched execution scores alone cannot distinguish command-generation errors from failures introduced after generation. QuoteBench measures this boundary with exact final-state validation on 56 one-shot tasks from 14 incident-derived families, crossing the generation contract with the execution transport around one deliberately unescaped added parser. Escaping at the interpolation point reproduces each replayed reply's raw-path outcome, so any recovery under a disclosed boundary must come from the model changing its generation. Across eight same-window configurations, replaying the same reply through the added parser lowers success by 55.4 to 73.2 percentage points; disclosure recovers 30.4 to 60.7 points for six configurations, and zero or slightly negative for the other two. Raw generation is nearly saturated at the frontier; boundary adaptation is what still separates models. GPT-5.6-sol's matched gap of -3.6 points hides -64.3 points of damage and +60.7 points of compensation. The deployment configuration reorders models: one reversal among 26 comparable pairs is unambiguous and four more sit on single-task margins. Evaluations of command-issuing agents should report the model configuration, generation contract, execution path, operating point, and final-state validator rather than treat a matched score as an intrinsic model property.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 QuoteBench，用于度量 LLM 编码智能体在生成 Bash 命令时，生成阶段错误与执行传输（execution transport）阶段引入的失败之间的边界。摘要基于 14 个事件衍生家族（incident-derived families）的 56 个一次性任务，以精确最终状态验证（exact final-state validation）为准则，并围绕一个刻意未转义的新增解析器将生成契约（generation contract）与执行传输交叉测试。摘要报告，在八个同窗口配置中重放同一回复会使成功率下降 55.4 至 73.2 个百分点；披露边界后六个配置恢复 30.4 至 60.7 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有的匹配执行分数（matched execution scores）无法区分命令生成错误与生成之后由接口序列化、包装、重新解析所引入的失败。作者认为，若不区分这一边界，评估者会把部署配置造成的损失误归为模型生成能力问题。
Method: QuoteBench 采用精确最终状态验证，在 56 个一次性任务上把生成契约与执行传输交叉组合，核心是一个刻意未转义的新增解析器。通过在插值点（interpolation point）进行转义来复现每个重播回复在原始路径下的结果，从而保证在披露边界后观察到的任何恢复只能来自模型生成的变化。
Result: 在八个同窗口配置中，同一回复经新增解析器重播后成功率下降 55.4-73.2 个百分点；披露边界（disclosure）在六个配置中恢复 30.4-60.7 个百分点，另外两个配置为零或略微负向。GPT-5.6-sol 的匹配差距 -3.6 个百分点掩盖了 -64.3 个百分点的损伤与 +60.7 个百分点的补偿；部署配置会重排模型顺序，26 个可比对中有 1 个明确反转、4 个处于单任务边缘。
Conclusion: 作者主张，命令发出智能体的评测应当报告模型配置、生成契约、执行路径、运行点（operating point）与最终状态验证器，而不应把匹配分数当作模型的内在属性。

papers.title: Alaya-EVOKE: From Linear-Scaling Supervision to Endless World
papers.abstract_en: Interactive world models must support persistent memory, responsive interaction, and long-horizon generation, yet these requirements place conflicting demands on the model. Maintaining history in the denoiser context or key-value cache incurs growing cost, forcing a trade-off between session length and retained memory, while low-latency interaction relies on few-step generation whose capabilities are bounded by its teacher. Evoke addresses both limitations by externalizing persistent world state and redesigning the teacher for long-horizon interactive generation. Scene geometry is maintained in an external, camera-indexed world state bank, from which only view-relevant information is retrieved, keeping the denoiser context bounded as the session grows. Rather than treating the teacher as a fixed generator, we design it for long-horizon supervision: its sparse attention combines chunk-wise grouping, retrieval of selected distant frames, and a linear-attention global state, yielding linear growth in memory and compute while enabling supervision over long horizons. Such supervision exposes content drift that stays locally plausible within short windows, while per-chunk conditioning enables prompt changes and event control throughout the sequence. A 30-second distribution-matching objective, applied under self-forced rollouts, transfers both capabilities to a three-step student that uses no classifier-free guidance, improving resistance to long-term drift while preserving responsive conditioning. With bounded context and recurrent external memory, Evoke supports open-ended, continuously evolving generation; on a single H200 at $384\times 640$, each $1.5\,\mathrm{s}$ chunk is generated in $2.11\,\mathrm{s}$. As a three-step world model, Evoke achieves state-of-the-art performance on WBench while remaining competitive on VBench-Long and VBench-2.0.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: LittleLearner: Language Models Under Pedagogically Controlled Knowledge Exposure
papers.abstract_en: Modern language models are trained on heterogeneous web-scale text corpora. Consequently, studying knowledge and skill acquisition is difficult, as prior exposure to related content is hard to characterize. To address this challenge, we introduce LITTLECURRICULUM, a curated 88B-token pretraining corpus tailored to U.S. elementary school material, explicitly excluding concepts, facts, and vocabulary taught above Grade 5. Training a 5B-parameter LLM from scratch on LITTLECURRICULUM yields LITTLELEARNER, a model with sufficient language competence for open-ended evaluation, yet with clear knowledge and capability boundaries mapped to interpretable curriculum guidelines. We release LITTLECURRICULUM and LITTLELEARNER as a developmentally restricted sandbox to study how models acquire, represent, and use data under a well-defined training scope. We illustrate the sandbox's utility in a first suite of experiments on injecting new knowledge through post-training and in-context learning. These methods let LITTLELEARNER better utilize existing knowledge, but do not raise out-of-scope capabilities. Our findings underscore the value of this controlled environment for future investigations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LITTLECURRICULUM，一个专门针对美国小学课程内容、明确排除五年级以上概念与词汇的 880 亿 token 预训练语料，并据此从零训练出 5B 参数的 LITTLELEARNER 模型。该模型具备足够的语言能力进行开放式评估，同时其知识与能力边界能够映射到可解释的课程大纲。作者将这项工作定位为受发展层级约束的沙盒环境，并用初步实验展示后续训练与上下文学习可以提升既有知识的利用，但不会扩展超出范围的能力。
Motivation: 现代语言模型在异构的海量 Web 文本上训练，导致难以刻画模型对相关知识内容的先前暴露，从而难以研究知识与技能的习得过程。
Method: 构建一个严格控制知识范围的小学课程语料 LITTLECURRICULUM，排除五年级以上教授的概念、事实和词汇，并在此语料上从零训练一个 5B 参数的 LITTLELEARNER 模型；随后通过后训练和上下文学习注入新知识进行实验。
Result: LITTLELEARNER 在开放评估中具备足够语言能力，其知识边界与课程指南一致；初步实验显示后训练和上下文学习能提升对既有知识的利用，但不会带来范围外能力提升。
Conclusion: 该受控环境有助于未来研究模型如何在明确定义的训练范围内获取、表征和使用数据；当前实验聚焦于知识注入的局限，强调了受控语料作为研究工具的价值。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SCULPT: Subtractive Composition for 3D Part Generation
papers.abstract_en: Part-aware 3D generation aims to create digital assets that are coherent as complete objects while exposing structural parts for editing, material assignment, animation, and reuse. Existing methods impose this structure outside the native generation loop: segmentation-based methods partition an already generated shape, while additive methods synthesize parts from predefined layouts, boxes, or tokens and then reconcile them into a whole. The former preserves the generated geometry but fixes the object before part boundaries are determined; the latter exposes part cardinality but often leaves shared boundaries vulnerable to gaps, interpenetrations, and material discontinuities. In this paper, we propose SCULPT, a framework that addresses these challenges through subtractive composition. Given a complete object represented in a structured 3D latent space, SCULPT iteratively applies a joint split predictor to generate one extracted part together with the remaining object. The predictor performs a coupled denoising process conditioned on both the image and the current 3D state, so the extracted part and updated remainder are generated together rather than reconciled after generation. The joint split predictor processes both outputs on the union of their native sparse 3D supports, allowing neighboring supports to overlap rather than imposing a disjoint voxel partition. The rollout ends when the remainder support becomes empty or reaches a fixed safety cap, allowing the number of generated parts to adapt to each object within that bound. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art geometry on PartObjaverse while preserving strong complete-object reconstruction after part assembly. Results on four dataset images, one text-to-image-generated input, and one real-world photograph further show fine-grained textured part decomposition beyond the benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SCULPT，一种面向部件感知 3D 生成的减式组合（subtractive composition）框架。给定结构化 3D 潜在空间中的完整物体，SCULPT 迭代使用联合分割预测器，将物体的一个部件和剩余部分一同生成，而不是在生成后拼接。预测器在两者原生稀疏 3D 支撑的并集上执行耦合去噪，允许相邻支撑重叠；rollout 在剩余支撑为空或达到安全上限时结束，使部件数量自适应。实验在 PartObjaverse 上取得领先几何质量，并在部件组装后保持强完整物体重建，还能处理真实照片和 text-to-image 输入。
Motivation: 现有部件感知 3D 生成要么在生成后再分割（固定了物体形状，部件边界后定），要么用预定义布局或 token 做加法式合成（部件边界易出现缝隙、互相穿插和材质不连续）。本文旨在让部件结构在原生生成循环内产生，同时避免加法方法中的边界问题。
Method: SCULPT 在结构化 3D 潜在空间中，给定完整物体，迭代应用联合分割预测器：每一步同时生成一个被提取的部件和剩余物体。预测器执行由图像和当前 3D 状态共同条件的耦合去噪过程，并在两者原生稀疏 3D 支撑的并集上处理输出，允许支撑重叠而非强制不相交体素划分。rollout 在剩余支撑为空或达到固定安全上限时停止。
Result: 摘要报告在 PartObjaverse 上达到最先进的几何质量，同时部件组装后保持强完整物体重建。对四个数据集图像、一个 text-to-image 生成的输入和一个真实世界照片的结果进一步展示了超出基准的细粒度带纹理部件分解。
Conclusion: 减式组合能够在生成过程中同时确定部件与剩余部分，避免加法式拼接的修复步骤，并自适应地决定每个物体的部件数量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DARTree: Speculative Diffusion Decoding with Autoregressive Draft Trees
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding losslessly accelerates autoregressive language models by verifying multiple draft tokens in parallel. Diffusion-based drafters further reduce proposal latency by predicting an entire token block in parallel, but their position-wise distributions are marginal rather than conditioned on tokens selected along each draft path. Existing recurrent correction incorporates causal information along a single draft chain, whereas diffusion-based tree construction broadens candidate coverage without carrying this correction along individual branches. We introduce DARTree, a training-free speculative decoding method that extends a pretrained AR correction head from chains to trees. DARTree first constructs a fixed-width candidate tree by expanding and scoring all nodes at each depth in a single batch, and then only applies best-first pruning to select the verification tree, decoupling AR-head inference from sequential heap operations. Across seven math, code, and chat benchmarks, DARTree achieves the highest average acceptance length and speedup in all four model--temperature configurations, accepting up to 12.97 tokens per verification round, 98.6\% more than DFlash and 27.9\% more than Domino in the same setting, and reaching up to 9.73$\times$ lossless speedup over locally measured autoregressive decoding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DARTree，一种无需训练的推测解码（speculative decoding）方法，将预训练的自回归（AR）修正头从单条草稿链扩展到候选树。它先在一个 batch 中扩展并评分每层所有节点，构建固定宽度候选树，再用最佳优先剪枝选出验证树，从而把 AR 头推理与顺序堆操作解耦。在七个数学、代码和聊天基准上，DARTree 在所有四种模型-温度配置中取得最高平均接受长度和加速比。
Motivation: 扩散式草稿器虽能并行预测整个 token 块，但其逐位置分布是边缘分布，而非沿每条草稿路径所选中 token 的条件分布；现有循环修正只在单链上引入因果信息，扩散式树构建虽扩大了候选覆盖，却未沿各分支携带这种修正。
Method: DARTree 先通过在同一 batch 中扩展和评分每个深度的所有节点构建固定宽度候选树，然后仅用最佳优先剪枝选择验证树，将 AR 修正头的推理与顺序堆操作解耦，实现从链到树的无训练扩展。
Result: 在七个数学、代码和聊天基准上，DARTree 在全部四种模型-温度配置中取得最高平均接受长度和加速比；每轮验证最多接受 12.97 个 token，比 DFlash 多 98.6%，比 Domino 多 27.9%，并相对本地测量的自回归解码达到最高 9.73 倍无损加速。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将 AR 修正头从链扩展到树，能够在保留扩散式树候选覆盖的同时，沿各分支引入条件修正，从而显著提升推测解码的验证效率与加速效果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Vero: Can AI Agents Build Formally Verified Software Repositories?
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are increasingly used for programming, but do not provide any guarantee on the correctness of generated code. Verified code generation, in which an agent produces both an implementation and a machine-checked proof of its specification, offers a stronger path toward trustworthy AI-generated software. Existing benchmarks in this direction either focus on individual functions or only evaluate proof generation with provided implementations. It is still an open question whether agents can make coherent implementation and proof choices across real multi-module codebases. To bridge this gap, we introduce Vero, the first benchmark to evaluate joint implementation and proof synthesis at the repository level. Vero contains 43 multi-module instances sourced from real-world repositories spanning Python, Dafny, Verus, and Coq, and covering diverse domains from cryptographic protocols to distributed systems. Each instance consists of a multi-module Lean 4 repository with predetermined API interfaces, manually curated formal specifications, and reference implementations, supporting both proof-only and code-and-proof evaluation modes. To improve benchmark reliability, Vero also includes an audit mechanism where agents are allowed to formally prove unsatisfiability of provided specification or incorrectness of reference code, which surfaces and corrects latent code and specification errors during curation. We evaluate frontier coding-agent configurations with Lean toolchain access. The strongest agent fully solves only 27 of 43 instances and closes no specifications on the hardest repositories. Vero provides a concrete testbed for measuring progress toward repository-scale verified software synthesis, where current agents still fall short. We release the benchmark, curation pipeline, and evaluation harness at https://github.com/sunblaze-ucb/vero.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Vero 是首个在仓库级别（repository level）评估联合实现与证明合成（joint implementation and proof synthesis）的基准。它包含 43 个来自真实仓库的多模块实例，涉及 Python、Dafny、Verus 和 Coq，每个实例是一个带预定义 API 接口、手工形式化规范和参考实现的 Lean 4 多模块仓库，支持仅证明与代码加证明两种评测模式。摘要报告最强的智能体配置只能完整解决 43 个实例中的 27 个，在最难的仓库上未能闭合任何规范。
Motivation: 现有 AI 编程智能体不提供生成代码的正确性保证，而已有验证代码生成基准要么聚焦单个函数，要么只评测给定实现下的证明生成，尚未考察智能体在真实多模块代码库中能否做出连贯的实现与证明选择。
Method: 引入 Vero 基准，包含 43 个来自真实仓库的多模块 Lean 4 实例，覆盖密码协议、分布式系统等多样领域；提供预定义 API 接口、手工形式化规范和参考实现，并设计了审计机制，允许智能体正式证明给定规范不可满足或参考代码不正确，从而暴露和纠正数据构建中的潜在错误。
Result: 对配备 Lean 工具链的前沿编码智能体配置进行评测，最强配置仅完整解决 43 个实例中的 27 个，在最难的仓库上没有任何规范被闭合。
Conclusion: 仓库规模的验证软件合成对当前智能体仍具挑战，Vero 提供了衡量该方向进展的具体测试平台，并开源了基准、构建流程和评测工具。

papers.title: Exponential quantum advantage for learning signals with a single qubit
papers.abstract_en: Quantum technology has the potential to transform scientific discovery, but quantum advantages often require processing capabilities well beyond the reach of experimental platforms. We show that coupling a single controllable qubit to an otherwise conventional sensor can exponentially reduce the number of measurements required to learn classical signals. These rigorous quantum advantages apply to fundamental sensing tasks, including learning Fourier coefficients, extracting temporal correlations from time-varying signals, and estimating transformations of physical observables. Using a superconducting cavity--qubit architecture, we experimentally demonstrate $10^7$-fold reductions in the number of measurements required for Fourier-amplitude and time-varying signal learning. Our $\textit{quantum feature sensing}$ algorithms further enable orders-of-magnitude improvements in simulations of weak-signal dark matter detection and wireless communication applications. These quantum advantages are derived from Quantum Phase-Space Inference (Q$Ψ$), a unifying theory of quantum-enhanced experiments that simultaneously converts a set of experimental objectives and constraints into tight lower bounds and optimal quantum-enhanced learning algorithms while producing a certificate of quantum advantage. Q$Ψ$ extends beyond the regimes captured by quantum Fisher information and provides a framework for systematically identifying rigorous quantum advantages in practical experimental tasks. Together, our results establish that near-term quantum technology can exponentially enhance our ability to learn from classical signals.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出量子特征感知 (quantum feature sensing) 算法，证明将单个可控 qubit 耦合到常规传感器可以指数级减少学习经典信号所需的测量次数。作者在超导腔-量子比特架构上实验演示了傅里叶幅度和时变信号学习任务中测量次数减少 10^7 倍，并引入量子相空间推断 (Quantum Phase-Space Inference, QΨ) 这一统一理论，用于将实验目标与约束转化为紧下界和最优量子增强学习算法。
Motivation: 量子优势往往需要远超现有实验平台的处理能力，限制了量子技术在实际科学发现中的应用。作者希望证明近端量子设备能在基础感知任务中提供严格且可验证的指数级优势。
Method: 提出 quantum feature sensing 算法，基于 QΨ 理论同时将一组实验目标和约束转化为紧下界与最优量子增强学习算法，并生成量子优势证书 (certificate of quantum advantage)。实验实现采用超导腔-量子比特架构。
Result: 摘要报告测量次数减少 10^7 倍，涵盖傅里叶幅度学习和时变信号学习；在弱信号暗物质探测仿真与无线通信应用中实现数量级改进。
Conclusion: 作者认为近端量子技术能够指数级增强我们从经典信号中学习的能力；QΨ 框架超越了量子 Fisher 信息 (quantum Fisher information) 的适用范围，可系统识别实际实验任务中的严格量子优势。

papers.title: The data geometry of masking diffusion: Certified-optimal schedules via unmasking growth complexity
papers.abstract_en: We study masking diffusion for discrete sampling and introduce a path-resolved measure of data geometry called the \emph{unmasking growth complexity} ({\textsf{UGC}\xspace}). Its local increments directly control Kullback--Leibler (KL) discretization error, yielding a unified analysis of Bernoulli-subset and fixed-cardinality unmasking schemes. In log-reveal-odds coordinates, this structure yields optimized single-block and multi-block schedules, and quantifies the gains from adapting computational effort to data geometry. Crucially, we show how {\textsf{UGC}\xspace} increments can be estimated from samples via KL increments along coupled reveal trajectories. This leads to \emph{certified-optimal} samplers that achieve a prescribed KL error with high probability and iteration complexity within a constant factor of the corresponding oracle procedure. Collapsing the \ugc path yields the aggregate {\textsf{UGC}\xspace} mass, which connects to classical multivariate dependence measures and complexity measures from previous analyses of discrete diffusion. In the fine-partition limit, the squared integral of the square-root {\textsf{UGC}\xspace} density determines the sharp leading-order optimal Euler discretization error. Examples exhibit substantial dimension-dependent gains over coarse schedules, including $\widetildeΩ(\sqrt{d})$ improvements achievable with a constant number of adaptively placed blocks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究用于离散采样的 masking diffusion，提出一种路径分解的数据几何度量 unmasking growth complexity (UGC)，其局部增量直接控制 Kullback-Leibler (KL) 离散化误差，并统一了 Bernoulli-subset 与固定基数 (fixed-cardinality) unmasking 方案的分析。在 log-reveal-odds 坐标下得到优化的单块与多块调度，并证明 UGC 增量可通过耦合揭示轨迹上的 KL 增量从样本中估计，从而构造 certified-optimal 采样器：以高概率达到指定 KL 误差，迭代复杂度与对应的 oracle 程序仅差常数因子。在细划分极限下，平方根 UGC 密度的平方积分决定最优 Euler 离散化误差的主导阶；示例显示相比粗调度存在维度相关的显著增益，包括常数个自适应放置块即可获得 ~Ω(√d) 的改进。
Motivation: 现有多数 masking diffusion 使用启发式或均匀调度，未针对数据几何调整计算量，导致 KL 离散化误差和迭代复杂度次优；需要一种路径层面的复杂度度量来统一分析并指导调度设计。
Method: 提出 UGC 作为路径分解的复杂度度量，利用其局部增量直接分析 KL 离散化误差；在 log-reveal-odds 坐标中推导单块与多块的最优调度，并通过耦合揭示轨迹估计 KL 增量来学习 UGC 增量，进而构建 certified-optimal 采样器。
Result: 摘要报告该采样器以高概率达到预设 KL 误差且迭代复杂度与 oracle 过程仅差常数因子；细划分极限下得到最优 Euler 离散化误差的尖锐主导阶，示例中常数个自适应块即可带来 ~Ω(√d) 的维度相关改进。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 UGC 作为路径测度统一了 Bernoulli-subset 与固定基数 unmasking 的分析，其聚合形式 (aggregate UGC mass) 与经典多元依赖测度及此前离散扩散分析的复杂度测度相衔接。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Intervention-Aware Clinical World Model for Post-Op Outcome Forecasting in Cardiology
papers.abstract_en: Many clinical prediction models treat post-intervention outcomes as a one-step mapping from baseline measurements to a future endpoint. However, recovery after a procedure often unfolds as an irregular trajectory: clinical observations, medication changes, repeat interventions, and physiological measurements are recorded asynchronously and can change risk assessment over time. We propose an intervention-aware clinical world model that represents each patient with a structured latent state and evolves it through time-ordered post-intervention events. The model first encodes baseline imaging into a 3D spatial latent state. It then updates this state using procedural context, static covariates, elapsed time, and peri-event physiological embeddings. Follow-up imaging provides training-only supervision through a latent forecasting objective. We apply the framework to atrial fibrillation ablation. During the 90-day recovery window, irregular post-procedure records provide clinically meaningful evidence for long-term recurrence risk. In repeated internal cross-validation on DECAAF-II, our model achieves AUROC 0.756 and AUPRC 0.777 for recurrence prediction. It also achieves a scar-extent MAE of 2.971 percentage points without requiring follow-up MRI intensities at inference. The learned state supports recurrence-risk queries at different horizons and retrospective input editing of blanking-period records.
papers.comment: Medical World Models (MWM) Workshop at MICCAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个干预感知的临床世界模型 (intervention-aware clinical world model)，用于心脏病学术后结局预测。模型将患者表示为一个结构化隐状态，并通过时间排序的术后事件逐步演化：基线影像被编码为 3D 空间隐状态，再结合手术上下文、静态协变量、经过时间和围事件生理嵌入进行更新，随访影像仅作为训练阶段的隐式预测监督。作者将该框架应用于心房颤动消融，在 DECAAF-II 数据集的重复内部交叉验证中，复发预测达到 AUROC 0.756、AUPRC 0.777，且无需随访 MRI 强度即实现疤痕范围 MAE 2.971 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有临床预测模型通常把术后结局看作从基线测量到未来端点的单步映射，但实际术后恢复是异步、不规则记录的轨迹，包含用药变化、重复干预和生理测量，这些会随时间改变风险估计。
Method: 提出一种干预感知的临床世界模型，先用基线影像编码得到 3D 空间隐状态，再用时序术后事件（程序上下文、静态协变量、经过时间、围事件生理嵌入）逐步更新状态；训练时用随访影像构造隐式预测目标，推理时无需随访影像。
Result: 在 DECAAF-II 数据集的重复内部交叉验证中，90 天恢复窗内的不规则术后记录为长期复发风险提供临床证据，模型复发预测 AUROC 0.756、AUPRC 0.777；疤痕范围 MAE 为 2.971 个百分点，推理时不需随访 MRI 强度。学习的隐状态还支持不同时间范围的风险查询与回顾性输入编辑。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架能利用不规则术后记录改进心房颤动消融后的复发风险预测，并可在无需随访影像的情况下进行推理；该工作属于医学世界模型方向。

papers.title: DFM Mimir v1: An Open HRM Delivering Frontier Performance at 1B Parameters Using Only Permissible Post-Training Data
papers.abstract_en: Current large language model development relies on massive, often non-permissible datasets, creating a high barrier for researchers committed to open-source and ethically sourced data. We introduce Mimir v1, a 1-billion-parameter language model based on the Hierarchical Reasoning Model (HRM) architecture, that is trained from scratch and delivers highly competitive performance for English and sets a new state of the art for Danish using only permissible post-training data. Trained on a mixture of 161 datasets, Mimir v1 outperforms the original HRM-Text 1B and competes with larger frontier models like Qwen 3.5 4B and Gemma 4 E2B, tested across 20 benchmarks for English, Math & Code and Danish. The model is available on the Hugging Face Hub: https://huggingface.co/danish-foundation-models/DFM-Mimir
papers.comment: Technical Report, 20 Pages, 1 Model, Hierarchical Reasoning Model
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Mimir v1，一个 10 亿参数、基于 Hierarchical Reasoning Model (HRM) 架构的语言模型，从零训练，仅使用允许再分发的后训练数据。模型在 161 个数据集的混合上训练，在 20 个英语、数学与代码、丹麦语基准上超越原 HRM-Text 1B，并与 Qwen 3.5 4B、Gemma 4 E2B 等更大规模模型竞争，且在丹麦语上达到新的 SOTA。模型已发布在 Hugging Face Hub。
Motivation: 当前大语言模型开发依赖大规模且通常不允许再使用的数据集，给坚持开源和伦理数据来源的研究者制造了高门槛。论文目标是证明仅使用许可数据也能训练出具有竞争力性能的模型。
Method: 提出基于 HRM 架构的 10 亿参数模型 Mimir v1，从零开始训练，后训练数据仅使用来自 161 个数据集的混合，且全部来自允许再分发的来源。
Result: 在 20 个英语、数学与代码、丹麦语基准上，Mimir v1 超越原 HRM-Text 1B，并与 Qwen 3.5 4B、Gemma 4 E2B 等更大规模的前沿模型竞争；在丹麦语上设定新的 SOTA。
Conclusion: 论文表明，仅使用许可的后训练数据即可在 10 亿参数规模获得有竞争力的性能，从而降低开源与伦理数据研究者的进入门槛。

papers.title: Bagging Robustly Learns VC Classes with Linear Sample Complexity
papers.abstract_en: We revisit the problem of learning predictors robust to adversarial examples at test-time. We prove that VC classes are adversarially robustly learnable with sample complexity linear in the VC dimension $d$, providing an exponential improvement over the previous upper bound of Montasser, Hanneke, and Srebro (2019). Remarkably, this result is achieved with a simple improper algorithm that combines the classic heuristic bagging (bootstrap aggregation) of Breiman (1996) with robust empirical risk minimization (RERM). Our algorithm computes RERMs on $O(d^\star)$ independent bootstrap samples and outputs their majority vote, where $d^\star$ denotes the dual VC dimension. We complement this result with a lower bound showing that this is unavoidable: in general, any learner in this oracle model requires $Ω(d^\star)$ calls to an RERM oracle, even when given arbitrarily many training examples.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新考察测试时对抗扰动鲁棒预测器的学习问题，证明 VC 类可以用线性于 VC 维 d 的样本复杂度实现对抗鲁棒学习，相比 Montasser、Hanneke 和 Srebro (2019) 的上界呈指数级改进。该结果由一个简单的非正当 (improper) 算法达成：在 O(d^star) 个独立 bootstrap 样本上计算鲁棒经验风险最小化 (RERM)，再输出多数投票，其中 d^star 为对偶 VC 维。作者还给出匹配下界，说明该 oracle 模型下任何学习器都需要 Ω(d^star) 次 RERM 调用，即使训练样本任意多。
Motivation: 对抗鲁棒学习的样本复杂度此前上界过松，Montasser 等人 (2019) 的结果可能随 VC 维呈指数增长，本文目标是证明更紧的线性上界。
Method: 提出将 Breiman (1996) 的 bagging（自举聚合）启发式与 RERM 相结合的算法：对 O(d^star) 个独立 bootstrap 样本分别运行 RERM，并对其输出进行多数投票。
Result: 证明 VC 类的对抗鲁棒学习样本复杂度为线性于 VC 维 d，较此前上界指数改进；同时给出下界，说明在该 oracle 模型中 Ω(d^star) 次 RERM 调用不可避免。
Conclusion: 摘要强调简单的 bagging 加 RERM 多数投票即能达到线性样本复杂度，且下界表明这种 oracle 调用次数是本质必需的。

papers.title: TabSOM: A tabular-to-image encoding method based on self-organizing maps
papers.abstract_en: Tabular-to-image methods have emerged as novel approaches to leverage the high predictive performance of convolutional neural networks and vision transformers. They convert tabular data into image representations, mapping each feature at a fixed pixel location derived from a dimensionality-reduction method (e.g., t-SNE, UMAP, PCA). However, they encode only the marginal value of each feature and discard information about feature relationships. We propose TabSOM, a tabular-to-image encoding built on the Self-Organizing Map (SOM), which provides: (i) a spatial layout in which every input feature occupies a fixed canvas position derived from its component plane via collision-free Hungarian assignment; and (ii) a graph that captures pairwise feature relationships derived from the SOM component planes. The resulting image stacks two multi-scale node channels: one encodes feature values at fixed scales, while the other encodes pairwise feature interactions as spatial connections between related features. Two SOM-derived interpretability approaches are introduced: a prototype-inspired partial dependence plot and a class--separation importance score. Benchmarked against twelve existing tabular-to-image methods across public binary-classification datasets, TabSOM ranks first or second on every dataset and achieves the lowest variance of any method evaluated. Interpretability obtained with TabSOM was validated against Random Forest, XGBoost, and SHAP, the class-separation score shows reasonable agreement with established baselines on the top-ranked features while capturing complementary structural information from input data. These results demonstrate that TabSOM provides an effective and interpretable approach for applying deep learning architectures to tabular data, bridging the performance--interpretability gap in this domain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TabSOM，一种基于自组织映射 (Self-Organizing Map) 的表格数据到图像编码方法。它通过无碰撞匈牙利分配将每个输入特征映射到固定画布位置，并利用 SOM 分量平面构造特征关系图；生成的图像堆叠两个多尺度节点通道，分别编码特征值和特征间交互。在十二种已有表格转图像方法对比中，TabSOM 在每个公开二分类数据集上排名第一或第二，并具有最低方差；其提出的两类可解释性方法与 Random Forest、XGBoost、SHAP 相对照，类分离重要性分数在 top 特征上与基线一致，同时捕获补充的结构信息。
Motivation: 现有表格转图像方法 (如基于 t-SNE、UMAP、PCA) 只编码每个特征的边际值，丢弃了特征间关系信息，限制了深度架构在表格数据上的表现与可解释性。
Method: 提出基于 SOM 的编码框架，包含：利用分量平面的无碰撞匈牙利分配确定特征固定位置；由 SOM 分量平面构造捕获两两特征关系的图；堆叠两个多尺度节点通道，分别编码特征值及空间连接表示的交互。另提出两个 SOM 衍生的可解释性工具，即原型启发的部分依赖图和类分离重要性分数。
Result: 在公开二分类数据集上对标十二种已有表格转图像方法，TabSOM 在每个数据集上排名第一或第二，且方差最低；类分离分数与 Random Forest、XGBoost 和 SHAP 在 top 特征上具有合理一致性，并额外捕捉输入数据的结构信息。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 TabSOM 为将深度学习架构应用于表格数据提供了有效且可解释的路径，弥合了该领域的性能与可解释性差距。

papers.title: On the Structural Limits of Machine Learning Decision Systems: An Information-Theoretic, Interaction-Based, and Stochastic-Dynamical Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning procedures are commonly evaluated in terms of predictive accuracy and computational efficiency. However, their achievable performance is fundamentally constrained by structural properties of the underlying data-generating process, which are formalized in terms of informational bounds. In this work we examine intrinsic limits of data-driven decision systems from an information-theoretic and interaction-based perspective. We analyze minimal achievable error in classification through Fano-type bounds and precision limits in parametric estimation via the Cramér-Rao inequality, emphasizing that such limits depend on the underlying model rather than on algorithmic sophistication alone. We further discuss how implicit assumptions, such as independence, ergodicity, and distributional stability, affect the validity of inferential procedures. Building on interaction-based modeling principles, we review typical frameworks such as Markov Random Fields and potential based representations for encoding dependence mechanisms. We also describe decision systems, including LLM-integrated agent architectures, as feedback-driven stochastic processes where state-dependent dynamics may induce emergent macroscopic behavior. This perspective highlights the importance of having adequate models for the data as a prerequi- site for expanding predictive capability, and situates algorithmic learning within the informational limits imposed by the models.
papers.journal_ref: JAIIO 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从信息论与交互视角考察机器学习决策系统的内在结构极限，而非仅以预测精度和计算效率评价。作者通过 Fano 型下界分析分类的最小可达误差，用 Cramér-Rao 不等式刻画参数估计的精度极限，并指出这些极限由底层数据生成模型决定，而非算法复杂度。文章还讨论独立性、遍历性和分布稳定性等隐式假设对推断有效性的影响，并回顾 Markov Random Field 与势函数表示等交互建模框架，最后将含 LLM 集成智能体的决策系统视为反馈驱动的随机过程。
Motivation: 现有机器学习评估通常只关注预测精度与计算效率，却忽略了数据生成过程的结构属性对可实现性能的根本约束；作者希望明确这类信息论层面的内在边界。
Method: 采用信息论与交互建模相结合的分析框架：利用 Fano 型不等式推导分类误差下界，利用 Cramér-Rao 不等式推导参数估计精度极限；考察独立性、遍历性、分布稳定性等隐式假设；基于交互建模原则综述 Markov Random Field 及势函数表示；并将决策系统建模为状态依赖的反馈随机过程。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值实验，核心结果是理论层面的：最小分类误差与参数估计精度受制于模型本身的信息结构，算法优化只能在既定信息界内发挥作用。
Conclusion: 作者强调为数据建立恰当模型是扩展预测能力的前提，算法学习应被定位于模型所施加的信息极限之内；该视角对理解 LLM 集成代理等复杂决策系统的涌现宏观行为具有指导意义。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Equivariant learning of a transferable three-dimensional classical density functional
papers.abstract_en: Liquids exhibit collective behavior that depends sensitively on thermodynamic conditions, interfaces and confinement, yet predicting each new state commonly requires a separate atomistic simulation. Classical density functional theory offers a reusable variational description, but its central excess free-energy functional is generally unknown, and learned approximations have largely remained restricted to planar or lower-dimensional settings. Here we show that this functional can be learned directly from fully three-dimensional equilibrium density fields while preserving spatial symmetry and variational consistency, without free-energy or chemical-potential labels. A single learned functional transfers across temperatures, system sizes and statistical ensembles, and recovers structure factors, the equation of state, liquid--vapor coexistence and interfacial broadening, none of which are used as training targets. Applied to complex three-dimensional geometries, it predicts the non-monotonic force associated with formation and rupture of a solvent-depleted bridge between colloids and adsorption in an interconnected gyroid pore. These results demonstrate that equilibrium density data can be converted into a transferable thermodynamic generator connecting microscopic liquid structure to response, phase behavior and collective phenomena.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出直接从三维平衡密度场学习经典密度泛函理论（classical density functional theory）中的过剩自由能泛函，保持空间对称性和变分一致性，且不需要自由能或化学势标签。学到的单一泛函可跨温度、系统尺寸和统计系综迁移，恢复结构因子、状态方程、液-汽共存和界面展宽等未作为训练目标的性质。在复杂三维几何下，它还能预测胶体间溶剂耗尽桥形成与断裂的非单调力以及互连 gyroid 孔中的吸附。
Motivation: 液体的集体行为对热力学条件、界面和限制非常敏感，但预测每个新状态通常需要单独的原子模拟；经典密度泛函理论提供可复用的变分描述，而其核心的过剩自由能泛函一般未知，已有的学习近似大多局限于平面或低维情形。
Method: 直接从全三维平衡密度场学习该自由能泛函，同时保持空间对称性与变分一致性，训练无需自由能或化学势标签。
Result: 单个学到的泛函可迁移到不同温度、系统尺寸和统计系综，并恢复结构因子、状态方程、液-汽共存和界面展宽等未被用作训练目标的性质；在复杂三维几何中可预测溶剂耗尽桥的非单调力与 gyroid 孔中的吸附。
Conclusion: 摘要表明平衡密度数据可转化为可迁移的热力学生成器，将微观液体结构连接到响应、相行为和集体现象；摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: Intern-S2-Preview: Scientific Agentic Foundation Model
papers.abstract_en: Scientific discovery increasingly requires AI systems that can reason over scientific evidence of heterogeneous modalities, interact with scientific tools and environments, and sustain progress across long task horizons. We present Intern-S2-Preview, a series of scientific agentic foundation models designed to support multimodal scientific understanding, reasoning, generation, and long-horizon tasks. The training pipeline begins with scientific multimodal pre-training over rendered scientific documents, interleaved image-text data, and diverse scientific corpora. Starting from the pretrained checkpoint, we apply a unified post-training pipeline consisting of supervised fine-tuning, scalable multi-task reinforcement learning (RL), black- and white-box agentic RL, and on-policy distillation. This pipeline is supported by practical techniques that improve rollout and training stability and efficiency, including partial rollout with off-policy correction, adaptive length regularization, online speculative decoding, robust multi-task optimization, and trace-aware experience assembly for agentic tasks. At the architecture level, Intern-S2-Preview-397B extends time series modelling from efficient long-sequence understanding to numerical forecasting, while Memory Decoder is studied as a separate memory-augmented path for rapid scientific specialization without modifying the frozen 397B backbone. Evaluations across scientific, multimodal, agentic, and general-purpose benchmarks show that Intern-S2-Preview-397B achieves competitive or leading results in multiple settings. The time series modules improve scientific signal understanding and forecasting on SciTS, while the separate Intern-MemDec-4B extension improves the Biology-Instructions average score from 56.92 to 60.32 without modifying the frozen 397B backbone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Intern-S2-Preview 系列科学智能体基础模型，面向多模态科学理解、推理、生成与长周期任务。训练从科学多模态预训练出发，经过包含监督微调、可扩展多任务强化学习、黑盒/白盒智能体强化学习以及 on-policy 蒸馏的统一后训练流水线，并辅以部分 rollout、自适应长度正则、在线投机解码等稳定性技术。摘要报告 397B 模型在科学、多模态、智能体及通用基准上取得有竞争力或领先结果，时间序列模块提升 SciTS 上的科学信号理解与预测，另立的 Intern-MemDec-4B 扩展在不改动冻结 397B 主干的情况下提升 Biology-Instructions 平均分。
Motivation: 科学发现要求 AI 系统能对异质模态科学证据进行推理、与科学工具和环境交互，并在长任务跨度内持续推进；现有模型在这些科学智能体能力上仍显不足。
Method: 提出科学多模态预训练加统一后训练的流水线：先对渲染科学文档、交错图文数据与科学语料预训练，再执行 SFT、多任务 RL、黑盒/白盒智能体 RL 和 on-policy 蒸馏。配套技术包括 partial rollout 与 off-policy correction、自适应长度正则、在线投机解码、鲁棒多任务优化以及面向智能体任务的 trace-aware experience assembly。架构层面，397B 模型将时间序列建模扩展至数值预测，Memory Decoder 作为独立记忆增强路径，在冻结 397B 主干下实现快速科学特化。
Result: Intern-S2-Preview-397B 在科学、多模态、智能体和通用基准上取得有竞争力或领先结果；时间序列模块改善 SciTS 上的科学信号理解与预测；独立扩展 Intern-MemDec-4B 将 Biology-Instructions 平均分从 56.92 提升至 60.32，且未修改冻结的 397B 主干。
Conclusion: 摘要强调大规模预训练配合统一后训练流水线可构建通用科学智能体基础模型，Memory Decoder 路径能以低成本支持科学领域特化；摘要未涉及降水、天气等具体领域应用。
Relevance: 45

papers.title: Sparse Orthogonal Regression Technique: A Spectral Framework for Equation Discovery, Approximation, and Integration
papers.abstract_en: We develop the Sparse Orthogonal Regression Technique (SORT), a sparse spectral framework for learning orthonormal-basis expansions from noisy and irregularly sampled data. SORT estimates expansion coefficients directly from observations using L1-regularized regression, avoiding explicit quadrature or analytic inner-product evaluation. The central application is data-driven discovery of ordinary differential equations: vector fields are represented in chosen orthogonal bases and learned as sparse coefficient expansions. This provides a complementary route to symbolic regression, grammar-based discovery, and SINDy-style sparse identification by first recovering a compact spectral representation, which can later guide searches for simpler analytic forms. Across the dynamical-system experiments, SORT matches or improves upon library-based sparse-regression baselines when the basis is well adapted to the problem, and shows more stable degradation under sparse sampling, noisy derivative estimates, and representation mismatch. Specific examples illustrate why this representation is useful: if a finite library misses the problem-specific nonlinearity, the resulting model can fail. SORT is not immune to mismatch, but it shifts the problem away from brittle selection among generic terms to basis design adapted to the problem domain. The experiments also show that dominant low-order coefficients persist as model order increases, supporting order-consistent model growth. Beyond equation discovery, the same learned expansion supports nonlinear approximation and estimation of complex, high-dimensional integrals by coefficient readout. Overall, SORT provides a reusable intermediate representation for system identification, approximation, and integration, while making basis design an explicit part of the scientific modeling problem.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 4 figures. Accepted for oral presentation at the 29th International Conference on Discovery Science (DS 2026), Mainz, Germany, October 5-9, 2026. To appear in Springer Lecture Notes in Computer Science (LNCS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出稀疏正交回归技术 (Sparse Orthogonal Regression Technique, SORT)，一种从含噪且非均匀采样的数据中学习标准正交基展开的稀疏谱框架。SORT 直接用 L1 正则化回归从观测中估计展开系数，避免显式求积或解析内积计算；其核心应用是从数据中发现常微分方程，把向量场表示为稀疏系数展开，为符号回归、文法发现和 SINDy 式稀疏辨识提供补充路线。实验表明，在基函数与问题适配时 SORT 可匹配或优于基于库的稀疏回归基线，并且在稀疏采样、含噪导数估计和表示失配下退化更稳定。
Motivation: 现有方程发现方法依赖预先给定的有限候选库，一旦库中缺失问题特定的非线性项，模型就会失效；符号回归和文法类方法也存在选择脆弱性问题。作者希望先恢复紧凑的谱表示，再把基设计显式纳入科学建模问题。
Method: SORT 从噪声和不规则采样数据中直接通过 L1 正则化回归估计正交基展开系数，绕过显式求积或解析内积；向量场在选定正交基下表示并学习为稀疏系数展开，所获谱表示可作为后续寻找更简单解析形式的中间步骤。
Result: 在动力学系统实验中，当基函数与问题适配时 SORT 匹配或优于基于库的稀疏回归基线；在稀疏采样、含噪导数估计和表示失配下退化更稳定。实验还显示主导的低阶系数随模型阶数增加而保持，支持阶数一致的模型生长，并表明同一展开可用于非线性逼近和高维积分估计。
Conclusion: SORT 为系统辨识、逼近和积分提供了一种可复用的中间表示，同时把基设计变成科学建模问题中的显式部分；它对表示失配并非免疫，但把问题从脆弱的一般项选择转移到适应问题域的基设计上。

papers.title: GS$^{2}$CI: Robust Gaussian Splatting For Snapshot Compressive Imaging via Large Vision Model Priors
papers.abstract_en: Snapshot Compressive Imaging (SCI) offers an efficient solution for high-speed video acquisition and, under exposure-time camera--scene relative motion, multi-view scene capture by compressing temporal or spatial information into a single 2D measurement. While recent studies have explored SCI for 3D scene reconstruction, existing methods struggle with significant challenges due to information loss, limited viewpoint diversity, and the computational burden of jointly optimizing 3D representations and camera poses. In this work, we propose a novel framework that reconstructs high-quality 3D scenes from a single SCI measurement by leveraging 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) and the powerful priors of large-scale vision foundation models (VFMs). Our primary reconstruction combines measurement-derived 3D VFM initialization with SCI-aware Gaussian optimization. After coarse-stage convergence, an auxiliary 2D VFM provides pseudo-view supervision at synthesized viewpoints for local appearance refinement. To further address the instability caused by ambiguous SCI supervision during 3DGS optimization, we introduce Opacity-Guided Splitting and Growth Regulation (OSGR), an SCI-specific densification strategy that augments split candidates using local opacity statistics, discourages loss-compensating opacity inflation through mean-opacity regulation, and bounds representation growth with explicit candidate-ratio and Gaussian-count constraints. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves the strongest overall performance, combining leading reconstruction quality and robustness to viewpoint variation with competitive computational efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GS$^2$CI，一种从单次快照压缩成像 (SCI) 测量重建高质量 3D 场景的框架，结合 3D 高斯泼溅 (3DGS) 与大规模视觉基础模型 (VFM) 先验。重建流程先利用测量导出的 3D VFM 初始化并进行 SCI 感知的高斯优化，粗阶段收敛后再用 2D VFM 在合成视点提供伪监督以细化局部外观。针对 SCI 监督模糊导致的不稳定，作者提出 Opacity-Guided Splitting and Growth Regulation (OSGR) 稠密化策略。多基准实验表明该方法在重建质量和视角鲁棒性上取得最强综合性能，同时计算效率具有竞争力。
Motivation: 现有将 SCI 用于 3D 场景重建的研究受制于信息丢失、视角多样性有限，以及联合优化 3D 表示与相机位姿带来的计算负担等显著挑战。
Method: 主要重建阶段使用测量导出的 3D VFM 初始化，并结合 SCI 感知的高斯优化；粗阶段收敛后，辅助 2D VFM 在合成视点提供伪视图监督进行局部外观细化。另提出 OSGR 稠密化策略：用局部不透明度统计扩充分裂候选，通过均值不透明度正则抑制损失补偿式的透明度膨胀，并以候选比例和高斯数量约束限制表示增长。
Result: 在多个基准上的大量实验表明，该方法取得最强的综合性能，兼具领先的重建质量、对视角变化的鲁棒性，以及有竞争力的计算效率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调结合 3DGS 与大规模 VFM 先验可以从单个 SCI 测量重建高质量 3D 场景，并将 OSGR 作为应对 SCI 监督不稳定性的关键组件。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TraVEL: Trajectory-Guided Video Embedding Learning for Driving-Video Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Efficiently retrieving relevant clips from large-scale driving logs is essential for data curation, model development, and safety analysis. Structured and rule-based retrieval systems can explicitly target driving events, but typically require expert-defined rules, auxiliary data, and multi-stage perception pipelines. Multimodal embedding models offer a simpler and more efficient alternative by representing each video with a single searchable vector. However, general-purpose models often rely on shortcuts from static scene context and struggle to distinguish motion-centric events, such as turning left versus right or accelerating versus decelerating. In this work, we study how to adapt a general-purpose multimodal embedding model to driving-video retrieval. We first fine-tune Qwen3-VL-Embedding on paired clips and reasoning traces from nuReasoning using an InfoNCE objective. While this stage substantially improves overall retrieval, caption supervision alone remains insufficient for fine-grained motion understanding. We therefore introduce TraVEL (Trajectory-Guided Video Embedding Learning), a motion-aware fine-tuning framework that uses ego-trajectory similarity as a reward within Group Relative Policy Optimization. Trajectories serve only as privileged training supervision; retrieval still operates on single-vector video embeddings without ego poses, expert rules, or auxiliary perception outputs. We further construct a driving-video retrieval benchmark from nuReasoning. Experiments show that TraVEL improves motion-centric retrieval across model scales: relative to SFT, it raises longitudinal and lateral mAP by 9.8 and 4.7 points at 2B, with corresponding gains of 7.2 and 1.5 points at 8B. TraVEL thus combines physically grounded supervision with efficient embedding-based search.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何将通用多模态嵌入模型适配到驾驶视频检索任务。作者先以 InfoNCE 目标在 nuReasoning 的成对片段和推理轨迹上微调 Qwen3-VL-Embedding，再提出 TraVEL（Trajectory-Guided Video Embedding Learning）：在 Group Relative Policy Optimization 中将自车轨迹相似度作为奖励，轨迹仅在训练阶段作为监督信号，推理时仍只用单向量视频嵌入，无需自车位姿、专家规则或辅助感知输出。作者基于 nuReasoning 构建了驾驶视频检索基准，实验显示相对 SFT，TraVEL 在 2B 规模上纵向和横向 mAP 分别提升 9.8 与 4.7 点，8B 规模上分别提升 7.2 与 1.5 点。
Motivation: 通用嵌入模型容易依赖静态场景上下文的捷径，难以区分左转与右转、加速与减速这类以运动为中心的事件；而规则式检索系统需要专家规则、辅助数据和多阶段感知流程。仅靠字幕监督不足以支撑细粒度的运动理解。
Method: 首先用 nuReasoning 的成对片段与推理轨迹通过 InfoNCE 微调 Qwen3-VL-Embedding；随后提出 TraVEL，在 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）中以自车轨迹相似度作为奖励进行运动感知微调。轨迹是训练阶段独有的特权监督（privileged supervision），检索时仍使用单向量视频嵌入，不需要自车位姿或辅助感知输出。
Result: 作者从 nuReasoning 构造了驾驶视频检索基准。实验表明 TraVEL 在模型规模上一致提升运动中心检索：相对 SFT，2B 模型的纵向与横向 mAP 分别提高 9.8 和 4.7 点，8B 模型分别提高 7.2 和 1.5 点。
Conclusion: TraVEL 将物理上有根据的轨迹监督与高效的基于嵌入的检索结合，能够在不同模型规模下改善以运动为中心的驾驶视频检索。

papers.title: Paleoclimate Boundary Conditions as an Out-of-Sample Test for the Forced Response of Ocean Climate Emulators
papers.abstract_en: AI weather emulators benefit from clear objectives and metrics, which have led to the rapid development of models that outperform traditional benchmarks. In contrast, long-term climate emulators must reliably reproduce forced responses over months to centuries, while relying on training objectives that span a small number of model time steps. We assess autoregressive, full-depth ocean emulators using data from the midHolocene experiment of a numerical climate model to examine their skill in responding to surface forcings from an in-distribution, out-of-sample climate. We demonstrate that these emulators generalize to new orbital forcings, reproducing the spatial structure of the large-scale response as well as changes in seasonal patterns and in the spatial structure of ocean variability, while underestimating their amplitude. Baselines that infer the ocean state directly from the boundary forcings also recover much of the large-scale pattern, but only near the surface, and capture neither the seasonal nor the variability changes, indicating that these require some representation of dynamics. Despite these successes, the emulators fail to reproduce the slow, internally driven evolution of the ocean interior. We then show that the emulators' total forced response is well reconstructed by linearly composing their independent responses to each forcing component. Tracking response across training epochs, we find that convergence on mean state metrics in the training climate does not guarantee that the emulators capture the dynamics necessary for a skillful response. Together, these experiments establish the midHolocene as a controlled, ground-truthed setting for diagnosing forced-response failures before emulators are pushed to out-of-distribution climates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估自回归、全深度海洋仿真器（ocean emulators）在 out-of-sample 气候下的强迫响应能力，使用数值气候模型的 midHolocene 实验数据作为测试。结果表明这些仿真器能泛化到新的轨道强迫，再现大尺度响应的空间结构以及季节和变率变化，但低估了振幅；基线模型只能恢复近地面的大尺度模态。作者还发现仿真器无法重现海洋内部的缓慢、内驱演变，且其总强迫响应可由各强迫分量的独立响应线性叠加近似。
Motivation: 长期气候仿真器必须可靠再现数月到世纪的强迫响应，但训练目标只覆盖少数模型时间步；缺乏清晰的 out-of-sample 测试来诊断其强迫响应能力。
Method: 使用 midHolocene 实验数据作为受控的 out-of-sample 测试，评估自回归、全深度海洋仿真器对不同表面强迫的响应；同时对比直接由边界强迫推断海洋状态的基线，并分析跨训练 epoch 的响应收敛行为以及各强迫分量响应的线性组合。
Result: 仿真器能再现大尺度响应的空间结构、季节性变化和海洋变率空间结构的变化，但低估振幅；基线只能恢复近地表的大尺度模态，无法捕捉季节和变率变化；仿真器无法重现海洋内部慢速的内驱演变。
Conclusion: 作者提出 midHolocene 实验可作为受控、有真值的环境，用于在将仿真器推向 out-of-distribution 气候之前诊断其强迫响应失败；并指出训练气候下平均态指标的收敛并不保证仿真器掌握实现熟练响应所需的动力学。

papers.title: AlayaWorld: Interactive Long-Horizon World Modeling - Full Technical Report (v1.1)
papers.abstract_en: This report presents an improved version of AlayaWorld. While the backbone architecture, chunk-wise autoregressive generation scheme, and training data remain unchanged from the previous release, we substantially revise how conditioning signals are represented and integrated into the model. The new design is guided by a simple principle: conditioning signals should match the generated content as closely as possible in both latent representation and temporal structure. To this end, we make two major changes. First, we replace the previous depth-warping-based spatial memory with a streaming 3D point-cache renderer. Second, we redesign the conditioning pipeline so that visual conditions are encoded in the same causal-VAE latent space, with temporal statistics consistent with those of the generated video. Concretely, the new version introduces six modifications: (1) replacing static-frame image conditioning with motion-aware latent conditioning; (2) causally encoding re-rendered spatial memory as a continuous sequence; (3) aligning the temporal-memory window in pixel space; (4) adopting hard memory dropout that removes memory tokens rather than zeroing them; (5) unifying the VAE encoding and decoding protocol across training and inference; and (6) removing the camera AdaLN branch, such that viewpoint control is provided entirely through the re-rendered spatial condition.
papers.comment: Authors are listed alphabetically by the first name and their role. See the contribution section for details
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是 AlayaWorld 的完整技术报告 v1.1，介绍在保持骨干架构、分块自回归生成 (chunk-wise autoregressive) 和训练数据不变的前提下，对条件信号表示与融合方式的系统性修订。核心原则是让条件信号在潜表示和时间结构上与生成内容尽量对齐；具体做法是用流式 3D 点缓存渲染器替换基于深度扭曲 (depth-warping) 的空间记忆，并重新设计条件管线，使视觉条件与生成视频共享 causal-VAE 潜空间和时间统计。摘要列出六项具体修改，未报告定量实验指标。
Motivation: 此前版本中条件信号与生成内容在潜表示和时间结构上的一致性不足，导致条件信息难以充分约束长时程 (long-horizon) 交互式世界生成。
Method: 提出六项修改：(1) 用运动感知的潜在条件 (motion-aware latent conditioning) 替代静态帧图像条件；(2) 将重新渲染的空间记忆因果编码为连续序列；(3) 在像素空间对齐时间记忆窗口；(4) 采用硬记忆 dropout，删除记忆 token 而非置零；(5) 统一训练与推理时的 VAE 编解码协议；(6) 移除相机 AdaLN 分支，使视点控制完全由重渲染的空间条件提供。整体架构、分块自回归生成方案和训练数据保持不变。
Conclusion: 摘要强调条件信号应与生成内容在潜表示和时间结构上尽可能匹配，并通过六项修改落实这一原则；摘要未给出实验评估或局限性说明。

papers.title: DreamX-Phi 1.0: Action-Conditioned Video World Model for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: We present \textbf{DreamX-Phi 1.0}, an action-conditioned video world model for robotic manipulation that, given an observed frame, a language instruction, and a prescribed action sequence comprising end-effector poses and gripper states, predicts the resulting future observations. Yet realism alone does not guarantee faithfulness: a convincing rollout can still move the wrong arm or lose the manipulated object. To ensure the prediction respects each arm's commanded path, we inject per-arm $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ transformations into attention via \textbf{PRoPE-style geometric encoding}, preserving arm identity and rigid-motion structure. Action control alone does not fully constrain scene geometry or the evolution of small manipulated objects. We therefore add a lightweight \textbf{depth branch} for scene-level geometry and use \textbf{SAM3 masks} with a frozen \textbf{V-JEPA teacher} to maintain object consistency throughout grasping. We further distill the multi-step generator into a few-step student via distribution-matching distillation for efficient deployment. At the time of writing, \model{} achieves first place on Track~1 and second place on Track~2 of the WorldArena~2.0 Challenge. Our model and code will be publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DreamX-Phi 1.0，一个用于机器人操作的动作条件视频世界模型 (action-conditioned video world model)。给定观测帧、语言指令以及包含末端执行器姿态和夹爪状态的动作序列，模型预测未来观测。为让预测遵守每条手臂的指令路径，作者将逐臂 SE(3) 变换通过 PRoPE 风格的几何编码注入注意力；并加入轻量深度分支和 SAM3 掩码、冻结的 V-JEPA teacher 来维持场景几何与被抓取物体的一致性。最后用分布匹配蒸馏将多步生成器蒸馏为少步学生模型以高效部署。在 WorldArena 2.0 Challenge 中取得 Track 1 第一、Track 2 第二。
Motivation: 真实感并不保证保真度：仅逼真的 rollout 仍可能移动错误的手臂或丢失被操作物体，而动作控制本身也不能完全约束场景几何和细小物体的演变。这对机器人操作中视频预测的可信度构成关键问题。
Method: 提出动作条件视频世界模型，将逐臂 SE(3) 变换以 PRoPE 风格几何编码注入注意力以保持手臂身份与刚体结构；加入轻量深度分支建模场景级几何，并用 SAM3 掩码配合冻结的 V-JEPA teacher 维持抓取过程中的物体一致性；通过分布匹配蒸馏将多步生成器蒸馏为少步学生模型。
Result: 摘要报告该模型在 WorldArena 2.0 Challenge 中获 Track 1 第一名、Track 2 第二名，但未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 摘要强调在视频世界模型中除了真实感还需保证动作保真和物体一致性，并通过几何编码、深度分支与蒸馏实现高效部署；模型和代码将公开。

papers.title: Toward a Gricean Retreat: Probing LLMs for Knowledge Boundaries and Referent Specificity
papers.abstract_en: When asked about entities outside their knowledge boundary, LLMs routinely fabricate plausible-sounding details rather than backing off to safer, more general claims. We frame this failure through a Gricean lens: a cooperative speaker who is uncertain about a referent retreats up the specificity hierarchy, trading informativeness for truthfulness. We ask whether LLMs have the ingredients to perform this retreat. Using a T-REx-based benchmark that varies entity familiarity and referent specificity, we probe models to answer two questions: (i) do their activations encode whether a referent falls inside the knowledge boundary, and (ii) do they anticipate the specificity of the referent they are about to generate? We find that the answer to both is yes, but the two signals are not reconciled in generation. Models overwhelmingly prefer specific referents even when the entity is unknown to them, and do so even when offered correct generic alternatives. The substrate for a Gricean retreat is present, but the policy that would act on it is not. We position our findings as a first step toward Gricean alignment, training or steering objectives that couple knowledge-boundary awareness to referent-specificity during generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从 Grice 合作原则的视角研究 LLM 在遇到知识边界外实体时的行为：模型本应沿特异性层级退让，用更一般但真实的表述替代虚构细节。作者基于 T-REx 构建基准，变化实体熟悉度和指称特异性，探测模型激活中是否编码知识边界信息以及是否预判即将生成的指称特异性。结果发现两种信号都存在，但在生成阶段未能协调，模型即使面对正确的一般性选项，仍偏向具体的指称。
Motivation: LLM 被问及知识边界外的实体时，常常编造看似合理的细节，而非退让到更安全、更一般的表述。作者将此失败框架化为 Grice 意义上的合作失败，并试图检验模型是否具备执行这种退让机制的基本成分。
Method: 构建基于 T-REx 的基准，操控实体熟悉度与指称特异性两个维度，通过探针 (probing) 分析模型激活：一是判断激活是否编码指称是否落在知识边界内，二是判断模型是否预判即将生成的指称特异性，并对比生成行为与探测信号。
Result: 摘要报告两个探测问题的答案均为肯定，但两种信号在生成中并不一致；模型即使实体未知，也压倒性地偏好具体指称，即使在提供了正确的通用备选项时依然如此。
Conclusion: 作者认为 Gricean 退让所需的底层表征已存在，但缺乏将其转化为行为的策略，并将这项工作定位为迈向 Gricean 对齐 (Gricean alignment) 的第一步，即把知识边界感知与生成时的指称特异性耦合到训练或引导目标中。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Synthetic Persona Pretraining: Alignment from Token Zero
papers.abstract_en: As language-model-based AI is increasingly deployed in autonomous settings, aligning its goals and values with those of humans becomes critical. Today, alignment, and the assistant identity itself, are typically introduced only after pretraining, once behavioral priors are already established. This can make values a thin overlay, rather than deeply rooted, and facilitate subsequent misalignment. Pursuing a different paradigm, we introduce Synthetic Persona Pretraining (SPP), which installs the desired assistant persona from token zero in pretraining. First, we annotate pretraining documents with value-aligned first-person reflections derived from a normative value constitution. Second, we pretrain via the standard cross-entropy loss on standard pretraining documents as well as their reflections, which installs the desired persona among a multitude of other personas. Finally, we post-train on user-assistant dialogue data, which binds this desired persona to the assistant identity, a process we call persona binding. By pretraining models up to 3B parameters on 500B tokens, we show that SPP improves constitution following and jailbreak robustness, and reduces the misalignment rate in out-of-distribution moral dilemmas, while preserving capabilities. Early intervention matters: compared with alignment from token zero, introducing SPP only at the end of pretraining yields weaker constitution adherence, does not shift value priorities, and leads to less aligned choices in dilemmas. This advantage depends on persona binding and, importantly, increases with pretraining budget. Overall, our results show that shaping values early is critical for alignment and establish pretraining-time persona interventions as an effective approach to do so.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出合成人格预训练 (Synthetic Persona Pretraining, SPP)，在预训练阶段从零 token 起就植入期望的助手人格，而非在预训练之后才引入对齐。作者用基于规范性价值宪法生成的具有价值一致性的第一人称反思注释预训练文档，然后在标准预训练文档及其反思上以标准交叉熵损失进行预训练，再通过用户-助手对话数据做后训练以将人格绑定到助手身份。实验预训练至 3B 参数、500B token，显示 SPP 能改善宪法遵循与越狱鲁棒性，降低分布外道德困境中的错位率，同时保持能力。
Motivation: 当前对齐通常在预训练之后才进行，即行为先验已经形成后才引入助手身份和价值观，导致价值观只是薄薄一层覆盖物，可能引发后续的错位。需要一种从预训练一开始就植入价值观的范式，使对齐更根本、更持久。
Method: SPP 分三步：一是用取自规范性价值宪法的价值对齐第一人称反思注释预训练文档；二是在标准预训练文档及其反思上使用标准交叉熵损失进行预训练，从而在众多人格中安装目标人格；三是用用户-助手对话数据进行后训练，将目标人格绑定到助手身份，称为人格绑定 (persona binding)。

Conclusion: 结果表明早期塑造价值观对对齐至关重要，并确立预训练阶段的人格干预是一种有效的对齐途径。

papers.title: MapRoute++: Surrogate-Guided Semantic Routing for Visual Concept Unlearning
authors: L. D. M. S. Sai Teja
papers.abstract_en: We present our submission to Task 3 of the Gen$μ$ 2.0 Challenge on visual concept unlearning. Building on MapRoute, we introduce task-specific training objectives, richer concept representations, and semantic routing for concept-specific mapper selection. Our approach improves robust concept removal while preserving unrelated and semantically adjacent concepts. On the official benchmark, evaluated using the Erasing-Retention-Robustness (ERR) metric on Stable Diffusion v1.4, our method outperforms the state-of-the-art baseline by 12.1\% on average across the five concept categories, achieving substantial gains.
papers.comment: Accepted at Unlearning and Model Editing Workshop, ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提交至 Genμ 2.0 挑战赛 Task 3（视觉概念遗忘）。作者在 MapRoute 基础上引入任务特定训练目标、更丰富的概念表示，以及用于概念特定映射器选择的语义路由，提出 MapRoute++。在 Stable Diffusion v1.4 上以 Erasing-Retention-Robustness (ERR) 指标评估，五个概念类别平均比现有最优基线提升 12.1%。
Motivation: 视觉概念遗忘需要在移除指定概念的同时保留无关和语义相邻概念；现有 MapRoute 等方法缺乏任务特定的训练目标和针对不同概念的映射器选择机制。
Method: 在 MapRoute 上扩展，加入任务特定训练目标、更丰富的概念表示，并通过语义路由（semantic routing）为每个概念选择特定的映射器。
Result: 官方基准上，ERR 指标平均较现有最优基线提升 12.1%，在五个概念类别上均有明显增益。
Conclusion: 该方法在稳健移除目标概念的同时能更好地保留无关概念和语义相邻概念；作为挑战赛提交，摘要未报告具体局限性。

papers.title: MARC v1: An Open-Source Multi-Agent Framework for Clinical AI Reasoning and Coordination
papers.abstract_en: We present Multi-Agent Reasoning and Coordination (MARC), an open-source framework that replaces monolithic LLM prompting with deterministic multi-agent orchestration for clinical reasoning. MARC coordinates role-specialized agents for extraction, reasoning, answer generation, and evaluation, with explicit context passing and traceable intermediate outputs, enabling stage-wise failure attribution. We additionally introduce a Decomposer module that generates task-specific agent prompts from a plain-language description, eliminating manual prompt engineering. The framework supports both API-based and local CPU-compatible deployments and is entirely configurable via YAML, without code modifications. MARC is designed to be model-agnostic, interpretable, and accessible to clinical domain experts without programming expertise. The full framework is available at https://github.com/Penn-RAIL/MARC-v1.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MARC (Multi-Agent Reasoning and Coordination)，一个面向临床推理的开源多智能体框架，用确定性的多智能体编排替代单体大模型提示。框架协调抽取、推理、答案生成和评估等角色专用智能体，支持显式上下文传递与可追踪的中间输出，并引入 Decomposer 模块从自然语言描述自动生成任务专用智能体提示，避免手动提示工程。
Motivation: 单体大模型提示在临床推理中缺乏可解释性和阶段级错误归因能力，手动提示工程也阻碍了临床领域专家的直接使用。
Method: MARC 采用角色专用智能体（抽取、推理、答案生成、评估）进行编排，通过显式上下文传递与可追踪的中间输出来支持分阶段失败归因；Decomposer 模块从自然语言描述生成任务专用提示；框架支持 API 与本地 CPU 部署，并完全通过 YAML 配置，无需代码修改。
Result: 摘要未报告量化实验结果或基准数据，主要描述框架的设计能力，包括模型无关、可解释、对无编程经验的临床专家可用。
Conclusion: 作者强调 MARC 作为开源、模型无关且可解释的框架，降低了临床推理多智能体系统的使用门槛，并提供 GitHub 仓库供社区使用。

papers.title: AaLLM: An End-to-End Analog Circuit Design Framework from Topology Generation to Sizing Using Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Analog circuit design is a time-consuming, iterative process in a nonlinear and high-dimensional design space that relies heavily on expert intuition. Among recent developments, LLMs have introduced a promising approach by bringing natural language reasoning to circuit design tasks. The majority of conventional LLM-based approaches provide fragmented solutions that focus either only on sizing or topology generation. These methods require adding specific technical knowledge manually, which is inefficient and prone to hallucinations during circuit sizing. Moreover, the inherent trade-off in meeting different specs makes current approaches iterative and tedious. Another shortcoming is the inability to create innovative topologies, which may lead to sub-optimal designs due to reliance on conventional topologies. In this paper, we present AaLLM, an open-source end-to-end multi-agent LLM workflow that takes user specs as input and outputs the appropriate netlist, encompassing both topology generation and circuit sizing. AaLLM automates the creation of a relevant knowledge base from research papers and textbooks to combat tedious manual data collection. A RAG model is implemented to emulate circuit design expertise using this knowledge base. Moreover, AaLLM uses a novel tri-agent feedback system comprising a Designer that determines circuit component values, a Critic that scrutinizes these values, and an Evaluator that minimizes circuit sizing iterations by arbitrating between the other two agents. AaLLM-generated novel topologies achieve a figure of merit (FoM) comparable to that of known topologies, and up to 3x higher for certain circuits. Testing on several circuit topologies, our results show a 3x - 4.5x decrease in the number of SPICE calls at inference when compared to SOTA multi-agent LLM pipelines. The results also show a 40x decrease in wall-clock time compared to existing approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AaLLM，一个开源、端到端的多智能体 LLM 工作流，输入用户规格后直接输出包含拓扑生成与电路尺寸确定的网表 (netlist)。AaLLM 自动从研究论文和教科书中构建相关知识库，并用 RAG 模型模拟电路设计经验；其新颖的三智能体反馈系统由 Designer、Critic 和 Evaluator 组成。摘要报告 AaLLM 生成的新拓扑在品质因数 (FoM) 上可与已知拓扑相当，某些电路可达 3 倍提升，同时推理时 SPICE 调用次数和墙钟时间分别下降 3x-4.5x 和 40x。
Motivation: 模拟电路设计耗时且迭代，设计空间高维非线性且依赖专家直觉；现有基于 LLM 的方法多为碎片化方案，只单独处理 sizing 或拓扑生成，且需要手动添加专业知识、易产生幻觉，也难以创造新颖拓扑，导致次优设计和繁琐迭代。
Method: 提出 AaLLM，一个开源端到端多智能体 LLM 框架，涵盖拓扑生成与电路 sizing；自动化从研究论文和教科书中创建知识库，并实现 RAG 模型来模拟电路设计专长；同时提出三智能体反馈系统，其中 Designer 决定元件值，Critic 审查这些值，Evaluator 在两个智能体间仲裁以最小化 sizing 迭代次数。
Result: 摘要报告 AaLLM 生成的新颖拓扑在 FoM 上与已知拓扑相当，某些电路最高达 3 倍；在多个电路拓扑上，推理时 SPICE 调用次数比 SOTA 多智能体 LLM 流水线减少 3x-4.5x，墙钟时间相比现有方法减少 40x。
Conclusion: AaLLM 将拓扑生成与电路 sizing 统一到一个端到端 LLM 框架中，减少人工数据收集并降低迭代成本，其结果表明自动化知识库和智能体仲裁能显著提升模拟电路设计效率。
