summary_sections.result: 在多个 3D 视觉空间推理基准上，方法取得 state-of-the-art 的 token 效率，并在高剪枝率下保持稳健推理性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者主张 3D VLM token 剪枝应从最大化多样性转向保留视觉证据覆盖度，CoverPrune 以 OT 框架实现了这一范式转变。

papers.title: Reliability analysis for BraTS-GoAT segmentation: a controlled robustness study of deep-ensemble uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Deep networks segment brain tumours accurately in-distribution, but can fail silently when the input differs from their training data. That risk is central to clinical deployment and is the premise of the BraTS-GoAT generalizability task. We ask not only how well a model segments, but whether its uncertainty knows when it is wrong. On BraTS-GoAT (Task 3) we train a 5-fold cross-validated nnU-Net baseline (one held-out prediction per case) and a 3-seed deep ensemble. Both are evaluated for calibration and error detection on a per-region relevant mask, aggregated per case. In-distribution the 3-seed ensemble improves modestly over the already strong single model on the same held-out split, with the clearest gain in calibration. The separation appears under shift. In a controlled robustness study using graded synthetic corruptions as a proxy for acquisition shift, the single model's confidence stays flat while its accuracy and calibration degrade. Inter-member disagreement instead rises steeply, about a quarter to a third above the clean condition, several times the single model's response. On the official validation leaderboard the 5-fold ensemble of those folds attains whole-tumour Dice 0.87. The generalization gap is concentrated on the harder regions, with a characteristic failure of missing small, satellite lesions on unseen cohorts. In the synthetic study, disagreement among the 3-seed members is a more sensitive case-level indicator of acquisition shift than single-model confidence. Its per-voxel error localisation weakens as severity grows. The contribution is a rigorous, honest reliability comparison rather than a claim that any one uncertainty method dominates.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Conditionally accepted at MICCAI 2026 BraTS-GoAT challenge workshop. Code: https://github.com/riyashet-hds/brats-goat-reliability
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究脑肿瘤分割模型的不确定性是否能在分布偏移时识别自身错误。基于 BraTS-GoAT Task 3，作者训练 5 折交叉验证 nnU-Net 基线和 3-seed 深度集成，并评估两者在逐区域相关掩膜上的校准与错误检测。在受控合成损坏下，单模型置信度保持平坦而准确率和校准下降，集成成员间分歧明显上升。官方验证集上 5 折集成达到全肿瘤 Dice 0.87，贡献是严谨的可靠性对比而非宣称某一种不确定性方法占优。
Motivation: 深度网络在分布内能准确分割脑肿瘤，但输入偏离训练数据时可能静默失败，这对临床部署构成关键风险，也是 BraTS-GoAT 泛化任务的前提。作者不仅关心模型分割得多好，还关心其不确定性是否知道何时出错。
Method: 在 BraTS-GoAT Task 3 上训练 5 折交叉验证 nnU-Net 基线（每个病例一个留出预测）和 3-seed 深度集成，两者在逐区域相关掩膜上按病例聚合评估校准和错误检测。作者使用分级合成损坏作为采集偏移的代理，开展受控鲁棒性研究。
Result: 分布内 3-seed 集成相对已很强的单模型提升有限，最明显的是校准改善；偏移下集成成员分歧比单模型置信度更敏感地指示病例级采集偏移，分歧较干净条件上升约四分之一到三分之一，是单模型响应的数倍。官方验证榜上 5 折集成全肿瘤 Dice 为 0.87，泛化差距集中在较难区域，表现为漏检未见队列中的小卫星病灶。
Conclusion: 作者强调其贡献是严谨、诚实的可靠性比较，而非声称某种不确定性方法全面占优；同时指出集成分歧的逐体素错误定位能力会随损坏严重度增加而减弱。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: TsuGO: Probing Search Efficiency in LLM Reasoning via Go Life-and-Death Problems
papers.abstract_en: The evaluation of LLM reasoning is moving from final-answer accuracy to process-level assessment, yet existing methods still fail to capture how models plan reasoning paths and allocate reasoning resources--that is, how they organize search. Prior process-level methods focus on the coherence and redundancy of chain-of-thought (CoT), and most benchmark tasks have a single objective solvable by static capabilities such as derivation and tool use, leaving search organization unmeasured. We introduce TsuGO, a process-level reasoning benchmark for evaluating Search Efficiency in LLM reasoning through Go life-and-death problems. These problems provide closed and verifiable solution spaces with an inherent adversarial structure, making candidate generation, response checking, branch comparison, and backtracking necessary parts of reasoning rather than incidental trace patterns. By constraining the solution space, TsuGO disentangles domain knowledge from search organization, parses CoT into a structured search tree, and reports Search Efficiency together with Token Efficiency and other diagnostic metrics and visualizations. Experiments show that current LLMs remain far from stable tsumego solving: stronger models succeed by finding the correct candidate earlier and sustaining effort on productive branches, but most models still behave much closer to unguided search algorithms than to neural-guided KataGo. Longer CoT or higher Token Efficiency does not necessarily imply better search. Our results identify search organization and reasoning-resource allocation as missing dimensions in LLM reasoning evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TsuGO，一个基于围棋死活题 (tsumego) 的流程级推理基准，用于评估 LLM 在推理中的搜索效率 (Search Efficiency)。通过封闭且可验证的解空间与内在对抗性结构，TsuGO 把 CoT 解析为结构化搜索树，并报告搜索效率、Token 效率等诊断指标。实验表明当前 LLM 在死活题求解上远未稳定，强模型更接近神经引导的 KataGo，而多数模型的行为更接近无引导搜索算法。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 推理评估正从最终答案准确率转向流程级评估，但已有方法只关注链式思维 (CoT) 的一致性和冗余度，且大多基准任务可由推导和工具使用等静态能力解决，无法测量模型如何规划推理路径、分配推理资源，即搜索组织方式。
Method: 引入 TsuGO 基准，利用围棋死活题的封闭可验证解空间和对抗性结构，使候选生成、应答检查、分支比较和回溯成为推理的必要环节而非偶然痕迹；通过约束解空间将领域知识与搜索组织解耦，把 CoT 解析为结构化搜索树，并输出 Search Efficiency、Token Efficiency 及其他诊断指标和可视化。
Result: 实验显示当前 LLM 远未达到稳定的死活题求解：较强模型更早找到正确候选并在有效分支上持续投入，但大多数模型行为仍接近无引导搜索算法而非神经引导的 KataGo；更长的 CoT 或更高的 Token 效率并不必然意味着更好的搜索表现。
Conclusion: 作者认为搜索结果识别出搜索组织和推理资源分配是 LLM 推理评估中缺失的维度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Statistical Noise and Missing Forcing Limit Estimates of Earth's Feedback from Prescribed Sea-Surface Temperature Simulations
papers.abstract_en: Earth's feedback parameter measures how the Earth system responds to forcing and is inversely proportional to climate sensitivity. Sea-surface temperature (SST) patterns can modulate the value of the feedback parameter. Differences between observed and simulated SSTs have raised the question how the observed SSTs evolution impacts the global feedback. The standard method for estimating this effect uses observed SSTs prescribed to an atmospheric model with fixed pre-industrial atmospheric forcing. This method makes two assumptions: first, that the observed SSTs capture all relevant effects from the forcing, so that prescribing a time-varying forcing is unnecessary; second, that the temporal variations in the feedback parameter are driven by the evolving SST pattern and can be estimated via moving-window regressions. We test these assumptions by running controlled experiments in which SSTs from fully-coupled historical simulations are prescribed to an atmospheric model. We find that the prescribed-SST experiments fail to capture the coupled feedback evolution. This is explained by two effects: First, the absence of prescribed atmospheric forcing, and second, statistical noise arising from the computation of moving-window regressions. We find no evidence of any significant relationship between evolving SST patterns and changes in the feedback time series in a 4000-year pre-industrial control simulation. Any trends in the feedback parameter detected on timescales shorter than ~100 years are indistinguishable from statistical noise, making their attribution to the evolving SST pattern extremely difficult. Our results imply that prescribed SST simulations offer limited potential for inferring temporal changes in Earth's parameter over the observational period.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过受控实验检验了用观测海表温度（SST）强迫大气模型来估计地球反馈参数（Earth's feedback parameter）时隐含的两项假设。作者将完全耦合历史模拟的SST输入大气模型，发现这种 prescribed-SST 实验无法还原耦合模式中的反馈演化，原因是缺少大气强迫以及移动窗口回归（moving-window regressions）带来的统计噪声。在4000年工业化前控制模拟中，未发现SST型演化与反馈时间序列变化之间有显著关系，短于约100年的反馈趋势与统计噪声不可区分。
Motivation: 观测与模拟SST的差异引发了对观测SST演化如何影响全球反馈的疑问，而标准的 prescribed-SST 方法假设观测SST已捕获强迫的所有相关效应、且反馈参数的时间变化可由演化SST型驱动并通过移动窗口回归估计；这些假设尚未得到验证。
Method: 作者设计受控实验，将来自完全耦合历史模拟的SST作为 prescribed boundary condition 输入大气模型，并比较其反馈演化与耦合模拟的差异，以检验上述两项假设。
Result: prescribed-SST 实验未能捕获耦合反馈演化，原因包括缺失大气强迫和移动窗口回归引入的统计噪声；在4000年控制模拟中未发现SST型演化与反馈序列变化存在显著关系，短于约100年的反馈趋势与统计噪声不可区分。
Conclusion: 作者认为 prescribed SST 模拟在推断观测期地球反馈参数的时间变化方面潜力有限。

papers.title: UniCon-Former: Unified Convolution Transformer is All You Need for Hand Gesture Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) capture local features efficiently but struggle with global context due to their limited receptive field. On the other hand, transformers effectively capture global dependencies through self-attention but suffer from high redundancy and computational costs. Thus, to leverage the advantages of both CNNs and transformers, we propose a unified model (UniCon-Former) that aims to provide robust and efficient performance on dynamic hand gesture recognition. The unified approach helps the model to learn both local and global features. At the beginning of each transformer stage, the convolution projections help in decreasing the dimension of the input vectors of the transformer block. This creates a pyramidal structure at each transformer stage. These features enable the UniCon-Former to reduce resource usage than vanilla transformers, making it flexible for learning multi-scale and high-resolution features, which is required in hand gesture recognition. We have performed experiments with NVGesture and Briareo datasets and achieved state-of-the-art results with fewer parameters and MACs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种统一卷积-Transformer 模型 UniCon-Former，用于动态手势识别。模型在每个 Transformer 阶段开始时用卷积投影降低输入向量维度，形成金字塔结构，从而同时学习局部与全局特征，并以更少的参数和计算量在 NVGesture 和 Briareo 数据集上取得 state-of-the-art 结果。
Motivation: CNN 能高效捕捉局部特征但受限于感受野难以建模全局上下文，而 Transformer 能通过自注意力捕捉全局依赖但存在高冗余和计算开销；作者希望结合两者优势，实现鲁棒且高效的手势识别。
Method: 提出 UniCon-Former：在每个 Transformer 阶段前使用卷积投影降低输入维度，构造金字塔式结构，使模型能够学习多尺度与高分辨率特征，同时相比 vanilla Transformer 降低资源占用。
Result: 在 NVGesture 和 Briareo 数据集上的实验取得 state-of-the-art 性能，并且参数量和 MACs 更少。
Conclusion: 统一卷积与 Transformer 的方法可以减少资源消耗，适合动态手势识别中对多尺度、高分辨率特征的需求。

papers.title: History-informed Lagrangian Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Forecasting the long-horizon evolution of mechanical systems from position-only observations is a pivotal yet difficult task, as hidden velocities and trajectory-specific physical properties must be inferred simultaneously. Although physics-guided neural networks like Lagrangian Neural Networks (LNNs) guarantee physical plausibility, they generally require complete state inputs and lack adaptability to changing system parameters. To break these limitations, we introduce History-informed Lagrangian Neural Networks (HiLNN). Grounded in the insight that temporal position sequences implicitly encode underlying dynamics, HiLNN employs a recurrent encoder to extract a latent context from history. This context not only reconstructs the unobserved initial velocity but also adaptively modulates the mass matrix, potential energy, and damping coefficients of a structured Lagrangian system. By leveraging a differentiable RK4 rollout scheme, the entire pipeline is optimized end-to-end under multi-step trajectory supervision and energy-consistency regularization. Empirical evaluations across conservative, dissipative, and heterogeneous variable-parameter systems show that HiLNN delivers superior long-term prediction accuracy and maintains precise energy profiles compared to state-of-the-art baselines. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/yingtian22/History-informed-LNN.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 5 figures. Accepted to the 9th Chinese Conference on Pattern Recognition and Computer Vision (PRCV 2026) as an oral paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 History-informed Lagrangian Neural Networks (HiLNN)，解决从仅位置观测预测机械系统长期演化的问题。HiLNN 用循环编码器从历史位置序列提取潜在上下文，同时重建未观测初始速度并自适应调制 Lagrange 系统中的质量矩阵、势能和阻尼系数，整个管线通过可微 RK4 rollout 在轨迹监督和能量一致性正则化下端到端训练。实验覆盖保守、耗散和异构变参数系统，显示相比现有基线有更优的长期预测精度并保持能量曲线。源码已公开。
Motivation: Lagrangian Neural Networks (LNNs) 虽然能保证物理合理性，但通常需要完整状态输入，且无法适应变化的系统参数；从位置观测做长期预测时，还必须同时推断隐藏速度和轨迹特定的物理属性。
Method: HiLNN 使用循环编码器从位置时间序列提取潜在上下文，该上下文既用于重建未观测的初始速度，也用于调制结构化 Lagrange 系统的质量矩阵、势能项和阻尼系数；结合可微 RK4 rollout 与多步轨迹监督及能量一致性正则化进行端到端优化。
Result: 在保守、耗散以及异构变参数系统上的实验表明，HiLNN 相比最先进基线实现了更优的长期预测精度，并保持精确的能量曲线。
Conclusion: 作者认为历史位置序列隐式编码了底层动力学，借助上下文调制可以突破 LNN 对完整状态和固定参数的依赖；摘要未提及明显局限。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: TANGCO: Learning Topology-Aware Capacity Allocation for Overload-driven Cascading Failures
papers.abstract_en: Networked systems, from power grids to traffic networks and cloud clusters, carry loads across nodes with limited capacity. A node whose load exceeds its capacity fails and sheds its load onto its neighbors, which can trigger a system-wide cascade. We study how to allocate a fixed capacity budget across nodes to resist these cascades under local load redistribution. The problem is difficult because no optimal allocation is known, and the fail-or-survive objective is non-differentiable and piecewise constant, so exact and gradient-based optimization methods do not directly apply. We introduce TANGCO (Topology-Aware Neural Graph-Guided Capacity Optimization), which uses a graph neural network policy trained through the cascade simulator with policy-gradient learning and a heuristic anchor. We evaluate TANGCO on five synthetic graph families and five real networks spanning power, road, air, and Internet topologies. The learned policy improves on the best of four hand-designed heuristics in all 450 synthetic instances and in 40 of 45 real-network conditions, with robustness gains ranging from 1.6% to 246%. The learned policies transfer to unseen graphs within a family and partially across related topologies, and TANGCO$^{pre}$, pre-trained on synthetic graphs, matches per-network training on unseen real networks. Training scales near-linearly with graph size, and TANGCO$^{pre}$ allocates on a new network with no per-target training, matching the deployment cost of a hand-designed heuristic. Free-vector variants without the GNN, stay close to the heuristics, so the graph representation carries the gain beyond numerical search. Finally, analysis of the learned allocations identifies when local risk is sufficient, leads to an improved closed-form heuristic, and reveals the regimes where a topology-aware learned policy remains necessary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究网络系统在局部负载再分配下的连锁故障（cascading failures）鲁棒性问题，提出 TANGCO（Topology-Aware Neural Graph-Guided Capacity Optimization），用图神经网络策略在级联模拟器中通过策略梯度学习和启发式锚点训练，以分配固定容量预算。在五个合成图族和五个真实网络（电力、道路、航空、互联网）上，学习策略在450个合成实例上全部优于四种手工启发式，在45个真实网络条件的40个中取得更优，鲁棒性提升1.6%到246%。预训练版本 TANGCO^{pre} 可在未见真实网络上直接部署，匹配逐网络训练的效果。
Motivation: 节点负荷超过容量即失效并把负荷转移给邻居，可能引发系统范围级联；在局部负载再分配下如何分配固定容量预算缺少已知最优分配，且 fail-or-survive 目标不可微、分段常数，精确优化和梯度优化方法都不直接适用。
Method: 提出 TANGCO，使用图神经网络策略，通过级联模拟器进行策略梯度学习，并引入启发式锚点；同时提供去掉 GNN 的 free-vector 变体以验证图表示的作用，以及预训练版本 TANGCO^{pre}。作者还分析学习到的分配，以识别局部风险何时足够并改进闭式启发式。
Result: 在450个合成实例上，学习策略全部优于四种手工启发式；在45个真实网络条件中40个取得更好结果，鲁棒性增益为1.6%到246%。策略可迁移到同族未见图，并部分迁移到相关拓扑；TANGCO^{pre} 在未见真实网络上匹配逐网络训练，训练规模随图大小近线性增长。
Conclusion: 摘要强调图表示（GNN）带来了超出数值搜索的收益，因为 free-vector 变体仅接近手工启发式；对学习分配的分析揭示了局部风险充分性的机制，并指出在哪些条件下仍需要拓扑感知的学习策略。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: NARU: A Benchmark for NARrative Evolution and Cultural Nuance Understanding in Japanese Extreme Long Video
papers.abstract_en: Long-form video understanding encompasses tasks that go beyond retrieving isolated events, including tracking an evolving narrative and interpreting social meaning that may remain implicit. However, existing benchmarks rarely evaluate these capabilities jointly, particularly in high-context, non-English media. To address this gap, we introduce NARU, a benchmark designed to evaluate Narrative evolution and Reasoning on cultural Understanding in Japanese long-form video. NARU consists of 1,481 questions grounded in 155 videos totaling 146.8 hours, spanning four narrative and five cultural dimensions. To construct the benchmark at this scale, we propose a hierarchical memory-based annotation pipeline that transforms raw video into structured event, narrative, and cultural annotations, then generates questions via task-oriented synthesis and iterative shortcut removal. The construction process includes two native-speaker verification stages involving 68 annotators. Evaluations across eight model configurations reveal substantial limitations in both long-range narrative integration and culturally grounded reasoning. By exposing these persistent gaps, NARU offers a systematic testing ground for developing MLLMs capable of reliably interpreting long-form, high-context video.
papers.comment: Yuheng Huang and Jianlang Chen contributed equally to this work. More details available on the project's website https://ma-labo.github.io/naru/ and https://infinimind.io/en/company/news/2026/narubench-release
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NARU 是一个面向日语长篇视频的基准，用于联合评估叙事演变跟踪与文化隐含意义理解。基准包含来自 155 个视频的 1,481 个问题，总时长 146.8 小时，覆盖四个叙事维度和五个文化维度；构建时采用基于层级记忆的标注流水线，并经过两轮母语者验证。对八种模型配置的评测显示，现有模型在长程叙事整合与文化推理上仍有明显局限。
Motivation: 现有长视频理解基准往往只评测孤立事件检索，很少同时考察叙事演变跟踪与社会文化含义理解，尤其是在高语境、非英语媒体上存在空白。
Method: 提出层级记忆式标注流水线，将原始视频转化为结构化的事件、叙事和文化标注，再通过任务导向式合成与迭代式捷径移除生成问题，并包含 68 名标注者参与的两阶段母语者验证。
Result: 基准包含 1,481 个问题、155 个视频、总计 146.8 小时内容；在八种模型配置上的评测表明模型在长程叙事整合与文化接地推理方面存在显著不足。
Conclusion: NARU 通过暴露这些持续存在的短板，为开发能够可靠理解长篇幅、高语境视频的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）提供系统的测试平台。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Chance-constrained selection of sequential intervention strategies from counterfactual estimates
papers.abstract_en: Many operational decisions are sequences of interventions under a cumulative resource limit, such as a maintenance schedule within a crew-hour budget. Choosing among them calls for the outcome and the cumulative cost each would produce, counterfactual quantities identified from observational data. Two strategies with the same expected cost can exceed the budget at very different rates, so constraining the mean does not bound how often an overrun occurs. Prior two-step architectures, recently extended to continuous doses, constrain the mean cost rather than its tail and allocate at a single decision point. Methods that do bound a cost tail take its distribution from a specified model rather than identifying it from data. We present a predict-then-optimize framework. In the prediction step, any estimator returning an outcome value and a cost distribution supplies what the decision rule consumes, so the predictor is interchangeable. In the optimization step, a chance-constrained selection over a finite candidate set bounds the probability that the cumulative cost exceeds the budget. That tail does not decompose across stages, so each strategy is scored whole. Sweeping the tolerated violation probability traces a safety-utility frontier, and distribution-free finite-sample bounds cover violation and outcome shortfall. Four of five environments, spanning clinical treatment and equipment maintenance, supply exact counterfactual ground truth; the fifth carries real outcomes from a digital-health micro-randomized trial. Across them, the rule holds the budget where a point-estimate rule overruns it, at an outcome cost the frontier makes explicit. All code is available at https://github.com/mfriendly/counterfactual-chance-selection
papers.comment: 46 pages, 10 figures, 20 tables. Includes supplementary material as an appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个 predict-then-optimize 框架，用于在累计资源约束下从反事实估计中选择序贯干预策略。预测步接受任意能返回结果值和成本分布的估计器，优化步在有限候选集上做机会约束选择，以概率界约束累计成本超过预算的事件。在五个环境中（四个具备精确反事实真值，一个来自数字健康微随机试验的真实结果），该规则在点估计规则超预算的场景下守住了预算，并用安全-效用前沿显式呈现结果代价。
Motivation: 现有方法通常只约束期望成本而非成本尾部，而期望成本相同的两个策略超预算频率可能差异很大；能约束成本尾部的方法则依赖指定模型分布而非从数据识别该分布。
Method: 采用两阶段设计：预测阶段将估计器替换为可插拔的任意结果值与成本分布估计器；优化阶段在有限候选策略集上进行机会约束选择，对每个策略整体评分（因为尾部不按阶段分解）。通过扫描可容忍违规概率得到安全-效用前沿，并提供无分布假设的有限样本界覆盖违规与结果缺口。
Result: 摘要报告在五个环境中，该规则能在点估计规则超预算的场景下守住预算，同时前沿显式暴露了其带来的结果代价；其中四个环境使用精确反事实真值，第五个使用数字健康微随机试验的真实结果。
Conclusion: 作者给出的核心结论是，对序贯干预策略进行整链机会约束选择并扫描违规概率，可以在数据驱动识别成本分布的前提下同时提供安全性与可供决策的效用权衡；全部代码已开源。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: HPSD: Hybrid-Policy Self-Distillation for Text-Image-to-Video Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Text-Image-to-Video (TI2V) models are an emerging unified architecture, where a single model simultaneously supports text-to-video (T2V) and image-to-video (I2V) generation. Given a high-quality first frame or a detailed textual prompt, TI2V models unlock substantially better visual quality than their T2V mode, raising a natural question: can the capability elicited by such privileged conditions be internalized into the model's own base generation ability? A common approach toward this goal is model self-distillation. However, the most straightforward solution, supervised fine-tuning, follows an off-policy strategy: its supervision is confined to teacher-generated endpoints from a fixed offline distribution rather than student-visited states, lacking precise correction tailored to the evolving policy. Recent on-policy distillation methods instead suffer from condition-state mismatch, where supervision is steered toward the given first frame instead of the student's actual content, misleading the correction. To achieve self-distillation that absorbs the teacher's privileged prior while retaining precise policy correction, in this work, we propose Hybrid-Policy Self-Distillation (HPSD), a novel self-distillation framework where a single TI2V model acts as both teacher and student under different conditions: the teacher operates in TI2V mode with a high-quality first frame and an enhanced prompt, while the student runs in the base T2V mode with only the vanilla prompt. Specifically, the student inherits off-policy teacher trajectory points as anchors, locally refines them toward its own policy, and finally receives velocity-level supervision on these self-generated roll-outs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HPSD significantly improves T2V performance while also delivering notable TI2V gains, effectively strengthening the model's base generation ability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出混合策略自蒸馏框架 HPSD (Hybrid-Policy Self-Distillation)，针对文本-图像到视频 (Text-Image-to-Video, TI2V) 扩散模型中稀缺的“特权条件生成能力”内化问题。作者让同一个 TI2V 模型在不同条件下同时扮演教师和学生：教师以高质量首帧加增强提示运行 TI2V 模式，学生以普通提示运行基础 T2V 模式，并结合 off-policy 锚点与 on-policy 速度级监督进行自蒸馏。实验显示 HPSD 显著提升 T2V 性能，同时给 TI2V 带来可观增益。
Motivation: TI2V 模型在给定高质量首帧或详细文本提示时，生成质量显著优于其纯 T2V 模式，因此自然的问题是能否将这些特权条件下的能力内化为模型自身的基础生成能力。已有的监督微调属 off-policy 策略，监督局限于固定分布下的教师生成端点，缺乏针对学生动态策略的精确校正；而现有 on-policy 蒸馏方法存在条件-状态不匹配，监督被导向给定首帧而非学生实际生成内容，导致校正偏差。
Method: 提出 HPSD 自蒸馏框架，其中单一 TI2V 模型在不同条件下作为教师和学生：教师端采用高质量首帧与增强提示的 TI2V 模式，学生端采用仅有普通提示的 T2V 模式。学生以 off-policy 教师轨迹点作为锚点，将其局部地朝自身策略细化，并在这些自生成 rollout 上接收速度级 (velocity-level) 监督。
Result: 大量实验表明，HPSD 显著提升 T2V 生成性能，同时带来可观的 TI2V 性能增益，有效增强了模型的基础生成能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 HPSD 能够吸收教师的特权先验，同时保留对学生策略的精确校正，从而提升基础生成能力；该框架适用于 TI2V 这类统一架构的扩散模型。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Sinkhorn Linearization and the Spectral Proxy: Unifying the Statistical and Algorithmic Theory of Feature-Parameterized Inverse Optimal Transport via a Single Spectral Sandwich
papers.abstract_en: We develop the statistical and algorithmic theory of inverse optimal transport (IOT) under the feature-parameterized cost C_theta(i,j) = -theta^T phi(i,j). The core technical contribution is the Sinkhorn linearization -- the implicit-function sensitivity of the entropic OT plan to the cost -- together with its spectral proxy, a formula that is spectrally exact yet geometrically transparent. The restricted Hessian on the tangent space satisfies the spectral sandwich (pi_min/epsilon) I <= H_T^{-1} <= (pi_max/epsilon) I, yielding the single core bound sigma_min >= (pi_min/(a_max epsilon)) sqrt(lambda_min(Sigma)) that drives the entire theory. On this core we establish four theorems and one observation. T1 (identifiability): theta is globally injective on the quotient of the gauge kernel, with dimension bound F <= (K-1)^2. T2 (sparsistency): the l1-penalized estimator recovers the true support under irrepresentability and score concentration, with exponential failure probability. T3 (well-posedness): the feature-moment map M(theta) = Phi^T x_theta is strongly monotone, and the inverse is Lipschitz with constant L <= epsilon ||Phi^T S_a||_op / (pi_min lambda_min(Sigma)). T4 (convergence): local strong convexity with mu >= pi_min^2 lambda_min(Sigma) / epsilon^2 guarantees monotone gradient descent convergence. O5 (misspecification): the estimator converges to the OT-model projection of the truth; the Holder continuity of the projection map is assessed numerically, yielding setting-dependent empirical exponents alpha_eff in (0,1).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文建立特征参数化代价 C_theta(i,j) = -theta^T phi(i,j) 下逆最优传输 (inverse optimal transport, IOT) 的统计与算法理论。核心贡献是 Sinkhorn 线性化（熵正则 OT 计划对代价的隐函数灵敏度）及其谱代理公式，并证明切空间上的限制 Hessian 满足谱夹逼 (pi_min/epsilon) I <= H_T^{-1} <= (pi_max/epsilon) I，由此导出驱动整个理论的核心下界 sigma_min >= (pi_min/(a_max epsilon)) sqrt(lambda_min(Sigma))。在此基础上给出四个定理与一个观察，覆盖可辨识性、稀疏恢复、适定性与收敛性。
Motivation: IOT 在特征参数化代价下的推断缺乏统一的统计与算法理论，现有结果在可辨识条件、估计误差界和优化收敛性等方面相互割裂，作者希望用单一的谱夹逼框架统一这些性质。
Method: 提出 Sinkhorn 线性化作为对代价扰动的灵敏度公式，并构造谱精确且几何透明的谱代理；利用切空间上限制 Hessian 的谱夹逼，导出核心奇异值下界，再以此证明四个定理（T1 可辨识性、T2 稀疏一致性、T3 适定性、T4 收敛性）和一个关于误设定 (misspecification) 的观察（O5）。
Result: 摘要报告：T1 给出 theta 在规范核商空间上的全局单射性与维数界 F <= (K-1)^2；T2 证明 l1 惩罚估计量在不可表示条件与得分集中下以指数失败概率恢复真实支撑；T3 给出特征矩映射的强单调性及 Lipschitz 逆，常数 L <= epsilon ||Phi^T S_a||_op / (pi_min lambda_min(Sigma))；T4 在局部强凸参数 mu >= pi_min^2 lambda_min(Sigma) / epsilon^2 下保证单调梯度下降收敛；O5 显示估计量收敛到真值的 OT 模型投影，投影映射的 Holder 连续性由数值实验给出经验指数 alpha_eff 位于 (0,1)。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该工作以单一谱夹逼为核心界统一了 IOT 的统计与算法理论，并指出在模型误设定下估计量收敛到 OT 模型投影，其连续性行为依赖具体设置。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: GEM: A Generative Embedding Model Bridging Reasoning and Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Modern LLMs excel at reasoning and instruction following, enabling users to express complex and diverse information needs. However, conventional retrievers largely rely on surface-level matching between queries and documents, resulting in a growing gap between how users express their needs and how retrievers interpret them. In this paper, we present GEM, a generative embedding model that augments retrieval through its own knowledge by explicitly reasoning about user intent and relevance criteria. GEM unifies generation and embedding within a single model: it first reasons over the query, then appends an embedding token to encode the enriched context for retrieval. \zhili{Evaluated on reasoning-intensive and instruction-following retrieval tasks, GEM demonstrates the effectiveness of its reasoning-augmented retrieval, outperforming its non-reasoning variant and matching baselines using substantially larger models.} Furthermore, GEM's generative nature allows test-time compute scaling via prompting to further enhance retrieval performance. Our code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/GEM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GEM，一个将生成与嵌入统一到单一模型中的生成式嵌入模型：模型先对查询进行显式推理，再追加一个嵌入 token 对推理增强后的上下文进行编码并用于检索。在推理密集型和指令跟随型检索任务上，GEM 优于其非推理变体，并能匹配使用明显更大模型的基线方法；其生成式特性还允许通过提示词进行测试时计算扩展来进一步提升检索性能。
Motivation: 现代大语言模型擅长推理和指令跟随，用户因此能表达复杂且多样的信息需求；但传统检索器大多依赖查询与文档之间的表层匹配，导致用户表达需求的方式与检索器理解需求的方式之间差距不断增大。
Method: GEM 将生成与嵌入统一在同一个模型内：先对查询进行显式推理以理解用户意图和相关性标准，再追加一个嵌入 token 将推理增强后的上下文编码为检索向量，从而通过模型自身知识增强检索。
Result: 在推理密集型和指令跟随型检索任务上，GEM 表现出推理增强检索的有效性，优于其非推理变体，并能匹配使用显著更大模型的基线；通过提示词进行测试时计算扩展可进一步增强检索性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 GEM 的生成式设计使其能够借助提示词实现测试时计算扩展，从而持续提升检索效果，并公开了代码。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Beyond Simulated Benchmarks: Evaluating Motion Representations for Fall Detection Under Real-World Data Scarcity
papers.abstract_en: Falls are a major health concern for older adults, and wearable sensors have been widely explored for detecting falls and enabling timely intervention. However, real-world falls are extremely rare: collecting 100 of them requires an estimated 100,000 days of monitoring, resulting in severely limited labelled data for training machine learning models. Consequently, many approaches rely on simulated datasets, often reporting high laboratory performance but limited real-world generalisation. We present a systematic evaluation of motion representations for wearable fall detection under real-world data scarcity. Using accelerometer signals, we compare interval-based, kernel-based, symbolic, and foundation model representations. As an interpretable baseline, we additionally investigate a lightweight symbolic representation that converts short motion segments into symbolic sentences augmented with physically-grounded impact descriptors. Experiments use FallAllD, a simulated falls dataset, and FARSEEING, a clinically verified real-world falls dataset. Through cross-validation, controlled data scarcity, and cross-dataset transfer, we examine how representation choices affect robustness under realistic deployment. Our results reveal that highly parameterised kernel and foundation models excel on simulated data but degrade severely under both data scarcity and domain shift. Although the interval-based representation achieves the strongest absolute real-world performance, augmenting a symbolic representation with physically-grounded impact descriptors yields the smallest degradation under domain shift and retains detection sensitivity under extreme scarcity, albeit at lower precision. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating beyond simulated benchmarks and show that representation choice is critical for deployable fall detection given the scarcity of real-world data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了可穿戴跌倒检测中不同运动表示（motion representation）在真实世界数据稀缺条件下的表现，比较了基于区间（interval-based）、核方法（kernel-based）、符号化（symbolic）和基础模型（foundation model）的表示。实验使用模拟跌倒数据集 FallAllD 和临床验证的真实跌倒数据集 FARSEEING，通过交叉验证、受控数据稀缺和跨数据集迁移考察表示选择的鲁棒性。结果显示，参数化程度高的核方法和基础模型在模拟数据上表现优异，但在数据稀缺和域偏移下严重退化；基于区间的表示取得最强的绝对真实世界性能，而带物理冲击描述符的符号化表示在域偏移下退化最小。
Motivation: 真实世界中老年人跌倒极为罕见，收集100次跌倒估计需要约100,000天的监测，导致可用于训练的标注数据非常有限。许多现有方法依赖模拟数据集，实验室性能高但真实世界泛化能力差，因此需要系统评估表示选择在真实数据稀缺和域偏移下的影响。
Method: 基于加速度计信号，对比基于区间、核方法、符号化和基础模型四种运动表示；并额外提出一种可解释的轻量级符号化表示，将短运动片段转换为符号化句子，并加入基于物理的冲击描述符（impact descriptors）。
Result: 核方法和基础模型在模拟数据 FallAllD 上表现突出，但在数据稀缺和域偏移下严重退化；基于区间的表示在真实世界数据上取得最强绝对性能；带有物理冲击描述符的符号化表示在域偏移下退化最小，并能在极端稀缺下保持检测灵敏度，但精度较低。
Conclusion: 作者强调不能仅依赖模拟基准评估，表示选择对真实数据稀缺条件下的可部署跌倒检测至关重要。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Fidelity-Constrained Anchoring for Black-Box Denoisers
papers.abstract_en: We propose a fidelity-constrained framework that anchors the output of a black-box denoiser to its input without retraining and with little additional computation. The method linearly blends the denoised image with the input and selects the maximum blending factor that satisfies a prescribed local fidelity constraint using Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) or Structural Similarity Index (SSIM). For PSNR control, a closed-form solution is obtained under a local constant-blending assumption. For SSIM control, we derive a tractable formulation based on inverse SSIM under the same assumption and solve it efficiently using iterative root finding. Experiments on DIV2K images with synthetic Gaussian noise and outputs from Real-ESRGAN and a non-local means denoiser show that the proposed anchoring strategy provides effective fidelity control while balancing denoising performance and statistical naturalness, as measured by the excess kurtosis of residual noise. In particular, SSIM-based anchoring yields more consistent behavior across noise levels than PSNR-based anchoring.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 5 figures. Supplementary material is available as an ancillary file
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种保真度约束（fidelity-constrained）的锚定框架，用于无重训练地约束黑盒去噪器的输出。方法将去噪图像与输入线性混合，并选择满足给定局部保真度约束的最大混合因子，约束指标采用 PSNR 或 SSIM。实验在 DIV2K 图像、合成高斯噪声以及 Real-ESRGAN 和非局部均值去噪器的输出上进行，显示该策略能在平衡去噪性能与统计自然度的同时实现有效保真度控制。
Motivation: 黑盒去噪器输出可能与输入偏离过大，而直接重训练不可行或代价高；需要一种轻量、无需访问内部参数的方式将输出锚定回输入，以满足指定的保真度约束。
Method: 提出线性混合方案：将去噪图像与输入按混合因子融合，并在局部常数混合假设下，为 PSNR 控制推导闭式解；对 SSIM 控制则基于该假设下的逆 SSIM 推导可处理公式，并用迭代求根高效求解。
Result: 在 DIV2K 上以 Real-ESRGAN 和非局部均值去噪器为对象，方法提供了有效的保真度控制，同时兼顾去噪性能与残差噪声统计自然度（以超额峰度衡量）。其中基于 SSIM 的锚定在不同噪声水平下比基于 PSNR 的锚定行为更一致。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该锚定策略能在几乎不增加计算的前提下对黑盒去噪器实施保真度约束，且 SSIM 锚定相比 PSNR 锚定具有更好的跨噪声水平一致性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ProME: Prototype-Margin Environments with Repair-Aware Selection for Group-Robust Learning
papers.abstract_en: Group-robust learning is crucial for maintaining accuracy on rare subpopulations when training-group labels are unavailable. However, existing methods often infer environments from a separate reference model and select representations before fitting the classifier used at deployment, leaving both decisions misaligned with the deployed predictor. In this work, we formulate group robustness without training-group labels as the endogenous environments with repair-aware selection (ERAS) problem, and propose ProME (Prototype-Margin Environments) to align both decisions with the deployed predictor. ProME splits prototype margins at their median to construct approximately balanced environments along the training trajectory, and fits a group-balanced linear head on group-annotated validation data to rank the resulting predictors by validation worst-group accuracy. We theoretically bound the worst risk across the inferred environments for a fixed predictor and partition, showing that this bound transfers to the oracle groups under an explicit alignment condition. Extensive experiments show that prototype margins enrich shortcut-conflicting examples, classifier repair reshapes candidate evaluation, and ProME achieves the highest average worst-group accuracy among the compared methods with the same group-label access.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究无训练组标签下的组鲁棒学习（group-robust learning），指出现有方法常先用参考模型推断环境、再在拟合部署分类器之前选择表征，导致两步决策与最终预测器不对齐。作者将该问题形式化为 ERAS（endogenous environments with repair-aware selection）问题，提出 ProME：沿训练轨迹在原型间隔（prototype margins）的中位数处切分以构造近似平衡的环境，并在带组标注的验证数据上拟合组平衡线性头，按验证最差组准确率对候选预测器排序。理论上作者对固定预测器和划分给出推断环境上的最差风险上界，并证明在显式对齐条件下该上界可迁移到 oracle 组。实验表明 ProME 在与对比方法相同的组标签访问条件下取得了最高的平均最差组准确率。
Motivation: 无训练组标签时，已有方法通常依赖单独的参考模型推断环境，并在拟合部署分类器之前选择表征，使环境推断与表征选择都和实际部署的预测器不对齐，难以维持稀有子群体的准确率。
Method: 提出 ProME 方法：将每个类的原型间隔按中位数拆分，沿训练轨迹构造近似平衡的环境；随后在组标注验证集上拟合组平衡线性头，并以验证最差组准确率来排序候选预测器。作者还从理论上固定预测器与划分，推导推断环境上的最差风险上界，并分析其向 oracle 组迁移所需的对齐条件。
Result: 摘要报告两点实验观察：原型间隔能够丰富与捷径相冲突（shortcut-conflicting）的样本，分类器修复（classifier repair）会重塑候选评估结果；在与对比方法相同的组标签访问设定下，ProME 取得了最高的平均最差组准确率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调环境推断与预测器选择都应面向最终部署的预测器对齐，并指出所提出的理论最差风险界在显式对齐条件下可以迁移到 oracle 组。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SketchSense: Learning to Interpret Imperfect Sketch Guidance for Image Inpainting
papers.abstract_en: Sketch-guided image inpainting provides intuitive structural control, yet real sketches often mix reliable global intent with locally crowded, displaced, incomplete, or deliberately unconventional strokes. Existing approaches typically either retain the input sketch as a fixed condition throughout denoising or refine it into a clean structure before RGB synthesis. The former assumes uniformly reliable strokes and can propagate local errors throughout generation; the latter must resolve ambiguous structure before emerging appearance and semantic context become available. We propose SketchSense, a framework that interprets imperfect sketch guidance by synchronously denoising interacting RGB and structure streams. Bidirectional Attention Fusion couples appearance generation with structural recovery, producing a refined structure that exposes the model's evolving sketch interpretation. A phrase-level objective aligns the semantic grounding of the two streams. Sketch-Aware Spatial Regulation further adapts sketch use to local generation states by modulating attention and the fusion process, while an optional signed prior injects preserve-versus-correct intent into feature representations and attention behavior. Experiments on natural and structurally complex imagery show substantial gains over existing methods in both restoration quality and structural fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SketchSense，一个用于草图引导图像修复（sketch-guided image inpainting）的框架。它通过同步去噪相互作用的 RGB 与结构流，配合 Bidirectional Attention Fusion、phrase-level 目标函数、Sketch-Aware Spatial Regulation 以及可选的 signed prior，来解释不完美草图。实验在自然图像和结构复杂图像上报告了修复质量与结构保真度的显著提升。
Motivation: 真实草图往往混合可靠的全局意图与局部的拥挤、错位、不完整或刻意非传统的笔画。现有方法要么在去噪全程把输入草图当作固定条件，假定笔画均匀可靠而传播局部错误；要么在 RGB 合成前先把草图细化成干净结构，但这时外观与语义上下文尚未出现，难以消解歧义。
Method: 提出 SketchSense，让 RGB 外观生成与结构恢复两条流同步去噪并相互作用。Bidirectional Attention Fusion 耦合外观生成与结构恢复，得到随去噪过程演化的精细结构；phrase-level 目标对齐两流的语义 grounding；Sketch-Aware Spatial Regulation 根据局部生成状态调制注意力与融合过程，可选的有符号先验（signed prior）将保留-修正意图注入特征表示与注意力行为。
Result: 在自然图像与结构复杂图像上的实验显示，相比现有方法，该方法在修复质量（restoration quality）与结构保真度（structural fidelity）上均有显著提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，与其把草图当作固定条件或预先精化，不如在去噪过程中同步耦合外观与结构流来逐步解释不完美草图，从而获得更优的修复效果。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A Controlled Study of Self-Supervised Image and Video Pretraining under Limited Resources
papers.abstract_en: Visual foundation models are a cornerstone of image and video understanding but typically require large amounts of data and computation. The current scale required for pretraining visual foundation models may be unsustainable or unnecessary, and significant benefits arise when effective models can be obtained with fewer resources. To better understand how self-supervised learning (SSL) objectives behave under resource constraints, we conduct a controlled study of image and video SSL objectives under matched data, architecture, and compute budgets. We compare contrastive, reconstruction, feature-prediction, and diffusion objectives and evaluate both standalone and jointly trained image-video SSL formulations across a diverse set of image and video understanding tasks. Our results show that DINOv2-style pretraining consistently provides the strongest overall performance under limited resources. Furthermore, combining DINOv2 with video SSL objectives such as VideoMAE substantially improves image classification and segmentation performance, but degrades video tracking and camera-pose estimation performance, revealing an important tradeoff between semantic and geometric representation learning. These findings suggest that combining image and video SSL objectives can be beneficial in resource-limited settings, while highlighting the need for improved methods that better balance semantic, temporal, and geometric supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在数据、架构和计算预算完全匹配的条件下，对图像和视频自监督学习（SSL）目标进行受控对比研究，比较了对比、重建、特征预测和扩散等目标，并评估了单独训练与联合训练的图像-视频SSL组合。结果表明，在资源受限情况下，DINOv2风格的预训练始终表现最佳；将DINOv2与VideoMAE等视频SSL目标结合能显著提升图像分类与分割性能，但会损害视频跟踪和相机位姿估计性能，揭示语义与几何表征学习之间的权衡。
Motivation: 视觉基础模型通常需要大量数据和计算资源，当前预训练所需的规模可能不可持续或不必要。作者希望理解SSL目标在资源约束下如何表现，以便用更少的资源获得有效模型。
Method: 采用受控实验设计，在匹配的数据、架构和计算预算下，系统比较对比学习、重建、特征预测和扩散等SSL目标，并考察单独训练与联合训练的图像-视频SSL组合在多种图像和视频理解任务上的效果。
Result: 摘要报告DINOv2风格预训练在有限资源下整体性能最强；DINOv2与视频SSL目标（如VideoMAE）联合训练可提升图像分类和分割，但降低视频跟踪和相机位姿估计性能。
Conclusion: 在资源受限环境下，结合图像和视频SSL目标可能有益，但需要开发能更好平衡语义、时间和几何监督的改进方法。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Teach the Magnitude, Not the Direction: Verifier-Bounded Credit Assignment for Multi-Turn Multi-step LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) offers a verifier-bounded performance ceiling for training multi-turn tool-use agents, yet its trajectory-level credit assignment conflates heterogeneous per-turn outcomes into a single reward signal. On-policy distillation provides dense per-token supervision but is either teacher-bounded or prone to gradient concentration collapse. We introduce $\textbf{CrEST}$, a hierarchical credit assignment framework that retains RL's verifier-bounded ceiling while incorporating dense token-level signals from a privileged self-teacher. $\textbf{CrEST}$ resolves credit at two levels: turn-segmented verified advantages address inter-turn dilution, while entropy-gated self-teacher modulation refines intra-turn token contributions. Experiments on BFCL V3 and WildToolBench show that $\textbf{CrEST}$ consistently outperforms both RL and distillation baselines across two model scales, with the largest gains on long-trajectory and strict session-level metrics. Our work demonstrates that the teacher's role in policy optimization can be reduced from determining update directions to modulating update magnitudes, unlocking dense credit assignment without sacrificing the verifier-bounded ceiling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CrEST，一个面向多轮多步 LLM 智能体 (multi-turn multi-step LLM agents) 的分层信用分配框架，旨在保留基于可验证奖励的强化学习 (RLVR) 的 verifier-bounded 性能上限，同时引入来自特权自我教师 (self-teacher) 的稠密 token 级信号。CrEST 在两层解析信用：turn 级分割的可验证优势处理跨轮稀释 (inter-turn dilution)，熵门控的自我教师调制细化轮内 token 贡献。在 BFCL V3 和 WildToolBench 上的实验表明，CrEST 在两个模型规模上均一致优于 RL 和蒸馏基线，在长轨迹和严格 session 级指标上收益最大。
Motivation: RLVR 的轨迹级信用分配将异质的每轮结果混入单一奖励信号，限制了训练上限；而在策略蒸馏 (on-policy distillation) 提供的稠密逐 token 监督要么受教师能力限制，要么容易出现梯度集中坍缩 (gradient concentration collapse)。因此需要一种既能保持 verifier-bounded 上限又能获得稠密信用信号的方法。
Method: 提出分层信用分配框架 CrEST，包含两个层级：turn 级分割的可验证优势函数解决跨轮信用稀释问题，熵门控的自我教师调制 (entropy-gated self-teacher modulation) 细化轮内 token 的贡献权重，从而将教师的角色从决定更新方向转变为调节更新幅度。
Result: 在 BFCL V3 和 WildToolBench 基准上，CrEST 在两个模型规模下均稳定优于 RL 和蒸馏基线，且最大的提升出现在长轨迹和严格的 session 级指标上。
Conclusion: 作者认为，策略优化中教师的角色可以简化为调制更新幅度而非决定更新方向，从而在不牺牲 verifier-bounded 上限的前提下实现稠密信用分配。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.motivation: RLVR 的轨迹级信用分配将异质的每轮结果混入单一奖励信号，限制了训练上限；而在策略蒸馏 (on-policy distillation) 提供的稠密逐 token 监督要么受教师能力限制，要么容易出现梯度集中坍缩 (gradient concentration collapse)。因此需要一种既能保持 verifier-bounded 上限又能获得稠密信用信号的方法。
summary_sections.method: 提出分层信用分配框架 CrEST，包含两个层级：turn 级分割的可验证优势函数解决跨轮信用稀释问题，熵门控的自我教师调制 (entropy-gated self-teacher modulation) 细化轮内 token 的贡献权重，从而将教师的角色从决定更新方向转变为调节更新幅度。
summary_sections.result: 在 BFCL V3 和 WildToolBench 基准上，CrEST 在两个模型规模下均稳定优于 RL 和蒸馏基线，且最大的提升出现在长轨迹和严格的 session 级指标上。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为，策略优化中教师的角色可以简化为调制更新幅度而非决定更新方向，从而在不牺牲 verifier-bounded 上限的前提下实现稠密信用分配。

papers.title: SkillShapley: Boundary-Adaptive Shapley Valuation for Skill Step Attribution in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills are crucial external instructions that enable language agents to execute long procedural tasks such as coding or document processing. Existing agent skills are primarily created through human manual crafting or agent execution traces, with limited understanding of how each step contributes to overall skill performance on specific tasks; i.e., there remains an open problem in quantifying the contribution of individual steps within an agent skill. To address this issue, we first model skill-step attribution as a Shapley value-based contribution estimation problem, and then propose SkillShapley, a step-level attribution framework for agent skills. Notably, SkillShapley operates in two phases, motivated by key empirical insights, i.e., discretized benchmark rewards that create sharp performance cliffs, and step interactions that are largely additive rather than synergistic. Specifically, it first identifies informative coalitional regions, and then adaptively samples new coalitions that can yield reusable marginal evidence. Experiments on skills from the widely adopted SkillsBench demonstrate that our SkillShapley can effectively and efficiently identify high- or low-value skill steps, providing several key takeaways for agent skill creation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SkillShapley，一个面向 LLM 智能体技能 (agent skills) 的步骤级归因框架，将技能步骤贡献估计建模为 Shapley 值问题。作者基于两个经验观察（离散基准奖励造成性能陡崖、步骤交互近似可加而非协同）设计两阶段方法：先识别信息性联盟区域，再自适应采样可产生可复用边际证据的新联盟。在 SkillsBench 上的实验表明，该方法能有效且高效地识别高价值或低价值的技能步骤。
Motivation: 现有智能体技能主要通过人工手工编写或智能体执行轨迹创建，缺乏对单个步骤如何影响特定任务整体技能性能的量化理解；技能步骤贡献归因仍是一个开放问题。
Method: 将技能步骤归因建模为基于 Shapley 值的贡献估计问题，并提出两阶段框架 SkillShapley：第一阶段识别信息性联盟区域，第二阶段自适应采样能够生成可复用边际证据的新联盟，从而降低估计代价。
Result: 在广泛采用的 SkillsBench 技能集上，SkillShapley 能够有效且高效地识别高价值或低价值的技能步骤，并为智能体技能创建提供了若干关键结论。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 SkillShapley 可用于智能体技能创建中的步骤价值评估，给出了若干经验性结论；摘要本身未讨论明确的局限性。

papers.title: High-dimensional networks and mean squared error for possibly misspecified models
papers.abstract_en: To avoid missing important variables and their connections in networks, more and more variables are included in network analysis. Here we show that in a setting with many more parameters than observations (high-dimensional) it is possible to get a conservative (i.e., low false positive rate) estimate of the neighbourhood for each node (which connections are in the network). A neighbourhood is often estimated with a linear model, and this leads to two interesting cases: (i) If the true model is linear, then neighbourhood selection work reasonably well, and (ii) if the true model is nonlinear, then neighbourhood selection requires a penalty for the high dimensions. Here we show the impact of the ridge parameter on the mean squared error, and how this leads to low test variance and hence to neighbourhoods with large numbers of edges. We connect these insights with results from machine learning, where the so-called double descent (when more parameters are included than observations, the mean squared error goes down a second time) has put the traditional view on model selection upside down. Essentially, for adequate neighbourhood selection in models with a large number of parameters, the volume of the model space needs to be included in the penalty. Most neighbourhood selection methods (e.g., Lasso, AIC, BIC) lead to spurious edges (high false positive rate), but we prove that in the high-dimensional setting, minimum description length leads to correct neighbourhood selection or smaller (low false positive rates) in both cases when either the model is correctly or incorrectly assumed linear
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究高维（参数个数远多于观测数）情形下网络邻域选择 (neighbourhood selection) 的均方误差性质。作者证明岭参数 (ridge parameter) 对均方误差的影响会带来低测试方差和大边数邻域，并将其与机器学习中的双下降 (double descent) 现象联系起来。论文证明，当模型线性假设正确或错误时，最小描述长度 (minimum description length, MDL) 都能得到正确或保守（低假阳性率）的邻域选择，而 Lasso、AIC、BIC 等常见方法易产生虚假边。
Motivation: 为避免遗漏重要变量及其连接，网络分析中包含越来越多变量，但在高维场景下需要保守（低假阳性率）的邻域估计；同时真实模型可能是非线性的（模型误设），这使得邻域选择需要针对高维度施加惩罚。
Method: 作者从理论上分析线性模型估计邻域时的两种情况（真实模型线性或非线性），考察岭参数对均方误差与测试方差的影响，并证明在惩罚中需要纳入模型空间的体积；在此基础上证明 MDL 在高维设定下能实现正确的邻域选择或更小的假阳性率。
Result: 摘要指出 Lasso、AIC、BIC 等多数邻域选择方法会造成高假阳性率（虚假边），而在高维设定下 MDL 在模型被正确或错误地假定为线性这两种情形中都能得到正确的邻域选择或更低的假阳性率。
Conclusion: 作者认为，对于参数数目很大的模型的充分邻域选择，惩罚中需要包含模型空间的体积；这一结论将网络邻域选择与机器学习中的双下降现象联系起来。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: TRAPSBench: Vision-Language Models Encode but Fail to Express Epistemic Restraint
papers.abstract_en: When visual evidence is occluded or chaotic, models should abstain. In this paper, we show that Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can internally distinguish when abstention is required, but fail to express it anyway. We introduce TRAPSBench, a procedurally generated video benchmark of 1,404 matched physics pairs in which a single targeted change renders the outcome undeterminable from the visual evidence. Furthermore, we introduce Penalized Epistemic Calibration Score (PECS), a new robust metric that requires models to both answer correctly when the outcome is knowable, and abstain when the outcome is not. Across 16 VLMs spanning five families, spontaneous restraint is poor: the best PECS is 0.292. The bottleneck is expression, not perception: linear probes decode answerability from hidden states at up to 0.91 AUROC across physics domains; steering a single-layer void direction causally induces or suppresses abstention. Our results replicate across three open-weight families (Qwen, Gemma, LLaVA). The failure is also more pronounced in visual than textual uncertainty: models detect textual impossibility about 4x more readily than missing visual evidence. Closing this representation--output gap likely requires output-stage interventions.
papers.comment: 10 Pages excluding Reference and Appendix, Published at COLM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉语言模型 (VLM) 在视觉证据被遮挡或混乱时是否能够主动弃权 (abstain)。作者提出 TRAPSBench，一个包含 1,404 个匹配物理对的程序化生成视频基准，其中单个定向变化会使结果无法由视觉证据确定；同时提出 Penalized Epistemic Calibration Score (PECS) 来同时要求模型在结果可知时答对、在不可知时弃权。实验发现模型在内部表征上能区分可回答性，但自发输出层面的弃权表现很差。
Motivation: 当视觉证据被遮挡或混乱时模型应当弃权，但现有 VLM 很少这样做；作者希望弄清这种失败究竟来自感知层面还是表达层面，并为此提供可量化的基准与指标。
Method: 构建 TRAPSBench 程序化视频基准，通过对匹配物理对做单点定向改变使结果不可判定；提出 PECS 指标；并用线性探针 (linear probes) 从隐藏状态解码可回答性，以及对单层 void direction 进行因果干预来诱发或抑制弃权。
Result: 16 个 VLM、5 个模型家族中自发弃权表现差，最佳 PECS 仅 0.292；线性探针在不同物理域上解码可回答性的 AUROC 最高达 0.91；通过引导单层 void direction 可因果地诱发或抑制弃权，且这一现象在 Qwen、Gemma、LLaVA 三个开放权重家族中可复现。模型检测文本不可能性的能力约为检测视觉证据缺失的 4 倍。
Conclusion: 失败瓶颈在于表达而非感知：模型内部能够编码可回答性却无法在输出中体现，关闭表征-输出差距很可能需要输出阶段的干预。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Better Decomposition, Free Aggregation: A Synthesizer-Folding Framework for Multilingual Multi-Hop Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Multilingual retrieval-augmented generation (mRAG) equips large language models with access to globally distributed external knowledge for complex multilingual question answering. Recent approaches either translate retrieved documents into English or the query language to bridge the cross-lingual semantic gap, or decompose a complex query into sub-questions and aggregate the intermediate reasoning process. However, both lines of work suffer from two limitations. First, one-size-fits-all translation alignment, blanket translation discards culturally and linguistically native information unique to the target language, introduces translation noise, and inflates system cost. Second, greedy decomposition and aggregation, uncontrolled decomposition produces redundant sub-questions that compound errors during step-wise reasoning, and the final aggregation over reasoning paths further amplifies these errors. We address both with our method Syfer, a synthesizer-folding framework for multilingual multi-hop question answering that defers translation rather than applying it by default. Syfer first invokes a format-constrained decomposer to produce a sub-question graph in the original language, followed by a decomposition-quality check; when the check passes, sub-questions are answered sequentially under a retrieve-then-answer policy in the target language, and the English translation pathway with bilingual sub-question graph alignment is activated only when the check fails. Experiments across multiple languages show that Syfer attains competitive accuracy while striking a favourable balance between performance and computational cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Syfer，一个面向多语言多跳问答的合成器折叠框架（synthesizer-folding framework），用于改进多语言检索增强生成（mRAG）。Syfer 默认延迟翻译而非一律翻译：先用格式约束的分解器生成原始语言的子问题图，再做分解质量检查；仅当检查失败时才激活英文翻译路径和双语子问题图对齐。实验表明 Syfer 在多个语言上获得有竞争力的准确率，并在性能与计算成本之间取得较好平衡。
Motivation: 现有 mRAG 方法要么统一翻译检索文档或查询以弥合跨语言语义差距，要么将复杂查询分解为子问题并聚合中间推理；但两者分别存在一刀切翻译丢失目标语言本土信息、引入翻译噪声和增加成本，以及无控制分解产生冗余子问题并在逐步推理和最终聚合中放大错误的问题。
Method: 提出 Syfer 框架：先由格式约束的 decomposer 在原始语言中生成子问题图，随后进行 decomposition-quality check；检查通过时按检索后回答（retrieve-then-answer）策略顺序回答子问题，检查失败时启用英文翻译路径并配合双语子问题图对齐。
Result: 在多种语言的实验上，Syfer 取得有竞争力的准确率，并在性能和计算成本之间实现有利的平衡。
Conclusion: 作者认为延迟翻译而非默认翻译，并结合受控分解与质量检查，可以在多语言多跳问答中同时缓解翻译噪声和分解聚合误差累积问题。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Splat-based Metal Artifact Reduction in Cone-Beam CT via Polychromatic Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) enables volumetric reconstruction from X-ray projections, but suffers from severe artifacts--especially beam hardening--when imaging materials with high attenuation such as metals. These artifacts arise from the polychromatic nature of X-rays and are not properly addressed by conventional monochromatic reconstruction algorithms. While recent neural representation-based methods offer improved reconstruction quality, they are computationally expensive and often impractical for deployment. We propose a novel physics-inspired, self-calibrating metal artifact reduction method that efficiently reconstructs 3D CBCT volumes while correcting beam hardening artifacts. Our method integrates a polychromatic X-ray projection model, material-dependent attenuation profiles, and system response modeling into a Gaussian Splatting framework. Unlike prior work, we eliminate the need for manual metal masks or strong prior assumptions, and we optimize both reconstruction parameters and X-ray spectral characteristics jointly during training. We further introduce a high-fidelity synthetic CBCT dataset generation pipeline validated on Monte-Carlo x-ray simulation toolbox and release new datasets with severe metal-induced artifacts to support the community. This is the first splat-based method for reducing beam hardening in CBCT. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in artifact suppression and reconstruction accuracy.
papers.journal_ref: Computer Graphics forum, Volume 45 (2026), Number 2
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于高斯泼溅 (Gaussian Splatting) 的锥束 CT (CBCT) 金属伪影去除方法，将多色 X 射线投影模型、材料相关衰减剖面和系统响应建模整合进渲染框架，联合优化重建参数与 X 射线光谱特征。作者称这是首个基于 splat 的 CBCT 束硬化伪影去除方法，在合成和真实数据集上超越现有方法，并发布了新的高保真合成数据集。
Motivation: CBCT 在成像高衰减金属材料时因 X 射线多色性产生严重束硬化伪影，传统单色重建算法无法正确处理；已有的神经表示方法虽提升重建质量，但计算成本高、难以实际部署。
Method: 提出物理启发的自校准金属伪影减少方法，无需人工金属掩膜或强先验假设，将多色 X 射线投影模型、材料相关衰减剖面和系统响应建模集成到 Gaussian Splatting 框架，并在训练中联合优化重建参数和 X 射线光谱特性；同时引入经蒙特卡洛 X 射线模拟工具箱验证的合成 CBCT 数据集生成流程。
Result: 摘要报告在合成与真实数据集的广泛实验中，该方法在伪影抑制和重建精度上优于现有最先进方法，且未提供具体数值。
Conclusion: 该方法作为首个 splat 类束硬化伪影去除方案，兼顾重建质量与计算效率，并通过发布带严重金属伪影的新数据集支持社区后续研究。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Rethinking Normalization Placement for LLMs: Post-Norm under Curriculum Depth Growing
papers.abstract_en: Pre-norm is the standard normalization placement in modern Transformers because it facilitates joint optimization of full-depth models. We ask whether this preference persists when depth is introduced through a curriculum. In curriculum depth growth, each appended block receives the boundary representation produced by a trained prefix, making normalization placement relevant to forward conditioning. We therefore test whether placement and training curriculum interact. In a controlled distillation study with a Qwen3-8B teacher and a nine-layer student, pre-norm and post-norm are indistinguishable under joint training, differing by $0.0004$ validation CE, while post-norm improves over pre-norm by $0.0328$ under curriculum growth, an order of magnitude larger. A post-joint control matched by student active-layer tokens remains worse than post-grow, which rules out compute as the sole explanation. The ranking crosses over during the curriculum: post-norm takes the lead once blocks are appended. Single-block and freeze controls localize the ranking change to block appending rather than shallow-block quality or retraining. Boundary diagnostics associate post-norm with stable residual scales and pre-norm with structural-token scale drift; on a fixed batch, the final pre-grow block is also nearly identity-mapped. Together with the phase-wise crossover, these observations are consistent with boundary-scale conditioning after new blocks are appended. The results motivate treating normalization placement and training curriculum as coupled design choices in this distillation setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在通过课程学习逐层增加深度（curriculum depth growth）时，归一化位置（pre-norm 与 post-norm）是否仍然维持 pre-norm 的偏好。作者以 Qwen3-8B 为教师、九层网络为学生进行受控蒸馏实验，发现在联合训练下两种归一化几乎无差异（验证 CE 差 0.0004），而在课程式增长下 post-norm 比 pre-norm 好 0.0328，差距高一个量级。通过单块与冻结等控制实验，作者将排名反转定位到新块追加阶段，并结合边界诊断认为这与新块追加后的边界尺度条件化（boundary-scale conditioning）有关。
Motivation: Pre-norm 是现代 Transformer 的标准归一化位置，因为它有利于全深度模型的联合优化；但这一偏好是否在深度通过课程逐步引入时仍然成立，此前不清楚。课程深度增长中每个新增块接收已训练前缀产生的边界表示，使得归一化位置与前向条件化相关。
Method: 采用 Qwen3-8B 教师蒸馏到九层学生的受控实验，系统比较 pre-norm 与 post-norm 在联合训练和课程增长两种训练方式下的表现；使用按学生 active-layer tokens 匹配的 post-joint 控制、单块控制以及冻结控制来排除计算量、浅层块质量和重训练等因素；并对边界表示做尺度诊断。
Result: 联合训练下 pre-norm 与 post-norm 的验证 CE 仅差 0.0004，而课程增长下 post-norm 比 pre-norm 好 0.0328，差距大一个量级；post-joint 控制仍差于 post-grow，说明计算量不是唯一解释。排名在课程中发生交叉，post-norm 在块被追加后取得领先；诊断显示 post-norm 保持稳定的残差尺度，pre-norm 出现结构性 token 尺度漂移，且最终 pre-grow 块在固定 batch 上近乎恒等映射。
Conclusion: 作者认为在该蒸馏场景下，归一化位置与训练课程应被视为耦合的设计选择；观察结果与新增块追加后的边界尺度条件化解释一致。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Less Annotation, More Interpretation: Prior-Guided Concept Bottleneck Models for Interpretable Cancer Imaging Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Concept bottleneck models (CBMs) can improve the transparency of cancer image diagnostic prediction by expressing predictions through radiological concepts. However, their dependence on instance-level concept annotations limits practical applicability. We propose a prior-guided hybrid CBM that integrates limited concept annotations, class-conditional concept distribution matching on unannotated patients, and prior initialization of the concept-to-diagnosis head. We evaluate the method on CBIS-DDSM mammographic masses and calcifications and LIDC-IDRI pulmonary nodules across 0-100% concept annotation. In the clinically relevant 0-20% annotation regime, the hybrid CBM consistently improves mean concept AUC over a matched standard CBM, while maintaining diagnostic performance close to black-box models. At 10% annotation specifically, concept AUC increases from 0.619 to 0.741 for masses, from 0.650 to 0.787 for calcifications, and from 0.597 to 0.642 for pulmonary nodules. Ablation experiments identify prior initialization as the main component contributing to improved concept detection, likely by stabilizing the concept-to-diagnosis head. Zero-shot VLMs remain insufficient for reliable fine-grained tumor-level concept prediction. These findings suggest that structured priors can substantially reduce the annotation burden of interpretable cancer imaging models.
papers.comment: Accepted at the iMIMIC Workshop at MICCAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种先验引导的混合概念瓶颈模型 (hybrid concept bottleneck model, CBM)，用于可解释的癌症影像诊断。模型整合少量实例级概念标注、未标注患者上的类别条件概念分布匹配，以及概念到诊断头的先验初始化，并在 CBIS-DDSM 和 LIDC-IDRI 上验证。结果表明在临床相关的 0-20% 概念标注区间内，混合 CBM 相比标准 CBM 持续提升概念 AUC，同时诊断性能接近黑盒模型。
Motivation: 概念瓶颈模型 (CBM) 能通过放射学概念提升癌症影像诊断的可解释性，但其依赖实例级概念标注，限制了实际应用。作者希望降低注释负担，同时保持可解释性和诊断性能。
Method: 提出先验引导的混合 CBM，包含三部分：有限的概念标注、在未标注患者上进行类别条件概念分布匹配 (class-conditional concept distribution matching)，以及对概念到诊断头的先验初始化 (prior initialization)。
Result: 在 0-20% 标注区间内，混合 CBM 持续优于匹配的标准 CBM 的平均概念 AUC，诊断性能接近黑盒模型。10% 标注时，概念 AUC 在肿块上从 0.619 提升到 0.741，钙化上从 0.650 提升到 0.787，肺结节上从 0.597 提升到 0.642。消融实验表明先验初始化是提升概念检测的主要因素，而零样本 VLM 仍不足以进行可靠的细粒度肿瘤级概念预测。
Conclusion: 结构化先验能够显著降低可解释癌症影像模型的标注负担，先验初始化通过稳定概念到诊断头带来主要收益。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Geometry-Grounded Unified 3D Perception for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Camera-based autonomous driving perception requires a shared representation that preserves metric 3D structure across synchronized multi-camera streams. However, existing image-based frameworks often rely on backbones pretrained for semantic recognition, and introduce 3D geometry through downstream task-specific modules. As a result, their shared representations may fail to preserve explicit metric geometry and consistent 3D scene structure. In this paper, we present a Geometry-grounded Unified 3D Perception (GeoUP) framework that adapts the reconstruction-oriented latent of VGGT to calibrated, streaming multi-camera driving scenes. GeoUP factorizes cross-image interaction into self, temporal, and view attention to capture structurally distinct temporal and cross-view correspondences. It further injects calibration-aware raymap encodings to provide metric scale and camera geometry. The resulting geometry-grounded latent is decoded for metric depth estimation, 3D object detection, and semantic occupancy prediction, corresponding to surface-, instance-, and volume-level readouts of the same 3D scene. Through joint multi-task and multi-dataset training, GeoUP effectively leverages heterogeneous annotations and generalizes across diverse sensor configurations and perception ranges. Extensive experiments on nuScenes, Argoverse 2, Waymo, KITTI, and DDAD demonstrate that GeoUP achieves SOTA performance across detection, occupancy, and depth estimation. These results validate the effectiveness of geometry-grounded representations for unified 3D driving perception.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Geometry-grounded Unified 3D Perception (GeoUP) 框架，用于基于相机的自动驾驶统一三维感知。GeoUP 将 VGGT 的重构导向潜在表示适配到标定的多相机流式驾驶场景，把跨图像交互分解为自注意力、时序注意力和视角注意力，并注入标定感知的 raymap 编码以提供度量尺度与相机几何。同一几何潜在表示被解码为度量深度估计、3D 物体检测和语义占用预测，并通过多任务、多数据集联合训练在 nuScenes、Argoverse 2、Waymo、KITTI 和 DDAD 上达到 SOTA。
Motivation: 现有基于图像的三维感知框架通常依赖面向语义识别预训练的主干网络，并通过下游任务特定模块引入三维几何，导致共享表示难以保留显式的度量几何和一致的三维场景结构。对于需要跨多相机流保持度量三维结构的自动驾驶感知，这一问题尤为关键。
Method: GeoUP 将重建导向的 VGGT 潜在表示用于标定的多相机驾驶场景，将跨图像交互分解为 self、temporal 和 view 三种注意力以捕获结构上不同的时序与跨视角对应关系；同时注入标定感知的 raymap 编码来提供度量尺度和相机几何，并基于该几何潜在表示解码出深度、检测与占用三种场景读取结果。
Result: 在 nuScenes、Argoverse 2、Waymo、KITTI 和 DDAD 上的大量实验表明，GeoUP 在 3D 检测、语义占用和深度估计上均达到 SOTA 性能。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，这些结果验证了几何接地表示对统一三维驾驶感知的有效性，并表明该方法能利用异构标注、泛化到不同传感器配置和感知范围。摘要未明确讨论局限。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LipCache: A Local Inference Proxy with Certified Caching for Edge Image Classification Service
papers.abstract_en: As edge-side vision services continue to expand toward low-latency, high-throughput scenarios, reducing the inference cost of vision models without sacrificing reliability has become a central concern. Existing semantic caching methods largely rely on empirical similarity thresholds; while such thresholds improve hit rates, they tend to introduce silent misclassifications near decision boundaries. To address this, we propose \texttt{LipCache}, a certified semantic caching framework for image classification. Without modifying the existing deployed main model, \texttt{MainNet}, the framework introduces a lightweight network, \texttt{GuardNet}, that maps inputs into a low-dimensional feature space subject to a Lipschitz constraint. It then computes a per-sample certified reuse radius from the local classification margin and the spectral norm of the classification head. At runtime, a cached result is reused only when the query feature falls inside the certified reuse ball; otherwise, the query falls back to \texttt{MainNet}. Thus, cache hits are transformed from empirical threshold tests into geometric certification decisions with explicit theoretical boundaries. Across standard image classification tasks like CIFAR, Tiny-ImageNet, and SVHN, \texttt{LipCache} achieves a measured speedup of up to $1.65\times$ with limited end-to-end accuracy degradation, while all accepted cache hits satisfy the \texttt{GuardNet}-side certified-consistency condition. Furthermore, an enhanced \texttt{GuardNet} training recipe substantially improves cache hit rates in the Tiny-ImageNet multi-class extension while maintaining a certified-consistency rate of $100\%$. These results demonstrate that per-sample certified reuse can reduce main-model fallback while preserving theoretical consistency, providing a feasible approach to reliable cache-assisted inference at the edge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LipCache，一种面向边缘图像分类的认证语义缓存框架。该框架在不修改已部署主模型 MainNet 的前提下，引入轻量网络 GuardNet，将输入映射到受 Lipschitz 约束的低维特征空间，并依据局部分类余量和分类头谱范数计算每个样本的认证复用半径。运行时只有查询特征落入认证复用球内才复用缓存结果，否则回退到 MainNet，从而将缓存命中从经验阈值判断转变为具有明确理论边界的几何认证。在 CIFAR、Tiny-ImageNet 和 SVHN 上，该方法实现了最高 1.65 倍的实测加速，端到端准确率下降有限，且所有被接受的缓存命中都满足 GuardNet 侧的认证一致性条件。
Motivation: 现有语义缓存方法多依赖经验相似度阈值，这些阈值虽能提高命中率，但在决策边界附近容易引入静默误分类。边缘视觉服务追求低延迟和高吞吐，因此需要在保证可靠性的前提下降低推理成本，而现有方法缺乏理论上的认证保障。
Method: 提出 LipCache 框架，引入 GuardNet 轻量网络将输入映射到低维特征空间并施加 Lipschitz 约束；利用局部分类余量和分类头谱范数逐样本计算认证复用半径。运行时仅当查询特征位于认证复用球内时才复用缓存结果，否则回退至 MainNet。此外，还提出了增强的 GuardNet 训练配方以提升缓存命中率。
Result: 在 CIFAR、Tiny-ImageNet 和 SVHN 等标准图像分类任务上，LipCache 达到最高 1.65 倍的实测加速，且端到端准确率下降有限；所有被接受的缓存命中均满足 GuardNet 侧的认证一致性条件。增强的训练配方在 Tiny-ImageNet 多类扩展上显著提高缓存命中率，同时保持 100% 的认证一致性率。
Conclusion: 逐样本的认证复用能够在保证理论一致性的前提下减少对主模型的回退，为边缘场景下可靠的缓存辅助推理提供了一种可行方案。

papers.title: MergeOver: Post-Training Token Merging for Recursive Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformers (ViTs) demonstrate exceptional performance in computer vision but suffer from large parameter counts and quadratic computational complexity, severely limiting their deployment on resource-constrained edge hardware. While recursive weight-sharing reduces parameter counts and token merging mitigates computational and memory bottlenecks, integrating these two paradigms without costly retraining is non-trivial, leaving this intersection largely unexplored. We propose MergeOver, a post-training approach that integrates Token Merging (ToMe) into the recursively weight-shared Sliced Recursive Transformer (SReT). Through an Unmerge tracking stack, constraint-safe merge-rate adjustment, and synchronised token-mass tracking across spatial permutations, MergeOver resolves the spatial and merging constraints of this integration. We further employ a stage-wise single-shot schedule that performs token reduction at the first block of each stage and maintains a fixed sequence length throughout its subsequent recursive iterations. Benchmarked on ImageNet-1K, our selected configuration reduces top-1 accuracy by 1.47 percentage points. On the GPU, it reduces peak activation memory by 37.3% and 38.4% at batch sizes 1 and 16, while throughput decreases by 21.7% at batch size 1 but increases by 21.7% at batch size 16. On a Raspberry Pi 5 (ARM CPU), it reduces latency by 2.4% and 17.6% at batch sizes 1 and 16. These results show that MergeOver can recover a meaningful part of the throughput and memory cost that recursive weight-sharing introduces, without retraining, and provides a baseline for combining token merging with hierarchical recursive transformers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MergeOver，一种面向递归视觉 Transformer 的后训练 token 合并方法，将 Token Merging (ToMe) 集成到递归权重共享的 Sliced Recursive Transformer (SReT) 中。通过 Unmerge 跟踪栈、约束安全的合并率调整以及跨空间置换的同步 token 质量跟踪，解决递归结构下的空间与合并约束；并采用分阶段单次调度，在每个阶段首个 block 进行 token 缩减。ImageNet-1K 基准上，所选配置的 top-1 准确率下降 1.47 个百分点，同时在不同批大小下降低峰值激活内存并改变吞吐量。
Motivation: 递归权重共享可减少参数量，token 合并可缓解计算和内存瓶颈，但两者在不重训情况下的集成存在非平凡的空间与合并约束，这一交叉领域此前少有探索。
Method: 提出 post-training 方法 MergeOver，在递归权重共享的 SReT 中加入 Token Merging；用 Unmerge 跟踪栈与同步 token 质量跟踪处理空间排列，配合约束安全的合并率调整，并采用阶段内单次合并调度。
Result: ImageNet-1K 上 top-1 准确率降低 1.47 个百分点；GPU 上峰值激活内存在批大小 1 和 16 时分别降低 37.3% 与 38.4%，批大小 1 时吞吐量下降 21.7%，批大小 16 时吞吐量提升 21.7%；Raspberry Pi 5 (ARM CPU) 上批大小 1 和 16 时延迟分别降低 2.4% 与 17.6%。
Conclusion: MergeOver 无需重训即可回收递归权重共享引入的部分吞吐量和内存成本，并为 token 合并与层级递归 Transformer 的结合提供基线。

papers.title: LigBench: A Unified and Human-Aligned Benchmark for LLM-based Research Idea Generation
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs), research idea generation has attracted increasing attention. Existing approaches enable LLMs to retrieve relevant literature and propose novel ideas for research areas. However, current evaluation practices for idea generation remain fragmented and lack objective standards, often relying on direct LLM scoring, which limits their ability to provide unified and reliable assessments across a coherent distribution of generated ideas. To address this challenge, we propose LigBench, an automated evaluation benchmark that enables fine-grained and reliable evaluation of AI research ideas, consistently applicable across different generation distributions. In addition, we introduce PAIR-IQ, a dataset tailored for training pairwise idea judgment models and serving as an auxiliary reference to support more objective comparative evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LigBench achieves stable and interpretable evaluations, significantly improving alignment with expert judgments. Furthermore, models trained on PAIR-IQ exhibit enhanced ranking accuracy and robustness, establishing a principled standard for scalable and objective research idea assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LigBench，一个面向基于 LLM 的研究想法生成 (research idea generation) 的自动化评估基准，旨在解决现有评估碎片化、缺乏客观标准、往往依赖 LLM 直接打分的问题。作者同时引入 PAIR-IQ 数据集，用于训练成对想法判断模型并作为比较评估的辅助参考。实验表明 LigBench 评估稳定且可解释，显著提升与专家判断的一致性。
Motivation: 现有对 LLM 研究想法生成的评估实践分散且缺乏客观标准，常依赖 LLM 直接打分，难以在连贯的想法分布上提供统一可靠的评估。
Method: 提出自动化评估基准 LigBench，可跨不同生成分布进行细粒度且可靠的 AI 研究想法评估；并构建 PAIR-IQ 数据集，用于训练成对想法判断模型，作为更客观比较评估的辅助参考。
Result: 摘要报告 LigBench 实现稳定且可解释的评估，显著改善与专家判断的对齐；基于 PAIR-IQ 训练的模型在排序准确率和鲁棒性上均有所增强。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作为可扩展、客观的研究想法评估建立了原则性标准。

papers.title: Predicting Signed Distance Functions for Visual Instance Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Visual instance segmentation is a challenging problem and becomes even more difficult if objects of interest varies unconstrained in shape. Some objects are well described by a rectangle, however, this is hardly always the case. Consider for instance long, slender objects such as ropes. Anchor-based approaches classify predefined bounding boxes as either negative or positive and thus provide a limited set of shapes that can be handled. Defining anchor-boxes that fit well to all possible shapes leads to an infeasible number of prior boxes. We explore a different approach and propose to train a neural network to compute distance maps along different directions. The network is trained at each pixel to predict the distance to the closest object contour in a given direction. By pooling the distance maps we obtain an approximation to the signed distance function (SDF). The SDF may then be thresholded in order to obtain a foreground-background segmentation. We compare this segmentation to foreground segmentations obtained from the state-of-the-art instance segmentation method YOLACT. On the COCO dataset, our segmentation yields a higher performance in terms of foreground intersection over union (IoU). However, while the distance maps contain information on the individual instances, it is not straightforward to map them to the full instance segmentation. We still believe that this idea is a promising research direction for instance segmentation, as it better captures the different shapes found in the real world.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉实例分割中锚框难以覆盖任意形状（如绳索等细长物体）的问题，提出训练神经网络逐像素预测沿不同方向到最近物体轮廓的距离图，并通过池化这些距离图来近似符号距离函数 (SDF)，再经阈值化得到前景-背景分割。在 COCO 上，该分割相比 SOTA 方法 YOLACT 的前景分割获得更高的前景 IoU；但作者也指出，从距离图映射到完整实例分割并不直接。
Motivation: 基于锚框的方法只能处理预定义边界框对应的有限形状，对长而细的物体（如绳索）适配困难；要为所有可能形状设计锚框将导致数量不可行的先验框，因此需要更灵活的形状表达。
Method: 提出训练一个神经网络，在每个像素上预测给定方向到最近物体轮廓的距离；将多方向距离图池化后得到 SDF 的近似，再对 SDF 取阈值以获得前景-背景分割。
Result: 在 COCO 数据集上，该方法得到的前景分割与 YOLACT 相比具有更高的前景交并比 (foreground IoU)。
Conclusion: 作者认为距离图虽包含实例信息，但将其映射为完整实例分割仍不直接；他们仍视其为有前景的研究方向，因为它能更好捕捉现实世界中的不同物体形状。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Statistical Properties of Robust Learning under Distributional Shifts
papers.abstract_en: Distributional shifts arise when the target deployment environment differs from the source environment that generated the training data. Robust learning frameworks such as Distributionally Robust Optimization (DRO) and Robust Satisficing (RS) aim to address this challenge, yet their finite-sample guarantees under such shifts, and their systematic comparison, remain underexplored: existing analyses typically establish guarantees either in the source environment or for adversarial worst-case performance over an ambiguity set. This paper instead studies generalization error in the target environment---the excess loss under the shifted target distribution. Our contributions are threefold. First, we derive finite-sample generalization error bounds in the shifted target environment for both DRO and RS. These bounds explicitly characterize the trade-off between reduced sensitivity to shift and the regularization penalty induced by each method's robustness hyperparameter, and they avoid the curse of dimensionality associated with Wasserstein empirical concentration. Second, when partial shift information such as shift magnitude or direction is available, we propose information-directed hyperparameter calibrations and compare the two methods given the same information. Under these calibrations, and in the partial-information regimes we study, DRO and RS exhibit complementary theoretical and empirical behavior. Finally, we apply the framework to a network lot-sizing problem, using it to interpret how robust policies respond to positive shifts in the demand distribution. Together, these results fill a gap in understanding the statistical properties of robust learning methods under distributional shifts and provide a principled basis for comparing DRO and RS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究分布偏移下鲁棒学习方法的统计性质，聚焦DRO（Distributionally Robust Optimization）与RS（Robust Satisficing）在目标环境（偏移后的分布）下的泛化误差。作者推导了两者在目标环境下的有限样本误差界，显式刻画鲁棒性超参数带来的偏移敏感度降低与正则化惩罚之间的权衡，并回避了Wasserstein经验集中的维度灾难问题。文章还提出在部分偏移信息下的超参数校准，并应用到网络批量定购（network lot-sizing）问题。
Motivation: 现有DRO和RS的分析通常只给出源环境下的保证或对模糊集（ambiguity set）内最坏情况的保证，缺乏对目标环境（真实偏移后分布）下泛化误差的系统研究，也缺乏两种方法的系统比较。
Method: 推导DRO和RS在偏移目标分布下的有限样本泛化误差上界；在已知部分偏移信息（如偏移幅度或方向）时提出信息导向的超参数校准方法，并在相同信息下比较两种方法；最后将框架应用于网络批量定购问题以解释需求正向偏移下鲁棒策略的行为。
Result: 摘要报告推导出的误差界显式刻画了鲁棒性超参数导致的灵敏度降低与正则化惩罚间的权衡，且避免了与Wasserstein经验集中相关的维度灾难；在部分信息机制下，DRO与RS表现出互补的理论与经验行为。
Conclusion: 这些结果填补了分布偏移下鲁棒学习方法统计性质理解的空白，并为比较DRO与RS提供了原则性依据。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告推导出的误差界显式刻画了鲁棒性超参数导致的灵敏度降低与正则化惩罚间的权衡，且避免了与Wasserstein经验集中相关的维度灾难；在部分信息机制下，DRO与RS表现出互补的理论与经验行为。
summary_sections.conclusion: 这些结果填补了分布偏移下鲁棒学习方法统计性质理解的空白，并为比较DRO与RS提供了原则性依据。

papers.title: Huber-Wasserstein barycenters for robust distribution-valued data
papers.abstract_en: We propose a robust barycenter for distribution-valued data by incorporating the Huber loss directly into the optimal transport cost. In contrast to metric-space Huber means, which apply the Huber loss to the Wasserstein distance after optimization, our construction acts on individual transport displacements, preserving quadratic behavior locally while limiting the influence of large displacements. The resulting Huber-Wasserstein barycenters form a natural interpolation between Wasserstein means and $L^1$-type Wasserstein medians. We establish the analytical and statistical foundations of this construction. For optimal transport with Huber loss, we prove regularity and uniqueness properties of dual potentials, existence of optimal transport maps, and stability as the Huber parameter varies. For the associated barycenter problem, we prove existence and characterization results, consistency of empirical plug-in estimators, and a finite-sample breakdown point essentially equal to $1/2$. In dimension one, we further derive the pointwise influence function and asymptotic distribution, quantify the associated robustness-efficiency trade-off, and show that displacement-wise Huberization can retain first-order information that is lost by distance-based Huberization under localized shape contamination. Numerical experiments on contaminated distribution-valued data demonstrate the robustness of the proposed barycenters and illustrate their interpolation between mean- and median-like behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将 Huber 损失直接嵌入最优传输 (optimal transport) 代价中，构造面向分布值数据的稳健重心 (robust barycenter)。与对 Wasserstein 距离事后施加 Huber 损失的度量空间方法不同，该构造作用于逐位移 (displacement-wise) 的传输位移，在保持局部二次行为的同时限制大位移的影响，从而构成 Wasserstein 均值与 L1 型 Wasserstein 中位数之间的自然插值。作者建立了该构造的解析与统计理论基础。
Motivation: 分布值数据在实际中常受异常值或污染影响，而现有度量空间中的 Huber 均值是在优化之后对 Wasserstein 距离施加 Huber 损失，无法直接控制单个传输位移的贡献，稳健性有限。
Method: 将 Huber 损失直接引入最优传输代价，逐位移地截断大位移影响；随后系统研究带 Huber 损失的最优传输问题与相应的重心问题，包括对偶势的正则性与唯一性、最优传输映射的存在性、随 Huber 参数的稳定性、经验 plug-in 估计量的一致性，以及一维情形下的影响函数与渐近分布。
Result: 理论结果表明经验估计量的一致性与有限样本崩溃点 (breakdown point) 本质上为 1/2；在一维情形导出逐点影响函数与渐近分布，量化稳健性-效率权衡，并证明逐位移 Huber 化在局部形状污染下能保留基于距离的 Huber 化会丢失的一阶信息。数值实验显示该重心在污染数据上的稳健性及其介于均值与中位数之间的行为。
Conclusion: Huber-Wasserstein 重心为分布值数据提供介于均值和 L1 型中位数之间的稳健估计，并具备完整的解析与统计理论支撑；其适用范围聚焦于稳健重心估计本身。

papers.title: Numeracy in Large Language Models: Fundamental Limitations and Paths to Improvement
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong results on mathematical reasoning benchmarks yet remain unreliable on elementary numerical tasks, including magnitude comparison, large-integer arithmetic, fractions, and scientific notation. This survey examines basic numerical understanding as a capability distinct from high-level mathematical reasoning. We propose the Numerical Grounding Framework (NGF), which decomposes numeracy into Representational Grounding (RG), mapping numeral forms to value, magnitude, and equivalent representations, and Procedural Grounding (PG), executing arithmetic operations in accordance with their mathematical definitions. Using NGF, we organize recent diagnostic benchmarks, failure modes, structural explanations, and mitigation strategies. We review evidence concerning tokenization, positional encoding, embedding geometry, and pretraining-data distribution. We also apply NGF in a coordinated evaluation of three frontier model families across Number Cookbook, NumericBench, and GSM-Symbolic, comparing atomic, contextual, and reasoning-assisted numeracy. Architectural interventions such as digit-aware tokenization and Abacus Embeddings can improve models trained from scratch but are generally unavailable to users of pretrained systems, for whom supervised fine-tuning, reasoning scaffolds, and external tools are more practical. We conclude with deployment recommendations and research directions for more reliable numerical behavior in foundation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于大语言模型 (LLM) 基础数值能力 (numeracy) 的综述。作者提出 Numerical Grounding Framework (NGF)，将数值能力分解为表征接地 (Representational Grounding, RG) 和过程接地 (Procedural Grounding, PG)，并据此组织诊断基准、失败模式、结构性解释与缓解策略。摘要还报告对三个前沿模型家族在 Number Cookbook、NumericBench 和 GSM-Symbolic 上的协调评估，比较原子式、上下文式和推理辅助式数值能力。
Motivation: LLM 在数学推理基准上表现强劲，却在数值大小比较、大整数运算、分数和科学计数法等基础数值任务上不可靠；作者主张将基础数值理解视为与高层数学推理相区别的独立能力，并系统梳理这一问题。
Method: 提出 Numerical Grounding Framework (NGF)，将数值能力分解为 RG（将数字形式映射到数值、量级和等价表示）与 PG（按数学定义执行算术运算）。作者利用该框架组织现有诊断基准、失败模式、结构性解释和缓解策略，并讨论 tokenization、位置编码、嵌入几何和预训练数据分布的证据，同时对多个前沿模型家族进行协调评估。
Result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标，但指出数字感知 tokenization (digit-aware tokenization) 和 Abacus Embeddings 等架构干预可改善从零训练的模型，而这些干预通常不适用于预训练系统的现有用户；对用户而言，监督微调、推理脚手架 (reasoning scaffolds) 和外部工具更实用。
Conclusion: 作者总结给出面向部署的建议和使基础模型数值行为更可靠的研究方向，强调区分基础数值能力与高层数学推理有助于定位失败并选择实用缓解手段。
Relevance: 3
