papers.title: SkillEvo: Self-Renewing Evolution Gradients from Multi-Turn Interaction Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Agent Skills are today either hand-authored or produced in a single LLM generation pass, and consequently possess no closed loop through which they might improve from the interaction failures they actually cause. Recent work does close this loop, but derives its feedback from single-turn question-answering evaluation. The consequence is a sharp asymmetry: once the first round has patched the gaps that a single exchange can reveal, the evolution gradient decays, the defects that surface only across multiple turns remain invisible, and evolution stalls. Governance in these systems is likewise driven by an end-to-end verification score, a scalar gate that can reject a degraded candidate but can neither localize nor repair its structural cause. We argue that the binding constraint on sustained skill evolution is neither editing capability nor the number of iterations, but whether the evaluation feedback keeps supplying trustworthy evolution gradients. We introduce SkillEvo, in which trustworthy feedback generates the gradient and controllable governance constrains its direction. The first component recasts multi-turn user simulation from an evaluation endpoint into a feedback generator: follow-up questions expose defects layer by layer, so that every round of revision both consumes feedback and produces new feedback. The second replaces the passive rejection of a scalar gate with an independent governance layer that actively repairs factual degradation and structural bloat, preventing the gradient from drifting as degradation accumulates. Across six categories of cloud services, 9 production Skills, and 98 skill-reference files, SkillEvo surpasses self-reflection-based evolution by 23.0 points and single- turn-QA-driven evolution by 15.4 points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SkillEvo，一种面向 Agent Skills 的自我更新演化框架，核心观点是持续演化的瓶颈不在于编辑能力或迭代次数，而在于评估反馈能否持续提供可信的演化梯度（evolution gradients）。框架包含两个组件：把多轮用户模拟从评估终点重构为反馈生成器，让追问逐层暴露缺陷；以及用独立的治理层替换被动拒绝的标量门控，主动修复事实退化与结构膨胀。在六类云服务、9 个生产 Skills 和 98 个 skill-reference 文件上，SkillEvo 比基于自我反思的演化高 23.0 个百分点，比基于单轮问答的演化高 15.4 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有 Agent Skills 要么手工编写，要么由单次 LLM 生成，缺乏从交互失败中改进的闭环；近期工作虽闭环，但反馈来自单轮问答评估，导致第一轮修补后演化梯度迅速衰减，跨多轮才显现的缺陷不可见，演化停滞。此外，端到端验证分数这种标量门控只能拒绝退化候选，无法定位或修复其结构性问题。
Method: SkillEvo 由两个组件构成：一是将多轮用户模拟从评估端点变为反馈生成器，通过后续追问逐层暴露缺陷，使每轮修订既消耗反馈又产生新反馈；二是用独立治理层取代标量门控的被动拒绝，主动修复事实退化和结构膨胀，防止累积退化导致梯度漂移。
Result: 在六类云服务、9 个生产 Skills 和 98 个 skill-reference 文件上，SkillEvo 相对自我反思式演化提升 23.0 个百分点，相对单轮问答驱动的演化提升 15.4 个百分点。
Conclusion: 作者认为持续技能演化的关键约束是评估反馈能否持续提供可信的演化梯度；SkillEvo 通过多轮反馈生成和可控治理展示了在真实生产技能上的持续改进能力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: QuISE: Defense against Typographic Attacks on VLMs via Query-Irrelevant Semantic Editing
papers.abstract_en: Typographic attacks pose a critical threat to vision-language models (VLMs) by injecting misleading text into images and causing models to rely on adversarial textual cues rather than visual evidence. Existing defenses often require model-specific modifications, additional training, or access to internal model components, limiting their applicability to modern closed-source VLMs. In this paper, we propose QuISE, a model-agnostic, training-free black-box defense based on query-irrelevant semantic editing. QuISE first identifies text regions likely to affect the current query through influence-aware text localization. QuISE then replaces these regions with two semantically distinct replacement texts that are irrelevant to both the query and the image. The final answer is determined by answer consistency across the edited images. Extensive experiments on three typographic-attack benchmarks, four attack settings, and four VLMs show that QuISE consistently improves defended accuracy. QuISE achieves a recovery rate of 67.9-75.0% with a harm rate of 0.5-1.1%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 QuISE，一种针对视觉语言模型 (VLM) 上排版攻击 (typographic attack) 的模型无关、无需训练的黑盒防御方法。QuISE 通过影响感知的文本定位 (influence-aware text localization) 识别可能影响当前查询的文本区域，再将其替换为与查询和图像均无关的两个语义不同文本，最后依据编辑后图像的答案一致性给出最终判定。在三类排版攻击基准、四种攻击设置和四个 VLM 上的实验显示，QuISE 一致提升防御准确率，恢复率 (recovery rate) 为 67.9%-75.0%，伤害率 (harm rate) 为 0.5%-1.1%。
Motivation: 排版攻击通过在图像中注入误导性文本，使 VLM 依赖对抗性文本线索而非视觉证据，构成严重威胁。现有防御往往需要修改模型、额外训练或访问模型内部组件，难以适用于闭源的现代 VLM，因此需要一种不依赖模型内部结构的黑盒防御。
Method: QuISE 采用查询无关语义编辑 (query-irrelevant semantic editing) 的流水线：先用影响感知的文本定位找出可能影响当前查询的文本区域，然后用两个与查询和图像均无关的语义不同文本替换这些区域，最后通过编辑后图像间的答案一致性决定最终输出。
Result: 在三个排版攻击基准、四种攻击设置和四个 VLM 上，QuISE 一致提升了防御后的准确率，并取得 67.9%-75.0% 的恢复率与 0.5%-1.1% 的伤害率。
Conclusion: QuISE 作为模型无关且无需训练的纯黑盒防御，可推广到无法访问内部组件的闭源 VLM，并通过跨编辑图像的一致性判定来抑制文本线索的误导。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.conclusion: QuISE 作为模型无关且无需训练的纯黑盒防御，可推广到无法访问内部组件的闭源 VLM，并通过跨编辑图像的一致性判定来抑制文本线索的误导。

papers.title: Branch and Bound for Relational Verification of Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Verification of neural networks against relational specifications, such as global robustness, is crucial for safety-critical applications of cyber-physical systems (CPS), given their increasing adoption of AI components. Compared to simple trace properties (e.g., local robustness), verifying relational specifications requires reasoning about the relationship between multiple network inferences, which brings significant technical challenges. Existing research has explored abstraction techniques based on sound and convex over-approximation of neural network outputs; however, since these approaches are inherently incomplete and may raise false alarms, they further underscore the need of effective abstraction refinement. In this paper, we propose a branch-and-bound (BaB) framework to mitigate the issue, which iteratively splits the problem until all sub-problems are verified. Specifically, our BaB framework features splitting of relational neurons rather than individual neurons as prior works do, and as the core of our technique, we devise a relational neuron selection strategy based on the dual formulation of the verification problem, which allows us to efficiently select the (most likely) optimal relational neuron that maximizes the refinement brought by problem splitting. We evaluate SaBRe on 817 verification problems across ACAS Xu, MNIST-F, MNIST-C, CIFAR and GTSRB. The results show that SaBRe outperforms different baseline approaches, in terms of the number of solved instances and verification efficiency, which demonstrates the effectiveness of our proposed techniques.
papers.comment: The full version of the paper accepted by EMSOFT 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对神经网络关系规范（如全局鲁棒性）的验证问题，提出一个分支定界 (branch-and-bound, BaB) 框架 SaBRe，通过迭代拆分问题直至所有子问题被验证。与先前工作不同，该方法拆分关系神经元而非单个神经元，并基于验证问题的对偶形式设计了关系神经元选择策略。在 ACAS Xu、MNIST-F、MNIST-C、CIFAR 和 GTSRB 上的 817 个验证问题上，SaBRe 在求解实例数量和验证效率上优于多种基线。
Motivation: 验证神经网络的关系规范对安全关键的 CPS 至关重要，但与局部鲁棒性等简单迹性质相比，关系规范需要推理多次网络推理之间的关系，带来显著技术挑战。现有基于凸过近似的抽象方法本质上不完备且可能产生误报，因此需要有效的抽象细化机制。
Method: 提出一个 BaB 框架，迭代拆分问题直到所有子问题被验证；其核心是拆分关系神经元而非单个神经元，并利用验证问题的对偶形式设计关系神经元选择策略，以高效选择最可能使拆分细化收益最大化的关系神经元。
Result: 在 ACAS Xu、MNIST-F、MNIST-C、CIFAR 和 GTSRB 共 817 个验证问题上，SaBRe 在求解实例数量和验证效率方面均优于不同基线方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调提出的关系神经元拆分与基于对偶的选择策略能有效提升关系规范验证的完备性和效率。

papers.title: Fast Iterative Five point Relative Pose Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Robust estimation of the relative pose between two cameras is a fundamental part of Structure and Motion methods. For calibrated cameras, the five point method together with a robust estimator such as RANSAC gives the best result in most cases. The current state-of-the-art method for solving the relative pose problem from five points is due to Nister [9], because it is faster than other methods and in the RANSAC scheme one can improve precision by increasing the number of iterations. In this paper, we propose a new iterative method, which is based on Powell's Dog Leg algorithm. The new method has the same precision and is approximately twice as fast as Nister's algorithm. The proposed method is easily extended to more than five points while retaining a efficient error metrics. This makes it also very suitable as an refinement step. The proposed algorithm is systematically evaluated on three types of datasets with known ground truth.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Workshop on Robot Vision (WoRV 2013), January 15-17, 2013, Clearwater, FL, USA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于 Powell's Dog Leg 算法的迭代式五点相对位姿估计方法，声称与 Nister 的经典算法精度相同但速度约快一倍，并易于扩展到五个点以上的情况，适用作精化步骤。作者在三类已知真值数据集上进行了系统评估。
Motivation: 相对位姿估计是 Structure and Motion 方法的基础环节，对已标定相机而言，五点法结合 RANSAC 在多数情况下效果最好；现有最先进的 Nister 算法虽快，但进一步提升速度可以在 RANSAC 框架内增加迭代次数以提高精度。
Method: 提出一种新的迭代方法，基于 Powell's Dog Leg 算法求解五点相对位姿问题，同时保持有效的误差度量；该方法可自然扩展至多于五个点，因此也适合作为精化步骤 (refinement step)。
Result: 摘要报告新方法与 Nister 算法精度相同，而速度约为其两倍，并在三类具有已知真值的数据集上进行了系统评估。
Conclusion: 摘要未提及明显局限，主要结论是在不损失精度的前提下将求解速度提升约一倍，且通过扩展点数可进一步用于精化。

papers.title: EgoMonth: A Month-Level Egocentric Video Benchmark for Long-Term Spatiotemporal Memory
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have led to substantial progress in video understanding, accompanied by a growing number of long video benchmarks. However, existing benchmarks rely predominantly on web-sourced videos that lack inter-clip spatiotemporal continuity, making it difficult to assess whether models can maintain consistent memory across days or weeks of real-world experience. We introduce EgoMonth, the first month-level egocentric video understanding benchmark. EgoMonth comprises over 300 hours of first-person daily-life recordings from 20 participants spanning 20 to 120 days, paired with 1,443 human-crafted multiple-choice question-answer pairs. We design a cognitively grounded 14-task evaluation framework organized into three hierarchical cognitive levels: Schema Consolidation, Episodic Indexing, and Cascading Reasoning. Evaluation of state-of-the-art open-source and closed-source MLLMs reveals that even the best-performing model, Gemini 2.5 Pro, achieves only 71.8% macro-average accuracy, remaining 22.4 percentage points below the corrected human baseline of 94.2%. Several models perform near or below the 25% chance level on tasks such as Route Reasoning, Cross-view Spatial Reasoning, and Direction Judgement, while even the strongest closed-source model remains substantially below human performance. These results indicate that current MLLMs function as lossy summarizers rather than faithful memorizers, highlighting the need for architectures with genuine long-term spatiotemporal memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EgoMonth，首个月级别的自我中心视频理解基准，包含 20 名参与者 20 至 120 天的 300 多小时第一人称日常录制，以及 1,443 个人工构建的多选题。作者设计了 14 个任务的三层级认知评估框架（Schema Consolidation、Episodic Indexing、Cascading Reasoning）。评测显示最优模型 Gemini 2.5 Pro 的宏平均准确率仅为 71.8%，比修正后的人类基线 94.2% 低 22.4 个百分点，且部分模型在若干空间推理任务上接近或低于 25% 随机水平。
Motivation: 现有长视频基准主要依赖网络视频，片段间缺乏时空连续性，难以检验模型是否能对跨天或跨周的真实世界经验维持一致记忆。
Method: 收集多参与者长时间第一人称日常视频，构建月级别时空连续的 QA 基准，并按认知层级组织 14 类任务以系统评估长期时空记忆能力。
Result: 对开源与闭源 MLLMs 的评测显示，最强模型 Gemini 2.5 Pro 宏平均准确率为 71.8%，明显低于人类基线；在 Route Reasoning、Cross-view Spatial Reasoning 和 Direction Judgement 等任务上，多个模型表现接近或低于随机水平。
Conclusion: 作者认为当前 MLLMs 更像有损摘要器而非忠实记忆器，需要具备真正长期时空记忆能力的架构。

papers.title: Towards Physics-Faithful Generation of Scientific Diagrams
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image generation has reached photorealistic quality, yet state-of-the-art systems remain unreliable at producing scientific diagrams, whose value depends not on appearance but on physical faithfulness: correct force directions, valid coordinate systems, consistent thermodynamic states, and equations matching the depicted scenario. Trained on web imagery with physically shallow captions, generic models produce diagrams that look plausible but are physically wrong, harmful in education and scientific communication. We present Princigram, a physics-faithful scientific-diagram generator, and its data pipeline. Our central advance is Structured Physical Chain-of-Thought (SP-CoT): a per-subdiscipline schema that decomposes a physics diagram into an explicit multi-step reasoning chain across six subdisciplines, from scene identification through force or process analysis to governing laws and synthesis. Unlike free-form chain-of-thought, SP-CoT follows a fixed schema with strict fidelity rules that separate visually grounded facts from physically inferred reasoning and type all mathematics symbolically; it serves both as dense training supervision and, at inference, as a structured "thinking" prompt. With it we curate and structurally annotate 4.3 million physics images, of which 115,037 carry expert-level annotation, and adapt a unified multimodal backbone. We further introduce VeriphyT2IBench, whose questions are derived from each held-out diagram's own structured annotation: each diagram becomes an item-specific bank of binary questions about its objects, forces, and states, so a judge model's score decomposes into named physical facts rather than one holistic number. On the physics subset of GenExam and on VeriphyT2IBench, Princigram shows that explicit physics-structured supervision improves the physical faithfulness of generated scientific diagrams.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Princigram，一个面向物理忠实性的科学示意图生成器，并配套数据流水线。核心是结构化物理思维链 (SP-CoT)：按六个子学科把物理图分解为显式多步推理链，从场景识别到力/过程分析再到定律与综合，并用固定模式区分视觉事实与物理推断、对数学做符号化类型化。作者据此整理并结构化标注了 430 万张物理图像（其中 115,037 张带专家级标注），同时引入 VeriphyT2IBench 基准，将每张保留图的结构化标注转换为若干二元问题，使评测分数可分解为具名的物理事实。实验显示在 GenExam 的物理子集与 VeriphyT2IBench 上，显式物理结构化监督提升了生成示意图的物理忠实性。
Motivation: 现有文生图系统能生成照片级真实的图像，但在科学示意图上不可靠，因为示意图的价值取决于物理忠实性（力的方向、坐标系、热力学状态、与场景匹配的方程），而非外观。通用模型基于网络图像和物理浅层描述训练，生成的图看似合理但物理错误，对教育和科学传播有害。
Method: 提出结构化物理思维链 (Structured Physical Chain-of-Thought, SP-CoT)，即按子学科设计的固定模式，将物理图分解为从场景识别到力或过程分析再到控制定律与综合的显式多步推理；与自由形式思维链不同，它带有严格保真规则，分离视觉可验证事实与物理推断，并对数学符号做类型化。基于该模式构建 430 万张物理图像的数据集并适配统一多模态骨干，同时设计 VeriphyT2IBench，以每张留出图自身结构化标注生成二元问题集，使评判模型的得分可分解到命名的物理事实。
Result: 摘要报告，在 GenExam 的物理子集和 VeriphyT2IBench 上，Princigram 表明显式物理结构化监督能够提升生成科学示意图的物理忠实性。
Conclusion: 作者认为，显式的物理结构化监督相比通用文生图训练，有助于生成物理上更忠实的科学示意图；该工作同时提供了大规模标注数据管道与可分解的物理事实评测基准。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Robust Dempster-Shafer Evidence Fusion with Chaos-Conflict Measurement and Historical-Experience Weighting
papers.abstract_en: Multi-source evidence fusion under Dempster-Shafer theory faces two persistent challenges: existing conflict measures assess inter-evidence inconsistency and intra-evidence uncertainty independently, yielding incomplete evaluations, and current fusion methods evaluate evidence sources exclusively through instantaneous comparisns without exploiting their long-term reliability across diverse decision contexts. This paper proposes a unified evidence reasoning framework that addresses both limitations. Specifically, a chaos-conflict measurement is introduced to jointly quantify cross-evidence conflict and intra-evidence non-specificity, with five formally proven properties ensuring consistent assessment. A historical experience driven weighting scheme partitions the decision space via spectral clustering and applies regret theory to compute context-specific reliability profiles from past fusion outcomes. These mechanisms feed into a hybrid combination rule that adaptively balances uncertainty preservation against weighted consensus, controlled by the global conflict level, followed by a belief-interval decision strategy that enables robust classification without discarding epistemic uncertainty. Experiments on 16 real-world benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves an average F1 score of 85.78 and a mean AUC of 93.30, outperforming eight DST-based baselines and three gradient boosting methods. Ablation analysis confirms the contribution of each component we proposed. The framework offers an effective approach for adaptive evidence fusion in multi-source decision making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向 Dempster-Shafer 理论下的多源证据融合，提出一个统一的鲁棒证据推理框架。其核心包括：联合量化跨证据冲突与证据内非特异性的混沌-冲突度量（chaos-conflict measurement）、基于谱聚类和后悔理论从历史融合结果构建情境相关可靠性的加权方案，以及由全局冲突水平控制、自适应平衡不确定性保留与加权共识的混合组合规则，最后用置信区间决策策略完成鲁棒分类。在 16 个真实世界基准数据集上，平均 F1 为 85.78、平均 AUC 为 93.30，优于 8 个 DST 基线和 3 个梯度提升方法。
Motivation: 现有的冲突度量分别评估证据间不一致与证据内不确定性，导致评估不完整；同时当前融合方法只通过瞬时比较评估证据源，没有利用证据源在不同决策情境中的长期可靠性。
Method: 提出统一证据推理框架：混沌-冲突度量联合量化跨证据冲突与证据内非特异性，并给出五个经形式化证明的性质以保证评估一致性；历史经验加权方案用谱聚类划分决策空间，并应用后悔理论从过去融合结果计算情境相关的可靠性画像；混合组合规则由全局冲突水平控制，自适应地在不确定性保留与加权共识之间权衡，随后通过置信区间决策策略进行分类。
Result: 在 16 个真实世界基准数据集上，平均 F1 达到 85.78、平均 AUC 达到 93.30，超过 8 个 DST 基线和 3 个梯度提升方法；消融分析确认了各提出组件的贡献。
Conclusion: 该框架为多源决策中的自适应证据融合提供了一种有效途径，摘要强调它通过全局冲突控制保留认知不确定性（epistemic uncertainty）并实现稳健分类。

papers.title: Online Learning of Correspondences between Images
papers.abstract_en: We propose a novel method for iterative learning of point correspondences between image sequences. Points moving on surfaces in 3D space are projected into two images. Given a point in either view, the considered problem is to determine the corresponding location in the other view. The geometry and distortions of the projections are unknown as is the shape of the surface. Given several pairs of point-sets but no access to the 3D scene, correspondence mappings can be found by excessive global optimization or by the fundamental matrix if a perspective projective model is assumed. However, an iterative solution on sequences of point-set pairs with general imaging geometry is preferable. We derive such a method that optimizes the mapping based on Neyman's chi-square divergence between the densities representing the uncertainties of the estimated and the actual locations. The densities are represented as channel vectors computed with a basis function approach. The mapping between these vectors is updated with each new pair of images such that fast convergence and high accuracy are achieved. The resulting algorithm runs in real-time and is superior to state-of-the-art methods in terms of convergence and accuracy in a number of experiments.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence, ISSN 0162-8828, E-ISSN 1939-3539, Vol. 35, no 1, p. 118-129
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种在图像序列间迭代学习点对应关系的在线方法，针对未知三维表面与未知投影几何的场景，利用 Neyman 卡方散度优化基于基函数表示的密度（channel vectors）之间的映射，并随新图像对逐帧更新。作者声称该方法可实时运行，在多个实验中收敛速度和精度均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 在点集对序列上建立对应关系时，传统方法要么依赖全局优化，要么假设透视投影模型并用基本矩阵求解；当成像几何与表面形状未知时，需要一种不依赖三维场景且能随序列迭代更新的通用求解方法。
Method: 将估计位置与实际位置的不确定性表示为由基函数计算的 channel vectors 密度，并基于 Neyman 卡方散度构造映射优化目标；映射随每对新图像在线更新，以兼顾收敛速度与精度。
Result: 摘要报告该算法实时运行，并在多个实验中相较 state-of-the-art 方法在收敛速度与精度上更优，但没有给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调迭代在线学习点对应关系在一般成像几何下可行且高效，方法以实时性、收敛性和精度为优势。

papers.title: RbFT-Net: Rectify-Before-Fuse Temporal Radar Anchors for 4D Radar-Camera Depth Completion
papers.abstract_en: Dense metric depth prediction from cameras and millimeter-wave radar offers a cost-effective sensing solution for autonomous systems. However, radar measurements are inherently sparse and susceptible to clutter, multipath reflections, and projection errors. While aggregating multiple radar frames provides denser metric cues, it also introduces temporal misalignment and dynamic-object interference. Directly propagating such unreliable measurements can therefore corrupt large regions of the predicted depth map. To address this issue, we propose RbFT-Net, an end-to-end rectify-before-fuse framework for multi-frame 4D radar-camera depth completion. Rather than assuming accumulated radar returns to be accurate, RbFT-Net treats them as noisy temporal anchor candidates. An image-conditioned rectification module jointly corrects their image-plane locations and metric depths while estimating pointwise reliability. The rectified anchors are then selectively propagated before high-level multi-modal fusion, suppressing the influence of unreliable measurements. Experiments on ZJU-4DRadarCam and a newly collected 4D radar-camera-LiDAR dataset show that RbFT-Net consistently outperforms the evaluated independent radar-camera methods and remains competitive with plug-in pipelines using auxiliary monocular depth models. Cross-platform evaluation and component analyses further support the effectiveness of the proposed rectification and reliability-aware propagation strategy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RbFT-Net，一个用于 4D 雷达-相机深度补全 (depth completion) 的端到端 rectify-before-fuse 框架。它将多帧累积的雷达点视为带噪声的时间锚点候选，先用图像条件修正模块校正其图像平面位置与度量深度并估计逐点可靠性，再选择性传播可靠锚点后进行高层多模态融合。在 ZJU-4DRadarCam 和新采集的 4D 雷达-相机-激光雷达数据集上，该方法一致优于所评估的独立雷达-相机方法，并与使用辅助单目深度模型的插件式方案竞争力相当。
Motivation: 毫米波雷达测量天然稀疏且易受杂波、多路径反射和投影误差影响；多帧聚合虽能提供更密的度量线索，却引入时间错位和动态目标干扰，直接传播不可靠测量会污染大范围深度预测区域。
Method: 提出 RbFT-Net，不假设累积雷达回波准确，而是将其视为噪声时间锚点候选；通过图像条件修正模块联合校正图像平面位置与度量深度并估计逐点可靠性，修正后的锚点在高层多模态融合前被选择性传播以抑制不可靠测量。
Result: 在 ZJU-4DRadarCam 和自采集的 4D 雷达-相机-激光雷达数据集上的实验表明，RbFT-Net 持续优于所评估的独立雷达-相机深度补全方法，且与使用辅助单目深度模型的插件式流程相比仍具竞争力；跨平台评估与组件分析进一步支持所提出的修正与可靠性感知传播策略的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将多帧雷达返回视为带噪声候选并先修正后融合，配合可靠性感知的选择性传播，能有效改善 4D 雷达-相机深度补全的性能。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Multi-Layer Context Camouflaging: A Semantic Superposition and Contextual Lamination Framework for Malpractice-Resilient Online Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Contemporary online assessment systems rely primarily on browser lockdown, webcam monitoring, and behavioural analytics, yet remain vulnerable to attacks that extract the assessment content itself through screenshots, screen sharing, optical character recognition, and automated scraping. This paper extends the Multi-dimensional Spatio-Temporal Context Camouflaging Model (MSCCM) within the MARS (Multi-modal Assessment Resilience Suite) by introducing the Multi-Layer Context Camouflaging Theory (MCCT), a mathematical framework that protects rendered assessment content through semantic superposition. Authentic assessment content and synthetically generated camouflage are represented as a unified rendering while remaining recoverable only by legitimate candidates. The framework models the adversarial extraction process through an explicit extraction-channel operator and develops six coupled constructs: the Context Inversion Operator, Contextual Lamination Operator, Separation Channel, Human Readability Functional, Computational Ambiguity Functional, and Context Camouflage Tensor. Computational ambiguity is formulated using conditional entropy, yielding a closed-form expression that quantifies uncertainty during unauthorized extraction, while legitimate recovery is guaranteed through an exact filtering identity. We further establish theoretical properties governing ambiguity, camouflage density, semantic preservation, multi-observation leakage, and temporal multiplexing, and present a rendering algorithm with computational complexity and a pre-registered evaluation protocol. MCCT provides a mathematically rigorous foundation for behaviorally adaptive, accessibility-aware, and computationally resilient digital assessment by securing rendered assessment content while preserving readability for legitimate users.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多层级上下文伪装理论 (Multi-Layer Context Camouflaging Theory, MCCT)，将 MSCCM 扩展到 MARS 框架中，用语义叠加 (semantic superposition) 方式保护在线测评的渲染内容：真实考题与合成伪装统一渲染，只有合法考生可恢复。作者通过显式抽取通道算子建模对抗性提取，给出六个耦合构造，并用条件熵得到计算歧义的闭式表达，同时以精确滤波恒等式保证合法恢复。
Motivation: 现有在线测评主要依赖浏览器锁定、摄像头监控和行为分析，但仍易受截图、屏幕共享、OCR 和自动抓取等手段的攻击，测评内容本身可以被直接提取。
Method: 在 MARS 套件中扩展 MSCCM，提出 MCCT 数学框架：将真实测评内容与合成伪装表示为统一渲染，并引入显式抽取通道算子，开发六个耦合构造（上下文反演算子、上下文层压算子、分离通道、人类可读性泛函、计算歧义泛函、上下文伪装张量）；用条件熵形式化计算歧义，并通过精确滤波恒等式保证合法恢复，同时给出渲染算法及计算复杂度与预注册评估协议。
Result: 摘要给出了计算歧义的闭式表达式以量化未授权提取的不确定性，并建立了关于歧义、伪装密度、语义保持、多观测泄露和时间复用的理论性质；未报告实证数值结果。
Conclusion: MCCT 旨在为行为自适应、无障碍感知且计算上有韧性的数字测评提供数学上严格的基础，在保障渲染内容安全的同时维持合法用户的可读性。

papers.title: FlowLOB: Efficient and Controllable Limit Order Book Generation with Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Limit order book (LOB) simulators are most useful to practitioners when they combine realistic market dynamics, computationally efficient sampling, controllable scenario generation, and the ability to generalize beyond the instruments seen during training---properties that existing agent-based and deep generative simulators provide only partially. We present \textbf{FlowLOB}, a conditional \textbf{flow}-matching generator of \textbf{LOB} trajectories, trained on multiple Hong Kong Exchange (HKEX) symbols at three sampling frequencies ($0.1$s, $1$s, $10$s) in tick-relative representation that transfers to unseen instruments. Because flow and diffusion models admit a common formulation, we train both with identical data, architecture, and budget, and sample both through the same fixed-step ODE solvers, yielding a controlled comparison of sampling efficiency and fidelity. Flow matching attains its best quality with only $10$ ODE-solver steps, whereas diffusion needs many more function evaluations to approach the same fidelity. At this efficient operating point, FlowLOB improves realism over baselines, two learned and two agent-based models, in most distributional metrics at the two finer sampling frequencies. We evaluate counterfactual controllability with a distributional test that asks whether changing a scenario condition moves the generated statistic toward the corresponding real tail regime; FlowLOB satisfies this criterion in most tested settings. Both realism and control effects transfer zero-shot on a held-out symbol. We additionally conduct ablation studies on the network architecture and the learning rate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FlowLOB，一个基于条件流匹配 (flow matching) 的限价订单簿 (LOB) 轨迹生成器，在多个港交所 (HKEX) 标的上以 0.1s、1s、10s 三个采样频率、采用 tick 相对表示训练，并能迁移到未见过的工具。在与扩散模型共享数据、架构和训练预算的受控对比中，流匹配仅需 10 步 ODE 求解器即达到最佳质量，而扩散需要更多函数评估才能接近同等保真度。FlowLOB 在大多数分布指标上优于两个学习型基线和两个基于代理的基线，并通过一种分布检验验证反事实可控性，且现实性与控制效果可在保留符号上零样本迁移。
Motivation: 现有基于代理和深度生成的 LOB 模拟器只能部分同时满足真实市场动态、计算高效采样、可控场景生成以及跨工具泛化这些实际需求，FlowLOB 旨在补齐这一组合缺口。
Method: 提出条件流匹配生成器 FlowLOB，利用流模型与扩散模型的统一公式，在相同数据、架构和预算下训练两种模型，并均通过固定步长 ODE 求解器采样，从而对采样效率和保真度进行受控比较。
Result: 摘要报告流匹配仅用 10 步 ODE 求解器即达到最佳质量；在两个较细采样频率下，FlowLOB 在大多数分布指标上优于两个学习型基线和两个基于代理的基线；分布检验表明其在多数测试设置下满足反事实可控性，且现实性与控制效果在保留符号上零样本迁移。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 FlowLOB 能以更少的函数评估实现与扩散模型相当甚至更好的生成质量，并具备可控性与跨工具泛化能力；此外还进行了网络架构与学习率方面的消融研究。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有基于代理和深度生成的 LOB 模拟器只能部分同时满足真实市场动态、计算高效采样、可控场景生成以及跨工具泛化这些实际需求，FlowLOB 旨在补齐这一组合缺口。
summary_sections.method: 提出条件流匹配生成器 FlowLOB，利用流模型与扩散模型的统一公式，在相同数据、架构和预算下训练两种模型，并均通过固定步长 ODE 求解器采样，从而对采样效率和保真度进行受控比较。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告流匹配仅用 10 步 ODE 求解器即达到最佳质量；在两个较细采样频率下，FlowLOB 在大多数分布指标上优于两个学习型基线和两个基于代理的基线；分布检验表明其在多数测试设置下满足反事实可控性，且现实性与控制效果在保留符号上零样本迁移。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调 FlowLOB 能以更少的函数评估实现与扩散模型相当甚至更好的生成质量，并具备可控性与跨工具泛化能力；此外还进行了网络架构与学习率方面的消融研究。

papers.title: Semantic Radiance Fields as Simulators for Spatial Reasoning in Real-World Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Training and evaluating spatial reasoning in embodied agents requires diverse environments that are both geometrically faithful and semantically queryable. Synthetic simulators offer ground truth semantics but sacrifice realism; simulators based on reconstructions of real-world environments have realistic appearance but lack ground truth semantics by default. We propose using Semantic Radiance Fields (SRF) as simulators for spatial reasoning agents. SRFs are a representation that unifies these requirements by lifting 2D semantic segmentations from pretrained vision models into a 3D radiance field that jointly encodes geometry, appearance, and per-class semantic identity. The resulting fields are reconstructed from posed RGB captures of real scenes and support novel-view synthesis, semantic and free-space queries within a single grounded representation. This enables the efficient generation of diverse real-world environments to train and evaluate spatial reasoning models. As an example application, we outline an SRF-driven simulator for an orchard apple-reaching task, in which the radiance field supplies camera rendering, semantic ground truth, and occupancy queries to a physics engine.
papers.comment: Accepted at the IJCAI 2026 Workshop on Spatio-Temporal Reasoning and Learning (STRL), oral presentation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将语义辐射场 (Semantic Radiance Fields, SRF) 作为具身智能体空间推理训练的仿真器。SRF 将预训练视觉模型的 2D 语义分割提升到 3D 辐射场中，同时编码几何、外观与逐类语义身份，由真实场景的带位姿 RGB 采集重建，并支持新视角合成、语义查询与自由空间查询。摘要以果园摘苹果任务为例，说明 SRF 可为物理引擎提供相机渲染、语义真值 (semantic ground truth) 与占用查询。
Motivation: 训练和评估具身智能体的空间推理需要既几何忠实又语义可查询的多样化环境。合成仿真器有真值语义但缺乏真实感；基于真实场景重建的仿真器外观真实但默认缺少真值语义。论文用 SRF 统一这两类需求。
Method: 利用 SRF 作为仿真器：从预训练视觉模型获取 2D 语义分割，将其提升为联合编码几何、外观和逐类语义身份的 3D 辐射场。该场从真实场景的有位姿 RGB 图像重建，在单一表征中提供新视角合成、语义查询和自由空间查询，并可将渲染、语义真值和占用查询交给物理引擎。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验，仅作为示例概述了果园摘苹果 (orchard apple-reaching) 任务中的 SRF 驱动仿真器应用。
Conclusion: 作者认为 SRF 能够在单一 grounded 表征中统一真实感、语义真值与空间查询，从而高效生成多样化真实世界环境，用于训练和评估空间推理模型。

papers.title: Paths: Prompt-aware Spatio-temporal Transformer with Hierarchical Multi-modal Fusion for RGB-Event Video Person Re-Identification
papers.abstract_en: RGB-Event Video Person Re-Identification (RE-VReID) aims to retrieve specific person across non-overlapping cameras with complementary RGB videos and event streams. However, existing methods often decouple spatial and temporal modeling, which limits their interaction. In addition, global-level RGB-Event fusion fails to fully exploit fine-grained discriminative cues. To address these issues, we propose Paths, a unified framework with spatio-temporal modeling and hierarchical multi-modal fusion for RE-VReID. Specifically, we first design a Memory-Augmented Backbone (MAB) to maintain modality-specific identity prototypes for stable intra-modal representation learning. Then, we propose a Prompt-aware Spatio-temporal Transformer (PST) to jointly model spatial and temporal cues within a unified Transformer. Finally, we introduce a Hierarchical Multi-modal Fusion (HMF) to integrate RGB and event features at global and local levels. With these modules, our framework can learn robust and discriminative representations for RE-VReID. Extensive experiments on three public RE-VReID benchmarks including EvReID, MARS and iLIDS-VID, demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method. The code is available at https://github.com/Reflection0427/Paths.
papers.comment: Accepted by ACM MM2026. More modifications may be performed
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Paths，一个用于 RGB-Event 视频行人重识别 (RE-VReID) 的统一框架，同时进行时空建模与层次化多模态融合。方法包括记忆增强骨干 (Memory-Augmented Backbone, MAB)、提示感知时空 Transformer (Prompt-aware Spatio-temporal Transformer, PST) 和层次化多模态融合 (Hierarchical Multi-modal Fusion, HMF)。在 EvReID、MARS 和 iLIDS-VID 三个公开基准上的实验验证了其有效性。
Motivation: 现有 RE-VReID 方法通常将空间和时间建模解耦，限制了两者间的交互；且全局层面的 RGB-Event 融合难以充分利用细粒度判别线索。
Method: 设计记忆增强骨干维护模态特定的身份原型以稳定模态内表示学习；提出提示感知时空 Transformer 在统一 Transformer 内联合建模空间与时间线索；引入层次化多模态融合在全局和局部层面整合 RGB 与事件特征。
Result: 在 EvReID、MARS 和 iLIDS-VID 三个公开 RE-VReID 基准上的大量实验表明该方法有效。
Conclusion: 通过统一时空建模与层次化融合，该方法能够为 RE-VReID 学习鲁棒且具判别力的表示。

papers.title: Sampling Luck Masquerades as Allocation Gain: Auditing Test-Time Budget Allocation for Neural Combinatorial Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Neural combinatorial optimization (NCO) solvers report the best of many sampled solutions per instance, and the sample count is, by convention, identical for every instance. Whether a non-uniform allocation of a fixed total budget would buy anything has not been measured. We measure it, and we audit the measurement itself. First, on in-distribution workloads the allocation headroom is not detectable. Across three pretrained solvers (POMO, AM, SymNCO) on uniform TSP-100, an oracle allocation computed and evaluated on the same stored samples reports a 2.2-2.6% gain with intervals excluding zero; measured out of sample the same gain is indistinguishable from zero (0.457, 0.015, -0.512 percent). Following the customary in-sample procedure, all three solvers would have supported a published 2%-level gain that does not exist. We calibrate this bias against an instance-wise null in which the true gain is zero by construction; over the ranges we test it does not shrink with more samples or more instances. Second, the same correction that removes the phantom gains preserves a real one. Under distribution shift (a workload mixing uniform and clustered instances), a pre-registered confirmatory experiment finds that allocation guided by held-out sample statistics improves best-of-k by 11.5% (AM, primary endpoint; 95% CI [7.4, 19.7]) and 12.0% (SymNCO, replication) at equal evaluation budget, with the signal-acquisition cost not charged; a pre-registered negative control (POMO, an order of magnitude more robust to shift) shows -0.3% [-0.7, 0.24]. The gain exceeds a frozen distribution-label baseline by 4.2 points [1.9, 7.7]. An exploratory policy charging a 20-sample probe against the same budget retains 3.4% (AM) and 4.6% (SymNCO). We give a correction procedure and a reporting checklist, and release all data, code, and the pre-registration record.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 8 tables. Pre-registered study; code, cost arrays, and the full pre-registration record (including every amendment and its direction) at https://github.com/nepersoned/best-of-k-allocation

papers.title: LOB-ID: Evaluating Synthetic Market Data by Inception Distances
papers.abstract_en: Generative models of limit orderbook (LOB) data have advanced rapidly, but their evaluation often focuses on stylised facts and selected market statistics. These measures provide useful diagnostics but may not capture the joint temporal and cross-level structure of order-book trajectories. We introduce LOB-ID, an embedding-based framework that adapts the Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) and Monge Inception Distance (MIND) to LOB data. To obtain domain-specific embeddings, we train the DeepLOB architecture on four months of Level-2 order-book data for five equities. We show that LOB-ID is stable across time, instruments, and embedding checkpoints, and rises monotonically under controlled distortions. We then construct a moment-matching attack against FID and a deep-book perturbation that evades statistic-based evaluation. MIND remains substantially more sensitive to both distortions. Finally, we score five generative LOB models, spanning stochastic baselines and deep learning approaches, and find that LOB-ID ranks them in line with the joint temporal and cross-level structure each captures by construction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LOB-ID，一个基于嵌入的限价订单簿 (LOB) 生成模型评估框架，将 Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) 与 Monge Inception Distance (MIND) 适配到 LOB 数据。作者用四个多月的 Level-2 订单簿数据在五只股票上训练 DeepLOB 嵌入，并验证 LOB-ID 在时间、标的和嵌入检查点之间均稳定，且随受控扰动单调上升。文中还构造矩匹配攻击与深度扰动，发现 MIND 对两类扰动都更敏感；最后用 LOB-ID 对五个生成模型排序，其结果与模型在构造上捕获的联合时序和跨层级结构一致。
Motivation: 现有 LOB 生成模型评估多依赖程式化事实和精选市场统计量，这些诊断指标可能无法刻画订单簿轨迹中联合的时序结构与跨层级结构。
Method: 使用 DeepLOB 架构在四个月 Level-2 订单簿数据上训练领域专用嵌入，将 FID 与 MIND 推广为 LOB-ID，并构造矩匹配攻击和深层订单簿扰动来检验评估指标的敏感性。
Result: LOB-ID 在不同时间、标的和嵌入检查点下保持稳定，在受控扰动下单调上升；MIND 对矩匹配攻击和深度扰动均比 FID 显著更敏感。
Conclusion: LOB-ID 能依据生成模型在构造上捕获的联合时序与跨层级结构对其进行排序，覆盖从随机基线到深度学习的五种 LOB 生成模型。

papers.title: Learning Discrete Decisions for MIPs with Constraint-Aware Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a novel learning-based approach to approximately solve instances of mixed-integer optimization problems. These problems are computationally challenging, as they require jointly determining discrete and continuous decisions while satisfying complex combinatorial constraints. The proposed method relies on a graph-based generative diffusion model that learns the discrete component of mixed-integer optimization problems while integrating a training-free feasibility projection operator directly into the reverse diffusion process to steer intermediate samples toward the feasible set throughout generation. Once the discrete decisions are generated, the remaining optimization reduces to a continuous problem that can be solved efficiently (relative to the original problem) using existing numerical methods. The resulting framework named Constrained Graph Diffusion (CGD), is problem-agnostic and can accommodate a broad class of mixed-integer optimization problems through suitable projection operators. We evaluate CGD on optimal transmission switching for ACOPF and discrete portfolio optimization, demonstrating substantial improvements in feasibility and solution quality over learning-based baselines while achieving speedups of up to $425\times$ over state-of-the-art numerical solvers for MINLPs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于图生成扩散模型的学习框架 Constrained Graph Diffusion (CGD)，用于近似求解混合整数优化问题。该方法学习问题的离散决策部分，并在反向扩散过程中集成无需训练的可行性投影算子，将中间样本引向可行集；生成离散决策后，剩余连续优化可用现有数值方法高效求解。在最优潮流切换和离散组合优化问题上，CGD 相比学习基线显著提升可行性与解质量，并相对最先进的 MINLP 数值求解器实现最高 425 倍的加速。
Motivation: 混合整数优化问题需要同时确定离散与连续决策并满足复杂组合约束，计算上极具挑战。现有学习式方法通常在可行性或求解质量上不足，难以平衡生成速度与约束满足。
Method: 提出基于图生成扩散模型的学习框架 CGD，利用扩散模型学习混合整数优化问题的离散决策分布，并将训练无关的可行性投影算子直接嵌入反向扩散过程，在生成过程中持续将中间样本推向可行集；生成离散决策后，剩余问题退化为连续优化，用现有数值方法求解。该框架与具体问题无关，可通过合适的投影算子适配多种混合整数优化问题。
Result: 在 ACOPF 的最优输电切换和离散组合优化任务上，CGD 相对学习基线显著改善可行性与解质量，并相对最先进的 MINLP 数值求解器实现最高 425 倍的加速。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将可行性投影融入扩散生成过程能够有效提升大规模混合整数优化问题的求解效率与可行性，且框架具有问题无关性。

papers.title: SPADE: Speculative Decoding for Precise and Low Cost Distributed Edge Cloud Inference
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success in natural language understanding and generation, but their deployment is constrained by high computational demands. Deploying smaller LLMs directly on the edge can circumvent this, but with degraded accuracy. Deploying smaller cloud-based big LLMs preserves performance, but at the cost of expensive per-token computation. We present a distributed inference framework, \our{}, that integrates speculative decoding (SD) across edge and cloud. A compact draft model deployed on the edge generates candidate tokens rapidly, and a large verifier model on the cloud validates these tokens in parallel. Accepted tokens are retained, while only rejections trigger verifier correction, substantially reducing the number of cloud queries. Our plug-and-play design shifts the bulk of computation to the edge, significantly lowers inference time and cloud cost, and preserves the accuracy of the big model without any retraining requirement. Our approach demonstrates a practical path toward scalable, cost-efficient, and accurate deployment of LLMs in real-world environments. Experimental results across multiple Natural Language Processing tasks using SpecBench and CNN/Dailymail datasets demonstrate that \our{} reduces the cloud model calls by $76\%$ with zero loss in accuracy as compared to the full model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SPADE，一种跨边缘与云端的分布式推理框架，将推测解码 (speculative decoding) 应用于边缘-云协同：边缘部署小型草稿模型快速生成候选 token，云端大型验证模型并行校验，仅在被拒绝时触发修正。摘要称该方法无需重训练即可保持大模型精度，并在 SpecBench 与 CNN/Dailymail 上减少 76% 的云端模型调用。
Motivation: LLM 部署受高计算需求制约：边缘直接部署小模型会降低精度，而云端部署大模型导致昂贵的逐 token 计算。作者希望在不损失大模型精度、无需重训练的前提下降低推理时延与云成本。
Method: 提出即插即用的分布式推理框架 SPADE，在边缘运行紧凑草稿模型快速生成候选 token，云端大模型并行验证；接受 token 保留，仅对拒绝 token 进行验证器修正，从而减少云端查询次数。
Result: 在 SpecBench 和 CNN/Dailymail 上的多项 NLP 任务中，相比完整模型，SPADE 将云端模型调用减少 76%，且零精度损失。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法展示了在真实环境中可扩展、低成本且保持准确性的 LLM 部署路径；但未给出在更广泛的边缘设备、网络环境下的性能或限制说明。

papers.title: A Multispectral Framework for the Detection of Calcium Carbide-Induced Ripening and Shelf-Life Estimation in Climacteric Fruits
papers.abstract_en: Significant health risks are associated with the illegal, yet commonly practiced use of industrial-grade Calcium Carbide (CaC2) for ripening climacteric fruits like mango and banana, which leaves behind trace residues of arsenic and phosphorus. To address this, the proposed study explores a novel, non-invasive multispectral framework for distinguishing safely ripened fruits (naturally ripened and ethephon-induced) from calcium carbide-ripened samples, while also estimating their ripening progression (in percentage) and remaining shelf life (in days). The spectral profiles of mango (Mangifera indica) and banana (Musa acuminata) at 18 discrete wavelengths in the visible-near infrared (NIR) range (410 nm - 940 nm) are studied using the AS7265x spectral triad sensor. CaC2-treated samples exhibit sharper spectral intensity drops in the visible region, consistent with accelerated chlorophyll degradation and carotenoid development. To characterize these physiological changes, the feature engineering strategy integrates inter-method spectral variance, intensity ratios at distinct wavelengths, and environmental parameters including temperature and humidity. Dimensionality reduction using Principal Component Analysis (PCA) retains >90% of spectral variance within the first 5-7 components. The resulting feature set is used to train three independent eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost)-based learning algorithms for ripening method classification, along with quantitative estimation of remaining shelf life and ripening progression. A classification accuracy of 95% along with carbide class recall of 0.67 is observed for mango samples, while the model achieves an accuracy of 81% and carbide class recall of 0.74 for banana. This instrumentation and data-driven approach demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed non-invasive framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种非侵入式多光谱框架，利用 AS7265x 光谱三合一传感器在可见-近红外波段（410 nm–940 nm）的 18 个离散波长上采集芒果与香蕉的光谱剖面，用于区分自然催熟、乙烯利催熟与工业级碳化钙（CaC2）催熟的水果，并估计成熟进度（百分比）与剩余货架期（天数）。实验显示经 PCA 降维后前 5-7 个主成分保留超过 90% 的光谱方差，基于 XGBoost 的三个独立学习器分别完成催熟方式分类及两个回归任务。
Motivation: 使用工业级碳化钙催熟跃变型水果（如芒果、香蕉）的非法但常见做法会残留砷和磷等有害物质，带来显著健康风险，因此需要能区分安全催熟与 CaC2 催熟样品的检测方法。
Method: 整合方法间光谱方差、特定波长强度比以及温湿度等环境参数作为特征工程，利用 PCA 降维，并训练三个独立的 XGBoost 学习器分别进行催熟方式分类、剩余货架期估计和成熟进度定量估计。
Result: 摘要报告芒果样本的分类准确率为 95%、碳化钙类别召回率为 0.67；香蕉样本准确率为 81%、碳化钙类别召回率为 0.74。CaC2 处理样品在可见光区表现出更尖锐的光谱强度下降，与叶绿素加速降解和类胡萝卜素发育一致。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该仪器化与数据驱动方法证明了所提非侵入式框架在检测 CaC2 催熟水果及估计货架期方面的有效性。

papers.title: EEG-PRIME: Prototype-Aligned Representation Learning with Multi-Level Conditioning for EEG Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalography (EEG) decoding models often generalize poorly across datasets and subjects due to domain shifts in acquisition protocols and individual neurophysiology. We propose EEG-PRIME, a two-stage EEG foundation model for cross-dataset multi-task decoding. EEG-PRIME combines masked pretraining with prototype-aligned instruction tuning to enable instruction-aware and subject-invariant decoding across diverse BCI paradigms. During pretraining, an EEG encoder learns transferable representations through masked reconstruction with frequency-cutoff spectral augmentation. During instruction tuning, EEG-PRIME incorporates task-semantic, dataset-specific, and subject-invariant conditioning. The resulting conditioning signal modulates the Q-Former through Layer-wise Query Modulation, while frozen text embeddings of class labels serve as prototypes for cosine-similarity-based prediction across heterogeneous label spaces. Experiments on sixteen datasets covering motor imagery, emotion recognition, ADHD detection, covert speech, and mental workload show consistent improvements over state-of-the-art baselines and prior EEG foundation models under cross-subject settings. On two additional held-out datasets, EEG-PRIME achieves balanced accuracy comparable to within-session calibration models without target-domain optimization, calibration, or linear probing, demonstrating promising zero-shot transfer capability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EEG-PRIME，一个面向跨数据集多任务 EEG 解码的两阶段基础模型。它结合掩码预训练与原型对齐的指令微调，通过频率截断谱增强学习可迁移表征，并在指令微调阶段引入任务语义、数据集特定与受试者不变的条件调制。在涵盖运动想象、情绪识别、ADHD 检测、隐蔽言语和精神负荷的 16 个数据集上，跨受试者设置下一致优于现有基线，并在两个保留数据集上展示了接近需校准模型的零样本迁移能力。
Motivation: EEG 解码模型常因采集协议和个体神经生理的域偏移而在跨数据集、跨受试者场景下泛化不良，现有方法难以在不同 BCI 范式间统一解码。
Method: 提出两阶段 EEG 基础模型：预训练阶段通过带频率截止谱增强的掩码重建训练 EEG 编码器；指令微调阶段结合任务语义、数据集特定和受试者不变的条件，用 Layer-wise Query Modulation 调制 Q-Former，并用冻结的类标签文本嵌入作为原型进行基于余弦相似度的预测。
Result: 在 16 个数据集（运动想象、情绪识别、ADHD 检测、隐蔽言语、精神负荷）上跨受试者设置一致优于 SOTA 基线和既有 EEG 基础模型；在两个额外保留数据集上无需目标域优化、校准或线性探测即可达到与 session 内校准模型相当的平衡准确率。
Conclusion: 作者认为原型对齐指令微调与多层级条件调制可实现指令感知且受试者不变的跨数据集 EEG 解码，并展现出零样本迁移潜力。

papers.title: Behavioral Reprogramming of Open-Weights Models: Cognitive Plasticity and Alignment Bounds
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are predominantly aligned to function as passive, sycophantic assistants. We challenge this default paradigm by empirically evaluating the cognitive plasticity of open-weight architectures when subjected to rigorous behavioral reprogramming. Our objective is to induce a proactive, Socratic conversational framework, characterized by high-frequency question generation under strictly constrained high-performance computing (HPC) conditions. Through a massively parallelized hyperparameter sweep comprising 405 HPC jobs, we define precise mathematical bounds for parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT). We identify an architectural threshold at LoRA rank $r=16$ and demonstrate via extensive epoch ablation that generalization capacity strictly reaches its optimal convergence within an optimized training window of $e \in [2, 3]$ depending on dataset density (minimum validation loss of 0.919). Furthermore, scaling model capacity to 14B parameters yielded a lower localized evaluation perplexity (1.414). Subsequent Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) successfully decoupled the underlying assertive behavior from localized syntax, while rigorous cross-lingual stress testing reveals both the capabilities and the structural boundaries of zero-shot persona transfer, demonstrating robust alignment in closely related linguistic families alongside identifiable degradation pathways in morphologically distant targets. These findings establish a rigorous empirical framework for compute-efficient, cross-lingual behavioral modification.
papers.comment: Preprint submitted to arXiv, August 12, 2026. 13 pages, 5 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文挑战大语言模型默认被对齐为被动、谄媚助手（sycophantic assistants）的范式，尝试在严格受限的高性能计算条件下诱导主动苏格拉底式对话行为。作者通过 405 个 HPC 作业的大规模超参数扫描为参数高效微调（PEFT）定义数学界，发现 LoRA 秩 r=16 的架构阈值，并给出最优训练窗口 e∈[2,3]（最小验证损失 0.919）。扩展至 14B 参数后局部困惑度降至 1.414，DPO 成功将断言行为与局部句法解耦，跨语言压力测试显示近缘语言族中零样本人格迁移稳健、形态差异大的目标语言中存在退化。
Motivation: 作者指出 LLM 主要被对齐为被动、谄媚的助手，本文目标在于实证评估开放权重架构在严格行为重编程下的认知可塑性，并诱导一种在受限 HPC 条件下高频生成问题的主动苏格拉底式对话框架。
Method: 采用大规模并行化的超参数扫描（共 405 个 HPC 作业）来界定参数高效微调（PEFT）的数学边界；通过 epoch 消融研究泛化能力；将模型规模扩展至 14B 参数；随后使用 Direct Preference Optimization（DPO）解耦行为与局部句法，并进行跨语言压力测试以检查零样本人格迁移。
Result: 识别出 LoRA 秩 r=16 的架构阈值，泛化能力在优化训练窗口 e∈[2,3] 内达到最优收敛（最小验证损失 0.919）；14B 模型取得较低的局部评估困惑度（1.414）；DPO 成功将断言行为与局部句法解耦；跨语言测试表明近缘语言族中零样本人格迁移对齐稳健，而在形态差异较大的目标语言中呈现可识别的退化路径。
Conclusion: 这些发现为计算高效、跨语言的行为修改建立了经验性框架，并揭示了零样本人格迁移的能力边界。

summary_sections.conclusion: 这些发现为计算高效、跨语言的行为修改建立了经验性框架，并揭示了零样本人格迁移的能力边界。

papers.title: Learning Unified Video and Image Representation for Video Face Forgery Detection
papers.abstract_en: Face forgery detection is crucial for preserving the security and integrity of facial data given the rapid developments in face manipulation techniques and deep generative models. Existing methods for video face forgery detection typically assume that all frames in a forged video are manipulated, while detecting partially forged videos that contain only a subset of altered frames remains challenging. To address this issue, we propose a novel framework, UVIF, that utilizes additional annotated images to provide fine-grained supervision for detecting partial forgeries in videos. UVIF employs a unified encoder and a multi-task learning paradigm to jointly model facial videos and images for boosted video face forgery detection. A 2D backbone with temporal fusion modules is employed as the unified encoder. A pseudo labeling process is designed for video frames to bridge their representations with those of static images. A video-oriented feature alignment strategy is further introduced to reduce the distribution gap between videos and images. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework, which outperforms state-of-theart methods in detecting partially forged videos while introducing no additional computational overhead. Our code is available at https://github.com/haotianll/UVIF.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UVIF 框架，利用额外标注的静态图像为视频人脸伪造检测提供细粒度监督，重点解决仅部分帧被篡改的部分伪造视频检测问题。UVIF 采用统一编码器（2D backbone 加时间融合模块）和多任务学习，联合建模视频与图像，并配合伪标签流程与视频导向特征对齐。基准实验表明其在部分伪造视频检测上超过现有方法，且不引入额外计算开销。
Motivation: 现有视频人脸伪造检测方法通常假设伪造视频的所有帧均被篡改，而实际中只包含部分篡改帧的视频难以被准确检测。
Method: 提出 UVIF 框架，使用统一编码器和多任务学习范式联合建模人脸视频与图像；为视频帧设计伪标签流程以桥接其与静态图像的表征，并引入视频导向特征对齐策略缩小视频与图像之间的分布差距。
Result: 在基准数据集上的大量实验表明，UVIF 在检测部分伪造视频方面优于现有最先进方法，同时不引入额外的计算开销。
Conclusion: 摘要强调利用额外标注图像提供细粒度监督能有效提升部分伪造视频的检测性能，并公开了代码。

papers.title: Explanatory Engagement Under Rare Anomalous Failure: Asymptotic Rarity in Model Behavior (or: The Asymptotic AI)
papers.abstract_en: Prior work on LLM behavior under anomalous conditions asks whether a model notices anomalies. We ask a narrower question: once a model sits in a workflow with a low, controllable failure rate, does its explanatory engagement - length, specificity, self-reported confidence - change as failure grows asymptotically rarer? We built a local, zero-cost harness on three open-weight models (qwen3:8b, llama3.1:8b, mistral:7b) running a repeated tool-call task where one call fails at probability p, swept across eight rates from 0.2 to 0.0001, under five elicitation conditions from immediate prompting to none. We hypothesized a rise in engagement as failures grew rarer, then a collapse near a detectability threshold. Pooled across conditions this appeared false: length fell in a flat, monotonic pattern. Splitting by condition overturned that. Under immediate_forced, where the model must explain every failure instantly, the predicted rise is confirmed but followed by a plateau, not a collapse: length peaks at 28.4 words at p=0.05, settles to 17.4-19.0 words at the rarest rates, and confidence rises unevenly from about 53% to the 70s-90s. Under grouped_runs, explanation batched to run-end, no collapse appears. Under passive_unprompted, aggregate magnitude is a floor artifact, but a recovered logging gap revealed real, model-specific self-monitoring: llama3.1:8b volunteers structured confidence reports unprompted, sometimes eroding its own confidence as trials accumulate; the other two do so only once, as boilerplate. Elicitation structure is a first-class moderator of collapse observability. A companion guaranteed-failure run (72 cells, backfilling rates where random sampling gave zero real failures) shows models differ in whether they recognize an anomaly, distinct from engagement once recognized. Limitation: discrete rate points cannot capture behavior between them, a direction for future work.
papers.comment: 11 figures. Elicitation-condition sweep across three open-weight models (qwen3:8b, llama3.1:8b, mistral:7b); pipeline scripts and experimental data available upon reasonable request
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 LLM 在低概率、渐近罕见异常失败下的解释性投入（explanatory engagement）变化，即当工作流中工具调用以概率 p 失败且 p 趋于极小时，模型输出的长度、具体性和自报置信度如何变化。作者在三个开源模型（qwen3:8b, llama3.1:8b, mistral:7b）上搭建本地零成本测试平台，对 0.2 到 0.0001 的八个失败率与五种引导条件（elicitation condition）做组合扫描。主要发现是：跨条件汇总时长度呈单调下降，但按条件拆分后结果相反；在 immediate_forced 条件下预测的上升得到确认但随后是平台期而非崩塌，而在 passive_unprompted 条件下 llama3.1:8b 会主动提供结构化置信度报告。作者认为引导结构是崩塌可观测性的首要调节因素。
Motivation: 已有工作通常只问模型能否注意到异常，本文提出更窄的问题：当模型处在一个失败率低且可控的工作流中时，随着失败在概率上渐近罕见，其解释性投入（长度、具体性、自报置信度）是否会发生系统性变化。理解这一点有助于刻画模型在罕见故障场景下的自我监控行为。
Method: 构建本地零成本测试平台，让三个开源权重模型反复执行工具调用任务，其中一次调用以概率 p 失败，从 0.2 到 0.0001 扫描八个概率档位，并在五种引导条件（从即时提示到无提示）下进行组合实验。另配一组保证失败的运行（72 个单元），用于回填随机采样导致真实失败为零的档位。
Result: 跨条件汇总时长度呈平坦单调下降；按条件拆分后结论被推翻。在 immediate_forced 条件下，预测的投入上升得到确认但随后是平台期而非崩塌：长度在 p=0.05 时达到峰值 28.4 词，在最罕见档位回落到 17.4–19.0 词，置信度从约 53% 不均匀地升至 70s–90s。grouped_runs 条件下未见崩塌；passive_unprompted 条件下，日志缺口显示 llama3.1:8b 会主动且反复提供结构化置信度报告（有时随试验累积反而降低自身置信度），另两个模型只在首次以套话形式给出。
Conclusion: 引导结构（elicitation structure）是崩塌能否被观测到的首要调节因素，模型是否识别异常与识别后的解释性投入是两个不同维度。作者自述的局限是离散概率点无法刻画档位之间的连续行为，这留作未来工作。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Uniform Herding: Exemplar Replay with Representation Refresh
papers.abstract_en: As the feature representation changes, replay must preserve the earlier classes. However, only a bounded active exemplar set can be replayed. We propose Uniform Herding, which allocates the current active set across observed classes and uses a bounded candidate pool to refresh their chosen exemplars in the current representation. On CIFAR-100 with ten class-incremental tasks, a ResNet-18 backbone, active budget $M=2{,}000$, retrieval budget $b=64$, and three seeds, Uniform Herding obtains $44.00\pm0.51\%$ final average accuracy and $17.22\pm0.43\%$ forgetting, compared with $42.33\pm1.20\%$ and $24.87\pm1.11\%$ for iCaRL. Within the Uniform Herding protocol, final accuracy decreased when NME or herding was replaced with the tested alternatives, while forgetting increased when distillation was removed. Changing the retrieval budget has a smaller effect across the tested range than changing the active budget. The comparison with iCaRL is end-to-end. It does not isolate the effect of refresh from the other protocol differences. These results are limited to the tested protocol.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Uniform Herding，一种用于类增量学习 (class-incremental learning) 的样本回放方法，在特征表示变化时通过有界候选池刷新当前表示下已选样本。在 CIFAR-100 十类增量任务、ResNet-18、活动预算 M=2000、检索预算 b=64 的设置下，该方法得到 44.00±0.51% 的最终平均准确率和 17.22±0.43% 的遗忘，优于 iCaRL 的 42.33±1.20% 准确率和 24.87±1.11% 遗忘。作者强调与 iCaRL 的比较是端到端的，并未隔离刷新操作单独带来的影响。
Motivation: 在类增量学习中，特征表示不断变化，回放必须保留早期类别，但只能回放有界的活跃样本集，因此需要一种能适应表示变化的样本选择与更新策略。
Method: 提出 Uniform Herding，将当前活跃样本集在观测到的所有类别间进行分配，并利用一个有界候选池在当前表示下刷新所选样本，从而替代固定的 herding 选择。
Result: 在 CIFAR-100 十类增量任务中，Uniform Herding 取得 44.00±0.51% 最终平均准确率与 17.22±0.43% 遗忘，对比 iCaRL 为 42.33±1.20% 与 24.87±1.11%。协议内部，用替代方法替换 NME 或 herding 会降低最终准确率，移除蒸馏会增加遗忘；改变检索预算 b 的影响小于改变活动预算 M。
Conclusion: 作者指出结果局限于所测试的协议，且与 iCaRL 的对比是端到端的，无法单独归因于刷新操作，说明该方法在现行协议下的有效性及其验证的局限性。

papers.title: VALG: An Agentic System for ML Theory Research
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning theory studies learning procedures through mathematical setups in which the data model, training protocol, oracle access, loss, metric, and randomness define the phenomenon that a theorem is meant to explain. Solving an open problem therefore requires the problem formulation, theorem target, and proof mechanism to be developed in concert. Researchers formulate hypotheses, test them through preliminary theoretical or empirical analysis, and refine both assumptions and proofs. We investigate whether this process can be organized as an autonomous agentic workflow for ML theory research. We develop VALG, an agentic system that combines multi-level Verification, Adaptive formulation of Learning-theory problems, and Graph-structured proof development. Within each source-relative theorem branch, VALG maintains a fixed mathematical specification, checks the theorem-level composition of a typed proof-dependency graph, and constructs and reviews local proofs in dependency order. When a proof attempt fails, VALG identifies whether the obstruction lies in a derivation, the proof structure, or the theorem formulation and routes the next attempt accordingly. Formulation-level obstructions initiate an explicitly related variant or relaxation, preserving the mathematical relation between the resulting theorem and the source problem. We evaluate VALG on nine subproblems from five COLT 2026 open problems. Two runs produce internally finalized theorem candidates that match the scope of their source briefs; the remaining seven yield restricted-method results, special cases, or conditional theorems. These case studies show how VALG keeps source-scope matches, relaxations, conditional results, and blocked attempts mathematically distinct. VALG is open source at https://github.com/DechenZhang/VALG-ML-Theory-Agent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VALG，一个面向机器学习理论研究自主智能体工作流（agentic workflow）的系统，结合多层级验证（multi-level Verification）、自适应学习理论问题表述（Adaptive formulation）与图结构证明开发（Graph-structured proof development）。系统在定理分支内维护固定数学规范，检查类型化证明依赖图的定理级组合，并按依赖顺序构造和审查局部证明；证明失败时区分障碍在于派生、证明结构还是定理表述，并据此路由尝试。在 COLT 2026 五个开放问题的九个子问题评估中，两次运行产生与源 brief 范围匹配的内部定理候选，其余七次产生受限方法结果、特例或条件定理。
Motivation: 机器学习理论研究中的开放问题需要问题表述、定理目标和证明机制协同发展，研究者不断提出假设、测试并通过初步分析修正假设与证明。本文旨在研究这一过程能否被组织为自主智能体工作流，以推动 ML 理论研究的自动化。
Method: VALG 将多层级验证、自适应表述学习理论问题与图结构证明开发相结合。在每个源相关定理分支内，系统保持固定的数学规范，检查类型化证明依赖图的定理级组合，并沿依赖顺序构造和审查局部证明。当一次证明尝试失败时，系统识别障碍位于派生、证明结构还是定理表述层面并相应路由下一次尝试；表述层面障碍会触发显式相关的变体或放松，保留所得定理与源问题之间的数学关系。
Result: 在来自 COLT 2026 五个开放问题的九个子问题上，两次运行产生了与源 brief 范围匹配的最终定理候选；其余七次产生受限方法结果、特殊情形或条件定理。案例研究展示了系统如何将源范围匹配、放松、条件结果与阻塞尝试保持为数学上不同的类别。
Conclusion: 摘要认为这些案例显示 ML 理论研究可以组织为自主智能体工作流，VALG 能够区分并维持不同数学状态的证明探索结果。系统已开源。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: VALG 将多层级验证、自适应表述学习理论问题与图结构证明开发相结合。在每个源相关定理分支内，系统保持固定的数学规范，检查类型化证明依赖图的定理级组合，并沿依赖顺序构造和审查局部证明。当一次证明尝试失败时，系统识别障碍位于派生、证明结构还是定理表述层面并相应路由下一次尝试；表述层面障碍会触发显式相关的变体或放松，保留所得定理与源问题之间的数学关系。
summary_sections.result: 在来自 COLT 2026 五个开放问题的九个子问题上，两次运行产生了与源 brief 范围匹配的最终定理候选；其余七次产生受限方法结果、特殊情形或条件定理。案例研究展示了系统如何将源范围匹配、放松、条件结果与阻塞尝试保持为数学上不同的类别。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要认为这些案例显示 ML 理论研究可以组织为自主智能体工作流，VALG 能够区分并维持不同数学状态的证明探索结果。系统已开源。

papers.title: TEMPO: Makespan-Aware Expert-Parallel Load Balancing Across Memory- and Compute-Bound Regimes
papers.abstract_en: In expert-parallel (EP) MoE serving, every layer synchronizes at the slowest GPU. Dispatchers balance token counts (EPLB, LPLB, UltraEP) or activated-expert counts (METRO), assuming expert time is linear in one. Measurements on two datacenter GPU generations show it is neither: below $\nstar\!\approx\!156$--$168$ tokens, HBM weight streaming dominates---cost attaches to \emph{activated replicas}, not tokens; above it, grouped GEMM rounds tokens to 128-tile $M$-tiles, so \emph{splitting} an expert adds padded compute. A max-affine profile $t=\max(a+bG,\,c+βN)$ captures both regimes. Realistic decode batches hold hot experts in the linear regime and cold in the flat \emph{simultaneously}; recorded batches show proxy dispatches differ by $1.4$--$1.6\times$ in modeled block time (p95 up to $1.7\times$), and \emph{which} proxy wins flips with the regime. We formalize per-batch dispatch as a fixed-charge makespan problem---NP-hard on two fully replicated GPUs, polynomial in degenerate limits---and present \sys{}, a makespan-aware dispatcher solving it in milliseconds off the critical path; its SGLang integration runs out-of-process and fuses dispatch with count collection into one in-graph kernel. Anchored by an 8-GPU Testbed~A microbenchmark, \sys{} stays within 1\% of the best fixed baseline everywhere and wins by up to $15.5\%$ where regimes mix. End-to-end on Testbed~B, Qwen3-235B (inside the win region) gains $4$--$6\%$ throughput and cuts p99 latency by ${\sim}15.6\%$; DeepSeek-V3 (outside, communication-dominated) shows only mechanism cost. A phase diagram, not a universal win, is the claim: it predicts both outcomes before deployment.

papers.title: Operationalizing Cyber Threat Intelligence with GraphRAG
papers.abstract_en: When a security researcher publishes a report on a cyberattack, detection engineers are supposed to turn it into working detection rules. In practice, most automated attempts at this only extract the simplest clues from the report --- bad IP addresses, domain names, and file hashes --- and turn them into block lists. This is a weak strategy, because attackers can change these simple clues within hours or days, so the resulting detections stop working almost as soon as they are deployed. Security teams describe this idea with the Pyramid of Pain. This project asks whether feeding a report into a knowledge-graph retrieval system, Microsoft GraphRAG, rather than a standard vector-similarity retrieval system (Naive RAG), produces detection plans that rely more on these durable, top-of-pyramid clues. Both systems are given the same report, the same generation instructions, and the same language model to write the final plan; only the retrieval step differs. In a detailed case study of one APT28 report, the GraphRAG plan kept firing at 100\% of its detections after every IP address, domain, and file hash in the report was rotated, while the Naive RAG plan kept firing at only 29\%. Repeating the comparison across nine real CTI reports from four vendors confirms the same pattern: GraphRAG plans consistently reach higher, harder-to-evade levels of the pyramid, even when the two systems end up close on total score. The results support treating knowledge-graph-aware retrieval as the architecturally correct foundation for automatically generating SOC-deployable hunting plans, while showing that the wording of the generation prompt matters almost as much as the retrieval back-end itself.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在从网络威胁情报 (CTI) 报告自动生成检测/狩猎计划时，使用知识图谱检索系统 Microsoft GraphRAG 是否比标准向量相似检索 (Naive RAG) 更依赖金字塔顶部、难以被攻击者快速更换的持久性指标。在 APT28 报告案例中，旋转报告中所有 IP、域名和文件哈希后，GraphRAG 生成的计划仍 100% 触发，而 Naive RAG 计划仅 29% 触发。在来自四家厂商的九份真实 CTI 报告上的重复比较也显示 GraphRAG 一致地达到更高、更难规避的金字塔层级。
Motivation: 安全研究员发布的攻击报告需要被检测工程师转化为可工作的检测规则，但现有自动化方法大多只提取 IP、域名、文件哈希等简单线索并生成封禁列表；攻击者可在数小时或数天内更换这些线索，导致检测很快失效，即 Pyramid of Pain 所指出的问题。
Method: 在同一份报告、相同的生成指令和相同语言模型的条件下，仅替换检索后端，对比 Microsoft GraphRAG 与 Naive RAG 对 CTI 报告进行知识图谱感知检索并生成最终检测计划的效果。
Result: 在 APT28 案例中，旋转所有 IP、域名和文件哈希后，GraphRAG 计划的检测触发率保持 100%，Naive RAG 计划仅为 29%；在九份来自四家厂商的真实 CTI 报告上重复比较得到一致模式，即使两者总分接近，GraphRAG 计划也一致达到更高、更不易规避的金字塔层级。
Conclusion: 作者认为结果支持将知识图谱感知检索视为自动生成 SOC 可部署狩猎计划的架构正确基础，同时指出生成提示词的措辞对结果的影响几乎与检索后端本身相当。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: H2R-Bench: Benchmarking Human-to-Robot Manipulation Video Generation in World Models
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale manipulation data is essential for robot learning, yet collecting robot demonstrations remains expensive and difficult to scale. Meanwhile, abundant egocentric human manipulation videos provide rich behavioral experiences, but transferring them across embodiments remains challenging due to differences between human hands and robotic end-effectors. Recent advances in video world models offer a promising pathway to synthesize robot-centric manipulation videos from human observations, while their cross-embodiment transfer capability remains largely unexplored. Therefore, we introduce H2R-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating cross-embodiment human-to-robot manipulation video generation, where models transform egocentric human demonstrations into robot manipulation videos under specified embodiments. Each benchmark instance contains a human demonstration video, target embodiment constraints, and source-grounded annotations covering task goals, action events, functional contacts, and object responses. H2R-Bench evaluates generated videos through five dimensions, including goal-state completion, action-event completion, functional contact transfer, embodiment correctness, and general video quality. We benchmark eleven state-of-the-art video generation models across six manipulation families and two robot embodiments. Our evaluation reveals that current video world models remain limited in human-to-robot manipulation transfer: even leading models often fail in embodiment consistency, functional interaction, and task execution. H2R-Bench provides a systematic diagnostic framework for evaluating whether video world models can bridge the human-to-robot embodiment gap and convert human manipulation observations into robot-centric training resources.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 H2R-Bench，一个用于评估跨具身（cross-embodiment）人-机器人操作视频生成的基准。基准将第一人称人类演示视频转换为指定机器人具身下的操作视频，并提供源接地标注与五维度评估。作者评测了 11 个 SOTA 视频生成模型在 6 个操作族和 2 个机器人具身上的表现，发现现有视频世界模型在具身一致性、功能交互和任务执行方面仍存在明显不足。
Motivation: 机器人学习需要大规模操作数据，但机器人演示数据采集昂贵且难以扩展；人类 egocentric 操作视频虽然丰富，但因人手与机器人末端执行器的差异，跨具身迁移困难。视频世界模型有望合成机器人视角的操作视频，但其跨具身迁移能力尚未被系统评估。
Method: 构建 H2R-Bench 基准，每个实例包含人类演示视频、目标具身约束以及源接地标注，覆盖任务目标、动作事件、功能接触和物体响应。生成视频通过五个维度评估：目标状态完成、动作事件完成、功能接触迁移、具身正确性以及一般视频质量。
Result: 对 11 个 state-of-the-art 视频生成模型、6 个操作族和 2 个机器人具身的评测表明，当前视频世界模型在人类到机器人操作的迁移上仍有限：即使是领先模型也常在具身一致性、功能交互和任务执行上失败。
Conclusion: H2R-Bench 提供了一个系统性诊断框架，用于评估视频世界模型能否弥合人与机器人之间的具身差距，并将人类操作观察转化为机器人可用的训练资源。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DMDIntel: Interpreting Large Language Models via Dynamic Mode Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we introduce DMDIntel which uses dynamic mode decomposition (DMD) to make the predictions made by LLMs in a classification task interpretable. It develops an input attribution pipeline, that first decomposes the hidden states of an LLM into prominent patterns, also known as modes, and then associates ranks to the input tokens based on the projection values on those modes. Rigorous experiments across three datasets and three model families consistently show that the ranked attribution of input tokens obtained using DMDIntel by far outperforms state-of-the-art techniques such as principal component analysis, integrated gradients and SHAP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DMDIntel，一种基于动态模式分解 (dynamic mode decomposition, DMD) 的 LLM 可解释性方法，用于分类任务的输入归因。方法先将 LLM 隐藏状态分解为显著模式 (modes)，再根据输入 token 在这些模式上的投影值对其排序。在三个数据集和三个模型家族上的实验表明，该归因排名显著优于主成分分析、集成梯度 (integrated gradients) 和 SHAP。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 解释技术（如 SHAP、集成梯度）在生成高质量输入归因时成本高或效果有限；作者试图利用 DMD 从隐藏状态中提取主要动态模式，为分类预测提供可解释且有效的 token 级归因。
Method: DMDIntel 构建输入归因流水线：先用 DMD 将 LLM 隐藏状态分解为主要模式，再基于各输入 token 在这些模式上的投影值计算排名归因。
Result: 在三个数据集和三个模型家族上的实验显示，DMDIntel 得到的 token 归因排名在性能上大幅优于 PCA、集成梯度和 SHAP。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 DMDIntel 为 LLM 分类预测提供了一种高效且可解释的归因方式，但未明确讨论计算开销或适用范围限制。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Topology-Unified 2D Pose Estimation across Intact, Residual and Prosthetic Limbs
papers.abstract_en: Driven by the availability of large-scale datasets, Human Pose Estimation (HPE) plays a critical role in numerous downstream tasks. However, mainstream benchmarks exhibit severe representation bias, predominantly featuring able-bodied individuals. While a few pioneering datasets have attempted to address limb differences, their annotation protocols fail to generalize, struggling to represent specialized mechanical structures like running blades or unprosthetized residual limbs. To bridge this gap, we introduce ProPose, a large-scale benchmark featuring a novel annotation protocol that unifies the topological representation of biological limbs, diverse prostheses, and physical absences within a single framework. Because real-world prosthetic images are inherently scarce and exhibit extreme long-tail distributions, we design a Real-to-Synthetic data expansion pipeline to explicitly synthesize and expand the underrepresented cases. However, simply training existing models on this enriched dataset often leads to suboptimal solutions, as they estimate each keypoint independently and might hallucinate non-existent joints on mechanical structures. To resolve this, we propose ProLoss, a structure-aware objective that enforces keypoint dependencies within a single limb to prevent unrealistic limb predictions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach improves the classification accuracy of long-tail prosthetic joints by 2% to 6% without compromising spatial coordinate localization performance. This work sets a foundation for inclusive pose estimation, unlocking new possibilities for understanding the interactions between human bodies and assistive devices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ProPose，一个面向完整肢体、残肢与假肢的二维人体姿态估计基准，并设计统一拓扑标注协议，将生物肢体、多种假肢和物理缺失表达在同一个框架中。针对真实假肢图像稀缺的长尾分布，作者提出 Real-to-Synthetic 数据扩增流程，并引入结构感知的 ProLoss 损失，约束同一肢体内部关键点依赖，避免在机械结构上幻觉出不存在的关键点。实验显示该方法在不损失空间坐标定位性能的前提下，将长尾假肢关节分类准确率提升 2% 到 6%。
Motivation: 现有 HPE 基准存在严重的表征偏差，主要面向健全人群；少数数据集尝试覆盖肢体差异，但其标注协议难以泛化到跑步假肢叶片或未安装假肢的残肢等特殊机械结构。真实世界假肢图像稀缺且呈极端长尾分布，直接训练现有模型往往得到次优解。
Method: 提出 ProPose 大规模基准，其核心是统一生物肢体、多种假肢与物理缺失的拓扑表示的新标注协议；设计 Real-to-Synthetic 数据扩增流程显式合成并扩展低频样本；提出 ProLoss 结构化目标，通过施加单肢体内部关键点依赖来防止不切实际的肢体预测。
Result: 在扩展数据集上的实验表明，该方法将长尾假肢关节的分类准确率提高 2% 到 6%，同时不损害空间坐标定位性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该工作为包容性姿态估计（inclusive pose estimation）奠定基础，并为理解人体与辅助设备之间的交互提供新的可能性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BoardroomAI: Dependency-Aware Human-Steerable Multi-Agent Deliberation through Evolving Decision Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Organizational decisions are co-created while evidence, constraints, and human priorities continue to evolve. In conventional transcript-based multi-agent systems, humans typically provide an initial problem, agents deliberate internally, and the system returns a final response. BoardroomAI instead treats the human as a persistent participant who can intervene by challenging assumptions, modifying constraints, changing priorities, introducing evidence, or redirecting the decision process. We operationalize this human--agent coexistence through four components: (i) a typed decision graph representing evidence, assumptions, constraints, claims, objections, alternatives, risks, decisions, semantic dependencies, and specialist responsibility; (ii) an intervention compiler that converts confirmed human actions into explicit graph updates; (iii) dependency-aware propagation that identifies affected subgraphs, preserves unaffected artifacts, and selectively reactivates relevant specialists; and (iv) an evaluation framework measuring intervention impact, repair coverage, preservation, recomputation, and decision validity. Across 600 generated decision-DAG interventions, propagation matched exhaustive impact computation while inspecting only 14.59% of nodes. In a 12-case exploratory pilot, selective repair recomputed 62.11% of canonical nodes, preserved all gold-unaffected nodes, and produced valid updated decisions in six cases while abstaining in the remaining six. These abstentions show that correct intervention routing may still provide insufficient context for synthesis, motivating a \emph{decision-sufficient context closure} for human-steered multi-agent deliberation. All results are synthetic and prototype-level.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BoardroomAI，一种将人类作为持续参与者的多智能体审议 (multi-agent deliberation) 系统，通过带类型的决策图 (typed decision graph) 来显式建模证据、假设、约束、主张、反对意见、替代方案、风险、决策及其语义依赖。系统包含干预编译器 (intervention compiler)、依赖感知传播 (dependency-aware propagation) 与评估框架四个组件。在 600 个生成的决策 DAG 干预上，传播能在仅检查 14.59% 节点的情况下匹配穷举影响计算；在 12 个案例的探索性试点中，选择性修复重算了 62.11% 的规范节点并保留所有未受影响节点，其中 6 例产生有效更新决策、6 例选择弃权。所有结果均为合成且原型级别。
Motivation: 传统基于转录的多智能体系统通常由人类给出初始问题后，智能体内部审议并返回最终答案，难以及时回应持续演化的证据、约束与人类优先级。本文针对这一交互缺口，目标是让人类在决策过程中持续介入，挑战假设、修改约束、改变优先级或引入新证据。
Method: 通过四个组件实现人机共存：一是带类型的决策图，表示证据、假设、约束、主张、反对意见、替代方案、风险、决策、语义依赖与专家责任；二是干预编译器，把确认后的人类动作转换为显式图更新；三是依赖感知传播，识别受影响子图、保留未受影响工件并选择性重新激活相关专家；四是评估框架，度量干预影响、修复覆盖率、保留性、重计算与决策有效性。
Result: 在 600 个生成的决策 DAG 干预上，依赖感知传播与穷举影响计算完全一致，且只检查了 14.59% 的节点。在 12 个案例的探索性试点中，选择性修复重算了 62.11% 的规范节点，保留了全部 gold 未受影响节点，6 例得到有效更新决策，其余 6 例弃权。
Conclusion: 弃权案例表明，即使干预路由正确，也可能缺乏足够的上下文来综合新决策，因此作者提出需要为人类引导的多智能体审议引入决策充分上下文闭合 (decision-sufficient context closure)。作者强调所有结果都是合成数据上的原型级验证，尚未涉及真实组织决策场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: P2Fusion: Prompt-based Progressive Infrared-Visible Image Fusion via Dual-Prior Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Infrared-visible image fusion (IVIF) is pivotal for multimodal perception, yet reconciling the inherent information disparity between thermal and textural features remains a fundamental challenge. Existing prior-guided methods often rely on static constraints that induce optimization conflicts or utilize extrinsic semantic priors from large-scale foundation models (e.g., CLIP/DINO), which frequently fail to exploit the intrinsic modality characteristics essential for high-fidelity fusion. To address these issues, we propose P2Fusion, a prior-guided distillation-based framework that reformulates IVIF via dual intrinsic prompts. Instead of imposing hard-coded penalties, we distill image-intrinsic priors, thermal saliency and spatial quality, into learnable dynamic regulators. Specifically, a Teach-to-Fuse mechanism provides dual-granularity progressive guidance, coupled with a Gated Dynamic Expert Recalibration (GDER) module for decoupled feature refinement. This design enables the network to adaptively mediate modal competition through expert specialization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that P2Fusion achieves state-of-the-art performance across five mainstream datasets. Notably, our framework demonstrates consistent performance advantages in fusion quality, achieving state-of-the-art results in 14 out of 20 key evaluation metrics across 5 benchmarks. Furthermore, it effectively contributes to the robustness of downstream perception, such as +3.2% mAP on MSRS, +0.5% mAP on M3FD and +0.9% mAP on DroneVehicle for object detection. Our code will be available at https://github.com/YiShi99/P2Fusion
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 P2Fusion，一种基于双内在提示的先验蒸馏式红外-可见光图像融合 (IVIF) 框架。作者将热显著性与空间质量等图像内在先验蒸馏为可学习的动态调节器，并通过 Teach-to-Fuse 机制提供双粒度渐进指导，配合门控动态专家重校准 (GDER) 模块实现解耦特征细化。在五个主流数据集上，该方法在 20 项关键指标中的 14 项上取得最优结果，并为下游目标检测带来稳定提升。
Motivation: 现有先验引导的 IVIF 方法常依赖静态约束导致优化冲突，或使用 CLIP/DINO 等外部基础模型的语义先验，未能充分利用模态内在特性，难以实现高保真融合。
Method: 提出 P2Fusion 框架，将图像内在先验（热显著性、空间质量）蒸馏为可学习的动态调节器，替代硬编码惩罚；采用 Teach-to-Fuse 机制提供双粒度渐进式训练指导，并引入门控动态专家重校准 (GDER) 模块进行解耦特征细化，使网络通过专家特化自适应调节模态竞争。
Result: 在五个主流基准数据集上取得融合质量的最优结果，20 项关键评估指标中 14 项达到最佳；同时提升下游目标检测性能，MSRS 上 mAP +3.2%，M3FD 上 +0.5%，DroneVehicle 上 +0.9%。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，将内在模态先验蒸馏为动态调节器并配合专家特化机制，能够有效缓解模态信息差异带来的竞争，提升融合质量与下游感知鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Local Mismatch to Global Impact: Optimizing Cache Reuse Policy for Efficient Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have achieved dominant performance in visual generation but suffer from substantial inference overhead. While cache-based acceleration has emerged as a promising solution, existing policies rely on local similarity heuristics, which we identify as being significantly misaligned with final generation quality. This discrepancy stems from the non-uniform propagation and accumulation of errors along the denoising trajectory. To address this, we propose Global-Impact Cache (GCache). We first establish a rigorous theoretical characterization of the error propagation upper bound. Recognizing that this bound can be overly conservative for complex, highly non-convex diffusion models, we further reparameterize the propagation exponent with a Bernstein form and reformulate cache policy search as a bilevel optimization problem. In detail, GCache identifies an optimal reuse policy in the inner objective while aligning the error-weighting function with generation quality loss in the outer objective. This framework effectively reconciles theoretical rigor with empirical performance, learning to prioritize computation where it most impacts visual fidelity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GCache consistently outperforms prior caching strategies on both video and image generation. Notably, on the state-of-the-art Wan2.1 video diffusion model, GCache maintains a 2.17x speedup while significantly enhancing generation quality, reducing LPIPS from 0.1095 to 0.0316.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散模型推理开销大、现有缓存加速策略依赖局部相似性启发式与最终生成质量错配的问题，提出 Global-Impact Cache (GCache)。作者建立误差传播上界的理论刻画，并用 Bernstein 形式重新参数化传播指数，将缓存策略搜索转化为双层优化：内层寻找最优复用策略，外层让误差加权函数对齐生成质量损失。实验表明 GCache 在图像和视频生成上一致优于既有缓存策略，在 Wan2.1 视频扩散模型上保持 2.17 倍加速的同时将 LPIPS 从 0.1095 降至 0.0316。
Motivation: 扩散模型在视觉生成中表现优异但推理开销大，缓存加速虽有前景，但现有策略基于局部相似性启发式，与最终生成质量严重错位；其根源是去噪轨迹中误差的非均匀传播与累积。
Method: GCache 先给出误差传播上界的严格理论刻画，针对该上界在高度非凸扩散模型中过于保守的问题，用 Bernstein 形式重新参数化传播指数，并将缓存策略搜索建模为双层优化：内层目标学习最优复用策略，外层目标将误差加权函数与生成质量损失对齐。
Result: 大规模实验表明 GCache 在视频和图像生成上均优于已有缓存策略；在 SOTA 的 Wan2.1 视频扩散模型上，GCache 维持 2.17 倍加速并显著提升生成质量，LPIPS 从 0.1095 降至 0.0316。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架在理论严谨性与经验表现之间取得调和，能够学习将计算资源优先分配到对视觉保真度影响最大的位置。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Latent On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Enabling agents to learn from experience and internalize it into their policy has become a central problem in self-evolving AI. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) offers an effective pathway by using a privileged self-teacher to provide dense supervision on the student's own trajectories; however, existing methods still rely heavily on designer-specified privileged artifacts (e.g., answers, feedback, skills, or trajectories), limiting the end-to-end learnability and scalability required for continual self-improvement. In this work, we introduce Latent On-Policy Self-Distillation (LOPD), which, rather than proposing another hand-crafted OPSD variant with a newly prescribed form of privileged context, makes the teacher's privileged context itself learnable end-to-end from experience. Technically, LOPD retrieves relevant experiences and composes them into continuous latent tokens that condition a self-teacher, while the student generates trajectories from the task and interaction history and receives dense token-level supervision at every visited prefix. We further introduce a privileged-margin objective to stabilize and regulate the learning of latent context. Empirically, LOPD demonstrates (I) strong performance, outperforming RLVR and representative OPSD methods including OPSD, SDPO, and Skill-SD across both agentic tool use and code generation; and (II) high learning efficiency, surpassing GRPO and Skill-SD with less than 30% of their rollout budget. Ablation studies further provide direct evidence that making privileged context learnable is necessary for realizing these gains. Together, these results position LOPD as a step toward a more scalable and self-directed paradigm for agent evolution.

Result: 实验表明 LOPD 在智能体工具使用和代码生成任务上优于 RLVR、OPSD、SDPO 和 Skill-SD，并且在不到 GRPO 与 Skill-SD 30% 的 rollout 预算下超过它们；消融研究直接证明特权上下文可学习是这些收益的必要条件。
Conclusion: 摘要将 LOPD 定位为迈向更可扩展、更自驱动的智能体进化范式的一步，并强调特权上下文可学习性的必要性。

papers.title: On the global feature importance for interpretable and trustworthy heat demand forecasting
papers.abstract_en: The paper introduces the ante-hoc Explainable AI methodology to assess the global feature importance of the Machine Learning models used for heat demand forecasting in intelligent control of District Heating Systems, with motivation to facilitate their interpretability and trustworthiness, hence addressing the challenges related to adherence to communal standards, customer satisfaction and liability risks. Methodology includes use of four different approaches, namely intrinsic interpretability of Gradient Boosting method and selected post-hoc methods, namely Partial Dependence, Accumulated Local Effects and SHAP. None of the selected methods assume feature permutation or perturbations which can introduce bias due to introduction of random unrealistic values of data instances. Discussion of results is provided, including the assessment of complementarities where applicable, with specific interpretations in context of the district heating processes.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 5 figures. This preprint corresponds to the paper published in Thermal Science 2025 Volume 29, Issue 5 Part A, Pages: 3355-3365
papers.journal_ref: Thermal Science 2025 Volume 29, Issue 5 Part A, Pages: 3355-3365
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向区域供热系统 (District Heating Systems) 智能控制中的热需求预测任务，提出一种 ante-hoc 可解释 AI (Explainable AI) 方法论，用于评估机器学习模型的全局特征重要性。方法同时使用梯度提升 (Gradient Boosting) 的固有可解释性和三种 post-hoc 方法，即部分依赖 (Partial Dependence)、累积局部效应 (Accumulated Local Effects) 和 SHAP，且这些方法均不采用特征排列或扰动。作者在区域供热过程背景下讨论了各方法的互补性与具体解释。
Motivation: 热需求预测模型在区域供热智能控制中需要满足社区标准、客户满意度并规避责任风险，因此模型的可解释性和可信度是关键挑战；而依赖特征排列或扰动的现有解释方法可能因引入随机不真实的数据实例而产生偏差。
Method: 提出 ante-hoc XAI 方法论，使用四种方法评估全局特征重要性：梯度提升方法的固有可解释性，以及部分依赖 (Partial Dependence)、累积局部效应 (Accumulated Local Effects) 和 SHAP 三种 post-hoc 方法；所选方法均不假设特征排列或扰动。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验结果，而是提供结果讨论，包括在适用处对各方法互补性的评估，以及在区域供热过程背景下的具体解释。
Conclusion: 作者认为不依赖特征排列或扰动的可解释方法有助于增强热需求预测模型的信任度，并指出不同全局特征重要性方法之间存在互补性。
