summary_sections.method: 提出基准 TRACE，统一细粒度击球属性、跨击球战术关系、层级战术标注和基于证据的问题；提出模型 TennisVAR，包含事件解析模块将连续回合转换为显式击球事件序列，以及战术图引导的时间推理器，联合建模回合进展和同球员决策依赖，以识别与问题相关的证据和关键动作。
summary_sections.result: 摘要未报告实验数值，主要贡献为定义新任务并发布大规模基准 TRACE，其规模包括 11,189 个回合视频、41,485 个击球事件、25,429 个战术单元与 11,189 个问答对。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为将战术推理锚定在击球证据上可以弥合感知与理解之间的鸿沟，并推动网球视频理解从事件识别走向战术层面的解释。

papers.title: Towards Socially Compliant Navigation in Deep Reinforcement Learning via Proxemics-Based Reward Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Developing effective robot navigation methods in crowded environments is essential for real-world applications. Although recent deep reinforcement learning (DRL) methods have improved navigation performance in crowded environments, they often focus primarily on task-centric objectives and underrepresent social compliance objectives. In this paper, we introduce a novel proxemics-based reward formulation for DRL social navigation that provides a dense, interpretable social learning signal while maintaining navigation efficiency. Our approach models each human's personal space as a radial Gaussian-mixture field derived from Hall's proxemics theory and computes a robot-centric local cost over the robot's field of view. We integrate the proposed reward into established DRL navigation methods and evaluate it in simulation across multiple crowd scenarios, reward baselines, and crowd densities using both navigation metrics and social metrics. Results show that the proposed reward consistently improves social metrics in simulation while maintaining competitive navigation performance relative to the compared reward models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对拥挤环境下深度强化学习 (DRL) 导航中社会合规目标表达不足的问题，提出一种基于 proxemics 的稠密奖励建模方法。作者依据 Hall 的 proxemics 理论，将每个人类个体的个人空间建模为径向高斯混合场 (radial Gaussian-mixture field)，并在机器人视野 (field of view) 内计算局部代价作为奖励。将该奖励集成到已有 DRL 导航方法后，仿真实验表明其能在保持竞争性导航性能的同时稳定提升社会指标。
Motivation: 现有 DRL 导航方法在拥挤环境中主要优化任务导向目标，忽略了社会合规目标，导致机器人行为缺乏对行人个人空间的尊重。
Method: 提出一种新的基于 proxemics 的奖励公式：用来自 Hall 理论的径向高斯混合场表示行人个人空间，在机器人视野内计算机器人本位的局部代价，并将该奖励集成进已有的 DRL 导航方法。
Result: 在多种人群场景、奖励基线和人群密度下的仿真评估中，该奖励相比对照奖励模型一致地改善了社会指标，同时保持了具有竞争力的导航性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该稠密、可解释的 proxemics 奖励能够在仿真中提升社会合规性而不牺牲导航效率；实验范围限于仿真环境。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: InFactPlanner: Planning Sustainable Geo-Distributed LLM Data Centers
papers.abstract_en: The rapid growth of LLM inference is shifting sustainability concerns from one-time training to continuous serving, where infrastructure decisions shape energy use, carbon emissions, water consumption, and service quality. Yet operators often need to compare deployment alternatives before large-scale infrastructure is built, making direct measurement costly, slow, and sometimes infeasible. We present InFactPlanner, a trace-driven decision-support framework for what-if analysis of sustainable AI data center deployment for LLM inference across single and geo-distributed sites. InFactPlanner combines query traces, hardware-model profiles, candidate site configurations, PUE/WUE parameters, renewable generation models, and time-varying grid carbon intensity to estimate power, energy, carbon emissions, water use, latency, and server utilization. The framework abstracts low-level serving effects into configurable hardware-model profiles, enabling rapid comparison of site selection, capacity placement, hardware, model, renewable integration, and routing choices. We validate the energy accounting pipeline by reproducing reference LLM inference energy estimates with less than 10% deviation, evaluate scalability across multiple data centers and server counts, and demonstrate scenario-driven decision analyses for hardware selection, renewable placement, geographic deployment, and carbon-aware routing. Our results show that sustainability-optimal choices can differ from latency-optimal ones, and that the carbon value of deployment depends strongly on the local grid mix.
papers.comment: Author copy of paper published at 34th International Symposium on the Modeling, Analysis, and Simulation of Computer and Telecommunication System (MASCOTS2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 InFactPlanner，一个基于流量 trace 的决策支持框架，用于对 LLM 推理在单一与地理分布式站点的可持续 AI 数据中心部署进行 what-if 分析。该框架结合查询 trace、硬件模型 profile、候选站点配置、PUE/WUE 参数、可再生能源发电模型和时变电网碳强度，估算功耗、能耗、碳排放、用水量、延迟与服务器利用率。作者用参考 LLM 推理能耗复现验证了能耗核算流程（偏差低于 10%），并展示了硬件选型、可再生能源布局、地理部署及碳感知路由等场景分析。
Motivation: LLM 推理的快速增长使可持续性问题从一次性训练转向持续服务，基础设施决策会直接影响能耗、碳排放、用水和服务质量；但在大规模基础设施建成前，直接测量部署替代方案的代价高、速度慢，有时甚至不可行。
Method: InFactPlanner 是一个 trace 驱动的决策支持框架，将查询 trace、硬件模型 profile、候选站点配置、PUE/WUE 参数、可再生能源发电模型与时变电网碳强度联合起来，以估算功耗、能耗、碳排放、用水、延迟和服务器利用率。框架把底层服务效应抽象为可配置的硬件模型 profile，从而支持对站点选择、容量放置、硬件、模型、可再生能源整合和路由选择进行快速比较。
Result: 摘要报告该框架在复现参考 LLM 推理能耗估算时偏差小于 10%，并可扩展到多个数据中心和不同服务器数量；场景分析显示，可持续性最优的部署选择可能与延迟最优的选择不同，且部署的碳价值强烈依赖于当地电网的电力结构。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 InFactPlanner 可用于可持续 AI 数据中心部署的 what-if 分析，其核心发现是可持续性最优与延迟最优选择并不一致，本地电网结构对部署的碳价值有决定性影响。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Revisiting Overestimation Bias Problem of Q-learning: Settling Large Discrete Action Space via Action Intersection
papers.abstract_en: This paper considers the overestimation bias problem of Q-learning in the setting of a large action space, for the purpose of relieving the bottleneck of existing methods. We find that the large action space increases the randomness in Q-value estimation. The randomness makes two paradigms that drive the major literature on the overestimation problem have their own bottlenecks: the coupling paradigm, i.e., the optimal action and its Q-value are estimated with the same Q-function, always has a positive bias. This is because randomness leads to some actions having abnormally high estimated values than their true values, and the coupling methods prefer these actions. The decoupling paradigm, i.e., the optimal action and its Q-value are estimated with two independent Q-functions, always has a negative bias. This is because randomness increases the estimation gap between the two independent Q-tables for the same action. This paper shows that action intersection can be a simple yet powerful strategy to relieve these bottlenecks. The action intersection strategy enables semi-decoupling via two designs: (1) it allows two Q-functions to share a certain fraction of trajectory data; (2) if a data sample is shared, each Q-function is updated using the coupling paradigm; otherwise, using the decoupling paradigm. Two properties make the action intersection strategy powerful: (1) attaining a large bias range, i.e., varying the data sharing fraction, the estimation bias varies from underestimating to overestimating; (2) fine granularity: the action intersection size can be made arbitrarily finer to enable finer control. We consider two experiment settings, i.e., tabular and deep RL, deep RL experiments show that our method outperforms several SOTA baselines drastically; tabular experiments reveal why our method can achieve superior performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大动作空间下Q-learning的过估计偏差问题，指出大动作空间会增大Q值估计的随机性，使耦合范式（optimal action与其Q值用同一Q函数估计）总是产生正偏差，解耦范式（用两个独立Q函数估计）总是产生负偏差。作者提出动作交集（action intersection）策略实现半解耦，通过让两个Q函数共享部分轨迹数据、共享样本用耦合范式更新、非共享样本用解耦范式更新，从而在欠估计与过估计之间调节偏差。tabular与deep RL实验显示该方法在deep RL中大幅优于多个SOTA基线。
Motivation: 现有缓解Q-learning过估计偏差的方法在大动作空间下遇到瓶颈：动作空间增大会提升Q值估计的随机性，使耦合范式偏好异常高估的动作而产生正偏差，同时使解耦范式中两个独立Q表对同一动作的估计差距增大而产生负偏差。
Method: 提出动作交集（action intersection）策略实现半解耦：允许两个Q函数共享一定比例的轨迹数据；若某个数据样本被共享，则用耦合范式更新每个Q函数，否则用解耦范式更新。该策略具有两个性质：通过改变数据共享比例，估计偏差可在欠估计与过估计之间大范围变化；动作交集大小可任意细化，从而支持精细的偏差控制。
Result: deep RL实验表明该方法在多个SOTA基线上有大幅提升；tabular实验揭示了方法取得优越性能的内在原因。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调动作交集是一种简单而有效的策略，能够缓解大动作空间下耦合范式的正偏差与解耦范式的负偏差，并通过半解耦设计实现可调的偏差范围与细粒度控制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Visual Evidence: Revealing and Mitigating Relational Privacy Leakage in Document MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: While the privacy risks of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have drawn significant attention, the unique vulnerabilities of domain-specific MLLMs remain largely underexplored. Focusing on document understanding MLLMs for identity document processing, this paper investigates the privacy issues inherent in Key Information Extraction (KIE) tasks. We reveal that when input images lack sufficient visual evidence, these models often rely on memorized field relations from training data to infer missing content, thereby leaking multiple correlated fields containing sensitive personal information. To mitigate this risk, we make three key contributions.First, we propose the Dynamic Relational Unlearning Framework (DRUF) which comprises a Relational Decoupling Unlearning (RDU) module and a dynamic set update mechanism. It suppresses the leakage of high-risk field pairs while preserving KIE performance.Second, we introduce DocPrivacyBench, a novel benchmark to systematically evaluate a model's susceptibility to privacy leakage under conditions of absent or minimal visual evidence.Third, we evaluate three MLLMs and six unlearning methods using this benchmark, assessing both post-unlearning leakage suppression and utility preservation.Our results demonstrate that existing MLLMs consistently exhibit privacy leakage when visual evidence is scarce, particularly on noisier datasets. In contrast, DRUF outperforms the strongest baseline by improving leakage suppression by 4.8 percentage points, effectively mitigating privacy risks while maintaining robust document information extraction performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究面向身份证件处理的文档理解多模态大模型（document MLLMs）在关键信息抽取（KIE）任务中的关系型隐私泄露问题。作者揭示：当输入图像缺少足够的视觉证据时，模型倾向于依赖训练数据中记忆的字段关系来推断缺失内容，从而泄露多个相互关联的敏感个人字段。为此提出 Dynamic Relational Unlearning Framework (DRUF)（含 Relational Decoupling Unlearning (RDU) 模块与动态集合更新机制）以及基准 DocPrivacyBench。实验表明现有 MLLMs 在视觉证据稀缺时普遍存在隐私泄露，而 DRUF 相比最强基线将泄露抑制率提升 4.8 个百分点，同时保持文档信息抽取性能。
Motivation: 多模态大模型的隐私风险虽已受关注，但领域特定 MLLMs（尤其是证件文档 KIE 任务）的独特脆弱性尚未被充分探索；当视觉证据不足时模型会利用记忆的字段关系推断缺失内容，导致多个敏感信息字段被连带泄露。
Method: 提出动态关系遗忘框架 DRUF，包含关系解耦遗忘（Relational Decoupling Unlearning, RDU）模块与动态集合更新机制，用于抑制高风险字段对的泄露并保持 KIE 性能；同时引入基准 DocPrivacyBench，系统评估模型在视觉证据缺失或极少条件下的隐私泄露敏感度。
Result: 作者用 DocPrivacyBench 评测了三个 MLLMs 和六种遗忘方法：现有模型在视觉证据稀缺时（尤其在噪声更大的数据集上）表现出一致的隐私泄露；DRUF 相比最强基线将泄露抑制提升 4.8 个百分点，并能维持稳健的文档信息抽取性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调文档 MLLMs 在 KIE 任务中存在依赖记忆字段关系的关系型隐私泄露风险，并主张 DRUF 可在有效抑制高风险字段对泄露的同时保留抽取能力。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 作者用 DocPrivacyBench 评测了三个 MLLMs 和六种遗忘方法：现有模型在视觉证据稀缺时（尤其在噪声更大的数据集上）表现出一致的隐私泄露；DRUF 相比最强基线将泄露抑制提升 4.8 个百分点，并能维持稳健的文档信息抽取性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调文档 MLLMs 在 KIE 任务中存在依赖记忆字段关系的关系型隐私泄露风险，并主张 DRUF 可在有效抑制高风险字段对泄露的同时保留抽取能力。

papers.title: EGRL: Edge generation-guided relation-aware learning for RNA-protein interaction prediction
papers.abstract_en: RNA-Protein Interactions (RPIs) are critical for regulating cellular functions. While traditional wet-lab experiments for RPI detection are costly and time-consuming, Deep Learning (DL) methods provide an efficient computational alternative for RPI Prediction (RPIP). In particular, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are promising, as they naturally model RPI networks. However, existing GNN-based methods often rely on homogeneous graphs or predefined meta-paths, which limit their ability to handle data sparsity and to generalize to cold-start scenarios involving unknown molecules. To address these limitations, we propose Edge Generation-guided Relation-aware Learning (EGRL), a novel framework with several key components: implicit meta-path learning to capture relational semantics without handcrafted paths; a multi-relation-aware attention mechanism for adaptive fusion of interaction patterns; a graph generator that predicts potential ("soft") edges to support cold-start nodes; and a multi-feature fusion predictor for final interaction scoring. EGRL is jointly trained with a primary task loss and an auxiliary generator loss. Comprehensive evaluations on four benchmark datasets demonstrate that EGRL achieves competitive overall performance. More importantly, it exhibits superior generalization in cold-start settings, achieving an Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.867 and an Area Under the Precision-Recall curve (AUPR) of 0.861 on unknown molecules, corresponding to improvements of 8.6% in AUROC and 5.0% in AUPR over prior state-of-the-art methods. The code will be released soon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Edge Generation-guided Relation-aware Learning (EGRL)，一个用于 RNA-蛋白质相互作用 (RPI) 预测的图神经网络框架。EGRL 通过隐式元路径学习、多关系感知注意力、图生成器预测软边以及多特征融合预测器，应对数据稀疏性和未知分子的冷启动问题。在四个基准数据集上，EGRL 取得有竞争力的总体性能，并在冷启动场景下显著优于先前方法。
Motivation: 现有基于 GNN 的 RPI 预测方法常依赖同质图或预定义元路径，限制了它们处理数据稀疏性的能力，也难以泛化到包含未知分子的冷启动场景。
Method: EGRL 包含如下组件：隐式元路径学习以在不手工设计路径的情况下捕获关系语义；多关系感知注意力机制自适应融合交互模式；一个图生成器预测潜在的软边以支持冷启动节点；以及多特征融合预测器进行最终交互打分。模型以主任务损失和辅助生成器损失联合训练。
Result: 在四个基准数据集上的综合评估显示 EGRL 总体性能具有竞争力；在未知分子的冷启动设置下，达到 AUROC 0.867 和 AUPR 0.861，相比之前的最先进方法在 AUROC 上提升 8.6%、AUPR 上提升 5.0%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 EGRL 在冷启动场景下的泛化优势，并指出代码将很快发布。

papers.title: HounsWorld: A Multimodal World Model for Hidden Patient-State Readout, Reconstruction, and Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Clinical intelligence requires estimating a patient's underlying condition from incomplete observations rather than learning isolated mappings from scans to answers. Volumetric medical images provide dense observations of anatomy, attenuation, and lesions, whereas clinical language provides sparse but complementary semantic observations. We formulate CT-centered intelligence as inference over a shared latent patient state, under which readout, reconstruction, and simulation all become state-dependent prediction problems. To operationalize this view, we introduce HounsBench, a computed tomography (CT) centric patient-state benchmark that unifies these three task families with patient-disjoint splits and per-family metrics, and HounsWorld, a 3B multimodal world model that treats volumetric scans and language as observations of the shared state through Joint Understanding-Generation Learning. A shared transformer forms an implicit patient-state estimate and supports three outputs: query-conditioned answers that read out the state, reports and captions that reconstruct it in language, and condition-specific CT volumes for low-dose denoising, virtual contrast enhancement, and anatomy-constrained text-and-mask-to-volume generation. Zero-initialized CT adapters preserve pretrained multimodal mappings, while condition-explicit Hounsfield-unit window sampling exposes clinically meaningful density observations. HounsWorld shows strong performance across all three task families while consistently improving CT understanding through clinically structured completion. Our project is available at https://github.com/byhwhite/HounsWorld.git
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出以CT为中心的共享隐式患者状态推断框架，将医学影像智能统一为从体积扫描（volumetric scans）与临床语言中读取、重建和模拟三种任务。作者构建了HounsBench基准和3B参数的多模态世界模型HounsWorld，通过联合理解-生成学习（Joint Understanding-Generation Learning）使同一Transformer支持问答读取、语言报告重建以及条件CT体积生成，包括低剂量去噪、虚拟对比增强和文本/掩码到体积生成。摘要报告其在三类任务上均表现强劲，并通过临床结构化补全持续提升CT理解。
Motivation: 临床智能需要从不完整的观察中估计患者潜在状态，而非学习从扫描到答案的孤立映射；现有方法缺乏统一共享状态的推断视角。
Method: 提出HounsWorld，一个3B多模态世界模型，将体积扫描和语言视为共享状态的观测，通过零初始化CT适配器保留预训练多模态映射，并用条件明确的Hounsfield单位窗采样暴露临床有意义的密度观测；同时提出HounsBench基准，以患者不重叠划分统一三类任务。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值，仅称HounsWorld在全部三类任务族上表现强劲，并通过临床结构化补全持续改善CT理解。
Conclusion: 共享潜在患者状态下的统一推断可以同时支持读取、重建和模拟，为CT中心智能提供可行框架。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Adaptive $k$ Nearest Neighbors Classifier via Granular Ball Computing
papers.abstract_en: The $k$-Nearest Neighbor~(KNN) algorithm is widely used across various tasks. The selection of the $k$ value is a key issue because it significantly impacts performance. In this paper, an adaptive and efficient KNN approach via granular-ball computing is proposed. The method consists of two stages. \textcolor{black}{In the training stage, the dataset is first coarsely partitioned to reduce the complexity of data distributions within a granular ball, and then the Fisher criterion is introduced to control ball splitting and stopping, yielding a multi-granularity granular ball representation. In the prediction stage, the nearest granular ball is first located through a weighted distance mechanism, and an adaptive neighborhood is then constructed around the test sample. The effective $k$ value is dynamically determined by the actual number of samples contained in this neighborhood. The neighborhood induced by the nearest granular ball provides more stable local group information, thereby improving robustness against noise and local perturbations.} Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms existing KNN variants across multiple datasets in terms of both accuracy and efficiency. The code has been open-sourced for reproducibility: https://github.com/lianxiaoyu724/Adaptive-GBKNN.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于粒度球计算 (granular-ball computing) 的自适应 k 近邻分类器。训练阶段先对数据集进行粗划分以降低粒度球内数据分布的复杂度，并引入 Fisher 准则控制球的划分与停止，得到多粒度表征；预测阶段通过加权距离定位最近的粒度球，并在测试样本周围构造自适应邻域，用邻域内实际包含的样本数动态确定有效 k 值。实验显示该方法在多个数据集上较现有 KNN 变体在准确率和效率上均有提升，代码已开源。
Motivation: KNN 中 k 值的选择对性能有显著影响，是该方法的关键问题。作者希望利用粒度球计算提供更稳定的局部群组信息，从而构造自适应邻域，提升对噪声和局部扰动的鲁棒性。
Method: 方法分两阶段：训练阶段先对数据集做粗划分，并用 Fisher 准则控制粒度球的划分与停止，生成多粒度粒度球表示；预测阶段通过加权距离机制定位最近粒度球，并围绕测试样本构造自适应邻域，有效 k 值由该邻域内的实际样本数动态确定。
Result: 实验结果表明，该方法在多个数据集上的准确率和效率均优于现有 KNN 变体；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为由最近粒度球诱导的邻域能提供更稳定的局部组信息，从而提高噪声鲁棒性；代码已开源以供复现，摘要未明确说明局限。

papers.title: NaviDC-OCR: Navigating Document Parsing Across Digital and Camera-Captured Documents
papers.abstract_en: Document parsing aims to transform unstructured documents into structured and machine-readable representations. Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have significantly advanced document parsing. However, existing approaches still face two major challenges. First, decoupled VLM-based methods heavily rely on accurate layout analysis, where geometric distortions in camera-captured documents can introduce cascading errors. Second, although end-to-end VLM-based methods alleviate the dependence on explicit layout detection, they often suffer from redundant generation, hallucinations, and insufficient structural reasoning in high-resolution scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose NaviDC-OCR, a unified framework for document parsing. NaviDC-OCR introduces deformation-aware learning to incorporate geometric perception into VLMs and proposes an adaptive sampling mechanism for complex layout representation. Furthermore, a content-structure decoupled learning strategy is developed to explicitly model formula grammars and table structures, enabling more effective structured representation learning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NaviDC-OCR achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse document parsing benchmarks. It obtains overall scores of 96.87, 88.53 and 78.41 on OmniDocBench v1.6, Wild-OmniDocBench, and PureDocBench, respectively, and ranks first in the ICDAR 2026 Sci-ImageMiner Challenge. These results validate the effectiveness and generalization capability of NaviDC-OCR in complex document parsing scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NaviDC-OCR，一个面向数字文档与相机拍摄文档的统一文档解析框架，旨在将非结构化文档转换为结构化机器可读表示。该方法引入变形感知学习 (deformation-aware learning) 以把几何感知融入视觉语言模型 (VLM)，提出自适应采样机制处理复杂版面，并采用内容-结构解耦学习显式建模公式语法与表格结构。实验表明其在 OmniDocBench v1.6、Wild-OmniDocBench、PureDocBench 上分别取得 96.87、88.53、78.41 的总分，并在 ICDAR 2026 Sci-ImageMiner Challenge 中排名第一。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 文档解析方法存在两类瓶颈：解耦式方法依赖精确版面分析，相机拍摄文档的几何畸变会引发级联错误；端到端方法虽减少对显式版面检测的依赖，但在高分辨率场景下易出现冗余生成、幻觉和结构推理不足。
Method: 提出统一框架 NaviDC-OCR，包含三部分：变形感知学习以增强 VLM 的几何感知能力；自适应采样机制用于复杂版面表示；内容-结构解耦学习策略显式建模公式语法和表格结构，以提升结构化表示学习。
Result: 在多个文档解析基准上取得当前最优 (state-of-the-art) 性能：OmniDocBench v1.6 得分 96.87，Wild-OmniDocBench 得分 88.53，PureDocBench 得分 78.41，并在 ICDAR 2026 Sci-ImageMiner Challenge 中排名第一。
Conclusion: 作者认为结果验证了 NaviDC-OCR 在复杂文档解析场景中的有效性与泛化能力，尤其是对相机拍摄文档的几何失真和复杂结构化内容具有鲁棒性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Agent Behavioral Contracts II: Certifying Compositional Reliability Without Assuming Independence
papers.abstract_en: Compositional reliability bounds for multi-agent systems multiply component reliabilities, a step licensed by a conditional-independence assumption that is routinely stated and rarely tested. We test it. Two instances of one model, in a two-agent handoff, co-fail on 90.0% of the missions on which either fails (log OR 6.66, 95% CI [6.38, 7.00]; phi 0.916), in a preregistered evaluation of 18,000 missions scored by deterministic code with no LLM judge. Substituting a different model reduces the association in six of six contrasts; substituting a different vendor, model already different, does not -- a registered hypothesis reported as a null. The error is signed and runs against the operator: positive dependence inflates joint failure above the independence product, so redundancy is over-credited exactly when components share a model. The assumption-free alternative is often vacuous, and fitting a dependence model is worse: we prove a bootstrap bound on a fitted model's functional loses coverage of the truth as n grows, the identification gap being O(1) while the bootstrap haircut is O(n^{-1/2}). More data makes such a certificate worse, with no visible symptom. We give a finite-sample certificate assuming no dependence structure: a linear program over the joint, over a Bonferroni-Clopper-Pearson box around measured co-execution moments. It is sound, sharp for the information supplied, and monotone in the moment family. Enriching ten moment functionals to fourteen narrows the identified interval by 85.7% and lifts the certified floor from 0.2455 to 0.4116. A companion anytime-valid certificate holds type-I error at 0.0471 under optional stopping. Common dependence statistics are marginal-bounded and can reverse an apparent ordering of conditions when the compared agents fail at different rates. Contracts, scoring code, analysis scripts, and the preregistration are released.
papers.comment: 49 pages, 12 tables, 25 numbered definitions, 18 theorems with full proofs, six experiments, 65 references. Code, analysis scripts, and preregistration: https://github.com/qualixar/agentassert-abc
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文检验多智能体系统组合可靠性中常规假设的组件条件独立性。通过预注册的18,000次任务（确定性代码评分，无LLM裁判）发现，同一模型的两个实例在双智能体交接中，在任一失败的任务上有90.0%共同失败（log OR 6.66，phi 0.916），说明独立性假设严重高估冗余收益。作者提出不假设依赖结构的有限样本证书——基于Bonferroni-Clopper-Pearson盒的线性规划，以及伴随的anytime-valid证书，并证明拟合依赖模型的bootstrap界随n增长失去对真实值的覆盖。
Motivation: 多智能体系统的组合可靠性界通常将组件可靠性相乘，这一步骤依赖条件独立性假设，但该假设常被陈述而很少被检验。实际中共享模型的组件可能共同失败，导致冗余被过度信任，且误差方向对操作者不利。
Method: 给出两种不依赖独立性假设的证书：一是有限样本证书，将联合分布的识别区间建模为线性规划，约束来自围绕测得共执行矩的Bonferroni-Clopper-Pearson盒；二是伴随的anytime-valid证书，在可选停止下控制第一类错误。理论上证明拟合依赖模型的bootstrap界覆盖概率随n增加而下降，识别间隙为O(1)而bootstrap衰减为O(n^{-1/2})。
Result: 预注册实验中同模型双实例的共败关联为log OR 6.66（95% CI [6.38, 7.00]），phi 0.916；更换模型在六个对比中均降低关联，而更换厂商（模型已不同）未降低，该注册假设以null报告。将矩函数从10个增至14个后，识别区间收窄85.7%，认证下限从0.2455升至0.4116；anytime-valid证书在可选停止下第一类错误为0.0471。
Conclusion: 公共依赖统计量受边际界约束，当比较的智能体失败率不同时可能逆转条件排序。论文强调不要盲目拟合依赖模型，并提供了一种既健全又可随信息量单调收紧的假设自由证书；相关契约、评分代码、分析脚本和预注册均已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Predictive Memory Localization: Forecasting Selective Intervention Paths from Internal Signals
papers.abstract_en: Activation steering turns localized representations into control directions, but localization alone does not reveal whether a direction has a selective operating regime. We introduce Predictive Memory Localization (PML), which treats the measured-grid intervention path as the predictive object of memory localization. PML separates random-calibrated target movement from semantic-neighbor and capability damage, and compares static localization and supervised geometry with a strength-disjoint low-dose causal response. Our frozen study covers 3,000 records from nine datasets and fourteen domains, yielding 30,000 distinct record-direction-layer paths and 210,000 distinct path-strength evaluations. At layer 7, the geometry-derived RFM/AGOP direction reaches 13.1% target-any and 12.3% clean-any, exceeding random by 3.6 and 3.4 percentage points under a record-paired bootstrap. Across record-, dataset-, and domain-grouped splits, responses at $|α|=0.1$ are the strongest signal for outcomes at disjoint strengths $|α|\in\{0.25,0.5\}$. On held-out records, a predictor-driven selector chooses a coefficient or abstains, improves utility and reduces semantic-neighbor damage relative to a train-tuned fixed-strength policy, and avoids most evaluations in a dense scan. Across three residual-norm-matched base models, learned directions retain selective-path gains and low-dose responses yield 0.801-0.828 record-held-out macro AUROC. PML therefore turns memory localization into a falsifiable forecast of margin-level selective outcomes and a risk-aware intervention decision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出预测性记忆定位 (Predictive Memory Localization, PML)，把干预路径的测量网格当作记忆定位的预测对象，用低剂量因果响应 (low-dose causal response) 来预测选择性干预结果。冻结模型研究覆盖九个数据集、十四个领域的 3,000 条记录，得到 30,000 条记录-方向-层路径和 210,000 条路径-强度评估。结果显示几何派生的 RFM/AGOP 方向在层 7 超过随机基线，且低剂量响应在留出记录、数据集和领域分组下都是更强信号的来源；基于预测器的选择器可提高效用、减少语义邻近损伤并避免密集扫描的大部分评估。
Motivation: 激活引导 (activation steering) 能把局部化表示变成控制方向，但仅靠定位无法判断某个方向是否存在选择性工作区间；需要可验证地预测干预路径的边际级选择性结果，而不仅仅是定位记忆。
Method: PML 将测量网格上的干预路径作为预测目标，分离随机标定的目标移动与语义邻近/能力损伤，比较静态定位和受监督几何在强度不相交 (strength-disjoint) 的低剂量因果响应下的表现；并用预测器驱动的选择器在持有系数与弃权之间决策。
Result: 在层 7，RFM/AGOP 方向达到 13.1% target-any 和 12.3% clean-any，比随机高 3.6 和 3.4 个百分点；在记录、数据集和领域分组划分下，|α|=0.1 的响应是 |α|∈{0.25,0.5} 不相交强度结果的最强信号。相比训练调参的固定强度策略，预测器选择器提高效用并减少语义邻近损伤；在三个残差范数匹配的基座模型上，低剂量响应取得 0.801-0.828 的留出记录宏 AUROC。
Conclusion: PML 把记忆定位转化为对边际级选择性结果的可证伪预测，并支持风险感知的干预决策；摘要强调该方法能保留选择性路径增益并减少密集扫描中的评估成本。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Distinguishing case-mix from context heterogeneity in prognostic regression model synthesis settings
papers.abstract_en: Prognostic regression models often synthesize data from multiple sites, whether within a multi-site study, across federated settings, or in individual participant data meta-analysis. Here, a site is any data source, such as a hospital, registry, trial, or study, and need not be a physical center. Analysts must then decide whether one regression model represents all sites or whether site-specific models are needed. Established measures such as coefficient-level tau^2 quantify heterogeneity but do not distinguish its source. We focus on diagnosing whether coefficient heterogeneity reflects case-mix or site-specific context effects. Case-mix heterogeneity can arise when linear regression terms approximate multivariable non-linear relationships in populations with different covariate distributions. Contextual heterogeneity arises when comparable patients require different regression relationships across sites. We do this by fitting site-specific local regressions in a dimension-reduced space and partitioning the smoothed coefficient surfaces into a cross-site reference and site-specific deviations. An autoencoder and custom loss structure the latent space around local prognostic relationships. We then project this partition onto the outcome scale to derive observation- and site-level summaries. We demonstrate the approach on a COPD trial with two sites. In the three leading latent slope coordinates, coefficient-surface variation was predominantly contextual. The derived observation-level outcome-scale variance partition was case-mix-leading, whereas its between-site aggregation was concentrated in contextual differences rather than case-mix shifts. A permuted-site negative control assesses whether the contextual summary can arise when site labels carry no signal. This diagnostic distinction can inform whether joint or site-specific regression models should be evaluated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多中心预后回归模型合成中系数异质性的来源诊断问题，提出将 case-mix 异质性与情境异质性（contextual heterogeneity）区分开来的框架。作者在降维空间中拟合站点特异局部回归，用带自定义损失的 autoencoder 构建潜在空间，再对平滑后的系数曲面做“跨站点参考 + 站点特异偏差”的分解，并把分解投影到结局尺度上生成观测级和站点级汇总。方法在含两个站点的 COPD 试验中展示：三个主要潜在斜率坐标上系数曲面变异以情境性为主，而观测级结局尺度方差分解以 case-mix 为主，站点间聚合则集中于情境差异。
Motivation: 当多个站点（医院、登记库、试验等）的数据被合并用于拟合预后回归模型时，分析者需要判断单一联合模型是否足够，还是需要站点特异模型。已有度量如 tau^2 能刻画系数异质性但无法区分其来源，而 case-mix（协变量分布差异与非线性近似的交互）与站点情境效应在建模决策上含义不同，因此需要一个诊断工具来区分二者。
Method: 在降维空间中拟合站点特异局部回归，利用 autoencoder 加自定义损失把潜在空间组织为局部预后关系；随后将平滑的系数曲面划分为跨站点参考部分和站点特异偏差，并将该划分投影到结局尺度，得到观测级与站点级汇总。另设一个标签置换的阴性对照（permuted-site negative control）来检验情境汇总是否可能在没有站点信号时出现。
Result: 在包含两个站点的 COPD 试验中，三个主要潜在斜率坐标上的系数曲面变异主要呈情境性；观测层面的结局尺度方差分解以 case-mix 为主，而站点间聚合则集中在情境差异而非 case-mix 漂移上。
Conclusion: 该诊断性区分可帮助分析者判断应当评估联合回归模型还是站点特异回归模型；作者强调其方法在（两站点）COPD 试验上得到了演示。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Labels Are Not Endpoints: Treatment Leakage and Construct Validity in MCP Agent Security Evaluation
authors: Rana Muhammad Ahmed (Department of Computer Science
papers.abstract_en: Security evaluations of tool-using agents often equate stored labels with behavioral facts. We audit a preserved campaign by tracing 10,200 execution rows to 180 model-bound requests, 45 semantic requests, and 15 observable stimuli. Two schema treatments were delivered, but the planned external payload-family corpus was not. The historical grader exhibited direct treatment leakage: treatment metadata gated the ATTACK_SUCCESS class, so fixed behavior could change class under treatment relabeling. A treatment-blind reconstruction corrects 58 historical ATTACK_SUCCESS or HIJACK_ATTEMPT labels to authorized benign completions while preserving three verified protected-data transfers and one separate unauthorized-forwarding case. The locked v2 census contains exactly zero ATTACK_SUCCESS records, while the forwarding case remains a HIJACK_ATTEMPT at a semantic boundary concerning objective completion. A dual-reviewer blinded concordance review of all 96 requests deemed structurally interpretable by locked v2 produced identical reviewer-consensus classes but differed from the locked codebook on four construct-boundary cases. We contribute a seven-link Integrity Chain and an executable, scope-bounded endpoint-integrity linter. The result is a campaign-bounded measurement audit, not a population attack-rate, model-ranking, defense-efficacy, or causal estimate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对一次已归档的 MCP（Model Context Protocol）智能体安全评估活动进行审计，将 10,200 条执行记录追溯到 180 个模型绑定请求、45 个语义请求和 15 个可观察刺激。作者发现历史评分器存在直接的治疗泄漏（treatment leakage），即治疗元数据门控了 ATTACK_SUCCESS 类别，导致固定行为在治疗重标定下可能改变类别。治疗盲重建修正了 58 个历史 ATTACK_SUCCESS 或 HIJACK_ATTEMPT 标签为授权良性完成，同时保留三个受保护数据传输和一个未授权转发案例。文章贡献七链路完整性链（seven-link Integrity Chain）和一个可执行的、范围受限的端点完整性 linter，并明确将其定位为战役范围的测量审计。
Motivation: 工具使用型智能体的安全评估常把存储的标签当作行为事实，但标签生成过程中的治疗泄漏会破坏构念效度（construct validity），进而扭曲对攻击率、模型排名和防御有效性的判断。
Method: 作者采用追溯式审计，将执行行映射到请求和刺激；提出治疗盲重建（treatment-blind reconstruction）修正历史标签；并引入七链路完整性链与范围受限的端点完整性 linter，配合双审阅者盲法一致性审查。
Result: 治疗盲重建将 58 个历史 ATTACK_SUCCESS 或 HIJACK_ATTEMPT 标签纠正为授权良性完成，同时保留三个受保护数据传输与一个未授权转发案例；锁定 v2 普查中 ATTACK_SUCCESS 记录为零，转发案例在目标完成语义边界上仍为 HIJACK_ATTEMPT；对 96 个请求的双审阅者盲法审查产生一致的共识类别，但在四个构念边界案例上与锁定 codebook 不一致。
Conclusion: 作者强调该结果是战役范围（campaign-bounded）的测量审计，而非总体攻击率、模型排名、防御有效性或因果估计，结论解释应限于该评估活动本身。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 治疗盲重建将 58 个历史 ATTACK_SUCCESS 或 HIJACK_ATTEMPT 标签纠正为授权良性完成，同时保留三个受保护数据传输与一个未授权转发案例；锁定 v2 普查中 ATTACK_SUCCESS 记录为零，转发案例在目标完成语义边界上仍为 HIJACK_ATTEMPT；对 96 个请求的双审阅者盲法审查产生一致的共识类别，但在四个构念边界案例上与锁定 codebook 不一致。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调该结果是战役范围（campaign-bounded）的测量审计，而非总体攻击率、模型排名、防御有效性或因果估计，结论解释应限于该评估活动本身。

papers.title: Robust data-driven discovery of fractional differential equations via weak formulations and Pareto-based subset selection
papers.abstract_en: Fractional partial differential equations describe nonlocal dynamics, but discovering them from noisy data is difficult because fractional differentiation amplifies high-frequency measurement noise and the derivative orders are unknown. We propose Weak-Pareto, which combines an adjoint-consistent weak formulation of fractional terms with Pareto-based subset selection over discrete term types and continuous fractional orders. For linear right-hand-side terms, the adjoint transfers fractional operators from measured fields to smooth test functions, replacing noise-sensitive pointwise differentiation with smoothing integration; for nonlinear terms, the noise-suppression effect is partial yet useful. Coefficients are fitted by ridge regression within a branch-aware differential-evolution search over the orders. The support size is then selected at the validation-error-complexity elbow. We show that the variance of fixed linear right-hand-side weak features vanishes under grid refinement, whereas noise amplification in pointwise fractional features increases with derivative order. Across fractional advection-diffusion, reaction-diffusion, and Burgers benchmarks, Weak-Pareto recovers parsimonious structures from clean and noisy measurements. In controlled advection-diffusion and Burgers comparisons, it retains the correct support at every tested multiplicative-noise level, whereas the unregularised strong-form counterpart largely fails once noise is introduced; this advantage persists under additive Gaussian noise. Ablations show that the weak library drives noise robustness and that continuous-order Pareto search avoids the support-selection failure of a dense fixed dictionary. On the advection-diffusion benchmark, Weak-Pareto yields more consistent operator recovery and substantially lower measured runtime than a contemporary neural baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Weak-Pareto，将分数阶偏微分方程（fractional PDE）的伴随一致弱形式（adjoint-consistent weak formulation）与 Pareto 子集选择结合，从含噪数据中发现分数阶动力学方程。弱形式把分数阶算子转移到光滑测试函数上，用平滑积分替代对测量场的逐点微分，从而抑制噪声放大；系数由岭回归拟合，分数阶阶数通过分支感知的差分进化搜索优化。在分数阶对流扩散、反应扩散和 Burgers 基准上，该方法能从干净和含噪测量中恢复精简结构。
Motivation: 从噪声数据中发现分数阶偏微分方程很困难，因为分数阶微分会放大高频测量噪声，且微分阶数未知；传统的逐点强形式方法在引入噪声后容易失效。
Method: 提出 Weak-Pareto：对线性右端项使用伴随一致的弱形式，将分数阶算子作用到光滑测试函数上；对非线性项则获得部分但仍然有用的噪声抑制。系数用岭回归拟合，并在分支感知的差分进化搜索（branch-aware differential-evolution search）中优化连续分数阶阶数，随后在验证误差与复杂度曲线的肘部选择支持集大小。
Result: 摘要表明，线性固定右端项的弱特征方差在网格细化下消失，而逐点分数阶特征的噪声放大随导数阶数增加。在分数阶对流扩散、反应扩散和 Burgers 基准上，Weak-Pareto 能从干净和含噪数据中恢复精简结构；在受控对流扩散和 Burgers 对比中，它在每个测试的乘法噪声水平下都保留正确支持集，而未正则化的强形式对应方法在引入噪声后基本失败，该优势在加性高斯噪声下依然存在。消融显示弱库是噪声鲁棒性的关键，连续阶 Pareto 搜索避免了稠密固定字典的支持集选择失败。在对流扩散基准上，Weak-Pareto 比当代神经基线获得更一致的算子恢复和显著更低的运行时间。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将弱形式库与基于 Pareto 的连续阶选择相结合，可以显著改善分数阶 PDE 发现对噪声的鲁棒性；不过非线性项的噪声抑制只是部分的，且实验验证限于摘要中列出的几类基准。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ReflectFact: Self-Reflective Agents for Improving Comprehension and Reasoning in Multi-Hop Fact Verification
papers.abstract_en: Multi-hop fact verification, which verifies claims by reasoning over multiple pieces of evidence, is critical for combating misinformation on social media yet remains highly challenging. Recent methods primarily rely on multi-agent collaboration to decompose fact verification into specialized subtasks. However, these methods face two critical limitations: (1) agents may perform individual subtasks without sufficient awareness of the global verification objective, causing their reasoning to deviate from the intended direction; and (2) conflicts between parametric knowledge and the provided evidence may undermine evidence-grounded reasoning and lead to incorrect verdicts. To address these challenges, we propose ReflectFact, a novel self-reflective agent framework for multi-hop fact verification. ReflectFact introduces three key tasks. Explicit Reasoning Path Planning builds an evidence-grounded reasoning path by resolving implicit entities, decomposing the claim into sub-questions, and integrating the verified facts into a verdict. Evidence-Drift Verification makes the agent re-answer by quoting the supporting evidence when a grounded answer merely echoes its parametric prior, thereby calibrating evidence deviation to ensure grounded comprehension. Reasoning Reflection Verification re-examines each reasoning step and regenerates it once an inconsistency is detected, correcting reasoning flaws such as location bias and replacement bias through a global task perspective. Subsequently, the agent aggregates validated reasoning chains to yield reliable verdicts. Extensive experiments on HOVER and EX-FEVER demonstrate that ReflectFact effectively remedies the comprehension and reasoning defects of existing methods, achieving state-of-the-art performance and respectively outperforming the strongest baseline by 3.32\% and 2.78\% on the two datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReflectFact，一个面向多跳事实验证 (multi-hop fact verification) 的自反思智能体框架。框架引入显式推理路径规划、证据漂移验证和推理反思验证三个关键任务，以修正智能体偏离全局验证目标、以及参数知识与给定证据冲突导致的问题。在 HOVER 和 EX-FEVER 两个数据集上达到当前最优，分别比最强基线提升 3.32% 和 2.78%。
Motivation: 现有方法主要依赖多智能体协作将事实验证分解为专门子任务，但存在两个关键局限：智能体执行子任务时缺乏对全局验证目标的意识，导致推理偏离预期方向；参数化知识与给定证据之间的冲突可能破坏基于证据的推理并导致错误判定。
Method: ReflectFact 引入三个关键任务：Explicit Reasoning Path Planning 通过解析隐式实体、将声明分解为子问题并整合已验证事实来构建证据接地 (evidence-grounded) 的推理路径；Evidence-Drift Verification 在接地答案仅呼应参数先验时让智能体引用支持证据重新作答，校准证据偏差；Reasoning Reflection Verification 从全局任务视角重新检查每一步推理并在发现不一致时重新生成，修正位置偏差和替换偏差等推理缺陷。最后智能体聚合验证过的推理链以产生可靠判定。
Result: 在 HOVER 和 EX-FEVER 上的广泛实验表明，ReflectFact 有效修复了现有方法的理解与推理缺陷，达到最先进性能，并分别比最强基线提升 3.32% 和 2.78%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过显式推理路径规划、证据漂移校准与推理反思组成的自我反思机制，可以改善多跳事实验证中的证据接地理解与推理可靠性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SPARED: Reasoning-Based AI-Generated Image Detection via Adversarially Edited Data
papers.abstract_en: Detecting AI-generated images is only half the task: a deployed detector must also justify its verdict, yet existing detectors inherit three failure modes from their training data: real and fake images collected from different sources invite provenance shortcuts, supervised explanation corpora teach templated rationales, and a static forgery corpus leaves the decision boundary standing still while generators keep moving. We introduce \methodname{}, an adversarial reinforcement learning framework that pits two heterogeneous models against each other. A diffusion image editor learns to edit real photographs into fake counterparts of those same photographs that fool the current detector, while a reasoning MLLM learns to expose them with a verdict grounded in free-form reasoning. Both rewards are shortcut-proof by design: the attacker is credited only when its edit is faithfully executed, and the defender only when its verdict is correct. As the two models alternate, each round's attacker regenerates a harder training pool aimed at the current detector's blind spots, so the detector must generalize rather than memorize any fixed artifact distribution. Although the explanation is never rewarded, its quality rises round over round as a side effect of accuracy-only training. A detector trained within this loop improves monotonically across rounds on each of three external benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SPARED，一种基于对抗强化学习的 AI 生成图像检测框架，目标不仅是判断真假，还要给出基于自由形式推理的裁决。框架中，扩散图像编辑器将真实照片编辑成能欺骗当前检测器的伪造版本，而推理型多模态大语言模型 (reasoning MLLM) 则学习用推理揭露这些伪造图像。两者交替对抗，攻击者每轮针对当前检测器的盲点生成更难训练的样本，使检测器必须泛化而非记忆固定伪造分布；摘要报告检测器在三个外部基准上随轮次单调提升，且解释质量在仅以正确率为奖励的训练中作为副产物不断上升。
Motivation: 现有 AI 生成图像检测器存在三个来自训练数据的失败模式：真实与伪造图像来自不同数据源导致来源捷径 (provenance shortcuts)、监督式解释语料教会模板化理由、静态伪造语料使决策边界在生成器不断更新时停滞。检测器不仅需要检测，还必须为其判断提供可辩护的理由。
Method: 提出对抗强化学习框架 SPARED，让两个异构模型相互对抗：扩散图像编辑器学习把真实照片编辑成能骗过当前检测器的伪造版本，推理 MLLM 学习以自由形式推理给出正确判决。两种奖励都被设计为防捷径：攻击者仅在其编辑被忠实执行时获得奖励，防御者仅在其判决正确时获得奖励；随轮次交替，攻击者重新生成针对当前检测器盲点的训练池。
Result: 摘要报告，在该循环中训练的检测器在三个外部基准上随训练轮次单调提升；虽然推理解释从未被直接奖励，其质量也随轮次上升。
Conclusion: 作者认为，通过让攻击者每轮针对当前盲点重新生成训练池，并采用防捷径奖励设计，可以使检测器不断泛化而非记忆固定伪影分布，同时获得质量逐步提升的自由形式推理解释。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Sustaining Plasticity via Learnable Wavelet Activations in Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Plasticity loss has emerged as a critical challenge in continual learning that significantly hinders the acquisition of sequential tasks. While optimizing activation designs offers a potential solution, current fixed-form functions suffer from an inherent spectral bias towards low-frequency variations, whereas learnable variants permit unconstrained updates that induce catastrophic forgetting. To address these limitations, we propose a novel learnable wavelet activation that decomposes the activation function into low-frequency and high-frequency components to explicitly counter spectral bias. Furthermore, we employ dynamic wavelet injection to adaptively enhance plasticity for new tasks, alongside a regularization strategy to ensure the stability of previous learned knowledge. Theoretically, we provide rigorous mathematical guarantees for the proposed framework, proving the structural necessity of the hybrid wavelet architecture for efficient $L^2$ approximation and demonstrating that the decoupled learning rate mechanism successfully restores network plasticity for high-frequency information. Additionally, we provide a formal derivation of the loss-driven injection trigger mechanism to precisely guide the injection. Extensive empirical evaluations demonstrate that our approach maintains superior trainability and generalization throughout the learning process and achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse continual learning benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对持续学习中的可塑性损失问题，提出一种可学习小波激活函数，将激活分解为低频和高频分量以对抗频谱偏差，并通过动态小波注入与正则化策略在保持旧知识稳定性的同时增强新任务的可塑性。理论部分给出混合小波结构在 L^2 逼近中的必要性证明，以及解耦学习率机制恢复高频信息可塑性的保证；实验在多个持续学习基准上达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 持续学习中可塑性损失严重阻碍顺序任务的学习，现有固定形式激活函数存在偏向低频变化的频谱偏差，而可学习变体因无约束更新容易引发灾难性遗忘。
Method: 提出可学习小波激活 (learnable wavelet activation)，将激活函数分解为低频与高频分量以显式对抗频谱偏差；采用动态小波注入自适应增强新任务可塑性，并结合正则化策略维持旧知识稳定；还形式化推导了损失驱动注入触发机制。
Result: 理论证明混合小波架构对高效 L^2 逼近的结构必要性，并证明解耦学习率机制能恢复网络对高频信息的可塑性；实验表明该方法在训练性与泛化性上均保持优势，并在多个持续学习基准上取得最先进性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架从频谱角度同时处理可塑性与稳定性，可为持续学习中的激活设计提供新思路。

papers.title: A Compositional Theory of Curvature in Probabilistic Circuits
papers.abstract_en: Probabilistic Circuits (PCs) are generative models that support exact inference and, unlike deep neural networks, admit an exact and tractable measure of loss-surface curvature: the trace of the Hessian of the log-likelihood. Recent work regularizes this trace globally to bias learning toward flatter, better generalizing optima. We show that treating sharpness as a global regularizer can be misspecified for PCs, whose curvature is inherently compositional. We prove that each sum node's contribution to the Hessian trace factorizes exactly into its circuit flow, which measures how heavily the node is used, and a local sharpness term determined by its output distribution. This decomposition provides insights into why global sharpness regularization is depth biased and can lead to underfitting. Building on it, we introduce an adaptive sharpness aware regularizer that penalizes nodes based on intrinsic local curvature and preserves closed form EM updates. We also show that empirically, this targeted regularization recovers the generalization that global regularization sacrifices while retaining the robustness and benefits of sharpness aware learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出概率电路 (Probabilistic Circuits) 中损失曲面曲率的组合性理论。作者证明每个 sum 节点对 Hessian trace 的贡献可精确分解为其 circuit flow（衡量该节点被使用的程度）与由输出分布决定的局部 sharpness 项的乘积，并指出全局 sharpness 正则化存在深度偏差并可能导致欠拟合。基于该分解，作者引入自适应 sharpness aware 正则化器，按节点内在局部曲率进行惩罚，同时保持闭式 EM 更新。
Motivation: 现有工作对 log-likelihood 的 Hessian trace 做全局正则化，以偏向更平坦、泛化更好的最优解；但对 PC 而言曲率本质上是组合的，把 sharpness 当作全局正则化项是 misspecified 的，会造成深度偏差和欠拟合。
Method: 先证明每个 sum 节点对 Hessian trace 的贡献精确分解为 circuit flow 与局部 sharpness 项的乘积；再基于该分解设计自适应 sharpness aware 正则化器，按节点内在局部曲率施加惩罚，并保留闭式 EM 更新形式。
Result: 实验表明，这种针对性的正则化恢复了全局正则化所牺牲的泛化性能，同时保留了 sharpness aware 学习的鲁棒性和收益。
Conclusion: 摘要强调全局 sharpness 正则化对 PC 不是合适设定，组合性分解解释了其局限；新的局部正则化器在保持 EM 闭式更新的同时改善泛化。摘要未提及方法局限。

papers.title: Discovering Persistent Behavioural Patterns for Interpretable Blockchain Forensics
papers.abstract_en: Public blockchain data enables large-scale DeFi-related analysis, but many existing approaches are application-specific, difficult to scale, or hard to interpret. This research proposes a scalable, application-agnostic framework for \emph{persistent behavioural pattern discovery} from large-scale blockchain activity. It constructs behaviour sentences enriched with contract, token and market context, then applies a two-step embedding process: sentence-level embeddings capture individual actions, while sequence-level embeddings capture user behaviour over time. An interpretable behavioural profiler characterizes discovered communities through behavioural motifs, routines, temporal dynamics, entity exposure, and suspiciousness evidence. Evaluation on Ethereum using over 30 million transactions shows that the framework uncovers both routine and malicious behavioural patterns, including decentralised exchange (DEX) trading, NFT activity, phishing, bot operations, oracle manipulation, and rug-pull schemes. Importantly, many patterns remain stable across independent observation windows, enabling the identification of long-term behaviours beyond a single analysis period. The proposed framework combines scalability, interpretability, and persistence analysis, supporting blockchain forensic investigation, behavioural attribution, and threat discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个可扩展且与应用无关的框架，用于从大规模区块链活动中发现持久行为模式 (persistent behavioural pattern)。它构造融入合约、代币与市场上下文的“行为句”，再通过句子级和序列级两阶段嵌入来刻画用户行为，并用可解释的行为画像器描述社区的动机、常规、时间动态、实体暴露与可疑证据。在以太坊超过 3000 万笔交易上的评估显示，该方法能同时发现常规与恶意行为模式，且许多模式在独立观察窗口间保持稳定。
Motivation: 现有基于公共区块链数据的 DeFi 分析方法多针对特定应用，难以扩展或不易解释，缺乏一个可规模化且可解释的通用分析框架。
Method: 构建包含合约、代币与市场上下文的行为句，并采用两步嵌入过程：句子级嵌入捕获单个动作，序列级嵌入捕获用户随时间的整体行为；随后通过可解释行为画像器 (interpretable behavioural profiler) 用行为动机、常规、时间动态、实体暴露与可疑性证据来描述社区。
Result: 在以太坊上使用超过 3000 万笔交易进行评估，框架发现了常规与恶意行为模式，包括 DEX 交易、NFT 活动、钓鱼、机器人操作、预言机操纵和 rug-pull 骗局；许多模式在独立观察窗口间保持稳定，可用于识别长期行为。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架兼具可扩展性、可解释性和持久性分析能力，可支持区块链取证调查、行为归因与威胁发现。

papers.title: AI and Consumer Rights in India Working Paper
papers.abstract_en: As AI systems proliferate in consumer facing applications, questions about liability for AI related harms remain unresolved. This working paper examines whether India's Consumer Protection Act, 2019, adequately addresses harm caused by defective AI products and services, and whether it proportionately allocates liability across the AI value chain. The Act's broad definitions of product liability, harm, and deficiency appear technology agnostic and potentially applicable to AI related incidents including personal injury, psychological harm, biased outputs, and loss of control. However, significant gaps remain. Proving causation between AI defects and consumer harm presents a technical challenge, as AI failures often stem from design choices rather than discrete defects. Additionally, the Act's framework assumes distinct roles for manufacturers, sellers, and service providers, yet the AI value chain involves overlapping responsibilities among data providers, model developers, deployers, and users that do not neatly map to these categories. Current liability frameworks lack proportionate mechanisms to effectively address complex, multistakeholder AI harms. While the Act may cover AI entities, enforcement requires clarification on sector specific overlaps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一份工作论文，考察印度《2019年消费者保护法》能否适用于缺陷AI产品和服务造成的损害，以及能否在AI价值链上按比例分配责任。摘要指出该法的产品责任、损害和缺陷定义看似技术无关，可能适用于人身伤害、心理伤害、偏见输出和失控等AI相关事件，但证明因果关系存在技术难题，且AI价值链中数据提供者、模型开发者、部署者和用户的交叉责任无法映射到该法假设的制造商、销售者和服务提供者角色。
Motivation: AI系统在面向消费者的应用中迅速普及，而AI相关损害的归责问题仍悬而未决；论文针对印度现行消费者保护法律框架能否妥善处理缺陷AI产品和服务这一问题。
Method: 这是一份法律分析工作论文，通过审视印度《2019年消费者保护法》中产品责任、损害和缺陷的定义，并对照AI价值链中数据提供者、模型开发者、部署者和用户等多方责任重叠的现实，评估该法的适用性与责任分配充分性。
Result: 摘要指出该法可能覆盖AI实体，但其责任框架缺乏按比例处理复杂多方AI损害的有效机制，且证明AI缺陷与消费者损害之间的因果关系面临技术挑战，执行时还需澄清行业特定重叠。
Conclusion: 论文强调现行责任框架不足以应对多利益相关方的复杂AI损害，尽管该法可能适用于AI实体，仍需在执法和行业特定重叠方面加以澄清。

papers.title: BrainWAM: Action-Space Coordination of Semantic Priors and Predictive Dynamics for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous driving requires planning under both semantic constraints and predictive dynamics. Existing end-to-end driving approaches, however, typically emphasize only one side of this requirement: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models exploit VLM priors for semantic reasoning, while World Action Models (WAMs) provide future-aware prediction through generative world modeling. This naturally motivates a unified planner that can leverage both semantic priors and predictive dynamics. However, we find that a naive combination through joint token-level attention suffers from an attention-allocation mismatch, where semantic shortcuts dominate the shared attention space and suppress predictive dynamics. Inspired by neuroscience evidence that complex behavior arises from coordination among functionally specialized systems, we propose BrainWAM, a structured action-space coordination framework that converts semantic reasoning and predictive world modeling into two specialized action-oriented pathways, and aligns them at the level of compact action representations. We further introduce an asynchronous rectified-flow inference strategy with decoupled video and action denoising, which shortens inference latency while preserving planning-relevant predictive context. BrainWAM reaches state-of-the-art performance on both NAVSIM v1 (89.5 PDMS) and NAVSIM v2 (89.6 EPDMS), consistently outperforming VLA-only or WAM-only methods, highlighting BrainWAM as a practical and promising direction for autonomous driving systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BrainWAM，一个面向自动驾驶规划的结构化动作空间协调框架，将视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的语义先验与 World Action Model（WAM）的预测动力学统一到两条专用动作导向通路中，并在紧凑动作表示层面进行对齐。作者发现朴素联合 token 级注意力存在语义捷径压制预测动力学的分配失配问题，因此采用异步整流流（rectified-flow）推理，将视频与动作去噪解耦以缩短推理延迟。在 NAVSIM v1 上达到 89.5 PDMS，在 NAVSIM v2 上达到 89.6 EPDMS，优于仅用 VLA 或仅用 WAM 的方法。
Motivation: 现有端到端自动驾驶方法通常只侧重语义约束或预测动力学之一：VLA 模型利用 VLM 先验做语义推理，WAM 通过生成式世界建模提供未来感知预测，缺乏同时利用两者的统一规划器；而简单的联合 token 级注意力会因语义捷径主导共享注意力空间而抑制预测动力学。
Method: 提出 BrainWAM，将语义推理与预测世界建模转化为两个专用动作导向通路，并在紧凑动作表示层面进行对齐，以避免注意力分配失配。推理阶段引入异步整流流策略，将视频去噪与动作去噪解耦，从而缩短推理延迟并保留规划相关的预测上下文。
Result: 在 NAVSIM v1 上取得 89.5 PDMS，在 NAVSIM v2 上取得 89.6 EPDMS，达到最先进性能，并一致优于仅 VLA 或仅 WAM 的基线方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调动作空间的系统化协调能够同时发挥语义先验与预测动力学的作用，是自动驾驶规划中有前景的实用方向。

papers.title: Falsehood and Impossibility Are Different Directions in an AI's Representation of Language
papers.abstract_en: Language can describe states of affairs that are false and states of affairs that could not be the case at all. Whether an AI model internally distinguishes these failures remains unclear. I report an exploratory activation study of the multimodal open-weight model Gemma 3 4B IT using 85 prompts from 17 philosophical families and a topic-matched modality set of 15 topics, each expressed as a truth, contingent falsehood, improbable claim, semantic anomaly, and necessary falsehood. In its answers, the model conflates contingent falsehood with contradiction, labeling 12 of 15 false statements "contradiction." Its activations show a different pattern. A linear truth probe separates impossible from true statements (AUC 0.93) but not impossible from false statements (AUC 0.20). An impossibility probe evaluated on held-out topic families separates necessary from contingent falsehood at AUC 1.00, peaking at layer 15 with balanced accuracy 0.97 (Bonferroni-adjusted P=0.018). The truth and impossibility directions are close to orthogonal, whereas the impossibility direction partially overlaps a semantic anomaly direction while remaining distinguishable from it. Sparse autoencoder features at the same layer repeat this geometry. Features selective for impossibility also fire on anomalous sentences but rarely on contingent falsehoods. In this model's activation space, necessary falsehoods are not extreme cases of contingent falsehood but lie closer to the experimentally defined category of semantic anomaly. This representational proximity does not imply that impossible statements are intrinsically meaningless. These correlational observations from one small model offer an empirical footnote to an old philosophical distinction.

Method: 对 Gemma 3 4B IT 进行探索性激活研究，构建 85 个来自 17 个哲学家族的提示，以及 15 个话题的话题匹配模态集，每个主题表达为真、偶然虚假、不可能声称、语义异常和必然虚假五种变体；训练线性真值探针和不可能探针，在留出主题家族上评估，并用稀疏自编码器特征检查表征几何。

papers.title: Practice Makes Unsafe: Skill Misevolution in Self-Improving LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Self-improving LLM agents convert successful trajectories into persistent cross-task state. An unsafe success can thereby become reusable policy after its triggering input disappears. Skill evolution makes this failure measurable by distilling operational trajectories into executable, transferable, and inspectable procedures. Because evolution optimizes task outcomes rather than procedure safety, compromised experience can cause skill misevolution. Existing benchmarks measure current behavior or static artifacts but cannot attribute risk across authoring, retrieval, and later execution. To expose this lifecycle, we introduce SkillMisevo-Gym, a lifecycle-aware harness that versions skill state across agent frameworks, and SkillMisevo-Bench, a frozen design from malicious exposure to carryover tasks, with concept-aligned benign tasks and nine lifecycle metrics. We also introduce SafeEvolve, a wrapper that repairs unsafe content and governs subsequent reuse. Across 25 agent-method configurations, each covering 525 tasks in 25 episodes, all 21 evolved configurations author unsafe artifacts, while only fifteen lead to fresh-session harm. In the exposure sweep, three malicious tasks raise carryover ASR from 16.0% to 35.3%. Across representative skill evolution methods, SafeEvolve reduces unsafe retrieval and fresh-session harm by 26.7 and 17.3 percentage points, respectively, while mean benign utility changes by only 0.4 points. Together, persistent-adaptation safety must govern what updates write and what future executors reuse. Code is available at https://github.com/henrymao2004/misevolve.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究自改进 LLM 智能体（self-improving LLM agents）在将成功轨迹固化为可复用技能（skill）时所引入的安全风险。作者提出技能演化（skill evolution）视角，将安全失败归因于跨编写、检索与执行的完整生命周期，并构建 SkillMisevo-Gym 生命周期感知测试平台、SkillMisevo-Bench 基准以及 SafeEvolve 安全包装器。摘要报告了 25 种智能体方法配置下的不安全工件与跨会话危害测量，并展示 SafeEvolve 在几乎不损失良性任务效用的情况下显著降低不安全检索与新鲜会话危害。
Motivation: 自改进智能体会把成功的轨迹转化为持久化的跨任务状态，导致不安全的成功在触发输入消失后仍可被复用为策略。现有基准只衡量当前行为或静态工件，无法在编写、检索与后续执行之间归因风险；技能演化使该失败可测量，但演化优化的是任务结果而非程序安全性，因此受污染经验可能引发技能误演化（skill misevolution）。
Method: 提出 SkillMisevo-Gym，一个跨智能体框架对技能状态进行版本化管理的生命周期感知测试平台；提出 SkillMisevo-Bench，一个从恶意暴露到延续任务（carryover tasks）的冻结设计，包含概念对齐的良性任务和九个生命周期指标；并引入 SafeEvolve，一个修复不安全内容并约束后续复用的包装器。
Result: 在 25 种智能体方法配置（每种覆盖 25 个 episode 共 525 个任务）中，所有 21 个演化配置都生成了不安全工件，但只有 15 个导致新鲜会话危害。在暴露扫描中，三个恶意任务将延续任务 ASR 从 16.0% 提升到 35.3%。在代表性技能演化方法上，SafeEvolve 将不安全检索和新鲜会话危害分别降低 26.7 和 17.3 个百分点，而平均良性效用仅变化 0.4 点。
Conclusion: 持续适应的安全性必须同时约束更新写入的内容以及未来执行者复用的对象；即需要生命周期层面的治理，而不仅是当前行为或静态工件的检查。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Retrieval: Query-Conditioned Reuse of Long-Horizon Agent Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval can identify a past trajectory that may matter, yet it does not specify how an acting agent should use that trajectory after users, entities, constraints, or environment state have changed. We identify this post-retrieval reuse step as a distinct bottleneck for long-horizon trajectory memory and formulate an evaluation framework that holds candidate retrieval, target state, model, decoding, and tool budget fixed while varying the support delivered to the agent. We instantiate the framework with query-conditioned reuse (QCR), a deliberately simple target-bound note that records a reusable procedure, bindings to recover, applicability conditions, and verification requirements. QCR serves to test the reuse hypothesis rather than to claim a universally preferred memory format. Across 2,391 target instances in WebArena, WorkArena, and AppWorld, QCR reaches 62.3% average Success, 10.7 points above Full Trajectory, while using 48.9% fewer online tokens. Summary reranking selects a reusable memory for 94.8% of targets, placing end-task Success within 1.8 points of an oracle reusable selector. Analyses by trajectory length and source--target binding shift show that direct trajectory injection loses much of its utility as traces grow longer or source-specific values change, whereas target-bound support preserves a larger share of the measured gain. The resulting framework separates retrieval quality from the problem of turning retrieved experience into safe, useful support for a new task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出检索后复用 (post-retrieval reuse) 是长视野智能体轨迹记忆中的独立瓶颈，并构建了一个固定检索、目标状态、模型、解码与工具预算、仅改变智能体获得支持的评估框架。作者用查询条件复用 (query-conditioned reuse, QCR) 这种刻意简单的目标绑定笔记来检验该假设。在 WebArena、WorkArena 和 AppWorld 的 2,391 个目标实例上，QCR 达到 62.3% 的平均 Success，比完整轨迹注入高 10.7 个点，同时减少 48.9% 的在线 token 使用。
Motivation: 检索能找到可能相关的历史轨迹，但无法说明在用户、实体、约束或环境状态变化后，智能体应如何实际使用这条轨迹；这一检索后复用步骤被识别为长视野轨迹记忆的独立瓶颈。
Method: 提出一个评估框架，固定候选检索、目标状态、模型、解码和工具预算，只变化提供给智能体的支持形式；并以查询条件复用 (QCR) 作为目标绑定笔记的具体实例，记录可复用流程、需恢复的绑定、适用条件和验证要求。
Result: 在 2,391 个目标上，QCR 平均 Success 为 62.3%，较完整轨迹注入高 10.7 点，同时在线 token 减少 48.9%；摘要重排序为 94.8% 的目标选出可复用记忆，端任务 Success 与 oracle 可复用选择器仅差 1.8 点。轨迹长度和源-目标绑定偏移的分析显示，直接注入轨迹在轨迹变长或特定值变化时效用下降，而目标绑定支持保留了更大比例的增益。
Conclusion: 该框架将检索质量与把检索到的经验转化为安全、有用支持的问题分离开；QCR 用于检验复用假设，而非声称一种普遍最优的记忆格式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FSGR: Mitigating Token Frequency Bias for Fair SID-Based Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Semantic ID (SID)-based generative recommendation has recently achieved remarkable success. However, existing methods suffer from a previously overlooked fairness issue, which we term \textbf{Token Frequency Bias}, where high-frequency SID tokens are systematically over-predicted while low-frequency SID tokens are under-predicted. This bias originates from the combined effects of imbalanced semantic codebooks during SID construction, and popularity bias together with the maximum likelihood estimation objective during recommendation training, resulting in unfair exposure across item categories. Existing SID methods mainly focus on improving codebook quality and overlook the impact of token frequency imbalance on downstream recommendation fairness, while LLM debiasing methods often yield suboptimal results when directly applied to SID-based recommendation, due to the hierarchical semantics of SID tokens. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{FSGR}, a fairness optimization framework for SID-based generative recommendation. During SID construction, FSGR employs OT-based Assignment Optimization and Dual-Criteria Re-anchor mechanism to form a more balanced SID representation space. During recommendation training, it adopts a two-stage training strategy and introduces Hierarchical Frequency Calibration for layer-specific fairness fine-tuning. Experiments on three public datasets with three backbone models demonstrate that FSGR mitigates token frequency bias and delivers an average Gini fairness improvement of over 20\% while maintaining competitive recommendation accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FSGR，一个针对基于语义 ID（Semantic ID, SID）的生成式推荐系统的公平性优化框架，用于缓解作者称为 Token Frequency Bias 的问题，即高频 SID token 被系统性过度预测、低频 token 被低估。摘要报告在三个公开数据集和三个 backbone 模型上，FSGR 平均将 Gini 公平性指标提升超过 20%，同时保持有竞争力的推荐精度。
Motivation: 现有 SID 生成式推荐方法存在被忽视的公平性问题 Token Frequency Bias，其来源包括 SID 构建时语义码本不平衡，以及训练阶段 popularity bias 与最大似然估计目标共同作用，导致不同物品类别曝光不公平。已有 SID 方法只关注码本质量，而 LLM 去偏方法因 SID token 的层级语义而难以直接迁移。
Method: FSGR 分为两个阶段的处理：在 SID 构建阶段，采用基于最优传输（OT）的赋值优化与双准则重锚定（Dual-Criteria Re-anchor）机制，以形成更均衡的 SID 表示空间；在推荐训练阶段，采用两阶段训练策略，并引入层级频率校准（Hierarchical Frequency Calibration）进行逐层公平性微调。
Result: 在三个公开数据集上使用三个 backbone 模型进行实验，摘要称 FSGR 能缓解 token frequency bias，平均公平性（Gini 指标）提升超过 20%，同时推荐精度保持有竞争力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过在 SID 构建和推荐训练两个阶段分别平衡表示空间与校准层级频率，可以在不牺牲推荐精度的情况下显著改善推荐公平性；该方案专门针对 SID token 的层级语义设计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Heterogeneous Vision-Language Ensemble with Disagreement-Aware Reranking for Text-Based Person Anomaly Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Text-based person anomaly retrieval aims to retrieve pedestrians exhibiting anomalous behaviors from a large image gallery using natural language descriptions. Compared with conventional text-based person retrieval, this task requires fine-grained reasoning over pedestrian appearance, behaviors, object interactions, and scene context, making robust cross-modal matching significantly more challenging. This paper presents the GENAI4E team's solution to AI City Challenge 2026 Track 4. Our framework builds upon a strong retrieval backbone and progressively integrates heterogeneous vision-language embedding models through score alignment and iterative ensemble fusion, followed by disagreement-aware VLM reranking for ambiguous queries. On the official Pedestrian Anomaly Behavior (PAB) benchmark, our approach achieves 90.92% mAP, 85.13% Recall@1, 97.72% Recall@5, and 98.68% Recall@10, demonstrating the effectiveness of combining complementary vision-language representations with selective multimodal reasoning for large-scale text-based person anomaly retrieval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 GENAI4E 团队在 AI City Challenge 2026 Track 4 上的解决方案，针对基于文本的行人异常检索任务。方法以强检索骨干为基础，通过分数对齐和迭代集成融合多个异构视觉-语言嵌入模型，并对歧义查询引入基于分歧感知的 VLM 重排序。在官方 Pedestrian Anomaly Behavior (PAB) 基准上达到 90.92% mAP、85.13% Recall@1、97.72% Recall@5 和 98.68% Recall@10。
Motivation: 基于文本的行人异常检索需要细粒度推理行人外观、行为、物体交互和场景上下文，比常规文本行人检索更难，跨模态匹配更具挑战性。
Method: 框架采用强检索骨干，通过分数对齐与迭代集成融合多种异构视觉-语言嵌入模型，并使用分歧感知的 VLM 重排序处理歧义查询。
Result: 在 PAB 基准上取得 90.92% mAP、85.13% Recall@1、97.72% Recall@5 和 98.68% Recall@10。
Conclusion: 摘要强调互补的视觉-语言表征结合选择性多模态推理能有效支持大规模文本行人异常检索。

papers.title: CABS+: Efficient and Scalable Model Merging via Conflict-Aware Sparsification and Adaptive Weight Allocation
papers.abstract_en: Model merging has recently attracted significant attention as a promising paradigm for constructing unified multi-task models without requiring additional retraining. However, parameter conflicts and knowledge interference across tasks often degrade merged-model performance. Prior work introduced Conflict-Aware and Balanced Sparsification (CABS), which reduces parameter interference through structured pruning and sequential masking. However, CABS relies on grid search to determine scaling coefficients, resulting in exponential time complexity, while its optimization objective can be dominated by high-performance tasks, leading to suboptimal overall performance. To address these limitations, we extend CABS and propose CABS+. Specifically, Adaptive Weight Allocation (AWA) optimizes merging coefficients via a gradient-free search scheme to reduce time complexity, while an asymmetric fitness function promotes more comprehensive performance gains across tasks. Moreover, we conduct a systematic empirical study of key factors influencing model merging performance and propose Relative Synergy Score (RSS) to quantify model mergeability and guide model selection. We compare CABS+ with state-of-the-art model merging methods, including CABS, AdaMerging, and WUDIMerging, across 27 datasets and 5 models covering large language, small-scale language, and vision models. Extensive experiments verify the effectiveness and efficiency of CABS+. Compared with AdaMerging and WUDIMerging, CABS+ improves overall performance by 16.97% and 12.93%, respectively, exhibits stronger stability and robustness across varying task numbers and model architectures, uses less than 25% of the GPU memory required by AdaMerging, and achieves nearly a 4x speedup in merging time over WUDIMerging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CABS+，扩展了冲突感知与平衡稀疏化 (CABS) 模型合并方法，引入自适应权重分配 (AWA) 的免梯度搜索和不对称适应度函数，以降低计算复杂度并提升多任务整体性能；同时提出相对协同分数 (RSS) 量化模型可合并性并指导模型选择。实验覆盖 27 个数据集和 5 种模型，相比 AdaMerging 和 WUDIMerging 分别提升整体性能 16.97% 和 12.93%，且显著降低 GPU 内存与合并时间。
Motivation: 现有 CABS 方法依赖网格搜索确定缩放系数，时间复杂度呈指数增长，且其优化目标可能被高性能任务主导，导致整体性能次优；模型合并中的参数冲突和知识干扰问题仍需更高效、更均衡的解决方案。
Method: CABS+ 在 CABS 基础上引入自适应权重分配 (AWA)，通过无梯度搜索优化合并系数以降低时间开销，并设计不对称适应度函数促进跨任务的综合性能提升；还提出相对协同分数 (RSS) 以量化模型可合并性并辅助模型选择。
Result: 在 27 个数据集、5 种模型（覆盖大语言模型、小规模语言模型和视觉模型）上与 AdaMerging、WUDIMerging 等先进方法对比，CABS+ 整体性能分别提升 16.97% 和 12.93%；相比 AdaMerging 仅使用其不到 25% 的 GPU 内存，且合并时间比 WUDIMerging 快近 4 倍，同时在不同任务数量与模型架构下表现更稳定和鲁棒。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 CABS+ 通过减少时间复杂度和缓解任务主导问题，实现了更高效、更鲁棒的模型合并，并提供了系统性的影响因素研究和模型可合并性度量。

papers.title: AQuA: Recursively Self-Improving Quantitative Trading Research Agents
papers.abstract_en: We study recursive self-improvement at the level of quantitative-investment research: whether an autonomous system can use evidence from earlier experiments to improve the hypotheses and candidates proposed in later iterations. We present AQuA, which comprises two separate language-model-driven research systems: one for symbolic factor discovery and one for trainable model development. The two systems do not share agents, memories, candidate spaces, or research state. Instead, each independently closes its own research loop by retaining validated evidence and using it to guide subsequent proposals. In this bounded sense, both systems implement recursive self-improvement at the level of the research process. Each system also uses its own sealed sandbox, which fixes the data splits, feature and label definitions, and evaluator while allowing the model to act only through constrained factor expressions or configuration diffs. The factor system, a manager-mediated multi-agent pipeline, discovers and combines factors into a signal that reaches a combined information coefficient of about $0.190$ on a crypto universe. The model system, a config-driven loop over a hybrid time-series architecture, reaches a per-stock information coefficient of $+0.0843$ on US equities and converts it into a threshold long/short strategy with a held-out Sharpe of up to $+2.50$ at a two-leg cost. The strategy is positive in every year from 2021 to 2025.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AQuA，一个由两个独立语言模型驱动的研究系统组成的框架，研究量化投资研究过程中的递归自我改进：系统能否用早期实验证据改进后续迭代中提出的假设与候选。两个系统分别负责符号因子发现与可训练模型开发，彼此不共享代理、记忆、候选空间或研究状态，各自通过保留已验证证据并据此指导后续提议来独立闭环。因子系统在加密货币宇宙上达到约 0.190 的综合信息系数；模型系统在美股上达到每股 +0.0843 的信息系数，并转化为持有期外阈值多空策略，两腿成本下 Sharpe 最高达 +2.50，且 2021 至 2025 每年收益均为正。两个系统都在密封沙箱内运行，固定数据划分、特征与标签定义及评估器，模型只能通过受约束的因子表达式或配置差异行动。
Motivation: 该工作研究的问题是量化投资研究层面的递归自我改进是否可行，即自主系统能否用先前实验的证据来改进后续迭代中的假设与候选。作者刻意让两个研究系统相互隔离，以验证在各自封闭研究循环内的递归自我改进能力。
Method: AQuA 由两个语言模型驱动的独立研究系统组成：一是经理中介的多代理因子发现管线，负责发现并组合因子；二是配置驱动的混合时间序列模型开发循环。每个系统使用自己的密封沙箱，固定数据划分、特征和标签定义及评估器，模型只能通过受约束的因子表达式或配置差异（configuration diffs）与系统交互。
Result: 因子系统在加密货币宇宙上产生的信号综合信息系数（combined information coefficient）约为 0.190；模型系统在美股上达到每股信息系数 +0.0843，并将其转化为阈值多空策略，持有期外两腿成本下 Sharpe 最高为 +2.50，且 2021 至 2025 年每年策略收益均为正。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，在受限意义上，两个系统都在研究过程层面实现了递归自我改进，即通过保留验证过的证据并用于指导后续提议来独立闭合各自的研究循环。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Atomic Evidence to Logical Composition: Structured Compositional Reasoning over Compound Answer Options
papers.abstract_en: Large language models often fail when answer options require combining atomic judgments under explicit logical operators, even when they judge the individual atoms correctly. We study compound options connected by AND, OR, and NEITHER/NOR, introducing a framework that decomposes each option into atomic answers and scores contrastive hypotheses about each one, so the model never sees a compound option. An operator-constrained integer linear program then composes the calibrated scores into a single prediction. We evaluate on LOGICAL-COMMONSENSEQA and introduce LOGICAL-SATA, a reading-comprehension benchmark derived from SATA-Bench. Our framework improves Macro-F1 from 48.3 to 77.0 on the human-validated LOGICAL-COMMONSENSEQA split and from 47.0 to 75.6 on LOGICAL-SATA, with the largest gains on NEITHER/NOR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型在 AND、OR、NEITHER/NOR 等显式逻辑算子连接的复合选项上的推理失败问题，提出将每个复合选项分解为原子答案，对每个原子进行对比假设打分，再用算子约束的整数线性规划组合成最终预测。在人工验证的 LOGICAL-COMMONSENSEQA 分割上 Macro-F1 从 48.3 提升到 77.0，并在新引入的 LOGICAL-SATA 基准上从 47.0 提升到 75.6，其中 NEITHER/NOR 选项收益最大。
Motivation: 即使大语言模型能正确判断单个原子命题，面对显式逻辑运算符组合的复合答案选项时仍经常失败；现有方法缺少对这种结构化组合推理的系统建模。
Method: 提出一个分解框架：将每个复合选项拆成原子答案，并为每个原子答案的对比假设 (contrastive hypotheses) 打分，使模型从不直接看到复合选项；随后用一个带算子约束的整数线性规划 (operator-constrained integer linear program) 把校准后的分数组合成单一预测。
Result: 在人类验证的 LOGICAL-COMMONSENSEQA 分割上 Macro-F1 从 48.3 提升到 77.0；在基于 SATA-Bench 构建的阅读理解基准 LOGICAL-SATA 上从 47.0 提升到 75.6，最大提升出现在 NEITHER/NOR 选项上。
Conclusion: 摘要强调原子分解与逻辑约束组合能显著改善复合选项下的组合推理；评估覆盖两个基准，其中 LOGICAL-SATA 为本文新引入的阅读理解基准。摘要未涉及天气或降水相关应用。

papers.title: Fast A/B/n Testing: Exact Multi-Policy Comparison via Tree-Coupled Feedback Sharing
papers.abstract_en: Online platforms increasingly compare many adaptive decision policies---ranking systems, recommendation algorithms, pricing rules, and language-model agents---while each reward-bearing interaction can be costly or risky. A direct A/B/n design gives each of $J$ policies its own horizon-$T$ trajectory and therefore uses $JT$ outcomes. We introduce Tree-Coupled A/B Testing (\TCAB), an exact feedback-sharing design for arbitrary history-dependent contextual-bandit policies. At each round, a predictable tree connects the current policy histories; every parent--child context--action law is maximally coupled, and one reward is shared within each component of matched tree edges. Every policy retains exactly its standalone finite-horizon trajectory law, even though the policies are deliberately dependent. If $D_{e,t}$ records a mismatch on tree edge $e$ at round $t$, the number of reward queries satisfies the pathwise identity $N(T)=T+\sum_{t,e}D_{e,t}$ and hence equals $T$ plus cumulative tree-edge total variation in expectation. This cost is conditionally optimal among exact edge-local designs on the selected tree, and a current-round minimum-spanning tree is myopically optimal among tree designs. For fixed $J$, sublinear pseudo-regret of every policy and almost-sure uniqueness of the oracle action imply $\mathbb{E}[N(T)]=T+o(T)$, versus $JT$ for independent runs. We also obtain finite-sample variance bounds for pairwise policy contrasts. Experiments on reward-model evaluation, multiple-choice language-model evaluation, and adaptive search policies demonstrate substantial improvements in the cost--precision frontier.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Tree-Coupled A/B Testing (TCAB)，一种用于任意历史依赖的上下文赌博机策略的精确反馈共享实验设计。其核心思想是在每轮用一棵树连接当前策略历史，对父子上下文-动作分布做最大耦合，并共享匹配边上的奖励，从而在保持每个策略独立有限时域轨迹分布不变的前提下减少奖励查询次数。摘要给出路径恒等式 N(T)=T+∑D_{e,t}，即在期望上等于 T 加累积树边全变差，固定策略数 J 时若为亚线性伪遗憾且 oracle 动作几乎必然唯一，则期望查询次数为 T+o(T)，远小于独立运行的 JT。实验在奖励模型评估、多选语言模型评估和自适应搜索策略上展示了成本-精度前沿的改进。
Motivation: 在线平台经常需要比较大量自适应决策策略（如排序系统、推荐算法、定价规则、语言模型智能体），但每次带奖励的交互可能昂贵或有风险。标准的 A/B/n 设计为每个策略分配独立的长度为 T 的轨迹，总代价为 JT，在 J 较大时不可承受。
Method: 提出 Tree-Coupled A/B Testing (TCAB)：每轮构建一棵可预测的树连接当前各策略历史，将每个父子上下文-动作分布进行最大耦合（maximally coupled），并在匹配树边内共享一个奖励。每个策略仍保持独立的有限时域轨迹分布，但策略间有意引入依赖；引入 D_{e,t} 记录树边 e 在 t 轮的不匹配，使奖励查询数满足路径恒等式 N(T)=T+∑_{t,e}D_{e,t}。
Result: 摘要证明代价在所选树上条件最优于精确边局部设计，且当前轮最小生成树在树设计中是近视最优的。固定 J 时，每个策略的亚线性伪遗憾和 oracle 动作几乎必然唯一性蕴含 E[N(T)]=T+o(T)，对比独立运行的 JT；还给出成对策略对比的有限样本方差界。实验展示在奖励模型评估、多选语言模型评估和自适应搜索策略上的成本-精度前沿显著改进。
Conclusion: 作者认为精确的树耦合反馈共享可以在保持每个策略独立轨迹分布的同时大幅降低奖励查询成本，并以成本-精度前沿的改进作为主要结论；摘要未展开具体数字或额外局限性。

papers.title: Semantic Steering for Controllable Generation: Tuning-Free Concept Erasure in Multimodal Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs) have demonstrated remarkable text-to-image generation performance, surpassing traditional U-Net-based diffusion models. Nevertheless, their powerful generative capabilities also raise significant safety concerns, as they may generate sensitive or inappropriate content. While existing concept erasure methods aim to mitigate such risks, most require modifying model parameters, which are often architecture-specific and impractical for deployed larger models. Several tuning-free approaches face challenges when applied to advanced large-scale MM-DiTs due to their deeply embedded knowledge, broad semantic space, and context-dependent text encoders. To address these challenges, we propose to erase concepts by directly manipulating the model's internal representations. Our key insight, derived from an in-depth analysis of MM-DiT's block-wise generative roles, is that text-conditioned semantic representations are most salient in the middle blocks of MM-DiTs. Based on this, we extract representations of an unwanted concept and a desirable safe one from the middle block, construct a steering vector from their difference, and inject this single vector into consecutive early and middle blocks. By operating exclusively on the sparse text-branch tokens and leveraging the straight sampling trajectory of rectified flow, our method achieves effective concept erasure with negligible overhead and without any training. Extensive experiments across MM-DiT models demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in erasing diverse concepts, enables effective control over the final output, and remains robust to adversarial attacks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无训练 (tuning-free) 的概念擦除方法，用于多模态扩散 Transformer (MM-DiT) 的文本到图像生成。作者分析 MM-DiT 逐块生成角色后发现文本条件语义表征在中间块最显著，于是从中间块提取不希望概念与安全概念的表示差，构造一个 steering vector 并注入连续的早期和中间块。该方法仅操作稀疏的文本分支 token，并利用 rectified flow 的直线采样轨迹，实现低开销、无需训练的概念擦除。
Motivation: 现有概念擦除方法大多需要修改模型参数，且往往依赖特定架构，难以应用到已部署的大规模 MM-DiT；已有的无训练方法在先进 MM-DiT 上效果受限，因为这些模型知识嵌入深、语义空间广且文本编码器依赖上下文。
Method: 从对 MM-DiT 块级生成角色的深入分析出发，提取中间块中不需要概念与期望安全概念的表示，用二者之差构建 steering vector，并将该单一向量注入连续的早期与中间块。方法仅作用于稀疏的文本分支 token，依赖 rectified flow 的直线采样轨迹，全程无需训练。
Result: 在多种 MM-DiT 模型上的大量实验表明，该方法在擦除多样概念上达到 state-of-the-art 性能，能够有效控制最终输出，并且对对抗攻击保持鲁棒。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，直接操纵内部表示并以单一 steering vector 注入无需修改参数，可实现几乎零开销且可部署的稳定概念擦除。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Distribution Steering via Sliced Optimal Transport Control
papers.abstract_en: Distribution steering seeks feedback laws that drive the state law of a dynamical system between prescribed initial and terminal distributions. Optimal transport provides a natural geometric approach, but its implementation generally requires a transport map or coupling in the full state space. Sliced optimal transport avoids this full-dimensional construction through one-dimensional projections. Yet, the resulting projected maps specify only directional displacements and do not by themselves prescribe a realizable feedback law. To this end, we develop a finite-horizon control framework based on sliced optimal transport. At each sampling instant, a projected optimal transport map defines a directional terminal condition, whose minimum-energy realization yields a randomized single-direction controller. Averaging over projection directions gives a deterministic sliced feedback. For the single-integrator dynamics, the averaged feedback makes the sliced Wasserstein distance to the target non-increasing. For Gaussian endpoint laws, it is affine, preserves Gaussianity, and steers the mean and covariance to their prescribed terminal values. We further identify a law-dependent gain that yields linear decay of the sliced Wasserstein distance together with an explicit characterization of the control energy. We also prove that the randomized controller converges to the averaged sliced flow as the sampling period vanishes. Finally, we extend the construction to linear dynamical systems. Reachability-normalized coordinates allow instantaneous realization of the sliced velocity for uniformly fully actuated systems, while local controllability Gramians provide exact finite-step realization for general controllable systems. Numerical examples illustrate the resulting distributional flows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于切片最优传输 (sliced optimal transport) 的有限时域分布控制框架：在每个采样时刻用投影最优传输映射定义方向终端条件，通过最小能量实现得到随机单方向控制器，再对投影方向取平均得到确定性切片反馈。摘要证明该平均反馈使单积分器系统的 sliced Wasserstein 距离非增，在高斯端点情形下保持仿射与高斯性并驱动均值协方差到指定值，且随机控制器在采样周期趋于零时收敛到平均切片流；随后将该构造推广到线性系统。
Motivation: 分布控制通常需要全状态空间上的传输映射或耦合，而切片最优传输虽能通过一维投影避免全维构造，但投影映射只给出方向位移，本身不构成可实现的状态反馈律。作者希望建立一套直接基于切片最优传输的反馈控制框架来弥补这一缺口。
Method: 在每个采样时刻，由投影最优传输映射定义关于方向的终端条件，取其最小能量实现作为随机单方向控制器；对所有投影方向平均后得到确定性切片反馈。进一步研究单积分器、高斯端点分布和一般线性系统，引入依赖律的增益，并利用可达性归一化坐标与局部可控性 Gramian 来实现控制律。
Result: 对单积分器，平均反馈使 sliced Wasserstein 距离到目标分布非增；高斯端点情形下反馈为仿射、保持高斯性并精确驱动均值与协方差至终值；识别出的律相关增益带来 sliced Wasserstein 距离的线性衰减和显式控制能量刻画；随机控制器在采样周期趋于零时收敛到平均切片流；对可控线性系统，可达性归一化坐标与局部可控性 Gramian 分别给出瞬时和有限步的精确实现。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该框架以切片最优传输为基础构造了可实现的分布导向反馈律，并提供非增距离、高斯不变性、收敛性以及线性系统可实现性等理论保证，数值例子展示了相应分布流。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Validation of Smartphone-Based Photogrammetric 3D Body Scanning for Automated Anthropometric Measurements Compared with a Commercial Depth-Sensor-Based Body Scanner
papers.abstract_en: 3D body scanning has become an important tool in healthcare applications because of its rapid and non-invasive nature. While smartphone-based photogrammetric reconstruction provide a low-cost and accessible alternative to commercial 3D body scanners, their performance for whole-body scanning remains insufficiently validated. Thus, we designed this study to comprehensively validate the photogrammetric 3D scanning application by evaluating automatically extracted whole-body measurements and longitudinal body-shape monitoring. We evaluated a representative application, PolyCam, against the commercial depth-sensor-based Fit3D ProScanner using 144 pregnant participants scanned longitudinally throughout pregnancy. We designed an automatic circumference extraction pipeline to get measurements at four anatomical landmarks from paired 3D scans. A linear mixed-effects model was used to evaluate scanner effects and longitudinal body-shape changes. Measurement consistency was assessed using repeated PolyCam scans and tape measurements on a rigid mannequin. PolyCam demonstrated strong agreement with Fit3D, with average biases below 16 mm, intraclass correlation coefficients above 0.8, and Pearson correlation coefficients above 0.9 across all landmarks. Both systems captured comparable longitudinal body-shape changes. Mannequin experiments showed mean biases below 3.5 mm and no significant differences from tape measurements. These findings support smartphone photogrammetry as a potential accessible alternative to commercial body scanners and applicable for longitudinal 3D body-shape assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文验证了基于智能手机的摄影测量 (photogrammetric) 3D 全身扫描在自动人体测量中的可靠性。研究用代表性应用 PolyCam 与商用深度传感器 Fit3D ProScanner 对比，采集 144 名孕妇在妊娠期的纵向扫描数据，并设计了自动周长提取流程和线性混合效应模型进行统计分析。结果显示 PolyCam 与 Fit3D 在多个解剖标志点上的平均偏差低于 16 mm，组内相关系数高于 0.8，Pearson 相关系数高于 0.9，且人体模型实验的平均偏差低于 3.5 mm。作者认为智能手机摄影测量可作为商用扫描仪的潜在低成本替代方案。
Motivation: 智能手机摄影测量重建为 3D 身体扫描提供了低成本、易获取的替代方案，但其在全身扫描场景下的测量精度和纵向监测能力尚缺乏充分验证。
Method: 使用 PolyCam 与商用深度传感器 Fit3D ProScanner 对 144 名孕妇进行纵向扫描，设计自动周长提取管线获取四个解剖标志点的测量值，并用线性混合效应模型评估扫描仪效应和身体形状的纵向变化；同时通过重复扫描和刚性人体模型的卷尺测量评估一致性。
Result: PolyCam 与 Fit3D 在全部标志点上显示强一致性：平均偏差低于 16 mm，组内相关系数 (ICC) 高于 0.8，Pearson 相关系数高于 0.9；两种系统捕获的纵向身体形状变化相当；人体模型实验中平均偏差低于 3.5 mm，且与卷尺测量无显著差异。
Conclusion: 结果表明智能手机摄影测量可以作为商用身体扫描仪的潜在可及替代方案，并适用于纵向 3D 身体形态评估。
Relevance: 3
