papers.title: A Simple State Space Model Excels at Multivariate Time Series Classification
papers.abstract_en: Structured state space models (SSMs) have recently emerged as a promising foundation for sequence modeling, with Mamba-based architectures demonstrating strong performance through input-dependent state transitions, albeit at considerable complexity. However, their application to time-series classification (TSC) has been largely limited to Mamba-style architectures, leaving the broader SSM design space underexplored. We present the first systematic study spanning diagonal SSMs (S4D) and input-dependent SSMs (Mamba family) on large-scale TSC benchmarks, asking whether such complexity is necessary for top performance. Our results reveal a surprising finding: S4D consistently outperforms Mamba-based variants in both accuracy and efficiency, challenging the assumption that increased complexity translates to meaningful gains in TSC. Building on this, we introduce MS4, lightweight modifications to S4D via a linear input projection and channel-mixing mechanism, and MS4N, a normalized variant that stabilizes state dynamics with negligible overhead. Evaluated on 59 datasets across MONSTER (up to 60 million samples, 50K timesteps, 82 classes) and the UEA benchmark, against 15 baselines, MS4 and MS4N consistently outperform Mamba-based models while remaining more efficient, and MS4N matches or surpasses competing deep learning models that are roughly 2x and 10x larger in parameters. These results position lightweight structured SSMs as a compelling alternative to scaling complexity for TSC.

TL;DR: 本文首次在大型时间序列分类 (TSC) 基准上系统比较对角状态空间模型 (S4D) 与输入依赖的 Mamba 系列 SSM，发现 S4D 在准确率和效率上均优于 Mamba 变体。作者据此提出轻量改进 MS4 和归一化变体 MS4N，在 59 个数据集上与 15 个基线对比，MS4/MS4N 以更小参数量匹配或超越更大的深度学习模型。
Motivation: Mamba 类架构因输入依赖的状态转换在序列建模中表现强，但复杂度高；其在 TSC 上的应用几乎仅限 Mamba 风格，更广泛的 SSM 设计空间未被探索，作者希望检验这种复杂度是否是获得顶尖 TSC 性能所必需的。
Method: 对 S4D（对角 SSM）与 Mamba 系列做系统性基准研究，并引入 MS4：对 S4D 加入线性输入投影和通道混合机制；以及 MS4N：通过归一化稳定状态动态，仅带来可忽略的额外开销。
Result: 在 MONSTER（多达 6000 万样本、5 万时间步、82 类）和 UEA 基准的 59 个数据集上，MS4 和 MS4N 持续优于 Mamba 类模型且更高效；MS4N 可匹配或超越参数量约为其 2 倍和 10 倍的深度学习模型。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果说明轻量结构化 SSM 是 TSC 中通过扩大模型复杂度来提升性能的替代方案；摘要未提及该工作与降水或天气领域的关系。

papers.title: Training Non-Differentiable Networks via Optimal Transport
papers.abstract_en: We optimize losses that jump: spiking thresholds, quantized layers, and discrete routing put jumps in the forward pass, where backpropagation does not apply. Finite differences fail: at a derivative-estimating radius, 99.5% of probe pairs on a quantized network leave the loss bit-identical, against 1.6% on a smooth control. At a jump, Clarke and conservative stationarity are undefined, and any radius-$h$ smoothing steepens like $1/h$, so no vanishing radius defines a derivative. Fixed-resolution stationarity survives. PolyStep attains it from forward passes alone, ranking probe points on a rotated polytope and stepping along a softmax-weighted average of their directions, the $λ=0$ endpoint of a KL-penalized transport program. A second impossibility fixes the frame: on a plateau wider than the probes reach, every rule that reweights one cost row freezes, softmax included, and only the column constraint escapes. In expectation, the cost-weighted average of the probed directions is exactly a gradient step on a smoothed loss, for every bounded measurable objective, with no probe asked to clear the jump set. Over $T$ steps it reaches subspace stationarity at rate $O(T^{-(1/2-γ)})$ up to a bias floor with an interior optimal probe radius, upgrading to Goldstein stationarity where the loss is Lipschitz. At matched optimizer steps, PolyStep leads all 36 comparisons of six architectures against six gradient-free baselines. It reaches 93.0% on hard LIF spiking networks against 79.6% for the best tuned baseline, and satisfies 92.6% of clauses on million-variable MAX-SAT against an 87.5% random floor. Matching total evaluations instead reverses argmax attention and one MAX-SAT size, and levels hard MoE. A step costs one forward pass per subspace dimension, leaving PolyStep at chance at 4.2M parameters from scratch; where gradients exist Adam is faster and more accurate.
papers.comment: 93 pages, 26 tables, 6 figures, submitted to Transactions on Machine Learning Research
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对前向传播中存在跳变（如脉冲阈值、量化层、离散路由）而导致反向传播失效的损失函数，提出 PolyStep 训练方法。方法仅依赖前向传播，利用最优传输理论在旋转多胞体上对探针点排序，并沿 softmax 加权方向均值步进。摘要给出理论收敛率与多组实验对比，涵盖脉冲网络、MAX-SAT、混合专家 (MoE) 等场景。
Motivation: 当损失函数存在跳变时，反向传播不适用；有限差分在量化网络上 99.5% 的探针对产生 bit 级相同损失，而光滑对照仅 1.6%。同时，在跳变处 Clarke 平稳性与保守平稳性无定义，任意半径 h 的平滑会使梯度像 1/h 一样陡增，因此不存在可定义导数的消失半径。
Method: PolyStep 从纯前向传播中达到固定分辨率平稳性 (fixed-resolution stationarity)：在旋转多胞体上对探针点排序，并沿 softmax 加权平均方向步进；该方向是一个带 KL 惩罚的传输程序在 λ=0 处的端点。理论上，探针方向的成本加权平均在期望上等价于对平滑损失做梯度步，且不需要任何探针越过跳变集。
Result: 在步数匹配时，PolyStep 在六种架构对六种梯度无关基线的全部 36 组比较中领先；在硬 LIF 脉冲网络上达 93.0%（最佳调参基线 79.6%），在百万变量 MAX-SAT 上满足 92.6% 子句（随机基线 87.5%）。若改用总评估次数匹配，则 argmax 注意力与一个 MAX-SAT 规模的结果反转，hard MoE 被拉平；每步需每个子空间维数一次前向传播，因此从零训练 4.2M 参数时表现仅等于随机猜测，且在有梯度处 Adam 更快更准。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 PolyStep 为不可微跳变损失提供一种有理论保证的前向传播训练方式，但承认其计算成本高：每步前向传播次数随子空间维数增长，在大规模参数从头训练时缺乏竞争力，且梯度存在时 Adam 仍更优。

papers.title: SIFT-VTON: Geometric Correspondence Supervision on Cross-Attention for Virtual Try-On
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based virtual try-on methods achieve photorealistic synthesis through cross-attention mechanisms that transfer garment features to target body regions. However, these approaches rely on implicit learning of spatial correspondences, struggling to preserve fine details such as text and illustrations. We propose a novel approach, which we call SIFT-VTON, that utilizes SIFT keypoint matching to provide explicit geometric guidance for diffusion-based virtual try-on. Our method applies domain-specific filtering to SIFT keypoint matches between garment and person images, then converts these correspondences into spatial probability distributions that supervise cross-attention layers during training. This explicit supervision guides the model to learn precise spatial alignment, concentrating attention on geometrically consistent garment regions. Experiments on the VITON-HD dataset demonstrate significant improvements on unpaired metrics while maintaining competitive paired reconstruction metrics. Qualitative comparisons show superior preservation of text clarity and pattern alignment. Attention visualizations confirm that our method produces sharply focused attention on relevant garment details. This work demonstrates that classical geometric correspondence methods can effectively enhance modern diffusion models for conditional synthesis tasks. The source code will be available at https://github.com/takesukeDS/SIFT-VTON.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SIFT-VTON，一种利用 SIFT 关键点匹配为扩散模型虚拟试穿提供显式几何监督的方法。该方法对服装与人物图像间的 SIFT 匹配进行域特定过滤，并将对应关系转换为空间概率分布来监督训练中的交叉注意力层。在 VITON-HD 数据集上的实验显示未配对指标显著提升，同时保持可比较的配对重建指标，定性结果展示了更好的文字清晰度与图案对齐。
Motivation: 基于扩散的虚拟试穿方法通过交叉注意力隐式学习空间对应关系，难以保留文字和插图等精细细节，本文旨在用显式几何对应解决这一问题。
Method: 利用 SIFT 关键点匹配在服装与人物图像之间建立对应，应用域特定过滤后再将这些对应转换为空间概率分布，在训练期间监督交叉注意力层，引导模型关注几何一致的服装区域。
Result: 在 VITON-HD 数据集上，未配对指标获得显著提升，配对重建指标保持竞争力；定性比较显示文字清晰度与图案对齐更优，注意力可视化也证实注意力更聚焦于相关服装细节。
Conclusion: 该工作表明经典几何对应方法可以有效增强现代扩散模型的条件合成任务，源代码已公开。

papers.title: From Unstructured Recall to Schema-Grounded Memory: Reliable AI Memory via Iterative, Schema-Aware Extraction
papers.abstract_en: Persistent AI memory is often reduced to a retrieval problem: store prior interactions as text, embed them, and ask the model to recover relevant context later. This design is useful for thematic recall, but it is mismatched to the kinds of memory that agents need in production: exact facts, current state, updates and deletions, aggregation, relations, negative queries, and explicit unknowns. These operations require memory to behave less like search and more like a system of record. This paper argues that reliable external AI memory must be schema-grounded. Schemas define what must be remembered, what may be ignored, and which values must never be inferred. We present an iterative, schema-aware write path that decomposes memory ingestion into object detection, field detection, and field-value extraction, with validation gates, local retries, and stateful prompt control. The result shifts interpretation from the read path to the write path: reads become constrained queries over verified records rather than repeated inference over retrieved prose. We evaluate this design on structured extraction and end-to-end memory benchmarks. On the extraction benchmark, the judge-in-the-loop configuration reaches 90.42% object-level accuracy and 62.67% output accuracy, above all tested frontier structured-output baselines. On our end-to-end memory benchmark, xmemory reaches 97.10% F1, compared with 80.16%-87.24% across the third-party baselines. On the application-level task, xmemory reaches 95.2% accuracy, outperforming specialised memory systems, code-generated Markdown harnesses, and customer-facing frontier-model application harnesses. The results show that, for memory workloads requiring stable facts and stateful computation, architecture matters more than retrieval scale or model strength alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出持久化 AI 记忆应基于 schema 而非自由文本检索，并给出迭代的 schema-aware 写入流程：将记忆摄入分解为 object detection、field detection 与 field-value extraction，配合验证门控、局部重试与有状态提示控制。作者在结构化抽取、端到端记忆与应用级基准上报告了 xmemory 系统的结果，显示在需要稳定事实与状态计算的记忆负载上，架构设计比检索规模或模型强度更重要。
Motivation: 现有外部记忆把存储当作检索问题：存文本、嵌入、后续取回。这适合主题回忆，但不支持精确事实、当前状态、更新删除、聚合、关系、否定查询和显式未知等生产级操作，因此需要把记忆变成 system of record 而非搜索。
Method: 提出 schema-grounded 记忆，schema 定义什么必须记、什么可忽略、哪些值绝不能推断；写入路径分 object detection、field detection、field-value extraction 三个阶段，包含验证门控 (validation gates)、局部重试 (local retries) 和有状态 prompt 控制。解释从读路径转移到写路径：读取变成对已验证记录的受限查询。
Result: 在抽取基准上，judge-in-the-loop 配置达到 90.42% object-level accuracy 和 62.67% output accuracy，超过测试的前沿结构化输出基线；端到端记忆基准上 xmemory 达 97.10% F1，而第三方基线为 80.16%-87.24%；应用级任务达 95.2% accuracy，优于专用记忆系统、代码生成的 Markdown harness 和面向客户的前沿模型应用 harness。
Conclusion: 作者结论是，对于需要稳定事实和状态计算的记忆工作负载，架构（schema-grounded 写入）比检索规模或模型强度更关键。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: The Optimal Sample Complexity of Multiclass and List Learning
papers.abstract_en: While the optimal sample complexity of binary classification in terms of the VC dimension is well-established, determining the optimal sample complexity of multiclass classification has remained open. The appropriate complexity parameter for multiclass classification is the DS dimension, and despite significant efforts, a gap of $\sqrt{\text{DS}}$ has persisted between the upper and lower bounds on sample complexity. Recent work by Hanneke et al. (2026) shows a novel algebraic characterization of multiclass hypothesis classes in terms of their DS dimension. Building up on this, we show that the maximum hypergraph density of any multiclass hypothesis class is upper-bounded by its DS dimension. This proves a longstanding conjecture of Daniely and Shalev-Shwartz (2014). As a consequence, we determine the optimal dependence of the sample complexity on the DS dimension for multiclass as well as list learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多类分类 (multiclass classification) 与列表学习 (list learning) 的最优样本复杂度。作者基于 Hanneke 等人 (2026) 对 DS 维数 (DS dimension) 的代数刻画，证明任意多类假设类的最大超图密度 (maximum hypergraph density) 以其 DS 维数为上界，从而证实 Daniely 与 Shalev-Shwartz (2014) 的长期猜想，并确定样本复杂度对 DS 维数的最优依赖关系。
Motivation: 二元分类的最优样本复杂度已由 VC 维数刻画，但多类分类的最优样本复杂度长期未决；此前其上界与下界之间存在 sqrt(DS) 的差距，需要新的证明技术来消除这一间隙。
Method: 将多类假设类编码为超图并分析其密度，利用 Hanneke 等人给出的 DS 维数代数刻画，证明最大超图密度不超过 DS 维数，从而同时收紧多类分类与列表学习的样本复杂度上界。
Result: 摘要报告该结果证明了 Daniely-Shalev-Shwartz (2014) 猜想，并由此确定了多类分类与列表学习在可实现 (realizable) 设定下样本复杂度对 DS 维数的最优依赖。
Conclusion: 该结果闭合了多类与列表学习中样本复杂度的平方根缺口；arXiv 备注指出可实现列表学习的结果被进一步收紧。摘要未给出样本复杂度的闭式表达式或实验验证。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Identifiability and Stability of Generative Drifting in the Companion-Elliptic Kernel Family
papers.abstract_en: A drifting model is a one-step generator trained by moving each sample along a field of kernel-weighted attraction toward data samples and repulsion between model samples; training halts once this field vanishes. The soundness of this scheme rests on two questions: whether a zero-field equilibrium guarantees agreement with the data distribution, and how the error is controlled when the field is small. We answer both questions. We introduce the companion-elliptic kernel class, which contains the Laplace kernel, and prove that a vanishing field identifies arbitrary Borel probability measures within this class and its blockwise product extension. The scalar companion-elliptic kernels are exactly the Gaussian and Matérn families, and deconvolution, the recovery of a measure from its kernel-smoothed density, is possible precisely when the zero set of the kernel's Fourier transform has empty interior. At approximate equilibria, a mass-escape counterexample shows that field information on a bounded region cannot control the global error. We therefore prove an explicit stability inequality bounding the error by the field residual on the observation region plus the convolution mass outside it. In this inequality the Gaussian kernel requires only field values but amplifies high-frequency errors exponentially, whereas the Matérn kernel requires one additional order of derivative information in exchange for polynomial amplification. Since this gap widens exponentially with frequency, the balance favors the Matérn family and hence the Laplace kernel.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究生成漂移模型（drifting model）的理论基础：该模型是一个一步生成器，通过沿核加权吸引与排斥场移动样本进行训练，并在场消失时停止。作者引入 companion-elliptic 核类（包含 Laplace 核），证明零场平衡可识别任意 Borel 概率测度，并给出近似平衡时误差受场残差与观测区域外卷积质量控制的显式稳定性不等式。摘要特别指出 Gaussian 核对高频误差呈指数放大，而 Matérn 核需额外一阶导数信息但只多项式放大，因此平衡偏向 Matérn 族（即 Laplace 核）。
Motivation: 漂移模型的合理性取决于两个未解决的问题：零场平衡是否足以保证生成分布与数据分布一致，以及当场较小时误差如何被控制。文中针对这两点给出理论回答。
Method: 引入 companion-elliptic 核类并证明标量情形恰好是 Gaussian 与 Matérn 族；证明该核类及分块乘积扩展下消失场可识别任意 Borel 概率测度，并用核 Fourier 变换零点集内部为空刻画反卷积的可行性；通过质量逃逸反例说明有界区域场信息无法控制全局误差，进而证明显式稳定性不等式。
Result: 摘要报告：在该核类内，零场平衡保证分布识别；反卷积可行当且仅当核 Fourier 变换的零点集内部为空；近似平衡时误差可由观测区域上的场残差加区域外卷积质量界定。Gaussian 核仅需场值但指数放大高频误差，Matérn 核需要额外一阶导数信息但仅多项式放大。
Conclusion: 作者认为 Gaussian 与 Matérn 之间的误差放大差距随频率指数扩大，因此该权衡支持 Matérn 族（含 Laplace 核）。

papers.title: Time-Series Forecasting in Safety-Critical Environments: An Open-Source Package for EU-AI-Act-Compliant Development / Zeitreihenprognose in sicherheitskritischen Umgebungen: Ein Open-Source-Paket für die KI-VO-konforme Entwicklung
papers.abstract_en: With spotforecast2-safe we present an integrated Compliance-by-Design approach to Python-based point forecasting of time series in safety-critical environments. A review of the relevant open-source tooling shows that existing compliance solutions operate consistently outside of the library to be used - e.g. as scanners, templates, or runtime layers. spotforecast2-safe takes the inverse approach and anchors the requirements of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (the EU AI Act, in German: KI-VO), of IEC 61508, of the ISA/IEC 62443 standards series, and of the Cyber Resilience Act within the library: in application-programming-interface contracts, persistence formats, and continuous-integration gates. The approach is operationalised by four non-negotiable code-development rules (zero dead code, deterministic processing, fail-safe handling, minimal dependencies) together with the corresponding process rules (model card, executable docstrings, CI workflows, Common-Platform-Enumeration (CPE) identifier, REUSE-conformant licensing, release pipeline). Interactive visualisation, hyperparameter tuning and automated machine learning (AutoML), as well as deep-learning and large-language-model backends are deliberately excluded, because each of these components either enlarges the attack surface, introduces non-determinism, or impairs reproducibility. Every article of the EU AI Act that is relevant to the library is discussed in detail. A bidirectional traceability matrix maps every regulatory provision onto the corresponding mechanism in the code; an end-to-end example of European-market electricity generation, transmission, and consumption forecasting demonstrates the application. The package is open-source and available under Affero General Public License (AGPL) 3.0-or-later.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 spotforecast2-safe，一个面向安全关键环境下时间序列点预测 (point forecasting) 的 Python 开源包，采用 Compliance-by-Design 思路将欧盟 AI 法案 (EU AI Act 2024/1689)、IEC 61508、ISA/IEC 62443 及网络弹性法案 (Cyber Resilience Act) 的要求直接嵌入库内部的 API 契约、持久化格式和持续集成门禁，而非像现有工具那样在库外提供扫描器或模板。摘要还给出了法规到代码机制的双向追溯矩阵，并以欧洲电力发输配消费预测作为端到端示例。
Motivation: 现有开源合规工具通常在库外部运作（如扫描器、模板、运行时层），导致合规要求难以真正约束所开发的库本身；本文试图填补这一缺口，把监管要求直接锚定在库的实现与开发流程中。
Method: 通过四条不可协商的代码开发规则（零死代码、确定性处理、故障安全处理、最小依赖）以及对应的流程规则（模型卡、可执行 docstring、CI 工作流、CPE 标识、REUSE 兼容许可、发布流水线）来落实合规。包明确排除交互式可视化、超参数调优、AutoML、深度学习和大型语言模型后端，理由是这些组件会扩大攻击面、引入非确定性或损害可复现性；同时逐条讨论与该库相关的欧盟 AI 法案条款，并建立双向追溯矩阵。
Result: 摘要报告的成果包括：基于库内集成而非库外工具的安全关键时间序列预测实现；一份覆盖相关欧盟 AI 法案条款的详细讨论；一个将每项监管规定映射到代码机制的双向追溯矩阵；以及欧洲电力市场发电、输电、消费预测的端到端应用示例。
Conclusion: 本文的定位是一个开源合规工具包，授权为 AGPL 3.0-or-later，其核心主张是合规要求可以通过库内设计和流程规则内生实现；同时明确以牺牲交互可视化、AutoML、深度学习与 LLM 后端为代价来保证确定性和可复现性。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Subject-Aware Multi-Granularity Alignment for Zero-Shot EEG-to-Image Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Decoding visual content from electroencephalography (EEG) is important for understanding neural visual representations and developing non-invasive brain-computer interfaces. Existing approaches mainly improve EEG representation learning and cross-modal alignment while treating pretrained visual representations as fixed supervision targets. However, pretrained vision models organize information hierarchically, with different depths encoding complementary structural and semantic information, and the visual granularity most compatible with EEG may vary across subjects. To address this issue, we propose Subject-Aware Multi-Granularity Alignment (SAMGA), which makes visual-target construction an explicit part of EEG-visual alignment. SAMGA constructs adaptive visual supervision from multiple intermediate representations and models EEG-compatible visual granularity through a global granularity prior with subject-dependent residual calibration, enabling subject-aware training and subject-agnostic inference. Based on the resulting adaptive target, a coarse-to-fine alignment strategy first organizes global cross-modal geometry and then refines instance-level retrieval discrimination. On THINGS-EEG, SAMGA improves Top-1 retrieval accuracy over the strongest competing method by 8.7 percentage points under intra-subject evaluation and 12.0 percentage points under leave-one-subject-out evaluation. These results support a broader view of neural-visual alignment, in which performance depends not only on how neural representations are mapped, but also on what visual representations define their supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Subject-Aware Multi-Granularity Alignment (SAMGA)，用于零样本 EEG-to-Image 检索。SAMGA 将视觉目标构建显式纳入 EEG-视觉对齐，从预训练视觉模型的多个中间表示构造自适应监督，并利用全局粒度先验加受试者相关残差校准来建模 EEG 兼容的视觉粒度，支持受试者相关训练与受试者无关推理。在 THINGS-EEG 上，SAMGA 在受试者内评估中比最强对比方法 Top-1 检索准确率提升 8.7 个百分点，在留一受试者评估中提升 12.0 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有方法将预训练视觉表征视为固定监督目标，忽略了预训练视觉模型具有层次化组织且不同深度编码互补信息，同时最适合 EEG 的视觉粒度可能因受试者而异。
Method: SAMGA 从多个中间表示构建自适应视觉监督，通过全局粒度先验与受试者依赖残差校准建模 EEG 兼容的视觉粒度，并采用由粗到细的对齐策略：先组织全局跨模态几何结构，再细化实例级检索判别。
Result: 在 THINGS-EEG 上，SAMGA 在受试者内评估中 Top-1 检索准确率较最强对比方法提升 8.7 个百分点，在 leave-one-subject-out 评估中提升 12.0 个百分点。
Conclusion: 结果表明神经-视觉对齐的性能不仅取决于神经表征如何映射，还取决于何种视觉表征定义监督，支持更广泛的神经-视觉对齐视角。

papers.title: Cat-DPO: Category-Adaptive Safety Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Aligning large language models with human preferences must balance two competing goals: responding helpfully to legitimate requests and reliably refusing harmful ones. Most preference-based safety alignment methods collapse safety into a single scalar that is applied uniformly to every preference pair. The result is a model that looks safe on average but stays relatively unsafe on a minority of harm categories. We cast safety alignment as a per-category constrained optimization problem and derive Cat-DPO, a direct-preference-optimization algorithm with a separate adaptive safety margin for each harm category. The margin tightens when the model still produces unsafe responses on a category and relaxes once the model catches up, so the training signal tracks each category's current difficulty rather than averaging under one global rate. Across two LLM backbones and six preference-learning baselines, Cat-DPO improves aggregate helpfulness and harmlessness and compresses per-category safety variance and the best-to-worst gap, offering a drop-in per-category refinement of direct preference safety alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Cat-DPO，一种按危害类别自适应的直接偏好优化（DPO）安全对齐算法。作者将安全对齐建模为逐类别约束优化问题，为每个危害类别设置独立的自适应安全边际，边际随模型在该类别上的表现收紧或放松。实验在两种 LLM 骨干和六种偏好学习基线上显示，Cat-DPO 提升整体有用性与无害性，并压缩逐类别安全方差和最好-最差差距。
Motivation: 现有基于偏好的安全对齐方法把安全性压缩成单一标量并统一施加到所有偏好对上，导致模型在平均意义上看似安全，但在少数危害类别上仍相对不安全。
Method: 将安全对齐形式化为逐类别约束优化问题，推导出 Cat-DPO，一种为每个危害类别配备独立自适应安全边际的直接偏好优化算法；当模型在某类别仍产生不安全响应时收紧边际，追上后放松边际，使训练信号跟踪各类别的当前难度。
Result: 在两种 LLM 骨干和六种偏好学习基线上，Cat-DPO 提升了整体 helpfulness 和 harmlessness，并压缩了逐类别安全方差与最好-最差差距（best-to-worst gap）。
Conclusion: 论文将 Cat-DPO 定位为直接偏好安全对齐的一种即插即用的逐类别细化方案，能在不牺牲整体表现的前提下改善少数危害类别的安全覆盖。

summary_sections.conclusion: 论文将 Cat-DPO 定位为直接偏好安全对齐的一种即插即用的逐类别细化方案，能在不牺牲整体表现的前提下改善少数危害类别的安全覆盖。

papers.title: OC-Distill: Ontology-aware Contrastive Learning with Cross-Modal Distillation for ICU Risk Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Early prediction of severe clinical deterioration and remaining length of stay can enable timely intervention and better resource allocation in high-acuity settings such as the ICU. This has driven the development of machine learning models that leverage continuous streams of vital signs and other physiological signals for real-time risk prediction. Despite their promise, existing methods have important limitations. Contrastive pretraining treats all patients as equally strong negatives, failing to capture clinically meaningful similarity between patients with related diagnoses. Meanwhile, downstream fine-tuning typically ignores complementary modalities such as clinical notes, which provide rich contextual information unavailable in physiological signals alone. To address these challenges, we propose OC-Distill, a two-stage framework that leverages multimodal supervision during training while requiring only vital signs at inference. In the first stage, we introduce an ontology-aware contrastive objective that exploits the ICD hierarchy to quantify patient similarity and learn clinically grounded representations. In the second stage, we fine-tune the pretrained encoder via cross-modal knowledge distillation, transferring complementary information from clinical notes into the model. Across multiple ICU prediction tasks on MIMIC, OC-Distill demonstrates improved label efficiency and achieves state-of-the-art performance among methods that use only vital signs at inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OC-Distill，一个面向 ICU 风险预测的两阶段框架，训练时利用多模态监督、推理时仅需生命体征（vital signs）。第一阶段引入基于 ICD 层级结构的本体感知对比目标（ontology-aware contrastive objective）来量化患者相似性；第二阶段通过跨模态知识蒸馏（cross-modal knowledge distillation）将临床笔记信息转移到预训练编码器中。摘要报告在 MIMIC 上的多个 ICU 预测任务中提升了标签效率，并在仅使用生命体征推理的方法中达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有对比预训练把所有患者视为等强度负样本，无法捕捉诊断相关患者之间有临床意义的相似性；下游微调又忽略临床笔记等互补模态，而这些信息在纯生理信号中不可得。
Method: 提出两阶段框架：第一阶段利用 ICD 层级结构构造本体感知对比目标，以患者间临床相似度指导表示学习；第二阶段通过跨模态知识蒸馏将临床笔记的信息注入预训练编码器，推理时仅依赖生命体征。
Result: 在 MIMIC 上的多个 ICU 预测任务中，OC-Distill 表现出更好的标签效率（label efficiency），并在仅以生命体征为推理输入的同类方法中达到最先进性能（state-of-the-art）。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为利用 ICD 本体层次量化患者相似性、并以蒸馏方式引入文本模态，可以在不增加推理输入的前提下提升 ICU 风险预测表现。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Q-learning-based QoS-aware multipath routing protocol in IoMT-based wireless body area network
papers.abstract_en: The Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) enables intelligent healthcare services but faces challenges such as dynamic topology, energy constraints, and diverse QoS requirements. This paper proposes QQMR, a Q-learning-based QoS-aware multipath routing method for WBANs. QQMR classifies data into three priority levels and employs adaptive multi-level queuing and fuzzy C-means clustering to optimize routing decisions. It maintains separate learning policies for each data type and selects primary and backup paths accordingly. Experimental results demonstrate improved packet delivery ratio and significant reductions in delay, routing overhead, and energy consumption compared to existing methods.

We therefore request withdrawal of the present version to appropriately resolve the authorship and contribution record
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 QQMR，一种基于 Q-learning 的 QoS 感知多路径路由协议，面向基于 IoMT 的无线体域网 (WBAN)。QQMR 将数据分为三个优先级，采用自适应多级队列和模糊 C 均值聚类优化路由决策，并为每类数据维护独立的学习策略以选择主路径和备份路径。摘要报告该方法相比现有方法提高了数据包投递率，并显著降低时延、路由开销和能耗。
Motivation: IoMT 智能医疗服务面临动态拓扑、能量受限和多样化 QoS 需求等挑战，现有路由方法难以同时满足这些约束。
Method: 提出 QQMR：利用 Q-learning 进行路由决策，按数据优先级分类，结合自适应多级队列和模糊 C 均值聚类，对不同数据类型分别维护学习策略，并据此选择主路径与备份路径。
Result: 实验结果表明，与现有方法相比，QQMR 提高了数据包投递率，并显著降低了时延、路由开销和能耗。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 QQMR 能够更好地支持 WBAN 环境下的 QoS 感知多路径路由；此外，arXiv 元数据显示作者已请求撤回当前版本以修订作者署名和贡献记录。

papers.title: ControlFoley: Unified and Controllable Video-to-Audio Generation with Cross-Modal Conflict Handling
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in video-to-audio (V2A) generation enable high-quality audio synthesis from visual content, yet achieving robust and fine-grained controllability remains challenging. Existing methods suffer from weak textual controllability under visual-text conflict and imprecise stylistic control due to entangled temporal and timbre information in reference audio. Moreover, the lack of standardized benchmarks limits systematic evaluation. We propose ControlFoley, a unified multimodal V2A framework that enables precise control over video, text, and reference audio. We introduce a joint visual encoding paradigm that integrates CLIP with a spatio-temporal audio-visual encoder to improve alignment and textual controllability. We further propose temporal-timbre decoupling to suppress redundant temporal cues while preserving discriminative timbre features. In addition, we design a modality-robust training scheme with unified multimodal representation alignment (REPA) and random modality dropout. We also present VGGSound-TVC, a benchmark for evaluating textual controllability under varying degrees of visual-text conflict. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across multiple V2A tasks, including text-guided, text-controlled, and audio-controlled generation. ControlFoley achieves superior controllability under cross-modal conflict while maintaining strong synchronization and audio quality, and shows competitive or better performance compared to an industrial V2A system. Code, models, datasets, and demos are available at: https://github.com/xiaomi-research/controlfoley.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ControlFoley，一个面向视频到音频（video-to-audio, V2A）生成的多模态统一框架，目标是对视频、文本和参考音频实现精细可控的音频合成。方法上采用 CLIP 与时空音视频编码器结合的联合视觉编码、时间-音色解耦（temporal-timbre decoupling）的参考音频处理，以及带统一多模态表示对齐（REPA）和随机模态 dropout 的模态鲁棒训练方案。作者还构建了 VGGSound-TVC 基准，用于在不同程度视觉-文本冲突下评估文本可控性，并在文本引导、文本控制和音频控制生成等任务上报告了优于现有方法的性能。
Motivation: 现有的 V2A 生成方法在视觉与文本信息冲突时文本可控性较弱，参考音频中时间与音色信息纠缠导致风格控制不精确，同时缺乏标准化基准来系统评估这类可控性。
Method: ControlFoley 引入联合视觉编码范式，将 CLIP 与时空音视频编码器相结合以改善对视听对齐与文本控制；提出时间-音色解耦策略，抑制参考音频中的冗余时间线索并保留判别性音色特征；并设计了模态鲁棒训练方案，包括统一多模态表示对齐（REPA）和随机模态 dropout。
Result: 在文本引导、文本控制、音频控制等多个 V2A 任务上的实验表明，ControlFoley 在跨模态冲突下取得具有竞争力的可控性，同时保持强音画同步和音频质量，并且与工业级 V2A 系统相比表现相当或更好。
Conclusion: 作者强调统一的跨模态对齐与解耦训练能够提升 V2A 生成在冲突条件下的可控性，并提供了代码、模型、数据集和演示以支持后续研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Post-Hoc Uncertainty-Aware Explanations for Deployed Power Quality Disturbance Classifiers via Laplace Approximation
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning classifiers achieve high accuracy in power quality disturbance (PQD) recognition, but existing explanation methods return a single deterministic attribution map and provide no measure of its reliability. This paper develops a post-hoc Bayesian explanation (B-explanation) method for trained PQD classifiers. A computationally efficient Laplace approximation converts the trained network into an approximate parameter posterior without retraining, and occlusion sensitivity is propagated through posterior samples to produce a distribution over disturbance-localization maps. Percentile summaries of this distribution yield explanations with distribution-free coverage bands: consensus summaries at low percentiles sharpen localization significantly for distinctive events such as sags, swells, and oscillatory transients, the band width indicates the reliability of each attribution, and the remaining disturbance types show class-dependent behavior. Explanation dispersion also increases under injected measurement noise and synthetic-to-field transfer, complementing predictive uncertainty. Experiments on a synthetic benchmark of 15 disturbance classes and on field-recorded sags compare the method with Monte Carlo dropout and deep ensembles under a common evaluation protocol, evaluate it against deterministic occlusion, LIME, and SHAP with localization and faithfulness metrics, and characterize the computational cost of explanation generation for grid monitoring applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对已部署的电力质量扰动 (PQD) 分类器提出一种事后贝叶斯解释方法 (B-explanation)：通过拉普拉斯近似 (Laplace approximation) 将训练好的网络转化为近似参数后验，无需重训练，再将遮挡敏感性 (occlusion sensitivity) 经后验样本传播，得到扰动定位图的分布。摘要报告，低百分位的共识摘要能显著锐化对凹陷 (sag)、隆起 (swell) 和振荡暂态等特征性事件的定位，带宽反映每个归因的可靠性，解释的离散度在注入测量噪声和合成到现场迁移时会增大，并与预测不确定性互补。实验基于 15 类扰动合成基准和现场记录凹陷数据，与 Monte Carlo dropout、深度集成、确定性遮挡、LIME 和 SHAP 进行了对比，并刻画了解释生成的计算成本。
Motivation: 现有深度学习 PQD 分类器的解释方法只能返回单一的确定性归因图，无法提供其可靠性的度量，这限制了其在电网监测等部署场景中的可信度。
Method: 提出一种事后贝叶斯解释方法：利用计算高效的拉普拉斯近似将已训练网络转换为近似的参数后验，无需重训练；通过后验样本传播遮挡敏感性，生成扰动定位图的分布；再用百分位汇总得到具有无分布覆盖带 (distribution-free coverage bands) 的解释。
Result: 低百分位的共识汇总能显著锐化凹陷、隆起和振荡暂态等特征性事件的定位，带宽指示每个归因的可靠性；解释离散度在注入测量噪声和合成到现场迁移下增大，与预测不确定性互补。通过与 MC dropout、深度集成、确定性遮挡、LIME 和 SHAP 的对比实验以及计算成本刻画，验证了方法的有效性。
Conclusion: 该方法为已部署的 PQD 分类器提供带可靠性度量的后验解释，覆盖带宽度和解释离散度可补充预测不确定性，适用于电网监测等在线应用场景。

papers.title: Learning Class Difficulty via Dynamic Focal Attention for Histopathology Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Frequency-based loss reweighting, the standard remedy for imbalanced histopathology segmentation, implicitly assumes that rare classes are difficult. Yet difficulty also arises from morphological variability, boundary ambiguity, and contextual similarity, all largely orthogonal to class frequency. We propose Dynamic Focal Attention (DFA), a simple, efficient mechanism that learns class-specific difficulty directly within the cross-attention of query-based mask decoders. DFA adds a learnable per-class bias to the attention logits, reweighting representations before prediction rather than gradients after it. Initialised from a centred log-frequency prior to prevent gradient starvation and then optimised end-to-end, the bias adapts to difficulty signals as they emerge during training, unifying frequency- and difficulty-aware reweighting in a single attention-bias framework. On three benchmarks (BCSS, BDSA, CRAG), DFA consistently improves Dice and IoU, matching or exceeding a two-stage difficulty-aware baseline without a separate estimator or extra training stage. This shows that encoding difficulty at the representation level is a principled alternative to conventional loss reweighting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对组织病理图像分割中的类别不平衡问题，提出 Dynamic Focal Attention (DFA)：在基于 query 的掩码解码器的交叉注意力中，为每个类别学习一个可学习的偏置项，从而在预测前对表示重新加权，而不是像传统损失重加权那样在梯度层面处理。该方法在 BCSS、BDSA 和 CRAG 三个基准上持续提升 Dice 与 IoU，且无需单独的难度估计器或额外训练阶段。
Motivation: 基于频率的损失重加权隐含假设稀有类别即困难类别，但组织病理分割中的难度还可能来自形态变异、边界模糊和上下文相似性，这些因素与类别频率基本正交，因此需要直接在表示层面建模类别难度。
Method: DFA 在 query-based 掩码解码器的交叉注意力 logits 中加入可学习的 per-class 偏置，以重新加权表示；偏置初始化采用中心化的对数频率先验以避免梯度饥饿，随后端到端优化，从而将频率感知与难度感知的统一整合到单一注意力偏置框架中。

Conclusion: 作者认为在表示层面编码类别难度是对传统损失重加权的原则性替代方案。

papers.title: Sequential Audit Sampling for Finite Populations with Exact and Simulation-based Guarantee
papers.abstract_en: Financial statement auditors use a risk-based approach to evidence collection to obtain reasonable assurance. When an initial sample does not support a conclusion, they may inspect additional items. We develop a sampling procedure by formulating this additional inspection as sequential hypothesis testing for a fixed finite population sampled without replacement. A tolerable deviation rate and a margin below that rate define the composite hypotheses and the intervening indifference region, and lower and upper stopping boundaries control the two probabilities of incorrect conclusions. Under simple random sampling, a hypergeometric recursion computes the boundaries, decision probabilities, and expected sample size exactly. The procedure permits decisions at prespecified times, including fixed intervals. A separate extension imposes a fixed maximum sample size. We also consider one-sided error control and complete examination of selected items. When the state is multidimensional or has too many possible values for direct enumeration, Monte Carlo simulation constructs candidate boundaries. An independent simulation then provides one-sided upper confidence bounds for the two error probabilities at the least-favorable population counts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把财务报表审计中的追加检查形式化为固定有限总体、无放回抽样的序贯假设检验 (sequential hypothesis testing)，并提出相应的抽样程序。可容忍偏差率及其下方的边际定义复合假设与中间的无关区，上下停止边界控制两类错误结论的概率。在简单随机抽样下，超几何递推可精确计算边界、决策概率与期望样本量；状态空间过大时用 Monte Carlo 模拟构造候选边界并给出误差概率的上置信界。
Motivation: 审计师采用基于风险的证据收集方法获取合理保证，当初始样本不足以支持结论时需要检查额外项目；现有实践缺少对这种追加检查的正式抽样程序，论文旨在用有限总体序贯检验填补这一缺口。
Method: 提出针对固定有限总体、无放回抽样的序贯抽样程序；以可容忍偏差率和其下方边际定义复合假设及无关区，用上下停止边界控制两类错误概率。简单随机抽样下用超几何递推精确计算边界、决策概率和期望样本量，并支持预定时点决策、固定最大样本量、单侧误差控制及对选定项目的完全检查；在多维或状态数过多的情形下用 Monte Carlo 模拟构造候选边界。
Result: 作者给出简单随机抽样下精确计算停止边界、决策概率与期望样本量的超几何递推方法，并说明当状态不可直接枚举时，可用 Monte Carlo 模拟构造边界，再通过独立模拟提供两种错误概率在最小有利总体计数下的单侧上置信界。
Conclusion: 该程序为审计中的追加检查提供了具有精确或基于模拟保证的序贯抽样框架，并涵盖固定最大样本量、单侧误差控制等扩展情形。

papers.title: Adjustable Text-Guided Backdoor Attacks with Natural-Word Triggers on Multimodal Pretrained Models
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents Text-Guided Backdoor (TGB), an adjustable backdoor attack against multimodal pretrained models that uses natural-word triggers, namely words that can naturally occur in ordinary textual inputs. Most existing backdoor attacks require specific trigger conditions that are typically not satisfied by ordinary inference inputs, thereby limiting their activation in real-world deployments. TGB overcomes this limitation by exploiting naturally occurring words as triggers, enabling stealthy activation without requiring explicit trigger insertion at inference time. This property avoids conspicuous trigger patterns and improves the practicality of TGB. Furthermore, we introduce visual adversarial perturbations on poisoned samples to modulate the model's learning of natural-word triggers, thereby enabling flexible adjustment of TGB attack strength without modifying the poisoned data. Extensive experiments are conducted on downstream tasks built upon multimodal pretrained models, including Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) and Visual Question Answering (VQA). Results demonstrate the effectiveness of TGB across diverse poisoning settings and its ability to flexibly adjust attack success rates, which reveal critical security vulnerabilities in multimodal pretrained models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Text-Guided Backdoor (TGB)，一种针对多模态预训练模型的可调节后门攻击，使用自然词触发器（natural-word triggers），即普通文本输入中天然可能出现的单词，从而无需在推理时显式插入触发器即可激活。作者引入视觉对抗扰动（visual adversarial perturbations）来调制模型对自然词触发器的学习，从而在不修改污染数据的情况下灵活调整攻击强度。实验在基于多模态预训练模型构建的 Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) 和 Visual Question Answering (VQA) 下游任务上进行，验证了 TGB 在多种投毒设置下的有效性，并揭示相关安全漏洞。
Motivation: 现有后门攻击大多依赖特定的触发条件，而这些条件通常不满足普通推理输入，限制了攻击在真实部署中的激活。本文针对这一缺陷，利用自然出现的单词作为触发器，使攻击无需显式触发器插入即可隐蔽激活，提高了攻击的实用性和隐蔽性。
Method: 提出 TGB 框架，以自然词作为文本触发器以规避显式触发器模式；同时向污染样本添加视觉对抗扰动，通过调控模型对自然词触发器的学习来灵活调整攻击强度，且无需修改已生成的污染数据。
Result: 在基于多模态预训练模型构建的 CIR 和 VQA 下游任务上的大量实验表明，TGB 在多种投毒设置下均有效，并能灵活调节攻击成功率（attack success rates），暴露出多模态预训练模型在此类攻击下的关键安全漏洞。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 TGB 具有隐蔽性好、攻击强度可调节的特点，并指出多模态预训练模型容易被自然词触发器的后门攻击所利用；摘要未提及防御方案或对正常任务性能的影响细节。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Auditable Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents call tools, query databases, delegate tasks, and trigger external side effects. Once an agent system can act in the world, the question is no longer only whether harmful actions can be prevented--it is whether those actions remain answerable after deployment. We distinguish accountability (the ability to determine compliance and assign responsibility), auditability (the system property that makes accountability possible), and auditing (the process of reconstructing behavior from trustworthy evidence). Our claim is direct: no agent system can be accountable without auditability. To make this operational, we define five dimensions of agent auditability, i.e., action recoverability, lifecycle coverage, policy checkability, responsibility attribution, and evidence integrity, and identify three mechanism classes (detect, enforce, recover) whose temporal information-and-intervention constraints explain why, in practice, no single approach suffices. We support the position with layered evidence rather than a single benchmark: lower-bound ecosystem measurements suggest that even basic security prerequisites for auditability are widely unmet (617 security findings across six prominent open-source projects); runtime feasibility results show that pre-execution mediation with tamper-evident records adds only 8.3 ms median overhead; and controlled recovery experiments show that responsibility-relevant information can be partially recovered even when conventional logs are missing. We propose an Auditability Card for agent systems and identify six open research problems organized by mechanism class.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 1 figure. Extended version. A condensed 4-page version appears in the Proceedings of the ACM AI Leadership Summit 2026 (Visionary Papers track)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文讨论LLM智能体（LLM agents）在部署后的可问责性问题，明确区分了accountability、auditability与auditing三个概念，并提出智能体可审计性（auditability）的五个维度：动作可恢复性、生命周期覆盖、策略可检查性、责任归因和证据完整性，以及三类机制（detect、enforce、recover）。作者通过分层证据支持论点：对六个开源项目的617项安全发现表明基本安全前提普遍缺失；运行时实验显示预执行调解与防篡改记录仅增加8.3 ms中位开销；受控恢复实验表明即使常规日志缺失也能部分恢复责任相关信息。文章还提出Auditability Card并列出六项开放研究问题。
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体系统已经能够调用工具、查询数据库、委托任务并触发外部副作用，但部署后如何回答其行为是否合规、责任归属何处这一问题缺乏系统性框架。作者认为没有auditability就不可能实现accountability，而当前尚无可操作的审计性定义和测量方法。
Method: 提出五个维度的agent auditability定义（动作可恢复性、生命周期覆盖、策略可检查性、责任归因、证据完整性），并识别三类机制（detect、enforce、recover）及其时间信息与干预约束，用以解释为何单一方法在实际中不充分。支持证据包括生态测量、运行时可行性和受控恢复实验，并引入Auditability Card作为标准化描述手段。
Result: 摘要报告三点证据：生态测量发现六个主流开源项目存在617项安全发现，表明审计性的基本安全前提普遍未满足；运行时实验显示预执行调解加防篡改记录的中位开销仅为8.3 ms；恢复实验表明在常规日志缺失时仍可部分恢复责任相关信息。
Conclusion: 作者主张没有auditability就没有accountability，并认为审计性需要多机制协同而非单一方案；据此提出Auditability Card和按机制分类的六项开放研究问题。

papers.title: SpatialVAM:Spatial-Aware Multi-View Video Diffusion as a Data-Efficient Robot Policy
papers.abstract_en: Robotic manipulation requires understanding both the 3D spatial structure of the environment and its temporal evolution, yet most existing policies neglect one or both aspects. They often rely on 2D visual observations or backbones pretrained on static image--text pairs, which leads to high data requirements and limited comprehension of environment dynamics. To address this, we introduce SpatialVAM, the first 3D Video Action Model that simultaneously predict spatial-aware multi-view heatmap videos and RGB videos. Our key insight is that this design naturally injects 3D information into video foundation models while aligning the representation format between video pretraining and action finetuning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SpatialVAM enables data-efficient, robust, generalizable, and interpretable manipulation. With only ten demonstration trajectories and no additional pretraining, SpatialVAM handles challenging long-horizon and contact-rich tasks, generalizes to out-of-distribution settings, and predicts realistic future videos. Evaluations on Meta-World (22\%$\uparrow$), RoboCasa (15\%$\uparrow$) and real-world robotic platforms (16\%$\uparrow$) show that SpatialVAM consistently outperforms other video action models, vision language action models and 3D-based policies, establishing a new state-of-the-art in data-efficient multi-task manipulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SpatialVAM，一个同时预测空间感知多视角热图视频与 RGB 视频的 3D 视频动作模型 (3D Video Action Model)，用于机器人操作。作者认为该设计能把 3D 信息注入视频基础模型，同时使视频预训练与动作微调的表示格式对齐。实验表明仅用 10 条演示轨迹且无额外预训练即可完成长时程与强接触任务，并在 Meta-World、RoboCasa 和真实机器人平台上超过其他视频动作模型、视觉语言动作模型和 3D 策略。
Motivation: 现有机器人操作策略大多只依赖 2D 视觉观测或静态图文预训练骨干，忽视了环境的三维空间结构和时间演化，导致数据需求高、对动态环境理解不足。
Method: 提出 SpatialVAM，即首个同时预测空间感知多视角热图视频与 RGB 视频的 3D 视频动作模型。核心思路是通过这种联合预测将 3D 信息自然注入视频基础模型，并统一视频预训练与动作微调之间的表示格式。
Result: 摘要报告仅用 10 条演示轨迹且无需额外预训练即可处理长时程和强接触任务，并泛化到分布外设置；在 Meta-World 提升 22%、RoboCasa 提升 15%、真实机器人平台提升 16%，超过其他视频动作模型、视觉语言动作模型和 3D 策略，达到数据高效多任务操作的新 SOTA。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 SpatialVAM 在数据高效、鲁棒、可泛化和可解释的操作策略上取得领先，但未展开讨论方法的局限性或详细分析。

papers.title: In-context superposition: human-like working memory interference in large language models
papers.abstract_en: Intelligent systems must maintain and manipulate task-relevant information online to adapt to dynamic environments. This capacity, known as working memory, is fundamental to human reasoning. Yet, human working memory is strikingly limited, maintaining only three to four items in a brain with billions of neurons. Surprisingly, large language models (LLMs), despite different substrates and direct access to prior context through attention, exhibit similar working memory limitations. Why should such different systems face analogous constraints? We propose that working memory limitations reflect a general trade-off of shared representations: representational compression and reuse support efficient learning and generalization, but also cause simultaneously active representations to interfere. We show a two-layer transformer trained on a working memory task can solve it perfectly, but diverse trained LLMs exhibit human-like limitations: performance declines with memory load, while retrieval is biased by recency and stimulus statistics. Mirroring humans, working memory performance in LLMs is also associated with broader model capability. Mechanistically, we show that LLMs encode multiple memories in entangled representations --- a condition we call \emph{in-context superposition} --- and progressively suppress competing content while aligning the target with the readout. Moreover, a causal intervention that suppresses interfering information improves performance. Together, these findings suggest that working memory capacity reflects the ability to select task-relevant information under interference, a computational challenge shared by biological and artificial systems.
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at COLM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个观点：人脑与大型语言模型（LLM）之所以表现出相似的工作记忆容量限制，是因为共享表征（shared representations）内在的压缩与复用会造成同时激活的表征相互干扰。作者在一个工作记忆任务上训练两层 Transformer，并测试多种预训练 LLM，发现 LLM 在记忆负荷增加时性能下降，并且提取结果受近因效应与刺激统计量影响，表现出类人限制。机制分析表明 LLM 以纠缠表征方式编码多个记忆（作者称为 in-context superposition），并逐步抑制竞争内容、对齐目标与读出端；因果干预抑制干扰信息可提升性能。
Motivation: 人脑仅能维持三到四个工作记忆项目，而 LLM 尽管结构不同且可通过注意力直接访问先前上下文，却表现出类似的工作记忆限制；作者试图解释为什么这两种截然不同的系统面临相似的约束。
Method: 作者用两层 Transformer 训练工作记忆任务以验证可解性，再对多个多样化的预训练 LLM 进行行为测试；通过机制分析考察记忆表征的纠缠与抑制过程，并实施因果干预以抑制干扰信息。
Result: 两层 Transformer 可以完美解决该任务，但多种 LLM 表现出类人限制：性能随记忆负荷下降，提取受近因和刺激统计量偏倚；工作记忆表现还与更广泛的模型能力相关，且因果干预抑制干扰信息后性能改善。
Conclusion: 摘要认为工作记忆容量反映了在干扰下选择任务相关信息的能力，这是生物与人工系统共同面临的计算挑战。

papers.title: CoLA: Cross-Modal Low-rank Adaptation for Multimodal Downstream Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models have revolutionized AI, but adapting them efficiently for multimodal tasks, particularly in dual-stream architectures composed of unimodal encoders, such as DINO and BERT, remains a significant challenge. ParameterEfficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) methods like LowRank Adaptation (LoRA) enable lightweight adaptation, yet they operate in isolation within each modality, limiting their ability in capturing cross-modal interactions. In this paper, we take a step in bridging this gap with Cross-Modal LowRank Adaptation (CoLA), a novel PEFT framework that extends LoRA by introducing a dedicated inter-modal adaptation pathway alongside the standard intra-modal one. This dual-path design enables CoLA to adapt unimodal foundation models to multimodal tasks effectively, without interference between modality-specific and crossmodal learning. We evaluate CoLA across a range of vision-language (RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, RefCOCOg) and audio-visual (AVE, AVS) benchmarks, where it consistently outperforms LORA, achieving a relative gain of around 3% and 2%, respectively, while maintaining parameter efficiency. Notably, CoLA enables the first multitask PEFT framework for visual grounding, bridging a key gap in efficient multimodal adaptation. Code is available at https://github.com/peterwisu/CoLA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoLA（Cross-Modal Low-Rank Adaptation），一种扩展 LoRA 的多模态 PEFT 框架，在标准模态内（intra-modal）适配路径之外增加跨模态（inter-modal）适配路径，用于将单模态基础模型（如 DINO、BERT）高效适配到视觉-语言和音频-视觉下游任务。作者在 RefCOCO、RefCOCO+、RefCOCOg、AVE、AVS 基准上评估，称其一致优于 LoRA，视觉-语言任务相对提升约 3%，音频-视觉任务相对提升约 2%，并保持参数效率；同时声称这是首个用于视觉定位（visual grounding）的多任务 PEFT 框架。代码已公开。
Motivation: 现有 PEFT 方法如 LoRA 在双流架构（由单模态编码器组成，如 DINO 和 BERT）中各自在单一模态内独立适配，难以捕获跨模态交互，限制了多模态下游任务的适配效果。
Method: CoLA 在 LoRA 基础上引入双路径设计：保留标准的模态内（intra-modal）低秩适配路径，同时增加专用的跨模态（inter-modal）适配路径，以在不干扰模态特定学习与跨模态学习的情况下适配多模态任务。
Result: 在视觉-语言基准（RefCOCO、RefCOCO+、RefCOCOg）上相对 LoRA 获得约 3% 的相对提升，在音频-视觉基准（AVE、AVS）上相对提升约 2%，且保持参数效率；并实现首个多任务 PEFT 视觉定位框架。
Conclusion: 作者认为 CoLA 通过分离模态内与跨模态适配路径，能有效将单模态基础模型适配到多模态任务，填补了多模态高效适配（尤其是视觉定位）中的空白。

papers.title: Distributed Online Submodular Maximization under Communication Delays: A Simultaneous Decision-Making Approach
papers.abstract_en: We provide a distributed online algorithm for multi-agent submodular maximization under communication delays. We are motivated by the future distributed information-gathering tasks in unknown and dynamic environments, where utility functions naturally exhibit the diminishing-returns property, i.e., submodularity. Existing approaches for online submodular maximization either rely on sequential multi-hop communication, resulting in prohibitive delays and restrictive connectivity assumptions, or restrict each agent's coordination to its one-hop neighborhood only, thereby limiting the coordination performance. To address the issue, we provide the Distributed Online Greedy (DOG) algorithm, which integrates tools from adversarial bandit learning with delayed feedback to enable simultaneous decision-making across arbitrary network topologies. We provide the approximation performance of DOG against an optimal solution, capturing the suboptimality cost due to decentralization as a function of the network structure. Our analyses further reveal a trade-off between coordination performance and convergence time, determined by the magnitude of communication delays. By this trade-off, DOG spans the spectrum between the state-of-the-art fully centralized online coordination approach [1] and fully decentralized one-hop coordination approach [2].
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对通信延迟下多智能体子模最大化问题，提出分布式在线贪心算法（Distributed Online Greedy, DOG），将对抗性赌博机学习（adversarial bandit learning）与延迟反馈相结合，支持任意网络拓扑上的同时决策。摘要给出 DOG 相对最优解的近似性能，并把去中心化导致的次优性代价表示为网络结构的函数；分析还显示协调性能与收敛时间之间存在由通信延迟大小决定的权衡，使 DOG 介于全集中式协调与一跳邻居协调两种现有方法之间。
Motivation: 现有在线子模最大化方法要么依赖顺序多跳通信，导致延迟过大并需要限制性连通性假设；要么将每个智能体的协调限制在一跳邻居内，限制协调性能。这阻碍了未知动态环境中分布式信息收集任务（效用函数自然具有边际递减/子模性质）的高效执行。
Method: 提出 DOG 算法，整合对抗性赌博机学习与延迟反馈机制，使各智能体无需顺序协调即可在任意网络拓扑下同时做出决策。
Result: 摘要报告 DOG 对最优解的近似性能，并刻画因去中心化产生的次优性代价与网络结构的关系；分析进一步揭示协调性能与收敛时间之间的权衡，其具体形态由通信延迟大小决定，DOG 可覆盖集中式与一跳协调方法之间的谱段。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 DOG 通过同时决策避免了顺序多跳通信的延迟与连通性限制，同时相对一跳邻居协调提升了协调能力，代价是以网络结构函数形式体现的次优性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Doctorina MedBench: A Dialogue-Based Benchmark and Evaluation Framework for Agent-Based Medical AI
papers.abstract_en: We present Doctorina MedBench, an evaluation framework for agent-based medical AI based on the simulation of physician-patient interactions. Unlike traditional medical benchmarks that rely on solving standardized test questions, the proposed approach models a multi-step clinical dialogue in which an AI system must collect medical history, analyze available synthetic attachments when present, formulate differential diagnoses, and provide diagnostic and management recommendations. System performance is evaluated across separate task-level domains, including diagnosis, differential diagnosis, treatment, safety-critical condition handling, and dialogue-step behavior; the broader D.O.T.S. framework is used as a supplementary summary for diagnosis, observations/investigations, treatment, and step count. The framework also supports testing and quality-monitoring workflows intended to identify changes in model behavior during development. It supports safety-oriented cases, category-based sampling of synthetic clinical scenarios, and regression-style comparisons across system versions. In the reported study, the analyzed paired complete-case cohort consisted of 254 physician-authored synthetic clinical cases retained from 261 attempted case identifiers. The evaluation metrics are intended for comparative research on interactive medical AI systems and for studying clinical reasoning workflows in synthetic dialogue settings. Our results suggest that simulated clinical dialogue can provide a complementary assessment setting to traditional examination-style benchmarks, while the reported findings do not establish independent clinical validity, clinical effectiveness, or readiness for real-world deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Doctorina MedBench，一个基于医患对话模拟的智能体医疗 AI 评估框架。与依赖标准化试题的传统医学基准不同，它让 AI 系统在多步临床对话中采集病史、分析合成附件、形成鉴别诊断并给出诊疗建议，并按诊断、治疗、安全关键情况处理等任务级域评估。文中用 254 个医生撰写的合成临床病例展示该框架作为传统考试式基准的补充评估场景，但强调结果不构成临床有效性或部署就绪的证据。
Motivation: 传统医学基准依赖标准化试题，难以评估多步交互式临床推理能力，因此缺少能模拟医生-患者对话并考核病史采集、鉴别诊断等行为的评估设置。
Method: 构建多步骤临床对话模拟框架，包含诊断、鉴别诊断、治疗、安全关键情况处理和对话步行为等任务级评估域，并使用 D.O.T.S. 框架作为诊断、检查、治疗与步数的补充总结；框架还支持安全导向案例、合成临床场景的类别化采样以及跨版本回归比较。
Result: 研究报告了从 261 个案例标识中保留 254 个医生撰写的合成临床病例的配对完整案例队列，结果表明模拟临床对话可作为传统考试式基准的补充评估场景。
Conclusion: 作者指出该框架适用于交互式医疗 AI 系统的对比研究和合成对话中临床推理流程的研究，但明确表示报告结果未建立独立的临床有效性、临床效果或真实世界部署就绪性。

papers.title: SHARP: Spectrum-aware Highly-dynamic Adaptation for Resolution Promotion in Remote Sensing Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image synthesis for remote sensing (RS) lacks an accessible, high-performance generative foundation, as directly training diffusion models at large, high resolutions is computationally prohibitive. Training-free resolution promotion via Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) extrapolation offers an efficient alternative, but existing algorithms apply static scaling rules tailored to natural scenes, whereas RS imagery is dominated by dense, minute instances that hinge on high-frequency structural integrity. We present a comprehensive framework for large-scale RS synthesis. First, we curate over 100{,}000 image-text pairs to train RS-FLUX, a domain-specialized generative prior. Second, we propose \textbf{SHARP}, a training-free extrapolation algorithm that introduces a Rational Decay Scheduler to modulate RoPE frequencies throughout denoising: strong positional extrapolation early on enforces coherent global layouts, and progressive relaxation later recovers dense high-frequency details. Extensive experiments show that SHARP consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple promoted resolutions with negligible ($<$4\%) overhead, offering an efficient and structurally faithful solution for large-scale RS generation.
papers.comment: Accepted by the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM 2026)
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对遥感图像文本生成在大分辨率下的训练成本问题，提出域专用生成先验 RS-FLUX 和免训练外推算法 SHARP。SHARP 通过 Rational Decay Scheduler 在去噪过程中动态调制 RoPE 频率：早期强位置外推保证全局布局，后期逐步放松以恢复密集高频细节。实验显示其在多个提升分辨率上达到 state-of-the-art 性能，且额外开销小于 4%。
Motivation: 遥感图像的文本生成缺少高性能生成基础模型，直接在大分辨率下训练扩散模型计算代价过高；现有免训练的 RoPE 外推采用针对自然场景的静态缩放规则，而遥感图像以密集、微小的目标为主，依赖高频结构完整性。
Method: 构建超过 100,000 个图像-文本对训练域专用生成先验 RS-FLUX；提出免训练外推算法 SHARP，引入 Rational Decay Scheduler 在去噪过程中调制 RoPE 频率，先通过强位置外推保持全局布局连贯，再逐步放松以恢复高频细节。
Result: 摘要报告 SHARP 在多个提升分辨率上一致取得 state-of-the-art 性能，且额外开销可忽略（小于 4%）。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 SHARP 为大尺度遥感图像生成提供了高效且结构保真的免训练分辨率提升方案。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Minimax and Adaptive Covariance Matrix Estimation under Differential Privacy
papers.abstract_en: Estimating covariance matrices is fundamental to a wide range of statistical applications. This paper studies minimax and adaptive estimation of high-dimensional covariance matrices under $ρ$-zero-concentrated differential privacy ($ρ$-zCDP) over three nested classes: the pointwise-decay class $\mathcal{H}_α$, the row-tail class $\mathcal{G}_α$, and the separated-block class $\mathcal{F}_α$. We consider both squared operator norm loss and normalized squared Frobenius norm loss. For $\mathcal{H}_α$ and $\mathcal{G}_α$, we develop center--outer dyadic estimators tailored to the refined geometry of the two classes, while for $\mathcal{F}_α$, we develop a blockwise tridiagonal estimator. The resulting minimax-optimal rates reveal a nontrivial interplay among the smoothness $α$, the loss, the geometry of the covariance class, and the privacy constraint. In contrast to the non-private setting, privacy distinguishes covariance classes that share the same leading non-private rate and induces a polynomial dependence on the ambient dimension. We further develop procedures that adapt to the unknown decay parameter over all three covariance classes under both losses, at the cost of at most polylogarithmic factors. To establish minimax lower bounds, we develop a novel differentially private van Trees inequality that connects Fisher information with the $ρ$-zCDP constraint and may be useful for other private estimation problems. We also construct carefully designed prior distributions to obtain matching minimax lower bounds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究ρ-零集中差分隐私（ρ-zCDP）下高维协方差矩阵的极小极大与自适应估计，覆盖点衰减类H_α、行尾类G_α和分离块类F_α三类嵌套协方差结构，同时考虑算子范数与归一化Frobenius范数损失。作者为不同类设计中心-外部二元估计量与块三对角估计量，并给出极小极大最优速率，揭示光滑度α、损失、协方差类几何与隐私约束之间的非平凡相互作用。
Motivation: 协方差矩阵估计是统计应用的基础，但高维环境下差分隐私约束下的估计问题尚缺乏完整的极小极大理论，尤其是不同协方差结构类之间的速率差异未被充分刻画。
Method: 针对H_α和G_α类提出中心-外部二元估计量（center-outer dyadic estimators），针对F_α类提出块三对角估计量（blockwise tridiagonal estimator）；还开发了适应未知衰减参数的自适应程序，并提出结合Fisher信息与ρ-zCDP约束的差分隐私van Trees不等式用于极小极大下界。
Result: 得到的极小极大最优速率显示隐私区分了具有相同非私有主导速率的协方差类，并在环境维度上引入多项式依赖；自适应程序在两种损失下至多损失多对数因子。
Conclusion: 摘要强调隐私约束对高维协方差估计速率结构有本质影响，所发展的私有van Trees不等式可为其他私有估计问题提供工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Automatic Termination Strategy of Inelastic Neutron-scattering Measurement Using Bayesian Optimization for Bin-width Selection
papers.abstract_en: Currently, an excessive amount of event data is being obtained in four-dimensional inelastic neutron-scattering experiments. A method for automatic bin-width optimization of multidimensional histograms has been developed and recently validated on real inelastic neutron-scattering data. However, measuring beyond the equipment resolution leads to inefficient use of valuable beam time. To improve experimental efficiency, an automatic termination strategy is essential. We propose a Bayesian-optimization-based method to compute a stopping criterion that can support online decisions on whether to continue or terminate an experiment. In the proposed method, the bin-width optimization is performed using Bayesian optimization to efficiently compute the optimal bin widths. The experiment is terminated when the optimal bin widths become smaller than the target resolutions. In numerical experiments using real inelastic neutron-scattering data, the optimal bin widths decrease as the number of events increases. Even the optimal bin widths for data downsampled to 1/5 are comparable with the resolutions limited by the sample size, choppers, and so on. This implies excessive measurement of the inelastic neutron experiments for the moment. Moreover, we found that Bayesian optimization can reduce the search cost to approximately 10% of an exhaustive search in our numerical experiments.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 6 figures; revised version under review at Journal of the Physical Society of Japan (JPSJ)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对四维非弹性中子散射实验中获得过量事件数据的问题，提出一种基于贝叶斯优化 (Bayesian optimization) 的自动终止策略。该方法通过贝叶斯优化高效计算最优分箱宽度 (bin widths)，并在最优分箱宽度小于目标分辨率时建议终止实验，从而支持在线决定继续或停止测量。数值实验表明，最优分箱宽度随事件数增加而减小，即使数据降采样到 1/5，其最优分箱宽度也与样品尺寸、斩波器等决定的分辨率相当，暗示当前实验存在过度测量。
Motivation: 非弹性中子散射实验通常获得远超设备分辨率的过量事件数据，导致宝贵的束流时间被低效使用；缺乏自动判断何时停止测量的策略，因此需要一种能够在线支持终止决策的方法。
Method: 提出基于贝叶斯优化的终止判据：利用贝叶斯优化高效计算多维直方图的最优分箱宽度，当最优分箱宽度小于实验目标分辨率时判定实验可以终止，以较低的计算成本支持在线决策。
Result: 在真实非弹性中子散射数据的数值实验中，最优分箱宽度随事件数增加而下降；即使数据降采样至 1/5，最优分箱宽度仍与样品尺寸、斩波器等限制的分辨率相当，表明当前实验数据已过量。此外，贝叶斯优化可将搜索成本降低到穷举搜索的大约 10%。
Conclusion: 作者认为当前非弹性中子散射实验存在过度测量，所提出的自动终止策略可提升实验效率；该结论基于真实数据的数值实验，尚未给出实际束流实验中的端到端验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OTPL-VIO: Robust Visual-Inertial Odometry with Optimal Transport Line Association and Adaptive Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Robust stereo visual-inertial odometry (VIO) remains challenging in low-texture scenes and under abrupt illumination changes, where point features become sparse and unstable, leading to ambiguous association and under-constrained estimation. Line structures offer complementary geometric cues, yet many efficient point-line systems still rely on point-guided line association, which can break down when point support is weak and may lead to biased constraints. We present a stereo point-line VIO system in which line segments are equipped with dedicated deep descriptors and matched using an entropy-regularized optimal transport formulation, which performs global mass-transport assignment and supports unmatched observations under ambiguity, outliers, and partial observations. The proposed descriptor is training-free and is computed by sampling and pooling network feature maps. To improve estimation stability, we analyze the impact of line measurement noise and introduce reliability-adaptive weighting to regulate the influence of line constraints during optimization. Experiments on EuRoC and UMA-VI, together with real-world deployments in low-texture and illumination-challenging environments, demonstrate improved accuracy and robustness over representative baselines while maintaining real-time performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OTPL-VIO，一种立体点线视觉惯性里程计 (VIO) 系统，用熵正则化的最优传输 (optimal transport) 进行线特征关联，并为线段配备免训练的深度描述子。系统还引入可靠性自适应加权以调节线约束在优化中的影响。实验在 EuRoC 和 UMA-VI 以及低纹理、光照剧变环境中的真实部署中，相比代表性基线提升了精度和鲁棒性，同时保持实时性能。
Motivation: 低纹理场景和突然光照变化下点特征稀疏且不稳定，导致关联模糊和位姿估计欠约束；现有高效点线系统依赖点引导的线关联，点支撑弱时会失效并引入有偏约束。
Method: 构建立体点线 VIO 系统：为线段提取深度描述子（免训练，通过采样和池化网络特征图得到），并用熵正则化的最优传输公式做全局质量传输分配，支持在模糊、异常值和部分观测下的未匹配观测；同时分析线测量噪声影响，引入可靠性自适应加权调节线约束。
Result: 在 EuRoC 和 UMA-VI 基准以及低纹理、光照挑战环境中的真实部署中，相比代表性基线改善了精度和鲁棒性，并保持实时性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将最优传输线关联与自适应不确定性加权结合，可提升点线 VIO 在退化场景中的稳定性和准确性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Agentic Neurosymbolic Collaboration for Mathematical Discovery: A Case Study in Combinatorial Design
papers.abstract_en: We study mathematical discovery through the lens of neurosymbolic reasoning, where an AI agent powered by a large language model (LLM), coupled with symbolic computation tools, and human strategic direction, jointly produced a new result in combinatorial design theory. The main result of this human-AI collaboration is a tight lower bound on the imbalance of Latin squares for the notoriously difficult case $n \equiv 1 \pmod{3}$. We reconstruct the discovery process from detailed interaction logs spanning multiple sessions over several days and identify the distinct cognitive contributions of each component. The AI agent proved effective at uncovering hidden structure and generating hypotheses. The symbolic component consists of computer algebra, constraint solvers, and simulated annealing, which provides rigorous verification and exhaustive enumeration. Human steering supplied the critical research pivot that transformed a dead end into a productive inquiry. Our analysis reveals that multi-model deliberation among frontier LLMs proved reliable for criticism and error detection but unreliable for constructive claims. The resulting human-AI mathematical contribution, a tight lower bound of $4n(n{-}1)/9$, is achieved via a novel class of near-perfect permutations. The bound was formally verified in Lean 4. Our experiments show that neurosymbolic systems can indeed produce genuine discoveries in pure mathematics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究神经符号（neurosymbolic）人机协作下的数学发现，以组合设计理论中拉丁方（Latin square）的失衡下界为例。由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的 AI 智能体、符号计算工具与人类策略指导协作，在困难的 n ≡ 1 (mod 3) 情形下证明了拉丁方失衡的紧下界 4n(n−1)/9，并通过 Lean 4 形式化验证。作者从多日多会话的详细交互日志中重构发现过程，并分析各组件各自的认知贡献。
Motivation: 纯数学中能否由神经符号系统产生真正的新发现在此前尚不明确；论文针对拉丁方失衡这一公认困难问题，探究 LLM、符号工具与人类指导的协作能否产出可验证的新数学结果。
Method: 提出人机协作研究框架：LLM 智能体负责揭示隐藏结构与生成猜想；符号组件包括计算机代数、约束求解器和模拟退火，提供严格验证与穷尽枚举；人类提供关键的策略转向，将死胡同转化为有效研究路径。此外，利用多个前沿 LLM 之间的多模型讨论（multi-model deliberation）进行批评与错误检测，并引入一类新的近完美排列（near-perfect permutations）。
Result: 主要结果是拉丁方失衡的紧下界 4n(n−1)/9，适用于 n ≡ 1 (mod 3) 的困难情形，且该界经 Lean 4 形式化验证。分析显示 AI 智能体在发现隐藏结构和生成假设方面有效；多模型讨论在批评与错误检测上可靠，但在建设性论断上不可靠，人类的策略指引是取得突破的关键。
Conclusion: 实验表明神经符号系统确实能在纯数学中产生真正的发现，但依赖于符号工具的严格验证与人类战略指导的配合；作者强调多模型讨论适合批判性任务而非建设性任务。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.motivation: 纯数学中能否由神经符号系统产生真正的新发现在此前尚不明确；论文针对拉丁方失衡这一公认困难问题，探究 LLM、符号工具与人类指导的协作能否产出可验证的新数学结果。
summary_sections.method: 提出人机协作研究框架：LLM 智能体负责揭示隐藏结构与生成猜想；符号组件包括计算机代数、约束求解器和模拟退火，提供严格验证与穷尽枚举；人类提供关键的策略转向，将死胡同转化为有效研究路径。此外，利用多个前沿 LLM 之间的多模型讨论（multi-model deliberation）进行批评与错误检测，并引入一类新的近完美排列（near-perfect permutations）。
summary_sections.result: 主要结果是拉丁方失衡的紧下界 4n(n−1)/9，适用于 n ≡ 1 (mod 3) 的困难情形，且该界经 Lean 4 形式化验证。分析显示 AI 智能体在发现隐藏结构和生成假设方面有效；多模型讨论在批评与错误检测上可靠，但在建设性论断上不可靠，人类的策略指引是取得突破的关键。
summary_sections.conclusion: 实验表明神经符号系统确实能在纯数学中产生真正的发现，但依赖于符号工具的严格验证与人类战略指导的配合；作者强调多模型讨论适合批判性任务而非建设性任务。

papers.title: SEAR: Sample Efficient Action Chunking Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Action chunking improves exploration and accelerates value propagation in long-horizon reinforcement learning, but naively applying off-policy methods to the temporally extended action space at reduced decision frequency offsets these gains, leading to poor sample efficiency. Existing online action chunking methods address these issues through computationally expensive critic-only approaches or by relying on offline data. We introduce SEAR, a sample-efficient off-policy algorithm that enables online reinforcement learning with action chunks by addressing both challenges. To handle high-dimensional action sequences, SEAR employs a causal transformer critic trained with multi-horizon targets that provide a training signal for every prefix of an action chunk, effectively increasing the useful gradients per sample. To restore decision frequency, SEAR operates with a receding horizon and random replanning, ensuring uniform state coverage while combining the fast value propagation of large chunks with the reactivity of small ones. SEAR outperforms state-of-the-art online reinforcement learning methods including SimbaV2 on challenging Metaworld manipulation tasks. Beyond online RL, applying SEAR to the offline-to-online method QC improves its performance on the demanding OGBench cube-triple tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SEAR，一种样本高效的离策略（off-policy）强化学习算法，用于在线动作分块（action chunking）学习。SEAR 使用带多视界目标（multi-horizon targets）的因果 Transformer critic，为动作块的每个前缀提供训练信号；并通过后退视界（receding horizon）与随机重规划来恢复决策频率，兼顾大块动作的快速价值传播和小块动作的响应性。摘要报告 SEAR 在 Metaworld 操作任务上优于包括 SimbaV2 在内的现有在线 RL 方法，并将其应用于 offline-to-online 方法 QC 后提升了 OGBench cube-triple 任务上的表现。
Motivation: 动作分块能改善长视界强化学习中的探索并加速价值传播，但将离策略方法直接应用于时间扩展的动作空间并以降低的决策频率运行时，会抵消这些收益，导致样本效率低下。现有在线动作分块方法要么依赖计算昂贵的 critic-only 方案，要么依赖离线数据。
Method: SEAR 提出一种样本高效的离策略算法，同时处理高维动作序列和决策频率下降两个问题。它采用带多视界目标的因果 Transformer critic，使动作块中每个前缀都能获得训练信号，从而增加每个样本的有效梯度；并以后退视界和随机重规划运行，确保均匀状态覆盖，同时结合大动作块和小动作块的优势。
Result: 摘要报告 SEAR 在具有挑战性的 Metaworld 操作任务上优于包括 SimbaV2 在内的最先进在线 RL 方法；将 SEAR 应用于 offline-to-online 方法 QC 后，也提升了其在要求较高的 OGBench cube-triple 任务上的性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，多视界 critic 目标与后退视界/随机重规划相结合，可以在在线环境中实现样本高效的动作分块强化学习，并增强下游 offline-to-online 方法的表现。摘要未提及明确的局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: General Bayesian Policy Learning
papers.abstract_en: This study proposes a General Bayes framework for policy learning. We consider decision problems in which a decision-maker chooses an action from a given set to maximize expected welfare. Typical examples include treatment choice and portfolio optimization. In such problems, the statistical target is a decision rule, and predicting each potential outcome is not necessarily of primary interest. We formulate this policy-learning problem through loss-based Bayesian updating. Our main technical device is a squared-loss surrogate for welfare maximization. We show that maximizing empirical welfare over a policy class with a quadratic penalty controlled by a tuning parameter $ζ>0$ is equivalent to minimizing a scaled squared error in the outcome difference. The resulting General Bayes posterior over decision rules admits two equivalent characterizations: a Gaussian pseudo-likelihood representation and a decision-theoretic loss-based characterization. As one implementation, we introduce GBPLNet, a neural network implementation with a tanh-squashed output. Finally, we establish PAC-Bayes-type guarantees for the surrogate risk and the corresponding penalized welfare.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于政策学习 (policy learning) 的 General Bayes 框架，用平方损失代理 (squared-loss surrogate) 将福利最大化问题转化为带二次惩罚的经验福利最大化，并由此构造决策规则后验。后验存在两种等价刻画：高斯伪似然表示和基于决策论的损失表示。作者还给出神经网络实现 GBPLNet，并为代理风险和惩罚福利建立了 PAC-Bayes 类型保证。
Motivation: 在治疗选择、投资组合优化等决策问题中，统计目标应当是决策规则本身，而非逐一预测每个潜在结果；现有贝叶斯方法缺乏直接以决策损失为基础的更新方式。
Method: 提出以平方损失代理福利最大化，证明在政策类上以由调参参数 ζ 控制的二次惩罚最大化经验福利，等价于最小化结果差异的缩放平方误差。由此定义 General Bayes 后验，给出高斯伪似然与决策论损失两种等价形式，并设计带 tanh 压缩输出的神经网络实现 GBPLNet。
Result: 摘要未报告数值实验，主要结果为理论性质：针对代理风险 (surrogate risk) 和对应的惩罚福利建立 PAC-Bayes 类型保证。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架将政策学习纳入损失驱动的贝叶斯更新范式，并提供可扩展的神经网络实现与理论保障。

papers.title: Stochastic Neural Networks for Quantum Devices
papers.abstract_en: This work presents a formulation to express and optimize stochastic neural networks as quantum circuits in gate-based quantum computing. Motivated by a classical perceptron, stochastic artificial neurons are introduced and combined into a quantum neural network. The Kiefer-Wolfowitz algorithm in combination with simulated annealing is used for training the network weights. Several topologies and models are presented, including shallow fully connected networks, Hopfield Networks, Restricted Boltzmann Machines, Autoencoders and convolutional neural networks. We also demonstrate the combination of our optimized neural networks as an oracle for the Grover algorithm to realize a quantum generative AI model.
papers.comment: 15 pages; v2: 19 pages. Some extensions and clarifications
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种将随机神经网络表达并优化为门控量子计算中量子电路的形式化方法。受经典感知机启发，作者引入随机人工神经元并将其组合成量子神经网络，用 Kiefer-Wolfowitz 算法结合模拟退火训练网络权重，并展示了浅层全连接网络、Hopfield 网络、受限玻尔兹曼机、自编码器和卷积神经网络等多种拓扑；此外还将优化后的神经网络作为 Grover 算法的 oracle，构造量子生成式 AI 模型。
Motivation: 在门控量子计算设备上表达和训练随机神经网络仍缺乏统一的形式化框架，论文旨在为量子设备上的神经网络提供可实现的构造与训练方案。
Method: 从经典感知机出发定义随机人工神经元，组合成量子神经网络；使用 Kiefer-Wolfowitz 随机逼近算法配合模拟退火更新权重；给出多种网络拓扑，并将训练好的网络作为 oracle 嵌入 Grover 算法以形成量子生成模型。
Result: 摘要未报告量化的实验数值；主要内容是提出上述形式化构造、多个网络拓扑以及在 Grover 算法中应用该模型作为 oracle 的演示。
Conclusion: 论文声称其框架能够在量子电路中表达并优化多种随机神经网络，并可作为构建量子生成式 AI 的组件；摘要未讨论具体基准或局限性。

papers.title: Spa3R: Predictive Spatial Field Modeling for 3D Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models excel at 2D visual understanding but remain limited in 3D spatial reasoning. Existing approaches either depend on explicit 3D modalities, which limits scalability, or inject partial, view-conditioned geometric priors and leave the language model to recover global scene structure from sparse cues. We introduce Spa3R, a self-supervised framework that learns a unified, view-invariant spatial representation from unposed multi-view RGB images. Its Predictive Spatial Field Modeling objective compresses context views into a compact latent representation and predicts aligned geometric and semantic feature fields at novel viewpoints, thereby encouraging coherent encoding of scene geometry and layout. We integrate the pre-trained Spa3R Encoder into a vision-language model through a lightweight residual cross-attention adapter, yielding Spa3-VLM and grounding language reasoning in global spatial context. Spa3-VLM achieves an average score of 58.6% on VSI-Bench and delivers leading or competitive performance across three additional spatial reasoning benchmarks. These results demonstrate that predictive spatial representation learning provides an effective visual foundation for 3D reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Spa3R，一个自监督框架，从无位姿的多视角 RGB 图像学习统一、视角不变的三维空间表示。其 Predictive Spatial Field Modeling 目标将上下文视图压缩为紧凑隐表示，并在新视角预测对齐的几何与语义特征场，从而编码场景几何与布局。作者将该预训练编码器通过轻量残差交叉注意力适配器接入视觉语言模型，得到 Spa3-VLM，在 VSI-Bench 上平均得分 58.6%，并在三个额外空间推理基准上取得领先或具竞争力的表现。
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在二维视觉理解上表现优异，但三维空间推理能力有限；现有方法要么依赖显式三维模态从而限制可扩展性，要么仅注入部分视角相关的几何先验，让语言模型从稀疏线索中恢复全局场景结构。
Method: 提出自监督的 Spa3R 框架，使用 Predictive Spatial Field Modeling 目标，把上下文多视图压缩成紧凑隐表示，并预测新视角下的对齐几何与语义特征场；随后通过轻量残差交叉注意力适配器将 Spa3R 编码器集成到视觉语言模型中，形成 Spa3-VLM。
Result: Spa3-VLM 在 VSI-Bench 上取得 58.6% 的平均得分，并在另外三个空间推理基准上表现领先或具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 结果表明，预测式空间表示学习能够为三维视觉推理提供有效的视觉基础。

papers.title: From Approximation Rates to Loss-Landscape Barrier Decay in Shallow ReLU Networks
papers.abstract_en: We study pathwise connectivity of sublevel sets for one-hidden-layer ReLU networks with constrained first-layer weights and an $\ell_1$ penalty on the output layer. The data term is assumed convex and globally Lipschitz in the scalar logit. We first give a finite-width construction that connects any two points of a common sublevel through a path controlled by a loss-consistent compression functional and a first-order perturbation term. The proof replaces the quadratic perturbation estimate in the Freeman--Bruna mechanism by a direct Lipschitz bound. Positive homogeneity is then used in a direction that is compatible with the penalty: every active atom is moved monotonically from the unit ball to the unit sphere while its output coefficient is reduced. Sphere covering and cluster merging consequently give $O(m^{-1/(n-1)})$ fixed-level thickening for $n\ge2$, while the one-dimensional two-ray dictionary gives exact connectivity for every $m\ge4$. We also prove internally that the regularized approximation values satisfy $e(l)-e_\infty=O(l^{-1/2})$. More generally, a rate $O(l^{-s})$ transfers to a near-optimal barrier rate $O(m^{-s/((n-1)s+1)})$; under the standing assumptions, this yields the explicit rate $O(m^{-1/(n+1)})$. A theorem-aligned finite-distribution experiment complements the analysis. The primary Huber run yields a maximal best certified upper gap $1.66\times10^{-5}$ over 720 recorded pairs at widths $m\ge16$; a matched binary-cross-entropy rerun and a 720-endpoint dense-representation stress test probe loss robustness and the active cluster-merging mechanism.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究单隐层 ReLU 网络（约束第一层权重、输出层施加 ℓ1 惩罚）在凸且全局 Lipschitz 数据项下的子水平集路径连通性。作者给出有限宽度构造，用损失一致的压缩泛函和一阶扰动项连接同一子水平集中的任意两点，并以直接 Lipschitz 界替换 Freeman–Bruna 机制中的二次扰动估计。正齐次性被用于在惩罚兼容方向上移动激活原子，从而得到 O(m^{-1/(n-1)}) 的固定水平加粗率与正则化近似值的 O(l^{-1/2}) 率。
Motivation: 现有损失景观连通性分析依赖于二次扰动估计，难以处理带 ℓ1 惩罚和权重约束的浅层 ReLU 网络。本文旨在建立这类网络的路径连通性与障碍衰减（barrier decay）的明确速率。
Method: 采用有限宽度构造：通过损失一致的压缩泛函和显式一阶扰动项连接子水平集中的点；利用 ReLU 正齐次性将活动原子从单位球单调移动到单位球面并同步缩减输出系数，再通过球面覆盖与簇合并证明连通性。正则化近似值的速率通过内部推导的 e(l)-e∞=O(l^{-1/2}) 给出，并推广到一般速率传递公式。
Result: 对于 n≥2，得到 O(m^{-1/(n-1)}) 的固定水平加粗率；一维双射线字典在 m≥4 时给出精确连通性。在既有假设下导出显式障碍率 O(m^{-1/(n+1)})。实验部分报告主 Huber 运行在宽度 m≥16、720 对端点上得到最大最优认证上间隙 1.66×10^{-5}，并辅以二元交叉熵重跑与 720 端点稠密表示压力测试。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，将二次扰动估计替换为 Lipschitz 界并利用正齐次性的单调移动，可以在带惩罚的浅层 ReLU 网络中建立接近最优的障碍衰减率。分析依赖凸且全局 Lipschitz 的数据项，实验仅作为定理对齐的有限分布验证。

papers.title: Physics-Informed Laplace Neural Operator for Solving Partial Differential Equations
papers.abstract_en: Neural operators have emerged as fast surrogate solvers for parametric partial differential equations (PDEs). However, purely data-driven models often require extensive training data and can generalize poorly, especially in small-data regimes and under unseen (out-of-distribution) input functions that are not represented in the training data. To address these limitations, we propose the Physics-Informed Laplace Neural Operator (PILNO), which enhances the Laplace Neural Operator (LNO) by embedding governing physics into training through PDE, boundary condition, and initial condition residuals. To improve expressivity, we first introduce an Advanced LNO (ALNO) backbone that retains a pole-residue transient representation while replacing the steady-state branch with an FNO-style Fourier multiplier. To make physics-informed training both data-efficient and robust, PILNO further leverages (i) virtual inputs: an unlabeled ensemble of input functions spanning a broad spectral range that provides abundant physics-only supervision and explicitly targets out-of-distribution (OOD) regimes; and (ii) temporal-causality weighting: a time-decaying reweighting of the physics residual that prioritizes early-time dynamics and stabilizes optimization for time-dependent PDEs. Across four representative benchmarks -- Burgers' equation, Darcy flow, a reaction-diffusion system, and a forced KdV equation -- PILNO consistently improves accuracy in small-data settings (e.g., N_train <= 27), reduces run-to-run variability across random seeds, and achieves stronger OOD generalization with respect to input function statistics than purely data-driven baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出物理信息拉普拉斯神经算子 (PILNO)，通过在训练中嵌入 PDE、边界条件和初始条件残差来增强 Laplace Neural Operator (LNO)。作者先引入 Advanced LNO (ALNO) 骨干结构，保留 pole-residue 瞬态表示并用 FNO 风格的傅里叶乘法器替换稳态分支；随后利用虚拟输入 (virtual inputs) 和时间因果加权 (temporal-causality weighting) 强化物理监督。在 Burgers 方程、Darcy 流、反应扩散系统和受迫 KdV 方程四个基准上，PILNO 在小数据场景下一致提升精度，降低随机种子的运行间方差，并取得更强的分布外 (OOD) 泛化。
Motivation: 纯数据驱动的神经算子需要大量训练数据，在小数据场景和训练数据未覆盖的分布外输入函数下泛化较差，这限制了其作为参数化 PDE 快速代理求解器的实用价值。
Method: PILNO 在 LNO 基础上引入物理残差（PDE、边界条件、初始条件）进行训练，并使用 ALNO 骨干结构结合 pole-residue 瞬态表示与 FNO 风格傅里叶乘法器。训练策略包括虚拟输入（横跨宽谱范围的未标注输入函数集成，提供纯物理监督并显式覆盖 OOD 区域）和时间因果加权（对物理残差施加随时间衰减的重加权，优先早期动力学并稳定时间依赖 PDE 的优化）。
Result: 在 Burgers 方程、Darcy 流、反应扩散系统和受迫 KdV 方程四个基准上，PILNO 在小数据设置（如 N_train <= 27）下一致提升精度，降低不同随机种子间的运行间变异性，并在输入函数统计分布外场景中取得比纯数据驱动基线更强的泛化。
Conclusion: 摘要强调物理信息训练结合虚拟输入和时间因果加权可使 LNO 在数据稀缺和分布外场景下更高效、更稳健；其验证范围限于上述四个 PDE 基准。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Training and Benchmarking Code Generation for Physics-Inspired Animations
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have been widely studied in areas such as mathematical reasoning, complex coding, and scientific problem solving. However, their ability to generate executable code that visually depicts physical scenarios and their qualitative dynamics remains underexplored. We propose SimuScene, the first systematic study that trains and evaluates LLMs on code generation for physics-inspired animations across 52 concepts spanning five physics domains. We build an automated data collection pipeline with human verification to ensure data quality. The resulting dataset contains 7,659 scenarios, including a 334-example human-verified test set. We evaluate 10 contemporary LLMs and find that even the strongest model achieves only a 21.5\% Avg@8 accuracy, demonstrating the difficulty of generating animations that are both executable and visually aligned with physical scenario descriptions. Finally, we introduce a reinforcement learning pipeline that uses visual rewards from code-generated videos to train text-only LLMs, with a vision-language model evaluating videos through verification questions. Experiments show that training with our data and video-based rewards improves LLM performance on physics-inspired animation generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SimuScene，声称是首个系统训练并评估 LLM 生成物理启发动画代码的研究，覆盖五个物理领域的 52 个概念。作者构建自动化数据收集管线并辅以人工验证，得到 7,659 个场景及 334 个人工验证测试集。评估 10 个当代 LLM 后，最强模型的 Avg@8 仅 21.5%，并进一步提出基于代码生成视频的视觉奖励来训练纯文本 LLM 的强化学习管线。
Motivation: LLM 在数学推理、复杂编码和科学问题求解上已被广泛研究，但其生成可执行代码以视觉呈现物理场景及其定性动力学的能力尚缺乏系统探索。
Method: 提出 SimuScene 数据集与自动化数据收集管线，并引入人工验证保证数据质量；同时提出强化学习训练管线，用代码生成的视频提供视觉奖励，由视觉语言模型通过验证问题评估视频，从而训练纯文本 LLM。
Result: 评测 10 个当代 LLM 时，最强模型在 Avg@8 上仅达到 21.5%，说明生成既可执行又与物理场景描述视觉对齐的动画颇具难度；实验表明使用该数据和基于视频的奖励训练能提升 LLM 在物理启发动画生成上的表现。
Conclusion: 摘要强调所提出数据与视频奖励训练方法可改善 LLM 的物理动画代码生成能力，同时指出该任务仍具挑战性；研究范围限定于物理启发动画，未涉及天气、降水或数据同化等内容。

papers.title: MOSAIC: Unveiling the Moral, Social and Individual Dimensions of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in sensitive applications including psychological support, healthcare, and high-stakes decision-making. This expansion has motivated growing research into the ethical and moral foundations underlying LLM behavior, raising critical questions about their reliability in ethical reasoning. However, existing studies and benchmarks rely almost exclusively on Moral Foundation Theory (MFT), largely neglecting other relevant dimensions such as social values, personality traits, and individual characteristics that shape human ethical reasoning. To address these limitations, we introduce MOSAIC, the first large-scale benchmark designed to jointly assess the moral, social, and individual characteristics of LLMs. The benchmark comprises nine validated questionnaires drawn from moral philosophy, psychology, and social theory, alongside four platform-based games designed to probe morally ambiguous scenarios. In total, MOSAIC includes over 600 curated questions and scenarios, released as a ready-to-use, extensible resource for evaluating the behavioral foundations of LLMs. We validate the benchmark across three models from different families, demonstrating its utility across all assessed dimensions and providing the first empirical evidence that MFT alone is insufficient to comprehensively evaluate complex AI systems' ethical behavior. We publicly release the dataset and our benchmark Python library.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MOSAIC，一个大规模基准，用于联合评估大语言模型（LLM）的道德、社会与个体维度。基准包含来自道德哲学、心理学和社会理论的九份验证问卷，以及四个基于平台的游戏，共 600 多个问题和场景。作者在三个不同家族的模型上验证了该基准，并提供首个经验证据表明仅依赖道德基础理论（MFT）不足以全面评估复杂 AI 系统的伦理行为。数据集和基准 Python 库已公开发布。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 伦理研究几乎完全依赖 Moral Foundation Theory (MFT)，忽略了社会价值观、人格特质和个体特征等影响人类伦理推理的维度。由于 LLM 被部署在心理支持、医疗和高风险决策等敏感场景，需要更全面的伦理评估工具。
Method: 引入 MOSAIC，首个大规模联合评估 LLM 道德、社会与个体特征的基准；包含九份验证过的问卷和四个探测道德模糊场景的平台游戏，总计 600 多个策展题项，并作为即用、可扩展的资源发布，附带基准 Python 库。
Result: 在三个不同模型家族的验证表明该基准能覆盖所有评估维度，并提供首个经验证据说明仅用 MFT 不足以全面评估复杂 AI 系统的伦理行为。
Conclusion: 作者强调 MOSAIC 作为即用、可扩展资源的价值，并指出未来伦理评估应超越 MFT，纳入社会与个体维度。
