papers.title: SpinCastML an Open Decision-Making Application for Inverse Design of Electrospinning Manufacturing: A Machine Learning, Optimal Sampling and Inverse Monte Carlo Approach
papers.abstract_en: Electrospinning is a powerful technique for producing micro to nanoscale fibers with application specific architectures. Small variations in solution or operating conditions can shift the jet regime, generating non Gaussian fiber diameter distributions. Despite substantial progress, no existing framework enables inverse design toward desired fiber outcomes while integrating polymer solvent chemical constraints or predicting full distributions. SpinCastML is an open source, distribution aware, chemically informed machine learning and Inverse Monte Carlo (IMC) software for inverse electrospinning design. Built on a rigorously curated dataset of 68,480 fiber diameters from 1,778 datasets across 16 polymers, SpinCastML integrates three structured sampling methods, a suite of 11 high-performance learners, and chemistry aware constraints to predict not only mean diameter but the entire distribution. Cubist model with a polymer balanced Sobol D optimal sampling provides the highest global performance (R2 > 0.92). IMC accurately captures the fiber distributions, achieving R2 > 0.90 and <1% error between predicted and experimental success rates. The IMC engine supports both retrospective analysis and forward-looking inverse design, generating physically and chemically feasible polymer solvent parameter combinations with quantified success probabilities for user-defined targets. SpinCastML reframes electrospinning from trial and error to a reproducible, data driven design process. As an open source executable, it enables laboratories to analyze their own datasets and co create an expanding community software. SpinCastML reduces experimental waste, accelerates discovery, and democratizes access to advanced modeling, establishing distribution aware inverse design as a new standard for sustainable nanofiber manufacturing across biomedical, filtration, and energy applications.
papers.comment: Paper published at https://doi.org/10.1021/acsomega.6c07333. The associated software developed in this study is released under the GNU GPL 3.0 license and is openly available as a citable archive at https://doi. org/10.5281/zenodo.18557989
papers.journal_ref: Elisa Roldan, Tasneem Sabir; SpinCastML An Open Decision Making Application for Inverse Design of Electrospinning Manufacturing: A Machine Learning, Optimal Sampling, and Inverse Monte Carlo Approach. ACS Omega 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 SpinCastML，一个开源、分布感知、化学信息约束的机器学习与逆蒙特卡洛 (Inverse Monte Carlo, IMC) 软件，用于静电纺丝 (electrospinning) 制造的逆向设计。它基于严格整理的 16 种聚合物、1,778 个数据集中的 68,480 个纤维直径，集成三种结构化采样方法、11 种学习器及化学感知约束，预测纤维直径的完整分布。摘要报告 Cubist 模型结合聚合物平衡的 Sobol D 最优采样达到最高全局性能 (R2 > 0.92)，IMC 对纤维分布实现 R2 > 0.90，预测与实验成功率误差 <1%。
Motivation: 静电纺丝中溶液或操作条件的微小变化会导致射流模式转变和非高斯纤维直径分布；现有框架既不能面向目标纤维结果进行逆向设计，也无法整合聚合物-溶剂化学约束或预测完整分布。
Method: 构建大规模纤维直径数据集，集成三种结构化采样方法、11 种高性能学习器与化学感知约束，训练分布预测模型；并开发 IMC 引擎，支持回顾性分析和前向逆向设计，为自定义纤维目标生成物理化学可行的聚合物-溶剂参数组合及量化成功率。
Result: 摘要报告 Cubist 模型搭配聚合物平衡的 Sobol D 最优采样获得最高全局性能 (R2 > 0.92)；IMC 准确捕获纤维直径分布，R2 > 0.90，预测与实验成功率误差 <1%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 SpinCastML 将静电纺丝从试错过程转变为可复现、数据驱动的设计流程；作为开源软件，它允许实验室分析自有数据并推动社区共建，减少实验浪费并加速发现，面向生物医学、过滤和能源等领域的可持续纳米纤维制造。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Variance Reduction Based Experience Replay for Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Effective reinforcement learning (RL) for complex stochastic systems requires leveraging historical data to improve sample efficiency and accelerate policy optimization. However, classical experience replay treats all past observations uniformly and fails to account for their varying contributions to learning. To address this limitation, we propose Variance Reduction Experience Replay (VRER), a principled framework that selectively reuses informative samples to reduce the variance of policy gradient estimates. VRER is algorithm-agnostic and can be integrated with existing policy optimization methods, yielding the sample-efficient off-policy algorithm, Policy Gradient with VRER (PG-VRER). To provide rigorous theoretical guarantees, we develop a novel analysis framework for experience replay that explicitly accounts for dependencies induced by Markovian dynamics and behavior-policy interactions. Using this framework, we establish finite-time convergence guarantees for PG-VRER and characterize a fundamental bias-variance trade-off: reusing older samples reduces gradient variance but may introduce greater estimation bias. Extensive experiments show that VRER consistently accelerates learning and outperforms state-of-the-art policy optimization algorithms
papers.comment: 46 pages, 6 figures. arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2208.12341
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出方差缩减经验回放 (Variance Reduction Experience Replay, VRER)，通过选择性复用信息量较大的历史样本来降低策略梯度估计的方差，并集成到现有策略优化方法中，得到样本高效的 off-policy 算法 PG-VRER。作者建立了一个显式考虑马尔可夫动力学与行为策略交互所引入依赖性的经验回放分析框架，据此给出 PG-VRER 的有限时间收敛保证，并刻画了偏差-方差权衡。实验表明 VRER 能持续加速学习，并优于现有策略优化算法。
Motivation: 经典经验回放将过去所有观测样本同等对待，未考虑不同样本对学习贡献的差异，限制了复杂随机系统下强化学习的样本效率与策略优化速度。
Method: 提出算法无关的 VRER 框架，选择性重用信息丰富的样本以减小策略梯度估计方差，并可嵌入现有策略优化方法形成 PG-VRER。理论上，构建了一个新的经验回放分析框架，显式处理马尔可夫动力学与行为策略交互导致的样本依赖，从而支持收敛性分析。
Result: 摘要报告了 PG-VRER 的有限时间收敛保证，并刻画了一个基本偏差-方差权衡：重用较旧样本虽降低梯度方差，但可能引入更大的估计偏差。实验显示 VRER 加速学习并在多个任务上优于已有的策略优化算法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 VRER 是算法无关的经验回放框架，可与现有策略优化方法结合，并在理论上阐明了经验回放中样本新旧程度带来的偏差-方差权衡；未报告具体数值指标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DomusFM: A Foundation Model for Event-Based Behavioral Monitoring in Smart-Homes
papers.abstract_en: Smart-home sensor-based behavioral monitoring holds significant potential for healthcare, independent living, and early detection of functional or cognitive changes. In this setting, tasks like activity recognition, prediction, and pattern discovery provide complementary views of daily life, supporting the modeling of personal routines and habits, and their long-term changes. Existing approaches, however, face critical limitations. Supervised approaches require impractical amounts of labeled activity data to capture the variability of daily behavior across residents and environments. Foundation models represent a promising direction for learning transferable representations of latent behavioral patterns from sensor data. Still, current efforts are mostly designed for continuous inertial or physiological sensor data and do not address the sparse, discrete, and semantically rich event streams produced by smart homes. In this paper, we introduce DomusFM, a domain-specific foundation model for sensor-based behavioral monitoring in smart homes based on semantic event streams. DomusFM employs a self-supervised dual contrastive learning paradigm to capture both event-level semantic attributes and sequence-level temporal dependencies. By integrating semantic embeddings from a lightweight language model and specialized encoders for temporal patterns and binary states, DomusFM learns transferable representations that can be adapted across heterogeneous smart-home environments and tasks related to activity and event analysis. Through a leave-one-dataset-out evaluation across seven public smart-home datasets, we demonstrate that DomusFM consistently outperforms baselines on three downstream tasks: ADL recognition, next-k event prediction, and unsupervised clustering. DomusFM has a small footprint and can be deployed on edge devices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DomusFM，一个面向智能家居传感器行为监测的领域专用基础模型（foundation model），其输入是语义事件流（semantic event streams）而非连续的惯性或生理信号。模型采用自监督双对比学习（dual contrastive learning）来同时捕获事件级语义属性和序列级时间依赖，并在七个公开智能家居数据集上通过 leave-one-dataset-out 评估，在 ADL 识别、next-k 事件预测和无监督聚类三个下游任务上一致优于基线。摘要还强调模型体积小，可部署在边缘设备上。
Motivation: 现有监督方法需要大量带标注的活动数据才能覆盖不同住户和环境的日常行为差异；而现有基础模型主要面向连续的惯性或生理传感器数据，无法处理智能家居产生的稀疏、离散且语义丰富的事件流。
Method: DomusFM 采用自监督双对比学习范式，整合轻量级语言模型的语义嵌入，以及针对时间模式和二元状态（binary states）设计的专门编码器，学习可在异构智能家居环境和活动/事件分析任务间迁移的表示。
Result: 在七个公开智能家居数据集上的 leave-one-dataset-out 评估中，DomusFM 在 ADL 识别、next-k 事件预测和无监督聚类三个下游任务上均一致优于基线。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，面向语义事件流的领域专用基础模型能够有效捕获智能家居行为模式并跨环境迁移，且小体积特性使其适合边缘设备部署。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Noise as a Probe: Membership Inference Attacks on Diffusion Models Leveraging Initial Noise
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable progress in image generation, but their increasing deployment raises serious concerns about privacy and copyright. In particular, fine-tuned models are highly vulnerable, as they are often fine-tuned on small and private datasets. Membership inference attacks (MIAs) are used to assess privacy risks by determining whether a specific sample was part of a model's training data. Existing MIAs against diffusion models either assume obtaining the intermediate results or require training the shadow model on auxiliary datasets. In this work, we utilized a critical yet overlooked vulnerability: the widely used noise schedules fail to fully eliminate semantic information in the images, resulting in residual semantic signals even at the maximum noise step. We empirically demonstrate that the fine-tuned diffusion model captures hidden correlations between the residual semantics in initial noise and the original images. Building on this insight, we propose a simple yet effective membership inference attack, which injects semantic information into the initial noise and infers membership by analyzing the model's generation result. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the semantic initial noise can strongly reveal membership information, highlighting the vulnerability of diffusion models to MIAs. Code is available at https://github.com/S3IC-Lab/NoiseMIA.
papers.comment: Accepted to 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散模型在微调小规模私有数据集时面临的隐私泄露问题，提出一种基于初始噪声的成员推理攻击 (MIA)。作者观察到常用的噪声调度 (noise schedule) 即使在最大噪声步也无法完全消除图像语义信息，微调后的扩散模型会捕获初始噪声中残余语义与原图之间的隐藏关联。据此提出的攻击方法通过向初始噪声注入语义信息并分析生成结果来判断成员身份，实验表明该方法能有效揭示成员信息。
Motivation: 扩散模型微调常使用小型私有数据集，存在严重的隐私与版权风险；现有针对扩散模型的成员推理攻击要么需要获取中间结果，要么需要借助辅助数据集训练影子模型 (shadow model)，攻击条件较为苛刻。
Method: 利用噪声调度无法完全抹除图像语义这一漏洞，向初始噪声注入语义信息，再通过分析扩散模型基于该初始噪声的生成结果来推断样本是否属于训练集，从而构建无需影子模型的简单有效成员推理攻击。
Result: 大量实验表明语义化的初始噪声能够强烈地揭示成员信息，凸显了扩散模型面对成员推理攻击时的脆弱性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调扩散模型存在被成员推理攻击利用的固有漏洞，并公开了代码 (NoiseMIA)，提示需要关注此类隐私风险。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Manifold constrained steepest descent for smooth and closed-set optimization
papers.abstract_en: We study minimization of smooth functions over feasible sets that have smooth embedded-manifold structure throughout or only on selected regions, using linear minimization oracles (LMOs) to determine search directions under user-chosen norms. Restricting an LMO to a tangent space, however, can require an iterative inner solve. We propose \emph{Manifold Constrained Steepest Descent} (MCSD) and a tangent-projected variant, MCSD-TP, which avoid solving tangent-space LMO subproblems iteratively. The spectral-norm specialization of MCSD on the Stiefel manifold yields \emph{SPEL}, which admits an efficient implementation using matrix-sign computations. Under standard regularity assumptions, both methods attain an \(O(\log T/\sqrt T)\) best-iterate stationarity bound. For closed feasible sets, the hybrid MCSD--PGD combines either smooth method with projected gradient descent; under the corresponding local smoothness condition, every accumulation point is Bouligand stationary. Experiments on Stiefel-constrained PCA, weighted low-rank approximation, and sparse phase retrieval illustrate the proposed methods.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 3 figures, and 2 tables. Compared to the previous version, introduced a new variant MCSD-TP and a hybrid algorithm MCSD-PGD for close-set optimization
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在可行集具有光滑嵌入流形结构（整体或局部）时，利用线性最小化 oracle（LMO）在用户指定的范数下求解光滑函数最小化问题。作者提出 Manifold Constrained Steepest Descent (MCSD) 及其切空间投影变体 MCSD-TP，避免迭代求解切空间上的 LMO 子问题；在 Stiefel 流形上的谱范数特例 SPEL 可通过矩阵符号计算高效实现。理论上两种方法在标准正则性假设下达到 O(log T / sqrt(T)) 的最优迭代驻点界，混合算法 MCSD-PGD 在闭可行集上保证所有聚点为 Bouligand 驻点。实验覆盖 Stiefel 约束 PCA、加权低秩近似和稀疏相位恢复。
Motivation: 当约束集具有流形结构时，将 LMO 限制到切空间往往需要迭代内层求解，计算代价高；本文旨在设计避免这种内层迭代的下降算法，并给出收敛性保证。
Method: 提出 MCSD 和切投影变体 MCSD-TP，利用 LMO 在用户选择的范数下确定搜索方向但避免求解切空间 LMO 子问题；在 Stiefel 流形上给出谱范数特化算法 SPEL，采用矩阵符号计算实现；对闭可行集提出混合算法 MCSD-PGD，将任一光滑方法与投影梯度下降结合。
Result: 在标准正则性假设下，MCSD 和 MCSD-TP 达到 O(log T / sqrt(T)) 的最佳迭代驻点界；在相应的局部光滑性条件下，MCSD-PGD 的每个聚点都是 Bouligand 驻点。实验在 Stiefel 约束 PCA、加权低秩近似和稀疏相位恢复上验证了所提方法。
Conclusion: 本文表明通过切投影或混合策略可以避免切空间 LMO 的迭代内层求解，并在流形约束和闭集优化中同时获得收敛性保证与高效实现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Safe Exploration via Policy Priors
papers.abstract_en: Safe exploration is a key requirement for reinforcement learning (RL) agents to learn and adapt online, beyond controlled (e.g. simulated) environments. In this work, we tackle this challenge by utilizing suboptimal yet conservative policies (e.g., obtained from offline data or simulators) as priors. Our approach, SOOPER, uses probabilistic dynamics models to optimistically explore, yet pessimistically fall back to the conservative policy prior if needed. We prove that SOOPER guarantees safety throughout learning, and establish convergence to an optimal policy by bounding its cumulative regret. Extensive experiments on key safe RL benchmarks and real-world hardware demonstrate that SOOPER is scalable, outperforms the state-of-the-art and validate our theoretical guarantees in practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SOOPER，一种将次优但保守的策略（如来自离线数据或仿真器）作为先验的安全探索强化学习方法。它使用概率动力学模型进行乐观探索，并在必要时悲观地回退到保守策略先验。作者证明了 SOOPER 在学习过程中保证安全，并通过限制累积遗憾建立了收敛到最优策略的理论保证；在关键安全 RL 基准和真实硬件上的实验表明其具有可扩展性并优于现有方法。
Motivation: 安全探索是强化学习智能体在受控环境之外在线学习的关键要求，而现有方法难以在探索效率与安全保证之间取得平衡。利用次优但保守的策略作为先验，为兼顾安全与学习提供了一条可行途径。
Method: 提出 SOOPER 方法，基于概率动力学模型进行乐观探索，同时设计悲观回退机制，在必要时切换到保守策略先验以维持安全；并给出安全保证与累积遗憾界的理论分析。
Result: 在关键安全 RL 基准和真实硬件上的广泛实验表明，SOOPER 可扩展、优于现有技术水平，并在实践中验证了理论保证。
Conclusion: 摘要强调利用保守策略先验配合乐观探索与悲观回退机制，可以在保证安全的同时实现学习收敛，且方法已在理论与实验中均得到验证。

papers.title: SpaRRTa: A Synthetic Benchmark for Evaluating Spatial Intelligence in Visual Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Visual Foundation Models (VFMs), such as DINO and CLIP, excel in semantic understanding of images but exhibit limited spatial reasoning capabilities, which limits their applicability to embodied systems. As a result, recent work incorporates some 3D tasks (such as depth estimation) into VFM training. However, VFM performance remains inconsistent across other spatial tasks, raising the question of whether these models truly have spatial awareness or overfit to specific 3D objectives. To address this question, we introduce the Spatial Relation Recognition Task (SpaRRTa) benchmark, which evaluates the ability of VFMs to identify relative positions of objects in the image. Unlike traditional 3D objectives that focus on precise metric prediction (e.g., surface normal estimation), SpaRRTa probes a fundamental capability underpinning more advanced forms of human-like spatial understanding. SpaRRTa generates an arbitrary number of photorealistic images with diverse scenes and fully controllable object arrangements, along with freely accessible spatial annotations. Evaluating a range of state-of-the-art VFMs, we reveal significant disparities between their spatial reasoning abilities. Through our analysis, we provide insights into the mechanisms that support or hinder spatial awareness in modern VFMs. We hope that SpaRRTa will serve as a useful tool for guiding the development of future spatially aware visual models.
papers.comment: Project page is available at https://sparrta.gmum.net/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SpaRRTa（Spatial Relation Recognition Task）基准，用于评估视觉基础模型（VFM，如 DINO、CLIP）对图像中物体相对位置的识别能力。基准可生成任意数量的逼真合成图像，场景多样且物体排布完全可控，并附带易获取的空间标注。作者评估了一系列最新 VFM，发现它们的空间推理能力存在显著差异，并分析了支持或阻碍空间意识的机制。
Motivation: 当前 VFM 在图像语义理解上表现优异，但空间推理能力有限，制约了其在具身系统中的应用。尽管已有工作把深度估计等 3D 任务加入训练，模型在其他空间任务上的表现仍不稳定，因此需要厘清模型是否真正具备空间意识还是仅过拟合特定 3D 目标。
Method: 构建 SpaRRTa 基准，核心任务是让 VFM 识别图像中物体的相对位置关系；与传统的精确度量预测（如表面法线估计）不同，该基准探测更基础的空间理解能力。基准通过生成可完全控制物体布局的多样化逼真图像，并提供自由获取的空间标注来支撑评测。
Result: 对一系列最新 VFM 的评估揭示了它们空间推理能力的显著差异；作者还通过分析提供了关于现代 VFM 中支持或阻碍空间意识机制的洞见。
Conclusion: 作者希望 SpaRRTa 能成为引导未来具备空间感知能力的视觉模型开发的实用工具；其范围限定于对视觉基础模型空间关系识别能力的评测与分析。

papers.title: AI for Mycetoma Diagnosis in Histopathological Images: The MICCAI 2024 Challenge
papers.abstract_en: Mycetoma is a neglected tropical disease caused by fungi or bacteria leading to severe tissue damage and disabilities. It affects poor and rural communities and presents medical challenges and socioeconomic burdens on patients and healthcare systems in endemic regions worldwide. Mycetoma diagnosis is a major challenge in mycetoma management, particularly in low-resource settings where expert pathologists are limited. To address this challenge, this paper presents an overview of the Mycetoma MicroImage: Detect and Classify Challenge (mAIcetoma) which was organized to advance mycetoma diagnosis through AI solutions. mAIcetoma focused on developing automated models for segmenting mycetoma grains and classifying mycetoma types from histopathological images. The challenge attracted the attention of several teams worldwide to participate and five finalist teams fulfilled the challenge objectives. The teams proposed various deep learning architectures for the ultimate goal of this challenge. Mycetoma database (MyData) was provided to participants as a standardized dataset to run the proposed models. Those models were evaluated using evaluation metrics. Results showed that all the models achieved high segmentation accuracy, emphasizing the necessitate of grain detection as a critical step in mycetoma diagnosis. In addition, the top-performing models show a significant performance in classifying mycetoma types.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是 MICCAI 2024 上组织的 Mycetoma MicroImage: Detect and Classify Challenge (mAIcetoma) 的综述性总结，目标是利用 AI 从组织病理图像中分割足菌肿颗粒 (mycetoma grains) 并分类足菌肿类型。挑战赛提供了标准化数据集 MyData，全球多支队伍参与，最终五个决赛团队提出多种深度学习架构。结果显示所有模型在分割任务上达到较高准确率，顶级模型在类型分类上也表现显著。
Motivation: 足菌肿是一种被忽视的热带病，在资源匮乏地区缺乏专业病理医生，诊断困难，给患者和医疗系统带来沉重负担。该挑战旨在通过 AI 解决方案推进足菌肿的自动化诊断。
Method: 组织 mAIcetoma 挑战赛，提供标准化的足菌肿组织病理图像数据集 MyData，让参赛团队开发自动化模型，任务包括足菌肿颗粒分割与足菌肿类型分类，并使用评价指标对模型进行统一评估。
Result: 所有参赛模型在分割任务上均取得较高的分割准确率，表明颗粒检测是足菌肿诊断中的关键步骤；排名靠前的模型在足菌肿类型分类上也表现出显著性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 AI 模型可以有效地辅助足菌肿诊断，其中颗粒分割是重要环节，但未给出具体量化指标或模型局限性的讨论。

papers.title: PhysMaster: Building an Autonomous AI Physicist for Theoretical and Computational Physics Research
papers.abstract_en: Advances in LLM reasoning and tool use have enabled agentic science, yet frontier theoretical and computational physics remains challenging because research requires deep domain expertise, long-horizon reasoning, and reliable numerical computation. We introduce PRL-Bench, a research-reproduction benchmark adapted from 100 Physical Review Letters papers across major areas of modern physics. PRL-Bench distills realistic research workflows into traceable tasks with explicit intermediate artifacts and diverse evaluation rubrics; each task is estimated by domain experts to require more than six hours for a specialized PhD student to reproduce independently. Evaluations show that existing agents remain unreliable on extended research workflows. We therefore present PhysMaster, a scientific agent combining adaptive MCTS-based multi-trajectory exploration with hierarchical memory to improve long-horizon robustness and knowledge accumulation. PhysMaster achieves the highest overall PRL-Bench score of 51.08, outperforming Codex, OpenHands, OpenClaw, and ReAct, and yields relative improvements of 14.13 percent to 93.38 percent across backbone models. Error analysis shows that PhysMaster substantially reduces failures from incomplete long-horizon execution, while remaining bottlenecks lie in physics knowledge and analytical reasoning. Together, PRL-Bench and PhysMaster provide a rigorous benchmark and effective system for advancing autonomous AI research in frontier physics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PRL-Bench，一个从 100 篇 Physical Review Letters 论文改编的研究复现基准，用于评估 AI 智能体在理论和计算物理研究中的长程工作流能力；同时提出 PhysMaster 科学智能体，结合自适应 MCTS 多轨迹探索与分层记忆。PhysMaster 在 PRL-Bench 上取得最高总分 51.08，超过 Codex、OpenHands、OpenClaw 和 ReAct，并在不同骨干模型上带来 14.13% 到 93.38% 的相对提升。错误分析显示其主要减少了长程执行不完整导致的失败，但物理知识和分析推理仍是主要瓶颈。
Motivation: 前沿理论和计算物理研究需要深度领域专业知识、长程推理和可靠数值计算，而现有 AI 智能体在扩展研究工作流上仍不可靠。缺乏能够反映真实研究流程并带有可追踪中间产物的基准，阻碍了自主科学智能体的发展。
Method: PRL-Bench 将真实研究工作流提炼为可追踪任务，包含显式中间产物和多样化的评估标准；PhysMaster 则采用自适应基于 MCTS 的多轨迹探索（adaptive MCTS-based multi-trajectory exploration）与分层记忆（hierarchical memory），以提升长程任务鲁棒性和知识积累。
Result: PhysMaster 在 PRL-Bench 上取得最高总分 51.08，优于 Codex、OpenHands、OpenClaw 和 ReAct；跨骨干模型相对提升 14.13% 至 93.38%。错误分析表明 PhysMaster 明显减少了因长程执行不完整造成的失败，但物理知识与分析推理仍是剩余瓶颈。
Conclusion: 作者认为 PRL-Bench 与 PhysMaster 共同为推进自主 AI 物理研究提供了严格基准和有效系统，并指出当前局限在于物理知识掌握与分析推理能力，而非执行长度。

papers.title: RadarGen: Automotive Radar Point Cloud Generation from Cameras
papers.abstract_en: We present RadarGen, a diffusion model for synthesizing realistic automotive radar point clouds from multi-view camera imagery. RadarGen adapts efficient image-latent diffusion to the radar domain by representing radar measurements in bird's-eye-view form that encodes spatial structure together with radar cross section (RCS) and Doppler attributes. A lightweight recovery step reconstructs point clouds from the generated maps. To better align generation with the visual scene, RadarGen incorporates BEV-aligned depth, semantic, and motion cues extracted from pretrained foundation models, which guide the stochastic generation process toward physically plausible radar patterns. Conditioning on images makes the approach broadly compatible, in principle, with existing visual datasets and simulation frameworks, offering a scalable direction for multimodal generative simulation. Evaluations on large-scale driving data show that RadarGen captures characteristic radar measurement distributions and reduces the gap to perception models trained on real data, marking a step toward unified generative simulation across sensing modalities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RadarGen，一个从多视角相机图像合成逼真汽车雷达点云的扩散模型。雷达测量被表示为鸟瞰图（bird's-eye-view）形式，编码空间结构、雷达截面（RCS）与多普勒属性，并通过轻量恢复步骤从生成图中重建点云。生成过程由预训练基础模型提取的 BEV 对齐深度、语义和运动线索引导，使生成结果与视觉场景一致。在大型驾驶数据上的评估显示，RadarGen 能捕捉雷达测量分布，并缩小与真实数据训练的感知模型之间的差距。
Motivation: 现有多模态生成仿真通常缺乏跨传感器模态的统一能力；作者希望利用相机图像作为条件生成雷达点云，从而兼容已有的视觉数据集和仿真框架，为大规模多模态生成仿真提供可扩展方向。
Method: RadarGen 将高效的图像-潜在扩散（image-latent diffusion）适配到雷达域，用 BEV 格式表征带 RCS 和多普勒属性的雷达测量；使用轻量恢复步骤将生成图转换为点云，并引入 BEV 对齐的深度、语义和运动线索作为生成引导，以增强物理合理性。
Result: 基于大型驾驶数据的评估表明，RadarGen 生成的雷达点云分布接近真实测量特性，并减少了与在真实数据上训练的感知模型之间的性能差距；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法标志着跨传感模态统一生成仿真的一步，其图像条件化特性使其在原理上可与现有视觉数据集和仿真框架兼容；摘要未讨论明显局限。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Security and Detectability Analysis of Unicode Text Watermarking Methods against Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Securing digital text is becoming increasingly relevant due to the widespread use of large language models. Individuals' fear of losing control over data when it is being used to train such machine learning models or when distinguishing model-generated output from text written by humans. Digital watermarking provides additional protection by embedding an invisible watermark within the data that requires protection. However, little work has been taken to analyze and verify if existing digital text watermarking methods are secure and undetectable by large language models. In this paper, we investigate the security-related area of watermarking and machine learning models for text data. In a controlled testbed of three experiments, ten existing Unicode text watermarking methods were implemented and analyzed across six large language models: GPT-5, GPT-4o, Teuken 7B, Llama 3.3, Claude Sonnet 4, and Gemini 2.5 Pro. The findings of our experiments indicate that, especially the latest reasoning models, can detect a watermarked text. Nevertheless, all models fail to extract the watermark unless implementation details in the form of source code are provided. We discuss the implications for security researchers and practitioners and outline future research opportunities to address security concerns.
papers.comment: Author's version of a paper, accepted and presented at the ICISSP 2026 conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Unicode 文本水印方法在面对大语言模型时的安全性与可检测性。作者在受控测试台的三组实验中实现了十种现有 Unicode 文本水印方法，并在 GPT-5、GPT-4o、Teuken 7B、Llama 3.3、Claude Sonnet 4 与 Gemini 2.5 Pro 六个模型上进行分析。实验发现，尤其是最新的推理模型能够检测出带水印的文本，但除非提供实现细节（源代码），所有模型都无法提取水印。
Motivation: 数字文本水印被用于保护文本数据，但现有方法是否安全、能否被大语言模型检测或提取，鲜有工作进行分析验证。
Method: 构建受控测试台，实现十种 Unicode 文本水印方法，并在六个不同的大语言模型上设计三组实验，考察模型对带水印文本的检测与提取能力。
Result: 实验表明，最新的推理模型能够检测出带水印的文本；不过所有模型在未获知实现细节（源代码）的情况下均无法提取水印。
Conclusion: 作者讨论了该结果对安全研究者和实践者的影响，并指出未来研究机会以应对这些安全问题。

papers.title: The N-Body Problem: Parallel Execution from Single-Person Egocentric Video
papers.abstract_en: Humans can intuitively parallelise complex activities, but can a model predict this from observing a single person? Given one egocentric video, we introduce the N-Body Problem: predicting how N individuals, can hypothetically perform the same set of tasks. The goal is to maximise speed-up, but naive assignment of video segments to individuals often violates real-world constraints, leading to physically impossible scenarios like two people using the same object or occupying the same space. To quantify this, we formalise the N-Body Problem and propose a suite of metrics to evaluate both performance (speed-up, task coverage) and feasibility (spatial collisions, object conflicts and causal constraints). As a proof of concept, we introduce a structured prompting strategy that guides a Vision-Language Model (VLM) to reason about the 3D environment, object usage, and temporal dependencies, producing a viable parallel execution. On 100 videos from EPIC-Kitchens and HD-EPIC, for $N = 2$, our structured prompt improves action coverage by 45% over a baseline prompt for Gemini 2.5 Pro, while simultaneously slashing collision rates, object and causal conflicts by 51%, 52% and 55% respectively.
papers.comment: accepted at ECCV Workshop, project webpage: https://zhifanzhu.github.io/ego-nbody
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“N-Body Problem”：给定单个第一人称（egocentric）视频，预测 N 个个体如何假设性地并行完成同一组任务，目标是最大化加速比，同时避免空间碰撞、物体冲突和因果约束违例。作者形式化了该问题并提出一组评估指标，并作为概念验证，设计了一种结构化提示策略，引导视觉语言模型（VLM）推理 3D 环境、物体使用和时序依赖以生成可行的并行执行方案。在 EPIC-Kitchens 和 HD-EPIC 的 100 个视频上，对 N=2 的场景，该结构化提示相比基线提示在 Gemini 2.5 Pro 上将动作覆盖率提升 45%，同时将碰撞率、物体冲突和因果冲突分别降低 51%、52% 和 55%。
Motivation: 人类可以直观地对复杂活动进行并行化，但尚不清楚模型能否仅从观察一个人的视频中预测这种并行化。朴素的视频段分配往往违反真实世界约束，导致两人使用同一物体或占据同一空间等物理上不可能的场景，因此需要形式化定义问题并量化可行性与性能。
Method: 形式化 N-Body Problem，提出评估性能（加速比、任务覆盖率）和可行性（空间碰撞、物体冲突、因果约束）的指标套件；作为一种概念验证，设计结构化提示策略，引导视觉语言模型（VLM）对 3D 环境、物体使用和时序依赖进行推理，从而生成可行的并行执行方案。
Result: 在 EPIC-Kitchens 和 HD-EPIC 的 100 个视频上，针对 N=2，使用 Gemini 2.5 Pro 时，结构化提示相比基线提示将动作覆盖率提高 45%，并将碰撞率、物体冲突和因果冲突分别降低 51%、52% 和 55%。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，通过结构化提示可以让 VLM 从单人自我中心视频中推理出可行的并行任务执行方案，大幅改善动作覆盖和约束满足；该项工作作为该问题的概念验证（proof of concept），后续仍需在更大规模或更复杂场景中验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: UltraFast-LiNET: Light-weight multi-scale shift convolutional network for real-time low-light image enhancement
papers.abstract_en: Addressing the urgent need for high-performance real-time low-light image enhancement on resource-constrained edge devices in low-illumination scenarios such as nighttime and tunnels, this paper presents UltraFast-LiNET, an ultra-lightweight network designed for extreme efficiency. The proposed network introduces Dynamic Shift Convolution, DSConv, a highly compact operation with only 12 learnable parameters. By using DSConv to construct a Multi-Scale Shift Residual Block, MSRB, UltraFast-LiNET effectively enlarges the receptive field while maintaining an exceptionally small parameter count. To alleviate gradient instability during the training of lightweight models, we further propose a multi-level gradient-aware loss function that strengthens supervision signals across different feature levels. UltraFast-LiNET supports flexible parameter configurations, enabling the model size to be reduced to as few as 36 learnable parameters. Remarkably, with only 180 learnable parameters, UltraFast-LiNET achieves a PSNR of 19.81 dB on the LOL dataset, surpassing the current state-of-the-art by 0.08 dB. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves an effective balance between millisecond-level real-time processing and superior enhancement quality under extreme computational constraints. These results highlight its chip-level computational efficiency and broad prospects for edge-side deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UltraFast-LiNET，一个面向边缘设备实时低光图像增强的极轻量级网络。核心是仅含 12 个可学习参数的动态移位卷积（DSConv）和基于其构建的多尺度移位残差块（MSRB），并配有多级梯度感知损失函数以缓解轻量模型训练中的梯度不稳定。在 LOL 数据集上，仅 180 个可学习参数即可达到 PSNR 19.81 dB，超过当前 SOTA 0.08 dB，同时支持毫秒级实时处理。
Motivation: 夜间、隧道等低照度场景下，资源受限的边缘设备需要高性能的实时低光图像增强，而现有方法难以在极端计算约束下兼顾处理速度与增强质量。
Method: 提出超轻量网络 UltraFast-LiNET：引入仅含 12 个可学习参数的动态移位卷积 DSConv，并以其构建多尺度移位残差块 MSRB 来扩大感受野，同时保持极小参数量；进一步提出多级梯度感知损失函数，通过增强不同特征层的监督信号来缓解轻量模型的梯度不稳定。网络还支持灵活的参数量配置，可降至 36 个可学习参数。
Result: 在 LOL 数据集上，仅 180 个可学习参数的 UltraFast-LiNET 取得 PSNR 19.81 dB，较当前 SOTA 提升 0.08 dB；实验表明该方法能在毫秒级实时处理与高质量增强之间取得有效平衡。
Conclusion: 作者强调该方法在极端计算约束下实现了实时性和增强质量的平衡，展现出芯片级计算效率和良好的边缘端部署前景。

papers.title: Embedding networks with the random walk first return time distribution
papers.abstract_en: We propose the first return time distribution (FRTD) of a random walk as an interpretable and mathematically grounded node embedding. The FRTD assigns a probability mass function to each node, allowing us to define a distance between any pair of nodes using standard metrics for discrete distributions. We present several arguments to motivate the FRTD embedding. First, we show that FRTDs are strictly more informative than eigenvalue spectra, yet insufficient for complete graph identification, thus placing FRTD equivalence between cospectrality and isomorphism. Second, we argue that FRTD equivalence between nodes captures structural similarity. Third, we empirically demonstrate that the FRTD embedding outperforms manually designed graph metrics in network alignment tasks. Finally, we show that random networks that approximately match the FRTD of a desired target also preserve other salient features. Together these results demonstrate the FRTD as a simple and mathematically principled embedding for complex networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将随机游走的首次返回时间分布 (first return time distribution, FRTD) 作为节点嵌入，为每个节点赋予一个概率质量函数，并用离散分布的标准度量定义任意节点对之间的距离。作者从理论上论证 FRTD 比特征谱 (eigenvalue spectra) 更具信息量但仍不足以完全识别图，并实验表明 FRTD 嵌入在网络对齐任务上优于手工设计的图指标。
Motivation: 现有图嵌入或人工设计的网络指标往往缺乏可解释性和数学基础，难以同时兼顾结构相似性的刻画与任务性能，需要一个既有理论依据又能捕捉节点结构角色的表示方法。
Method: 将每个节点的 FRTD 作为其嵌入表示，利用离散概率分布之间的距离度量定义节点间距离；通过谱、同构与结构等价性分析论证该嵌入的性质，并在网络对齐和随机网络生成等任务中检验其有效性。
Result: 摘要报告 FRTD 比特征谱严格更具信息量，但仍不足以唯一确定图；FRTD 嵌入在网络对齐任务上优于手工设计的图指标，且近似匹配目标 FRTD 的随机网络能保留其他显著特征。
Conclusion: 作者认为 FRTD 是一种简单且具有数学原则的复杂网络嵌入，适用于结构相似性度量与网络对齐等场景。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Pathryoshka: Compressing Pathology Foundation Models via Multi-Teacher Knowledge Distillation with Nested Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Pathology foundation models (FMs) have driven significant progress in computational pathology. However, these high-performing models can easily exceed a billion parameters and produce high-dimensional embeddings, thus limiting their applicability for research or clinical use when computing resources are tight. Here, we introduce Pathryoshka, a multi-teacher distillation framework inspired by RADIO distillation and Matryoshka Representation Learning to reduce pathology FM sizes while allowing for adaptable embedding dimensions. We evaluate our framework with a distilled model on ten public pathology benchmarks with varying downstream tasks. Compared to its much larger teachers, Pathryoshka reduces the model size by 86-92% at on-par performance. It outperforms state-of-the-art single-teacher distillation models of comparable size by a median margin of 7.0 in accuracy. By enabling efficient local deployment without sacrificing accuracy or representational richness, Pathryoshka democratizes access to state-of-the-art pathology FMs for the broader research and clinical community.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Pathryoshka，一个受 RADIO 蒸馏和 Matryoshka 表示学习启发的多教师知识蒸馏框架，用于压缩病理学基础模型 (pathology foundation models) 并允许可调嵌入维度。作者在十个公共病理学基准上评估，蒸馏后模型体积减少 86-92%，性能与更大的教师模型相当，并在同等尺寸下优于最先进的单教师蒸馏模型。
Motivation: 病理学基础模型性能优异但参数量可超十亿且嵌入维度高，在计算资源受限的研究或临床场景中难以部署。
Method: 提出多教师蒸馏框架 Pathryoshka，结合 RADIO 蒸馏与 Matryoshka 表示学习，在压缩模型尺寸的同时保留可灵活调整的嵌入维度。
Result: 在十个公共病理学基准上，Pathryoshka 将模型尺寸减少 86-92% 且性能与更大的教师模型相当；与同等大小的最先进单教师蒸馏模型相比，中位准确率提升 7.0。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 Pathryoshka 支持高效本地部署，在不牺牲精度或表示丰富性的前提下，使前沿病理学基础模型更易被研究和临床社区使用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EvDiff: Event-Based Video Reconstruction using One-Step Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: As neuromorphic sensors, event cameras asynchronously record changes in brightness as streams of sparse events with the advantages of high temporal resolution and high dynamic range. Reconstructing intensity images from events is a highly ill-posed task due to the inherent ambiguity of absolute brightness. Early methods generally follow an end-to-end regression paradigm, directly mapping events to intensity frames in a deterministic manner. While effective to some extent, these approaches often yield perceptually inferior results and struggle to scale up in model capacity and training data. In this work, we propose EvDiff, an event-based diffusion model that follows a surrogate training framework to produce high-quality videos. To reduce the high computational cost of high-frame-rate video generation, we design an event-based diffusion model that performs only a single forward diffusion step, equipped with a temporally consistent EvEncoder. Furthermore, our novel Surrogate Training Framework eliminates the dependence on paired event-image datasets, allowing the model to leverage large-scale image datasets for higher capacity. The proposed EvDiff is capable of generating high-quality colorful videos solely from monochromatic event streams. Experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that our method strikes a sweet spot between fidelity and realism, outperforming existing approaches on both pixel-level and perceptual metrics. The code will be released publicly.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EvDiff，一种基于事件相机（event camera）的单步扩散模型，用于仅从单色事件流重建高质量彩色视频。作者设计了只执行一次前向扩散步骤的模型结构，并引入替代训练框架（Surrogate Training Framework）以摆脱对成对事件-图像数据集的依赖，从而可以利用大规模图像数据集提升模型容量。真实数据实验表明，该方法在像素级与感知指标上均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 从事件流重建强度图像是高度病态的任务，早期端到端回归方法虽有一定效果，但感知质量较差，且难以在模型容量和训练数据规模上扩展。扩散模型虽能提升生成质量，但高帧率视频生成的计算成本高，同时依赖配对的 event-image 数据。
Method: 提出一个事件驱动的扩散模型 EvDiff，采用仅单步前向扩散（single forward diffusion step）的方式降低高帧率视频生成的计算开销，并配备时间一致的 EvEncoder 以保持时序一致性。其 Surrogate Training Framework 消除了对配对事件-图像数据集的依赖，使模型能够利用大规模普通图像数据集进行训练。
Result: 在真实世界数据集上的实验表明，EvDiff 能够在像素级指标和感知指标上优于现有方法，并仅由单色事件流生成高质量的彩色视频。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法在保真度（fidelity）与真实感（realism）之间取得了较好的平衡，并计划公开代码。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Self-Localizing MIMO Beam Mapping for Intelligent Open RAN with Continuously Evolving Channel Memory
papers.abstract_en: Open and intelligent radio access networks (RANs) envisioned for 6G require accurate and reusable wireless channel knowledge for intelligent inference and control. However, full-dimensional channel state information (CSI) and accurate location labels are difficult to acquire and maintain across open and multi-vendor deployments. This paper develops a self-localizing multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) beam map framework that constructs a hierarchical wireless memory from highly sparse CSI measurements without explicit location labels. To reduce acquisition and processing overhead, we use beam-domain received signal strength (RSS) as compact inputs and theoretically show that they enable asymptotically unbiased spatial signature estimation. A dual-scale extractor captures intra-snapshot angular dependencies and inter-sample correlations for incomplete observations, and a hybrid temporal encoder is designed to consolidate recent CSI into stable short-term context for physical anchor inference. The inferred anchors spatially index a physically structured radio map embedding that stores long-term channel knowledge, which conditions a diffusion decoder for location-consistent full CSI reconstruction. Such a radio map embedding provides a persistent wireless knowledge representation that can be continuously updated and reused by intelligent RAN functions without repeated full CSI acquisition. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework improves physical-anchor recovery accuracy by over 30% under sparse measurements and achieves more than 20% channel-capacity gain in non-line-of-sight (NLOS) beam tracking over Kalman-filter-based baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 6G 开放智能 RAN 中无线信道知识难以获取与复用的问题，提出一种自定位 MIMO 波束地图框架。该框架利用波束域接收信号强度（RSS）作为紧凑输入，在无显式位置标签的条件下从稀疏 CSI 测量构建分层无线记忆，并通过物理锚点推断与无线电地图嵌入实现位置一致的完整 CSI 重建。实验表明，该框架在稀疏测量下将物理锚点恢复精度提升超过 30%，在非视距（NLOS）波束跟踪中相对基于 Kalman 滤波的基线获得超过 20% 的信道容量增益。
Motivation: 6G 开放智能 RAN 需要准确且可复用的无线信道知识用于智能推理与控制，但跨厂商开放部署中全维度 CSI 和精确位置标签难以获取与维护，制约了智能 RAN 功能的有效运行。
Method: 提出自定位 MIMO 波束地图框架：以波束域 RSS 作为紧凑输入，并从理论上证明其可实现渐近无偏的空间特征估计；设计双尺度提取器捕捉快照内角度依赖与样本间相关性，混合时间编码器将近期 CSI 整合为稳定短期上下文以推断物理锚点；推断的锚点对物理结构化的无线电地图嵌入进行空间索引，该嵌入存储长期信道知识并条件化扩散解码器用于位置一致的完整 CSI 重建。
Result: 实验显示该框架在稀疏测量下物理锚点恢复精度提升超过 30%，在 NLOS 波束跟踪中相较 Kalman 滤波基线获得超过 20% 的信道容量增益。
Conclusion: 该无线电地图嵌入提供一种持久、可连续更新并可被智能 RAN 功能复用的无线知识表征，避免了重复进行完整 CSI 采集；摘要强调该方法在无显式位置标签的开放多厂商部署中的适用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SONIC: Supersizing Motion Tracking for Natural Humanoid Whole-Body Control
papers.abstract_en: Despite the rise of billion-parameter foundation models trained across thousands of graphical processing units (GPUs), similar scaling gains have not been shown for humanoid control. Current neural controllers for humanoids remain modest in size, target a limited set of behaviors, and are trained on a handful of GPUs. We show that scaling model capacity, data, and compute yields a generalist humanoid controller capable of natural, robust whole-body movements. We position motion tracking as a scalable task for humanoid control, leveraging dense supervision from diverse motion-capture data to acquire human motion priors without manual reward engineering. We build a foundation model for motion tracking by scaling along three axes: network size (1.2M to 42M parameters), dataset volume (100M+ frames from 700 hours of motion capture), and compute (21k GPU hours). Beyond demonstrating the benefits of scale, we further show downstream utility through a real-time kinematic planner that bridges motion tracking to tasks such as navigation, enabling natural and interactive control, as well as a unified token space that supports virtual reality (VR) teleoperation and vision-language-action (VLA) models with a single policy. Through this interface, we demonstrate autonomous VLA-driven whole-body loco-manipulation requiring coordinated hand and foot placement. Scaling motion tracking exhibits favorable properties: performance improves steadily with compute and data diversity, and learned policies generalize to unseen motions, establishing motion tracking at scale as a practical foundation for humanoid control.
papers.journal_ref: Science Robotics 11 (117), eaed4592 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将运动跟踪（motion tracking）作为人形机器人控制的可扩展任务，通过密集的动捕数据监督学习人类运动先验，避免手工奖励工程。作者沿网络规模（1.2M 到 42M 参数）、数据量（700 小时、1 亿+帧动捕）和计算量（21k GPU 小时）三个维度扩展，构建了一个通用型人形机器人全身运动控制器。结果显示性能随规模和多样性稳定提升，且策略能泛化到未见过的动作，并可通过统一 token 空间支持 VR 遥操作和 VLA 驱动的全身操作。
Motivation: 当前人形机器人神经控制器规模远小于其他领域的基础模型，参数少、行为覆盖有限、训练资源受限，尚未展示类似大模型的扩展收益。
Method: 将运动跟踪定位为可扩展任务，利用大规模动捕数据提供密集监督来获取人类运动先验；在模型容量、数据集规模（700 小时动捕）和训练计算量（21k GPU 小时）上同步扩大；同时引入实时运动学规划器把运动跟踪连接到导航等下游任务，并构建统一 token 空间以融合 VR 遥操作和 VLA 模型。
Result: 摘要报告扩展运动跟踪带来性能随计算和数据多样性稳定提升，学习到的策略能够泛化到未见过的动作；并通过统一策略接口实现了自主 VLA 驱动的全身移动操控（loco-manipulation），需要协调手与脚的放置。
Conclusion: 作者认为规模化运动跟踪可以成为人形机器人控制的实际基础，支持自然、鲁棒的全身运动以及多样化的交互式下游应用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Delving into Cascaded Instability: A Lipschitz Continuity View on Image Restoration and Object Detection Synergy
papers.abstract_en: To improve detection robustness in adverse conditions (e.g., haze and low light), image restoration is commonly applied as a pre-processing step to enhance image quality for the detector. However, the functional mismatch between restoration and detection networks can introduce instability and hinder effective integration -- an issue that remains underexplored. We revisit this limitation through the lens of Lipschitz continuity, analyzing the functional differences between restoration and detection networks in both the input space and the parameter space. Our analysis shows that restoration networks perform smooth, continuous transformations, while object detectors operate with discontinuous decision boundaries, making them highly sensitive to minor perturbations. This mismatch introduces instability in traditional cascade frameworks, where even imperceptible noise from restoration is amplified during detection, disrupting gradient flow and hindering optimization. To address this, we propose Lipschitz-regularized object detection (LROD), a simple yet effective framework that integrates image restoration directly into the detector's feature learning, harmonizing the Lipschitz continuity of both tasks during training. We implement this framework as Lipschitz-regularized YOLO (LR-YOLO), extending seamlessly to existing YOLO detectors. Extensive experiments on haze and low-light benchmarks demonstrate that LR-YOLO consistently improves detection stability, optimization smoothness, and overall accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从 Lipschitz 连续性视角重新审视图像恢复与目标检测级联框架的不稳定性。作者分析指出，恢复网络执行平滑连续变换，而检测器具有不连续的决策边界，对微小扰动高度敏感，导致传统级联中恢复引入的不可感知噪声被放大、梯度流受阻。为此提出 Lipschitz 正则化目标检测（LROD），并实例化为可无缝扩展到现有 YOLO 检测器的 LR-YOLO，在雾天和低光照基准上持续提升检测稳定性、优化平滑性与整体精度。
Motivation: 恶劣条件下常用图像恢复作为检测的前置步骤来增强图像质量，但恢复网络与检测网络之间存在功能失配，会引入不稳定并阻碍有效集成，这一问题尚未被充分研究。
Method: 在输入空间和参数空间对恢复网络与检测网络的 Lipschitz 连续性差异进行分析，提出将图像恢复直接融入检测器特征学习的 Lipschitz 正则化目标检测（LROD）框架，并实现为 LR-YOLO，可扩展到现有 YOLO 检测器。
Result: 在雾天和低光照基准上的大量实验表明，LR-YOLO 能够持续改善检测稳定性、优化平滑性和整体精度。
Conclusion: 摘要认为协调恢复与检测两个任务的 Lipschitz 连续性可以缓解级联框架中的不稳定性，从而改善恶劣条件下的检测性能。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.motivation: 恶劣条件下常用图像恢复作为检测的前置步骤来增强图像质量，但恢复网络与检测网络之间存在功能失配，会引入不稳定并阻碍有效集成，这一问题尚未被充分研究。
summary_sections.method: 在输入空间和参数空间对恢复网络与检测网络的 Lipschitz 连续性差异进行分析，提出将图像恢复直接融入检测器特征学习的 Lipschitz 正则化目标检测（LROD）框架，并实现为 LR-YOLO，可扩展到现有 YOLO 检测器。
summary_sections.result: 在雾天和低光照基准上的大量实验表明，LR-YOLO 能够持续改善检测稳定性、优化平滑性和整体精度。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要认为协调恢复与检测两个任务的 Lipschitz 连续性可以缓解级联框架中的不稳定性，从而改善恶劣条件下的检测性能。

papers.title: CityRiSE: Reasoning Urban Socio-Economic Status in Large Vision-Language Models via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Urban socio-economic sensing plays a vital role in advancing global sustainable development goals. With the advent of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), new opportunities have emerged to address this challenge by framing it as a multi-modal perception and reasoning task. However, recent studies show that LVLMs still struggle to make accurate and interpretable socio-economic predictions from visual data. To overcome these limitations and fully exploit the potential of LVLMs, we propose CityRiSE, a novel framework for Reasoning urban Socio-Economic status in LVLMs via reinforcement learning (RL). With carefully curated multi-modal dataset and verifiable reward design, our approach guides the LVLM to focus on semantically meaningful visual cues, enabling structured and goal-oriented reasoning for generalist socio-economic status prediction. Experiments demonstrate that CityRiSE, equipped with emergent reasoning, significantly outperforms existing baselines, improving both prediction accuracy and generalization across diverse urban contexts, especially on unseen cities and unseen indicators. This work highlights the promise of combining RL and LVLMs for interpretable and generalist urban socio-economic sensing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CityRiSE，一个通过强化学习 (RL) 提升大规模视觉-语言模型 (LVLM) 进行城市社会经济状态推理的框架。作者设计了精心整理的多模态数据集与可验证的奖励设计，引导模型关注有语义意义的视觉线索，实现结构化和目标导向的推理。实验表明 CityRiSE 在预测准确率和跨城市泛化上显著优于现有基线，尤其是对未见过的城市和指标。
Motivation: 城市社会经济感知对全球可持续发展目标至关重要，而 LVLM 在从视觉数据做出准确且可解释的社会经济预测方面仍存在困难，这限制了其在该任务上的潜力。
Method: 提出 CityRiSE 框架，采用 RL 训练策略，并配备精心整理的多模态数据集和可验证的奖励设计，使 LVLM 聚焦语义相关的视觉线索，进行结构化的社会经济状态推理。
Result: 实验显示 CityRiSE 显著优于现有基线，在多个城市场景下提升了预测准确率和泛化能力，尤其对未见过的城市与未见过的指标表现更好。
Conclusion: 作者强调将 RL 与 LVLM 结合用于可解释、通用型城市社会经济感知是有前景的方向。

papers.title: DiffGRM: Diffusion-based Generative Recommendation Model
papers.abstract_en: Generative recommendation (GR) is an emerging paradigm that represents each item via a tokenizer as an n-digit semantic ID (SID) and predicts the next item by autoregressively generating its SID conditioned on the user's history. However, two structural properties of SIDs make ARMs ill-suited. First, intra-item consistency: the n digits jointly specify one item, yet the left-to-right causality trains each digit only under its prefix and blocks bidirectional cross-digit evidence, collapsing supervision to a single causal path. Second, inter-digit heterogeneity: digits differ in semantic granularity and predictability, while the uniform next-token objective assigns equal weight to all digits, overtraining easy digits and undertraining hard digits. To address these two issues, we propose DiffGRM, a diffusion-based GR model that replaces the autoregressive decoder with a masked discrete diffusion model (MDM), thereby enabling bidirectional context and any-order parallel generation of SID digits for recommendation. Specifically, we tailor DiffGRM in three aspects: (1) tokenization with Parallel Semantic Encoding (PSE) to decouple digits and balance per-digit information; (2) training with On-policy Coherent Noising (OCN) that prioritizes uncertain digits via coherent masking to concentrate supervision on high-value signals; and (3) inference with Confidence-guided Parallel Denoising (CPD) that fills higher-confidence digits first and generates diverse Top-K candidates. Experiments show consistent gains over strong generative and discriminative recommendation baselines on multiple datasets, improving NDCG@10 by 6.9%-15.5%. Code is available at https://github.com/liuzhao09/DiffGRM.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DiffGRM，一种基于扩散的生成式推荐模型 (generative recommendation model)。它针对语义 ID (SID) 自回归生成的两个结构问题——digit 间的一致性和异质性，用掩码离散扩散模型 (masked discrete diffusion model, MDM) 替代自回归解码器，实现 SID 数字的双向上下文与任意顺序并行生成。摘要报告在多个数据集上相较强生成式与判别式推荐基线一致提升，NDCG@10 提高 6.9%-15.5%。
Motivation: 生成式推荐将物品编码为 n 位语义 ID 并用自回归模型逐位生成，但 SID 的 n 位数字共同指定一个物品，左到右因果训练只让每位数字在其前缀条件下学习，丢失双向跨位证据；同时不同位的语义粒度与可预测性不同，统一 next-token 目标会过度训练易学数字、欠训练难学数字。
Method: DiffGRM 用掩码离散扩散模型替换自回归解码器，并做三方面定制：并行语义编码 (Parallel Semantic Encoding, PSE) 解耦数字、平衡各位信息；在策略一致加噪 (On-policy Coherent Noising, OCN) 通过一致掩码优先扰动不确定数字，把监督集中在高价值信号上；置信度引导并行去噪 (Confidence-guided Parallel Denoising, CPD) 先填充高置信度数字并生成多样 Top-K 候选。
Result: 在多个推荐数据集上，DiffGRM 一致优于强生成式和判别式推荐基线，NDCG@10 相对提升 6.9%-15.5%；代码已开源。
Conclusion: 摘要认为用离散扩散替代自回归生成可有效解决 SID 生成中的结构失配问题，为生成式推荐提供了一种新的建模方向。

papers.title: StarEmbed: Benchmarking Time Series Foundation Models on Astronomical Observations of Variable Stars
papers.abstract_en: Current time series foundation model (TSFM) training corpora largely omit data with certain complexities like irregular temporal sampling. Astronomical time series of stellar fluxes (light curves) are available in immense quantities and exhibit irregular sampling, multiple variates, and heteroskedasticity. We introduce StarEmbed, the first public benchmark for light curves comprised of real observations of ~40,000 stars expert-labeled across seven classes and evaluations in clustering, classification, and out-of-distribution (OOD) source detection. We benchmark TSFMs with differing architecture and training strategies as well as domain-specific transformers. Our results demonstrate that the Chronos family, despite being pre-trained on regularly sampled non-astronomical data, yields state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in light curve clustering and OOD detection. While no TSFM strictly surpasses the classification performance of the long-established domain baseline, they do demonstrate excellent generalization abilities. StarEmbed marks a step toward universal light curve embeddings and improved TSFM performance on challenging data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StarEmbed，第一个面向天文变星光曲线（light curves）的公开时序基础模型（TSFM）基准，包含约 40,000 颗真实恒星观测、七类专家标注，并覆盖聚类、分类和分布外（OOD）源检测三类评估。作者对多种架构和训练策略的 TSFM 以及领域专用 Transformer 进行基准测试，发现预训练于规则采样非天文数据的 Chronos 家族在光曲线聚类与 OOD 检测上取得 SOTA；虽然没有任何 TSFM 在分类上严格超越长期存在的领域基线，但它们展现出良好的泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有时序基础模型训练语料大多忽略了不规则时间采样等复杂数据特征，而天文恒星通量时间序列（光曲线）数量庞大且天然具有不规则采样、多变量和异方差性，正好可作为评估和提升 TSFM 泛化能力的测试床。
Method: 构建 StarEmbed 基准，包含约 40,000 颗恒星的真实观测数据与七类专家标注，并设计聚类、分类和 OOD 源检测三类评价任务；随后系统比较不同架构与训练策略的 TSFM 以及领域专用 Transformer。
Result: 摘要报告 Chronos 家族尽管仅在规则采样的非天文数据上预训练，仍在光曲线聚类和 OOD 检测中达到 SOTA；在分类任务上，没有 TSFM 严格超过领域基线，但 TSFM 展现出优秀的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为 StarEmbed 是迈向通用光曲线嵌入的一步，并指出 TSFM 在具有不规则采样等复杂性的挑战性数据上仍有改进空间。

papers.title: Gradual Code-Switching as Inference-Time Cross-Lingual Representational Alignment for LLMs
papers.abstract_en: While large language models (LLMs) have achieved notable progress in multilingual settings, their performance remains uneven across languages as LLMs often rely on English-centric latent representations. In this work, we introduce code-switching in-context learning (CSICL), an inference-time mechanism for cross-lingual representational alignment. Rather than relying on an abrupt translation pivot, CSICL explicitly scaffolds the reasoning trajectory by gradually transitioning from a target language to English, aligning non-English inputs with an English-centric reasoning space. Across 4 LLMs, 6 datasets, and 10 languages, CSICL consistently outperforms cross-lingual in-context learning baselines, yielding average gains of 6.0pp and 4.8pp in target and unseen languages, respectively. The improvements generalize across language families and are even more pronounced in low-resource settings, with gains of 14.7pp in target and 5.3pp in unseen languages. These findings establish code-switching as a robust and effective approach for reducing cross-lingual misalignment during inference, moving LLMs towards more equitable and effective multilingual systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 code-switching in-context learning (CSICL)，一种推理期的跨语言表征对齐机制，通过从目标语言逐步过渡到英语来搭建推理轨迹，使非英语输入对齐英语中心的推理空间。在 4 个 LLM、6 个数据集、10 种语言上，CSICL 一致优于跨语言上下文学习基线，目标语言平均提升 6.0pp，未见语言提升 4.8pp，低资源设定下分别提升 14.7pp 和 5.3pp。
Motivation: 多语言 LLM 在不同语言上的表现不均，常依赖英语中心的潜在表征，导致非英语输入与英语推理空间存在跨语言错位；现有方法依赖 abrupt translation pivot，缺少显式的推理期对齐机制。
Method: 提出 CSICL，在推理时不采用突然的翻译中转，而是通过从目标语言到英语的渐进过渡（gradually transitioning）显式搭建推理轨迹，实现跨语言表征对齐。
Result: 在 4 个 LLM、6 个数据集、10 种语言上，CSICL 一致优于跨语言上下文学习基线，目标语言和未见语言分别平均提升 6.0pp 和 4.8pp；低资源设定下提升更显著，目标语言和未见语言分别提升 14.7pp 和 5.3pp，且收益可泛化到不同语言族。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果将 code-switching 确立为一种稳健有效的推理期跨语言错位缓解方法，推动 LLM 向更公平、更有效的多语言系统发展。

papers.title: Exploring Instruction Data Quality for Explainable Image Quality Assessment
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, with the rapid development of large multimodal models (LMMs), explainable image quality assessment (IQA) has attracted increasing attention, aiming to understand the perceptual quality problems of images. Existing studies typically construct large-scale instruction tuning datasets to enhance the quality perception capabilities of LMMs, following the data scaling law. However, as the fundamental capabilities of LMMs continue to improve, existing instruction tuning datasets may contain redundant and less challenging samples, resulting in substantial computational costs. In this paper, we investigate whether data quantity remains the dominant factor in LMM instruction tuning for explainable IQA. Based on a strong pre-trained LMM, we observe that randomly selecting a properly sized subset of training data can outperform full-data fine-tuning, indicating substantial redundancy in existing instruction tuning datasets. Motivated by this observation, we propose Q-Selector, a clustering-based data selection framework consisting of three stages: hierarchical LMM-based clustering feature extraction, cluster quota allocation through density and transferability, and SVD-based cluster sampling strategy. Specifically, Q-Selector extracts multi-layer features from the vision encoder, text encoder, and large language model components of LMMs as clustering features. It then determines the sampling quota for each cluster based on inter-cluster transferability and intra-cluster density. Finally, Q-Selector employs a Singular Value Decomposition (SVD)-based sampling strategy to select high-quality instruction data. Experimental results demonstrate that Q-Selector achieves 102.1% and 103.7% of the performance of full-data fine-tuning using only 10% of the training data on explainable IQA and image aesthetics assessment tasks, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究可解释图像质量评估（explainable IQA）中大语言-多模态模型（LMM）指令微调的数据质量，提出基于聚类的数据选择框架 Q-Selector。作者发现从已有指令数据中随机选取适当规模的子集即可超过全量微调性能，说明现有数据集存在冗余。Q-Selector 通过三阶段流程——LMM 多层次聚类特征提取、基于密度与迁移性的簇配额分配、基于 SVD 的簇内采样——在仅用 10% 训练数据时，在可解释 IQA 与图像美学评估任务上分别达到全量微调性能的 102.1% 和 103.7%。
Motivation: 现有可解释 IQA 研究遵循数据规模法则，构建大规模指令微调数据集来增强 LMM 的感知能力；但随着 LMM 基础能力增强，这些数据集可能包含冗余且挑战性不足的样本，带来高昂计算成本。论文目标是检验数据量是否仍是主导因素，并探索更高效的数据选择方法。
Method: 提出 Q-Selector 三阶段数据选择框架：先从 LMM 的视觉编码器、文本编码器和语言模型组件中提取多层特征作为聚类特征；再根据簇间迁移性和簇内密度为每个簇分配采样配额；最后用基于奇异值分解（SVD）的采样策略挑选高质量指令数据。
Result: 基于强预训练 LMM，随机选取合适大小的训练子集可优于全量微调，表明现有指令微调数据存在明显冗余。Q-Selector 在可解释 IQA 和图像美学评估任务上分别仅用 10% 数据即达到全量微调性能的 102.1% 和 103.7%。
Conclusion: 论文表明在可解释 IQA 的 LMM 指令微调中，数据质量可以替代数据数量，通过系统化的聚类与采样策略在显著降低数据量时仍保持甚至超过全量训练效果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Bayesian Distributional Models of Executive Functioning
papers.abstract_en: This study uses controlled simulations with known ground-truth parameters to evaluate how Distributional Latent Variable Models (DLVM) and Bayesian Distributional Active LEarning (DALE) perform in comparison to conventional Independent Maximum Likelihood Estimation (IMLE). DLVM integrates observations across multiple executive function tasks and individuals, allowing parameter estimation even under sparse or incomplete data conditions. To establish known-ground truth, we uniformly sample individual sessions from a neural network learned latent space and map them to distributional cognitive performance across different tasks. The individual test-items are then sampled from these distributions using either DALE, random procedure or a standard fixed battery approach. When given the same set of observations, DLVM consistently outperformed IMLE, especially under smaller amounts of data, and converges faster to highly accurate estimates of the true distributions. In a second set of analyses, DALE adaptively guided sampling to maximize information gain, outperforming random sampling and fixed test batteries, particularly within the first 80 trials. These findings establish the advantages of combining DLVM's cross-task inference with DALE's optimal adaptive sampling, providing a principled basis for more efficient cognitive assessments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过带已知 ground truth 的受控仿真，评估分布隐变量模型 (DLVM) 与贝叶斯分布主动学习 (DALE) 相比传统独立极大似然估计 (IMLE) 在执行功能认知评估中的表现。DLVM 整合多个执行功能任务和个体观测，即使在稀疏或不完整数据下也能估计参数；DALE 则通过自适应采样最大化信息增益。结果显示 DLVM 在小数据下明显优于 IMLE 且收敛更快，DALE 在前 80 次试验内优于随机采样和固定测试组。
Motivation: 传统认知评估中独立极大似然估计在数据稀疏或不完整时参数估计不稳，且固定测试方式采样效率低。作者希望验证结合跨任务推断的 DLVM 与最优自适应采样 DALE 能否建立更高效认知评估的原则性基础。
Method: 作者从神经网络学习的潜在空间中均匀采样个体会话，映射到不同任务上的分布化认知表现以建立已知 ground truth；随后分别用 DALE、随机过程和标准固定测试组从这些分布中采样个体测试项，并在同一组观测下对比 DLVM 与 IMLE 的估计表现。
Result: 在相同观测条件下，DLVM 始终优于 IMLE，尤其在数据量较小时优势明显，并且更快收敛到真实分布的高精度估计；在第二组分析中，DALE 自适应引导采样在前 80 次试验内优于随机采样和固定测试组。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 DLVM 的跨任务推断与 DALE 的最优自适应采样相结合可以带来更高效的认知评估，为后续评估设计提供原则性依据。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Performance-Carbon Trade-Offs across Architectural Biases in Shear Flow Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Development of modern deep learning methods has been driven primarily by the push for improving model efficacy (accuracy metrics), leading to large-scale models that require massive computational resources and result in considerable carbon footprint across the model lifecycle. In this work, we explore how architectural biases, specifically a model's receptive field and periodicity assumption, are associated with the trade-offs between predictive performance and carbon footprint for spatio-temporal forecasting of incompressible shear flow. We study seven models differing in these properties and evaluate pointwise accuracy, physics-fidelity, and carbon cost across training and inference. We find that no single model dominates across both predictive performance and carbon cost, that a lower training cost does not straightforwardly extend to inference, and that runtime alone is an unreliable proxy for carbon cost, particularly during training. Together, these results underscore the importance of explicitly evaluating carbon costs across the full model lifecycle. We argue that model efficiency, alongside efficacy, should be a core consideration in machine learning model development and deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究时空预测中架构偏置（感受野与周期性假设）与碳足迹之间的权衡，以不可压缩剪切流预测为例。作者比较了七个在感受野和周期假设上不同的模型，并评估了点级精度、物理保真度以及训练和推理阶段的碳成本。摘要表明没有任何单一模型同时在预测性能和碳成本上占优，且训练成本低并不简单延拓到推理，运行时也不足以作为碳成本的可靠代理。
Motivation: 现代深度学习发展主要被模型有效性（精度指标）驱动，导致大规模模型消耗大量算力并在模型生命周期内产生可观碳足迹，而架构偏置如何与碳成本相关联缺乏系统研究。
Method: 选取七个在感受野（receptive field）和周期性假设（periodicity assumption）上不同的模型，对不可压缩剪切流进行时空预测，统一评估点级精度、物理保真度以及训练与推理过程的碳成本。
Result: 摘要报告没有单一模型在预测性能与碳成本两个维度上同时占优；训练成本较低并不保证推理成本也低；运行时（runtime）单独无法可靠代理碳成本，尤其在训练阶段。
Conclusion: 作者强调应在机器学习模型全生命周期中显式评估碳成本，并主张模型效率应与有效性一样成为模型开发和部署的核心考虑因素。

papers.title: Confidence-Calibrating Regularization for Robust Brain MRI Segmentation Under Domain Shift
papers.abstract_en: The Segment Anything Model (SAM) exhibits strong zero-shot performance on natural images but suffers from domain shift and overconfidence when applied to medical volumes. We propose \textbf{CalSAM}, a lightweight adaptation framework that (i) reduces encoder sensitivity to domain shift via a \emph{Feature Fisher Information Penalty} (FIP) computed on 3D feature maps and (ii) penalizes overconfident voxel-wise errors through a \emph{Confidence Misalignment Penalty} (CMP). The combined loss, \(\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{CalSAM}}\) fine-tunes only the mask decoder while keeping SAM's encoders frozen. On cross-center and scanner-shift evaluations, CalSAM substantially improves accuracy and calibration: e.g., on the BraTS scanner split (Siemens$\to$GE) CalSAM shows a $+7.4\%$ relative improvement in $\mathrm{DSC}$ (80.1\% vs.\ 74.6\%), a $-26.9\%$ reduction in $\mathrm{HD95}$ (4.6 mm vs.\ 6.3 mm), and a $-39.5\%$ reduction in $\mathrm{ECE}$ (5.2\% vs.\ 8.6\%). On ATLAS-C (motion corruptions), CalSAM achieves a $+5.3\%$ relative improvement in $\mathrm{DSC}$ (75.9\%) and a $-32.6\%$ reduction in $\mathrm{ECE}$ (5.8\%). Ablations show FIP and CMP contribute complementary gains ($p<0.01$), and the Fisher penalty incurs a modest $\sim$15\% training-time overhead. CalSAM therefore delivers improved domain generalization and better-calibrated uncertainty estimates for brain MRI segmentation, while retaining the computational benefits of freezing SAM's encoder.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CalSAM，一种轻量级适配框架，用于缓解 Segment Anything Model (SAM) 在医学影像分割中的域偏移与过度自信问题。方法冻结 SAM 编码器，仅微调掩码解码器，引入 Feature Fisher Information Penalty (FIP) 和 Confidence Misalignment Penalty (CMP) 两项正则化损失。跨中心和跨扫描仪的脑 MRI 分割实验显示，CalSAM 在 DSC、HD95 和 ECE 上均有显著改善，并保持冻结编码器带来的计算优势。
Motivation: SAM 在自然图像上具有强大的零样本性能，但在医学体数据上存在域偏移和过度自信（overconfidence）问题，导致分割精度与校准性下降。
Method: 提出 CalSAM 框架：(i) 在 3D 特征图上计算 Feature Fisher Information Penalty (FIP) 以降低编码器对域偏移的敏感性；(ii) 通过 Confidence Misalignment Penalty (CMP) 惩罚过度自信的体素级错误。联合损失 L_CalSAM 仅微调掩码解码器，保持 SAM 编码器冻结。
Result: 在 BraTS 扫描仪划分（Siemens→GE）上，DSC 相对提升 +7.4%（80.1% vs. 74.6%），HD95 降低 -26.9%（4.6 mm vs. 6.3 mm），ECE 降低 -39.5%（5.2% vs. 8.6%）。在 ATLAS-C（运动损坏）上，DSC 相对提升 +5.3%（75.9%），ECE 降低 -32.6%（5.8%）。消融实验显示 FIP 与 CMP 产生互补增益（p<0.01），Fisher 惩罚带来约 15% 的训练时间开销。
Conclusion: CalSAM 通过两项互补的正则化损失，提升了脑 MRI 分割的域泛化能力和校准不确定性估计，同时保留冻结 SAM 编码器的计算效率优势。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Assessing the Effectiveness of Deep Embeddings for Tree Species Classification in the Dutch Forest Inventory
papers.abstract_en: National Forest Inventory (NFI) serves as the primary source of forest information, however, maintaining these inventories requires labor-intensive on-site campaigns by forestry experts to identify and document tree species. Embeddings from deep pre-trained remote sensing models offer new opportunities to update NFIs more frequently and at larger scales. This work systematically investigates how deep embeddings improve tree species classification accuracy in the Netherlands with few annotated data. We evaluate this question on three embedding models: Presto, Alpha Earth, and TESSERA, using three tree species datasets of varying difficulty. Data-wise, we compare the available embeddings from Alpha Earth and TESSERA with dynamically calculated embeddings from a pre-trained Presto model, for which we extracted time series from Sentinel-1 , Sentinel-2, and weather data, along with elevation data downloaded from Google Earth Engine. Our results demonstrate that publicly available remote sensing time series deep embeddings outperform the current state-of-the-art hand crafted features in NFI species classification in the Netherlands, yielding performance gains of roughly 7 to 9 percentage points in overall accuracy and up to 17 points in macro-F1 on the NFI datasets at the reference plot level. This indicates that classic hand defined features are too simple for this task and highlights the potential of using deep embeddings for data-limited applications such as NFI classification. Country-scale maps built from the pre-computed embeddings reach accuracy consistent with the plot-level results and with an independent comparison against the NFI. By leveraging openly available satellite data and deep embeddings from pre-trained models, this approach consistently improves classification accuracy compared to traditional methods and can effectively complement existing forest inventory processes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估深度预训练遥感模型嵌入 (deep embeddings) 在荷兰国家森林清查 (NFI) 树种分类中的效果，比较 Presto、Alpha Earth 与 TESSERA 三种嵌入模型，并在三个难度不同的树种数据集上验证。摘要报告，公开可用的遥感时间序列深度嵌入在 NFI 树种分类上优于当前最先进的手工特征，总体精度提升约 7-9 个百分点，宏观 F1 最高提升 17 个百分点，且由预计算嵌入构建的国家尺度地图精度与样地级结果一致。
Motivation: 国家森林清查依赖专家实地调查，成本高、更新慢；深度预训练遥感模型嵌入有望以更低成本、更大尺度更频繁地更新 NFI，但少有研究系统评估其在少量标注数据下的树种分类增益。
Method: 基于三种嵌入模型 (Presto、Alpha Earth、TESSERA) 进行对比，其中 Alpha Earth 与 TESSERA 使用公开预计算嵌入，Presto 则动态计算：从 Google Earth Engine 提取 Sentinel-1、Sentinel-2、天气数据及海拔数据构成时间序列，再生成嵌入用于分类。
Result: 公开遥感时间序列深度嵌入在 NFI 树种分类上优于当前 SOTA 手工特征，在参考样地层面总体精度提升约 7-9 个百分点，宏观 F1 最高提升 17 个百分点；基于预计算嵌入的国家尺度地图精度与样地级结果一致，并与独立 NFI 对比吻合。
Conclusion: 摘要认为传统手工定义特征对该任务过于简单，深度嵌入在数据受限的 NFI 分类中具有潜力，可利用公开卫星数据与预训练模型有效补充现有森林清查流程。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文系统评估深度预训练遥感模型嵌入 (deep embeddings) 在荷兰国家森林清查 (NFI) 树种分类中的效果，比较 Presto、Alpha Earth 与 TESSERA 三种嵌入模型，并在三个难度不同的树种数据集上验证。摘要报告，公开可用的遥感时间序列深度嵌入在 NFI 树种分类上优于当前最先进的手工特征，总体精度提升约 7-9 个百分点，宏观 F1 最高提升 17 个百分点，且由预计算嵌入构建的国家尺度地图精度与样地级结果一致。

papers.title: REHEARSE: Experiential Rehearsal for Verbal Confidence Calibration in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) often express verbal confidence that is poorly aligned with actual correctness, limiting their reliability in safety-critical applications. Existing prompt-based methods treat calibration largely as a one-shot inference problem, relying on either instance-level reasoning or post-hoc self-assessment. We introduce Rehearse (Experiential Rehearsal), a training-free method that instead enables models to adapt from their own scored confidence experience. In a credence-calibration game grounded in a strictly proper scoring rule, the model receives feedback on prior confidence decisions; this experience is summarized in a post-game trajectory prefix that captures systematic over- or under-confidence. At inference time, the model applies this cross-instance calibration signal to the chain-of-thought reasoning trace for each new question. Across four LLMs, three benchmarks, and five random seeds, Rehearse achieves the lowest average ECE among training-free methods with improved accuracy, reducing average ECE by 58% relative to the uncalibrated baseline. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Experiential-Rehearsal-7C77/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Rehearse（Experiential Rehearsal），一种无需训练 (training-free) 的 LLM 口头置信度校准方法。方法让模型在一个基于严格适当评分规则 (strictly proper scoring rule) 的置信度校准博弈中，根据自身历史得分置信度反馈形成经验摘要，并在推理时将这种跨实例校准信号注入新问题的 chain-of-thought 推理轨迹。摘要报告在四个 LLM、三个基准、五个随机种子下，Rehearse 是训练无关方法中平均 ECE 最低的，且准确率有所提升，平均 ECE 相对未校准基线降低 58%。
Motivation: LLM 常表达与真实正确性不一致的口头置信度，限制其在安全关键应用中的可靠性。现有基于提示的方法基本将校准视为一次性推理问题，依赖实例级推理或事后自我评估，缺少从自身经验中适应的机制。
Method: 提出 Rehearse：让模型参与一个基于严格适当评分规则的置信度校准博弈，获得对先前置信度决策的反馈；该经验被总结为赛后轨迹前缀，捕捉系统性过度自信或不足自信。推理时将该跨实例校准信号应用于每个新问题的 chain-of-thought 推理轨迹。
Result: 在四个 LLM、三个基准、五个随机种子下，Rehearse 在训练无关方法中取得最低平均 ECE，同时提高准确率，并将平均 ECE 相对未校准基线降低 58%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过让模型从自身被评分的置信度经验中学习，可以在不训练的情况下实现跨实例口头置信度校准，并改善准确率与校准之间的平衡。

papers.title: Generalizable Operating Room Expert with Multimodal Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: Precise spatial modeling in the operating room (OR) is essential for intraoperative awareness, hazard avoidance, and surgical decision-making. Although existing approaches exploit multimodal data to learn spatial relationships, many depend on sensing modalities that are difficult to deploy in real clinical environments and remain limited in explicit 3D reasoning under constrained sensing conditions. Meanwhile, models trained primarily on readily available 2D data often fail to capture the fine-grained geometric and semantic structure of complex OR scenes. To address these limitations, we introduce \textbf{OR-Expert}, a large vision-language framework for 3D spatial reasoning with RGB-only inference. OR-Expert internally derives depth, panoptic segmentation, and point-cloud cues from RGB images and encodes them as structured spatial representations. Its Spatial-Enhanced Feature Fusion Block aligns these pseudo-modalities with RGB and textual features in a shared token space, enabling joint semantic, geometric, and language reasoning. The unified end-to-end MLLM therefore supports detailed spatial understanding without requiring external depth, segmentation, or point-cloud sensors, or additional expert annotations at inference time. Experiments on multiple operating-room benchmarks demonstrate that OR-Expert achieves state-of-the-art performance and generalizes effectively to unseen surgical scenes and downstream spatial reasoning tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OR-Expert，一个面向手术室 (operating room) 3D 空间推理的大型视觉语言框架，仅需要 RGB 图像输入。框架在内部从 RGB 推导深度、全景分割和点云线索，编码为结构化空间表示，并通过 Spatial-Enhanced Feature Fusion Block 将这些伪模态与 RGB、文本特征在共享 token 空间中对齐，实现端到端的语义、几何与语言联合推理。摘要报告在多个手术室基准上达到 state-of-the-art 性能，并能泛化到未见手术场景和下游空间推理任务。
Motivation: 现有手术室空间建模方法多依赖难以在真实临床环境部署的感知模态，且在感知受限条件下缺乏显式 3D 推理能力；基于 2D 数据训练的模型难以捕捉复杂手术室场景的细粒度几何与语义结构。
Method: 提出 OR-Expert，在端到端多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 内部从 RGB 图像推导深度、全景分割和点云作为伪模态，并编码为结构化空间表示；Spatial-Enhanced Feature Fusion Block 将这些伪模态特征与 RGB 和文本特征在共享 token 空间中融合，使推理阶段无需外部深度、分割或点云传感器以及额外专家标注。
Result: 摘要报告在多个手术室基准上取得 state-of-the-art 性能，并有效泛化到未见手术场景及下游空间推理任务；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为仅依赖 RGB 输入、通过内部伪模态生成与特征对齐即可实现无需外部传感器的手术室精细空间理解与跨场景泛化。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Consistency and inconsistency in $k$-means clustering
papers.abstract_en: A celebrated result of Pollard proves asymptotic consistency for $k$-means clustering when the population distribution has finite variance. In this work, we point out that the population-level $k$-means clustering problem is, in fact, well-posed under the weaker assumption of a finite expectation, and we investigate whether some form of asymptotic consistency holds in this setting. As we illustrate in a variety of negative results, the complete story is quite subtle; for example, the empirical $k$-means cluster centers may fail to converge even if there exists a unique set of population $k$-means cluster centers. A detailed analysis of our negative results reveals that inconsistency arises because of an extreme form of cluster imbalance, whereby the presence of outlying samples leads to some empirical $k$-means clusters possessing very few points. We then give a collection of positive results which show that some forms of asymptotic consistency, under only the assumption of finite expectation, may be recovered by imposing some a priori degree of balance among the empirical $k$-means clusters.
papers.journal_ref: Electronic Journal of Statistics 20(2):3291-3334 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究k-means聚类的渐近相合性。Pollard的经典结果表明，当总体分布具有有限方差时，k-means聚类具有渐近相合性；本文指出在仅要求有限期望的较弱假设下，总体层面的k-means问题仍是适定的，但经验簇中心可能不收敛，即使总体簇中心唯一。作者通过一系列负结果和正结果说明，不一致性源于极端簇不平衡，而施加一定的经验簇平衡约束可以恢复某种形式的渐近相合性。
Motivation: 经典k-means相合性依赖于有限方差假设，而实践中许多重尾分布仅满足有限期望。本文试图回答在有限期望假设下k-means聚类是否仍然渐近相合，并刻画其成立的条件。
Method: 作者给出多种反例说明有限期望下经验k-means簇中心可能不收敛，并分析不一致性的机制——离群样本导致某些经验簇只包含极少数点。随后提出施加先验的簇间平衡约束，证明在此条件下可以恢复部分渐近相合性。
Result: 摘要报告的主要结果为：即使存在唯一的总体k-means簇中心，经验簇中心也可能不收敛；不一致性源于极端的簇不平衡；通过人为限制经验簇的平衡程度，可以在仅有限期望假设下重新获得某些形式的渐近相合性。
Conclusion: 本文认为有限期望假设下k-means聚类的相合性问题比有限方差情形更微妙，完全相合性一般无法保证，但可通过簇平衡约束部分恢复。结论强调了簇不平衡在理论中的核心作用。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Finite-Time Minimax Bounds and an Optimal Lyapunov Policy in Queueing Control
papers.abstract_en: We introduce an original minimax framework for finite-time performance analysis in queueing control and propose a surprisingly simple Lyapunov-based scheduling policy with superior finite-time performance. The framework quantitatively characterizes how the expected total queue length scales with key system parameters, including the capacity of the scheduling set and the variability of arrivals and departures across queues. This characterization provides a systematic quantitative basis for evaluating and comparing scheduling policies in the finite-time regime, including nonstationary settings under certain assumptions on the model, and shows that the proposed policy provably and empirically outperforms the classical MaxWeight strategy in finite time. Within this framework, we establish three main sets of results. First, we derive minimax lower bounds on the expected total queue length for parallel-queue scheduling via a novel Brownian coupling argument. Second, we propose a new policy, LyapOpt, which minimizes the full quadratic Lyapunov drift-capturing both first- and second-order terms-and achieves optimal finite-time performance under the dominated region condition in heavy traffic while retaining classical stability guarantees. Third, we identify a key limitation of the classical MaxWeight policy, which optimizes only the first-order drift: its finite-time performance depends suboptimally on system parameters, leading to substantially larger backlogs in explicitly characterized settings. Together, these results delineate the scope and limitations of classical drift-based scheduling and motivate new queueing-control methods with rigorous finite-time guarantees.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出排队控制中有限时间性能分析的极小极大 (minimax) 框架，并给出一个基于 Lyapunov 的简单调度策略 LyapOpt。摘要表明该策略在有限时间内理论上和经验上都优于经典 MaxWeight，并推导了并行队列调度中期望总队长度的极小极大下界。作者通过新颖的 Brownian coupling 论证下界，并指出 MaxWeight 只优化一阶漂移导致其有限时间性能依赖参数次优。
Motivation: 现有排队调度策略多关注稳态或渐近性能，缺乏对有限时间 (finite-time) 行为的定量刻画。经典 MaxWeight 仅优化一阶 Lyapunov 漂移，其有限时间性能可能随系统参数次优扩展，因此需要能严格刻画并改善有限时间回队长度的框架与策略。
Method: 提出一个针对排队控制的极小极大分析框架，定量刻画期望总队列长度如何随调度集容量、各队列到达与服务的变异性等关键参数变化；提出新策略 LyapOpt，最小化同时包含一阶与二阶项的完整二次 Lyapunov 漂移；并通过新颖的 Brownian coupling 论证推导有限时间极小极大下界。
Result: 摘要报告三组主要结果：导出并行队列调度期望总队长度的极小极大下界；LyapOpt 在 heavy traffic 下的 dominated region 条件中达到最优有限时间性能，同时保留经典稳定性保证；经典 MaxWeight 因只优化一阶漂移，其有限时间性能次优，在显式刻画的情形中导致显著更大的积压。
Conclusion: 结果表明经典基于漂移的调度策略在有限时间范围存在局限，并激励具备严格有限时间保证的新排队控制方法。摘要同时说明部分结果（包括非平稳设定）依赖对模型的特定假设。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Shortest-Path Decomposition for Foliage-Robust 3D Tree Modeling and Above-Ground Biomass Estimation from Point Clouds
papers.abstract_en: Estimating above-ground biomass (AGB) from terrestrial laser scanning (TLS) via quantitative structural models (QSMs) is highly accurate under leaf-off conditions, yet major QSM paradigms degrade sharply when foliage is present. The standard remedy, leaf-wood separation, introduces its own errors and complexity. We present topology-driven foliage suppression that replaces explicit leaf--wood classification inside the reconstruction pipeline. On the shortest-path tree of a point-cloud graph, the number of root-to-node paths traversing a node equals the size of its rooted subtree, so path traversal frequency is an exact topological descriptor of branching hierarchy. Three decompositions of the path structure, plus an adaptive frequency threshold at the elbow of frequency growth along each branch, recover the branching hierarchy from a single Dijkstra run. We evaluate it on 90 trees under exclusively leaf-on conditions across tropical TLS and temperate UAV laser scanning (ULS) platforms. On dense tropical TLS it achieves a mean absolute percentage deviation (MAPD) of 17.2% with RMSE 2.37~Mg (RMSE% 34.8%) and an R^2 of 0.956, outperforming the best separation-assisted TreeQSM pipeline (21.2%). Structural analysis confirms that foliage introduces 2.6~cm of mean geometric error (3.8~cm RMS) and preserves the hierarchical volume distribution. On low-density ULS data, MAPD reaches 6.4% with field-measured diameter at breast height (DBH) and 32.3% with DBH inferred allometrically from tree height. All AGB experiments use identical parameter settings. Directly recovering branching hierarchy from shortest-path structure removes a barrier to operational QSM-based forest inventory under leaf-on conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于最短路径分解的拓扑驱动叶片抑制方法，用于在叶茂（leaf-on）条件下从点云重建三维树结构并估算地上生物量（AGB），替代传统的先做叶-木分离再重建的流程。作者利用点云图最短路径树中路径遍历频率作为分支层级的精确拓扑描述，结合三种路径结构分解和自适应频率阈值，仅需一次 Dijkstra 运行即可恢复分支层级。在 90 棵全叶态树木的评估中，该方法在热带 TLS 与温带 ULS 数据上均优于现有分离辅助的 TreeQSM 流程。
Motivation: 基于 TLS 和定量结构模型（QSM）的 AGB 估算在落叶（leaf-off）条件下很准确，但叶茂时主流 QSM 范式表现急剧下降；常见的补救手段叶-木分离会引入额外误差和复杂度，成为叶茂条件下森林清查的实际障碍。
Method: 提出用拓扑驱动的叶片抑制取代重建流程中显式的叶-木分类：在点云图的最短路径树上，经过某节点的根到节点路径数等于其子树大小，因此路径遍历频率是分支层级的精确拓扑描述子；通过对路径结构做三种分解，并沿每条分支在频率增长肘部取自适应阈值，从单次 Dijkstra 运行中恢复分支层级。
Result: 在 90 棵全叶态树木上，密集热带 TLS 数据的平均绝对百分比偏差（MAPD）为 17.2%，RMSE 2.37 Mg（RMSE% 34.8%），R² 为 0.956，优于最佳分离辅助 TreeQSM 流程的 21.2%；结构分析显示叶片引入 2.6 cm 平均几何误差（3.8 cm RMS）并保持层级体积分布。低密度 ULS 数据上，使用野外实测胸径（DBH）时 MAPD 为 6.4%，使用异速生长推断 DBH 时为 32.3%；所有 AGB 实验使用相同参数设置。
Conclusion: 直接从最短路径结构恢复分支层级，消除了在叶茂条件下进行可操作的基于 QSM 森林清查的障碍；作者强调该方法无需显式叶-木分离即可实现鲁棒的 AGB 估算。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: In Silico Study for Optimizing Intensity and Focality Electrode Configurations for Directional DBS Under Uncertainty Using Metaheuristic L1L1 Method
papers.abstract_en: Background and Objective: As Deep Brain Stimulation (DBS) advances toward directional leads and optimization-based current steering, selecting electrode contact configurations becomes complex. This study formulates configuration selection as an inverse mapping between target activation and electrode currents using metaheuristic L1-norm regularized L1-norm fitting (L1L1). L1L1 incorporates lead-field uncertainty arising from electrode placement, tissue properties, and forward modeling assumptions. Methods: The framework introduces lead-field perturbations and restricts the controllable domain through a sensitivity-based feasibility criterion within a finite element formulation derived using the Complete Electrode Model. Current distributions were optimized for 8- and 40-contact leads. Performance was evaluated using focused current density, nuisance current density, and their ratio under safety and sparsity constraints. Results: L1L1 was evaluated using noiseless and noisy lead fields, with noise selected to reflect attenuation within the volume of tissue activated. The method produced sparse, spatially selective stimulation patterns across perturbation levels. Hyperparameter optimization yielded bipolar or multipolar configurations. Compared with the Reciprocity Principle (RP), which produced strictly bipolar configurations, and Tikhonov-regularized least squares (TLS), which produced more distributed solutions, L1L1 enabled controlled transitions between sparse and multipolar patterns. It concentrated stimulation within the target while limiting unintended current spread, particularly under noisy conditions. Conclusions: L1L1 can assist specialists in optimizing DBS configurations. By incorporating uncertainty directly into optimization, it provides robust and interpretable current steering across lead configurations while accounting for forward-model variability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对定向深脑刺激（DBS）中电极接触组合选择问题，提出基于元启发式 L1 范数正则化 L1 范数拟合（L1L1）的逆映射框架，将目标激活与电极电流关联，并在优化中纳入铅场不确定性。作者在 8 与 40 触点导联上，用完整电极模型（Complete Electrode Model）的有限元公式生成含扰动的铅场，评估聚焦电流密度、杂散电流密度及其比值。结果表明 L1L1 可产生稀疏、空间选择性强的刺激模式，并与互易原理（RP）和 Tikhonov 正则化最小二乘（TLS）形成对比，支持在稀疏与多极模式间受控切换。
Motivation: 随着 DBS 走向定向导联与基于优化的电流控制，电极接触配置选择变得复杂，且铅场不确定性（电极位置、组织属性、正演建模假设）会影响优化结果，需要把这种不确定性纳入配置选择的逆映射中。
Method: 将配置选择建模为目标激活与电极电流之间的逆映射，采用 L1L1（L1 范数正则化的 L1 范数拟合）元启发式方法；引入铅场扰动，并通过基于灵敏度的可行性准则限制可控域；在 8 与 40 触点导联上优化电流分布，并在安全与稀疏约束下比较聚焦电流密度、杂散电流密度及其比值。
Result: 摘要报告 L1L1 在不同扰动水平下产生稀疏且空间选择性的刺激模式；超参数优化得到双极或多极配置。与产生严格双极配置的 RP 和产生更分布式解的 TLS 相比，L1L1 能在稀疏与多极模式间受控过渡，并在噪声条件下更集中刺激于靶区、限制杂散电流。
Conclusion: L1L1 可在优化中直接纳入不确定性，为不同导联配置提供稳健且可解释的电流控制，辅助专家优化 DBS 配置；摘要未展开具体临床验证或局限细节。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Lyapunov Drift-Plus-Penalty Method Tailored for Reinforcement Learning with Queue Stability
papers.abstract_en: With the proliferation of Internet of Things (IoT) devices, the demand for addressing complex optimization challenges has intensified. The Lyapunov Drift-Plus-Penalty algorithm is a widely adopted approach for ensuring queue stability, and some research has preliminarily explored its integration with reinforcement learning (RL). In this paper, we investigate the adaptation of the Lyapunov Drift-Plus-Penalty algorithm for RL applications, deriving an effective method for combining Lyapunov Drift-Plus-Penalty with RL under a set of common and reasonable conditions through rigorous theoretical analysis. Unlike existing approaches that directly merge the two frameworks, our proposed algorithm, termed Lyapunov drift-plus-penalty method tailored for reinforcement learning with queue stability (LDPTRLQ) algorithm, offers theoretical superiority by effectively balancing the greedy optimization of Lyapunov Drift-Plus-Penalty with the long-term perspective of RL. Simulation results for multiple problems demonstrate that LDPTRLQ outperforms the baseline methods using the Lyapunov drift-plus-penalty method and RL, corroborating the validity of our theoretical derivations. The results also demonstrate that our proposed algorithm outperforms other benchmarks in terms of compatibility and stability.
papers.comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Lyapunov Drift-Plus-Penalty (DPP) 算法在强化学习 (RL) 中面向队列稳定性的适配问题，通过理论分析推导出一组常见合理条件下将 DPP 与 RL 结合的有效方式，并提出 LDPTRLQ 算法。该算法试图在 DPP 的贪心优化与 RL 的长远视角之间取得平衡。多个问题的仿真结果表明 LDPTRLQ 优于单独使用 DPP 或 RL 的基线方法，并在兼容性与稳定性方面表现更好。
Motivation: 随着物联网 (IoT) 设备激增，复杂优化问题日益增多；Lyapunov Drift-Plus-Penalty 是保证队列稳定性的常用方法，已有研究初步探索其与 RL 的结合，但现有方法多为直接合并两个框架，缺乏理论上的精细适配。
Method: 通过严格的理论分析，在一组常见且合理的条件下推导将 Lyapunov Drift-Plus-Penalty 与强化学习结合的有效方法，提出名为 LDPTRLQ 的算法，以平衡 DPP 的贪心优化与 RL 的长期视角。
Result: 仿真结果表明，在多个问题上 LDPTRLQ 均优于采用 Lyapunov drift-plus-penalty 方法和 RL 的基线方法，并且相比其他基准在兼容性和稳定性上表现更优，验证了理论推导的有效性。
Conclusion: 作者强调其方法在理论上具有优越性，并得到仿真验证；论文已提交 IEEE 审稿。
Relevance: 3
