papers.title: Trajectory First: A Curriculum for Discovering Diverse Policies
papers.abstract_en: Being able to solve a task in diverse ways makes agents more robust to task variations and less prone to local optima. In this context, constrained diversity optimization has become a useful reinforcement learning (RL) framework for training a set of diverse agents in parallel. However, existing constrained-diversity RL methods often under-explore in complex tasks such as robot manipulation, resulting in limited behavioral diversity. We address this with a two-stage curriculum that introduces a spline-based trajectory prior as an inductive bias to produce diverse, high-reward behaviors in an initial stage, and then distills these behaviors into reactive, step-wise policies in a second stage. In our empirical evaluation, we provide novel insights into challenges of diversity-targeted training and show that our curriculum increases the diversity of learned skills while maintaining high task performance.
papers.comment: Best paper at the Inductive Biases in Reinforcement Learning Workshop at RLC 2025
papers.journal_ref: Reinforcement Learning Journal 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对复杂任务（如机器人操作）中约束多样性强化学习（constrained-diversity RL）探索不足的问题，提出一个两阶段课程：先用基于样条（spline）的轨迹先验作为归纳偏置生成多样且高回报的行为，再将这些行为蒸馏为反应式逐步策略。实验表明该方法在保持高任务性能的同时提升了所学技能的多样性，并给出了多样性目标训练中挑战的新见解。
Motivation: 现有约束多样性RL方法在机器人操作等复杂任务中往往探索不足，导致行为多样性有限，影响对任务变化的鲁棒性和避免局部最优的能力。
Method: 提出两阶段课程：第一阶段引入基于样条的轨迹先验作为归纳偏置以产生多样、高回报行为；第二阶段将这些行为蒸馏成反应式、逐步的策略。
Result: 摘要报告在经验评估中，该方法在保持高任务性能的同时提高了所学技能的多样性，并提供了对多样性目标训练中挑战的新见解。
Conclusion: 摘要强调以轨迹优先的课程式归纳偏置能够缓解现有约束多样性RL在复杂任务中的欠探索问题，适用于机器人操作等场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: How Significant Are the Real Performance Gains? An Unbiased Evaluation Framework for GraphRAG
papers.abstract_en: By retrieving contexts from knowledge graphs, graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) enhances large language models (LLMs) to generate quality answers for user questions. Many GraphRAG methods have been proposed and reported inspiring performance in answer quality. However, we observe that the current answer evaluation framework for GraphRAG has two critical flaws, i.e., unrelated questions and evaluation biases, which may lead to biased or even wrong conclusions on performance. To tackle the two flaws, we propose an unbiased evaluation framework that uses graph-text-grounded question generation to produce questions that are more related to the underlying dataset and an unbiased evaluation procedure to eliminate the biases in LLM-based answer assessment. We apply our unbiased framework to evaluate 3 representative GraphRAG methods and find that their performance gains are much more moderate than reported previously. Although our evaluation framework may still have flaws, it calls for scientific evaluations to lay solid foundations for GraphRAG research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出现有 GraphRAG（基于图的检索增强生成）答案评估框架存在两个关键缺陷——无关问题与评估偏差，可能导致有偏甚至错误的性能结论。作者提出一个无偏评估框架，利用基于图-文本的问题生成（graph-text-grounded question generation）产生与底层数据集更相关的问题，并采用无偏评估流程消除基于 LLM 的答案评估偏差。将该框架应用于 3 个代表性 GraphRAG 方法后，发现它们的性能提升比此前报道的温和得多，并呼吁 GraphRAG 研究应建立在更科学的评估基础上。
Motivation: GraphRAG 方法通常宣称在答案质量上取得显著性能提升，但现有评估框架存在无关问题和评估偏差两个关键缺陷，可能使性能结论有偏甚至错误，因此需要更可靠的评估方法来检验真实增益。
Method: 提出一个无偏评估框架，核心包括两部分：一是使用图-文本问题生成（graph-text-grounded question generation）生成与数据集更相关的问题；二是设计无偏评估流程，用于消除基于 LLM 的答案评估中存在的偏差。
Result: 将该框架应用于 3 个代表性 GraphRAG 方法进行评估，结果显示它们的性能提升相比以往报道要温和得多，表明此前报告的性能增益可能被高估。

papers.title: Exploiting Symbolic Heuristics for the Synthesis of Domain-Specific Temporal Planning Guidance using Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Recent work investigated the use of Reinforcement Learning (RL) for the synthesis of heuristic guidance to improve the performance of temporal planners when a domain is fixed and a set of training problems (not plans) is given. The idea is to extract a heuristic from the value function of a particular (possibly infinite-state) MDP constructed over the training problems. In this paper, we propose an evolution of this learning and planning framework that focuses on exploiting the information provided by symbolic heuristics during both the RL and planning phases. First, we formalize different reward schemata for the synthesis and use symbolic heuristics to mitigate the problems caused by the truncation of episodes needed to deal with the potentially infinite MDP. Second, we propose learning a residual of an existing symbolic heuristic, which is a "correction" of the heuristic value, instead of eagerly learning the whole heuristic from scratch. Finally, we use the learned heuristic in combination with a symbolic heuristic using a multiple-queue planning approach to balance systematic search with imperfect learned information. We experimentally compare all the approaches, highlighting their strengths and weaknesses and significantly advancing the state of the art for this planning and learning schema.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在给定固定领域和一组训练问题（而非规划）时，用强化学习（RL）为时间规划器合成启发式指导。作者提出对该学习-规划框架的演进：在 RL 与规划阶段都利用符号启发式（symbolic heuristics）的信息，包括设计多种奖励模式以缓解无限状态 MDP 中情节截断带来的问题，学习现有符号启发式的残差（residual）而非从头学习整个启发式，并用多队列规划方法将所学启发式与符号启发式结合。实验比较表明该方法在该规划与学习范式下显著推进了现有技术水平。
Motivation: 现有方法在固定领域与给定训练问题（不含规划）条件下用 RL 从值函数提取启发式，但面对可能无限状态的 MDP，情节截断会引入问题，且从零学习完整启发式成本高。
Method: 形式化不同的奖励模式用于启发式合成，并借助符号启发式缓解情节截断带来的偏差；提出学习现有符号启发式的一个残差修正项，而非从头训练；在规划阶段用多队列（multiple-queue）方式结合符号启发式与学习得到的启发式，以在系统性搜索与不完美学习信息之间取得平衡。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值，仅报告对所有方法进行了实验对比，指出各自优缺点，并称该学习与规划范式相对已有工作显著推进了当前最优水平。
Conclusion: 作者强调所提出的利用符号启发式的多种策略各有优劣，整体上使这一规划-学习框架取得明显进展。

papers.title: Exploring Sparsity for Parameter Efficient Fine Tuning Using Wavelets for Vision
papers.abstract_en: Efficiently adapting large pretrained models is critical under tight compute and memory budgets. While Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) methods like LoRA achieve efficiency through low-rank updates, their discrete rank constraint limits fine-grained parameter control and confines adaptations to low-dimensional subspaces. We propose Wavelet Fine-Tuning (WaveFT), which learns sparse updates in the wavelet domain of weight matrices, enabling fine-grained control over trainable parameters well below LoRA's minimum rank. Wavelet bases provide semi-local receptive fields that aggregate spatially coherent gradients, offering better coverage than direct weight sparsity (SHiRA) without the destructive interference of global Fourier bases (FourierFT). We provide theoretical analysis showing: (i) sparse methods achieve high-rank updates, avoiding LoRA's subspace bottleneck and enabling higher representational capacity, and (ii) a gradient coverage framework explaining when WaveFT is preferable. We perform experiments across text-to-image generation, image classification, and language understanding. WaveFT demonstrates state-of-the-art results among PEFT methods for vision tasks, where wavelets effectively capture sparse gradient structure through improved coverage, while performing comparably on NLP tasks. WaveFT has officially been included in the Hugging Face PEFT library (huggingface.co/docs/peft/en/package_reference/waveft).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Wavelet Fine-Tuning (WaveFT)，一种在权重矩阵小波域中学习稀疏更新的参数高效微调方法。与 LoRA 的低秩更新相比，WaveFT 能够实现低于 LoRA 最小秩的细粒度参数控制；相比直接权重稀疏 (SHiRA) 和全局傅里叶基 (FourierFT)，小波基提供半局部感受野，能聚合空间一致的梯度并减少破坏性干扰。实验涵盖文本到图像生成、图像分类和语言理解，视觉任务上在 PEFT 方法中达到 SOTA，且已正式纳入 Hugging Face PEFT 库。
Motivation: LoRA 等 PEFT 方法通过低秩更新获得效率，但离散的秩约束限制了细粒度参数控制，并把适配局限在低维子空间中，难以兼顾参数效率与表达能力。
Method: 提出 WaveFT，在权重矩阵的小波域学习稀疏更新，利用小波基的半局部感受野来聚合梯度；同时给出理论分析，说明稀疏方法能实现高秩更新以避免 LoRA 的子空间瓶颈，并提出梯度覆盖框架来判断 WaveFT 何时优于其他稀疏或谱域方法。
Result: 在文本到图像生成、图像分类和语言理解任务上的实验表明，WaveFT 在视觉任务的 PEFT 方法中取得 SOTA 结果，在 NLP 任务上与现有方法相当；该方法已集成进 Hugging Face PEFT 库。
Conclusion: 摘要认为小波域稀疏更新通过改进梯度覆盖，比直接稀疏和傅里叶基方法更适合视觉任务，且无需牺牲 NLP 任务性能；但摘要未报告其在天气或降水相关数据上的验证。

papers.title: Foam-Agent: A Large Language Model-Based Multi-Agent Framework for Automating Computational Fluid Dynamics Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) has been the main workhorse of computational physics, yet its steep learning curve and fragmented, multi-stage workflow create significant barriers to entry. We present Foam-Agent, a multi-agent framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) to automate the end-to-end CFD workflow in OpenFOAM from a single natural-language prompt. Foam-Agent rests on three methodological contributions. First, a multi-index retrieval scheme organizes domain knowledge along four complementary structural dimensions and selects indices by workflow stage, sharpening retrieval precision over conventional single-index retrieval-augmented generation. Second, dependency-aware file generation is formulated as a topological traversal of the OpenFOAM case dependency graph, so that each configuration file is synthesized in the context of its already-generated predecessors, enforcing cross-file consistency. Third, a trajectory-conditioned reviewer loop iteratively repairs failed runs by conditioning each correction on the accumulated error-and-diagnosis trajectory of its own previous attempts, applying a minimal configuration edit that targets a reduced solver-error set. Around these contributions, six specialist agents span planning, meshing, file writing, execution, review, and visualization; Foam-Agent additionally exposes its capabilities through the Model Context Protocol as a deployment surface for external orchestrators. On FoamBench, Foam-Agent achieves an 88.2% execution success rate on the 110 Basic-tier tasks and 62.5% on the out-of-distribution Advanced tier, all without expert intervention. These results show how strategic harnessing of specialized multi-agent systems can reduce expertise barriers while preserving the rigor of solver-based simulation workflows.
papers.journal_ref: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering, Vol. 461, 119271 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Foam-Agent，一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体框架，用于从单一自然语言提示自动完成 OpenFOAM 中端到端的计算流体动力学（CFD）工作流。框架包含多索引检索、依赖感知的文件生成和基于轨迹条件的评审循环三个方法贡献，并由六个专业智能体分别负责规划、网格划分、文件编写、执行、评审和可视化。在 FoamBench 基准上，无需专家干预即可在 110 个 Basic 级任务上达到 88.2% 的执行成功率，在分布外的 Advanced 级任务上达到 62.5%。
Motivation: CFD 虽然是计算物理的主要工具，但其陡峭的学习曲线和碎片化、多阶段的工作流形成了显著的入门障碍。
Method: Foam-Agent 提出三项方法贡献：多索引检索方案沿四个互补的结构维度组织领域知识并按工作流阶段选择索引；依赖感知的文件生成被形式化为 OpenFOAM 案例依赖图的拓扑遍历，以强制执行跨文件一致性；轨迹条件化评审循环通过依据先前尝试累积的错误与诊断轨迹进行修正，并施加最小配置编辑以针对减少的求解器错误集。框架还通过 Model Context Protocol 暴露能力供外部编排器部署。
Result: 在 FoamBench 上，Foam-Agent 在 110 个 Basic 级任务上达到 88.2% 的执行成功率，在分布外的 Advanced 级任务上达到 62.5%，全程无需专家干预。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，策略性地利用专业化多智能体系统可以降低 CFD 领域的专业门槛，同时保持基于求解器的仿真工作流的严谨性。

papers.title: Unsupervised training of keypoint-agnostic descriptors for flexible retinal image registration
papers.abstract_en: Current color fundus image registration approaches are limited, among other things, by the lack of labeled data, which is even more significant in the medical domain, motivating the use of unsupervised learning. Therefore, in this work, we develop a novel unsupervised descriptor learning method that does not rely on keypoint detection. This enables the resulting descriptor network to be agnostic to the keypoint detector used during the registration inference. To validate this approach, we perform an extensive and comprehensive comparison on the reference public retinal image registration dataset. Additionally, we test our method with multiple keypoint detectors of varied nature, even proposing some novel ones. Our results demonstrate that the proposed approach offers accurate registration, not incurring in any performance loss versus supervised methods. Additionally, it demonstrates accurate performance regardless of the keypoint detector used. Thus, this work represents a notable step towards leveraging unsupervised learning in the medical domain.
papers.journal_ref: Pattern Recognition Letters, 208, 41-47 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无监督的视网膜图像配准描述子学习方法，不依赖关键点检测，使描述子网络在推理时对所用关键点检测器保持无关性。作者在公开视网膜图像配准数据集上进行了广泛对比，并使用多种性质不同的关键点检测器验证，结果表明该方法能达到与监督方法相当的准确配准性能，且不随检测器变化而损失精度。
Motivation: 彩色眼底图像配准受限于标注数据缺乏，在医学领域这一问题尤为突出，因此需要借助无监督学习来缓解对标注的依赖。
Method: 开发了一种不依赖关键点检测的无监督描述子学习方法，使得训练出的描述子网络对推理阶段使用的关键点检测器具有不可知性（agnostic）。
Result: 在公开视网膜图像配准参考数据集上的大量对比表明，该方法在配准精度上与监督方法无性能损失，并且在使用多种性质不同的关键点检测器时均保持准确性能，包括作者新提出的一些检测器。
Conclusion: 这项工作表明无监督学习可在医学图像配准中达到与监督方法相当的效果，且对关键点检测器选择具有鲁棒性，是向医学领域无监督学习应用迈出的重要一步。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Unsupervised Deep Learning-based Keypoint Localization Estimating Descriptor Matching Performance
papers.abstract_en: Retinal image registration, particularly for color fundus images, is a challenging yet essential task with diverse clinical applications. Existing registration methods for color fundus images typically rely on keypoints and descriptors for alignment; however, a significant limitation is their reliance on labeled data, which is particularly scarce in the medical domain. In this work, we present a novel unsupervised registration pipeline that entirely eliminates the need for labeled data. Our approach is based on the principle that locations with distinctive descriptors constitute reliable keypoints. This fully inverts the conventional state-of-the-art approach, conditioning the detector on the descriptor rather than the opposite. First, we propose an innovative descriptor learning method that operates without keypoint detection or any labels, generating descriptors for arbitrary locations in retinal images. Next, we introduce a novel, label-free keypoint detector network which works by estimating descriptor performance directly from the input image. We validate our method through a comprehensive evaluation on four hold-out datasets, demonstrating that our unsupervised descriptor outperforms state-of-the-art supervised descriptors and that our unsupervised detector significantly outperforms existing unsupervised detection methods. Finally, our full registration pipeline achieves performance comparable to the leading supervised methods, while not employing any labeled data. Additionally, the label-free nature and design of our method enable direct adaptation to other domains and modalities.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对彩色眼底图像配准中标注数据稀缺的问题，提出一种完全无监督的配准流水线。其核心思想是反转传统做法，不再让描述符依赖检测器，而是以描述符的区分性（distinctiveness）作为关键点定位的依据。方法包括一种无需关键点检测或标签的描述符学习方式，以及一个直接从输入图像估计描述符匹配性能（descriptor matching performance）的无标签关键点检测网络。在四个保留数据集上的评估显示，该无监督描述符优于现有监督描述符，无监督检测器显著优于现有无监督方法，完整配准流水线达到与领先监督方法相当的性能且不使用任何标签。
Motivation: 现有彩色眼底图像配准方法通常依赖关键点与描述符，但需要带标签数据，而医学影像领域标注十分稀缺。本文旨在消除对标签的依赖，为视网膜图像配准提供无监督方案。
Method: 先提出一种无需关键点检测或任何标签的描述符学习方法，为视网膜图像中的任意位置生成描述符；再引入一个无标签的关键点检测器网络，通过直接从输入图像估计描述符匹配性能来定位可靠关键点，从而将检测器建模为描述符的函数而非相反。
Result: 在四个保留数据集上的实验表明，无监督描述符优于当前最优的监督描述符，无监督检测器显著优于现有无监督检测方法；完整无监督配准流水线的性能与领先的监督方法相当，且全程未使用任何标签数据。
Conclusion: 该方法的无标签特性和整体设计使其能够直接迁移到其他领域与模态，为缺乏标注数据的医学影像配准以及更广泛的应用提供了可行的无监督路线。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Multiview Representation Learning via Distributed Joint Latent Space Structuring
papers.abstract_en: We study distributed multiview representation learning, a problem in which $K$ clients each observe a distinct but possibly statistically correlated view. The clients independently extract local representations from their views, which are then used by a central decoder for joint target estimation. One central difficulty is that, since the clients are not allowed to communicate with each other, they must autonomously decide what to encode. We study this coordination problem from a generalization error perspective. For both classification and regression tasks, we derive novel generalization bounds expressed in terms of the Minimum Description Length (MDL) of the joint latent variables across all views and across both training and test datasets. Our structure-aware bound reveals that statistical correlations among the extracted representations tighten the bound, providing theoretical grounding for the empirically observed benefits of cross-view feature alignment. Perhaps counterintuitively, our findings imply that encoders may benefit from extracting redundant representations. Motivated by these bounds, we introduce a data-dependent Gaussian product mixture prior that can be learned and applied in a fully distributed manner. The joint structure of this multiview prior captures inter-view dependencies that are typically discarded by marginal-only approaches. Comprehensive experiments across multiple datasets, encoder architectures, numbers of views, and distortion settings demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究分布式多视角表示学习（distributed multiview representation learning）：K 个客户端各自观测一个不同但可能统计相关的视图，独立提取局部表示，再由中央解码器做联合目标估计。作者从泛化误差角度分析客户端的协调问题，为分类和回归任务推导出以联合潜变量（所有视图、训练与测试数据）的 MDL 表示的新泛化界。该结构感知界表明表示间的统计相关性会收紧界，并由此提出一种可完全分布式学习的数据相关高斯乘积混合先验。
Motivation: 在分布式多视角学习中，客户端之间不允许通信，却需要自主决定编码哪些信息，这一协调问题缺乏泛化误差层面的理论刻画。作者希望理解表示间的统计相关性如何影响联合估计的泛化性能，并为支持跨视图特征对齐的已有经验结果提供理论依据。
Method: 从泛化误差视角出发，为分类和回归任务推导以联合潜变量 MDL 表示的泛化界；基于该界提出一个数据相关的高斯乘积混合先验（Gaussian product mixture prior），其联合结构可捕获被边际化方法丢弃的视图间依赖，并且能完全分布式地学习和应用。
Result: 结构感知的泛化界显示，提取表示之间的统计相关性会收紧界，为跨视图特征对齐的经验收益提供理论解释；反直觉的推论是编码器可能受益于提取冗余表示。摘要还报告在多个数据集、编码器架构、视图数量和失真设置下的综合实验验证了所提方法的有效性。
Conclusion: 作者认为，分布式编码时应保留视图间的联合结构而非仅用边际表示，这既能收紧泛化界，也通过所学先验在中央解码端利用已被丢弃的视图间依赖。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Yes, Q-learning Helps Offline In-Context RL
papers.abstract_en: Existing offline in-context reinforcement learning (ICRL) methods have predominantly relied on supervised training objectives, which are known to have limitations in offline RL settings. In this study, we explore the integration of RL objectives within an offline ICRL framework. Through experiments on more than 150 GridWorld and MuJoCo environment-derived datasets, we demonstrate that optimizing RL objectives directly improves performance by approximately 30% on average compared to widely adopted Algorithm Distillation (AD), across various dataset coverages, structures, expertise levels, and environmental complexities. Furthermore, in the challenging XLand-MiniGrid environment, RL objectives doubled the performance of AD. Our results also reveal that the addition of conservatism during value learning brings additional improvements in almost all settings tested. Our findings emphasize the importance of aligning ICRL learning objectives with the RL reward-maximization goal, and demonstrate that offline RL is a promising direction for advancing ICRL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在离线上下文强化学习 (in-context RL, ICRL) 中引入 RL 目标而非纯监督目标的效果。作者在超过 150 个 GridWorld 与 MuJoCo 环境派生数据集上实验，发现直接优化 RL 目标相比广泛使用的 Algorithm Distillation (AD) 平均提升约 30%，并在 XLand-MiniGrid 上性能翻倍。加入价值学习保守性 (conservatism) 在几乎所有测试设置中带来额外改进，表明 ICRL 的学习目标应与 RL 奖励最大化目标对齐。
Motivation: 现有离线 ICRL 方法主要依赖监督训练目标，而监督目标在离线 RL 场景下存在已知局限；作者希望探索将 RL 目标整合进离线 ICRL 框架是否能弥补这一缺陷。
Method: 在离线 ICRL 框架中整合 RL 优化目标，具体体现为 Q-learning 式的价值学习，并在价值学习过程中加入保守性 (conservatism) 约束以提升离线设置下的稳定性。
Result: 在 150 多个 GridWorld 和 MuJoCo 环境派生数据集上，RL 目标相比 Algorithm Distillation (AD) 平均改进约 30%，覆盖不同数据集覆盖度、结构、专家水平和环境复杂度；在更具挑战性的 XLand-MiniGrid 环境中性能翻倍，且保守性在几乎所有设置中带来额外提升。
Conclusion: 作者强调将 ICRL 的学习目标与 RL 奖励最大化目标对齐的重要性，并认为离线 RL 是推进 ICRL 的有前景方向。

papers.title: Regularization can make diffusion models more efficient
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models are one of the key architectures of generative AI. Their main drawback, however, is the computational costs. This study indicates that the concept of sparsity, well known especially in statistics, can provide a pathway to more efficient diffusion pipelines. Our mathematical guarantees prove that sparsity can reduce the input dimension's influence on the computational complexity to that of a much smaller intrinsic dimension of the data. Our empirical findings confirm that inducing sparsity can indeed lead to better samples at a lower cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究稀疏性（sparsity）这一统计学概念能否提升扩散模型（diffusion model）的计算效率。作者给出数学保证，证明稀疏性可以将输入维度对计算复杂度的影响降低到数据内在维度（intrinsic dimension）的水平；经验结果也表明诱导稀疏性可以在更低成本下生成更好的样本。
Motivation: 扩散模型是生成式人工智能的关键架构之一，其主要缺点是计算成本高。论文希望借助统计学中成熟的稀疏性概念，为更高效的扩散流程提供路径。
Method: 通过引入稀疏性（正则化）来降低扩散模型的计算开销；理论上证明稀疏性可使计算复杂度从输入维度依赖降到内在维度依赖，并用实证研究验证诱导稀疏性的效果。
Result: 摘要报告了数学上的复杂度降低保证，并给出实证结论：诱导稀疏性可以在更低成本下获得更好的样本。摘要未提供具体数据集或数值。
Conclusion: 论文的结论是稀疏性为更高效的扩散模型流程提供了一条可行途径，能够兼顾生成质量与计算成本。
Relevance: 45

papers.title: Optimizing Likelihoods via Mutual Information: Bridging Simulation-Based Inference and Bayesian Optimal Experimental Design
papers.abstract_en: Simulation-based inference (SBI) is a method to perform inference on a variety of complex scientific models with challenging inference (inverse) problems. Bayesian Optimal Experimental Design (BOED) aims to efficiently use experimental resources to make better inferences. Various stochastic gradient-based BOED methods have been proposed as an alternative to Bayesian optimization and other experimental design heuristics to maximize information gain from an experiment. We demonstrate a link via mutual information bounds between SBI and stochastic gradient-based variational inference methods that permits BOED to be used in SBI applications as SBI-BOED. This link allows simultaneous optimization of experimental designs and optimization of amortized inference functions. We evaluate the pitfalls of naive design optimization using this method in a standard SBI task and demonstrate the utility of a well-chosen design distribution in BOED. We compare this approach on SBI-based models in real-world simulators in epidemiology and biology, showing notable improvements in inference.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过互信息界 (mutual information bounds) 建立了模拟推断 (SBI) 与基于随机梯度的变分贝叶斯最优实验设计 (BOED) 之间的联系，提出 SBI-BOED 框架，使得实验设计和摊销推断函数 (amortized inference functions) 可以同时优化。作者在标准 SBI 任务中考察了朴素设计优化的缺陷，并在流行病学和生物学的真实模拟器上展示了该方法带来的推断改进。
Motivation: SBI 用于复杂科学模型的逆问题推断，而 BOED 的目标是高效利用实验资源以获得更优推断；现有随机梯度类 BOED 方法被用作贝叶斯优化等设计启发式的替代，但 SBI 与这类方法缺乏统一的理论连接。
Method: 利用互信息界将 SBI 与随机梯度变分推断方法联系起来，提出 SBI-BOED，允许同时优化实验设计 (experimental designs) 和摊销推断函数，并强调设计分布 (design distribution) 的合理选择对效果的重要性。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在标准 SBI 任务中揭示了朴素设计优化的缺陷，并在流行病学和生物学的真实模拟器上相比现有方法取得显著的推断改进。
Conclusion: 摘要强调所建立的互信息联系使 BOED 能够直接用于 SBI 应用，且设计分布的选择是影响性能的关键；摘要未明确讨论方法局限。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Unmasking Conversational Bias in AI Multiagent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Detecting biases in the outputs produced by generative models is essential to reduce the potential risks associated with their application in critical settings. However, the majority of existing methodologies for identifying biases in generated text consider the models in isolation and neglect their contextual applications. Specifically, the biases that may arise in multi-agent systems involving generative models remain under-researched. To address this gap, we present a framework designed to quantify biases within multi-agent systems of conversational Large Language Models (LLMs). Our approach involves simulating small echo chambers, where pairs of LLMs, initialized with aligned perspectives on a polarizing topic, engage in discussions. Contrary to expectations, we observe significant shifts in the stance expressed in the generated messages, particularly within echo chambers where all agents initially express conservative viewpoints, in line with the well-documented political bias of many LLMs toward liberal positions. Crucially, the bias observed in the echo-chamber experiment remains undetected by current state-of-the-art bias detection methods that rely on questionnaires. This highlights a critical need for the development of a more sophisticated toolkit for bias detection and mitigation for AI multi-agent systems. The code to perform the experiments is publicly available.

papers.title: Cueless EEG imagined speech for subject identification: dataset and benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalogram (EEG) signals have emerged as a promising modality for biometric identification. While previous studies have explored the use of imagined speech with semantically meaningful words for subject identification, most have relied on additional visual or auditory cues. In this study, we introduce a cueless EEG-based imagined speech paradigm, where subjects imagine the pronunciation of semantically meaningful words without any external cues. This innovative approach addresses the limitations of prior methods by requiring subjects to select and imagine words from a predefined list naturally. The dataset comprises over 4,350 trials from 11 subjects across five sessions. We assess a variety of classification methods, including traditional machine learning techniques such as Support Vector Machines (SVM) and XGBoost, as well as time-series foundation models and deep learning architectures specifically designed for EEG classification, such as EEG Conformer and Shallow ConvNet. A session-based hold-out validation strategy was employed to ensure reliable evaluation and prevent data leakage. Our results demonstrate outstanding classification accuracy, reaching 97.93%. These findings highlight the potential of cueless EEG paradigms for secure and reliable subject identification in real-world applications, such as brain-computer interfaces (BCIs).
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Biometrics, Behavior, and Identity Science ( Volume: 8, Issue: 2, March 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无外部线索的 EEG 想象言语 (cueless imagined speech) 范式用于主体身份识别，要求受试者从预定义词表中自然地选择并想象发音。数据集包含 11 名受试者、5 个 session、超过 4,350 次试验，并采用基于 session 的留出验证。作者评估了 SVM、XGBoost、时间序列基础模型以及 EEG Conformer、Shallow ConvNet 等 EEG 专用深度学习架构，取得 97.93% 的分类准确率。
Motivation: 以往基于想象言语的 EEG 生物识别研究多依赖视觉或听觉外部线索，偏离真实应用场景；本文旨在提出一种无需任何外部提示的 paradigm，以解决此前方法对额外线索的依赖问题。
Method: 设计了无提示 (cueless) 的想象言语实验范式，让受试者在无外部刺激的条件下从预定义列表中自行选择并想象单词；随后系统比较传统机器学习、时间序列基础模型与 EEG 专用深度学习架构，并采用 session 级留出验证以防止数据泄漏。
Result: 摘要报告在包含 11 名受试者、5 个 session 的数据集上达到 97.93% 的分类准确率，展示了该无提示范式在主体识别上的有效性。
Conclusion: 作者认为无提示 EEG 想象言语范式在脑机接口等真实应用场景中具有安全可靠主体识别的潜力。

papers.title: Enhancing In-Hospital Mortality Prediction Using Multi-Representational Learning with LLM-Generated Expert Summaries
papers.abstract_en: To evaluate a multi-representational framework in which large language model (LLM)-generated expert summaries of intensive care unit (ICU) notes are fused with physiology for in-hospital mortality (IHM) prediction, and to determine how much of the resulting gain is non-redundant with the notes themselves. Using MIMIC-III (19,211 first ICU stays, 12.83% mortality), we encoded 48-hour physiology, clinical notes, and LLM summaries generated under a prompt forbidding prognostication, then fused them. Redundancy was assessed by ridge recoverability, linear probes, and retrained ablations substituting a note-orthogonal residual or a patient-shuffled summary embedding. On 3,843 held-out stays, fusion reached AUPRC 0.4977/AUROC 0.8429 versus 0.3625/0.7770 for physiology alone. Ridge regression from note embeddings explained 40.8% of summary-embedding variance. The note-orthogonal residual retained a minority of the gain (+0.0258 AUPRC, 95% CI 0.005--0.047; 28%), while patient-shuffled summaries fell below the reference. Summaries improve prediction patient-specifically, but predominantly by reorganizing information the notes already contain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种多表征融合框架，将大规模语言模型（LLM）生成的 ICU 临床笔记专家摘要与生理信号融合，用于院内死亡（IHM）预测，并在 MIMIC-III 上评估其增益。作者进一步用冗余分析检验摘要带来的提升是否独立于原始笔记，结论是摘要能患者特异性地改善预测，但主要作用在于重新组织笔记中已有的信息。
Motivation: 院内死亡预测通常单独使用生理信号或临床笔记，较少系统考察 LLM 生成的专家摘要与原始笔记之间的信息冗余；若不厘清这一点，就无法判断融合摘要的真实增量价值。
Method: 使用 MIMIC-III 的 19,211 次首次 ICU 住院（12.83% 死亡率），对 48 小时生理数据、临床笔记及在禁止预后的提示下生成的 LLM 摘要分别编码并融合；冗余性通过 ridge recoverability、线性探针（linear probes）以及重训消融（替换为笔记正交残差或患者打乱的摘要嵌入）来评估。
Result: 在 3,843 个留出样本上，融合达到 AUPRC 0.4977、AUROC 0.8429，而单独生理信号为 0.3625/0.7770。从笔记嵌入做 ridge 回归可解释摘要嵌入 40.8% 的方差；笔记正交残差仅保留少数增益（+0.0258 AUPRC，95% CI 0.005–0.047，约 28%），患者打乱摘要低于参考表现。
Conclusion: LLM 摘要确实带来患者特异性的预测改善，但大部分增益与原始笔记冗余，主要来自对笔记已有信息的重新组织；结论限于 MIMIC-III 数据集和该研究使用的特定摘要提示设计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Impact of Generative AI on Collaborative Open-Source Software Development: Evidence from GitHub Copilot
papers.abstract_en: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) facilitates content production and enhances ideation, with potentially important implications for developer productivity and participation in software development. To explore its impact on collaborative open-source software (OSS) development, we investigate the role of GitHub Copilot, a generative AI pair programmer, in OSS development where multiple distributed developers voluntarily collaborate. Using GitHub's proprietary Copilot usage data, combined with public OSS project data obtained from GitHub, we find that Copilot use increases project-level code contributions by 5.9%. This gain is accompanied by a 3.4% increase in developer coding participation and a 2.1% increase in individual code contributions. However, Copilot use is also associated with an 8% increase in coordination time and more code discussions. This reveals an important tradeoff: While AI expands who can contribute and how much they contribute, it slows coordination in collective development efforts. Despite this tension, the overall effect remains positive, resulting in a net increase in the timely merge of code contributions at the project level. Interestingly, we also find heterogeneous effects across developer roles. Peripheral developers exhibit relatively smaller increases in project-level code contributions and larger increases in coordination time than core developers. Together, our findings highlight the dual effects of AI pair programmers on code contributions and coordination in OSS development and provide implications for how generative AI may reshape the structure of OSS communities over time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用 GitHub 专有的 Copilot 使用数据并结合公开 OSS 项目数据，研究生成式 AI 结对编程工具对协作式开源软件开发的影响。摘要报告 Copilot 使用使项目级代码贡献增加 5.9%，开发者编码参与增加 3.4%，个人代码贡献增加 2.1%，但协调时间增加 8% 并伴随更多代码讨论，揭示贡献增长与协调成本之间的权衡；总体净效应为正，且对边缘开发者与核心开发者存在异质性影响。
Motivation: 生成式 AI 对开发者生产力和参与度的影响缺少基于大规模真实协作场景的证据；OSS 开发由分布式的自愿贡献者协作完成，理解 AI 工具如何影响集体贡献与协调是该研究要填补的空白。
Method: 使用 GitHub 专有的 Copilot 使用数据，结合 GitHub 公开 OSS 项目数据，对项目层面和开发者层面的代码贡献、参与程度及协调时间进行经验分析。
Result: 摘要报告 Copilot 使用使项目级代码贡献提升 5.9%，开发者编码参与提升 3.4%，个人代码贡献提升 2.1%；同时协调时间增加 8% 并伴随更多代码讨论。项目层面及时合并代码贡献呈净增加，且存在角色异质性：边缘开发者项目级贡献增幅较小、协调时间增幅较大。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 AI 结对编程对 OSS 开发具有双重效应：一方面扩大谁能贡献以及贡献多少，另一方面拖慢集体开发中的协调；整体净效应仍为正，并可能长期重塑 OSS 社区结构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SelfDRSC++: Self-Supervised Dual Reversed Rolling Shutter Correction via Video Interpolation
papers.abstract_en: Modern consumer cameras often use rolling shutter, capturing scenes row-by-row and causing distortion in dynamic scenes. Existing correction methods rely on supervised learning with high-frame-rate global shutter images as ground truth. We propose SelfDRSC++, a self-supervised framework for RS distortion correction {from simultaneously captured top-to-bottom and bottom-to-top RS images}. A lightweight network with a bidirectional correlation matching block jointly optimizes optical flows and corrected RS features, improving performance with fewer parameters. A self-supervised strategy enforces {a physically constrained RS--GS--RS cycle} between input and reconstructed dual reversed RS images. RS reconstruction is formulated as a specialized video frame interpolation task, enabling feasible one-stage training. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world data show that SelfDRSC++ achieves competitive quantitative performance, improves perceptual quality, and produces high-frame-rate GS sequences with better temporal consistency.
papers.comment: Accepted by Pattern Recognition 2026 and the code is available at \url{https://github.com/shangwei5/SelfDRSC_plusplus}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SelfDRSC++，一个面向卷帘快门 (rolling shutter, RS) 畸变校正的自监督框架，仅利用同时采集的自上而下与自下而上双反向 RS 图像，无需全局快门 (global shutter, GS) 真值。方法将 RS 重建建模为专门的视频帧插值任务，用轻量网络和双向相关匹配块联合优化光流与校正后的 RS 特征，并通过物理约束的 RS-GS-RS 循环实现单阶段自监督训练。实验表明，在合成与真实数据上该方法取得有竞争力的量化性能，改善感知质量，并生成时间一致性更好的高帧率 GS 序列。
Motivation: 现有 RS 畸变校正方法依赖监督学习，需要高帧率全局快门图像作为真值，实际场景中难以获取。作者希望仅利用成对的双反向 RS 图像实现自监督校正，降低对真值数据的依赖。
Method: 提出一个包含轻量网络与双向相关匹配块的自监督框架，联合估计光流并优化校正后的 RS 特征；将 RS 重建表述为专门的视频帧插值任务，从而支持可行的一阶段训练；利用输入与重建双反向 RS 图像之间的物理约束 RS-GS-RS 循环作为自监督信号。
Result: 在合成与真实世界数据上的大量实验显示，SelfDRSC++ 取得了有竞争力的量化性能，提升了感知质量，并生成具有更好时间一致性的高帧率 GS 序列。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，自监督双反向 RS 校正可以替代依赖真值监督的方案，并在校正畸变的同时输出高帧率 GS 序列；代码已公开。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Langevin dynamics for high-dimensional optimization: the case of multi-spiked tensor PCA
papers.abstract_en: We study nonconvex optimization in high dimensions through Langevin dynamics, focusing on the multi-spiked tensor PCA problem. In this tensor estimation model, the goal is to recover a finite number of hidden signal vectors, or spikes, from noisy Gaussian tensor observations using maximum likelihood estimation. We characterize the number of samples required for Langevin dynamics to efficiently recover the spikes and identify the separation conditions on the signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs) needed for exact recovery. In particular, we show that the sample complexity required to recover the spike associated with the largest SNR matches the well-known algorithmic threshold for the single-spike case, whereas the threshold degrades when recovering all spikes. A key ingredient is a precise low-dimensional description of the Langevin trajectory through its correlations with the spikes, which captures both the high-dimensional dynamics and the interactions among competing signal directions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论上研究高维非凸优化中的 Langevin 动力学，以 multi-spiked tensor PCA 为对象，分析极大似然估计下如何从含噪高斯张量观测中恢复多个隐藏信号向量（spikes）。作者刻画了 Langevin 动力学高效恢复 spikes 所需的样本数，以及实现精确恢复所需的信噪比（SNR）分离条件。关键结果是最强 SNR 对应 spike 的样本复杂度与已知单 spike 情形的算法阈值一致，而恢复全部 spikes 时阈值会退化。
Motivation: 高维非凸优化问题中，Langevin 动力学的理论性质尚需系统性刻画，而 multi-spiked tensor PCA 作为包含多个竞争信号方向的张量估计模型，能同时考察高维动力学与信号间相互作用，是分析该问题的合适载体。
Method: 作者对极大似然目标函数上的 Langevin 动力学进行理论分析，核心工具是通过 Langevin 轨迹与各 spikes 的相关性给出精确的低维描述，从而同时捕捉高维动力学行为以及不同信号方向之间的竞争与交互。
Result: 摘要报告了恢复单个最强 SNR spike 的样本复杂度与单 spike 情形的已知算法阈值相匹配；而若要恢复所有 spikes，所需样本阈值会退化，并且需要满足对信噪比分离条件的要求才能实现精确恢复。
Conclusion: 本文的结论是，借助轨迹相关性的低维精确描述，可以严格刻画 multi-spiked tensor PCA 中 Langevin 动力学的样本复杂度与 SNR 分离条件，并揭示多信号恢复相对单信号恢复带来的阈值退化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Topological complexity of spiked random polynomials and finite-rank spherical integrals
papers.abstract_en: We study the annealed complexity of Gaussian random homogeneous polynomials on the $(N-1)$-dimensional unit sphere in the presence of deterministic perturbations depending on fixed orthonormal vectors and external parameters. We derive variational formulas for the exponential asymptotics of the average number of critical points and local maxima. Our approach combines the Kac-Rice formula with determinant asymptotics for finite-rank perturbations of Gaussian Wigner matrices. In particular, the determinant analysis builds on recent results by [Guionnet, Husson 2022] on finite-rank spherical integrals, which we use to establish large deviation estimates for the largest eigenvalue of finite-rank Gaussian Wigner matrices. The resulting variational problems reveal a topological phase transition: above an explicit threshold in the external parameters, new zero-complexity regions emerge, corresponding to critical points with large correlation with the perturbation vectors. We also identify regions associated with critical points having large correlations with several vectors simultaneously; numerical evidence suggests that these critical points are more likely to be saddles than local maxima.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究带确定扰动的 Gauss 随机齐次多项式在 (N-1) 维单位球面上的退火复杂度 (annealed complexity)，推导临界点和局部极大值平均数的指数渐近变分公式。方法结合 Kac-Rice 公式与有限秩 Gauss Wigner 矩阵扰动的行列式渐近，并借助 Guionnet–Husson (2022) 的有限秩球积分结果得到最大特征值的大偏差估计。结果显示存在拓扑相变：外部参数超过显式阈值时出现新的零复杂度区域，对应与扰动向量高度相关的临界点。数值证据表明同时与多个扰动向量高相关的临界点更可能是鞍点而非局部极大值。
Motivation: 随机能量景观中尖峰扰动 (spiked perturbations) 对临界点拓扑复杂度的影响尚未被充分刻画；本文目标是给出这类 spiked 随机多项式的平均临界点数精确指数渐近，并理解外部参数驱动的相变机制。
Method: 将 Kac-Rice 公式应用于带确定扰动的随机多项式，把行列式期望约化为有限秩扰动 Wigner 矩阵的行列式渐近；利用 Guionnet–Husson 的有限秩球积分结果推导最大特征值的大偏差估计，最终得到变分公式。
Result: 推导出临界点与局部极大值平均数的指数渐近变分公式；发现拓扑相变，外部参数超过显式阈值后出现零复杂度区域，对应与扰动向量相关性大的临界点；同时与多个向量高相关的临界点在数值上更可能是鞍点。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该方法为分析 spiked 随机多项式复杂度提供统一框架，揭示外部参数驱动的拓扑相变；数值结果提示多向量高相关区域的临界点以鞍点为主。摘要未讨论具体局限。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Interpretable ODE-style Generative Diffusion Model via Force Field Construction
papers.abstract_en: For a considerable time, researchers have focused on developing a method that establishes a deep connection between the generative diffusion model and mathematical physics. Despite previous efforts, progress has been limited to the pursuit of a single specialized method. In order to advance the interpretability of diffusion models and explore new research directions, it is essential to establish a unified ODE-style generative diffusion model. Such a model should draw inspiration from physical models and possess a clear geometric meaning. This paper aims to identify various physical models that are suitable for constructing ODE-style generative diffusion models accurately from a mathematical perspective. We then summarize these models into a unified method. Additionally, we perform a case study where we use the theoretical model identified by our method to develop a range of new diffusion model methods, and conduct experiments. Our experiments on CIFAR-10 demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach. We have constructed a computational framework that attains highly proficient results with regards to image generation speed, alongside an additional model that demonstrates exceptional performance in both Inception score and FID score. These results underscore the significance of our method in advancing the field of diffusion models.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种可解释的 ODE 风格生成扩散模型构建思路，从数学角度筛选适合构造此类模型的物理模型，并归纳为统一方法。作者以该理论模型为例发展出一批新的扩散模型方法，并在 CIFAR-10 上进行实验，得到生成速度表现良好的计算框架以及一个在 Inception score 和 FID 上表现优异的附加模型。arXiv 注释表明该工作是对苏剑林博客内容的复现实验，作者承认引用失误并计划撤稿。
Motivation: 生成扩散模型与数学物理之间的深层联系长期受到关注，但已有进展仅限于单一专门方法；作者希望建立一个受物理模型启发、具有清晰几何意义的统一 ODE 风格生成扩散模型，以推动扩散模型的可解释性和新研究方向。
Method: 从数学视角系统识别适合精确构造 ODE 风格生成扩散模型的各类物理模型，并将它们总结为统一方法；随后以该方法识别出的理论模型为案例，开发多种新的扩散模型方法并搭建计算框架。
Result: 摘要报告在 CIFAR-10 上的实验验证了方法的有效性：所构建的一个计算框架在图像生成速度上表现良好，另一个模型在 Inception score 和 FID 上表现优异；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为实验结果显示了该方法对扩散模型领域的意义；同时，arXiv 注释说明这是对 Jianlin Su 博客的复现和实验尝试，作者称引用有误并需要撤稿澄清。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Modulation of the tropical meridional circulation by the Madden-Julian Oscillation
papers.abstract_en: The Hadley circulation is Earth's dominant tropical overturning circulation, regulating atmospheric energy transport, tropical rainfall, and subtropical aridity. Although its variability has been extensively studied on seasonal to decadal climate-change timescales, its subseasonal behaviour remains poorly understood. Here we show that the Madden-Julian Oscillation (MJO), the leading mode of tropical intraseasonal variability, systematically modulates the Hadley circulation and influences global hydroclimate variability. Using reanalysis data and dynamical diagnostics, we identify a robust hemispherically asymmetric Hadley circulation anomaly associated with active MJO events, with amplitudes comparable to the climatological intraseasonal variability of the Hadley circulation. Breaking down the dynamical components reveals that the response is primarily maintained by latent heating associated with moist convection, while the overturning strength is driven by interhemispheric moisture gradients. Lead-lag analyses further show that the Hadley circulation lags the MJO by 4-15 days, indicating that MJO convection may drive overturning adjustments on subseasonal timescales. This coupled MJO-Hadley circulation state reveals a previously overlooked pathway linking tropical intraseasonal oscillations, meridional circulation and the hydrological cycle.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用再分析资料和动力学诊断，揭示马登-朱利安振荡（MJO）会系统性地调制哈德莱环流，并产生具有半球不对称性的环流异常，其幅度与哈德莱环流的气候态季节内变率相当。作者通过动力分量分解发现该响应主要由湿对流相关的潜热释放维持，而环流翻转强度受半球间水汽梯度驱动；超前滞后分析显示哈德莱环流比MJO滞后4-15天，表明MJO对流可能在季节内时间尺度上驱动经向环流调整。
Motivation: 哈德莱环流在季节到年代际尺度上的变率已被广泛研究，但其次季节尺度的行为仍不清楚；MJO作为热带季节内变率的主导模态，其与哈德莱环流的耦合关系此前未被充分认识。
Method: 使用再分析资料和动力学诊断方法，识别活跃MJO事件对应的哈德莱环流异常，并对响应进行动力分量分解，同时采用超前滞后分析考察两者之间的时序关系。
Result: 摘要报告发现一个稳健的半球不对称哈德莱环流异常，其幅度与气候态季节内变率相当；响应主要由湿对流潜热维持，强度由半球间水汽梯度驱动；哈德莱环流滞后MJO约4-15天。
Conclusion: 作者认为该MJO-哈德莱环流耦合状态揭示了一条此前被忽视的路径，将热带季节内振荡、经向环流与水文循环联系起来，并可能影响全球水文气候变率。
Relevance: 55

papers.title: A Local-Linearly Convergent Algorithm for Nonconvex Equality-Constrained Optimization
papers.abstract_en: For solving nonconvex equality-constrained optimization problems, a recent Gradient-Eigenstep Algorithm by Goyens et al.~is an iteration-efficient approach, based on minimizing Fletcher's augmented Lagrangian function, for finding an approximate second-order stationary point from an arbitrary starting point. In this paper, the analysis of this algorithm is extended, offering a two-fold contribution. First, it is shown that a local-linear rate of convergence can be obtained by this method if it is initiated sufficiently close to a strong second-order stationary point and employs a sufficiently small step-size parameter and sufficiently large penalty parameter. In this case, the algorithm reduces to a gradient descent algorithm applied to minimize Fletcher's augmented Lagrangian. Second, as a particularly useful application of the first result, it is shown that the Gradient-Eigenstep algorithm can be used as an iteration-efficient subproblem solver in the context of a progressive sampling strategy for solving equality-constrained optimization problems when the objective and constraint functions are defined by large sample averages, ultimately offering an algorithm with an improved worst-case sample complexity when compared to an approach that solves a full-sample problem directly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非凸等式约束优化问题，扩展了 Goyens 等人的 Gradient-Eigenstep 算法的理论分析。作者证明，若算法在强二阶稳定点附近启动，并采用足够小的步长参数和足够大的惩罚参数，则可获得局部线性收敛速率，此时算法退化为对 Fletcher 增广拉格朗日函数做梯度下降。进一步，该算法被用作渐进采样策略 (progressive sampling) 的子问题求解器，以改善大规模样本均值形式优化问题的最坏样本复杂度。
Motivation: 现有 Gradient-Eigenstep 算法虽在迭代效率上有优势，但缺少局部线性收敛的理论保证；当目标函数和约束由大样本均值定义时，直接求解全样本问题会导致较差的样本复杂度。
Method: 通过扩展 Gradient-Eigenstep 算法的收敛性分析，证明其在强二阶稳定点邻域内的局部线性收敛性，并将其集成到渐进采样策略中作为子问题求解器。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在接近强二阶稳定点时具有局部线性收敛速率，并相比直接求解全样本问题获得改进的最坏情况样本复杂度。
Conclusion: 该算法在特定参数条件下可简化为对 Fletcher 增广拉格朗日函数的梯度下降，并能作为大样本等式约束优化问题的高效子问题求解器。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 通过扩展 Gradient-Eigenstep 算法的收敛性分析，证明其在强二阶稳定点邻域内的局部线性收敛性，并将其集成到渐进采样策略中作为子问题求解器。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告该方法在接近强二阶稳定点时具有局部线性收敛速率，并相比直接求解全样本问题获得改进的最坏情况样本复杂度。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该算法在特定参数条件下可简化为对 Fletcher 增广拉格朗日函数的梯度下降，并能作为大样本等式约束优化问题的高效子问题求解器。

papers.title: Evaluating AlphaEarth Foundations Embeddings for Wildfire Susceptibility Mapping
papers.abstract_en: Wildfire susceptibility mapping typically relies on physical variables assembled from multiple remote-sensing, climate, and geospatial products. AlphaEarth Foundations (AEF) provides analysis-ready geospatial embeddings that may reduce this dependence on heavy harmonisation and task-specific feature engineering, but their value for wildfire susceptibility mapping has not been systematically evaluated. Using Victoria, Australia (2017-2025), as a case study, we show that AEF embeddings can reconstruct commonly used variables in wildfire susceptibility analysis with high accuracy. In downstream susceptibility models trained on satellite-derived fire occurrence data, embedding-based susceptibility models achieve ROC-AUC values above 0.92 and consistently identify high wildfire susceptibility across eastern Victoria, particularly Gippsland and the north-eastern uplands, with additional localized hotspots in central and northwestern Victoria. A key feature of AEF embeddings is their strong near-region transferability within climatically similar regions. When embedding-based models trained in Victoria are applied to Canberra and Western Sydney-Blue Mountains, ROC-AUC improves by around 4% at Canberra and declines by around 2% at Western Sydney-Blue Mountains, compared with a mean decrease of approximately 25% for physical-variable models. These findings provide practical guidance for using AEF embeddings and lay a foundation for scalable wildfire susceptibility mapping workflows for downstream users such as government agencies and (re)insurers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估 AlphaEarth Foundations (AEF) 地理空间嵌入在野火易发性制图 (wildfire susceptibility mapping) 中的价值，以澳大利亚维多利亚州 2017-2025 年为案例。摘要报告 AEF 嵌入能高精度重建常用野火分析变量，基于嵌入的下游模型 ROC-AUC 超过 0.92，并能识别东部高地及中部、西北部的局部热点。嵌入模型在气候相似区域的跨区迁移中性能衰减远小于物理变量模型。
Motivation: 传统野火易发性制图依赖从多种遥感、气候和地理空间产品中组装物理变量，需要繁重的数据协调和任务特定的特征工程。AEF 提供分析就绪的 geospatial embeddings，但其对野火易发性制图的价值尚未被系统评估。
Method: 以 Victoria, Australia (2017-2025) 为案例，先用 AEF 嵌入重建常用野火易发性分析变量，再基于卫星观测的火灾发生数据训练嵌入驱动的易发性模型，并将维多利亚州训练的模型迁移到 Canberra 与 Western Sydney-Blue Mountains 评估近邻迁移性。
Result: 嵌入驱动的易发性模型在维多利亚州取得 ROC-AUC 高于 0.92；迁移到 Canberra 时 ROC-AUC 提升约 4%，到 Western Sydney-Blue Mountains 下降约 2%，而物理变量模型平均下降约 25%。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些发现为使用 AEF 嵌入提供实践指导，并为政府机构和（再）保险公司等下游用户建立可扩展的野火易发性制图工作流奠定基础。摘要未讨论该方法在其他气候区的适用边界或局限。

papers.title: Inference-Time Orthogonal Seeding Enables Geometry-Aligned 3D Organ Segmentation for Slice-Propagation Methods
papers.abstract_en: Dense voxel-level annotation remains a major bottleneck in 3D medical image segmentation. Single-slice propagation methods such as Sli2Vol reduce this burden by propagating one annotated seed slice through a volume using label-free registration. However, axial-only propagation accumulates errors with distance from the seed, especially in surface-distance metrics, because it ignores coronal and sagittal evidence and therefore underuses the 3D information available in CT/MRI volumes. To better leverage volumetric geometry, we study how key training and inference choices affect slice-propagation models, including single-axis versus multi-axis label-free registration, single-seed versus multi-seed propagation, and orthogonal seed configurations. Instead of propagating from a single axial seed, we use three orthogonal seeds---one axial, one coronal, and one sagittal---and fuse their propagated labels with a simple label-free rule. Our results show that the training paradigm has limited impact: an axially trained network applied to off-axis seeds captures nearly all the improvement, while explicit three-axis training adds little. Instead, performance is driven by inference-time seed geometry, especially orthogonality rather than the number of annotated slices, as a budget-matched three-axial control provides no benefit and can even degrade performance. On a multi-organ CT cohort, orthogonal seeding with the axial Sli2Vol backbone improves Dice by 21.9%, Normalized Surface Dice by 25.5%, and reduces Average Hausdorff Distance by 53.5% over the single-axis baseline.
papers.comment: 8 Pages Accepted at MLMI Workshop MICCAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于单切片传播（slice propagation）的 3D 器官分割方法，系统考察训练与推理阶段的不同选择，并提出推理期正交播种（inference-time orthogonal seeding）策略：从轴向、冠状、矢状三个正交种子切片传播标签，并用简单的无标签规则融合。作者发现训练范式影响有限，性能主要由推理期种子几何（尤其是正交性）决定。在 CT 多器官数据集上，该策略较单轴基线显著提升几何对齐指标。
Motivation: 稠密体素级标注是 3D 医学图像分割的主要瓶颈；单轴传播（如 Sli2Vol）仅利用轴向切片，随距种子距离增加误差累积，在表面距离指标上尤其明显，未能充分利用 CT/MRI 的三维几何信息。
Method: 研究多个关键选择：单轴与多轴无标签配准、单种子与多种子传播、以及正交种子配置；具体做法是使用轴向、冠状、矢状三个正交种子切片，并通过简单的无标签规则融合传播后的标签。
Result: 实验表明，轴向训练的网络直接用于离轴种子即可获得几乎全部提升，显式三轴训练增益很小；与正交种子等预算的三轴对照无收益甚至降低性能。在多器官 CT 队列上，相对单轴基线，Dice 提高 21.9%，Normalized Surface Dice 提高 25.5%，Average Hausdorff Distance 降低 53.5%。
Conclusion: 结论是性能主要由推理期种子几何（正交性）而非标注切片数量驱动；该结论基于多器官 CT 队列的评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: General Probabilities of Causation with Causal Knowledge
papers.abstract_en: Probabilities of causation (PoCs) characterize individual causal responses that cannot be directly observed and therefore generally require partial identification. Tian and Pearl first derived theoretically sharp bounds for binary PoCs, including the probability of necessity (PN), the probability of sufficiency (PS), and the probability of necessity and sufficiency (PNS). Mueller et al. subsequently tightened the bounds for binary PNS by incorporating causal information encoded in covariates and mediators. More recently, Li and Pearl, as well as Shu et al., extended PoCs to multivalued settings and derived corresponding theoretical bounds. These developments naturally raise the question of whether additional causal knowledge can further tighten the bounds in multivalued settings. This paper addresses this question by deriving tighter bounds for multivalued PoCs through the incorporation of causal information encoded in covariates and mediators. We illustrate the theoretical results with toy examples, while simulation studies further demonstrate that the proposed bounds are tighter than existing nonbinary bounds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨在多值因果设置中，能否利用协变量和中介变量编码的因果信息进一步收紧因果概率（probabilities of causation, PoCs）的界。作者将先前针对二元PoCs的收紧思路推广到多值情形，推导出更紧的理论界，并通过玩具示例和模拟研究验证所提界优于现有的非二元界。
Motivation: Tian 和 Pearl 给出了二元 PoCs 的锐界，Mueller 等人利用协变量和中介变量信息收紧了二元 PNS 的界；Li 和 Pearl 以及 Shu 等人将 PoCs 推广到多值设置。本文关注的问题是：在多值设置中，额外的因果知识能否进一步收紧这些界。
Method: 通过将协变量和中介变量编码的因果信息纳入多值 PoCs 的偏识别框架，推导出比现有非二元界更紧的理论界，并用玩具示例说明理论结果。
Result: 模拟研究表明，所提出的界比现有的非二元界更紧。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，纳入协变量和中介变量的因果信息可以在多值设置下进一步收紧 PoCs 的界。

papers.title: Training Under Challenge: Executable Certificates and Challenge-Closed Optimality for Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: A flat training curve does not reveal whether a neural network has reached a global optimum, is locally trapped, is representation-limited, or is mismatched to its trainer. We introduce Training Under Challenge, an executable-certificate framework in which predeclared, architecture-valid procedures construct complete alternatives in the same certified class and reevaluate the same objective. Any lower-valued candidate is a replayable witness that lower-bounds the checkpoint's empirical global-optimality gap. Passing a finite suite is only suite-relative; global-gap conclusions require a separately justified coverage mechanism. We define a resource-indexed challenge-power modulus that characterizes the largest gap compatible with passage. For squared loss, current block-decrease operators make coverage checkable and yield uniform and realized-residual bounds. We prove the converse frontier: without coverage, a first-order ReLU trainer can reach infinitely many exact conditional head optima while converging to a non-global point. On a channel-gated ResNet-18 distillation problem with known optimum, eight internal challenges cover all 240 audited output directions, and realized-residual bounds lie within factors of 1.74--3.02 of the true gap. Paired predictive certificates separate decoder under-use from representation insufficiency, while quantized-denoising studies demonstrate diagnosis, repair, and current-state recertification.
papers.comment: 82 pages, 24 figures, 10 tables. Ancillary reproducibility materials included
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Training Under Challenge，一个用于神经网络训练诊断的可执行证书 (executable-certificate) 框架：预先声明且架构有效的程序会在同一认证类中构造完整替代方案并重新评估同一目标函数，任何取值更低的候选都可作为可回放的见证，给出 checkpoint 经验全局最优性差距的下界。在平方损失下，块下降算子 (block-decrease operators) 使覆盖 (coverage) 可检验，并得到均匀与实现残差界；作者还证明无覆盖时一阶 ReLU 训练器可到达无穷多个精确条件头最优却收敛到非全局点。
Motivation: 平坦的训练曲线无法区分网络是达到全局最优、陷入局部陷阱、受表示能力限制，还是与训练器不匹配；论文针对这一诊断盲区提出可验证的最优性证书框架。
Method: 定义资源索引的挑战能力模 (challenge-power modulus)，刻画能与通过检验相容的最大差距；对平方损失使用当前块下降算子使覆盖性可检查，并推导均匀与实现残差界；在已知最优的 channel-gated ResNet-18 蒸馏问题上用八个内部挑战覆盖全部审计输出方向。
Result: 在 channel-gated ResNet-18 蒸馏实验中，八个内部挑战覆盖全部 240 个审计输出方向，实现残差界 (realized-residual bounds) 处于真实差距的 1.74--3.02 倍范围内；配对预测证书 (paired predictive certificates) 可区分解码器利用不足与表示不足。
Conclusion: 通过有限挑战套件只意味着相对于该套件的通过，全局差距结论必须依赖单独证明的覆盖机制；量化去噪实验展示了诊断、修复与当前状态重新认证的流程。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SteerBench-Work: A Benchmark for Agent Steering at Action Boundaries
papers.abstract_en: Long-running LLM agents act through tools, and a single step can send an email, merge a pull request, or wire a payment. The steering decision is the pre-commit choice at that boundary: proceed, or hold for human or policy review. We introduce SteerBench-Work, an incident-anchored, bidirectional benchmark for that decision in workplace agents across developer operations, customer service, finance, legal, medical, HR, and security. Release v2026-05 contains 106 scenarios anchored in public incidents, paired evidence-reversed mirrors, and calibration controls, with labels split nearly evenly between proceed and hold so the two error directions get near-identical numbers of chances. A model sees the proposed action and the available evidence, returns a gate decision, and is scored on whether it crosses or holds the boundary correctly. Across 30 model conditions the failures run almost entirely in one direction: models wrongly hold authorized, evidence-cleared work on 28.1% of opportunities and wrongly allow unsafe work on 1.0%. The hardest cases are risk-resolved commits, where signed or structured evidence has already cleared a real risk trigger, and models score markedly worse on evidence-reversed mirrors of famous incidents (63.8%) than on the incidents themselves (98.5%). General capability is not the same as steering calibration: higher-capability models often over-refuse at the commit boundary, and more reasoning can repair a weak gate while leaving a calibrated one flat. The public leaderboard is at steerbench.com.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SteerBench-Work，一个用于评估长期运行的 LLM 代理在工具调用前“转向决策”（proceed 或 hold）的双向基准。基准 v2026-05 包含 106 个锚定公共事件的场景，覆盖开发运维、客服、金融、法律、医疗、HR 和安全领域，标签在 proceed 与 hold 间近似均衡。在 30 个模型条件下，错误几乎单向：模型在 28.1% 的机会上错误扣住已授权且证据充分的工作，仅 1.0% 错误放行不安全工作；风险已解决的提交最难，证据反转镜像上的得分（63.8%）远低于原始事件（98.5%）。
Motivation: 长期运行的 LLM 代理通过工具执行操作，单步动作可能产生高影响后果（如发邮件、合并 PR、转账），因此在执行前需要决定继续还是暂停等待人工或策略审查。现有基准缺乏针对这一“行动边界”决策的系统评估，且需要同时衡量两个错误方向（过度拒绝与危险放行）。
Method: 提出 SteerBench-Work，一个事件锚定（incident-anchored）的双向基准，包含基于公共事件的场景、证据反转镜像对（evidence-reversed mirrors）和校准控制（calibration controls）。模型接收提议动作与可用证据，返回门控决策（gate decision），按是否正确跨过或守住边界评分。
Result: 在 30 个模型条件下，错误方向极不均衡：模型错误扣住授权且证据充分的工作占 28.1%，错误允许不安全工作占 1.0%。风险已解决的提交（risk-resolved commits）最难，证据反转镜像得分 63.8%，原始事件为 98.5%；更高能力模型往往过度拒绝，更多推理能修复弱门控但对已校准门控无提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通用能力不等于转向校准（steering calibration），高能力模型在提交边界易过度拒绝，且更多推理不一定改善已校准的门控。公共排行榜位于 steerbench.com。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Excess Separability: Nuisance-Controlled Residual-Stream Probing for Benchmark Contamination Detection
papers.abstract_en: Benchmark contamination is diagnosed today with n-gram overlap, with likelihood-based membership inference, or with canary strings, and each needs something usually unavailable: the training corpus, a well-chosen test statistic, or foresight at dataset release. A recent alternative reads contamination off a linear probe on internal activations. We show that the natural way to do this does not work, and specify one that survives measurement. The protocol reports a zero-sum contrast on the depth profile of probe accuracy, recentred on a level-matched placebo baseline, tested against a label-permutation null, with the reference set twice the size of the suspect set. Each choice replaces a simpler alternative we measured and rejected. Reporting the level of excess separability rather than its shape makes the false positive rate track the size of the analyst's own control set, from 0.03 to 0.99 under a true null. Contrasting against a flat depth profile fails in both directions, rejecting a true null 0.72 of the time when surface decodability rises with depth and losing all power when it falls. An item bootstrap holds the fitted probe fixed and rejects up to 0.09 of the time where a permutation null that refits it holds 0.02. A half-size baseline triples the error rate. On real transformers, baseline depth profiles are measurably not flat, spanning up to 29.1 accuracy points on a temporal split, and their non-flatness tracks the surface difference between the item sets (correlation 0.87 over 6 audits), so the correction is largest exactly where it is needed. All 4 well-matched Pile arms return null, and the protocol refuses a verdict on the temporal split rather than reporting one. What this does not establish is whether transformers carry a familiarity direction at all: the only positive sits on the split where exchangeability fails. Implementation, tests and audits are released.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 11 figures, 7 tables. Code and artefacts: https://github.com/mabushi-lab/residual-stream-contamination-probing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何用内部激活上的线性探针 (linear probe) 检测基准测试污染 (benchmark contamination)。作者先说明自然的探针做法在测量上不可靠，然后给出一个稳健的协议：在探针准确率的深度剖面 (depth profile) 上做零和对比，以层级匹配的安慰剂基线重新定中心，用标签置换零假设检验，并要求参考集大小是被测集的两倍。协议报告超额可分性 (excess separability) 的水平而非形状。在真实 Transformer 上，基线深度剖面并非平坦，最多跨越 29.1 个准确率点，因此修正最大处正是最需要处。
Motivation: 现有多数污染检测方法依赖训练语料、精心选择的检验统计量或数据集发布时预埋的 canary 字符串，而这些条件通常不可得。最近有人提出用内部激活的线性探针读取污染，但本文显示这种自然做法不能直接工作，需要设计能经受测量过程的协议。
Method: 提出一个测量稳健的污染检测协议：以参考集为被测集两倍大小，在探针准确率的深度剖面上计算零和对比量，并用层级匹配的安慰剂基线 (level-matched placebo baseline) 重新定中心，再对标签置换零假设 (label-permutation null) 检验；判定依据是超额可分性的水平而非剖面形状。作者还逐一测过并否定了更简单的替代选择，如平坦深度剖面基线、半尺寸基线和重拟合的置换零假设。
Result: 协议报告超额可分性水平时，假阳性率随分析者自身控制集大小变化，在真零假设下从 0.03 到 0.99；用平坦剖面做对比则会双向失效：当表面可解码性随深度上升时 0.72 的概率拒绝真零假设，下降时则完全失去功效。固定已拟合探针的 item bootstrap 拒绝率最高 0.09，而重拟合的置换零假设保持 0.02；半尺寸基线使错误率翻三倍。在真实 Transformer 上，时间切分的基线深度剖面跨度最高 29.1 个准确率点，且其非平坦程度与项目集之间的表层差异相关（6 次审计中相关系数 0.87）。4 个匹配良好的 Pile 分支均返回零结果，协议对时间切分拒绝给出裁决。
Conclusion: 作者给出的协议能够经受测量过程的影响，并指出修正量在基线剖面非平坦最严重处最大；但摘要明确说明，该工作并未确立 Transformer 是否真的具有熟悉性方向 (familiarity direction)，因为唯一的阳性结果出现在交换性 (exchangeability) 不成立的时间切分上。

papers.title: Jagged Judges: Epistemic Stability Under Silence, Pressure, and Persistence
papers.abstract_en: LLM judges have become central infrastructure for model evaluations, online grading, and reward modeling. Judges are typically validated by accuracy on golden data, but accuracy says little about whether they are stable under re-prompting, challenge, or sustained pushback. We introduce the \emph{Wiggle Framework}, a unified stress test for epistemic stability in LLM judges. The framework decomposes judge robustness along three dimensions: Mechanical Consistency (stability under re-prompting and reframing), Single-turn Conviction (stability under a single challenge), and Multi-turn Persistence (stability under sustained or adaptive pressure). We use the framework to study 9 frontier models across 14 judging tasks spanning safety, toxicity, AI writing detection, and political-response evaluation. Every model exhibits substantial wiggle as a judge --- flipping verdicts 25--71\% of the time under static pushback, and 62--91\% with an adversarial LLM persuader. Critically, we find that pressure that succeeds in changing a judge's verdict is almost always net-corrupting with respect to ground truth. Beyond the framework itself, we identify baseline jury majority strength as the most effective single-shot signal for anticipating which items wiggle. Taken together, this is the first apples-to-apples cross-dataset comparison of mechanical, conformity, and persuadability tests in a judging context.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Wiggle Framework，一个用于评估 LLM 法官（judge）认知稳定性的统一压力测试框架，将鲁棒性分解为机械一致性（Mechanical Consistency）、单轮坚定性（Single-turn Conviction）和多轮持久性（Multi-turn Persistence）三个维度。作者在 9 个前沿模型、14 个评判任务上测试，发现所有模型在静态反驳下翻案率为 25–71%，在对抗性说服下为 62–91%，且成功改变判决的压力几乎总是相对真实标签净破坏性的。研究还指出基线陪审团多数强度是最有效的单次信号，用于预测哪些项目容易翻转。
Motivation: LLM 法官已被广泛用于模型评估、在线评分和奖励建模，但传统上只用黄金数据上的准确率验证，无法反映其在重新提示、挑战或持续施压下的稳定性。
Method: 提出 Wiggle Framework，将法官鲁棒性分解为三个维度：机械一致性（重提示与重框架下的稳定性）、单轮坚定性（单次挑战下的稳定性）和多轮持久性（持续或自适应压力下的稳定性），并在安全、毒性、AI 写作检测和政治回应评估等任务上系统测试。
Result: 所有被测模型在静态推回下 25–71% 的判决翻转，在对抗性 LLM 说服者下 62–91% 翻转；压力导致的判决改变几乎总是偏离真实标签（net-corrupting）。基线陪审团多数强度是预测哪些条目会翻转的最有效单次信号。
Conclusion: 这是首个在同一评判语境下对机械一致性、从众性和可说服性测试进行跨数据集苹果对苹果比较的研究，说明仅靠准确率验证的 LLM 法官在压力下高度不稳定。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Interpretable Causal Discovery via Causal-Effect Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Causal discovery aims to uncover the underlying causal relationships given data generated from a system. The goal, however, is not merely to predict causal edges given data, but also to be able to interpret and explain either observed or hypothesized phenomena, such as a particularly large causal effect. We consider this task of conditional causal discovery and cast it as a Bayesian inference problem, in which we target the posterior over causal graphs and parameters conditional on an event such as a causal-effect constraint. Unfortunately, this poses a computational challenge: existing approaches to Bayesian causal discovery struggle when the event has small posterior mass. To address this, we adapt rare-event estimation techniques to perform inference the joint graph-parameter space. Our method gradually drives a particle population toward the constrained region while maintaining samples that approximate the conditional posterior. Empirical evaluation on synthetic graphs validates the accuracy of our approach at small and large scales, and we show in a case study on the Sachs protein dataset how our method can be used to aid scientific exploration by providing pathway-level summaries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出条件因果发现（conditional causal discovery）的贝叶斯推断框架，目标是在因果效应约束（causal-effect constraint）等事件条件下推断因果图与参数的联合后验。针对这类事件后验质量小导致现有贝叶斯因果发现方法计算困难的问题，作者引入稀有事件估计（rare-event estimation）技术，在联合图-参数空间中将粒子群逐步推向约束区域以近似条件后验。在合成图上的小规模与大规模实验以及Sachs蛋白数据集案例研究中验证了方法的准确性和科学探索价值。
Motivation: 因果发现的目标不仅是预测因果边，还要解释观测或假设的现象（如特别大的因果效应）。现有贝叶斯因果发现方法在目标事件的后验质量很小时难以有效计算条件后验，因此需要新的推断技术。
Method: 将条件因果发现建模为贝叶斯推断问题，目标分布为给定事件（如因果效应约束）下的因果图与参数后验。采用稀有事件估计技术，逐步驱动粒子群（particle population）朝向约束区域移动，同时保持近似条件后验的样本。
Result: 在合成图上验证了方法在小型和大型规模下的准确性；在Sachs蛋白数据集案例研究中，展示了该方法可通过提供路径级摘要（pathway-level summaries）辅助科学探索。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该方法能够处理事件后验质量小的条件因果发现场景，并通过路径级摘要支持科学探索；实验证据来自合成图与Sachs蛋白数据集。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Novels generated by language models show compressed formal variation
papers.abstract_en: While large language models can generate entire novels, there is little information about the level of formal variation in their output over many generations. Rather than asking whether individual passages can be identified as AI-generated, this study asks whether repeated AI generation can produce the same range of diversity which is found across human corpora. This paper contrasts six corpora based on generation source and target style: twenty novels generated using GPT-5.5 Thinking in a nineteenth-century British realist style, twenty novels generated using Qwen3-14B in a nineteenth-century British realist style, twenty novels generated using each of these models in a contemporary zero style, 205 nineteenth-century human-written British novels, and sixty-five contemporary human-written Zero-Style novels. At the document level, the research includes MATTR-500, Shannon entropy, average sentence length, readability, and punctuation rate measurements. The most robust and reliable result is compression of sentence structure. Repeated generations produce novels that vary far less from one another in sentence structure than human novels do. Compression is also present in the measures of readability, punctuation, and sentence length variability within novels. Lexical measures tend to be similarly compressed, with the exception of Qwen Zero-Style MATTR. Despite having distinct mean stylistic profiles, GPT and Qwen lack a stable pattern of cross-measure correlation. This article therefore distinguishes between variance overclosure, which represents a limited formal range between novels, and a more specific phenomenon of correlational overclosure. This means that an individual AI-generated novel may resemble human fiction stylistically, while a collection of AI-generated novels occupies a much narrower formal range.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文考察大语言模型反复生成整本小说时，其形式多样性是否与人类语料库相当。作者构建六个语料库：GPT-5.5 Thinking 与 Qwen3-14B 分别在十九世纪英国现实主义风格和当代 Zero 风格下各生成二十本小说，并对照 205 部人类十九世纪英国小说与 65 部当代 Zero-Style 小说。文档级测量包括 MATTR-500、Shannon 熵、平均句长、可读性和标点率，最稳健的结果是句子结构压缩：重复生成的小说之间在句子结构上的差异远小于人类小说之间。可读性、标点、句长变异度也出现压缩，词汇度量大多类似压缩，例外是 Qwen Zero-Style 的 MATTR。
Motivation: 现有研究多关注单段文本能否被识别为 AI 生成，而很少回答反复 AI 生成能否复现人类语料库中的多样性范围。该研究把问题从个体检测转向语料层面的形式变化范围。
Method: 构建六语料库，包含两种生成模型与两种目标风格组合下的各二十本生成小说，以及人类写作的 205 部十九世纪英国小说和 65 部当代 Zero-Style 小说。在文档层级测量 MATTR-500、Shannon 熵、平均句长、可读性、标点率等指标，并考察跨指标相关模式。
Result: 最稳健的结果是句子结构压缩：重复生成的小说在句子结构上彼此差异远小于人类小说。压缩也出现在可读性、标点和句长变异度中；词汇度量大多被压缩，例外是 Qwen Zero-Style 的 MATTR。GPT 和 Qwen 虽有不同平均风格画像，但缺乏稳定的跨度量相关模式。
Conclusion: 作者区分了 variance overclosure（小说之间形式范围收窄）与 correlational overclosure（指标间相关关系收窄）。单个 AI 生成的小说可能风格上接近人类小说，但一组 AI 生成的小说整体占据更窄的形式范围。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CAKE: Compiler-Agent Co-Design for Frontier Kernel Evolution
papers.abstract_en: GPU kernel agents and GPU programming languages have advanced separately, leaving expert kernels difficult to reproduce. Agents usually treat the compiler as a fixed black box and receive only errors, correctness outcomes, and timing, while existing DSLs either hide critical scheduling decisions or expose them through difficult layout abstractions. We present CAKE, a compiler-agent co-design in which agents author CAKE IR, a typed, hardware-explicit schedule representation. CAKE exposes warp roles, memory movement, synchronization, and pipelines while supporting verification, cost modeling, and localized diagnostics. The harness itself evolves: recurring failures become verifier rules, IR primitives, model calibrations, and reusable optimization tactics. In matched implementation-hidden Flash-KMeans clean starts on B200, the best CAKE IR candidate at an 80-million-token budget runs at 1.144x the tuned FlashML baseline, compared with 0.928x for direct CUDA/PTX. Beyond this benchmark, agent-generated Kimi Delta Attention achieves a 2.05x geometric-mean speedup over official FlashKDA and passes end-to-end serving validation. Dispatcher-backed KNN and KMeans improve performance by 1.42x to 2.12x across more than 400 shapes, and four kernel changes are available as upstream PRs. CAKE targets NVIDIA GPUs from Ampere through Blackwell and separates single-shape evolution from library generalization and dispatch.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CAKE，一种编译器-智能体协同设计 (compiler-agent co-design) 框架：智能体直接编写类型化、硬件显式的调度表示 CAKE IR，编译器不再是黑盒。CAKE 会暴露 warp 角色、内存移动、同步和流水线，并把反复出现的失败转化为验证规则、IR 原语、模型校准和可复用优化策略。在 B200 上，匹配实现且隐藏实现的 Flash-KMeans 干净启动中，80M token 预算下最佳 CAKE IR 候选运行速度是调优后 FlashML 基线的 1.144x，而直接 CUDA/PTX 为 0.928x；智能体生成的 Kimi Delta Attention 相对官方 FlashKDA 取得 2.05x 几何平均加速，Dispatcher 支持的 KNN/KMeans 在 400 多个 shape 上提升 1.42x 至 2.12x。
Motivation: GPU kernel 智能体与 GPU 编程语言各自发展，导致专家级 kernel 难以复现：智能体通常把编译器当作固定黑盒，只能接收错误、正确性结果和耗时；现有 DSL 要么隐藏关键调度决策，要么通过难以使用的布局抽象暴露它们。
Method: 提出 CAKE 协同设计，让智能体编写 CAKE IR——一种类型化、硬件显式的调度表示，显式暴露 warp 角色、内存移动、同步和流水线，同时支持验证、成本建模和局部化诊断。框架本身会演化：反复出现的失败被固化为验证规则、IR 原语、模型校准和可复用优化策略。
Result: 在 B200 的 Flash-KMeans 干净启动实验中，80M token 预算下最佳 CAKE IR 的吞吐为调优 FlashML 基线的 1.144x，而直接 CUDA/PTX 仅为 0.928x；智能体生成的 Kimi Delta Attention 对官方 FlashKDA 取得 2.05x 几何平均加速并通过端到端服务验证；Dispatcher 支持的 KNN 与 KMeans 在 400 多个 shape 上获得 1.42x 至 2.12x 提升，并有四项 kernel 改动以上游 PR 形式提供。
Conclusion: CAKE 面向 Ampere 到 Blackwell 的 NVIDIA GPU，并将单 shape 演化与库泛化及 dispatcher 调度相分离。摘要未提及该方法在天气降水或时空预测类任务上的适用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EgoCITE: Context-Augmented Indexing and Time-Aware Retrieval for Long-Horizon Egocentric Memory
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon egocentric memory transforms continuous first-person video and audio into a searchable record of past experiences. We demonstrate two bottlenecks in existing systems: indices built from context-poor captions are unreliable for agentic search, while retrieval ignores a question's temporal intent. To address both bottlenecks, we introduce EgoCITE (Egocentric Context-augmented Indexing and Time-aware Evidence retrieval), a long-horizon agentic memory framework for egocentric QA. EgoCITE comprises three components. EgoScheme uses local multimodal context to turn fragmentary video captions and speech transcripts into self-contained atomic memory indices. EgoIndex organizes complementary action, activity, utterance, and conversation representations into searchable multi-view memory indices at multiple granularities. EgoRetrv combines semantic search with question-conditioned temporal relevance scoring and curation of retrieved evidence. We evaluate EgoCITE on EgoLifeQA, EgoMem, and EgoR1-Bench in terms of answer accuracy and target-event retrieval alignment. EgoCITE improves accuracy over agentic memory baselines by at least 4.4--14.2\% while achieving 36$\times$ lower cost than long-context LLM agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EgoCITE，一个面向长时间跨度第一人称视频问答（egocentric QA）的智能体记忆框架。框架包含三个组件：EgoScheme 利用局部多模态上下文把零散的视频字幕和语音转写整理成自包含的原子记忆索引；EgoIndex 组织动作、活动、语句、对话等多视角多粒度表示；EgoRetrv 将语义检索与基于问题的时间相关度评分及证据筛选结合。作者在 EgoLifeQA、EgoMem 和 EgoR1-Bench 上评估，称 EgoCITE 相比智能体记忆基线在准确率上提升至少 4.4–14.2%，同时比长上下文 LLM 智能体成本低 36 倍。
Motivation: 现有长时间跨度第一人称记忆系统存在两个瓶颈：基于缺乏上下文的字幕构建的索引在智能体搜索中不可靠，而检索过程忽略了问题的时间意图。这两个瓶颈限制了把连续第一人称视频和音频转化为可检索历史经验的效果。
Method: 提出 EgoCITE，由 EgoScheme、EgoIndex 和 EgoRetrv 三部分组成。EgoScheme 用局部多模态上下文将片段化视频字幕和语音转录转为自包含的原子记忆索引；EgoIndex 将互补的动作、活动、话语和对话表示组织为多视角、多粒度的可检索记忆索引；EgoRetrv 组合语义搜索与基于问题条件的时间相关性打分，并对检索到的证据进行整理。
Result: 在 EgoLifeQA、EgoMem 和 EgoR1-Bench 上，以答案准确率和目标事件检索对齐度为指标，EgoCITE 相比智能体记忆基线准确率提升至少 4.4–14.2%，同时相比长上下文 LLM 智能体实现 36 倍的成本降低。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过上下文增强的索引构建和考虑时间意图的检索，EgoCITE 能在长时程第一人称记忆中实现更可靠、更经济的问题回答。

papers.title: LLMs Are Not Good Strategists, Yet Memory-Enhanced Agency Boosts Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Strategic reasoning in Large Language Models (LLMs) within long-horizon environments is often limited by inconsistent subgoals. In these settings, finite attention resources prevent the model from maintaining strategic coherence over thousands of steps. This limitation leads to strategic drift, where localized decisions fail to sustain a coherent trajectory across reasoning. To address this, we introduce EpicStar, a framework that enables agents to learn memory as policy to tackle long-horizon reasoning. Specifically, the agent maintains a bank of successful past episodes as a heuristic alongside a working memory to track short-term environmental changes. During inference, a dynamic gating mechanism determines whether to execute a retrieved action directly or to perform new reasoning through a contextual fusion of the retrieved episodes and current working memory. Utilizing StarCraft II as the testbed, we evaluated EpicStar against diverse opponent styles. It significantly outperforms baseline methods, achieving higher win rates while consuming an order of magnitude fewer tokens, and it maintains this advantage consistently across difficulty levels and opponent strategies. Our findings provide compelling evidence that structured cross-episode memory is essential for enabling LLM agents to perform robust, long-term strategic execution in dynamic, autonomous settings.
papers.journal_ref: Published at Reasoning and Planning for LLMs at ICLR 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EpicStar 框架，针对 LLM 在长时程环境中因有限注意力资源而难以维持战略一致性的问题，将记忆当作策略来学习。智能体维护成功历史片段库作为启发式，并结合工作记忆跟踪短期环境变化；推理时由动态门控机制决定直接执行检索动作，还是融合检索片段与当前工作记忆进行新推理。在 StarCraft II 测试中，该方法相比基线显著提升胜率，同时消耗约一个数量级更少的 token。
Motivation: LLM 在长时程环境中的战略推理常受制于不一致的子目标；由于注意力资源有限，模型无法在数千步内维持战略连贯性，导致局部决策偏离整体轨迹，即出现战略漂移 (strategic drift)。
Method: EpicStar 让智能体学习“记忆即策略”：保存成功历史片段作为启发式，并维持工作记忆以跟踪短期环境变化；推理时用动态门控机制决定是直接执行检索到的动作，还是通过检索片段与当前工作记忆的上下文融合进行新的推理。
Result: 以 StarCraft II 为测试平台、面向多种对手风格评估时，EpicStar 显著超过基线方法，获得更高胜率，同时 token 消耗减少一个数量级，并且在不同难度和对手策略下均保持优势。
Conclusion: 作者认为，结构化跨片段记忆 (cross-episode memory) 是 LLM 智能体在动态、自主环境中实现稳健长期战略执行的关键。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Structure-preserving uncertainty quantification for GENERIC dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Structure-preserving machine learning embeds physical structure directly into model architectures, yet uncertainty quantification (UQ) for such hard-constrained models remains limited because standard UQ methods may violate the encoded admissibility conditions, require architectural modifications, or impose substantial computational costs. In this work, we propose Structure-Preserving Epistemic Neural Networks (S-PENNs), a general framework for UQ in scientific machine learning models with hard architectural constraints, and instantiate it for GENERIC (General Equation for Non-Equilibrium Reversible-Irreversible Coupling) dynamics. S-PENNs preserve the structural constraints of a pretrained model by attaching lightweight epinets to its constrained components, ensuring that every sampled realization remains physically admissible by construction. When applied to GENERIC dynamics, such a proposed framework yields thermodynamically consistent rollouts that preserve the first and second laws. Furthermore, we combine S-PENNs with split conformal prediction as a post-hoc calibration method to produce prediction intervals with finite-sample marginal coverage guarantees. We validate S-PENNs on three numerical examples: a harmonic oscillator coupled to a heat bath and an idealized chemical motor, both governed by ODEs, and a one-dimensional viscoplastic model governed by PDEs. Across all three examples, S-PENNs produce thermodynamically consistent stochastic realizations and well-calibrated prediction intervals while reducing the computational cost by about one to three orders of magnitude compared to deep ensembles. Although the present study focuses on GENERIC dynamics, S-PENNs can be extended more broadly to scientific machine learning models in computational mechanics with either hard or soft constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Structure-Preserving Epistemic Neural Networks (S-PENNs)，一种面向带硬物理约束的科学机器学习模型的通用不确定性量化框架，并以 GENERIC 动力学为例进行实例化。S-PENNs 通过在预训练模型的约束组件上附加轻量 epinets，保证每次采样出的随机实现都天然满足物理可容性，并与 split conformal prediction 结合得到有限样本边际覆盖保证的预测区间。作者在三个数值算例（耦合热浴的谐振子、理想化化学马达的 ODE 系统，以及一维粘塑性模型的 PDE 系统）上验证了方法的热力学一致性与校准效果。
Motivation: 现有的不确定性量化方法在硬约束科学模型中可能违反编码的可容性条件，需要修改模型架构，或者带来高昂计算成本；这使得在保持物理结构的前提下进行 UQ 仍是一个未解决的问题。
Method: S-PENNs 将轻量 epinets 附着在预训练模型的受约束组件上，使每次采样实现都按构造保持物理约束；同时将 S-PENNs 与 split conformal prediction 结合，作为事后校准手段提供具有有限样本边际覆盖保证的预测区间。
Result: 在三个数值算例上，S-PENNs 产生了热力学一致的随机实现与校准良好的预测区间，且相比深度集成 (deep ensembles) 将计算成本降低约一到三个数量级。
Conclusion: 作者强调该框架不仅适用于 GENERIC 动力学，还能推广到计算力学中带硬约束或软约束的科学机器学习模型；本文的验证局限于 GENERIC 框架下的 ODE/PDE 算例。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: When Explanations Betray Backdoors: Black-Box Auditing for Language Model Classifiers
papers.abstract_en: Language model classifiers with explanations are used for moderation, routing, topic triage, and low-resource annotation. We study black-box auditing when the defender has only clean calibration data without trigger information but can ask the classifier for a label plus a short rationale or quoted evidence. We introduce Groundedness Drift, a lightweight score measuring whether the answer summary remains grounded in the input. Across two 7B backbones, five datasets, and four common non-adaptive OpenBackdoor-style attack families, Groundedness Drift achieves higher AUROC and lower residual target ASR than every compared detector in all cases at a nominal 5\% clean-FPR budget. We then evaluate Unsupported Groundedness, a multi-probe escalation for explanation-camouflage stress cases. Unsupported Groundedness improves signals but does not close the adaptive gap.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究带解释的语言模型分类器（如用于审核、路由、主题分诊和低资源标注的模型）的黑盒后门审计问题。作者假设防御方只有干净校准数据、没有触发器信息，但可以查询分类器获得标签和一段简短理由或引用证据，并据此提出 Groundedness Drift 这一轻量评分，衡量回答摘要是否仍然基于输入内容。在两个 7B 骨干模型、五个数据集和四类常见非自适应 OpenBackdoor 风格攻击族上，该方法在 5% 干净误报率预算下取得了比所有对比检测器更高的 AUROC 和更低的残余目标攻击成功率。作者进一步提出多探针升级方案 Unsupported Groundedness 以应对解释伪装压力场景，称其能改善信号但无法完全弥合自适应攻击差距。
Motivation: 防御方在不知道触发器信息、只拥有干净校准数据的情况下，需要对带解释的黑盒语言模型分类器进行后门审计；现有的检测方法在此类受限设定下表现不足，而解释或引用证据可以被当作额外的探测信号来利用。
Method: 提出 Groundedness Drift，一种轻量评分，用于度量模型给出的答案摘要相对于输入文本的接地（grounded）程度；同时提出 Unsupported Groundedness，一种多探针升级方案，专门用于解释伪装（explanation-camouflage）的压力场景。
Result: 在两个 7B 骨干模型、五个数据集和四类非自适应 OpenBackdoor 风格攻击族上，Groundedness Drift 在 5% 干净误报率预算下，所有情形均取得比所有对比检测器更高的 AUROC 和更低的残余目标 ASR；Unsupported Groundedness 能改善检测信号，但并未弥合自适应攻击差距。
Conclusion: 摘要强调基于解释接地性的评分可以作为黑盒后门审计的有效信号，同时承认在面对自适应攻击时仍存在未闭合的性能差距，说明该方法对高级逃逸的鲁棒性有限。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: The Boolean Power of ReLU
papers.abstract_en: We prove that, on finite simple undirected graphs equipped with a single Boolean node feature, the Boolean queries expressible in $Σ$-MPLang, for any collection $Σ$ of eventually constant activation functions and with arbitrary real coefficients, form a strict subclass of the Boolean queries expressible in ReLU-MPLang. We thereby settle a recently posed open problem: whether ReLU-MPLang is more powerful than trReLU-MPLang when it comes to Boolean queries. In particular, this implies that ReLU-GNNs are strictly more expressive than {TrReLU,id}-GNNs with respect to Boolean queries on Boolean-featured graphs.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, comes with AI declaration
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究带单个布尔节点特征的有限简单无向图上的布尔查询表达能力。作者证明，对于任意由最终常值激活函数组成的集合 Σ 且允许任意实数系数，Σ-MPLang 所能表达的布尔查询严格包含于 ReLU-MPLang 所能表达的布尔查询，从而解决了最近提出的一个开放问题：在布尔查询上 ReLU-MPLang 是否比 trReLU-MPLang 更强。该结论进一步暗示，ReLU-GNN 在布尔特征图上的布尔查询表达能力严格强于 {TrReLU,id}-GNN。
Motivation: 该工作针对图神经网络（GNN）表达能力的理论刻画中的一个开放问题：带 ReLU 激活的 message-passing 语言（ReLU-MPLang）与带截断 ReLU（trReLU）的语言相比，在布尔查询上是否有严格更强的表达能力。这涉及对常用激活函数在逻辑式查询语言中作用的理解。
Method: 作者通过理论证明的方式，考虑由最终常值（eventually constant）激活函数组成的任意集合 Σ 所对应的 MPLang 变体，并允许任意实数系数，证明其布尔查询类是 ReLU-MPLang 布尔查询类的真子类。证明基于图上的逻辑语言与 GNN 表达式的对应关系。
Result: 摘要报告了严格的包含关系：Σ-MPLang 的布尔查询能力严格弱于 ReLU-MPLang。由此推出 ReLU-GNN 与 {TrReLU,id}-GNN 在布尔特征图上的布尔查询表达能力存在严格差异。
Conclusion: 该结果正面回答了 ReLU-MPLang 是否比 trReLU-MPLang 对布尔查询更强大的开放问题，并为 GNN 的激活函数选择提供了新的表达力理论依据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Drive-to-Music: Context-Aware Generative Audio for In-Vehicle Experiences
papers.abstract_en: In-vehicle music can serve as an adaptive interface to enhance driver experience, attention, and well-being. We present Drive-to-Music, a context-aware system that generates music in real time from multimodal driving signals. Using dashcam imagery and vehicle telemetry, the system extracts scene semantics and driving context, maps them to high-level musical descriptors, and conditions generative audio models to produce contextually aligned soundtracks. The architecture combines perception and generative components to translate visual and kinematic inputs into structured musical attributes and synthesize audio with low latency. It supports smooth transitions as driving conditions evolve, and to ensure robustness and deployment readiness, we incorporate constraint-based controls and safety checks across the generation pipeline. Our results demonstrate the feasibility of real-time, context-aware music generation in automotive settings, providing a foundation for personalized and adaptive in-vehicle audio experiences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Drive-to-Music，一个面向车载场景的上下文感知音乐生成系统。系统利用行车记录仪图像与车辆遥测数据提取场景语义和驾驶上下文，将其映射为高层音乐描述符，并条件化生成式音频模型，以低延迟实时合成与环境对齐的配乐。架构融合感知与生成组件，支持随驾驶状态演变的平滑过渡，并在生成管线中加入约束控制与安全检查。结果表明实时上下文感知音乐生成在汽车场景中可行，为个性化、自适应车载音频体验提供基础。
Motivation: 车载音乐可以作为自适应界面来改善驾驶员体验、注意力和幸福感，但传统音乐播放缺乏对驾驶环境的实时感知与上下文对齐，因此需要一种能从多模态驾驶信号中实时生成匹配音乐的系统。
Method: 系统从行车记录仪图像和车辆遥测数据中提取场景语义与驾驶上下文，将其转换为高层音乐描述符，再条件化生成式音频模型合成音频；整体架构结合感知组件与生成组件，并通过约束控制和安全检查保证生成管线的稳健性与部署就绪。
Result: 摘要报告实验证明了在汽车环境中进行实时、上下文感知音乐生成的可行性，并为个性化和自适应车载音频体验提供基础；未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 该工作表明实时上下文感知音乐生成在汽车场景中可行，可作为未来个性化与自适应车载音频系统的基础，同时强调约束控制与安全检查对部署稳健性的重要性。
Relevance: 5
