papers.title: From Visual Widgets to UI Code: Efficient Tool-Grounded Generation
papers.abstract_en: Existing screenshot-to-code systems face a trade-off between flexibility and controllability. Direct multimodal generation can hallucinate visible details, whereas structured pipelines reduce such errors through component-wise decomposition, predefined templates, and customized intermediate representations. These structures, however, introduce additional generative orchestration and restrict outputs to designs covered by the representation. We investigate whether selective tool grounding can improve the fidelity--efficiency trade-off of direct widget-to-code generation. We introduce \textbf{WidgetGen}, a lightweight tool-grounded framework that extracts observable text and color evidence, performs high-level layout and optional chart reasoning, and directly generates executable JavaScript XML (\emph{JSX}). This design reduces reliance on component-wise generation while avoiding a fixed UI schema. Across six multimodal models and \(1{,}000\) held-out widgets, WidgetGen outperforms direct prompting and the structured Widget2Code pipeline on most visual reconstruction metrics, with consistent gains in area, legibility, and style. Finally, reconstruction-derived image-code pairs improve six Qwen-family open-weight models across every reported metric through supervised fine-tuning. These results establish WidgetGen as a strong lightweight baseline and show that selective evidence grounding offers an effective alternative to extensive representation constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WidgetGen，一个轻量的工具接地 (tool-grounded) 框架，用于从 UI 截图直接生成可执行 JSX 代码。它通过提取可见文本与颜色证据，并执行高层布局与可选图表推理，避免了直接多模态生成的幻觉，也不依赖固定 UI schema。在六个多模态模型和 1000 个留出小部件上的实验显示，WidgetGen 在多数视觉重建指标上优于直接提示和结构化的 Widget2Code 流水线，并在面积、可读性和风格上有一致提升。此外，用重建得到的图像-代码对微调六个 Qwen 系列开源模型，在所有报告指标上都有改善。
Motivation: 现有 screenshot-to-code 系统在灵活性与可控性之间存在权衡：直接多模态生成可能产生可见细节的幻觉，而结构化流水线通过组件级分解、预定义模板和定制中间表示降低错误，但引入了额外的生成编排并限制了输出范围。
Method: WidgetGen 选择性地接地工具，提取可观测的文本和颜色证据，进行高层布局与可选图表推理，并直接生成可执行的 JavaScript XML (JSX)；该设计减少对逐组件生成的依赖，同时避免固定的 UI 表示模式。
Result: 在六个多模态模型和 1000 个留出小部件上，WidgetGen 在大多数视觉重建指标上优于直接提示和 Widget2Code 流水线，尤其在面积 (area)、可读性 (legibility) 与风格 (style) 方面获得一致提升；基于重建的图像-代码对进行监督微调后，六个 Qwen 系列模型在每个报告指标上均得到提升。

papers.title: @skills: Attention is all you have
papers.abstract_en: There are 56,804 public agent skills today, and teams write many more privately. The dominant delivery model is installation: once installed, a skill's description remains in the system prompt, competing for fewer than 100 reliable trigger slots. This leaves the long tail with no practical path to use and forces teams' own playbooks to compete for the same scarce space. We observe that installation bundles three separable functions: content, persistence, and automatic triggering. Only the last requires prompt residency. We therefore propose @skills, an open protocol that separates them. A path addresses any skill, subtree, or collection, and reading a skill is sufficient to use it, so nothing is installed or made resident. The operation vendors a copy at the same path into a project's Git-tracked tree for adaptation and ownership. The operation adds one .gitignore-style line, the only element that costs prompt residency. A directory is a menu, making bundles ordinary directories rather than all-or-nothing units. The protocol requires no manifest, lockfile, or registration, and SKILL.md remains unchanged. @skills is additive, ships as an installable package, and turns any agent that can read files and run commands into a client through a single instruction file. Its open specification is at https://github.com/SylphAI-Inc/atskills and it is implemented in the AdaL CLI at https://adalagent.ai . Because paths address skills well but cannot find them, the protocol is paired with a free hub at https://atskills.one for corpus-wide search and ranking, repository-free hosting, private and team collections, and one-screen authoring. The hub is optional: gh: and local paths resolve without it, and indexed GitHub skills retain their gh: identities. Install less, use more.
papers.comment: 7 pages main, 23 pages in total with appendix, 6 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 @skills 开放协议，将 agent skill 的安装模式拆分为内容、持久化和自动触发三个可分离功能，只有自动触发需要驻留系统提示词。协议用路径寻址任意 skill、子树或集合，读取即用、无需安装；vendoring 操作把同一路径的副本复制进项目 Git 树以便适配和归属，唯一占用提示词空间的是一个 .gitignore 式单行条目。目录被视为菜单，协议不要求 manifest、lockfile 或注册，并配套一个可选的 hub 用于搜索与排名。
Motivation: 当前公开 agent skills 数量庞大，但主导交付模式是安装：安装后 skill 描述长期驻留系统提示词，争夺不到 100 个可靠触发槽位，导致长尾 skill 缺乏实用路径，团队私有 playbook 也竞争同一稀缺空间。
Method: 提出 @skills 协议，把安装捆绑的三项功能分离：路径（path）寻址任意 skill、子树或集合，读取即可使用；vendoring 操作将同一路径的副本复制进项目 Git 跟踪树中以便修改与归属；以 .gitignore 风格的单行条目作为唯一驻留元素。目录即菜单，使 bundle 成为普通目录；协议无需 manifest、lockfile 或注册，SKILL.md 保持不变，并以单个指令文件让任何能读文件和运行命令的 agent 成为客户端。
Result: 摘要未报告实验或基准数据；交付物包括开放规范、AdaL CLI 实现，以及可选的免费 hub（atskills.one），后者提供语料级搜索与排名、免仓库托管、私有/团队集合和单屏创作，且 gh: 与本地路径无需 hub 即可解析。
Conclusion: 作者的核心主张是“少安装，多使用”（Install less, use more）：路径擅长寻址但不擅长发现，因此协议配以可选 hub 补足发现能力；方案是增量式的，可安装为软件包，并保持已有 gh: 索引 skill 的身份不变。

papers.title: PseudoMapLabeler: Confidence-Aware Pseudo-Label Generation for Semi-Supervised Online Mapping
papers.abstract_en: A critical challenge in deploying online HD map construction systems to real-world scenarios is the scarcity of labeled training data, which limits model generalization in diverse environments. To address this limitation, we propose a teacher-student semi-supervised learning (SSL) framework that generates high-quality pseudo-labels from unlabeled data through confidence-aware map refinement. Our approach first trains a teacher model on limited labeled data, then leverages Beta-distribution-based confidence maps to assess the reliability of predicted map elements across temporal observations. Unlike conventional filtering methods that discard entire elements, we introduce a spatial clipping technique that selectively preserves high-confidence regions while removing unreliable segments. The refined map elements serve as map priors that improve the teacher model's prediction accuracy on unlabeled data in a second pass. These enhanced predictions become pseudo-labels for training a student model from scratch, followed by fine-tuning on the original labeled data. Experimental results on the nuScenes dataset demonstrate that our teacher-student framework with refined pseudo-labels improves performance by +6.1 mAP under a low-label regime compared to training on labeled data alone, offering a practical solution to the labeled data scarcity problem in online HD map construction.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 4 figures, Accepted at ECCV 2026 DriveX Workshop on Foundation Models for Autonomous Driving
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个教师-学生半监督学习框架 PseudoMapLabeler，用于在线高清地图构建中从无标签数据生成高质量伪标签。框架先用有限标注数据训练教师模型，基于 Beta 分布置信度图评估预测元素的可靠性，并用空间裁剪保留高置信区域、去除不可靠片段；精炼后的地图元素作为先验改进教师模型的第二遍预测，再生成伪标签用于从头训练学生模型，最后在原始标注数据上微调。在 nuScenes 数据集上，低标注条件下该框架相比仅用标注数据训练提升 +6.1 mAP。
Motivation: 在线高清地图构建部署到真实场景时面临标注训练数据稀缺的问题，这限制了模型在多样化环境中的泛化能力，作者针对该标注稀缺问题提出生成高质量伪标签的方法。
Method: 先训练教师模型，利用 Beta 分布置信度图在时间观测上评估预测地图元素的可靠性；与直接丢弃整个元素的常规过滤不同，采用空间裁剪技术只保留高置信区域并移除不可靠片段。精炼后的地图元素作为先验提升教师模型在无标签数据上的第二遍预测，增强后的预测成为伪标签，用于从零训练学生模型，再在原始标注数据上微调。
Result: 在 nuScenes 数据集上进行实验，低标注（low-label）设置下，教师-学生框架配合精炼伪标签比仅用标注数据训练提升 +6.1 mAP。
Conclusion: 论文强调该教师-学生框架与精炼伪标签方案为在线高清地图构建中的标注数据稀缺问题提供了实用解决方案。

papers.title: Dead text or binding clause? Measuring and restoring constraint influence in black-box LLM dialogues
papers.abstract_en: Multi-turn dialogues let users revoke constraints as easily as impose them, but revocation does not reliably take effect: models keep enacting withdrawn requirements (occasionally beneath comments asserting their removal), a failure we call \emph{behavioral relapse}, or revocation inertia. No existing instrument measures this influence per clause, predicts it before delivery, or repairs it under matched budgets. \sysname{} closes the three gaps through the model API alone: a contract ledger pairs every constraint with an executable checker, records revocations as tombstones, and compiles the net constraint state ahead of time into a single specification; a sequential ablation probe measures per-clause adherence and incremental behavioral effect; a repair ladder operates under token- and attempt-matched budgets. On \dataname{} (\NTasks{} HumanEval tasks, \NClauses{} verified checkers), relapse at an 8B operating point climbs from \ScaleDelayedMTwo{} to \ScaleDelayedMEight{} as constraint load grows, while stronger models sit at floor. Under matched checkers, model, and budget, ahead-of-time compilation significantly reduces relapse against a no-ledger verifier-retry baseline (\RestoreDiff{}, 95\% CI \RestoreDiffCI{}, $p$ \RestoreDiffP{}); adaptive ladder interventions stacked on top add no detectable gain (95\% confidence excludes gains $\geq$ \LadderExcludedGain{}). The probe predicts relapse before delivery (AUROC \AurocPrimary{}); a one-sentence tombstone note recovers about a third of the compilation effect and survives a placebo control. At \CostDeliveryFactor{} delivery overhead and \CostTotalHedged{} of API compute for every result, revocation failure becomes a measurable, predictable, and repairable property of dialogue state rather than an invisible one.

papers.title: Predicting When Random Low-Dimensional Reparameterizations Train Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Neural networks can often be trained or fine-tuned through random low-dimensional reparameterization, where a small latent vector is mapped into a full parameter update by a frozen random map. This raises a practical question: how large must the latent search space be to reach a low-loss region? We first express the known accessibility transition in an equivalent conic form, centered for compact convex targets at the statistical dimension of the polar cone. Our main theoretical contribution is an orientation-resolved quadratic master formula that predicts the random-slice residual from both the curvature spectrum and the reference-to-solution displacement profile. It yields a self-consistent isotropic-orientation predictor and, in a conservative radius-only specialization, recovers the earlier Gaussian-width quadratic bound. Building on this analysis, we introduce Random Mapping Networks (RaMaN), which instantiate the predicted latent dimension using structured Hadamard or seed-regenerated Gaussian maps. These constructions avoid the O(dP) storage of dense random maps and reduce optimizer-state memory from O(P) to O(d). We also develop matrix-free curvature approximations and sweep-free dimension selection. Across controlled quadratic and neural-curvature experiments, the orientation-resolved predictor closely tracks measured transition locations and outperforms orientation-agnostic approximations when displacement direction matters. End-to-end experiments further show sharp, protocol-dependent training transitions across image and language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究随机低维重参数化（random low-dimensional reparameterization）训练神经网络时，隐空间需要多大才能到达低损失区域的问题。作者将已知的可达性转变（accessibility transition）表达为等价的锥形形式，并提出一个方向分辨的二次主公式（orientation-resolved quadratic master formula），利用曲率谱和参考到解的位移轮廓预测随机切片残差。基于该分析，作者提出随机映射网络（RaMaN），用结构化 Hadamard 或种子再生高斯映射替代稠密随机映射，将存储从 O(dP) 降至 O(d)、优化器状态从 O(P) 降至 O(d)，并在多个实验上验证了预测器与转变位置的吻合。
Motivation: 神经网络常可通过随机低维重参数化进行训练或微调，即用冻结的随机映射把小隐向量映射为完整参数更新；实际问题是隐空间搜索维度需要多大才能进入低损失区域。
Method: 先把已知可达性转变在紧凑凸目标下以极锥（polar cone）的统计维数为中心写成锥形等价形式；再提出方向分辨的二次主公式，该公式同时依赖曲率谱与参考到解的位移轮廓，并给出自洽的各向同性方向预测器，其保守的仅半径特化可恢复此前的高斯宽度二次界。在此基础上引入 Random Mapping Networks (RaMaN)，采用结构化 Hadamard 或种子再生高斯映射、无矩阵曲率近似和免扫掠的维度选择。
Result: 在受控二次与神经曲率实验中，方向分辨预测器紧密跟踪实测转变位置，并在位移方向起作用时优于方向无关的近似；端到端实验还显示图像与语言模型上存在尖锐的、依赖训练协议的转变。
Conclusion: 摘要强调方向分辨的预测框架能够有效预测随机低维重参数化训练中的转变位置，且 RaMaN 通过结构化映射显著降低存储与优化器状态开销，同时保持训练能力。

summary_sections.result: 在受控二次与神经曲率实验中，方向分辨预测器紧密跟踪实测转变位置，并在位移方向起作用时优于方向无关的近似；端到端实验还显示图像与语言模型上存在尖锐的、依赖训练协议的转变。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调方向分辨的预测框架能够有效预测随机低维重参数化训练中的转变位置，且 RaMaN 通过结构化映射显著降低存储与优化器状态开销，同时保持训练能力。

papers.title: What Makes a Peer? Valuation-Anchored Similarity in Private Markets
papers.abstract_en: As more investors contemplate private markets and contend with limited transparency, sparse disclosures, and infrequent transactions, identifying economically meaningful peer companies for comparison is a fundamental challenge for valuation, due diligence, portfolio construction, and risk management. We propose an ensemble tree-based supervised similarity learning framework that defines company similarity through the lens of market valuation rather than static feature matching or semantic descriptions. Specifically, we train a CatBoost gradient-boosted decision tree model on observed private company valuations and derive a valuation-aware similarity metric from importance-weighted leaf-node co-occurrences across the ensemble. The similarity metric captures shared valuation drivers while accommodating nonlinear relationships, mixed data types, and pervasive missing data common in private markets. Using a global private-market universe of approximately 270,000 companies, including more than 53,000 firms with observed or derivable post-money valuations spanning multiple industries, geographies, and deal stages, we demonstrate that the proposed similarity framework improves upon traditional distance-based and text-embedding-based approaches in downstream k-nearest-neighbor valuation tasks in the evaluated industry groups, while retaining case-based explainability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对私募市场中可比公司识别难的问题，提出基于市场估值的监督相似性学习框架。作者用 CatBoost 梯度提升树在约 27 万家公司的全球私募市场数据上训练，并从集成模型中基于重要性加权的叶节点共现导出估值感知的相似度度量。在多个行业、地域和交易阶段的超过 5.3 万个有估值样本上，该方法在下游 k 近邻估值任务中优于传统距离度量和文本嵌入方法，同时保留基于案例的可解释性。
Motivation: 私募市场透明度低、披露稀疏、交易不频繁，投资者在估值、尽调、组合构建和风险管理中难以找到经济意义上有可比性的同行公司；传统的静态特征匹配或语义描述无法捕捉估值驱动因素。
Method: 提出集成树监督相似性学习框架：训练 CatBoost 梯度提升决策树拟合观测到的私募公司估值，并从集成中依据特征重要性的叶节点共现导出估值感知的相似度度量，能够处理非线性关系、混合数据类型和私募市场中普遍的缺失数据。
Result: 在全球约 27 万家公司的私募市场数据上（其中超过 5.3 万家有观测或可推导的投后估值），该框架在所评估的行业组中的下游 k 近邻估值任务上优于传统的基于距离的方法和基于文本嵌入的方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调以市场估值而非静态特征或语义作为相似性锚点，可以在私募市场可比公司识别中取得更好效果，并保留基于案例的可解释性。

papers.title: DiG-bench: Discovery in Games
papers.abstract_en: Discovery---formulating novel generalizations---is a central part of the scientific process. Despite its importance, there is a gap in the current AI benchmark landscape, with few benchmarks directly probing the capacity for discovering new knowledge with experimentation in controlled environments where the objective is unknown. To address this gap, we release a new benchmark: DiG-bench (Discovery in Games). DiG-bench consists of a set of 70 independent games. Each game is encoded as a short string and has unique transformation rules that must be discovered through interaction and experimentation. The levels of the game present a series of challenges to test whether the rules have been discovered, where the win conditions for each level are also unknown. We provide games at seven tiers of difficulty for AI agents. The lowest tier is routinely solvable by multiple models, while the highest tier challenges the best models in agentic harnesses. All 70 games were solved by at least one human on first attempt. A subset of 21 games is released publicly, and the remainder is held private for secure evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DiG-bench 是一个用于评测 AI 智能体在未知目标环境中通过交互和实验发现新规则能力的基准，包含 70 个独立的游戏，每个游戏以短字符串编码并具有独特的变换规则。游戏分为七个难度层级，最低层级多个模型可解，最高层级对现有最强智能体构成挑战；全部 70 个游戏均至少有一名人类玩家首次尝试即通关。基准公开其中 21 个游戏，其余保留为私有集以支持安全评估。
Motivation: 现有 AI 基准很少直接考察在目标未知的受控环境中通过实验发现新知识的能力，而发现（discovery）即形成新颖泛化是科学过程的核心，因此存在基准空白。
Method: 构建 DiG-bench：设计一组用短字符串编码、具有唯一变换规则的独立游戏，智能体需通过交互和实验发现规则，且每关的胜利条件也未知；按难度设置七个层级，并采用部分公开、部分私有的评估方式。
Result: 摘要报告最低难度层级可被多个现有模型解决，最高层级则挑战最强智能体；70 个游戏全部能被人类首次尝试解决，其中 21 个公开，其余私有。
Conclusion: 该基准旨在直接探测 AI 在未知目标环境下的发现能力，并为安全评估保留私有测试子集。

papers.title: Represent, Then Generate: Multimodal-Conditioned Time-Series Generation under Irregular Missingness
papers.abstract_en: Continuous physiological time series underpin modern clinical monitoring, yet many of the most informative signals are invasive, expensive, or simply unavailable for a given patient. Conditional generation offers a remedy: an absent signal can be synthesized from co-recorded signals and routine clinical variables. Existing generators, however, are built around a single conditioning modality and degrade when forced to handle the heterogeneous, irregularly missing mix of time-variant signals and static covariates seen in practice. We propose ReCoGen (Represent Conditions, then Generate), a two-stage framework that decouples multimodal condition representation from target generation. Stage I trains one masked autoencoder per modality, distilling each time-variant condition into a compact and missingness-tolerant token sequence. Stage II trains a flow-matching generator that fuses these tokens with static conditions to synthesize the target signal. Across three physiological benchmarks, including continuous glucose monitoring on AI-READI and arterial blood pressure generation on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV, ReCoGen attains the best downstream utility on all sixteen (dataset, task, metric) settings, surpassing six representative conditional generators; on thirteen of them its utility also reaches or exceeds the utility measured on the real signal, a reference we read as an approximate anchor rather than a ceiling. Ablations trace the gains to the conditioning path: learnable cross-attention over the frozen per-modality encoders, and a dual token-plus-AdaLN route for the static conditions. ReCoGen thus turns routinely collected signals into informative surrogates for invasive or unavailable ones, a step toward less invasive, lower-cost continuous clinical monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReCoGen（Represent Conditions, then Generate），一个将多模态条件表示与目标生成解耦的两阶段框架，用于在异构且不规则缺失（irregular missingness）条件下生成连续生理时间序列。Stage I 为每个模态训练一个掩码自编码器（masked autoencoder），把随时间变化的条件压缩成紧凑且对缺失容忍的 token 序列；Stage II 用 flow-matching 生成器融合这些 token 与静态条件来合成目标信号。在 AI-READI 连续血糖监测和 MIMIC-III/MIMIC-IV 动脉血压生成等三个生理基准上，ReCoGen 在全部十六个（数据集、任务、指标）设置中获得最佳下游效用，超过六个代表性条件生成器，并在十三个设置上达到或超过真实信号效用。
Motivation: 现有条件生成器围绕单一条件模态构建，在面对实际中时间变化信号与静态协变量混合且不规则缺失的场景时性能退化。作者希望用条件生成将常规记录信号合成为侵入性、昂贵或不可用信号的替代，以支持更少侵入、更低成本的连续临床监测。
Method: 提出两阶段框架 ReCoGen：第一阶段逐模态训练掩码自编码器，将时间变化条件蒸馏为紧凑且缺失容忍的 token 序列；第二阶段训练 flow-matching 生成器，将这些 token 与静态条件融合以生成目标信号。消融表明收益集中在条件路径上：对冻结的逐模态编码器使用可学习交叉注意力（learnable cross-attention），以及静态条件采用 token 加 AdaLN 的双路径融合。
Result: 在三个生理时间序列基准（AI-READI 连续血糖监测，MIMIC-III 与 MIMIC-IV 动脉血压生成）上，ReCoGen 在全部十六个（dataset, task, metric）设置中取得最佳下游效用，超越六个代表性条件生成器；其中十三个设置达到或超过在真实信号上测得的效用，作者将该真实信号效用视为近似锚点而非上限。
Conclusion: ReCoGen 将常规收集的信号转化为侵入性或不可用信号的信息性替代物，是朝向更低侵入性、更低成本连续临床监测的一步。摘要未给出明确的局限性描述。

papers.title: Auditable agentic AI for evidence-grounded thyroid ultrasound diagnosis and reporting
papers.abstract_en: Thyroid ultrasound diagnosis requires coordinated lesion localization, measurement, risk stratification and reporting, yet most AI systems address these tasks in isolation and provide limited support for clinical review. We present ThyroidXAgent, a clinician-interactive agentic AI system that coordinates specialized diagnostic tools and stores their outputs as an auditable case-level evidence record. The system was developed using OpenThyroidDB, a multicentre, multitask resource integrating approximately 0.3 million ultrasound images and 24,000 paired reports, and was evaluated on 28,458 non-overlapping test cases, including 8,721 cases from 35 centres in the private NHC-MISD-TUS cohort. Across heterogeneous datasets, ThyroidXAgent achieved a mean Dice score of 87.21 percent for nodule segmentation and a mean AUROC of 0.9466 for benign-malignant classification. The same workflow supported lymph-node metastasis prediction and follicular versus papillary thyroid carcinoma classification, with AUROCs of 0.864 and 0.805, respectively. For report generation, evidence-grounded assembly outperformed multimodal language-model baselines across three cohorts. ThyClinScore, a lesion-level clinical semantic metric introduced here, showed the strongest correlation with a location-aware language-model judge. ThyroidXAgent improved physician classification accuracy, increased report diagnostic consistency from 70.3 percent to 86.2 percent, and reduced segmentation and reporting time by 35.9 percent and 27.4 percent, respectively. These findings support auditable, clinician-correctable agentic AI for thyroid ultrasound diagnosis and reporting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ThyroidXAgent，一个临床医生可交互的 agentic AI 系统，用于甲状腺超声的诊断与报告，协调病变定位、测量、风险分层和报告生成，并将工具输出存储为可审计的病例级证据记录。系统基于 OpenThyroidDB 多中心多任务数据集开发，在 28,458 例非重叠测试病例上评估，包括 NHC-MISD-TUS 队列的 8,721 例。结果显示结节分割平均 Dice 为 87.21%，良恶性分类 AUROC 为 0.9466，证据驱动的报告生成优于多模态语言模型基线。
Motivation: 现有 AI 系统大多孤立处理甲状腺超声的病变定位、测量、风险分层和报告任务，对临床审查支持有限。作者希望构建一个协调这些任务并保留可审计中间证据的系统，以支持临床医生审核与纠正。
Method: 提出 ThyroidXAgent，一种 clinician-interactive 的 agentic AI 系统，协调专门的诊断工具链并将输出保存为病例级证据记录。作者构建了 OpenThyroidDB 数据集，包含约 30 万张超声图像和 2.4 万份配对报告，并引入 ThyClinScore，一个病变级临床语义评估指标。报告生成采用证据驱动组装（evidence-grounded assembly）而非直接端到端生成。
Result: 在非重叠测试集上，系统实现结节分割平均 Dice 87.21%，良恶性分类 AUROC 0.9466；淋巴结转移预测与滤泡型/乳头状甲状腺癌分类的 AUROC 分别为 0.864 和 0.805。证据驱动的报告生成在三个队列上优于多模态语言模型基线。医生使用系统后分类准确率提升，报告诊断一致性从 70.3% 提升到 86.2%，分割和报告时间分别减少 35.9% 和 27.4%。
Conclusion: 摘要认为这些结果支持可审计、可被临床医生纠正的 agentic AI 用于甲状腺超声诊断与报告。论文目前处于审稿阶段（under review）。

summary_sections.result: 在非重叠测试集上，系统实现结节分割平均 Dice 87.21%，良恶性分类 AUROC 0.9466；淋巴结转移预测与滤泡型/乳头状甲状腺癌分类的 AUROC 分别为 0.864 和 0.805。证据驱动的报告生成在三个队列上优于多模态语言模型基线。医生使用系统后分类准确率提升，报告诊断一致性从 70.3% 提升到 86.2%，分割和报告时间分别减少 35.9% 和 27.4%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要认为这些结果支持可审计、可被临床医生纠正的 agentic AI 用于甲状腺超声诊断与报告。论文目前处于审稿阶段（under review）。

papers.title: Supervised Mixed-Frequency Learning for Macro-Financial Forecasting When Factors are Weak
papers.abstract_en: Factor-MIDAS regressions forecast a low-frequency target by extracting common factors from a large panel of high-frequency predictors via principal component analysis (PCA). While PCA mitigates the curse of dimensionality, it relies on factor pervasiveness, an assumption often violated when factors are weak, as is common in macro-financial forecasting. We propose SsPCA-MIDAS, which integrates supervised scaled PCA (SsPCA) into the mixed-data sampling framework. We establish consistency and asymptotic normality under weak factors, permitting inference on the prediction target. Simulations show that SsPCA-MIDAS outperforms competing PCA-based and supervised methods, especially when weak factors are prevalent. Applying machine-learning techniques such as boosting to the cleaner factors it extracts yields further gains. An extensive application to U.S. macro-financial forecasting shows that SsPCA-MIDAS selects economically meaningful predictors and improves forecasts of GDP, inflation, unemployment, asset prices, and volatility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 SsPCA-MIDAS，将有监督的缩放主成分分析 (supervised scaled PCA, SsPCA) 集成到混合数据采样 (MIDAS) 框架中，用于因子较弱时的宏观金融预测。作者在弱因子条件下建立了预测目标的相合性和渐近正态性；模拟显示 SsPCA-MIDAS 优于基于 PCA 和监督的竞争方法。对美国宏观金融数据的应用表明，该方法能选择有经济意义的预测变量，并改进 GDP、通胀、失业率、资产价格和波动率的预测。
Motivation: 因子-MIDAS 回归通常用 PCA 从高频预测变量面板中提取共同因子以缓解维度灾难，但 PCA 依赖因子渗透性 (pervasiveness) 假设，而宏观金融预测中弱因子很常见，该假设常被违背。
Method: 将有监督的缩放 PCA (SsPCA) 引入 MIDAS 回归，形成 SsPCA-MIDAS；同时提出可将 boosting 等机器学习技术应用于其提取的更干净因子以进一步获得收益。
Result: 模拟显示在弱因子普遍存在时 SsPCA-MIDAS 优于基于 PCA 和监督的竞争方法；应用于美国宏观金融预测时，该方法改善了 GDP、通胀、失业率、资产价格和波动率的预测。
Conclusion: 摘要强调弱因子环境下结合监督缩放 PCA 与 MIDAS 既能对预测目标进行推断，又能提升宏观金融预测效果，并指出机器学习方法可叠加在提取的因子上获得额外提升。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DYSANOS Generative Dynamic Smooth Arbitrage-free Non-parametric Option Surfaces
papers.abstract_en: This article presents with DYSANOS the first generative market model for smooth SANOS option surfaces for all strikes and expiries which are free of static arbitrage. Our model is designed to generate entire paths of daily spot and option prices for years in the future. We present a robust and useful if somewhat simplistic baseline hidden state generative model in the form of an AR(1) model. We discuss model setup, data pipeline, and training and investigate numerical resence of dynamic arbitrage. We illustrate model performance on Option Metrics' IvyDB S\&P Index data from 2020 to~2025 and compare it to a pure implied-vol PCA model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DYSANOS，据称是首个能够生成对所有行权价和到期日都无静态套利 (static arbitrage) 的平滑 SANOS 期权曲面的生成式市场模型。该模型旨在生成未来数年每日现货与期权价格的完整路径，并以 AR(1) 模型作为简化的基准隐状态生成模型。文章在 OptionMetrics IvyDB 的 S&P 指数数据（2020 至 2025 年）上展示了模型表现，并与纯隐含波动率 PCA 模型进行了比较。
Motivation: 现有模型难以同时生成覆盖全部行权价与到期日、且无静态套利的光滑期权曲面，更缺乏能够对多年未来路径进行生成的生成式市场模型。
Method: 采用 DYSANOS 生成模型，并以 AR(1) 隐状态生成模型作为稳健但较为简化的基线；同时介绍了模型设定、数据管道和训练流程，并数值考察动态套利（dynamic arbitrage）情况。
Result: 在 Option Metrics IvyDB S&P 指数 2020 至 2025 年数据上展示了模型性能，并将其与纯隐含波动率 PCA 模型进行了比较；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为 DYSANOS 是可生成无静态套利平滑 SANOS 期权曲面的首个生成式市场模型，但所采用的 AR(1) 基线模型被明确描述为 somewhat simplistic，提示当前模型仍有简化之处。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reasoning Jury: Multi-Model Consensus for Evaluating Reasoning Traces
papers.abstract_en: Improving reasoning LLMs requires the ability to judge the quality of long reasoning traces for effective reasoning data curation, strong training signals during reinforcement learning, and an in-depth understanding of reasoning behaviors during model performance evaluation. Additionally, surfacing reasoning mistakes that the model makes would enable improving the model's performance at runtime through providing feedback. Due to the difficulty of this complex task on long reasoning traces, single-model judges (even frontier models) do not do well at identifying reasoning defects. Additionally, leveraging frontier models during online training of reasoning LLMs is generally prohibited due to guardrails in terms of use. In this work, we introduce Reasoning Jury, a system that replaces the single judge with a jury of LLMs and a moderated consensus mechanism, to improve the fidelity of judgments for identifying reasoning defects. In reasoning jury, defects of a reasoning trace and their severity are surfaced through a deliberation where a moderator conducts a discussion amongst the jury where the jurors critique each other's judgments and get to modify their initial votes. The moderator derives a consensus through deliberation amongst jurors or consolidation of judgements. We show that Reasoning Jury with a jury of open-weight models (e.g., gpt-oss-120b) is able to significantly outperform frontier models (opus-4.6, sonnet-4.6, and gemini-3.1-pro) at correctly identifying reasoning defects. Besides accuracy performance improvements, the aggregated cost of the jury (initial verdicts, deliberations, consolidation, etc.) is a fraction (8 to 15%) of the cost of running frontier models in LLM-as-a-judge setup. We also show how these judgements can be leveraged to understand failure modes of reasoning LLMs on benchmarks, which allows much deeper understanding of a model's performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Reasoning Jury，用一组开源 LLM 组成的陪审团加受调节的共识机制替代单一评判模型，对长推理轨迹中的推理缺陷进行识别。陪审员在主持人组织的讨论中互相批评判断并修改初始投票，最终由主持人形成共识或汇总判决。摘要报告称开源权重模型陪审团在识别推理缺陷上显著胜过前沿模型，且成本仅为后者的 8–15%。
Motivation: 改进推理 LLM 需要高质量评判长推理轨迹，但单一模型评判（即使是前沿模型）在长推理轨迹上难以识别推理缺陷；同时，在线训练推理 LLM 时通常因使用条款限制而无法使用前沿模型。
Method: 提出以多模型陪审团和受调节的共识机制取代单一评判器：推理缺陷及其严重程度通过 deliberation 呈现，主持人主持讨论，陪审员互相批评对方的判断并允许修改初始投票，最后由主持人通过讨论达成共识或对判决进行汇总。
Result: 摘要报告由开源权重模型（如 gpt-oss-120b）组成的陪审团在正确识别推理缺陷方面显著超越前沿模型（opus-4.6、sonnet-4.6、gemini-3.1-pro）；其聚合成本（初始判决、讨论、汇总等）仅为前沿模型 LLM-as-a-judge 设置的 8–15%。此外，这些判断可用于理解推理 LLM 在基准上的失败模式。
Conclusion: 作者认为多模型共识机制能提升推理轨迹缺陷判别的保真度，同时以远低于前沿模型的成本支持对推理缺陷的识别与失败模式分析。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Not All Nudges Land: Behavioral Controllability and Elaboration Quality in AI-Supported Journaling
papers.abstract_en: AI journaling tools can tailor prompts to a person's own sensed behavior, but it is unclear which behaviors respond to them. We analyzed 369 journal entries from an eight-week passive sensing study. An LLM labeled each entry as expressing an intention to change a behavior or not, and we measured follow-through against 26 sensor features with a 3-day before/after comparison. Responsiveness depended most on whether a behavior involves other people. Behaviors that depend on others improved in only 15 to 22% of cases, while behaviors a person can act on alone improved more often, up to 50 to 63%, though unevenly. How users wrote mattered less. No single text feature separated improved from unimproved entries; writing carried signal only within specific behaviors, most clearly for text messaging and for longer, more personal intention entries. The sample is small, so we treat these as exploratory patterns that point to where AI journaling nudges are most likely to work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析了一项为期八周的被动感知研究中 369 条日记条目，用 LLM 标注每条条目是否表达改变行为的意图，并对比 3 天前后 26 个传感器特征来衡量实际跟进情况。研究发现行为是否涉及他人是响应性的最主要因素：依赖他人的行为仅在 15% 到 22% 的案例中改善，而个人可独自执行的行为改善率更高，可达 50% 到 63% 但不均匀。文本特征整体上无法区分改善与未改善的条目，写作信号只在特定行为中（最明显是短信和更长、更个人化的意图条目）才出现。作者强调样本较小，因此将其视为探索性模式。
Motivation: AI 日志工具可以根据个人感知行为定制提示，但尚不清楚哪些行为会对这类提示产生响应，现有研究缺乏对行为层面的可控性分析。
Method: 基于八周被动感知研究的 369 条日记条目，使用 LLM 对条目是否表达行为改变意图进行标注，并利用 26 个传感器特征做 3 天前后对照，比较不同行为类型的跟进率。
Result: 依赖他人的行为改善率仅 15% 至 22%，而独立可执行行为改善率更高，达 50% 至 63% 但不均匀；单个文本特征无法区分改善与未改善的条目，写作信号仅在特定行为中显现，最明显的是短信行为以及更长、更个人化的意图条目。
Conclusion: 行为是否依赖他人在 AI 日志提示的响应性中起关键作用，文本写作质量的影响较小；由于样本规模有限，结果应视为探索性模式，用于指出 AI 日志提示最可能有效的方向。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Trie Automata for Constrained Decoding over Large Finite Sets
papers.abstract_en: Large language models increasingly need to generate structured outputs that conform to predefined schemas, with one common constraint being selection from a finite set of valid strings. Current constrained decoding systems handle this through general-purpose grammar compilation, which becomes prohibitively slow as the number of valid values grows into the thousands, a cardinality wall. We introduce the trie automaton, a specialized mechanism that exploits finite-set structure (shared prefixes, bounded depth, known cardinality) via Aho-Corasick multi-pattern matching to precompute per-node token masks. The trie achieves 7X faster per-step valid-token computation (0.65 us vs. 5.8 us) compared to XGrammar, one of the primary backends in vLLM and SGLang, and 2--6.5X faster compilation at K >= 300. Because precomputed masks enable a stateless serving path that bypasses the guided decoding pipeline, this advantage compounds in batch serving: end-to-end vLLM throughput reaches 219 req/s vs. XGrammar's 7.5 req/s at batch size 256 (29X). The 29X combines the algorithmic speedup with integration-path savings that only precomputed masks can unlock. Across seven tokenizer families (32K--262K vocabulary), the trie maintains sub-100ms compilation up to K = 10,000 and flat per-step cost regardless of set size, while guaranteeing 100% output validity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 trie automaton，一种针对有限字符串集合约束解码的专用机制，利用 Aho-Corasick 多模式匹配和有限集结构（共享前缀、有界深度、已知基数）预计算每 token 掩码。相比 XGrammar，逐 token 有效 token 计算快 7 倍（0.65 us vs. 5.8 us），编译在 K >= 300 时快 2–6.5 倍；在 vLLM 批处理吞吐上达到 219 req/s，而 XGrammar 为 7.5 req/s（29 倍），并保证 100% 输出有效性。
Motivation: 大语言模型生成符合预定义模式的结构化输出时，常需要从有限合法字符串集合中选取；现有基于通用文法编译的约束解码系统在合法值数量达到数千时变得极慢，即所谓的基数墙 (cardinality wall)。
Method: 引入 trie automaton，利用 Aho-Corasick 多模式匹配，针对有限集合的共享前缀、有界深度和已知基数等结构特征，预计算每个位置的 token 掩码；预计算掩码使服务路径无状态化，从而绕过引导解码管线。
Result: 摘要报告 trie 在逐 token 有效 token 计算上比 XGrammar 快 7 倍（0.65 us vs. 5.8 us），K >= 300 时编译快 2–6.5 倍；vLLM 端到端吞吐在 batch size 256 时达 219 req/s vs. 7.5 req/s（29 倍）；在七种 tokenizer family（32K–262K 词表）下，K 最大到 10,000 时编译保持在 100ms 内，逐 token 成本与集合大小无关，且保证 100% 输出有效性。

papers.title: Prof-K: Probabilistic One-Pass Filtering for Efficient Top-k Selection
papers.abstract_en: Top-k selection is a fundamental computational primitive with applications spanning databases, information retrieval, signal processing, and modern machine learning workloads, including sparse activations and attention pruning. As data sizes grow, existing approaches become inefficient: exact methods incur high memory and compute overhead, while approximate methods often rely on brittle heuristics that degrade under adversarial or heavy-tailed inputs. In this paper, we introduce Prof-K, a fast, scalable, and distribution-agnostic top-k algorithm with probabilistic correctness guarantees. Prof-K performs a single-pass filtering procedure: a small random sample estimates an adaptive threshold, the N input elements are streamed once into a compact buffer, and an exact top-k routine on this buffer recovers the true top-k elements with probability at least 1 - $ε$, where $ε$ > 0 is user specified. We derive high-probability guarantees for correctness and buffer size, together with an approximately optimal sample size that minimizes overhead as a function of N and k. Empirically, Prof-K achieves 1.5x-10x speedups over the highly optimized PyTorch topk and recent RadiK implementations, with the largest gains in the large-scale, small-to-moderate-k regime where prior methods struggle most. Unlike previous approaches, these guarantees hold independently of the input distribution, ensuring robustness to adversarial settings. By relaxing the recall target (e.g., recovering 95% of the true top-k values), Prof-K additionally provides a principled accuracy-speed trade-off. We further demonstrate its impact on training BatchTopK Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), where top-k selection constitutes a significant portion of the training cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Prof-K，一种面向 top-k 选择的单遍过滤算法，具备概率正确性保证。算法先用小随机样本估计自适应阈值，再将 N 个输入元素流式写入紧凑缓冲区，最后在缓冲区上运行精确 top-k 例程，以至少 1-ε 的概率恢复真实 top-k 元素。摘要报告其在 PyTorch topk 和 RadiK 基础上取得 1.5x-10x 加速，并展示了在 BatchTopK 稀疏自编码器训练中的应用。
Motivation: 随着数据规模增大，现有 top-k 方法越来越低效：精确方法带来高内存与计算开销，近似方法常依赖脆弱的启发式规则，在对抗性输入或重尾分布下表现退化。
Method: 提出分布无关 (distribution-agnostic) 的 top-k 算法 Prof-K，执行单遍过滤流程：小随机样本估计自适应阈值，输入元素一次性流入紧凑缓冲区，再对该缓冲区运行精确 top-k。作者推导了正确性与缓冲区大小的高概率保证，并给出关于 N 和 k 近似最优的样本大小；通过放宽召回目标还可提供有原则的精度-速度权衡。
Result: 实验显示 Prof-K 相比高度优化的 PyTorch topk 和近期 RadiK 实现取得 1.5x-10x 加速，最大收益出现在大规模、k 值较小或中等（small-to-moderate-k）的场景；正确性保证不依赖输入分布，并额外验证了其在 BatchTopK Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) 训练中的效果。
Conclusion: 作者强调与先前方法不同，Prof-K 的保证独立于输入分布，因而对对抗性设置具有鲁棒性；通过放松召回目标可以在精度与速度之间进行原则性权衡。

papers.title: Attribute-Conditioned Multimodal Slot Factorization for Controllable Fashion Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Fashion retrieval often requires satisfying multiple attributes at once, such as category, color, pattern, and demographic. Monolithic embeddings mix these signals into a single vector, making attribute-specific control difficult at retrieval time. Many existing semantic-ID methods provide discrete item codes, but these codes are typically optimized as item-level or residual addresses and do not expose named, independently controllable attribute slots. We introduce MM-slotgate, a multimodal slot encoder that factorizes Fashion-CLIP text and image embeddings into four named attribute slots. Each slot learns its own text-image gate, so visually grounded attributes such as color and pattern can rely more on image evidence, while taxonomy-oriented attributes such as category and demographic can remain more text-driven. On H&M, using a combined slot-similarity and slot-logit retrieval score, MM-slotgate achieves 0.7566 macro ConstraintSatisfied@10, outperforming equal-weight multimodal fusion (0.7142) and fCLIP text-only retrieval (0.4755). The largest gain is on color, which improves from 0.321 to 0.889 (+0.568 absolute), as the learned color gate assigns 57.4% weight to image evidence. The learned gates are interpretable without modality supervision: color is image-leaning, category is text-leaning, and pattern and demographic lie near the middle. The resulting slots also remain controllable: linear probes show no measured excess leakage beyond the label-correlation baseline, and quantized slot codes support targeted intervention, including a 15.3x lift for color. These results suggest that controllable fashion retrieval benefits from typed, attribute-conditioned multimodal slots rather than either a single global embedding or opaque item-level semantic IDs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MM-slotgate，一个将 Fashion-CLIP 文本与图像嵌入分解为四个具名属性槽（category, color, pattern, demographic）的多模态槽编码器。每个槽学习独立的文本-图像门控，使颜色、图案等视觉属性更依赖图像证据，类别、人群等分类属性更依赖文本。在 H&M 数据集上，结合槽相似度与槽 logit 检索得分，MM-slotgate 达到 0.7566 macro ConstraintSatisfied@10，优于等权多模态融合（0.7142）与 fCLIP 纯文本检索（0.4755）。
Motivation: 时尚检索常需同时满足类别、颜色、图案、人群等多个属性，而单体嵌入（monolithic embeddings）将这些信号混在一个向量中，导致检索时难以进行属性级控制；已有语义 ID 方法只提供条目级或残差地址，不暴露独立可控的具名属性槽。
Method: 提出 MM-slotgate 多模态槽编码器，将 Fashion-CLIP 的文本和图像嵌入分解为四个具名属性槽；每个槽学习自己的文本-图像门控，使视觉属性更多依赖图像证据、分类属性更多依赖文本。检索时使用组合的槽相似度加槽 logit 得分。
Result: 在 H&M 上达到 0.7566 macro ConstraintSatisfied@10，优于等权多模态融合（0.7142）和 fCLIP 纯文本检索（0.4755）；颜色属性从 0.321 提升到 0.889（+0.568），且学习到的颜色门给图像证据分配 57.4% 权重。线性探针显示没有超出标签相关基线的多余泄漏，量化槽码支持定向干预，颜色上实现 15.3 倍提升。
Conclusion: 可控时尚检索受益于带类型的、属性条件化的多模态槽，而非单一全局嵌入或不透明的条目级语义 ID。学习到的门控无需模态监督即可解释：颜色倾向图像、类别倾向文本、图案和人群居中。

papers.title: Scaling Automatic Research Agents via World Models
papers.abstract_en: Automating empirical research is a long-standing direction of AI. Recent automatic research (AutoResearch) agents bring this goal within reach, as modern LLMs show the capability to independently implement solutions and learn from the execution outcomes. Behind these gains, post-training (especially RL) plays a central role. In this paper, we identify a fundamental tension when scaling RL for these agents: the two components of every AutoResearch trajectory (agent generation and environment execution) scale in very different manners, since all generation shares compute through batching, while each execution occupies its exclusive sandbox and real machine time. As a result, the environment execution dominates the training cost and becomes the bottleneck as trajectories grow. To resolve this tension, we propose World Model RL (WMRL), which replaces environment execution with a world model to remove this bottleneck. Additionally, the world model can be imperfect, as its rewards are corrupted by bias and noise. Therefore, we further equip WMRL with two mitigations, Online Debiasing and Inverse-Variance Denoising, which offset the bias and suppress the noise respectively. Theoretically, we prove that both mitigations of WMRL strictly improve the convergence guarantee. Empirically, WMRL accelerates training by 3-4x on various tasks at different agent scales, while exceeding the performance of standard RL baselines. Moreover, our post-trained 4B and 9B agents outperform much larger open-weight agents of 48B and 120B on held-out benchmarks. Beyond AutoResearch, WMRL also transfers to post-training embodied VLA policies, which demonstrates the generalizability of our method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出自动科研（AutoResearch）智能体在扩展强化学习（RL）训练时存在根本矛盾：智能体生成可通过批处理共享算力，而环境执行需要独占沙盒和真实机器时间，导致执行成本成为训练瓶颈。作者提出 World Model RL（WMRL），用世界模型替代环境执行，并配套在线去偏（Online Debiasing）与逆方差去噪（Inverse-Variance Denoising）来抵消世界模型的奖励偏差与噪声。理论证明两种缓解措施严格改善收敛保证，实证显示 WMRL 在不同规模任务上加速训练 3-4 倍并超过标准 RL 基线，且后训练的 4B 和 9B 智能体在留出基准上超越 48B 和 120B 的更大开源模型，方法还可迁移到具身 VLA 策略的后训练。
Motivation: AutoResearch 智能体的 RL 训练中，环境执行占据独占沙盒和真实机器时间，随轨迹增长成为主导训练成本并构成瓶颈，而生成部分可通过批处理扩展，两者扩展方式不同导致张力。
Method: 提出 WMRL，用世界模型执行轨迹以移除环境执行瓶颈；针对世界模型不完美带来的奖励偏差和噪声，分别引入 Online Debiasing 与 Inverse-Variance Denoising 进行补偿，并从理论上证明其改善收敛保证。
Result: 摘要报告 WMRL 在多种任务和不同智能体规模下加速训练 3-4 倍并超过标准 RL 基线；后训练的 4B/9B 智能体在留出基准上胜过 48B/120B 的开源模型；该方法也能迁移到后训练具身 VLA 策略。
Conclusion: 摘要强调世界模型替代环境执行可解除 AutoResearch RL 训练的瓶颈，且通过偏差校正与噪声抑制能在不完美世界模型下保持有效；方法超出 AutoResearch 领域，展现了在具身 VLA 策略后训练上的泛化性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CAS: A Causal Attribution Score for Local and Global Explainable Artificial Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Predictive explanation methods attribute a model output; they do not, by themselves, attribute an intervention effect on the real-world outcome. We introduce the Causal Attribution Score (CAS), a compact score architecture for causal explanation. CAS starts from an identified interventional coalition game, allocates the joint intervention contrast with causal Shapley contributions, and converts those raw outcome-scale effects into Local CAS, Signed Local CAS, and two complementary Global CAS summaries. The innovation is not a new Shapley formula, but a local-to-global causal reporting layer with an explicit intervention target. In the known-truth benchmark, eight repeated primary-interaction simulations (n = 2,200 each, three actions) gave mean Local CAS MAE of 0.107 for coalition-aware CAS, compared with 0.173 for one-at-a-time normalisation and 0.213 for a global normalised absolute ATE vector. The paired advantage over one-at-a-time normalisation increased from -0.003 under additivity to 0.091 under strong interactions. On both empirical DoubleML datasets, 401(k) eligibility/net financial assets (n = 9,915) and Pennsylvania reemployment bonus/unemployment duration (n = 5,099), predictive SHAP/TreeSHAP rankings differed materially from Feature-CAS rankings of treatment-effect modifiers. In Pennsylvania, dep1 (exactly one dependent) moved from predictive global rank 13 to Feature-CAS rank 2 and was the leading local Feature-CAS modifier. These results isolate the added value of separating what predicts the outcome from what explains heterogeneity in an estimated causal effect.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出因果归因分数 (Causal Attribution Score, CAS)，一个用于局部与全局可解释人工智能的因果解释报告层。CAS 从一个已识别的干预合作博弈 (identified interventional coalition game) 出发，用因果 Shapley 贡献分配联合干预对比，并将原始结果尺度效应转换为 Local CAS、Signed Local CAS 和两个互补的 Global CAS 摘要。作者强调创新点不是新的 Shapley 公式，而是带有明确干预目标的局部到全局因果报告结构。
Motivation: 现有的预测性解释方法归因的是模型输出，而不是对现实世界结果的干预效应；这会造成预测重要性与因果效应异质性解释之间的混淆。需要一个显式干预目标下的局部到全局因果报告层来弥补这一缺口。
Method: CAS 的架构从已识别的干预合作博弈开始，使用因果 Shapley 贡献来分配联合干预对比，再将原始结果尺度的效应转换为局部因果分数、带符号局部因果分数以及两个互补的全局摘要，从而统一局部和全局的因果解释报告。

papers.title: StrAD: A Streaming Method and Benchmark for Audio Description Generation for Long-form Videos
papers.abstract_en: Visual content is the dominant medium of communication, yet without audio descriptions (ADs), it remains inaccessible to blind and low-vision people. ADs narrate context-relevant visual events during natural audio pauses. Manually creating ADs is expensive, limiting coverage to a small fraction of available content. Most existing automatic AD generation methods frame the task as video clip captioning, requiring ground-truth timestamps and additional context cues such as character databases. Current benchmarks reinforce this framing, consisting of short video segments paired with automatic or task-mismatched annotations. We introduce StrAD, a benchmark for long-form AD generation on full-length videos spanning diverse genres such as movies, documentaries, short films, performances, and video games. We reformulate AD generation as streaming dense video captioning. Our approach processes full-length videos with a sliding window, inserting ADs into existing transcripts without ground-truth timestamps, and supports both fine-tuned models and zero-shot prompting of vision-language models. On the segment-level task with given timestamps, our fine-tuned StrAD-FT sets the state of the art on CMD-AD with 36.3 CIDEr (+10.0 over Shot-by-shot), establishes a reference point on StrAD (51.0 CIDEr), and remains competitive on MAD-Eval at 24.9 CIDEr. On the full-video streaming task, StrAD-FT reaches a SODA score of 2.4 against 1.1 for our zero-shot baseline StrAD-Zero, though both exhibit limitations in temporal localization and narrative coherence. While prior work has tackled full-video AD generation in an offline, multi-stage fashion, ours is the first streaming approach, generating ADs on the fly without ground-truth timestamps. StrAD makes progress on full-video AD generation measurable, a prerequisite for scaling accessibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StrAD，一个面向长视频的音频描述 (audio description, AD) 生成基准，并将 AD 生成重新定义为流式密集视频描述 (streaming dense video captioning) 任务。方法用滑动窗口处理整段视频，无需真实时间戳即可将描述插入现有字幕，支持微调模型和视觉语言模型的零样本提示。在 CMD-AD 上，微调模型 StrAD-FT 达到 36.3 CIDEr，超出 Shot-by-shot 10.0 分，并在 StrAD 基准上建立 51.0 CIDEr 的参考点。
Motivation: 人工制作音频描述成本高昂，导致现有内容的覆盖极少；现有自动 AD 方法大多将任务当作视频片段字幕生成，依赖真实时间戳和额外上下文线索，已有基准也由短片段和不匹配的标注构成，难以衡量整段视频的 AD 生成能力。
Method: 将 AD 生成重构为流式密集视频描述任务，用滑动窗口处理完整视频，在没有真实时间戳的情况下把 AD 插入已有转录文本，同时支持微调模型 (StrAD-FT) 和零样本提示视觉语言模型 (StrAD-Zero)。
Result: 在给定时间戳的片段级任务上，StrAD-FT 在 CMD-AD 上取得 36.3 CIDEr 的新最优（较 Shot-by-shot 提升 10.0），在 StrAD 上建立 51.0 CIDEr 参考点，在 MAD-Eval 上为 24.9 CIDEr。完整视频流式任务中，StrAD-FT 的 SODA 分数为 2.4，显著高于零样本基线 StrAD-Zero 的 1.1，但两者在时间定位和叙事连贯性上均有不足。
Conclusion: 该工作首次提出流式全视频 AD 生成方法，无需真实时间戳，并使整段视频 AD 生成的进展可量化，这是扩展可访问性的前提。

papers.title: Analysis of Motor Signatures of Social Adaptation in Autism for Efficient Human-Centric Systems
papers.abstract_en: Dance imitation integrates motor planning, sensorimotor integration, and social cognition, offering a sensitive framework to characterize motor behavior in autism. In this work, we explore a computational analysis framework to identify potential biomarkers that allow the design and development of improved medical and human-machine systems. We analyzed 3D motion capture data from autistic and neurotypical adults performing dance imitation under solo and socially-framed duo conditions. Methodologically, using Dynamic Time Warping, we quantified movement consistency and propose the Social Context Sensitivity Index (SCSI) to measure modulation of variability by social framing. These features were then used on a classifier to discriminate subjects into autistic or neurotypical groups. Results show that neurotypical adults exhibited increased movement variability in socially-framed imitation, especially in upper and lower limbs, whereas autistic adults maintained consistent movement across contexts. Classification achieved 79.2% balanced accuracy in distinguishing groups. These findings suggest that social context sensitivity in motor imitation constitutes a robust biomarker of autism-related motor behavior, highlighting the importance of social modulation in motor assessments and informing the development of inclusive human-centric technologies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向自闭症谱系中的运动行为表征，用 3D 动作捕捉数据分析了自闭症与神经典型成年人在独舞与社交情境双人舞两种条件下的舞蹈模仿。作者用动态时间规整 (Dynamic Time Warping) 量化动作一致性，并提出社会情境敏感指数 (Social Context Sensitivity Index, SCSI) 以衡量社会框架对运动变异性的调节，最后用分类器区分两组人群。摘要报告分类达到 79.2% 的平衡准确率，并指出神经典型成人在社交框架下运动变异性增加（尤其上下肢），而自闭症成人跨情境保持稳定。
Motivation: 舞蹈模仿整合了运动计划、感觉运动整合与社会认知，为刻画自闭症运动行为提供了敏感框架；作者希望借此识别潜在生物标志物，以支持改进医疗系统与人机系统设计。
Method: 提出一套计算分析框架：在独舞和社交框架双人舞条件下采集 3D 动作捕捉数据，用 Dynamic Time Warping 量化动作一致性，提出 SCSI 度量社会框架对运动变异性的调制，随后将这些特征输入分类器以区分自闭症与神经典型成人。
Result: 神经典型成人在社交框架模仿中表现出更高的运动变异性（尤其在上下肢），而自闭症成人跨情境保持一致的运动模式；分类器区分两组人群的平衡准确率为 79.2%。
Conclusion: 摘要认为社会情境下的运动模仿敏感性可作为自闭症相关运动行为的稳健生物标志物，强调运动评估中社会调制的重要性，并为包容性人本技术 (human-centric technologies) 的开发提供依据。

papers.title: Surface-to-Skeleton 3D Cephalometry: Estimating Hidden Skeletal Landmarks from CT-Derived External Soft-Tissue Surfaces
papers.abstract_en: Existing 3D facial-landmark methods localize points on visible skin, but whether CT-defined internal skeletal landmarks can be inferred from external soft-tissue geometry remains unclear. We formulate a coordinate-consistent surface-to-skeleton task using same-acquisition CT-derived surfaces, separating estimation from optical-to-CT registration, scanner-domain, and acquisition-state effects, with coverage analyzed separately. From 240 clinical CT scans from two hospitals, we construct a locked retrospective protocol pairing CT-derived external soft-tissue point clouds with 21 skeletal landmarks and three visible soft-tissue landmarks. An integrated hierarchical point-cloud model achieves 2.97 mm mean radial error on skeletal landmarks and 3.03 mm on deep or surface-invisible landmarks in 40 held-out patients. Patient-mismatch controls support patient-specific signal beyond a fixed population configuration or global similarity alone, while coverage ablations indicate dependence on non-anterior geometry. Optical-transfer diagnostics reveal substantial coverage-related and global-configuration components, although deployable optical inference remains unresolved. These results answer the controlled feasibility question affirmatively and provide a basis for hidden skeletal landmark inference.
papers.comment: Accepted to AI4M3D Workshop at ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究能否从外部软组织表面推断CT定义的内部骨骼标志点，提出坐标一致的surface-to-skeleton任务，并使用同一CT扫描中导出的软组织点云与21个骨骼标志点配对。基于两家医院240例临床CT构建锁定回顾性协议，集成层次化点云模型在40例留出患者上对骨骼标志点达到2.97 mm平均径向误差，对深部或表面不可见标志点为3.03 mm。患者不匹配对照和覆盖消融支持存在个体特异信号，但可部署的光学推理仍未解决。
Motivation: 现有3D面部标志点方法定位的是可见皮肤上的点，而CT定义的内部骨骼标志点能否从外部软组织几何推断出来尚不明确；作者希望在一个受控条件下回答这一可行性问题。
Method: 使用同源CT导出的外部软组织点云与骨骼标志点构建坐标一致的surface-to-skeleton任务，将估计与光学到CT配准、扫描仪域和采集状态效应分离；提出集成层次化点云模型，并设置患者不匹配对照与覆盖消融实验。
Result: 在40例留出患者上，骨骼标志点平均径向误差2.97 mm，深部或表面不可见标志点为3.03 mm；患者不匹配对照表明存在超越固定群体配置或全局相似性的个体特异信号，覆盖消融显示对非前部几何的依赖。
Conclusion: 摘要认为受控可行性问题得到肯定回答，为隐藏骨骼标志点推断提供了基础；但光学传输诊断显示覆盖和全局配置成分显著，可部署的光学推断仍待解决。

papers.title: GENADA: efficient generative time series adversarial attack framework
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models are widely used for time series analysis in domains such as healthcare, finance, energy systems, and environmental monitoring. However, these models remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks, where small input perturbations cause severe degradation in predictive performance. Commonly used gradient-based attacks, iterative first-order methods, are computationally burdensome, as they repeatedly backpropagate through the victim model to compute input gradients during a number of iterative refinement steps. We propose a GENerative ADversarial Attack (GENADA) that learns a generative model to produce deceptive perturbations directly in a single forward pass and a procedure to train it. Variants include single-step and iterative generative attack schemes. The validation considers attacks on several neural models and datasets in the time-series domain, a controlled, low-dimensional setting. Empirically, GENADA achieves comparable attack quality to strong baselines while requiring less time to generate perturbations during inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GENADA，一个面向时间序列的高效生成式对抗攻击框架。它训练一个生成模型，在单次前向传播中直接产生欺骗性扰动，并提供单步与迭代两种攻击方案。在若干时间序列神经网络模型和数据集（受控低维设定）上的验证显示，GENADA 能达到与强基线相近的攻击质量，同时生成扰动所需推理时间更少。
Motivation: 深度学习模型在时间序列任务中易受对抗攻击，而常用的一阶梯度迭代攻击需要反复对受害模型反向传播计算输入梯度，计算负担重。
Method: 学习一个生成模型以单次前向传播直接生成对抗扰动，并配套训练流程；攻击方案包含单步和迭代两种生成式变体。
Result: 在多个时间序列神经网络模型和数据集（受控低维设定）上，GENADA 的攻击质量与强基线相当，但生成扰动的耗时更低。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架能以更低的推理成本实现与强基线相当的攻击质量；验证范围限于受控的低维时间序列设定。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 在多个时间序列神经网络模型和数据集（受控低维设定）上，GENADA 的攻击质量与强基线相当，但生成扰动的耗时更低。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调该框架能以更低的推理成本实现与强基线相当的攻击质量；验证范围限于受控的低维时间序列设定。

papers.title: MASCOT: Model-Aware Submodular Coverage for Composite-Attribute Text-to-Image Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are highly effective in retrieving semantically relevant images. However, in practice, relevance alone is often insufficient. Systems must also achieve Result Diversification (RD) across composite attributes such as geography and time, a task for which precise control remains challenging. Current re-ranking methods, such as Multi-Source Determinantal Point Processes (MS-DPP), address this using manifold-based repulsion over similarity representations. Although this strategy is effective for broad exploration, it exposes a key limitation in manifold-based models: when subjected to diversity-decrease tasks on discrete metadata, they suffer substantial degradation in early-rank recall. To bridge this gap, we introduce MASCOT (Model-Aware Submodular Coverage for Composite-Attribute Text-to-Image Retrieval). Instead of relying on manifold repulsion, MASCOT formulates multi-attribute diversity as a resource allocation problem, projecting attributes into a soft-binning space weighted by query-driven importance. Averaged across the three PixelProse diversity-decrease tasks, MASCOT preserves an early-rank recall (R@10) of 88.58%, while MS-DPP retains 67.63%. The margin widens under composite constraints: on PP_geo_hour, where temporal and geographic diversity must be suppressed simultaneously, MS-DPP's recall collapses from 0.9737 to 0.4931 and its top-ranked result degrades to R@1 = 0.23, while MASCOT holds R@10 = 0.9410 and R@1 = 0.7202 at a diversity metric above the unconstrained baseline. We do not claim uniform superiority: on aggregate diversity-relevance scores our own simpler ablations attain higher harmonic means on all three decrease tasks, and MASCOT's advantage is specific to recall beyond rank 1 under composite constraints.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at ACM Multimedia 2026 (MM '26), Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. Extended version with full appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MASCOT（Model-Aware Submodular Coverage），用于复合属性文本到图像检索中的结果多样性（Result Diversification）。与依赖流形排斥（manifold repulsion）的 MS-DPP 不同，MASCOT 将多属性多样性建模为资源分配问题，在软分箱空间中按查询驱动的重要性加权。在 PixelProse 的三个 diversity-decrease 任务上，MASCOT 平均保持 R@10 88.58%，而 MS-DPP 仅保留 67.63%。作者明确表示不宣称全面优势，其更简单的消融版本在聚合多样性-相关性得分上反而取得更高的调和均值。
Motivation: 实际检索中仅有相关性不够，还需要跨地理、时间等复合属性的结果多样化，但现有基于流形排斥的重排序方法（如 MS-DPP）在面对离散元数据上的多样性抑制任务时，早期排名召回率显著下降。
Method: MASCOT 放弃流形排斥，将多属性多样性重新表述为资源分配问题，把属性投影到由查询驱动重要性加权的软分箱空间，并采用模型感知的子模覆盖（submodular coverage）来平衡相关性与多样性。
Result: 在 PixelProse 三个 diversity-decrease 任务上，MASCOT 平均 R@10 为 88.58%，MS-DPP 为 67.63%。在 PP_geo_hour 复合约束下，MS-DPP 的召回从 0.9737 跌至 0.4931、R@1 降至 0.23；MASCOT 保持 R@10=0.9410、R@1=0.7202，且多样性指标高于无约束基线。摘要同时指出，其更简单的消融版本在所有三个下降任务上的聚合多样性-相关性调和均值更高。
Conclusion: MASCOT 的优势是特定场景的：在复合约束下、排名第 1 之后的召回保持上优于 MS-DPP；作者不声称在所有多样性-相关性聚合指标上全面领先。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SchemaLink: An Intelligent Web Editor for LinkML Schema Curation
papers.abstract_en: Motivation: LinkML is a suitable language for the representation of the structural and content constraints of different kinds of biomedical data. Even if it is a quite recent proposal, it has been applied in several biomedical contexts. Developing and maintaining LinkML schemas presents several challenges, particularly for novice curators. Non-expert bio-curators may struggle with LinkML syntax and best practices, requiring significant time and effort to develop well-structured schemas. Results: In this paper we propose SchemaLink, a web-based environment for the graphical construction and enhancement of LinkML schemas that address the following requirements: $(i)$ introduce a graphical language for the specification of LinkML schemas, $(ii)$ make uniform the specification of schemas in similar contexts, $(iii)$ simplify the design and curation processes by exploiting a RAG-based approach to assist curators in creating new schemas from scratch and editing already developed ones. Several experimental analyses show the quality of the produced LinkML schemas through the AI-based editing facilities. Availability and Implementation: SchemaLink is available online at: https://SchemaLink.biodata.di.unimi.it. SchemaLink code and testing data are available as open-source on GitHub at: https://github.com/AnacletoLAB/{schemalink-webapp,schemalink-api}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SchemaLink，一个基于 Web 的图形化环境，用于 LinkML 模式的构建与增强。它引入面向 LinkML 模式的图形化语言，通过基于 RAG 的编辑辅助来统一类似上下文中的模式规范，并简化新手策展人从零创建和编辑模式的过程。实验分析表明，AI 辅助编辑设施能产出质量良好的 LinkML 模式。
Motivation: LinkML 虽已用于多个生物医学场景，但开发与维护 LinkML 模式对非专家生物策展人存在较大挑战；他们难以掌握 LinkML 语法与最佳实践，构建结构良好的模式需要大量时间和精力。
Method: 实现一个 Web 环境 SchemaLink，满足三项需求：为 LinkML 模式规范引入图形化语言；使相近场景下的模式规范保持一致；利用基于 RAG（检索增强生成）的方法辅助策展人从零创建新模式和编辑已有模式。
Result: 多项实验分析表明，通过基于 AI 的编辑设施能够生成质量良好的 LinkML 模式；但摘要未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: SchemaLink 以图形化和 AI 辅助方式降低 LinkML 模式策展门槛，并以开源形式提供在线服务与代码。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: $\varepsilon$-MemEvo: Adaptive Cross-Task Memory Transfer for LLM Program Evolution
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based program evolution systems such as FunSearch and AlphaEvolve have shown strong ability to discover novel algorithms, but typically optimize each task in isolation, discarding search experience after completion. We introduce $\varepsilon$-MemEvo, a framework for cross-task knowledge transfer in LLM program evolution. $\varepsilon$-MemEvo stores prior experience as task-agnostic tactic memories: compact natural-language summaries of successful algorithmic strategies rather than raw code, enabling transfer across tasks with different APIs and evaluators. To avoid negative transfer from semantically mismatched memories, $\varepsilon$-MemEvo uses an adaptive injection gate that decides whether retrieved memories should be injected, and at what intensity. We evaluate $\varepsilon$-MemEvo on 8 diverse optimization benchmarks spanning mathematical optimization and systems engineering, using a content-level Leave-One-Out protocol that excludes target-task memory entries. On the primary GPT-5 backbone, $\varepsilon$-MemEvo improves AUCC over AdaEvolve on all 8 tasks, with a mean relative gain of +8.7%, and improves early-stage convergence by +9.4% on average. Ablations show that naive memory injection can fail catastrophically, while adaptive gating remains safe across all five ablation tasks. The data-updated posterior is interpretable in observed states: it favors skip during improving search and shifts from skip to hint across early and late plateaus. These gains incur less than 1% computational overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ε-MemEvo，一个用于 LLM 程序进化（program evolution）的跨任务知识迁移框架。它将先前搜索经验编码为任务无关的战术记忆（tactic memories），即成功算法策略的紧凑自然语言摘要，而非原始代码，从而可在 API 和评估器不同的任务间迁移。为了避免语义不匹配记忆带来的负迁移，框架引入自适应注入门（adaptive injection gate），决定检索到的记忆是否注入以及注入强度。在 8 个优化基准上，该方法相对 AdaEvolve 在所有任务上提升 AUCC，平均相对增益 +8.7%。
Motivation: 基于 LLM 的程序进化系统（如 FunSearch、AlphaEvolve）通常孤立地优化每个任务，搜索经验在任务完成后被丢弃；现有方法缺少跨任务的知识复用，限制了进化效率。
Method: ε-MemEvo 将历史搜索经验存储为任务无关的战术记忆（自然语言摘要而非代码），通过检索实现跨任务迁移；并设计自适应注入门，根据记忆与当前任务的语义匹配程度决定是否注入及注入强度，以规避负迁移。
Result: 在 8 个涵盖数学优化和系统工程任务的基准上，使用内容级留一（content-level Leave-One-Out）协议并排除目标任务记忆条目，ε-MemEvo 在 GPT-5 骨干上相较 AdaEvolve 在所有 8 个任务上提升 AUCC，平均相对增益 +8.7%，平均早期收敛改善 +9.4%；消融显示朴素记忆注入可能灾难性失败，而自适应门控在全部 5 个消融任务上保持安全，且计算开销低于 1%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调自适应注入门是安全跨任务迁移的关键，数据更新的后验在观测状态下可解释：在改进搜索中偏向跳过（skip），在早期和晚期平台期从跳过转向提示（hint）。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Can Vision-Language Models Assess Proxemic Risk from Egocentric Robot Images?
papers.abstract_en: Assessing proxemic danger from a robot's egocentric perspective is critical for safe embodied navigation in human environments and requires both visual and contextual reasoning. We evaluate three opensource vision-language models (VLMs) (\textit{InternVL}, \textit{Qwen-VL}, and \textit{SmolVLM}) on the classification of egocentric robot images into four danger levels, comparing three prompting strategies and two rounds of QLoRA fine-tuning against a stratified random baseline. Without fine-tuning, all models perform near the baseline, while fine-tuning yields only modest overall improvements. However, \textit{Qwen-VL} with an advanced prompt achieves substantially higher recall for high-danger cases than the other models. An analysis of person localization further shows that correct danger classification does not correspond to better spatial grounding, indicating that a model may produce a useful safety label without attending to the relevant region of the scene. These results show that current VLMs remain limited in fine-grained proxemic reasoning and spatial grounding, although targeted prompting and fine-tuning can improve high-danger detection in selected models.
papers.comment: Accepted at the EMR 2026 workshop at ECCV 2026 (non-archival)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估 InternVL、Qwen-VL 和 SmolVLM 三种开源视觉语言模型 (VLM) 在机器人自我中心图像上按四个危险等级进行近距离风险 (proxemic risk) 分类的能力，比较三种提示策略和两轮 QLoRA 微调，并以分层随机基线作对照。结果表明未微调时各模型接近基线，微调仅带来有限提升；但使用高级提示的 Qwen-VL 在高危险案例上召回率显著更高。对人物定位的分析显示正确的危险分类并不对应更好的空间定位，说明模型可能给出安全标签却未关注相关场景区域。
Motivation: 从机器人自我中心视角评估近距离危险对安全具身导航至关重要，需要视觉与上下文推理，而现有 VLM 在此细粒度任务上的能力尚不清楚。
Method: 在机器人自我中心图像的危险等级分类任务上，对三种开源 VLM 采用三种提示策略，并进行两轮 QLoRA 微调，同时与分层随机基线对比；另通过人物定位分析检验空间定位与危险分类的关系。
Result: 未微调时所有模型性能接近基线，微调后总体提升有限；Qwen-VL 搭配高级提示在高危险案例上取得比其他模型更高的召回率。人物定位分析显示正确分类与更好的空间定位不一致。
Conclusion: 当前 VLM 在细粒度近距离推理和空间定位上仍有限，但针对性的提示与微调可提升选定模型的高危险检测能力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Exploring Oversmoothing with Householder Matrices
papers.abstract_en: Deep graph neural networks(GNNs) suffer from oversmoothing- a progressive collapse of node representation towards a low information subspace as network depth increases because the normalized graph propagation operator is repeatedly applied directly to the hidden representations. In this work we study Householder Graph Neural Network (HouseGNN). Rather than updating the hidden state like standard GCN, HouseGNN uses the aggregated neighbourhood message solely to estimate a reflection direction; the node embedding is then updated by a Householder reflector followed by GroupSort, yielding a piecewise orthogonal layer that preserves Euclidean norm at every node and at every depth. We prove three core properties: (i) every internal layer preserves the node-wise Euclidean norm; (ii) the Householder reflector is scale scale and sign-invariant in the message; and (iii) pairwise distance between nodes can change through mismatch between node-wise orthogonal operators.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Householder 图神经网络 (HouseGNN)，用聚合邻域消息估计反射方向，再通过 Householder 反射器与 GroupSort 更新节点嵌入，构造分段正交层以缓解深层 GNN 的过平滑 (oversmoothing) 问题。摘要证明三个核心性质：每层保持节点欧氏范数、反射器对消息具有尺度与符号不变性、节点间距离可通过节点级正交算子的错配而改变。
Motivation: 深层图神经网络因重复直接应用归一化图传播算子到隐藏表示，导致节点表示随深度增加逐渐塌缩到低信息子空间，即过平滑问题，影响深层 GNN 的表达能力。
Method: HouseGNN 不直接以标准 GCN 方式更新隐状态，而是仅用聚合的邻域消息估计反射方向；节点嵌入通过 Householder 反射器后接 GroupSort 更新，形成在每一层和每一节点都保持欧氏范数的分段正交层。
Result: 摘要给出三个理论性质：(i) 每个内部层保持节点级欧氏范数；(ii) Householder 反射器对消息是尺度与符号不变的；(iii) 节点间距离可通过节点级正交算子之间的错配而改变。

papers.title: Fast Length-Squared Sampling for Positive-Semidefinite Matrices
papers.abstract_en: We describe a simple rejection-sampling-based algorithm to perform length-squared sampling on an $n \times n$ positive-semidefinite (psd) matrix: that is, to sample a column with probability proportional to its squared $\ell_2$-norm. The algorithm runs in just $O(n)$ expected time, which is significantly sublinear in the input matrix size. The runtime is optimal, even when the input is assumed to be diagonal. Our result has several applications. Length-squared sampling is used by a number of sublinear time algorithms for matrix problems, like low-rank approximation and eigenvalue approximation. Often, it is assumed that the algorithm is given access to the matrix column norms, and thus can perform length-squared sampling efficiently. Our result shows that, at least for psd matrices, we can remove this assumption. We also discuss an application to an asymptotically optimal algorithm for estimating the Frobenius norm of a psd matrix to relative error. Finally, we show that our sampling algorithm yields a very simple sublinear time algorithm for the robust psd low-rank approximation problem introduced by Bakshi et al. (FOCS, 2020), which nearly matches the more complex method developed there.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于拒绝采样 (rejection sampling) 的简单算法，对 n×n 正半定 (psd) 矩阵进行长度平方采样 (length-squared sampling)，即以正比于列平方 ℓ2 范数的概率采样某一列。算法期望运行时间为 O(n)，相对于输入矩阵规模是显著亚线性的，并且即使输入为对角矩阵时该运行时间也是最优的。该结果可移除许多亚线性时间矩阵算法中预先给定列范数的假设，并应用于 Frobenius 范数估计与鲁棒 psd 低秩近似。
Motivation: 长度平方采样是低秩近似、特征值近似等众多亚线性时间矩阵算法的关键子程序，但这些算法通常假设已能访问矩阵列范数，从而可高效采样。本文针对 psd 矩阵去除这一假设，目标是仅通过矩阵本身实现同样高效的采样。
Method: 描述了一个简单的拒绝采样算法：利用 psd 矩阵的结构对候选列进行采样并接受/拒绝，使得最终接受概率与列平方 ℓ2 范数成比例，且期望总运行时间仅为 O(n)。该算法无需预计算全部列范数。
Result: 摘要报告算法期望运行时间为 O(n)，并且即使输入被假定为对角矩阵时该运行时间仍然最优。应用上，它给出一个估计 psd 矩阵 Frobenius 范数至相对误差的渐近最优算法；同时为 Bakshi 等人 (FOCS, 2020) 提出的鲁棒 psd 低秩近似问题提供了一个极简单的亚线性时间算法，几乎匹配该文更复杂方法的性能。
Conclusion: 作者的核心结论是：对于 psd 矩阵，可以在亚线性时间内完成长度平方采样而无需预先知道列范数，从而简化依赖该采样的矩阵算法；摘要未强调明显局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: HIMEC: Directional Change Representation and Fixed-Interface Decoding for Remote Sensing Image Change Captioning
authors: Aysha Ashraf (University of Electronic Science and Technology of China)
Wafaa I. M. Hussin (University of Electronic Science and Technology of China)
Ali Haider (University of Electronic Science and Technology of China)
Zhi Lu (University of Electronic Science and Technology of China)
Zhenming Peng (University of Electronic Science and Technology of China)
papers.abstract_en: Remote sensing image change captioning (RSICC) converts bitemporal imagery into a sentence describing semantic changes. Most RSICC methods condition caption decoders directly on fused visual features, leaving intermediate change structure and decoder-interface consistency less studied. We present HIMEC, combining Directional Change Representation (DCR) with fixed-interface decoding. DCR separates signed differences into appearance-oriented, disappearance-oriented, and shared-context streams before fusion. A learned-query encoder converts the fused representation into visually conditioned change-query tokens that form the scene decoder's only sample-dependent memory. A training-only auxiliary phrase decoder supplies caption-derived supervision. With a fixed zero input, the scene decoder maintains the same interface during training and inference. Separately, we evaluate a local-to-scene cascade conditioned on teacher-forced local states during training and autoregressive states at inference. On changed LEVIR-CC validation pairs, these states have a mean cosine distance of 0.69. Regime-matched conditioning recovers most of the associated deficit, whereas permuting state correspondence causes no detectable penalty. These findings are limited to the evaluated cascade. In a matched three-seed comparison, HIMEC reaches a Consensus-based Image Description Evaluation (CIDEr) score of $142.81\pm0.60$ on LEVIR-CC, versus $139.51\pm3.40$ for direct fused-feature memory. On SECOND-CC, fixed-zero and regime-matched diagnostic conditioning reach 75.67 and 76.99 CIDEr, respectively, versus 60.77 for the mismatched cascade. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/ayshaashra/HIMEC upon publication.
papers.comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing (TGRS) for review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对遥感图像变化描述 (RSICC) 提出 HIMEC，将方向性变化表示 (Directional Change Representation, DCR) 与固定接口解码 (fixed-interface decoding) 相结合。DCR 将有符号差异分离为出现导向、消失导向和共享上下文三个流后再融合，并由学习查询编码器生成视觉条件化的 change-query 标记作为解码器唯一的样本依赖记忆。在 LEVIR-CC 上，HIMEC 的 CIDEr 达到 142.81±0.60，高于直接融合特征记忆的 139.51±3.40。
Motivation: 现有 RSICC 方法大多直接将融合视觉特征作为解码器条件，对中间变化结构和解码器接口一致性关注不足；本文旨在通过显式分离变化方向并保持训练/推理接口一致来改进描述质量。
Method: 方法包含两部分：DCR 将双时相差异按符号分成三个流并融合，再由 learned-query encoder 转化为 change-query 标记；解码时使用固定零输入，使场景解码器在训练和推理时保持相同接口，另设训练专用的辅助短语解码器提供来自描述的监督。此外还构造了 local-to-scene 级联，以诊断训练时 teacher-forced 状态与推理时自回归状态的不匹配效应。
Result: 三种子匹配实验下，HIMEC 在 LEVIR-CC 上达到 142.81±0.60 CIDEr，对照直接融合特征记忆为 139.51±3.40；在 SECOND-CC 上，固定零输入和 regime-matched 诊断条件分别达到 75.67 和 76.99 CIDEr，而不匹配级联仅为 60.77。变化区域的 local 状态在训练与推理间的平均余弦距离为 0.69。
Conclusion: 作者认为方向性变化表示配合固定接口解码能有效提升变化描述性能，并指出训练/推理条件匹配可恢复大部分不匹配带来的性能损失；但这些结论仅限于所评估的级联设置。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: When Can You Trust Offline Evaluation of Equal-Cost Top-k Allocation? A Controlled, Reproducible Benchmark and Practitioner's Guide
papers.abstract_en: Organizations decide whom to treat under a budget and want to know what a targeting rule would have earned before deploying it. Off-policy evaluation promises this from logged data, but the deployable rule is a deterministic top-k policy: it removes all averaging over actions, so weak overlap hits the estimate directly. We benchmark six estimators across five datasets and two known-effect sweeps, and validate the mechanisms against a non-simulated paired reference. First, weak overlap is governed by logger-target action alignment, not by logging sharpness alone: what governs support is the logger's probability of the target's actions. Sharpening a logger built from the target's own score barely moves overlap over the tested range; action-level disagreement collapses it. Effective sample size ranks this risk across logging environments, but is weak at ranking candidates within the single log a practitioner holds, and its cut point does not transfer. Second, the optimizer's curse is not fixed by cross-fitting the outcome nuisance. When the rule is fit on the data used to evaluate it, cross-fitting the nuisance alone leaves the reuse bias in place and makes it worse. Honest policy-level splitting avoids the reuse by targeting the learning procedure's value -- a change of estimand, not a de-biasing of the full-sample policy. Third, propensity-estimation error is the largest degradation we measure: an out-of-fold estimate hurts IPS more than any other stress we apply, leaves doubly-robust estimation almost unchanged, and can invert the overlap diagnostic itself. Logging is synthesized and propensities floored at 0.02, so every failure occurs with bounded weights; the floor also reduces the two tuned hybrids to their untuned parents, leaving four practically distinct estimators, and all exact-value surfaces are synthetic or semi-synthetic. We release the benchmark; public data only.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究离线评估（off-policy evaluation）在确定性 top-k 分配策略下的可靠性问题。作者在五个数据集和两个已知效应扫描上基准测试六种估计器，并用非模拟配对参考验证机制。主要发现：弱重叠由 logger 与目标动作对齐决定而非日志锐度；优化者诅咒不能通过交叉拟合结果 nuisance 解决；倾向性估计误差是最大的退化因素。基准已发布，仅公开数据。
Motivation: 组织需要在预算下决定治疗对象，并希望部署前知道目标规则能获得多少收益。离线评估承诺从日志数据做到这一点，但可部署规则是确定性 top-k 策略，它消除了对所有动作的平均化，弱重叠直接冲击估计。
Method: 基准测试六种估计器，跨五个数据集和两个已知效应扫描，并使用非模拟配对参考（paired reference）验证机制。还分析了有效样本量（effective sample size）、诚实策略级划分（honest policy-level splitting）和倾向性估计误差（propensity-estimation error）等机制。
Result: 弱重叠由 logger-目标动作对齐控制，而非日志锐度；从目标自身分数构建的 logger 锐化在测试范围内几乎不改变重叠，动作级分歧使其崩溃。有效样本量能排序风险但弱于单一日志内候选排序，截止点不可转移。交叉拟合 nuisance 不能修复优化者诅咒，反而使重用偏差更糟；诚实策略级划分通过改变估计目标避免重用。倾向性估计误差是最大退化：out-of-fold 估计对 IPS 伤害最大，对 doubly-robust 估计几乎不变，并可能反转重叠诊断。所有失败发生在有界权重下（propensities 下限 0.02）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调离线评估 top-k 策略时，重叠由动作对齐决定，需要改变估计目标（honest policy-level splitting）来解决重用偏差，且倾向性估计误差是主要威胁。基准已发布，仅公开数据。

papers.title: Learning Under Treatment-Induced Label Indeterminacy with Expert Annotations of Counterfactual Outcomes: A Case Study in Neurological Prognostication
papers.abstract_en: Clinical prediction models are often developed as if the outcome of interest were cleanly observed for every patient. This assumption fails when treatment decisions make the clinically relevant outcome permanently unobservable. As a case study of this problem, we consider post-cardiac-arrest neurological prognostication using a cohort of 2,497 patients, including 1,429 patients whose outcomes were rendered indeterminate by treatment decisions. These patients with indeterminate outcomes were reviewed by independent clinical experts, who provided their guesses of counterfactual outcomes about what would have happened to the patients. We refer to these patients as uncertain cases. We also have patients for whom we observe their clinically relevant outcomes; we refer to these patients as certain cases. We propose a framework for evaluating prediction models that explicitly splits the evaluation between certain and uncertain cases. Here, we cannot easily evaluate both types of cases in a uniform manner as the available target labels differ. We then propose a simple prediction model that uses target labels from both certain and uncertain cases in a manner that allows us to trade off between them. Across the proposed neural model and a collection of tabular baselines, models with similar certain-case AUROC can nevertheless differ substantially in both certain-case Brier score and their probability estimates for uncertain cases. Improving alignment with target labels of uncertain cases for our proposed model generally comes at the cost of worse accuracy on certain cases, highlighting an explicit tradeoff that standard evaluation conceals. These results show that when treatment decisions determine whether clinically meaningful outcomes remain observable, conventional evaluation metrics can miss important failure modes in the very patients for whom prognostic support matters most.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究治疗决策导致临床结局不可观测时的预测建模问题，以心脏骤停后神经预后预测为案例。数据包含 2,497 名患者，其中 1,429 名因治疗决策而结局不确定，由独立临床专家给出反事实结局的猜测（uncertain cases），其余患者有可观测结局（certain cases）。作者提出将评估明确拆分为 certain 与 uncertain 两类的框架，并给出一个能同时利用两类目标标签、允许在两者间权衡的简单预测模型。摘要发现，certain-case AUROC 相近的模型在 certain-case Brier score 和 uncertain cases 概率估计上可能差异很大，且提升与 uncertain 标签的对齐通常会牺牲 certain cases 的准确率。
Motivation: 临床预测模型通常假设每个患者的结局可被干净观测，但治疗决策会使临床相关结局永久不可观测，导致标准评估假设失效。作者以心脏骤停后神经预后预测为例，指出这类标签不确定（label indeterminacy）问题在预后支持最需要的患者中可能被常规评估指标掩盖。
Method: 提出一个显式区分 certain cases 与 uncertain cases 的模型评估框架，因为两类病例的目标标签形式不同，难以统一评估。同时提出一个简单预测模型，使用来自 certain 和 uncertain 两类病例的目标标签，并允许在两者之间进行权衡。
Result: 在 2,497 名患者的队列上，所提出的神经模型与若干表格基线中，certain-case AUROC 相近的模型在 certain-case Brier score 及 uncertain cases 的概率估计上仍可能显著不同。改善对 uncertain cases 目标标签的拟合通常以损害 certain cases 准确率为代价，显示出标准评估所隐藏的显式权衡。
Conclusion: 当治疗决策决定临床有意义结局是否可观测时，常规评估指标可能遗漏预后支持最相关患者群体的重要失败模式，评估应同时覆盖确定与不确定两类病例。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Governed Persistent Memory: Source-Bound State Semantics and Fail-Closed Release for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-term agent memory is usually treated as select--store--retrieve, but retrieval does not decide whether contradictory, superseded, retracted, deleted, or stale records may support an outgoing claim. We introduce Governed Persistent Memory (GPM), an auditable bitemporal state-transition model with source-bound admission, derived lifecycle state, current public barriers, and fail-closed structured release. Five executable clauses cover ledger integrity, source binding, conflict isolation, non-revival after retraction or deletion, and exact claim closure over a fresh view at one verified head. On a prespecified hash-frozen 3,600-case GPM-ReleaseBench, GPM matches all complete outcomes; the strongest of three intentionally simple complete policies matches 1,800/3,600 and makes unmatched releases on 50% of violation cases. A separate sealed end-to-end service evaluation exercises real ingestion and release across eight query families. In its publicly disclosed V3 arm, the governed lane is correct on 2,400/2,400 clusters versus 600/2,400 for ungoverned local Qwen2.5-7B; it repairs all 1,800 baseline failures with no regression (one-sided 95% lower bounds 99.875% and 99.834%). A later V5 reseal over Chinese- and English-command arms, with generation-date pinning and no post-freeze reducer amendment, again obtains 2,400/2,400 per arm. A production-code-independent finite model explores 331,776 semantic and 1,990,656 query states without a full-contract counterexample, and a 100,000-trace three-engine differential yields zero mismatches. These are bounded contract and implementation results, not open-world model accuracy or evidence of world truth. Governed answers in the sealed service evaluation are deterministic service outputs; the 7B result is the ungoverned comparison, not a claim that a language model itself became perfectly accurate.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 2 figures, 11 tables. Includes a sealed end-to-end governed-memory service evaluation with an ungoverned local Qwen2.5-7B comparison
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Governed Persistent Memory (GPM)，一个可审计的双时态状态转换模型 (bitemporal state-transition model)，为长时程智能体 (long-horizon agents) 的持久记忆引入 source-bound 准入、派生生命周期状态、当前公共屏障 (current public barriers) 与 fail-closed 结构化发布。摘要报告在预散列冻结的 GPM-ReleaseBench 上匹配全部完整结果，并在密封端到端服务评估中 governed lane 达到 2400/2400，而未受治理的本地 Qwen2.5-7B 仅为 600/2400。作者明确限定这些为有界契约与实现结果，而非开放世界模型精度或世界真实性的证据。
Motivation: 长期智能体记忆通常被当作 select-store-retrieve 处理，但检索本身并不决定相互矛盾的、被取代的、被撤回的、被删除的或过时的记录是否可能支撑一个对外声明，这一缺口可能导致智能体基于无效状态发布声明。
Method: 提出 GPM，一种带 source-bound 准入和派生生命周期状态的 bitemporal 模型，由五个可执行子句覆盖：账本完整性、源绑定、冲突隔离、撤回或删除后不可复活 (non-revival)、以及在单一已验证头部上对 fresh view 进行精确声明闭合 (exact claim closure)，并配套 fail-closed 结构化发布机制。
Result: 在 3,600 例 GPM-ReleaseBench 上 GPM 匹配所有完整结果，三种简单完整策略中最强者匹配 1,800/3,600 并在 50% 违规案例上产生未匹配发布；密封 V3 臂中 governed lane 在 2,400/2,400 聚类上正确，对比 ungoverned Qwen2.5-7B 的 600/2,400，修复全部 1,800 个基线失败且无回归（单侧 95% 下界 99.875% 与 99.834%）。生产代码无关的有限模型探索 331,776 个语义状态与 1,990,656 个查询状态未见全契约反例，100,000 迹三引擎差分得到零不匹配。
Conclusion: 作者强调这些是受边界约束的契约与实现验证结果，不构成开放世界准确率或世界真实性的证据；密封评估中的 governed 答案是确定性服务输出，7B 结果仅作为未受治理的对比，而非声称语言模型本身达到完美准确。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Don't Cut Corners: How Training Outside the Prior Makes Simulation-Based Inference More Robust
papers.abstract_en: Large astrophysical simulation campaigns often generate training data by sampling parameters across a Uniform prior box. Due to the proposal's sharp edge, neural posterior estimators struggle to learn accurate approximations near the boundaries. We propose Tailed-Uniform, a family of hybrid proposal distributions for sampling training simulations for robust simulation-based inference. By padding the original hard-truncated training box with decaying tails, Tailed-Uniform-trained networks yield more accurate posteriors near and beyond the edges. We demonstrate these improvements on a family of tail shapes, including a widened Uniform box as a control. Our results suggest that additional simulations near the prior boundary better constrain the networks as it approaches the edge of the training box, even for Uniform assumed priors. We show these advantages on a toy problem and cosmological parameter inference from the matter power spectrum. These benefits increase in high dimensions, where boundaries dominate parameter space volume.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 10 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to PRX Intelligence
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型天体物理模拟中常用的均匀先验盒子采样在边界处导致神经后验估计器学习不准确的问题，提出 Tailed-Uniform 混合提议分布族。通过在硬截断的训练盒子外添加衰减尾部，该方法改善了边界附近及边界外的后验估计。作者在玩具问题和基于物质功率谱的宇宙学参数推断上验证了改进，并指出在高维空间中收益更大。
Motivation: 大型天体物理模拟通常从一个均匀先验盒子中采样参数生成训练数据，但由于该提议分布的锐利边缘，神经后验估计器难以在边界附近学习准确的近似，从而影响基于模拟的推断（simulation-based inference）的鲁棒性。
Method: 提出 Tailed-Uniform，一族混合提议分布，用于为训练模拟抽样。其核心是对原始的硬截断训练盒子进行填充，附加衰减尾部，使网络在接近训练边界时获得更好的约束。实验考虑了多种尾部形状，并以拓宽的均匀盒子作为对照。
Result: 在玩具问题和物质功率谱的宇宙学参数推断上，Tailed-Uniform 训练的网络的到了更准确的后验。结果表明，即使假设先验为均匀分布，在边界附近增加额外模拟也能更好地约束网络，并且这种收益在高维空间中增大，因为高维中边界占参数空间体积的比例更高。
Conclusion: 作者认为，训练盒子边界附近的额外模拟样本能够显著改善网络在边缘处的后验准确性，且该改进在高维场景下更为明显。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Exemplar-based objective classification of gust-induced loads across multiple flight conditions
papers.abstract_en: Is it possible to find an objective classification criterion that organizes the complexity of gust-induced loads across many flight conditions? And one that remains as interpretable as a labelling based on coarse parameters, such as the flight attitude? Our approach encodes a large number of experimental observations through a machine-learned representation and applies a summarization procedure to select a minimal subset of highly significant exemplars. The exemplars provide a similarity-based objective classification criterion of all the observations, they can be more conveniently inspected by experts and can become subject of more refined experiments. We demonstrate the approach on a database of 3480 pressure-load measurements induced by random gusts on a flying-wing model across six flight attitudes. We find nine fundamental response types that recur across multiple attitudes; analysis of a type's transient response enables physical intuition into the underlying fluid mechanics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将阵风引起的载荷分类问题表述为基于样本的客观分类：先用机器学习表示对大量实验观测编码，再用摘要(summarization)过程选出少量高显著性的典型样本(exemplars)，以相似性标准对所有观测分类。在包含 3480 次随机阵风压力载荷测量、覆盖六个飞行姿态的飞翼模型数据库上，作者得到九种跨姿态重复出现的基本响应类型。作者认为这些典型样本便于专家检查并可用于更精细的实验设计。
Motivation: 现有基于飞行姿态等粗参数的标签方式会给阵风载荷分类带来主观性，且难以跨飞行条件组织复杂度；作者希望找到既客观又保持可解释性的分类准则。
Method: 方法分两步：通过机器学习表示编码实验观测，再对表示应用汇总(summarization)程序选取最小的高显著典型样本子集；这些典型样本构成基于相似性的客观分类判据。
Result: 在 3480 条随机阵风诱导压力载荷测量（六个飞行姿态）的飞翼模型数据库上，方法识别出九种跨姿态重复出现的基本响应类型。摘要还指出，分析某类型的瞬态响应可为底层流体力学提供物理直觉。
Conclusion: 摘要将典型样本筛选作为一类客观且可检查的分类工具，并与基于飞行姿态的标签保持可解释性；其验证范围限于飞翼模型的阵风载荷数据。
Relevance: 5
