papers.title: Geometric and Behavioral Stratification in Transformer Residual Streams
papers.abstract_en: Trained transformer models develop privileged bases: coordinate axes whose statistics differ from the rest of the residual stream. But what kind of direction does such a basis select? We investigate the prediction direction, the unembedding direction of the token a model currently predicts, and find that it functions as a content-defined privileged anchor. Measured with respect to this anchor, residual-stream variation is geometrically and behaviorally stratified by proximity to the prediction. The stratification holds in all eighteen models tested (dense and mixture-of-experts, 7B-120B, base and instruction-tuned). A narrow, scale-invariant prediction interface concentrates readout-relevant structure, while the vast prediction-distal complement expands with model scale. Because the prediction direction sits nearly orthogonal to the principal variance axes, variance-based analyses recover this organization only partly, and the shortfall grows with prompt heterogeneity. Anchoring reveals a steep geometric gradient: prediction-proximal regions are highly structured and cluster related prompts, while the complement is flatter and anti-discriminates among prompt groups. The interface is a narrow slice but functionally decisive. Disrupting the variance directions closest to the prediction causes immediate divergence and frequent task-frame shifts; disrupting the next level down delays divergence and preserves framing. The complement is weakly readout-aligned per direction yet causally and temporally load-bearing, and behavior is driven by direction rather than magnitude. These results establish the prediction direction as a privileged anchor distinct from previously described coordinate axes, and give a geometric account of how high-dimensional computation coexists with linear readout.
papers.comment: 63 pages, 10 figures, 15 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/nelsonguda/pdsf-residual-geometry
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究Transformer残差流中的特权基（privileged bases），提出预测方向（prediction direction）——即模型当前预测token的unembedding方向——作为内容定义的特权锚点。作者在18个模型（稠密与MoE，7B-120B，基座与指令微调）中发现，残差流变异按与该预测方向的接近程度呈几何与行为分层：窄而尺度不变的预测接口集中了读出相关结构，而广阔的预测远端补充随模型规模扩大。由于预测方向几乎正交于主方差轴，基于方差的分析只能部分恢复这一组织。
Motivation: 已有工作发现Transformer会形成坐标轴统计异于其余残差流的特权基，但不清楚这类基选择的是何种几何方向。作者希望刻画预测方向这一特定的特权锚点，并解释高维计算如何与线性读出（linear readout）共存。
Method: 以模型当前预测token的unembedding方向为锚，测量残差流变异相对该锚的接近度，检验其几何与行为分层；随后扰动最接近预测的方差方向、次一层方向以及远端方向，观察预测发散与任务框架切换的时序，以判定各层的因果作用。
Result: 分层在全部18个测试模型中成立。预测方向几乎正交于主方差轴，因此方差类分析只能部分恢复该组织，且缺口随提示异质性增大而扩大。预测近端区域高度结构化并聚类相关提示，远端更平坦且对提示组反判别（anti-discriminates）。扰动最接近预测的方差方向立即导致发散与任务框架切换，扰动次一层则延迟发散并保持框架；远端各方向虽弱对齐读出，但因果和时间上承重，且行为由方向而非幅值驱动。
Conclusion: 摘要将预测方向确立为区别于此前描述的坐标轴的特权锚，并给出高维计算与线性读出共存的一种几何解释。研究限于残差流几何与因果扰动分析，未涉及训练方法或下游任务改进。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Personalized Scorer Modeling: A Learning-Based Framework for Deriving Robust Sleep Stage Labels from Multiple Experts
papers.abstract_en: Sleep stage classification is important for the diagnosis and management of sleep disorders, yet most automatic staging studies evaluate models against a single reference hypnogram despite known inter-scorer variability. This study investigates whether multi-scored datasets can be used to construct more reliable reference labels from the collective behavior of multiple experts. We use the publicly available DOD-H and DOD-O datasets. EEG (C3-M2) and chin EMG signals were segmented into 30-s epochs, and 30 features were extracted from each modality, yielding 60 features for EEG+EMG. We propose a learning-based hypnogram (LBH) that models the stage-specific behavior of each scorer using confusion matrices derived from machine-learning models. After column normalization, these matrices estimate the probability of each true sleep stage given each scorer's label; probabilities are aggregated across scorers to assign the final label for each epoch. LBH was evaluated with random forest, support vector machine, and multilayer perceptron classifiers under EEG-only and EEG+EMG settings, and compared with the dataset hypnogram (DH) and best-scorer hypnogram (BSH). LBH consistently improved overall performance. The best results were obtained with random forest and EEG+EMG, reaching 86.07% accuracy, 85.46% precision, and 85.29% F1-score on DOD-H, and 86.04% accuracy, 85.21% precision, and 84.70% F1-score on DOD-O. These findings suggest that personalized scorer modeling can improve reference hypnogram construction without discarding information from individual experts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对睡眠分期中已知的评分者间差异 (inter-scorer variability) 问题，提出一种基于学习的 hypnogram 构建框架 LBH (learning-based hypnogram)，利用多评分者数据集生成更可靠的参考标签。方法在 DOD-H 和 DOD-O 公开数据集上，以 EEG (C3-M2) 与 chin EMG 的 30 秒片段和 60 维特征进行评估，并与数据集 hypnogram (DH) 及最佳评分者 hypnogram (BSH) 对比。最佳配置为随机森林配合 EEG+EMG，在 DOD-H 上达到 86.07% 准确率、85.46% 精确率和 85.29% F1-score，在 DOD-O 上达到 86.04% 准确率、85.21% 精确率和 84.70% F1-score。
Motivation: 大多数自动睡眠分期研究只针对单一参考 hypnogram 评估模型，而评分者间的已知差异会削弱参考标签的可靠性；作者试图利用多评分数据集，从多个专家的集体行为中构造更可靠的参考标签。
Method: 提出 LBH 框架：先用机器学习模型为每个评分者构建混淆矩阵，经列归一化后估计在给定评分者标签下各真实睡眠阶段的概率，再将各评分者的概率聚合以确定每个 epoch 的最终标签。评估中使用随机森林、支持向量机和多层感知机三种分类器，分别在仅 EEG 与 EEG+EMG 两种设置下比较 DH、BSH 和 LBH。
Result: LBH 在所有设置下均一致提升整体性能；最佳结果来自随机森林与 EEG+EMG 组合，DOD-H 和 DOD-O 上的准确率分别为 86.07% 和 86.04%，F1-score 分别为 85.29% 和 84.70%。
Conclusion: 作者认为个性化评分者建模 (personalized scorer modeling) 可以在不丢弃单个专家信息的前提下改进参考 hypnogram 的构建质量。

papers.title: Non-Degenerate Risk Certification for Automated Security Decisions: A Decision-Contract Theory with ATT\&CK-Aligned Triage as a Worked Instance
papers.abstract_en: An unconditional risk bound on automated decisions can be satisfied without automating anything, since a selector that never acts drives the bound to zero. We show this is structural: any risk certificate is defined over a decision contract, the inputs a system acts on plus the semantic relation under which an output counts correct, and weakening either hides base-classifier error. We develop a decision-contract theory: an error-conservation law showing error is only reassigned among harmful automation, human deferral, and semantic masking; a label-free singleton capacity certifying structural incapacity, with a risk-feasible refinement separating recoverable threshold misalignment from risk-constrained incapacity; and a non-degenerate actionability certificate excluding all-abstain solutions by construction. We instantiate this on ATT\&CK-aligned alert triage for LLM-based intrusion detection, the setting that exposed the vacuity failure. Across 3 IDS datasets, 6 LLMs, and 4 error-rate thresholds, empirical false-attribution risk stays at or below target in 90.3% of configurations, with 83.4% mean correct automation. The capacity diagnostic explains every low-utility configuration; its refinement separates genuine misalignment from risk-constrained incapacity, confirmed by an exhibited alternative threshold; a training-stability re-run finds no confirmed structural-incapacity instance; and real fine-grained attack-subtype labels confirm the coarsening-transfer identity under a genuine many-to-one map, with small but non-zero masking mass.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出决策契约理论 (decision-contract theory)，指出无条件风险界可以被“永不动作的选择器”平凡满足，因此任何风险证书必须显式定义系统作用输入的集合与判定正确的语义关系。作者建立误差守恒律、无标签单元容量证书和非退化可行动性证书，并在 ATT&CK 对齐的 LLM 入侵检测告警分流上实例化；在 3 个 IDS 数据集、6 个 LLM 和 4 个错误率阈值下，90.3% 的配置中经验虚假归因风险达标，平均正确自动化率为 83.4%。
Motivation: 现有自动化决策的无条件风险界存在空洞性：一个从不行动的选择器即可把风险界压到零，且任何风险证书都依赖决策契约（输入集合与语义关系），弱化任一会掩盖基分类器错误。需要一种能排除全弃权 (all-abstain) 解、并识别结构性无能力的非退化证书。
Method: 发展决策契约理论：提出误差守恒律，说明误差只在有害自动化、人工延迟和语义掩蔽之间重新分配；给出无标签单元容量 (label-free singleton capacity) 以证明结构性无能力，并用风险可行细化 (risk-feasible refinement) 区分可恢复的阈值错位与受风险约束的无能力；构造非退化可行动性证书，从构造上排除全弃权方案，并在 ATT&CK 对齐的 LLM 入侵检测告警分流上实例化。
Result: 在 3 个 IDS 数据集、6 个 LLM、4 个错误率阈值下，90.3% 的配置中经验虚假归因风险达到或低于目标，平均正确自动化率 83.4%；容量诊断解释了所有低效用配置，训练稳定性重跑未发现确认的结构性无能力实例；真实细粒度攻击子类型标签验证了多对一映射下的粗化转移恒等式，掩蔽质量小但非零。
Conclusion: 摘要强调风险证书必然依附于决策契约，弱化输入或语义关系会隐藏基分类器错误；该理论通过误差守恒与容量诊断将低效用配置区分为可恢复的阈值错位和受风险约束的无能力，并提供排除全弃权解的非退化证书。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: SSPO: Structure-Aware Similarity-Weighted Preference Optimization for Neural Combinatorial Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Neural combinatorial optimization (NCO) relies on parallel solution sampling for training, yet existing methods fail to fully exploit the rich information latent in a co-sampled solution group. Preference-optimization methods anchor on the single best solution and discard fine-grained quality and structural signal from all other peers-a failure we term gradient signal polarization. Mean-based baselines instead weight peers uniformly, so structurally near-identical peers flood the baseline with redundant information and keep gradient variance high-a failure we term baseline redundancy. We propose SSPO (Structure-Aware Similarity-Weighted Preference Optimization), which scores all $B$ sampled solutions jointly through a dissimilarity-weighted leave-one-out baseline: structurally distinct peers receive higher weight, resolving both failures in a single mechanism. The baseline uses zero-parameter, problem-adaptive solution embeddings built from the encoder's existing node representations. Experiments on TSP, EFL, and JSP benchmarks show consistent gains over prior best-anchor and uniform-weight baselines. A direct comparison against uniform RLOO on TSP and EFL confirms that structure-aware weighting is the primary driver of improvement. The SSPO-trained EFL policy has been deployed in a production facility-location system at JD$\mathord{.}$com, confirming practical viability at scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SSPO（Structure-Aware Similarity-Weighted Preference Optimization），面向神经组合优化（NCO）的强化学习训练。针对同一批次采样解组中质量与结构信息未被充分利用的问题，SSPO 通过不相似度加权的留一基线（dissimilarity-weighted leave-one-out baseline）对所有 B 个采样解联合打分，使结构差异大的解获得更高权重。实验在 TSP、EFL 和 JSP 基准上相对最佳锚点基线与均匀权重基线取得一致提升，且 SSPO 训练的 EFL 策略已部署于京东的设施选址系统中。
Motivation: 现有 NCO 训练方法未能充分利用同批采样解组中的丰富信息：偏好优化方法只锚定单个最优解，丢弃其他同批次解的质量与结构信号（称为梯度信号极化）；基于均值的方法对同伴均匀加权，导致结构近似的解向基线注入冗余信息并保持高梯度方差（称为基线冗余）。
Method: SSPO 使用不相似度加权留一基线，联合评估全部 B 个采样解：结构上差异越大的解权重越高，从而在一个机制中同时缓解两个失效模式。基线采用零参数、问题自适应的解嵌入（solution embeddings），由编码器已有的节点表示构建。
Result: 在 TSP、EFL 和 JSP 基准上，SSPO 相对此前最佳锚点基线与均匀权重基线均取得一致改进；与 TSP 和 EFL 上的均匀 RLOO 直接对比表明，结构感知加权是提升的主要来源。SSPO 训练的 EFL 策略已部署于京东的生产级设施选址系统，验证了规模化实用性。
Conclusion: 作者认为结构感知加权能够统一解决 NCO 训练中的梯度信号极化与基线冗余问题；结论基于 TSP、EFL、JSP 的实验及 EFL 的实际部署。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MV2: Multi-View Multi-Vehicle Driving Dataset for Novel View Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Differentiable rendering has advanced novel view synthesis (NVS), yet applying it to real-world driving remains difficult due to sparse capture viewpoints, dynamic objects, and limited multi-trajectory data. We introduce the Multi-View Multi-Vehicle (MV2) dataset and benchmark for evaluating NVS models under large viewpoint changes in dynamic urban scenes. MV2 features synchronized captures from a car, scooter, and drone, each following distinct yet synchronized trajectories. Training NVS methods on one vehicle's camera stream and testing on another enables evaluation under substantially larger viewpoint variations than existing single-trajectory datasets. All sequences are registered via Structure-from-Motion and camera poses verified using manual pixel-level correspondence annotations, yielding 50 high-quality scenes with 12000 images. Benchmarking recent NVS and camera pose estimation methods shows that NVS performance degrades with increasing viewpoint disparity, and that feed-forward pose estimators notably lag behind optimization-based approaches, highlighting MV2 as a rigorous testbed for NVS in driving. The dataset, benchmark protocol, and project resources are available at https://mv2-dataset.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出名为 MV2 的多视角多车辆驾驶数据集与基准，用于评估动态城市场景中大幅视角变化下的新视图合成 (NVS)。数据集包含汽车、踏板车和无人机同步采集的 50 个高质量场景、共 12000 张图像，所有序列均通过 Structure-from-Motion 注册，并用人工像素级对应标注验证相机位姿。基准测试表明 NVS 性能随视角差异增大而下降，且前馈位姿估计器明显落后于基于优化的方法。
Motivation: 可微渲染推动了新视图合成的发展，但真实驾驶场景因采集视角稀疏、物体动态以及多轨迹数据有限而难以应用 NVS，现有单轨迹数据集不足以评估大视角变化下的模型表现。
Method: 构建 MV2 数据集与基准：从汽车、踏板车和无人机三条同步但不同的轨迹采集数据，用一辆车的相机流训练 NVS 方法、在另一辆车的流上测试；基于 Structure-from-Motion 配准序列，并用人工像素级对应标注验证相机位姿。
Result: 基准测试显示 NVS 性能随视角差异增大而下降，前馈位姿估计器显著落后于基于优化的方法，说明 MV2 是驾驶场景 NVS 的严格测试平台。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 MV2 作为评估大视角变化下动态驾驶场景 NVS 的基准的价值，并公开数据集、基准协议与项目资源。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Dual Spatial-Temporal Attribution: Architecture-Aligned Post-Hoc Explainability for Recurrent Graph Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning detectors for anomalies in dynamic graphs have reached strong accuracy, yet they remain opaque: when an edge is flagged, the analyst receives a score but no reason. This opacity is untenable in the cooperative, regulated information systems where such detectors are deployed, where automated decisions must be auditable and trustworthy. We address this gap for AddGraph, the foundational GCN+GRU framework for edge-level anomaly detection in dynamic graphs, which to our knowledge has never been equipped with any form of explainability. We present a strictly post-hoc explainability framework, X-AddGraph, built on a Dual Spatial-Temporal Attribution (DSTA) mechanism whose three components are each aligned with one of AddGraph's architectural modules: a gradient-based relevance attribution over the current adjacency structure (spatial), a direct reading of the contextual attention weights already computed during inference (short-term temporal, at zero additional cost), and a gradient rollback through the recurrent hidden states (long-term temporal). Because the detector is frozen, detection performance is preserved exactly (Delta AUC = 0, verified empirically to ten decimal places). On the UCI Message benchmark, our trained AddGraph baseline reaches an average per-snapshot AUC of 0.8705, exceeding the originally published result; X-AddGraph reproduces every score identically while adding explanations where none existed. Evaluated across four edge populations - confident true positives, low-confidence true positives, false positives, and random samples - the long-term attribution identifies historical snapshots carrying significantly more counterfactual signal than random selection (0.127 vs. 0.074), a capability that no spatially-blind explainer can provide. We release our implementation for full reproducibility.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为动态图边级异常检测框架 AddGraph（GCN+GRU）提出首个严格事后 (post-hoc) 可解释性框架 X-AddGraph，其 Dual Spatial-Temporal Attribution (DSTA) 机制包含三个与 AddGraph 架构模块对齐的组件：基于梯度的空间相关性归因、零额外成本的短期时间注意力读取，以及通过循环隐状态的梯度回滚实现长期时间归因。由于检测器保持冻结，检测性能被精确保留（Delta AUC = 0，经验验证到小数点后十位）。在 UCI Message 基准上，训练的 AddGraph 基线平均每快照 AUC 为 0.8705，超过原发表结果，而 X-AddGraph 在逐分数复现的同时新增了解释。
Motivation: 动态图上的深度异常检测器虽准确率高但高度不透明：当一条边被标记时，分析人员只得到分数而没有任何理由。在需要审计和信任的协作式、受监管信息系统中，这种不透明性难以接受；而 AddGraph 作为基础性的 GCN+GRU 边级异常检测框架，据作者所知从未配备任何形式的可解释性。
Method: 提出严格的 post-hoc 可解释框架 X-AddGraph，基于 DSTA 机制，其三个组件分别对齐 AddGraph 的架构模块：对当前邻接结构进行基于梯度的相关性归因（空间维度）；直接读取推理期间已计算的上下文注意力权重（短期时间维度，零额外成本）；通过循环隐状态进行梯度回滚（长期时间维度）。检测器保持冻结，不修改或重训。
Result: 在 UCI Message 基准上，训练后的 AddGraph 基线达到平均每快照 AUC 0.8705，超过原始发表结果；X-AddGraph 逐分数复现该结果，Delta AUC = 0 精确到小数点后十位。在置信真阳、低置信真阳、假阳和随机样本四类边群体上，长期归因识别出的历史快照携带比随机选择显著更多的反事实信号（0.127 vs 0.074），这是任何无空间感知的可解释器都无法提供的能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为，架构对齐的 DSTA 事后归因可以在完全不损失检测性能的前提下为 AddGraph 等递归图异常检测器提供可审计解释，且长期时间归因能够提供空间盲解释器无法获得的因果/反事实信号；实现已开源以保证可复现性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Specification-first convergence with an AI coding agent: a case study of dismantling a core architectural invariant across 189 files in a 717k-line codebase with no test oracle and no human code review
papers.abstract_en: This paper reports a single, fully instrumented case study of a large-scale architectural refactoring by an AI coding agent under a specification-first protocol, with no human review of the generated code and no pre-existing oracle to validate the target behaviour. The task, dismantling a central invariant across a large interdependent codebase, was assessed by the author as effectively infeasible through incremental refactoring, the kind of change that conventionally calls for a rewrite instead. Under the protocol described here, the agent completed it successfully. The system is a 717,725-line production TypeScript application across 3,648 files. The task required dismantling a core lifetime invariant: the guarantee that a UI panel remains open for the duration of an AI request. The target behaviour was that a streaming generation survives the closing of its panel and can be reattached, on reopening, to the same live stream with no loss or duplication. The protocol: formal specification by the agent, 14 refinement cycles auditing that specification against the source code, atomic implementation, a compile/test feedback loop, then 17 verification cycles auditing the code against the frozen specification. Across 31 audit passes, 201 defects were corrected before any human executed the program. The convergence criterion was empirical: two consecutive verification passes returning zero findings. The change touched 189 files (31 new); with the extraction phase, the two commits total 288 files, 34,770 insertions, 16,422 deletions. Across the first and roughly thirty later sessions, the software behaved as specified, no bug observed. Elapsed: three days; cost: USD 2,430. The full specification and raw session logs, 1,500+ pages in French, are published as evidence, allowing inspection of the process and submission to a language model for consistency checking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告了一个单一的全仪表化案例研究：在‘规范优先’（specification-first）协议下，AI 编码智能体成功完成了一次大规模架构重构，拆除了一个核心不变量，整个过程没有人类代码审查，也没有预置的测试 oracle。目标系统是 717,725 行 TypeScript 生产应用（3,648 个文件），任务要求拆除‘UI 面板在 AI 请求期间保持打开’的生命周期不变量，使流式生成在面板关闭后仍能存活并在重新打开时无丢失或重复地重挂载到同一实时流。作者评估该任务在增量重构下实际上不可行，传统上需要重写。
Motivation: 要处理的是那些通常被认为必须重写而非增量重构的大规模架构变更：拆除一个跨大量相互依赖文件的核心不变量。作者想验证在既无测试 oracle 又无人类代码审查的情况下，规范驱动的协议能否让 AI 智能体可靠地完成这类任务。
Method: 提出‘规范优先’协议：由智能体先进行形式化规范（formal specification），随后用 14 轮细化周期把规范与源代码对照审计；接着是原子实现，配以编译/测试反馈循环；再用 17 轮验证周期将代码与冻结的规范对照审计。收敛标准是连续两轮验证返回零发现问题，全程没有人类审查生成的代码。
Result: 在人类执行程序之前，31 次审计中修正了 201 个缺陷。变更涉及 189 个文件（其中 31 个新文件），两次提交合计 288 个文件、34,770 行插入、16,422 行删除。在第一次及之后约三十次会话中，软件行为符合规范，未观察到 bug；耗时三天，成本 2,430 美元。
Conclusion: 该案例表明，规范优先协议可使 AI 编码智能体在没有测试 oracle 和人类代码审查的情况下完成一项作者评估为‘增量重构不可行’的架构重构。论文发布了完整规范及 1,500 多页法语原始会话日志作为证据，供他人检查流程并用语言模型做一致性核对。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unifying Generative Models with Path Integrals
papers.abstract_en: We formulate generative modeling as a path integral in which flow-based, diffusion-based, variational, and adversarial models arise as different evaluation principles for a single master action. Its Martin-Siggia-Rose-Janssen-de~Dominicis (MSRJD) form separates free from interacting probability flows and opens them to diagrammatic perturbation theory. The expansion yields a one-loop correction to deterministic samplers at no stochastic-sampling cost, which we validate on solvable and nonlinear drifts, where it reduces a 53 % tree-level error to 1.6 %. Imperfect learned scores enter as insertions and yield a response-weighted score-matching objective, and symmetry-equivariant drift design becomes an operator expansion with EFT power counting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将生成建模表述为路径积分（path integral），使得基于流、扩散、变分和对抗的生成模型都可视为同一主作用量的不同评估原理。其 Martin-Siggia-Rose-Janssen-de Dominicis (MSRJD) 形式分离自由与相互作用概率流，并引入图微扰论；一阶修正可在不增加随机采样成本的情况下改进确定性采样器。摘要报告在可解和非线性漂移上把树级误差从 53% 降到 1.6%。
Motivation: 流模型、扩散模型、变分和对抗模型通常被视为不同框架，缺少统一的理论视角。作者希望用一个主作用量统一这些生成模型，并借助路径积分与微扰展开获得系统修正和新的设计原则。
Method: 将生成建模写成路径积分形式，采用 MSRJD 形式分离自由流与相互作用流，打开图微扰理论；推导出确定性采样器的一阶（one-loop）修正。不完美学习的 score 作为插入项，得到响应加权（response-weighted）的 score-matching 目标；对称等变漂移设计被表达为带 EFT 幂次计数（power counting）的算符展开。
Result: 在可解和非线性漂移上验证了该框架，一阶修正将树级误差从 53% 降低到 1.6%，并且这一改进不产生额外的随机采样成本。
Conclusion: 摘要主张路径积分统一框架能为生成模型提供系统微扰修正，并导出响应加权 score matching 与 EFT 式对称设计等新原则。

papers.title: Multi-AUV Ad-hoc network-based Target Tracking: A Value Gradient Guidance Multi-Agent Diffusion Reinforcement Learning Approach
papers.abstract_en: Multi-AUV ad-hoc network-based target tracking requires networked autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) to cooperatively track maneuvering targets under constrained acoustic communication, dynamic topology, and uncertain ocean disturbances. Although multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) enables decentralized coordination through centralized training, existing methods suffer from high-dimensional joint state-action modeling, noise-sensitive policy generation, leading to unstable training and degraded tracking. To address these issues, we propose VGG-MADiffRL, a value-gradient-guided multi-agent diffusion RL algorithm, and MDCA, a diffusion?based hierarchical control architecture. Leveraging underwater mission characteristics, we model sonar detection mechanisms and ocean current disturbances, formulating cooperative tracking for multi-AUV ad-hoc networks as an MDP. The proposed MDCA constitutes a three-tier closed-loop control framework: a global intelligent control layer, a local online training layer, and a physical action execution layer. This structure enables synergistic optimization across task allocation, local decision processes, and execution feedback. Within MDCA, the local online training layer is the policy learning framework; VGG-MADiffRL builds on diffusion policies and incorporates value gradients to guide action generation in the reverse denoising process, steering the generated actions towards higher expected returns. It employs twin value networks with joint optimization and soft target updates to mitigate overestimation and training oscillations, promoting more stable convergence. Experimental results show that VGG-MADiffRL consistently achieves faster convergence, higher tracking accuracy, and smoother training dynamics in cooperative tracking scenarios, validating its effectiveness and practical engineering value in dynamic underwater settings.

papers.title: MARCH: Scaling Recurrent Memory with Content-Routed State Anchors
papers.abstract_en: Transformers owe much of their strong long-context retrieval capability to a token-level memory that grows with context length. This flexibility, however, incurs a quadratic computation complexity during training and a key--value cache that grows linearly during autoregressive inference. Recurrent alternatives offer efficient decoding by compressing the entire history into a fixed-size state, but often underperform on recall-intensive tasks since earlier associations usually get overwritten by subsequent updates, and only the most recent contextual information is retained. In this paper, we introduce Memory-Anchor Routing across Context History (MARCH), a network architecture that effectively scales state-space models beyond a fixed-size dimension, while maintaining computational efficiency over long-sequences. MARCH periodically caches cumulative recurrent-state checkpoints as state anchors and associates each anchor with a compact, content-conditioned anchor key. This lets MARCH maintain a memory bank, which can grow as context length increases, providing a controllable trade-off between historical resolution and memory cost. At each token, MARCH produces an anchor query to attend all causally available state anchors, and the output is calculated as an attention-style aggregation over all historical anchors along the current state. We show that after standard pretraining, MARCH consistently outperforms multiple linear attention variants across commonsense reasoning, LongBench, and in-context retrieval. These results demonstrate that content-routed state caching substantially strengthens recurrent long-range memory while preserving its native computation path.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Memory-Anchor Routing across Context History (MARCH)，一种在保持序列计算效率的同时扩展状态空间模型记忆维度的网络架构。MARCH 周期性地将累积的循环状态检查点缓存为状态锚点 (state anchors)，并为每个锚点配备紧凑的、由内容条件化生成的锚点键，从而形成一个可随上下文长度增长、在历史分辨率和记忆成本之间可调的记忆库。每个 token 生成一个锚点查询，对所有因果可用的状态锚点执行注意力式聚合，并将结果融入当前状态。
Motivation: Transformer 的长上下文检索能力来自随上下文长度增长的 token 级记忆，但训练时带来二次计算复杂度，自回归推理时键值缓存线性增长；循环替代方案将全部历史压缩为固定大小状态，解码高效，但早期关联易被后续更新覆盖，在召回密集型任务上表现不足。
Method: MARCH 在循环模型前向过程中周期性缓存累计状态检查点作为状态锚点，并利用内容条件化的锚点键组织记忆；每个 token 生成锚点查询以注意所有因果可用的状态锚点，输出通过注意力式聚合历史锚点并结合当前状态计算。
Result: 经过标准预训练后，MARCH 在常识推理、LongBench 和上下文内检索 (in-context retrieval) 等任务上一致优于多种线性注意力变体。
Conclusion: 内容路由的状态缓存 (content-routed state caching) 能在保留循环模型原生计算路径的同时显著增强其长程记忆能力，表明该方法有效弥补了固定大小循环状态在长时间跨度上的记忆缺陷。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SynWeaver: Website-Prior Task and Trajectory Co-Synthesis for Web Agents
papers.abstract_en: Web agents often struggle to generalize to unseen websites because they lack website-specific supervision. Recent exploration-based data synthesis methods reduce manual annotation, but they still face two key limitations: they often fail to cover the full functionality of a website, and without sufficient website prior knowledge, they tend to propose hallucinated tasks, which in turn limits the diversity and efficiency of downstream trajectory synthesis. We present \textbf{SynWeaver}, a website-prior task-trajectory co-synthesis framework designed to address these challenges. SynWeaver first performs structured website exploration and constructs a website map that covers a broad set of functionally distinct page states and executable interactions on the target website. It then derives page-level and transition-level supervision from this map to train a UI-aware model with website-specific priors, enabling more grounded task proposals. Finally, SynWeaver performs collaborative task-trajectory synthesis, jointly updating the task and execution trajectory when they become inconsistent, and then verifies and repairs the collected results to produce executable, semantically aligned supervision. Experiments on WebArena and WebVoyager demonstrate that SynWeaver consistently outperforms strong synthesis baselines and yields more effective supervision for both in-domain and out-of-domain generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SynWeaver，一个面向 Web agent 的网站先验任务-轨迹协同合成框架。它先通过结构化探索构建覆盖目标网站功能状态的网站地图，再从中导出页面级与转移级监督以训练带网站先验的 UI-aware 模型，最后在任务与轨迹不一致时联合更新并验证修复，生成可执行且语义对齐的监督数据。在 WebArena 和 WebVoyager 上的实验表明，SynWeaver 持续优于强合成基线，并提升域内与域外泛化的监督效果。
Motivation: Web agent 因缺乏网站特定的监督数据而难以泛化到未见过的网站；已有的基于探索的数据合成方法虽减少人工标注，但往往不能覆盖网站的完整功能，且因缺乏网站先验知识会提出幻觉任务，从而限制下游轨迹合成的多样性和效率。
Method: SynWeaver 首先进行结构化网站探索，构建覆盖功能不同页面状态与可执行交互的网站地图；随后从地图中导出页面级和转移级监督，训练具有网站特定先验的 UI-aware 模型，以生成更扎实的任务提案；最后进行任务-轨迹协同合成，在任务与执行轨迹不一致时联合更新，并对收集结果进行验证和修复。
Result: 在 WebArena 和 WebVoyager 上的实验显示，SynWeaver 一致地超越多种强合成基线，并为域内和域外泛化提供更有效的监督数据，具体数值在摘要中未给出。
Conclusion: 作者强调，将网站先验融入任务-轨迹协同合成并加入验证修复环节，可以缓解数据合成中的功能覆盖不足与幻觉任务问题，从而提升 Web agent 监督数据的质量及其泛化能力。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: MindMemOS: A Portable and Self-Evolving Memory Operating Layer for AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Memory is a core component of AI agents, enabling them to accumulate experience, maintain personalization, and adapt over long-term interactions. However, existing memory systems often remain fixed after development, limiting their ability to adapt their memory models, organization strategies, and procedural knowledge through continued use. We present MindMemOS, a portable and self-evolving memory operating layer that organizes open-world information using a unified entity property timestructure. MindMemOS supports scenario-adaptive memory modeling, higher-order pattern discovery, autonomous memory refinement, and continuous skill evolution. Its MindMemEvolve algorithm employs validation-driven evolutionary search to optimize memory schemas for target scenarios, whiledreaming consolidates accumulated memories by merging redundant records and resolving conflicts. In addition, implicit corrective feedback serves as a human-in-the-loop signal for identifying and revising potentially inaccurate or misaligned memories. Its MindSkillEvolve algorithm further transforms agent execution trajectories into reusable and progressively refined skills. MindMemOS achieves 94.03% accuracy on LOCOMO and 70.63% on PersonaMem. MindSkillEvolve improves SpreadsheetBench success by 9.2 percentage points over the initial-skill baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MindMemOS，一个面向 AI 智能体的可移植、自进化的记忆操作系统层，用统一的实体属性时间结构（entity property time structure）组织开放世界信息。系统支持场景自适应记忆建模、高阶模式发现、自主记忆精炼和持续技能进化，并设计了 MindMemEvolve 与 MindSkillEvolve 两个进化算法。在 LOCOMO 上准确率为 94.03%，PersonaMem 上为 70.63%，MindSkillEvolve 在 SpreadsheetBench 上比初始技能基线提升 9.2 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有智能体记忆系统在开发完成后通常保持固定，难以在使用过程中自适应调整记忆模型、组织策略和程序性知识，限制了长期交互中的适应能力。
Method: MindMemOS 采用统一实体属性时间结构组织信息，并包含场景自适应记忆建模、高阶模式发现、自主记忆精炼与持续技能进化。MindMemEvolve 使用验证驱动的进化搜索优化目标场景的记忆模式，dreaming 通过合并冗余记录和解决冲突来巩固记忆，隐式纠正反馈作为人类参与回路信号修正不准确记忆；MindSkillEvolve 将智能体执行轨迹转化为可复用且逐步精炼的技能。
Result: 摘要报告 MindMemOS 在 LOCOMO 上达到 94.03% 准确率，在 PersonaMem 上达到 70.63%；MindSkillEvolve 在 SpreadsheetBench 上较初始技能基线提升成功率高 9.2 个百分点。
Conclusion: 本文认为将记忆组织为自进化层并引入验证驱动的模式优化与技能演化，可以显著增强智能体的长期记忆能力和任务执行表现。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Large Language Models Can Follow Instructions, But Not Many at Once: Phase Transitions in Compositional Constraint Satisfaction
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly deployed in settings that require simultaneous adherence to multiple explicit constraints - reasoning structure, safety boundaries, output schemas. Individual constraints are handled proficiently, but the compositional regime, where many must hold jointly, remains poorly characterized: how rapidly does performance degrade, what governs the degradation, and can the collapse be mitigated? We introduce Constraint Saturation Evaluation (CSE), a procedurally generated benchmark that systematically varies the number of simultaneous constraints (k), with every constraint scored by a deterministic, rule-based verifier and zero LLM-judge involvement: 15 models, 36 constraint types, 369,753 checks at k=1-12. Three findings emerge. First, per-constraint pass rate decays gradually and predictably, while the chance of satisfying all k constraints collapses - a model passing individual constraints at ~41% at k=8 succeeds on all eight just 5.7% of the time. Second, constraints do not degrade equally: structural constraints lose 2x more baseline capability per added constraint than lexical ones, ordered by a comprehension-maintenance gap that separates constraints requiring sustained tracking from binary decisions immune to composition. Third, failures are nearly independent, which is what makes the accumulation multiplicative; the residual coupling that does exist tracks shared output features rather than pairwise interference - a wrong sentence count fails every constraint that reads it. Reliable instruction following breaks down beyond 5-6 simultaneous constraints: probe-level success falls below 50% at 7 constraints for the strongest model, and at 3 or fewer for 12 of 15.
papers.comment: 35 pages, 7 figures, 13 tables. Reviewed in the ARR May 2026 cycle
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Constraint Saturation Evaluation (CSE)，一个程序化生成的基准，用于系统研究大语言模型在同时满足多个显式约束时的表现退化。基准覆盖 15 个模型、36 种约束类型，在 k=1-12 下共进行 369,753 次检查，所有约束均由确定性规则验证器评分，不涉及 LLM 裁判。摘要报告三个主要发现：单约束通过率随 k 缓慢下降但全部约束同时满足的概率急剧坍塌；结构约束比词汇约束衰减更快；失败近乎独立，导致性能下降呈乘法累积。可靠指令遵循在约 5-6 个约束之后失效。
Motivation: 大语言模型常被部署在需要同时满足多个显式约束（如推理结构、安全边界、输出格式）的场景中，但组合约束区间的退化速度、退化机制以及能否缓解仍缺乏系统刻画。
Method: 引入程序化生成的基准 CSE，系统变化同时约束数量 k（1-12），每个约束由确定性、基于规则的验证器独立评分，从而完全避免 LLM 裁判偏差；在 15 个模型、36 种约束类型上执行 369,753 次检查。

papers.title: AI-Driven Multiscenario Interest Rate Forecasting: A Proof of Concept for Banking Asset Management
papers.abstract_en: This study focuses on developing an AI-supported prototype for multiperspective interest rate forecasting that combines classical econometric models with modern artificial intel-ligence methods. Tested in a major European bank, the system enables more precise and flexible prediction of interest rate developments, supporting strategic decision-making in Asset-Liability Management (ALM). It integrates topic modeling, sentiment analysis, econometric forecasting, and market-based analyses within an interactive platform. Leveraging AI to analyze large volumes of financial documents and market data enables the identification of monetary policy trends and sentiment signals at an early stage. The core econometric model is a Bayesian vector autoregression (BVAR) that enables simulation-based scenario analyses to evaluate economic developments from multiple perspectives. The system's innovation lies in its integration of several forecasting approaches that consolidate previously separate information sources and present them transparently and interpretably. Financial analysts and risk managers thus gain a better basis for making decisions, allowing them to assess interest rate risks more accurately and manage market movements more proactively. While the prototype demonstrates how AI can transform interest rate management in banking, further development is required to optimize real-time data integration and regulatory compliance. Even at this stage, the study shows that multi-perspective, AI-driven forecasting provides substantial added value for banks by increasing transparency, strengthening evidence-based decision-making, and improving risk management.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍一个在大型欧洲银行中测试的AI原型系统，用于多视角利率预测，支持银行资产与负债管理（ALM）中的战略决策。系统将主题建模、情感分析、计量经济预测和市场分析整合到一个交互式平台中，核心计量模型为贝叶斯向量自回归（BVAR），并支持基于模拟的情景分析。摘要称该原型使利率预测更精确和灵活，并能更早识别货币政策趋势和情绪信号。
Motivation: 银行资产管理中的利率预测长期依赖分散且相互割裂的信息来源，难以兼顾不同视角并保持透明可解释。该研究旨在通过结合经典计量经济模型与现代AI方法，构建一个统一的多视角预测平台，改善利率风险管理决策。
Method: 构建一个AI驱动的原型系统，整合主题建模、情感分析、计量经济预测和市场数据分析；核心预测模型是贝叶斯向量自回归（BVAR），用于执行仿真情景分析。系统在一个大型欧洲银行环境中进行了实际测试。
Result: 摘要报告该系统实现了更精确、更灵活的利率走势预测，并能早期识别货币政策趋势与情绪信号，为分析人员和风险管理者提供更好的决策依据。摘要未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为多视角、AI驱动的利率预测能通过提升透明度、强化循证决策和改进风险管理为银行带来实质价值；同时指出仍需进一步优化实时数据集成和监管合规。

papers.title: Which Site, and When: A Free-Satellite-Data Test of Himalayan Glacial Lake Bursts, Landslides, and Ice Floods
papers.abstract_en: Two free satellite signals carry real information about glacial-lake outburst risk in the Nepal Himalaya: radar interferometry sees a moraine dam slowly sagging, and satellite weather marks the weeks when a primed lake is under stress. A companion feasibility study found that deformation indicates which lake is destabilizing and weather indicates when it is at risk, but proposed no predictive model. To address this gap, we propose and evaluate models that predict which site is susceptible and when a trigger arrives. We test three related hazards on free data alone: large moraine- and ice-dammed bursts, rainfall-triggered landslides, and smaller floods from ponds on and around a glacier. Each hazard gets two questions, never blended. Using 589 dated outbursts from HMAGLOFDB and several thousand catalogued landslides, we match each event against similar but unfailed sites, and hold every model to a strong simple baseline under spatial cross-validation that withholds whole map tiles, so no model succeeds by recognising a trained-on neighbourhood. Antecedent weather times the trigger at ROC 0.73 for big bursts, 0.83 for landslides, and 0.82 for small floods. Terrain ranks susceptibility only in part: scored naively it appears near 0.9, largely because catalogued failures cluster in wetter ranges; matched against comparable nearby sites the honest figures are 0.76, 0.71, and 0.54 (no better than chance). The burst signal holds within single regions, reaching 0.89 in Nepal alone. Five deep-learning models do not decisively beat a simple gradient-boosted baseline. Three score marginally higher on landslides, a hint too small to confirm. For the lake hazards the baseline wins outright, reproduced by a three-rule decision tree on ruggedness and monsoon rainfall. We close with a ranked Nepal watchlist, a prioritisation aid, not a prediction, and note where free data reaches its limits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用免费卫星数据（雷达干涉测量与卫星气象）对尼泊尔喜马拉雅地区的冰川湖溃决、降雨触发滑坡和冰川小洪水三类灾害进行可预测性测试。作者为每个灾害分别建模“哪个地点易受影响”和“何时触发”，并用 589 个已记录溃决事件和数千个滑坡事件与相似未失败地点匹配，在按地图瓦片留出的空间交叉验证下对比强基线。结果显示前置天气在触发时机上达到 ROC 0.73（大溃决）、0.83（滑坡）和 0.82（小洪水），地形的易感性排序在匹配后仅为 0.76、0.71 和 0.54，其中小洪水不优于随机；五个深度学习模型未显著超过梯度提升基线，最终给出按风险排序的尼泊尔监测清单。
Motivation: 此前的可行性研究发现雷达形变能指示哪个湖泊正在失稳、天气能指示何时处于风险状态，但未提出预测模型。本文旨在填补这一空白，仅用免费数据回答“哪个地点”和“何时触发”这两个问题，并避免不同灾害的混杂。
Method: 针对三种相关灾害（冰碛/冰坝大溃决、降雨触发滑坡、冰川上及周边小洪水）分别建立预测模型，每个灾害独立回答地点易感性与触发时机的两个问题；使用 HMAGLOFDB 中 589 个已日期化溃决事件和大规模滑坡目录，将每个事件与相似但未失败的场地匹配，并在按整个地图瓦片留出的空间交叉验证下评估，禁止模型通过识别已训练邻域来得分；对比模型包括五类深度学习和梯度提升基线，并辅以一个基于粗糙度和季风降雨的三规则决策树。
Result: 前置天气对触发时机的 ROC 分别为 0.73（大溃决）、0.83（滑坡）和 0.82（小洪水）；地形对易感性的朴素评分接近 0.9，但匹配可比邻近地点后的诚实数值为 0.76、0.71 和 0.54（后者不优于随机）；溃决信号在单一区域内保持，仅在尼泊尔即达 0.89。五个深度学习模型未决定性超过梯度提升基线，滑坡上仅三个略高但不足为凭；湖泊灾害由基线胜出，可被三规则决策树复现。
Conclusion: 本文以免费卫星数据给出了喜马拉雅冰川湖溃决、滑坡和小洪水的可预测性边界，并生成一个按风险排序的尼泊尔监测清单作为优先级辅助工具而非逐次预测；同时明确指出免费数据在此类应用中表现的下限与局限性。

papers.title: LoKiFormer: Locality-aware Attention with Decoupled Knowledge Memory for Efficient Large Language Model Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable breakthroughs across various applications. However, their architectures remain inefficient in pretraining due to two main limitations: (i) self-attention lacks an explicit inductive bias for locality, leading to redundant modeling of sequence-internal local information; (ii) mixture-of-experts (MoE) implicitly couples knowledge storage with computational pathways, hindering flexible access to sequence-external global knowledge. To overcome these limitations, we propose LoKiFormer, a novel LLM architecture that augments the standard decoder with two dedicated modules: 1) Local Fusion Attention (LFA), which incorporates a convolutional fusion to attention, explicitly capturing local patterns and allowing the attention to operate on more informative representations; 2) Knowledge Memory Module (KMM), which introduces a parametric key-value memory that explicitly stores global knowledge in addressable slots, decoupling storage from computation and enabling direct knowledge retrieval. Together, these modules enable LoKiFormer to achieve more efficient and effective integration of information at both levels. Experimental results show that LoKiFormer converges 1.33x faster in pre-training than baseline models, underscoring its superiority over existing LLM architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LoKiFormer，一种面向大语言模型（LLM）预训练的新型架构，在标准 decoder 上增加两个专用模块：Local Fusion Attention (LFA) 和 Knowledge Memory Module (KMM)。摘要报告该方法在预训练中比基线模型收敛快 1.33 倍，并认为其能更高效地整合序列内部局部信息与序列外部全局知识。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 架构预训练效率受限于两个问题：自注意力缺乏显式的局部性归纳偏置，会冗余建模序列内部局部信息；混合专家（MoE）将知识存储与计算路径隐式耦合，阻碍对序列外部全局知识的灵活访问。
Method: LoKiFormer 在标准 decoder 上加入两个模块：LFA 在注意力中引入卷积融合（convolutional fusion），显式捕获局部模式并让注意力作用于更具信息量的表示；KMM 引入可寻址槽位的参数化键值记忆，显式存储全局知识，将存储与计算解耦并支持直接知识检索。
Result: 实验结果表明，LoKiFormer 在预训练中比基线模型收敛速度快 1.33 倍，体现了其在现有 LLM 架构上的效率优势。
Conclusion: 作者认为 LFA 与 KMM 共同使 LoKiFormer 在局部和全局两个层面实现更高效、更有效的信息集成；摘要未涉及具体下游任务表现或局限性。

papers.title: RoutePack: Expert Placement and Attention-Aware Data Packing for MoE Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Training Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models for reinforcement learning (RL) couples two load-balancing problems: sequence composition determines dense attention work in each data-parallel microbatch, while token routing determines sparse expert work on expert-parallel ranks. Optimizing either alone can shift the bottleneck to the other. In MoE RL, rollout-time routing replay exposes every sample's sequence length and layer-wise expert demand before its training step. We present RoutePack, a hierarchical planner that coordinates state-consistent, layer-wise expert rerouting with joint attention- and expert-aware data packing over an optimizer-step window. RoutePack first places experts independently at each MoE layer using aggregate routing demand. It then packs samples into the smallest certified, or best-known feasible, number of token-capped execution rows and optimizes their DP layout with a projected EDP-shard-aware objective. The objective combines a window-normalized linear-quadratic attention proxy with per-layer physical EP-rank peaks and minimizes the accumulated cost of the slowest EDP shard. Parallel population annealing searches fixed-row feasible layouts while preserving sample coverage, capacity, nonempty cells, equal microbatch counts, and communicator topology. State-consistent materialization preserves logical top-k routing and existing MoE kernels without microbatch-level expert replication. Across Ling-3.0-Tiny and Ling-3.0-Flash, expert rerouting improves mean trainer-measured token throughput by 3.80% and 10.50%, while routing-aware packing adds another 4.86% and 3.98%, respectively. Overall, RoutePack improves throughput by 8.85% and 14.89% over the baseline.

TL;DR: 本文提出 RoutePack，一种面向 MoE 强化学习训练的层次化规划器，将序列打包带来的稠密注意力负载与 token 路由带来的稀疏专家负载联合优化。它先在每个 MoE 层按聚合路由需求独立放置专家，再将样本打包进带 token 上限的执行行并优化数据并行布局，通过并行模拟退火搜索可行布局。在 Ling-3.0-Tiny 和 Ling-3.0-Flash 上，总体吞吐量较基线提升 8.85% 和 14.89%。
Motivation: MoE 强化学习训练同时面临两个负载均衡问题：序列组合决定数据并行微批次中的稠密注意力工作量，token 路由决定专家并行 rank 上的稀疏专家工作量。单独优化其中任何一个都可能把瓶颈转移到另一个，因此需要联合规划。
Method: RoutePack 采用分层规划器：先利用 roll-out 阶段的路由重放获得每个样本的序列长度和逐层专家需求，按聚合路由需求在各 MoE 层独立放置专家；随后将样本打包进满足 token 上限的最少可行执行行，并用一个结合逐层物理 EP-rank 峰值的窗口归一化线性二次注意力代理目标来优化 DP 布局，目标是最小化最慢 EDP shard 的累积成本。布局搜索使用并行种群退火 (parallel population annealing)，保证样本覆盖、容量、非空单元、相等微批次数量和通信拓扑等约束，并通过状态一致物化保持逻辑 top-k 路由与现有 MoE 内核不变。
Result: 摘要报告，在 Ling-3.0-Tiny 和 Ling-3.0-Flash 上，专家重路由分别将平均 trainer 测得的 token 吞吐量提升 3.80% 和 10.50%，路由感知打包再额外提升 4.86% 和 3.98%，总体提升分别为 8.85% 和 14.89%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将逐层专家放置与注意力/专家感知的数据打包放在同一优化窗口内协调，可以在不改变逻辑 top-k 路由和现有内核的前提下显著提升 MoE RL 训练吞吐量。

papers.title: Nutrition Data Infrastructure for the AI Era: Operationalizing FAIR for Agent-Mediated Research
papers.abstract_en: AI agents can accelerate nutrition research, but their analyses inherit the identity, semantic, and release ambiguities of the underlying data. We present Nutrition Data Service (NDS), source-preserving infrastructure that operationalizes FAIR for automated use: description resolution makes release-specific records findable; typed crosswalks connect independently released resources; machine-readable interfaces expose versioned sources and crosswalks, supporting replayable and auditable analyses. On food-description benchmarks, NDS outperforms the best published language-model result on NutriBench. External and blinded crosswalk evaluations show that its typed contract favors defensible links and rejects unsupported mappings. In a person-level glycemic-index analysis, pinned NDS inputs produce identical outputs across models and repeated runs, while open-web reconstruction remains unstable. Together, these results show that agent-mediated nutrition research requires a new infrastructure that makes data identity, search, and crosswalk policy explicit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Nutrition Data Service (NDS)，一种保留来源的基础设施，旨在将 FAIR 原则落地到 AI 代理介导的营养研究中：通过描述解析（description resolution）让发布特定记录可发现，通过类型化 crosswalks 连接独立发布的资源，并通过机器可读接口暴露版本化源与 crosswalks，从而支持可重放、可审计的分析。在食物描述基准上，NDS 超过 NutriBench 上最佳已发表语言模型结果；外部盲评显示其类型化契约偏向可辩护链接并拒绝不支持映射；在个人血糖指数分析中，固定的 NDS 输入在不同模型和重复运行中得到相同输出，而开放网络重建不稳定。
Motivation: AI 代理可以加速营养研究，但其分析会继承底层数据在身份、语义和发布版本上的歧义，导致分析结果不可复现、难以审计，现有数据基础设施不足以支撑自动化使用。
Method: NDS 采用三类机制操作化 FAIR：描述解析以区分同一资源的不同发布版本；类型化 crosswalks 在不同独立发布的数据资源之间建立语义映射；机器可读接口提供版本化来源和映射，支持重放和审计。
Result: 在食物描述基准上，NDS 优于 NutriBench 上最佳已发表的语言模型结果；外部和盲式 crosswalk 评估表明其类型化契约能产生可辩护的链接并拒绝不支持映射；在人级血糖指数分析中，固定 NDS 输入可跨模型与重复运行复现相同输出，而基于开放网络的重建不稳定。
Conclusion: 作者认为代理介导的营养研究需要新的基础设施，显式地规定数据身份、搜索和 crosswalk 策略，以确保分析的可靠性与可追溯性。

papers.title: Gated Spatial Redundancy Projection for Pathology Transformer Attentions
papers.abstract_en: Transformer models are increasingly used for whole-slide image analysis in computational pathology. Yet, WSIs differ fundamentally from natural images: neighbouring patches often contain highly similar tissue type, stain, texture, and cellular composition. We identify this local spatial redundancy as a pathology-specific failure mode of self-attention, where dominant neighbourhood features can be repeatedly mixed into patch-tokens and weaken subtle diagnostic or prognostic deviations. We propose Gated Spatial Redundancy Projection (Gated SRP), a lightweight drop-in correction module for self-attention layers. For each patch token and attention head, Gated SRP estimates a local redundancy axis from neighbouring value vectors, projects the attention output onto this axis, and applies a learned signed gate to correct the redundancy-aligned component geometrically. Across five TCGA survival cohorts, Gated SRP obtains the highest mean C-index among the compared attention variants in all cohorts, with an average improvement over the base attention, while adding only +0.02% parameters. Across five slide-level classification datasets, it improves the base attention on 12 of 16 reported metrics and achieves the best AUC on three datasets. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/AtlasAnalyticsLab/GatedSRP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对全切片图像（WSI）分析中病理 Transformer 自注意力的局部空间冗余问题，提出 Gated Spatial Redundancy Projection (Gated SRP)，一个轻量级即插即用的注意力修正模块。模块为每个 patch token 和注意力头估计局部冗余轴，将注意力输出投影到该轴上，并用可学习的符号门控对冗余对齐分量进行几何修正。在五个 TCGA 生存队列和五个幻灯片级分类数据集上验证了有效性，代码已公开。
Motivation: WSI 与自然图像不同，相邻 patch 常包含高度相似的组织类型、染色、纹理和细胞组成，这种局部空间冗余会使主导性邻域特征被反复混入 patch-token，削弱细微的诊断或预后偏差，成为病理 Transformer 特有的自注意力失效模式。
Method: 提出 Gated SRP，一种轻量级 drop-in 修正模块：对每个 token 和注意力头，从相邻 value 向量估计局部冗余轴，把注意力输出投影到该轴，再用学习到的有符号门控对冗余对齐分量做几何修正，并集成进自注意力层。
Result: 在五个 TCGA 生存队列中，Gated SRP 相比所比较的注意力变体在所有队列都获得最高平均 C-index，平均优于基础注意力，且仅增加 +0.02% 参数；在五个幻灯片级分类数据集的 16 项指标中改善基础注意力的 12 项，并在三个数据集上取得最佳 AUC。
Conclusion: 摘要强调局部空间冗余是病理图像中自注意力的特定失效模式，Gated SRP 以极低参数开销修正冗余分量，可提升生存分析与分类性能；作者提供公开代码以便复现与集成。

papers.title: Do LLM Recommenders Know When They're Hallucinating? Auditing Confidence Calibration in Catalog Faithfulness
papers.abstract_en: LLM recommenders for top-K item suggestion regularly emit titles outside the target catalog. Prior audits report a binary out-of-domain rate; none ask whether the model knew. We jointly audit hallucination rate (OOD@10) and verbalized-confidence calibration (ECE, Brier, reliability) for four zero-shot LLM recommenders from four independent vendors (Mistral Large, Llama-3.3-70B, GPT-OSS-120B, Claude Sonnet 4.6), not grounded or fine-tuned systems, across three catalogs (MovieLens-25M, Amazon Reviews 2023 Toys, Yelp Open Dataset), stratified by item popularity. Measuring catalog membership is itself the hard part: on identical outputs the reported rate moves by an order of magnitude with the string matcher used, and F1 cannot separate the candidates. We validate the instrument against 201 human judgments and select on net bias, where the adopted one is off by -0.040 against +0.144 for the common fuzzy rule. Hallucination is then strongly catalog-dependent (0.6-2.7% on MovieLens, 11.6-38.7% on Yelp, 49.3-61.0% on Amazon Toys). Each model holds a near-constant confidence level barely responsive to the catalog, while the catalog-hit rate swings 60 points, so the sign of the error is set by where a model's constant lands against a catalog's accuracy: 7 of the twelve cells are under-confident and 5 over-confident, all four under-confident on MovieLens, all four over-confident on Amazon Toys. We read this as an elicitation mismatch: "Just Ask" elicits a generic quality rating, not a catalog-membership probability. A conformal abstention threshold over verbalized confidence changes hallucination by at most 1.65 pp across four alpha levels, because the channel cannot separate correct items from hallucinations. We recommend that audits report calibration alongside OOD, validate the matcher producing the OOD number, and use catalog-anchored elicitation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文联合审计四个零样本 LLM 推荐系统（Mistral Large、Llama-3.3-70B、GPT-OSS-120B、Claude Sonnet 4.6）在三个目录（MovieLens-25M、Amazon Reviews 2023 Toys、Yelp Open Dataset）上的幻觉率（OOD@10）与口头置信度校准（ECE、Brier、reliability）。作者发现幻觉率强烈依赖目录，且每个模型的置信度几乎恒定、对目录不敏感，导致校准误差方向由模型常数与目录准确率的相对位置决定。研究还指出目录成员判定本身是难点：不同字符串匹配器可使报告率相差一个数量级。
Motivation: 已有审计只报告二元 out-of-domain 率，没有人追问模型是否知道自己正在输出目录外内容；同时目录成员测量本身存在不确定性，匹配器选择会显著改变结果。
Method: 对四个零样本（非 grounding 或微调）LLM 推荐器，按物品流行度分层，在三个目录上联合测量 OOD@10 与置信度校准；用 201 个人类判断验证测量工具，并按净偏差选择字符串匹配器（选中者偏差 -0.040，常见模糊规则为 +0.144）；另外测试基于口头置信度的 conformal abstention 阈值。
Result: 幻觉率强烈目录依赖：MovieLens 为 0.6-2.7%，Yelp 为 11.6-38.7%，Amazon Toys 为 49.3-61.0%。每个模型的置信度接近常数，而目录命中率波动达 60 个百分点；12 个模型-目录单元中 7 个欠自信、5 个过自信，四个模型在 MovieLens 全部欠自信、在 Amazon Toys 全部过自信。Conformal abstention 在四个 alpha 水平上最多只改变幻觉率 1.65 个百分点，说明该置信度通道无法区分正确项与幻觉项。
Conclusion: 作者将结果解读为 elicitation mismatch：“Just Ask”引出的是通用质量评分而非目录成员概率。建议未来审计在报告 OOD 的同时报告校准，验证产生 OOD 数值的匹配器，并使用 catalog-anchored 的 elicitation。

papers.title: Latent Fact-Checking: Detecting Misinformation through Activation Engineering
papers.abstract_en: The proliferation of misinformation online has driven demand for scalable detection systems. While most existing approaches rely on surface-level linguistic features or external knowledge retrieval, we examine truthfulness as a geometric property of a language model's representation space. We introduce a misinformation detection framework grounded in activation engineering, which leverages the latent geometry of transformer models. Our approach elicits a misinformation direction in the residual stream by contrasting activations from paired truthful and false statements, following the difference-in-means principle of Contrastive Activation Addition (CAA). At inference time, the last-token activation of an unseen claim is projected onto this direction, and the projected representation is fed to an Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) for classification. The procedure requires no fine-tuning of the backbone model, no external evidence retrieval, and no task-specific supervision beyond the contrastive pairs used to estimate the direction. We evaluate the method across 11 models from the Gemma, Llama, and Qwen families, ranging from 270M to 12B parameters, on three fact-checking benchmarks: AVeriTeC, LIAR, and FACTors. The falsehood direction is recoverable across model scales and architectural families, and last-token projection matches or surpasses zero-shot and few-shot prompting baselines on LIAR and FACTors, with the largest gains observed for smaller models. Performance on AVeriTeC is more limited, which we attribute to its evidence-grounded labeling scheme. These findings provide evidence that truthfulness is a structured, linearly separable concept in the latent space of pretrained language models, and point toward interpretability-driven misinformation detection as a practical complement to retrieval-based pipelines. The code is available on https://github.com/Malta-Lab/LaFaCt.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于激活工程（activation engineering）的虚假信息检测框架，通过对比成对真假陈述在残差流中的激活，按照对比激活加法（Contrastive Activation Addition, CAA）的均值差原理提取"误导方向"（misinformation direction）。推理时将未见声明的最后token激活投影到该方向，并将投影表示输入MLP分类，全程无需微调骨干模型、无需外部证据检索、也无需任务特定监督。作者在Gemma、Llama、Qwen家族的11个模型（270M到12B参数）上评估了AVeriTeC、LIAR和FACTors三个基准，发现LIAR和FACTors上该方法匹配或超越零样本/少样本提示基线，小模型收益最大，而AVeriTeC上性能有限。
Motivation: 现有虚假信息检测大多依赖表面语言特征或外部知识检索，本文转向考察真实性是否是语言模型表示空间中的几何属性，希望提供一种不依赖外部资源和微调的可扩展检测途径。
Method: 方法基于CAA的差异均值原理，用成对真假陈述的激活对比估计残差流中的虚假方向；推理时把未见声明的最后token激活投影到该方向，再将投影表示送入MLP进行分类。

Conclusion: 作者认为真实性是预训练语言模型潜在空间中结构化且线性可分的概念，可解释性驱动的虚假信息检测可作为基于检索管道的实用补充，并已公开代码。

papers.title: Recursive Synthesis for Long-Horizon Terminal Tasks
papers.abstract_en: High-quality long-horizon training data for terminal agents is expensive to produce, often costing hundreds to thousands of dollars per task, because each task must keep the instruction, environment, reference solution, and verifier mutually consistent. Human authoring does not scale, and direct generation with large language models (LLMs) often breaks these dependencies. We present Recursive Synthetic Terminal Tasks (RST), a recursive verified synthesis framework for constructing long-horizon terminal-agent tasks at scale. Starting from verified seed tasks, RST extends the reference solution, realigns the verifier and instruction to the new workflow, validates the result in a fresh sandbox, and reuses accepted tasks as seeds for subsequent rounds. Across fifteen recursive rounds, RST produces 37,484 synthesized terminal-agent tasks at roughly $0.05 per task. Task difficulty increases substantially over rounds: the median reference solution grows from 67 to 374 lines, the median number of executed commands grows from 40 to 244, and DeepSeek-V4-Pro pass@4 drops from 90% at R1 to 2.5% at R15. To demonstrate training utility, we collect rejection-sampled Qwen3.5 trajectories on the synthesized tasks and use them for supervised fine-tuning. Fine-tuning on these trajectories improves Qwen3.5-27B and Qwen3.5-122B-A10B by up to 10 points on Terminal-Bench 2, Terminal-Bench Hard, and Long-Horizon Terminal Bench, while agentic PPO lifts Qwen3.5-27B to 49.44%, 32.00%, and 22.07% on the three benchmarks, corresponding to relative gains of 20.0%, 41.2%, and 21.9% over the base model. Moreover, after 15 rounds, the recursion shows no ceiling: synthesis yield and validation rates remain stable as difficulty keeps climbing, indicating that the process can continue well beyond the scale reported here.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出递归合成框架 RST (Recursive Synthetic Terminal Tasks)，用于大规模构建长视界终端智能体任务。从已验证的种子任务开始，扩展参考解法并对齐验证器与指令，在新沙箱中验证，再把通过的任务作为下一轮种子迭代。15 轮后产出 37,484 个合成任务，单任务成本约 0.05 美元，任务难度随轮次显著上升；用这些任务上的拒绝采样轨迹微调，能明显提升 Qwen 系列模型在多个终端基准上的表现。
Motivation: 长视界终端智能体的高质量训练数据人工编写成本极高（每任务数百至数千美元），且要求指令、环境、参考解与验证器相互一致；直接让 LLM 生成往往破坏这些依赖关系。
Method: RST 采用递归验证式合成：扩展参考解法，将验证器和指令重新对齐到新工作流，在全新沙箱中验证结果，并将通过的任务作为后续轮次的种子，共迭代 15 轮。
Result: 摘要报告 15 轮生成 37,484 个任务，单任务约 0.05 美元；参考解法行数中位数从 67 增至 374，执行命令数中位数从 40 增至 244，DeepSeek-V4-Pro 的 pass@4 从 R1 的 90% 降至 R15 的 2.5%。拒绝采样微调使 Qwen3.5-27B 与 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 在 Terminal-Bench 2、Terminal-Bench Hard、Long-Horizon Terminal Bench 上最高提升 10 分；agentic PPO 使 Qwen3.5-27B 在三项基准上分别达到 49.44%、32.00%、22.07%，相对提升 20.0%、41.2%、21.9%。
Conclusion: 作者认为 15 轮后递归仍未出现天花板：合成产出率与验证率保持稳定而难度持续上升，表明该过程可以继续扩展到远超当前报告规模。

papers.title: SparseDitto: Customizing GPU Kernels for Different Sparsity Patterns with LLM-Based Agentic System
papers.abstract_en: Sparse matrix kernels are fundamental to scientific computing, graph analytics, and machine learning. Their GPU performance depends strongly on the input sparsity pattern and execution strategy. For the same SpMM on the same matrix, cuSPARSE exhibits a 350x performance gap between CSR and Blocked-ELL. Our study of multiple data formats, specialized systems, and sparse compilers shows that no single implementation consistently dominates across sparsity patterns and operators. This motivates a system that can adapt its representation, execution strategy, and hardware mapping to each workload and target GPU. We present SparseDitto, an LLM-based system that constructs a GPU kernel for each matrix, operator, and target GPU. SparseDitto supports SpMV, SpMM, and SpGEMM within a unified design framework. A lightweight additive model ranks established strategies using structural features of the input matrix. An architecture-aware planner then proposes several candidate designs. Coding and verification agents implement and refine them using measurements from the target GPU. Across three sparse operators and a diverse set of matrices, SparseDitto achieves a geometric-mean speedup of 2.68x over cuSPARSE on an NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU, with a maximum of 146.61x. On an NVIDIA H200 GPU, it achieves 2.79x, with a maximum of 78.5x. Its generated SpMM kernels also accelerate full-batch GCN training by up to 3.39x.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SparseDitto，一个基于 LLM 的智能体系统，为每个矩阵、算子与目标 GPU 自动构造定制化 GPU kernel，统一支持 SpMV、SpMM 与 SpGEMM。系统先用轻量级加性模型基于矩阵结构特征排序已有的执行策略，再由架构感知规划器提出候选设计，并由编码与验证智能体结合目标 GPU 上的实测结果进行实现和迭代。摘要报告其在 RTX PRO 6000 上相对 cuSPARSE 的几何平均加速为 2.68 倍、最大 146.61 倍，在 H200 上为 2.79 倍、最大 78.5 倍，且生成的 SpMM kernel 能将全批次 GCN 训练加速最高 3.39 倍。
Motivation: 稀疏矩阵 kernel 的 GPU 性能强烈依赖输入稀疏模式与执行策略，例如同一矩阵上的同一 SpMM 在 cuSPARSE 中 CSR 与 Blocked-ELL 两种格式间存在 350 倍性能差距；对多种数据格式、专用系统和稀疏编译器调研后，没有单一实现能在所有稀疏模式和算子上一致占优，因此需要能随 workload 与目标 GPU 自适应表示、执行策略和硬件映射的系统。
Method: SparseDitto 以 LLM 为基础，在统一设计框架内为每个矩阵、算子和目标 GPU 构建 kernel；包含一个轻量加性模型，用输入矩阵的结构特征对既有策略排序，再通过架构感知规划器提出多个候选设计，最后由编码和验证智能体实现设计并用目标 GPU 上的测量结果进行迭代优化。
Result: 在三个稀疏算子与多种矩阵上，SparseDitto 在 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 上取得相对 cuSPARSE 的几何平均 2.68 倍、最大 146.61 倍加速；在 NVIDIA H200 上为几何平均 2.79 倍、最大 78.5 倍；其生成的 SpMM kernel 可将全批次 GCN 训练加速最高 3.39 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，依据每个 workload 与目标 GPU 自适应地选择表示、执行策略和硬件映射，可以带来远超单一实现的大幅加速；其适用范围是 SpMV、SpMM、SpGEMM 三类稀疏算子。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SE(3)-MeanFlow: Few-Step Protein Backbone Generation on Lie Groups
papers.abstract_en: Generative modeling of protein backbones promises the de novo design of proteins with prescribed structural and functional properties. Existing diffusion and flow-matching models produce high-quality backbones on SE(3)^N, but inference requires numerically integrating an ODE over hundreds of network evaluations, each involving a Lie group exponential map - a bottleneck for high-throughput design campaigns. We introduce SE(3)-MeanFlow, a few-step generative framework that extends MeanFlow from Euclidean space to the Lie group geometry of protein frames. Working natively in the Lie algebra so(3) and in R^3, we derive closed-form average-velocity identities for rotations and translations, giving simulation-free training targets. We further introduce an SE(3) alpha-Flow objective that removes the Jacobian-vector product from the rotation branch and serves as a warm-up stage, after which training switches to a small-t stabilized MeanFlow loss that is used for the remainder of pretraining and for rectification-based post-training. In protein backbone generation, SE(3)-MeanFlow matches or exceeds flow-matching baselines that use several times more sampling steps, and its advantage widens in the few-step regime, where rectification lets it lead at every matched budget - at a modest cost in diversity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SE(3)-MeanFlow，将 MeanFlow 从欧氏空间推广到蛋白质骨架所在的李群几何，直接在 so(3) 李代数与 R^3 中推导旋转和平移的平均速度闭式恒等式，得到免模拟训练目标。作者还引入 SE(3) alpha-Flow 目标作为预热阶段，随后切换至小 t 稳定的 MeanFlow 损失，并在预训练后使用 rectification 后训练。在蛋白质骨架生成任务上，SE(3)-MeanFlow 用更少的采样步数即可匹配或超过 flow-matching 基线，且少步数区间优势更明显。
Motivation: 现有蛋白质骨架扩散和 flow-matching 模型在 SE(3)^N 上生成质量高，但推理需要对 ODE 进行数百次网络评估，每次评估都涉及李群指数映射，成为高通量设计流程的瓶颈。目标是减少采样步数，实现少步生成。
Method: 将 MeanFlow 扩展到蛋白质框架的李群几何，在 so(3) 和 R^3 中推导旋转与平移的平均速度闭式恒等式作为免模拟训练目标；引入 SE(3) alpha-Flow 目标去除旋转分支中的雅可比向量积，作为预热阶段，随后切换至小 t 稳定的 MeanFlow 损失，并在训练后半段和 rectification 后训练中使用。
Result: 在蛋白质骨架生成中，SE(3)-MeanFlow 在采样步数远少于基线的情况下匹配或超过 flow-matching 基线，少步数区间优势更明显；rectification 使其在同等计算预算下全面领先，但代价是生成多样性略有下降。
Conclusion: 作者表明在 SE(3) 李群上结合闭式平均速度与 rectification，可以在保持生成质量的同时显著减少推理步数，是蛋白质骨架少步生成的有效方案；其代价是多样性适度降低。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Borey: A High-Resolution Regional Atmosphere-Ocean-Sea Ice-Wave Forecasting System and Hindcast Dataset for the Barents and Kara Seas
papers.abstract_en: Borey is a high-resolution regional modeling and operational forecasting system for the Barents and Kara Seas. It combines WRF for the atmosphere, NEMO-SI3 for the ocean and sea ice, and WW3 for waves on approximately 3--6\,km grids, and generates daily forecasts to 72 hours. We describe the model chain and production workflow and present an accompanying hourly hindcast of surface conditions from August 2015 to August 2023. The archive provides aligned atmosphere, ocean, sea ice, and wave fields for regional marine studies and a baseline for evaluating the operational system. Comparisons with observations and observation-based products show that Borey captures much of the variability in near-surface atmospheric conditions and ocean temperature. Skill in the evaluated WRF, NEMO, and SI3 forecasts changes only modestly across the three-day window. The main limitations are persistent rather than rapidly growing errors: sea surface temperature is generally too cold, sea ice concentration and occurrence are overestimated during seasonal retreat, and significant wave height is underestimated. Borey should therefore complement observation-constrained products. The planned public release will provide hourly surface fields, native grids, provenance information, and validation outputs for regional analysis, model development, and carefully evaluated data-driven forecasting and data-assimilation research.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了 Borey，一个针对巴伦支海和喀拉海的高分辨率区域大气-海洋-海冰-波浪预报系统和回溯数据集。该系统结合 WRF、NEMO-SI3 和 WW3，在约 3-6 公里网格上运行，每日生成 72 小时预报，并提供 2015 年 8 月至 2023 年 8 月的逐小时表面条件回溯数据。与观测对比显示，系统能捕捉近地面大气条件和海洋温度的大部分变率，但存在海表温度偏冷、海冰高估和有效波高低估等系统性偏差。
Motivation: 该研究针对巴伦支海和喀拉海缺少高分辨率、多分量联合的预报系统和长期一致回溯数据集的问题，旨在为区域海洋研究、模型评估及数据驱动方法提供协调的多变量场和基准。
Method: 采用 WRF 模拟大气、NEMO-SI3 模拟海洋与海冰、WW3 模拟波浪的耦合建模链，在约 3-6 公里网格上运行，并通过生产工作流生成每日 72 小时预报，同时构建 2015-2023 年逐小时表面条件的回溯数据集。
Result: 与观测和观测类产品比较，Borey 捕捉了大部分近地面大气条件和海洋温度变率，WRF、NEMO 和 SI3 的预报技巧在三天预报窗口内变化很小；主要误差是持续性的：海表温度系统性偏冷，海冰浓度和海冰出现在季节消退期被高估，有效波高被低估。
Conclusion: 摘要强调系统的误差是持久而非快速增长，因此 Borey 应作为观测约束产品的补充；计划中的公开版本将提供逐小时表面场、原生网格、来源信息和验证输出，以支持区域分析、模型开发以及经仔细评估的数据驱动预报和资料同化研究。
Relevance: 60

papers.title: Dimension-Calibrated Unexplained Mass: An Interpretable Drift Statistic for Contamination Monitoring in Data Streams
papers.abstract_en: Drift detectors that work tend not to explain themselves, and drift detectors that explain themselves tend to fail in high dimension. We close that gap for Gaussian mixture models (GMMs): each fitted component is a named "regime," and the fraction of a stream window matching no regime -- its unexplained mass -- is a drift signal that is simultaneously its own explanation. We identify why this statistic collapses in high dimension and repair it. Under a correct component a normal point in d dimensions lies about sqrt(d) sigma from the mean, so once d exceeds 9 essentially every point exceeds a fixed 3-sigma radius: window-level ROC-AUC is exactly 0.50 on Satellite (d=36) and Optdigits (d=64). Calibrating the radius to sqrt(chi-squared_d(0.99)) removes the collapse -- AUC 1.00 and 0.89 -- while leaving low dimensions unchanged. Across seven public benchmarks, five seeds, and eight model-free detectors spanning the kernel, classifier, projection, density-difference, transport, likelihood and partition families, the repaired statistic is best or tied-best on five of seven datasets at 10% window contamination (its two losses are Pendigits, where the whole field beats it, and Optdigits), and as contamination becomes sparse the sample-level detectors fade toward chance while it degrades most gracefully: at 2% its mean AUC across the benchmarks is 0.86 against at most 0.73 for any model-free detector (1.00 vs. MMD's 0.72 on KDD-http) -- while alone among them reporting which regime the data left and how far outside it the window lies. We delimit its scope honestly: unexplained mass detects and explains novel-regime drift but is blind by construction to in-support re-weighting of known regimes, where distribution-level tests are required and explain nothing; and the underlying density model's EVT-calibrated false-alarm rates degrade above d of about 36. All code and experiments are released.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Code to reproduce all experiments included as ancillary files
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种可解释的数据流漂移统计量 unexplained mass：对高斯混合模型（GMM）拟合的每个成分命名一个 regime，窗口内未被任何 regime 匹配的样本比例既是漂移信号，也是漂移解释。作者指出该统计量在高维下失效的原因在于固定 3-sigma 半径，并用按维度校准的 sqrt(chi-squared_d(0.99)) 半径修复；在 Satellite（d=36）和 Optdigits（d=64）上 AUC 从 0.50 分别提升到 1.00 和 0.89。在七个基准、五个种子和八个无模型检测器的对比中，修复后的统计量在 10% 污染下五个数据集最佳或并列最佳，并在稀疏污染时退化最平缓。
Motivation: 现有漂移检测器要么有效但不可解释，要么可解释但在高维下失效；本文希望同时获得漂移信号和可解释的漂移来源。
Method: 基于 GMM 拟合，将每个成分视为命名 regime，以匹配不到任何 regime 的窗口样本比例作为漂移信号；关键修复是将判定半径从固定 3-sigma 改为 sqrt(chi-squared_d(0.99))，避免高维下正常点因距离均值约 sqrt(d) sigma 而被误判为漂移。
Result: 修复前 Satellite 和 Optdigits 上窗口级 ROC-AUC 恰为 0.50，修复后为 1.00 和 0.89；七个基准中在 10% 窗口污染下五个数据集达到最佳或并列最佳；2% 稀疏污染时平均 AUC 为 0.86，而所有无模型检测器最高仅 0.73（KDD-http 上为 1.00，MMD 为 0.72），并且只有该方法报告数据离开哪个 regime 以及超出多远。
Conclusion: 作者明确限定适用范围：unexplained mass 能检测并解释 novel-regime 漂移，但对已知 regime 内的 in-support re-weighting 天然不敏感，后者需要分布级测试且不提供解释；此外底层密度模型的 EVT 校准误报率在 d 约 36 以上退化。所有代码和实验已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Illusion of Improvement: Reject Inference Strategies in Credit Scoring
papers.abstract_en: Reject inference methods are widely used to mitigate survival bias in credit scoring, yet their effectiveness remains poorly understood. We systematically evaluate several such methods and uncover a structural failure mode: in a natural retraining cycle, models whose accuracy improves while recall collapses create an illusion of improvement that leads practitioners to believe the system is getting better when, in fact, its rejection quality -- the ability to correctly screen out defaulters -- is deteriorating. We then propose a controlled exploration strategy that breaks the feedback loop without statistical assumptions: the lender deliberately approves a fraction of rejected applicants and observes their true outcomes. We show that accuracy and rejection quality give opposite recommendations on whether to explore: accuracy favors no exploration, while rejection quality improves with it, confirming that standard evaluation metrics are misleading under selection bias. Even minimal exploration rates (2--5\%) prove sufficient in our experiments to diagnose the severity of the feedback loop at near-zero cost. Our findings are consistent across two machine learning methods and three real-world datasets, and suggest that standard evaluation protocols are inadequate for assessing models trained under survival bias.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了信用评分中常用的拒绝推断 (reject inference) 方法，发现一个结构性失效模式：在自然的再训练循环中，模型准确率提升而召回率崩塌，造成‘改进的假象’，使实务者误以为系统在变好，而实际上拒绝质量（正确筛掉违约者的能力）在恶化。作者提出一种无需统计假设的受控探索策略——有意批准一部分被拒申请者并观察其真实结果——并证明即使 2–5% 的最低探索率也足以诊断反馈回路的严重性，且成本近乎为零。
Motivation: 拒绝推断被广泛用于缓解信用评分中的幸存者偏差 (survival bias)，但其有效性长期缺乏系统理解，标准评估指标在选择偏差下可能产生误导。
Method: 对多种拒绝推断方法进行系统评估，并设计一种受控探索策略：贷款机构刻意批准部分被拒申请者并获得真实违约结果，从而打破评估反馈回路，且不依赖统计假设。
Result: 摘要报告准确率与拒绝质量在是否探索上给出相反建议：准确率倾向不探索，而拒绝质量随探索提升；2–5% 的最低探索率即可诊断反馈回路严重性，结果在两种机器学习方法和三个真实数据集上保持一致。
Conclusion: 作者认为，在幸存者偏差下训练出的模型，标准评估协议不足以评估其真实表现；探索策略能以极低成本暴露反馈回路问题，标准评估指标不应用于此类场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Inference for High-Dimensional Sparse Spectral Precision Matrices
papers.abstract_en: Statistical inference for the spectral precision matrix at a given frequency allows us to assess frequency-specific conditional relationships among the components of a stationary multivariate time series. Compared with classical analogues, inference in the spectral domain is more challenging due to the absence of closed-form asymptotic variance expressions for complex-valued estimators, the limited asymptotic theory in high-dimensional settings, and the presence of truncation and smoothing biases in finite samples. We construct a debiased complex graphical lasso estimator at any fixed frequency by leveraging the full likelihood structure of neighboring discrete Fourier transforms. Using asymptotic distributions for bilinear forms of stationary multivariate time series, we establish the joint asymptotic normality of the real and imaginary parts of the debiased estimator. Our main theoretical contributions include deriving a closed-form asymptotic covariance matrix for the real and imaginary parts, establishing a central limit theorem for bilinear forms of the underlying time series, and controlling smoothing and truncation biases in covariance estimation to ensure valid inference. Simulation studies demonstrate reliable coverage and improved statistical power relative to the benchmark, while maintaining false discovery rates near the nominal level. An application to real fMRI data further reveals distinct patterns of functional connectivity across selected frequencies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对固定频率下谱精度矩阵 (spectral precision matrix) 的统计推断问题，构建了一个去偏的复数图套索 (debiased complex graphical lasso) 估计量，并利用邻近离散傅里叶变换的完整似然结构。作者证明了去偏估计量实部与虚部的联合渐近正态性，给出闭式渐近协方差矩阵，并控制平滑与截断偏差以保证推断有效性。模拟实验显示覆盖率可靠、统计功效优于基准方法，fMRI 数据应用揭示了不同频率下功能连接模式的差异。
Motivation: 谱域的推断比经典时域推断更难，原因是复数估计量缺乏闭式渐近方差表达式、高维情形下的渐近理论有限，以及有限样本中存在截断与平滑偏差。这阻碍了对平稳多元时间序列在给定频率下条件关系的可靠推断。
Method: 利用相邻离散傅里叶变换的完整似然结构，构造任意固定频率下去偏的复数图套索估计量；借助平稳多元时间序列双线性形式 (bilinear forms) 的渐近分布，建立估计量实部与虚部的联合渐近正态性，并给出闭式渐近协方差矩阵和偏差控制方案。
Result: 模拟研究表明，相比基准方法，该方法实现了可靠的覆盖率并提升了统计功效，同时将错误发现率 (false discovery rate) 维持在名义水平附近。对真实 fMRI 数据的应用进一步显示了所选频率间不同的功能连接模式。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，同时控制平滑和截断偏差是确保谱域统计推断有效性的关键，去偏方法可在高维平稳时间序列中实现频率特异的条件关系推断。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Do Transformers Need Three Projections? Systematic Study of QKV Variants
papers.abstract_en: Transformers have become the standard solution for various AI tasks, with the query, key, and value (QKV) attention formulation playing a central role. However, the individual contribution of these three projections and the impact of omitting some remain poorly understood. We systematically evaluate three projection sharing constraints: a) Q-K=V (shared key-value), b) Q=K-V (shared query-key), and c) Q=K=V (single projection). The last two variants produce symmetric attention maps; to address this, we also explore asymmetric attention via 2D positional encodings. Through experiments spanning synthetic tasks, vision (MNIST, CIFAR, TinyImageNet, anomaly), and language modeling (300M and 1.2B parameter models on 10B tokens), we discovered that our transformers perform on par or occasionally better than the QKV transformer. In language modeling, Q-K=V projection sharing achieves 50% KV cache reduction with only 3.1% perplexity degradation. Crucially, projection sharing is complementary to head sharing (GQA/MQA): combining Q-K=V with GQA-4 yields 87.5% cache reduction, while Q-K=V + MQA achieves 96.9%, enabling practical on-device inference. We show that Q-K=V preserves quality because keys and values can occupy similar representational spaces and attention operates in a low-rank regime, whereas Q=K-V breaks attention directionality. Our results systematically characterize projection sharing as an underexplored instance of weight tying in attention, with direct, quantifiable inference memory benefits, particularly valuable for edge deployment. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/Brainchip-Inc/Do-Transformers-Need-3-Projections
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 (PMLR vol. 306). 26 pages, 12 figures, 16 tables. Code: https://github.com/Brainchip-Inc/Do-Transformers-Need-3-Projections
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了 Transformer 注意力中三种投影共享约束：Q-K=V（共享 key-value）、Q=K-V（共享 query-key）和 Q=K=V（单一投影），并与标准 QKV 注意力对比。实验覆盖合成任务、视觉（MNIST、CIFAR、TinyImageNet、异常检测）和语言建模（300M 与 1.2B 参数模型、10B tokens）。结果表明 Q-K=V 共享在语言建模上仅带来 3.1% 的 perplexity 退化，却减少 50% KV cache；与 GQA-4 或 MQA 组合时缓存分别减少 87.5% 和 96.9%，利于设备端推理。
Motivation: QKV 三个投影各自的贡献以及省略部分投影的影响尚不明确，理解这一点可在保持质量的同时降低注意力的推理内存开销，尤其对边缘部署有价值。
Method: 提出并系统比较三类投影共享约束；对产生对称注意力图的 Q=K-V 和 Q=K=V 变体，使用 2D 位置编码探索非对称注意力；并通过表示空间相似性与低秩性质分析解释不同共享方式的优劣。
Result: 摘要报告 Q-K=V 共享在语言建模中达到 50% KV cache 缩减且仅退化 3.1% perplexity，性能与 QKV Transformer 持平甚至略优；Q-K=V + GQA-4 实现 87.5% cache 缩减，Q-K=V + MQA 实现 96.9%。分析显示 key 与 value 可占据相似表示空间且注意力处于低秩 regime，而 Q=K-V 破坏注意力的方向性。
Conclusion: 投影共享是注意力中一种未被充分研究的权重绑定（weight tying）形式，可带来直接可量化的推理内存收益，尤其适合边缘部署；作者指出 Q-K=V 是有效变体，而 Q=K-V 会损害注意力方向性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Zoom In, Reason Out: Efficient Far-field Anomaly Detection in Expressway Surveillance Videos via Focused VLM Reasoning Guided by Bayesian Inference
papers.abstract_en: Expressway video anomaly detection is important for traffic safety, but remains challenging across diverse scenes, particularly for far-field vehicles with subtle abnormal motion. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) provide strong semantic reasoning capabilities, yet processing full frames can dilute evidence from distant targets and introduce substantial computational overhead. To address these challenges, we propose VIBES, an asynchronous framework that uses Bayesian inference to guide focused VLM reasoning. Specifically, an online kinematics-guided Bayesian inference module continuously estimates a context-dependent normal-motion distribution from vehicle trajectories and updates its probabilistic boundaries. Deviations from these boundaries produce asynchronous triggers that localize candidate anomalies in time and space. Instead of processing continuous full-frame video, the VLM reasons only over selected frames and localized visual regions associated with the triggers, reducing irrelevant visual content and unnecessary inference. Extensive experiments show that VIBES improves far-field anomaly detection and semantic interpretation while achieving real-time processing efficiency across diverse expressway conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VIBES，一个异步框架，利用贝叶斯推断引导聚焦的 VLM 推理，用于高速公路监控视频中的远场异常检测。在线运动学引导的贝叶斯推断模块从车辆轨迹估计上下文相关的正常运动分布并更新概率边界，偏离边界产生异步触发以在时空中定位候选异常；VLM 只对触发关联的选定帧和局部图像区域推理。摘要报告 VIBES 在多样高速场景下提升远场异常检测和语义解释能力，同时达到实时处理效率。
Motivation: 高速公路视频异常检测在远场车辆细微异常运动场景下依然困难，而 VLM 处理全帧会稀释远处目标证据并引入大量计算开销。
Method: 提出 VIBES 异步框架：在线运动学引导的贝叶斯推断模块持续估计正常运动分布并更新概率边界，偏离边界产生的异步触发用于定位候选异常；VLM 仅对与触发相关的选定帧和局部区域进行推理，而非连续全帧视频。
Result: 摘要报告 VIBES 提升了远场异常检测与语义解释性能，并在多样高速公路条件下实现实时处理效率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调只对触发选定的帧和局部区域推理可以降低无关视觉内容和冗余推理，从而兼顾检测精度与计算效率。

papers.title: IACDM: Interactive Adversarial Convergence Development Methodology -- A Structured Framework for AI-Assisted Software Development
papers.abstract_en: Adoption of AI-assisted development in 2025 exposed a tool-agnostic failure pattern: experienced developers using frontier models were measurably slower while believing they were faster, and 10.3% of applications in one production showcase leaked data through misconfigured access. These failures share a structural cause, the verification gap: absent external tool use, no language model can determine whether what it generated is correct. The tool is irrelevant; the process is determinative. We present IACDM (Interactive Adversarial Convergence Development Methodology), an 8-phase framework in which verification agents external to the generator operate at discrete gates, and the AI alternates between building artifacts and attacking them through specialized critique lenses. What distinguishes it from the review and red-teaming traditions it borrows from is that the gate is enforced by a state machine outside the model: the agent may request advancement, not grant it. One component has now been tested. A pre-registered experiment over twelve projects under a single frozen instrument asked whether the nineteen lenses are non-redundant, against a prior expectation from replications of Perspective-Based Reading, which found reading perspectives not to differ. Every lens found at least one defect no other lens found, under four independent judgements of what counts as the same defect. Two further results were unplanned: the taxonomy withstands testing while the criterion deciding when to apply it does not, and the method creates commitments nothing ever re-confronts with the built system. The method was otherwise developed at one industrial R&D institute. That evidence establishes applicability, not effectiveness: no project ran without the method, and the proponents are the evaluators. Whether IACDM outperforms direct prompting remains open, and this paper is written to make it refutable.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IACDM（Interactive Adversarial Convergence Development Methodology），一个面向 AI 辅助软件开发的 8 阶段框架，核心是让生成模型之外的外部验证智能体在离散门控处运行，并让 AI 交替进行工件构建与攻击性批判。一个预注册实验在 12 个项目上检验其 19 个批判视角（lens）是否冗余，结果显示每个视角都能发现其他视角未发现的缺陷。作者明确表示该证据只建立了适用性（applicability），未建立有效性（effectiveness）。
Motivation: 2025 年 AI 辅助开发实践暴露出与具体工具无关的失败模式：有经验的开发者使用前沿模型时实际更慢却自认为更快，且一个生产展示中 10.3% 的应用因访问配置错误导致数据泄露。作者将这些失败归因于验证缺口（verification gap）：在没有外部工具的情况下，语言模型无法判断自己生成的内容是否正确，因此问题在于流程而非工具。
Method: IACDM 是一个 8 阶段框架，其门控由模型外部的状态机强制执行：验证智能体在离散门控处工作，代理只能请求推进，不能自行批准推进。AI 在构建工件与通过专门批判视角攻击工件之间交替；已测试的组件包含 19 个视角，实验设计为单一冻结工具下的预注册测试。
Result: 在 12 个项目的预注册实验中，每个视角都至少发现了一个其他视角未发现的缺陷，且在四种关于缺陷同一性的独立判断标准下均成立。另有两个非计划结果：分类法经受住了测试，但其应用判据未经受住测试；该方法产生的承诺从未与最终构建的系统重新对照。
Conclusion: 作者强调现有证据只表明该方法具有适用性而非有效性：没有任何项目在不使用该方法的情况下运行，且评估者即提出者本身。IACDM 是否优于直接提示（direct prompting）仍是开放问题，论文的写作目标就是使其可被反驳。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: EvoTale: Continual Character Customization for Expanding Story Worlds
papers.abstract_en: Character-centric story visualization aims to synthesize coherent image sequences that depict narrative events and interactions while preserving recurring character identities. In expanding story worlds, new user-specified characters must be continually incorporated despite varying customization difficulty and identity conflicts in multi-character scenes, without disrupting previously learned identities. In this paper, we propose EvoTale, a continual character customization framework for expanding stylized story worlds. We first introduce an All-in-One-World Character Integrator, which accumulates character-specific residual components within a unified LoRA branch using sparsely overlapping subspaces spanned by a shared orthonormal basis, while freezing previously learned components to limit cross-character coupling. We then develop a Character Quality Gate that uses rubric-guided MLLM feedback as a bounded controller to adapt the optimization budget based on the assessed customization quality. Finally, we propose Character-Aware Region-Focus Sampling, which combines bounding-box-guided regional denoising with identity-aware global denoising to preserve character identities within their designated regions while maintaining global narrative coherence. Experimental results show that EvoTale achieves a favorable balance across character fidelity, continual identity retention, multi-character generation quality, and story-text alignment compared with representative story visualization and customization methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EvoTale，一个面向不断扩展的叙事世界的持续角色定制框架，用于角色为中心的故事可视化。框架包含三个组件：All-in-One-World Character Integrator 在统一 LoRA 分支中通过共享标准正交基张成的稀疏重叠子空间累积角色残差组件并冻结旧组件；Character Quality Gate 利用 rubric 引导的 MLLM 反馈作为有界控制器来调整优化预算；Character-Aware Region-Focus Sampling 结合边界框引导的区域去噪与身份感知全局去噪。实验表明，与代表性故事可视化和定制方法相比，EvoTale 在角色保真度、持续身份保留、多角色生成质量和故事文本对齐之间取得了良好平衡。
Motivation: 在持续扩展的叙事世界中，需要不断整合用户指定的新角色，但定制难度各不相同，且多角色场景中存在身份冲突，同时不能破坏先前学到的角色身份。现有方法难以同时满足这些要求。
Method: 提出 EvoTale 持续角色定制框架：All-in-One-World Character Integrator 在单一 LoRA 分支内累积各角色的残差组件，使用共享正交基下的稀疏重叠子空间并冻结已学组件以限制跨角色耦合；Character Quality Gate 以 rubric 引导的 MLLM 反馈作为有界控制器，依据评估出的定制质量调节优化预算；Character-Aware Region-Focus Sampling 将边界框引导的区域去噪与身份感知的全局去噪相结合，在指定区域保持角色身份的同时维护全局叙事连贯性。
Result: 实验对比了多种代表性故事可视化和角色定制方法，EvoTale 在角色保真度、持续身份保留、多角色生成质量以及故事文本对齐四个方面取得了较好的平衡。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架能够在风格化叙事世界中持续加入新角色并保留已有身份，核心贡献在于将角色残差累积、质量门控优化预算和区域聚焦采样三者结合。
Relevance: 5
