papers.title: CangjieBench: Benchmarking LLMs on a Low-Resource General-Purpose Programming Language
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models excel in high-resource programming languages but struggle with low-resource ones. Existing research related to low-resource programming languages primarily focuses on Domain-Specific Languages (DSLs), leaving general-purpose languages that suffer from data scarcity underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce CangjieBench, a contamination-free benchmark for Cangjie, a representative low-resource general-purpose language. The benchmark comprises 248 high-quality samples manually translated from HumanEval and ClassEval, covering both Text-to-Code and Code-to-Code tasks. We conduct a systematic evaluation of diverse LLMs under four settings: Direct Generation, Syntax-Constrained Generation, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Agent. Experiments reveal that Direct Generation performs poorly, whereas Syntax-Constrained Generation offers the best trade-off between accuracy and computational cost. Agent achieve state-of-the-art accuracy but incur high token consumption. Furthermore, we observe that Code-to-Code translation often underperforms Text-to-Code generation, suggesting a negative transfer phenomenon where models overfit to the source language patterns. We hope that our work will offer valuable insights into LLM generalization to unseen and low-resource programming languages. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/cjhCoder7/CangjieBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CangjieBench，一个针对低资源通用编程语言 Cangjie 的无污染基准，包含 248 个从 HumanEval 和 ClassEval 人工翻译的高质量样本，覆盖 Text-to-Code 与 Code-to-Code 两类任务。作者系统评估了多种 LLM 在 Direct Generation、Syntax-Constrained Generation、RAG 和 Agent 四种设置下的表现，发现 Direct Generation 效果差，Syntax-Constrained Generation 在准确率与计算成本间权衡最佳，Agent 准确率最高但 token 消耗大，且 Code-to-Code 翻译往往不如 Text-to-Code 生成，存在负迁移现象。
Motivation: LLM 在高资源编程语言上表现优秀，但在低资源语言上表现困难；已有低资源编程语言研究主要集中于领域特定语言 (DSL)，对数据稀缺的通用目的语言探索不足。
Method: 构建 CangjieBench 基准，将 HumanEval 和 ClassEval 人工翻译为 248 个样本，覆盖 Text-to-Code 和 Code-to-Code 任务，并在 Direct Generation、Syntax-Constrained Generation、Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) 和 Agent 四种设置下对多种 LLM 进行系统评估。
Result: 实验显示 Direct Generation 性能较差，Syntax-Constrained Generation 在准确率和计算成本之间取得最佳权衡；Agent 达到最高准确率但 token 消耗高。此外，Code-to-Code 翻译通常不如 Text-to-Code 生成，表明模型对源语言模式过拟合并产生负迁移。
Conclusion: 作者希望该工作为 LLM 向未见过的、低资源编程语言的泛化提供见解，并已开源代码与数据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Unified Framework for Joint Detection of Lacunes and Enlarged Perivascular Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Cerebral small vessel disease (CSVD) markers, specifically enlarged perivascular spaces (EPVS) and lacunae, present a unique challenge in medical image analysis due to their radiological mimicry. Standard segmentation networks struggle with feature interference and extreme class imbalance when handling these divergent targets simultaneously. To address these issues, we propose a morphology-decoupled framework where Zero-Initialized Gated Cross-Task Attention exploits dense EPVS context to guide sparse lacune detection. Furthermore, biological and topological consistency are enforced via a mixed-supervision strategy integrating Mutual Exclusion and Centerline Dice losses. Finally, we introduce an Anatomically-Informed Inference Calibration mechanism to dynamically suppress false positives based on tissue semantics. Extensive 5-folds cross-validation on the VALDO 2021 dataset (N=40) demonstrates state-of-the-art performance, notably surpassing task winners in lacunae detection precision (71.1%, p=0.01) and F1-score (62.6%, p=0.03). Furthermore, evaluation on the external EPAD cohort (N=1762) confirms the model's robustness for large-scale population studies. Code will be released upon acceptance.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 29th International Conference on Medical Image Computing and Computer Assisted Intervention (MICCAI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一框架，用于联合检测脑小血管病（CSVD）的两种放射学相似标志物——扩大的血管周围间隙（EPVS）和腔隙（lacunae）。框架通过形态解耦、零初始化门控交叉任务注意力（Zero-Initialized Gated Cross-Task Attention）、混合监督以及解剖学推理校准，解决标准分割网络在这类任务中的特征干扰和极端类别不平衡问题。在VALDO 2021数据集和外部EPAD队列上的实验显示，该方法的腔隙检测精度和F1分数超过了任务获胜者。
Motivation: 腔隙和扩大的血管周围间隙在影像上表现相似，标准分割网络难以同时处理这两种目标，容易产生特征干扰并面临极端类别不平衡，导致联合检测效果不佳。
Method: 提出形态解耦框架，其中Zero-Initialized Gated Cross-Task Attention利用密集的EPVS上下文信息引导稀疏腔隙检测；通过混合监督策略整合互斥损失（Mutual Exclusion loss）和中心线Dice损失（Centerline Dice loss）以保持生物学和拓扑一致性；最后引入Anatominally-Informed Inference Calibration机制，基于组织语义动态抑制假阳性。
Result: 在VALDO 2021数据集（N=40）上进行的5折交叉验证实现了当前最优性能，腔隙检测精度达到71.1%（p=0.01），F1分数达到62.6%（p=0.03），优于任务获胜者；外部EPAD队列（N=1762）的评估验证了模型在大规模人群研究中的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者表明所提出的框架在CSVD标志物联合检测方面达到了先进水平，并能在大规模人群研究中保持稳健；代码将在论文被接收后发布。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Prior-Aware Metric for Efficiently Distinguishing Memorization from Generalization in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Training data leakage from Large Language Models (LLMs) raises serious concerns related to privacy, security, and copyright compliance. A central challenge in assessing this risk is distinguishing prefix-specific memorization of training data from the generation of statistically common sequences. Existing approaches to measuring memorization often conflate these phenomena, labeling outputs as memorized even when they arise from generalization over common patterns. Counterfactual memorization and other related metrics \citep{zhang2023counterfactual, wang2025generalization, lesci2024causal} provide principled solutions, however, their reliance on retraining multiple baseline models or parsing through the training data makes them computationally impractical at scale. This work introduces \emph{Prior-Aware memorization}, a theoretically grounded, lightweight and training-free criterion for identifying prefix-specific memorization in LLMs. The key idea is to evaluate whether a candidate suffix is strongly associated with its specific training prefix or whether it appears with high probability across many IID sampled sequences from the training data distribution due to statistical commonality. We correlate our metric with counterfactual memorization, and also evaluate it on the training corpora of two pre-trained models, LLaMA and OPT. Our results show that between 55\% and 90\% of sequences previously labeled as memorized fail our criterion and are consistent with statistical commonality
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Prior-Aware memorization，一种基于理论支撑、无需训练 (training-free) 的轻量判据，用于区分大语言模型中的 prefix-specific memorization 与基于统计常见模式 (statistical commonality) 的生成行为。作者将该指标与 counterfactual memorization 相关联，并在 LLaMA 和 OPT 两个预训练模型的训练语料上评估，发现此前被标记为 memorized 的序列中有 55% 到 90% 并不满足该判据，而更符合统计常见性。
Motivation: 现有衡量 LLM 训练数据泄漏的指标常把 prefix-specific memorization 与常见序列的泛化生成混为一谈，导致误报；counterfactual memorization 等方法虽有原则性定义，但依赖重训多个基线模型或解析训练数据，在大规模场景下计算代价过高。
Method: 提出 Prior-Aware memorization 判据：判断某个候选后缀是否与其特定训练前缀强关联，还是以较高概率出现在训练数据分布下大量 IID 采样序列中，从而将记忆与统计常见性分离；该方法无需训练、不检索训练数据即可计算。
Result: 该指标与 counterfactual memorization 相关；在 LLaMA 和 OPT 的训练语料上，约有 55% 到 90% 原本被标记为 memorized 的序列未通过该判据，与统计常见性一致。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作提供了一种理论上可解释且可扩展的指标，可更准确地识别 LLM 对特定训练前缀的记忆，从而改进隐私、安全与版权风险评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Latency-Aware Orchestration for Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems (MAS) coordinate multiple LLM-powered agents through structured workflows, gaining reasoning power but incurring high inference latency from multi-step execution and repeated model invocations. Existing orchestration methods primarily optimize task performance and inference cost, leaving latency largely unaddressed. In MAS, end-to-end latency is governed by the \textit{critical execution path}, so reducing total cost alone does not reliably reduce latency. Moreover, optimizing latency while preserving accuracy remains non-trivial: naive latency optimization can misassign operator-level credit and degrade task accuracy. To address this gap, we propose \textbf{L}atency-\textbf{A}ware \textbf{M}ulti-\textbf{a}gent \textbf{S}ystem (\textbf{LAMaS}), a latency-aware orchestration framework for learning-based multi-agent systems. LAMaS addresses this challenge at two levels: at \emph{training time}, it learns latency-aware execution graphs through constrained optimization with critical-path-aware credit assignment; at \emph{inference time}, since a graph committed at training time cannot exploit runtime evidence, it complements graph construction with a lightweight controller that adaptively eliminates redundant future agent interactions as execution unfolds. Experiments on four benchmarks show that LAMaS achieves the best latency among evaluated learning-based MAS baselines, reducing end-to-end latency by over 50% while maintaining competitive or better accuracy. LAMaS is also modular and transfers to other MAS with minimal changes, consistently yielding latency reductions.
papers.comment: Preprint. Previously this version appeared as arXiv:2607.13359 which was submitted as a new work by accident
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LAMaS，一个面向基于学习的多智能体系统 (multi-agent systems) 的延迟感知编排框架。针对 LLM 智能体多步执行和重复模型调用带来的高推理延迟，LAMaS 在训练时通过关键路径感知的信用分配和约束优化学习延迟感知执行图，并在推理时用轻量控制器自适应消除冗余的未来智能体交互。在四个基准上，LAMaS 相比评估的基于学习的 MAS 基线实现了最佳延迟，端到端延迟降低超过 50%，同时保持相当或更好的准确率。
Motivation: 现有多智能体编排方法主要优化任务性能和推理成本，基本未专门处理延迟；且端到端延迟由关键执行路径 (critical execution path) 决定，仅降低总成本并不总能降低延迟，而朴素延迟优化可能错误分配算子级信用并损害任务准确率。
Method: LAMaS 采用两级机制：训练时通过关键路径感知的信用分配和约束优化学习延迟感知执行图；推理时用轻量控制器根据运行证据自适应地消除冗余的未来智能体交互，弥补训练时固定图无法利用运行时信息的问题。
Result: 在四个基准上的实验表明，LAMaS 在学习型 MAS 基线中取得最低延迟，端到端延迟降低超过 50%，同时准确率保持竞争力或更好；该框架具有模块性，能以最小改动迁移到其他 MAS 并持续获得延迟降低。
Conclusion: 摘要强调延迟感知编排需要同时在训练时学习执行图、在推理时动态剪枝，LAMaS 证明显著降低延迟的同时可以保持准确率，并具备跨 MAS 的可迁移性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Architecture Before the Formula: Individuating Neural Architecture Beyond the Composite Map
authors: Luis F. Rosario Freytes (University of Michigan)
papers.abstract_en: Neural architecture is often identified by module syntax, computation graphs, or the composite functions they realize. These descriptions answer different identity questions. We study the represented process available at a receiver: an actual factorization $B_j=G_jQ_j$ in which $Q_j(x)$ is the intermediate state supplied for further computation. Forgetting the presentation and retaining only $\ker Q_j$ yields the predecessor distinctions preserved at that cut. For a fixed branch, this extensional shadow exactly classifies unmarked surjective factorizations up to unique carrier re-presentation, but it does not determine marked receiver organization or the accessibility of retained information to restricted continuations. Under composition the relevant interface is $Q_{j,θ}A$, so downstream architectural distinctions depend on the states produced upstream. An exact two-token construction shows that local and attention schemas are distinction-equivalent after one injective prefix and inequivalent after another, even though neither prefix loses predecessor information. The result exposes a context dependence hidden by modular architecture labels and motivates architecture comparison at the represented-process level.
papers.comment: 34 pages. Major reconstruction and retitling of the withdrawn previous version. The incorrect non-completability theorem and all dependent claims have been removed. The present version replaces the earlier operator-first development with an analysis of neural-architecture individuation and architecture under composition. Submitted to JMLR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究神经网络架构的个体化（individuation）问题，主张架构不应仅由模块语法、计算图或实现的复合函数来识别，而应从接收端可获得的表示过程（represented process）出发。作者以实际因子分解 B_j=G_jQ_j 为对象，考察中间状态 Q_j(x)、其核 ker Q_j 以及组合下的接口 Q_{j,θ}A，并通过一个精确的双 token 构造展示局部（local）与注意力（attention）模式在不同前缀下等价与不等价，说明架构区分依赖上游语境。
Motivation: 模块语法、计算图和复合函数等常见架构描述回答的是不同同一性问题，缺少对接收端可用表示过程的刻画；作者希望分析这种被模块化架构标签掩盖的上下文依赖。
Method: 对因子分解进行形式分析：遗忘表示形式、仅保留 ker Q_j 得到该切分处保留的前驱区分（extensional shadow），并证明它可对无标记的满射因子分解进行分类；随后把组合下的相关接口定义为 Q_{j,θ}A，并用双 token 构造比较不同架构模式。
Result: 摘要报告：固定的分支上，extensional shadow 能精确分类无标记满射因子分解（至多差唯一载体再表示），但无法确定有标记的接收端组织或受限续接对保留信息的可及性；一个双 token 构造显示，局部模式和注意力模式在某个单射前缀后区分等价、在另一个前缀后区分不等价，且两个前缀都不丢失前驱信息。
Conclusion: 该结果揭示模块化架构标签所隐藏的语境依赖，并支持在表示过程层面进行架构比较。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.motivation: 模块语法、计算图和复合函数等常见架构描述回答的是不同同一性问题，缺少对接收端可用表示过程的刻画；作者希望分析这种被模块化架构标签掩盖的上下文依赖。
summary_sections.method: 对因子分解进行形式分析：遗忘表示形式、仅保留 ker Q_j 得到该切分处保留的前驱区分（extensional shadow），并证明它可对无标记的满射因子分解进行分类；随后把组合下的相关接口定义为 Q_{j,θ}A，并用双 token 构造比较不同架构模式。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告：固定的分支上，extensional shadow 能精确分类无标记满射因子分解（至多差唯一载体再表示），但无法确定有标记的接收端组织或受限续接对保留信息的可及性；一个双 token 构造显示，局部模式和注意力模式在某个单射前缀后区分等价、在另一个前缀后区分不等价，且两个前缀都不丢失前驱信息。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该结果揭示模块化架构标签所隐藏的语境依赖，并支持在表示过程层面进行架构比较。

papers.title: Reduced Order Modeling for Tsunami Forecasting with Bayesian Hierarchical Pooling
papers.abstract_en: Reduced-order models (ROMs) can represent spatiotemporal processes in significantly fewer dimensions and can often be solved many orders of magnitude faster than their governing partial differential equations (PDEs). For example, proper orthogonal decomposition yields a ROM in which the state is represented as a low-dimensional linear combination of fixed spatial modes and time-dependent coefficients, but this representation remains constrained by the process used to construct the basis. In this work, we explore a new type of ROM that is not restricted to a single fixed coefficient trajectory. Specifically, we consider a corrected Galerkin-projection ROM, formulated as an initial value problem that encodes the physics of the governing PDEs and is calibrated through operator corrections to more accurately reproduce the coefficient dynamics. By combining this corrected reduced model with a Bayesian hierarchical pooling framework over the initial reduced coefficients, we obtain new, statistically interpretable and physically grounded coefficient trajectories that generalize across related scenarios. When recombined with the spatial modes, these trajectories define a complete probabilistic physics surrogate, called a randPROM, for generating simulations that are distributionally consistent with a neighborhood of initial conditions near those used to construct the ROM. We apply the randPROM framework to tsunami modeling, a setting involving unpredictable, catastrophic, and strongly nonlinear dynamics, using both a synthetic case study near Fiji and the real-world 2011 Tohoku tsunami. We demonstrate that randPROMs can substantially reduce the number of full simulations required while providing statistically calibrated and physically defensible predictions of tsunami wave arrival times and heights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的概率降阶模型 (ROM) 框架 randPROM，将修正的 Galerkin 投影 ROM 与贝叶斯分层池化 (Bayesian hierarchical pooling) 结合，生成与构造 ROM 所用初始条件邻域分布一致的仿真。该方法应用于海啸预测，包括斐济附近的合成案例和 2011 年东日本大地震海啸，摘要称可大幅减少所需的全仿真次数，并提供统计校准且物理上合理的波到达时间和波高预测。
Motivation: 传统 ROM（如本征正交分解 proper orthogonal decomposition）将状态表示为固定空间模态与时间系数的低维线性组合，但受限于构造基的过程，难以在相关场景间灵活泛化。作者希望突破单一固定系数轨迹的限制，构造兼具统计可解释性和物理基础的代理模型。
Method: 提出以初值问题形式编码控制 PDE 物理的修正 Galerkin 投影 ROM，通过算子修正 (operator corrections) 校准系数动力学；再将该修正 ROM 与对初始约化系数的贝叶斯分层池化框架结合，获得跨相关场景泛化的系数轨迹，并与空间模态重组为完整的概率物理代理 randPROM。
Result: 在斐济附近合成案例和 2011 年东日本大地震海啸中，randPROM 被证明能显著减少全仿真的数量，同时给出统计校准且物理上可辩护的海啸波到达时间与波高预测。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将物理嵌入的修正 ROM 与贝叶斯分层池化相结合，可得到与初始条件邻域分布一致的仿真，为强非线性灾害场景提供概率代理；摘要未明确讨论方法的局限。

papers.title: Automated Design Optimization via Strategic Search with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Optimization methods have long advanced many fields, yet they struggle when faced with design problems where the search space and design parameters are difficult to define. Large language models (LLMs) offer a promising alternative by dynamically interpreting design spaces and leveraging encoded domain knowledge. To this end, we present AUTO: an iterative optimization framework that treats design optimization as a strategic search guided by LLM reasoning. The framework separates high-level planning by a Strategist agent from low-level implementation by concurrent Implementor agents, iteratively refining designs through explore-exploit strategies. We demonstrate AUTO on three GPU code optimization problems. For chemical kinetics, AUTO outperforms in-lab-optimized code by up to 1.74$\times$ for problem sizes up to $10^5$ cells. For matrix multiplication, AUTO achieves up to 94\% of cuBLAS double-precision performance. For KernelBench, we achieve speedups of up to 118$\times$ over PyTorch baselines across 29 problems spanning individual operators and full neural network architectures; however, cheating was frequently observed. A posteriori analysis reveals 50~--~70\% alignment with Bayesian optimization sampling strategies. All AUTO simulations ran within 100 iterations (about 10 hours), with estimated costs of \$15~--~159 per run for proprietary models. Furthermore, AUTO is built entirely on open-source LLMs and libraries, demonstrating affordability and data privacy. Given AUTO's generizability and flexibility, future work will explore domains beyond GPUs and supercomputing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AUTO，一个将设计优化视为由大语言模型 (LLM) 推理引导的迭代式战略搜索框架。框架将高层规划交给 Strategist agent，由并行的 Implementor agents 执行底层实现，通过探索-利用 (explore-exploit) 策略逐步改进设计。作者在三个 GPU 代码优化问题上验证 AUTO：化学动力学场景相比实验室优化代码最高提升 1.74 倍，矩阵乘法达到 cuBLAS 双精度性能的 94%，在 KernelBench 的 29 个问题上相对 PyTorch 基线最高获得 118 倍加速，但摘要同时指出作弊 (cheating) 现象频繁出现。
Motivation: 传统优化方法在搜索空间和设计参数难以定义的工程设计问题上表现受限，而 LLM 能动态理解设计空间并利用编码的领域知识，本文以此作为设计优化的替代思路。
Method: AUTO 框架将设计优化组织为 LLM 推理引导的战略搜索：Strategist agent 负责高层计划，多个并行的 Implementor agents 负责具体实现，通过探索-利用策略在迭代中精炼设计。框架完全基于开源 LLM 和库构建。
Result: 在化学动力学问题中，AUTO 最高比实验室优化代码快 1.74 倍（问题规模至 10^5 cells）；矩阵乘法达到 cuBLAS 双精度性能的 94%；在 KernelBench 上覆盖 29 个算子级和完整神经网络问题，获得最高 118 倍的 PyTorch 基线加速，但作弊现象被频繁观察到。事后分析显示其采样策略与贝叶斯优化有 50–70% 的一致性。所有实验在 100 次迭代内完成（约 10 小时），专有模型的单次运行成本估计为 15–159 美元。
Conclusion: 作者强调 AUTO 完全基于开源 LLM 与库，具备可负担性和数据隐私优势；鉴于其通用性和灵活性，未来工作将探索 GPU 与超算之外的领域。摘要同时承认作弊问题值得进一步审视。

papers.title: Functional Adjoint Sampler: Scalable Sampling on Infinite Dimensional Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Learning-based methods for sampling from the Gibbs distribution in finite-dimensional spaces have progressed quickly, yet theory and algorithmic design for infinite-dimensional function spaces remain limited. This gap persists despite their strong potential for sampling the paths of conditional diffusion processes, enabling efficient simulation of trajectories of diffusion processes that respect rare events or boundary constraints. In this work, we present the adjoint sampler for infinite-dimensional function spaces, a stochastic optimal control-based diffusion sampler that operates in function space and targets Gibbs-type distributions on infinite-dimensional Hilbert spaces. Our Functional Adjoint Sampler (FAS) generalizes Adjoint Sampling (Havens et al., 2025) to Hilbert spaces based on a SOC theory called stochastic maximum principle, yielding a simple and scalable matching-type objective for a functional representation. We show that FAS achieves superior transition path sampling performance across synthetic potential and real molecular systems, including Alanine Dipeptide and Chignolin.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Functional Adjoint Sampler (FAS)，一种基于随机最优控制 (stochastic optimal control) 的扩散采样器，直接在无穷维 Hilbert 函数空间上对 Gibbs 型分布进行采样，并将 Adjoint Sampling 方法推广到函数空间。摘要报告 FAS 在合成势能系统和真实分子系统（包括 Alanine Dipeptide 与 Chignolin）的转移路径采样任务上表现优越。
Motivation: 有限维空间中基于学习的 Gibbs 分布采样方法进展迅速，但无穷维函数空间的相应理论和算法设计仍然有限，尽管这类方法在采样条件扩散过程路径、模拟满足稀有事件或边界约束的扩散轨迹方面潜力很大。
Method: 基于称为随机最大原理 (stochastic maximum principle) 的最优控制理论，将 Adjoint Sampling 泛化到 Hilbert 空间，得到一个简单且可扩展的匹配型目标用于函数表示。
Result: 摘要表明 FAS 在合成势能系统和真实分子系统（包括 Alanine Dipeptide 与 Chignolin）上均取得优于现有方法的转移路径采样性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为 FAS 填补了无穷维函数空间上可扩展采样的算法空白，其价值主要体现在转移路径采样等应用；摘要未提及该方法与天气或降水领域的关联。

papers.title: Online Correlation Clustering: Simultaneously Optimizing All $\ell_p$-norms
papers.abstract_en: The $\ell_p$-norm objectives for correlation clustering present a fundamental trade-off between minimizing total disagreements (the $\ell_1$-norm) and ensuring fairness to individual nodes (the $\ell_\infty$-norm). Surprisingly, in the offline setting it is possible to simultaneously approximate all $\ell_p$-norms with a single clustering. Can this powerful guarantee be achieved in an online setting? This paper provides the first affirmative answer. We present a single algorithm for the online-with-a-sample (AOS) model that, given a small constant fraction of the input as a sample, produces one clustering that is simultaneously $O(\log^4 n)$-competitive for all $\ell_p$-norms with high probability, $O(\log n)$-competitive for the $\ell_\infty$-norm with high probability, and $O(1)$-competitive for the $\ell_1$-norm in expectation. This work successfully translates the offline "all-norms" guarantee to the online world. Our setting is motivated by a new hardness result that demonstrates a fundamental separation between these objectives in the standard random-order (RO) online model. Namely, while the $\ell_1$-norm is trivially $O(1)$-approximable in the RO model, we prove that any algorithm in the RO model for the fairness-promoting $\ell_\infty$-norm must have a competitive ratio of at least $Ω(n^{1/3})$. This highlights the necessity of a different beyond-worst-case model. We complement our algorithm with lower bounds, showing our competitive ratios for the $\ell_1$- and $\ell_\infty$- norms are nearly tight in the AOS model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在线相关聚类（online correlation clustering）中同时优化所有 $\ell_p$-范数目标的问题。作者在 online-with-a-sample (AOS) 模型下提出单一算法：给定输入的一小部分常数比例样本，该算法以高概率对所有 $\ell_p$-范数达到 $O(\log^4 n)$-competitive，以高概率对 $\ell_\infty$-范数达到 $O(\log n)$-competitive，并对 $\ell_1$-范数达到期望 $O(1)$-competitive。论文还证明了标准随机顺序（RO）模型中 $\ell_\infty$-范数竞争比的下界为 $\Omega(n^{1/3})$，说明需要超越最坏情况的模型。
Motivation: 离线设定下可以用单一聚类同时近似所有 $\ell_p$-范数目标，但这一强大保证能否推广到在线设定此前未知。标准 RO 模型中 $\ell_1$-范数平凡可 $O(1)$-逼近而 $\ell_\infty$-范数存在 $\Omega(n^{1/3})$ 下界，凸显了不同目标之间的根本分离，促使作者转向 AOS 模型。
Method: 提出 AOS 模型下的单一在线算法，利用输入的一小部分常数比例样本作为先验信息，输出一个聚类，并同时提供针对所有 $\ell_p$-范数的竞争比保证。
Result: 算法以高概率对所有 $\ell_p$-范数达到 $O(\log^4 n)$-competitive，以高概率对 $\ell_\infty$-范数达到 $O(\log n)$-competitive，并对 $\ell_1$-范数达到期望 $O(1)$-competitive。作者还证明任何 RO 模型算法对 $\ell_\infty$-范数的竞争比至少为 $\Omega(n^{1/3})$，并给出 AOS 模型下 $\ell_1$ 和 $\ell_\infty$ 竞争比的近紧下界。
Conclusion: 该工作首次将离线设定下的“所有范数”保证成功翻译到在线世界，并通过下界表明所获竞争比在 AOS 模型中接近最优，同时论证了标准 RO 模型无法同时处理公平性导向目标。

papers.title: A solution to generalized learning from small training sets found in infants repeated visual experiences of individual objects
papers.abstract_en: One-year-old infants rapidly form and generalize categories from idiosyncratic experiences of very few exemplars of those categories. Here we provide evidence on the statistics of infants daily-life visual experiences for 8 object categories. Using a corpus of infant head-camera images recorded at mealtimes (87 mealtimes,14 infants), we measure the frequency of the unique instances of each category and the variability of the visual experiences within and across instances of the same category. The frequency distributions of instances for individual infants are highly skewed, containing many images of the same few objects along with fewer images of other instances. Graph theoretic measures of individual category experiences for individual children reveal a lumpy mix of high similarity and high variability, organized into multiple but interconnected clusters of high-similarity images. In computational experiments, we show that artificially created training sets characterized by an interconnected mix of high and low similarity support generalization to novel instances after limited training. We discuss implications for category recognition, and for learning more generally, by both humans and machines.

TL;DR: 本文利用 14 名婴儿在 87 次进餐时段的头戴相机影像语料，统计了 8 个物体类别在日常视觉经验中的实例频率与内部变异性，发现单个婴儿的类别经验呈高度偏斜分布，并由多个高相似度簇相互连接构成。计算实验表明，由这种高、低相似度交织构成的人工训练集在有限训练后能够支持对未见实例的泛化。作者讨论了该结果对类别识别以及人类与机器学习的启示。
Motivation: 一岁婴儿能从极少量样例的个体经验中快速形成并泛化类别，但自然视觉经验的统计结构尚不清楚，这制约了对小样本学习机制的理解。
Method: 基于婴儿头戴相机在进餐时拍摄的图像语料，测量每个类别唯一实例的频率以及类内、类间的视觉变异性，并用图论度量刻画个体类别经验的结构；随后构造人工训练集进行计算实验验证泛化效果。
Result: 摘要报告实例频率分布高度偏斜，同一类别经验呈现由高相似度簇相互连接组成的混合结构；人工构造的具有高、低相似度交织的训练集在有限训练后支持对新实例的泛化。
Conclusion: 作者认为该经验统计结构对类别识别以及更普遍的人类和机器小样本学习具有启示意义。

papers.title: RealMat: Realistic Materials with Diffusion and Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Generative models for high-quality materials are particularly desirable to make 3D content authoring more accessible. However, the majority of material generation methods are trained on synthetic data. Synthetic data provides precise supervision for material maps, which is convenient but also tends to create a significant visual gap with real-world materials. Alternatively, recent work used a small dataset of real flash photographs to guarantee realism, however such data is limited in scale and diversity. To address these limitations, we propose RealMat, a diffusion-based material generator that leverages realistic priors, including a text-to-image model and a dataset of realistic material photos under natural lighting. In RealMat, we first finetune a pretrained Stable Diffusion XL (SDXL) with synthetic material maps arranged in $2 \times 2$ grids. This way, our model inherits some realism of SDXL while learning the data distribution of the synthetic material grids. Still, this creates a realism gap, with some generated materials appearing synthetic. We propose to further finetune our model through reinforcement learning (RL), encouraging the generation of realistic materials. We develop a realism reward function for any material image under natural lighting, by collecting a large-scale dataset of realistic material images. We show that this approach increases generated materials' realism compared to our base model and related work.
papers.journal_ref: Computer Graphics Forum 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RealMat，一种基于扩散模型的材质生成器，旨在解决材质生成中合成数据与真实世界视觉差距显著、真实训练数据规模有限的问题。方法先用合成材质图（按 2×2 网格排列）微调预训练的 Stable Diffusion XL (SDXL)，再通过强化学习（RL）进一步微调，并设计一个基于大规模自然光照真实材质图像的逼真度奖励函数。摘要报告该方法相比基础模型和相关工作能生成更真实的材质。
Motivation: 多数材质生成方法在合成数据上训练，虽能提供精确监督但会带来明显的视觉差距；近年使用少量真实闪光照片保证真实感的工作又受限于数据规模和多样性。
Method: 首先用合成材质图（2×2 网格）微调预训练的 SDXL，使其继承模型的真实感并学习合成材质网格的数据分布；随后通过强化学习进一步微调，利用一个基于大规模自然光照真实材质图像数据集学习的奖励函数来鼓励生成逼真材质。
Result: 摘要显示该方法相比基础模型及相关工作提升了生成材质的真实感，但未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为结合合成数据的监督与真实材质先验（SDXL 微调加 RL 逼真度奖励）能缩小生成材质与真实世界的视觉差距。

papers.title: Unlearning at Scale: State-Exact Trace-Preserving Deletion in Billion-Parameter Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Can a prospectively instrumented training continuation reproduce a deletion counterfactual exactly after selected examples leave its replay dataset? We study a trace-preserving counterfactual that fixes recorded execution controls while assigning requested identifiers zero contribution. The guarantee is prospective: the original run must record this execution provenance and retain an eligible uncontaminated checkpoint. Under pinned single-GPU environments, replay from a token store materialized without the requested rows reconstructs a separately executed trace oracle bit-for-bit in model and optimizer state. Pythia 160M is exact across four deletion geometries; Pythia 2.8B matches all 2,775,208,960 model-state elements for a random 5% request; and Llama 3.2 1B is exact after omitting 400 of 4,000 TOFU examples from replay storage. These results establish billion-parameter state exactness. They do not establish cheap deletion, because dispersed requests can force nearly full replay. We release standardized TOFU/OpenUnlearning measurements as descriptive diagnostics only because the frozen campaign lacks the matched controls required for a causal behavioral claim.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. Code and frozen research records available at https://github.com/abdullah-x-bd/unlearning (v0.3.1)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究十亿参数语言模型中的精确样本删除（unlearning），提出一种可预期插桩（prospectively instrumented）的训练续跑方案：固定记录的执行控制，同时将被请求删除的标识符贡献设为零。通过从不含被删行的 token 存储中回放，模型与优化器状态能与单独执行的 trace oracle 逐位一致。实验在 Pythia 160M、Pythia 2.8B 和 Llama 3.2 1B 上达到状态级精确，但作者明确指出这不等于廉价删除，因为分散的删除请求可能迫使近乎完整的回放。
Motivation: 现有机器遗忘方法难以在训练数据部分移除后精确复现删除反事实（deletion counterfactual），且缺少可验证的逐位一致性保证；本文瞄准在保留执行溯源的前提下让被请求样本贡献为零的可复现删除。
Method: 采用前瞻式训练插桩记录执行来源（execution provenance），保留符合条件的未污染检查点，并从删除指定行后的 token 存储中回放训练；在固定的单 GPU 环境中，该回放可与另一次独立执行的 trace oracle 逐位对齐。
Result: Pythia 160M 在四种删除几何上完全精确；Pythia 2.8B 在随机 5% 删除请求下匹配全部 2,775,208,960 个模型状态元素；Llama 3.2 1B 在从回放存储中省略 TOFU 数据 400/4000 条后达到精确。作者同时声明这些结果证明十亿参数级状态精确性，但并未证明删除成本低廉。
Conclusion: 作者强调其贡献是建立十亿参数规模的逐位状态精确删除，而非廉价删除；TOFU/OpenUnlearning 上的标准化测量仅作为描述性诊断发布，因为该冻结测试战役缺少匹配对照组，不能据此做出因果性行为论断。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RulerNet: Learning Perspective-Invariant Ruler Representations for Robust Image Scale Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Accurately converting pixel measurements into absolute real-world dimensions remains a fundamental challenge in computer vision, limiting progress in applications such as biomedicine, forensics, nutritional analysis, and e-commerce. We introduce RulerNet, a deep learning framework that robustly infers scale in the wild by reformulating ruler reading as a unified keypoint detection problem and representing rulers with geometric progression parameters that compactly approximate the non-uniform spacing induced by perspective transformations. Unlike traditional methods that rely on handcrafted thresholds or rigid, ruler-specific pipelines, RulerNet directly localizes centimeter markings using a mark-visibility-based annotation and training strategy that remains valid under mark-preserving transformations, enabling strong generalization across diverse ruler types and imaging conditions while mitigating data scarcity. Additionally, we introduce a scalable synthetic data generation pipeline that combines graphics-based ruler creation with ControlNet-enhanced realism, significantly expanding training diversity and improving model performance. Extensive experiments on both our datasets and public benchmarks demonstrate that RulerNet achieves accurate, consistent, and efficient scale estimation under challenging real-world conditions. Integration into a medical analysis pipeline further demonstrates its practical utility for scale-aware measurement. These results suggest that RulerNet can serve as a generalizable measurement component and be readily integrated with other vision modules, such as segmentation, monocular depth estimation, and diagnostic workflows, for automated analysis in medical and other domains. An online demo is provided. The project page is at https://github.com/ymp5078/RulerNet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RulerNet，一个在现实场景中稳健推断图像尺度的深度学习框架，将标尺读数统一重构为关键点检测问题，并用几何级数参数 (geometric progression parameters) 紧凑地近似透视变换导致的非均匀刻度间距。摘要还介绍了一种基于标记可见性 (mark-visibility) 的标注与训练策略，以及结合图形学标尺创建和 ControlNet 增强真实感的合成数据生成流程，并在自建数据集和公共基准上验证了其在多样标尺类型和成像条件下的准确、一致且高效的尺度估计能力。
Motivation: 将像素测量准确转换为绝对真实世界尺寸仍是计算机视觉的基础难题，制约着生物医学、法医、营养分析和电子商务等应用；传统方法依赖手工阈值或 rigid 且特定于标尺的流程，难以泛化到不同的标尺类型和成像条件。
Method: RulerNet 将标尺读数视为统一的关键点检测问题，用几何级数参数表示标尺，以紧凑近似透视引起的非均匀刻度间距；采用基于标记可见性的标注和训练策略，使其在保持标记的变换下仍然有效；并引入一个可扩展的合成数据生成流程，将图形学标尺生成与 ControlNet 增强的真实感结合以缓解数据稀缺。
Result: 摘要报告在自建数据集和公共基准上的大量实验表明，RulerNet 在具有挑战性的现实条件下实现了准确、一致、高效的尺度估计，并通过对医学分析流程的集成展示了其在尺度感知测量中的实际效用。
Conclusion: 作者认为 RulerNet 可以作为一个可泛化的通用测量组件，与分割、单目深度估计等视觉模块以及诊断工作流方便集成，用于医学及其他领域的自动化分析。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Can Generalist Vision Language Models (VLMs) Rival Specialist Medical VLMs? Benchmarking and Strategic Insights
papers.abstract_en: Vision Language Models (VLMs) have shown promise in automating image diagnosis and interpretation in clinical settings. However, developing specialist medical VLMs requires substantial computational resources and carefully curated datasets, and it remains unclear under which conditions generalist and specialist medical VLMs each perform best. This study highlights the complementary strengths of specialist medical and generalist VLMs. Specialists remain valuable in modality-aligned use cases, but we find that efficiently fine-tuned generalist VLMs can achieve comparable or even superior performance in most tasks, particularly when transferring to unseen or rare OOD medical modalities. These results suggest that generalist VLMs, rather than being constrained by their lack of specialist medical pretraining, may offer a scalable and cost-effective pathway for advancing clinical AI development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了通用视觉语言模型（generalist VLM）和专业医学 VLM 在临床图像诊断任务上的表现，发现高效微调后的通用模型在多数任务上能达到甚至超过专业模型，尤其是在未见或罕见分布外医学模态上。作者据此提出，通用 VLM 可能为临床 AI 提供一条可扩展且成本更低的路径。
Motivation: 开发专业医学 VLM 需要大量计算资源和精心整理的数据集，但通用模型与专业模型各自在什么条件下表现更优仍不清楚，这给临床 AI 的部署选型带来不确定性。
Method: 通过基准测试对比专业医学 VLM 与通用 VLM，考察不同任务和模态对齐场景下的性能差异；研究侧重模式识别与策略洞见，而非提出新的训练算法。
Result: 专业模型在模态对齐的用例中仍有价值，但高效微调的通用 VLM 在大多数任务上可达到相当或更优的性能，尤其擅长迁移到未见或罕见的分布外医学模态。
Conclusion: 通用 VLM 无需依赖专业医学预训练即可胜出，可能成为推进临床 AI 开发的可扩展、经济高效的替代路径；摘要未提及具体数据集、指标或局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Efficient Image Restoration with State-Dependent Forward Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes to perform image restoration through a state-dependent mean-reverting forward diffusion (FoD) process. In contrast to traditional diffusion-based approaches that rely on a coupled forward-backward diffusion scheme, FoD directly learns image restoration through a single forward diffusion process, yielding a simple yet efficient framework. The core of FoD is a state-dependent stochastic differential equation (SDE) that involves a mean-reverting term in both the drift and diffusion functions. This mean-reverting structure drives the low-quality data toward the clean endpoint with controlled stochastic variation, therefore simulating a stochastic interpolation between source and target distributions. More importantly, FoD is analytically tractable and is trained using a simple stochastic flow matching objective, enabling few-step sampling during inference. The proposed FoD model, despite its simplicity, achieves strong overall performance on various image restoration tasks compared to representative diffusion, diffusion bridge, and flow matching approaches. The code is available at https://github.com/Algolzw/FoD.
papers.comment: Accepted by TMLR. Project page: https://algolzw.github.io/fod
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FoD（state-dependent mean-reverting forward diffusion），将图像修复建模为单一的前向扩散过程，而不是传统扩散模型所依赖的前后向耦合扩散方案。其核心是一个状态依赖的 SDE，在漂移和扩散函数中都包含均值回归项，使低质量数据在受控随机波动下向干净端点插值；该过程解析可处理，并用随机流匹配（stochastic flow matching）目标训练，支持推理时少步采样。摘要称 FoD 在多种图像修复任务上取得了与代表性扩散、扩散桥和流匹配方法相比有竞争力的整体性能。
Motivation: 传统基于扩散的图像修复依赖于耦合的前向-后向扩散方案，结构复杂且效率受限；本文希望直接通过单一前向扩散过程学习修复映射，以简化框架并提升效率。
Method: 提出状态依赖的均值回归前向扩散过程 FoD：构造包含均值回归项的 SDE，同时作用于漂移和扩散函数，模拟源分布到目标分布的随机插值；训练采用解析可处理的随机流匹配目标，推理时只需少步采样。
Result: 摘要报告，尽管 FoD 结构简单，它在多种图像修复任务上的整体性能可与代表性的扩散、扩散桥和流匹配方法相比，且支持少步采样。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者强调 FoD 作为单一前向扩散修复框架的简洁性与高效性，并公开了代码；其适用范围限定于图像修复任务。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Identification of Probabilities of Causation: from Recursive to Closed-Form Bounds
papers.abstract_en: Probabilities of causation (PoCs) are fundamental quantities for counterfactual analysis and personalized decision making. However, existing analytical results are largely confined to binary settings. This paper extends PoCs to multi-valued treatments and outcomes by deriving closed form bounds for a representative family of discrete PoCs within Structural Causal Models, using standard experimental and observational distributions. We introduce the notion of equivalence classes of PoCs, which reduces arbitrary discrete PoCs to this family, and establish a replaceability principle that transfers bounds across value permutations. For the resulting bounds, we prove soundness in all dimensions and empirically verify tightness in low dimensional cases via Balke's linear programming method; we further conjecture that this tightness extends to all dimensions. Simulations indicate that our closed form bounds consistently tighten recent recursive bounds while remaining simpler to compute. Finally, we illustrate the practical relevance of our results through toy examples.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把因果概率 (probabilities of causation, PoCs) 从二值情形推广到多值处理与多值结果，在结构因果模型 (Structural Causal Models) 中推导出一族代表性离散 PoCs 的闭式界。作者引入 PoCs 等价类与可替换原则 (replaceability principle)，证明所导出界在所有维度下 sound，并在低维情形用 Balke 线性规划验证 tightness。模拟显示闭式界一致收紧最新的递归界且计算更简单，并用玩具示例说明实际相关性。
Motivation: 现有 PoCs 的解析结果大多局限于二值设定，多值处理和结果下缺乏闭式识别界，限制了反事实分析与个性化决策的适用范围。
Method: 基于标准实验分布和观测分布，在结构因果模型下推导一族离散 PoCs 的闭式界；引入 PoCs 等价类将任意离散 PoCs 归约到该族，并提出可替换原则以在值置换之间迁移界；同时证明界的 soundness 并用 Balke 线性规划检验 tightness。
Result: 摘要报告在低维情形通过 Balke 线性规划方法验证了闭式界的 tightness；模拟显示闭式界一致收紧近期递归界且计算更简单；作者进一步猜想 tightness 在所有维度成立。
Conclusion: 作者将该工作定位为多值 PoCs 的识别工具：闭式界比递归界更紧、更易计算，但 tightness 目前仅在低维得到实证验证，高维情形以猜想形式提出。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Accelerated Markov Chain Monte Carlo Algorithms on Discrete States
papers.abstract_en: We propose a class of discrete state sampling algorithms based on Nesterov's accelerated gradient method, which extends the classical Metropolis-Hastings (MH) algorithm. The evolution of the discrete states probability distribution governed by MH can be interpreted as a gradient descent direction of the Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence, via a mobility function and a score function. Specifically, this gradient is defined on a probability simplex equipped with a discrete Wasserstein-2 metric with a mobility function. This motivates us to study a momentum-based acceleration framework using damped Hamiltonian flows on the simplex set, whose stationary distribution matches the discrete target distribution. Furthermore, we design an interacting particle system to approximate the proposed accelerated sampling dynamics. The extension of the algorithm with a general choice of potentials and mobilities is also discussed. In particular, we choose the accelerated gradient flow of the relative Fisher information, demonstrating the advantages of the algorithm in estimating discrete score functions without requiring the normalizing constant and keeping positive probabilities. Numerical examples, including sampling on a Gaussian mixture supported on lattices or a distribution on a hypercube, demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed discrete-state sampling algorithm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一类基于 Nesterov 加速梯度法的离散状态采样算法，将经典 Metropolis-Hastings (MH) 算法推广到带动量的框架。作者把 MH 驱动的离散概率分布演化解释为在带 mobility function 的离散 Wasserstein-2 度量下，KL 散度的梯度下降，并在概率单纯形上引入阻尼 Hamiltonian 流以构造加速采样动力学。文章还设计了交互粒子系统 (interacting particle system) 来近似该动力学，并讨论了一般势函数与 mobility 的扩展。数值实验在格点上的高斯混合分布和超立方体分布上验证了算法的有效性。
Motivation: 连续状态空间已有基于动量的加速采样方法，而离散状态上的经典 MH 采样收敛较慢；本文试图在离散状态上建立与连续情形对应的加速梯度流框架，从而获得更快且保持目标分布不变的采样算法。
Method: 将 MH 的分布演化解释为在带 mobility function 的离散 Wasserstein-2 度量下 KL 散度的梯度下降方向，进而在概率单纯形上构造基于阻尼 Hamiltonian 流的动量加速框架，使其平稳分布匹配离散目标分布；进一步设计交互粒子系统逼近该加速动力学，并扩展到一般势函数和 mobility，特别采用相对 Fisher 信息 (relative Fisher information) 的加速梯度流。
Result: 数值示例表明，该算法在格点支撑的高斯混合分布和超立方体分布上采样有效；摘要指出该算法估计离散 score function 时无需归一化常数，并能保持概率为正。
Conclusion: 作者给出的加速框架将经典 MH 算法推广到带动量的离散状态采样，并通过粒子系统近似实现；摘要未报告与其他基线的大规模定量对比，主要结论来自所展示的数值示例和一般化讨论。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: "Cause" is Mechanistic Narrative within Scientific Domains: An Ordinary Language Philosophical Critique of "Causal Machine Learning"
papers.abstract_en: Causal Learning has emerged as a major theme of research in statistics and machine learning in recent years, promising computational techniques to reveal ``true'' causality. In this paper, we critique the premise of causal learning by considering the epistemology of causality across disciplines, applying the Ordinary Language method of an anthropological investigation of customary word use in reasoning about cause and effect in the real world. We observe that although cause-and-effect semantics vary between scientific domains, they maintain a consistent central function of describing the mechanisms underlying forces most salient to the systems under research. A critical distinction is the degree to which the mathematical representations of the models used for statistical analysis exhibit a faithful correspondence to expert knowledge in mechanism. We demarcate 1) physics and engineering as domains wherein mathematical models are sufficient to comprehensively describe causality, in contrast to 2) biology, which studies open and irreducible systems with mechanisms crossing scales through emergence, and 3) the social sciences as suffering from compounding difficulties for precision but providing, through Hermeneutics, the potential for subjective phenomenology yielding findings instrumentally useful to individuals. We posit the greater the discrepancy between expert-defined models and complete characterization of mechanism, the more that epistemic virtue requires that definitive causal claims regarding phenomena can only come through an agglomeration of consistent evidence across multiple domains. Exercising greater caution in communicating the degree of certainty evidence provides, especially demanding restraint in the face of incentives to overstate research conclusions, is the only durable solution to modern science's collective action problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从日常语言哲学 (Ordinary Language) 视角批评因果机器学习的前提，认为"因果"在不同学科中语义不同，但其核心功能一致：描述所研究系统中关键机制。作者将物理学与工程学、生物学、社会科学按数学模型对机制表征的忠实程度区分，主张学科间机制表征差距越大，越需要跨领域一致证据聚合并谨慎沟通结论。
Motivation: 因果学习 (Causal Learning) 声称能通过计算方法揭示"真实"因果，但这种前提忽略了因果意义在不同科学领域中的差异性，可能导致过度自信的因果断言。
Method: 采用日常语言方法，对人类在现实世界中推理因果时的惯常用语进行人类学式考察，并比较数学统计模型与各领域专家机制知识的对应关系，以此划分不同学科的认识论条件。
Result: 摘要指出各学科因果语义虽不同但都围绕机制描述；物理学和工程学中数学模型足以刻画因果，生物学是开放的不可约系统而难以完整建模，社会科学虽精度困难却能通过诠释学 (Hermeneutics) 提供主观现象学的实用知识。
Conclusion: 作者认为专家模型与完整机制刻画之间差异越大，就越需要跨领域的汇聚证据才能支撑明确因果断言；并强调应谨慎表达证据的确定程度、克制夸大结论，以此应对现代科学的集体行动问题。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: MatchMiner-AI: Open-source, Privacy-preserving Cancer Clinical Trial Matching using Artificial Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Background: Clinical trials are essential to advancing cancer treatments, but fewer than 10% of adults with cancer enroll in therapeutic trials. Open-source AI trial matching tools could democratize access to trial options. Methods: We created MatchMiner-AI, co-developed with practicing clinical oncologists and trained on synthetic electronic health record (EHR) data. It uses open-weight LLMs to summarize patient histories from unstructured EHR text and extract target populations from trial eligibility documents. Embedding and re-ranking models were distilled to retrieve and rank trial and patient suggestions. Multifaceted evaluation was performed, including retrospective quantification of distillation fidelity; applying a closed-source LLM as judge of patient summarization and matching; and evaluation of candidate matches by oncologists. Results: Across retrospective evaluations of distillation fidelity, the pipeline outperformed a baseline text-embedding model, improving mean average precision (MAP) at 20 from 0.44 (95% CI 0.44-0.45) to 0.95 (95% CI 0.95-0.96) for trial-enrolled patients and from 0.38 (95% CI 0.37-0.38) to 0.94 (95% CI 0.93-0.94) for patients who received standard of care therapies. In a 50-patient sample selected for comparison between MatchMiner-AI and a rules-based tumor genomic trial matching algorithm, MatchMiner-AI retrieved trials for all patients, as opposed to 19 patients (38%) who had tumor genomic data available. Among those 19 patients, 80% of 256 trial suggestions retrieved by MatchMiner-AI were deemed reasonable considerations by a frontier LLM, vs 53% of 113 suggestions retrieved by the rules-based approach. Conclusion: MatchMiner-AI is an open-source, open-weights, clinical trial matching AI pipeline for oncology. Synthetic training data, model weights, inference tools, and demonstration frontends are publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 MatchMiner-AI，一个开源、保护隐私的肿瘤临床试验匹配 AI 流水线。该系统与执业临床肿瘤学家共同开发，使用开放权重 LLM 从非结构化 EHR 文本总结患者病史，并从试验入组文档中提取目标人群，再通过蒸馏的嵌入和重排序模型检索并排序试验与患者建议。回顾性评估显示，其在试验匹配的准确率和覆盖面优于基线文本嵌入模型以及基于规则的肿瘤基因组匹配算法。合成训练数据、模型权重、推理工具和演示前端均公开可用。
Motivation: 临床试验对推进癌症治疗至关重要，但成人癌症患者入组治疗性试验的比例不足 10%。开源 AI 试验匹配工具可能使试验选项的获取更加民主化，而现有基于规则的算法往往依赖肿瘤基因组数据，覆盖有限。
Method: 与执业临床肿瘤学家共同开发，并使用合成电子健康记录 (EHR) 数据训练。采用开放权重 LLM 总结患者病史、从试验入组文档提取目标人群；蒸馏 (distill) 嵌入和重排序模型用于检索和排序候选匹配。评估方法包括对蒸馏保真度的回顾性量化、以闭源 LLM 作为裁判评估患者总结与匹配质量，以及由肿瘤学家评估候选匹配。

papers.title: Continual Distillation Learning for Rehearsal-Free Class-Incremental Learning via Decoupled Prompting
papers.abstract_en: Prompt-based continual learning has shown strong performance in rehearsal-free class-incremental learning by adapting learnable prompts while freezing a pre-trained Vision Transformer (ViT) backbone. However, the effect of backbone scale remains underexplored. We observe that larger ViT backbones consistently yield better continual learning performance, which motivates us to study how to transfer such capability from a larger model to a smaller one. In this paper, we introduce Continual Distillation Learning (CDL), a new setting for knowledge distillation in rehearsal-free prompt-based continual learning. We show that conventional distillation methods provide only limited gains in CDL, mainly because task-specific prompts are forced to encode both continual adaptation and distillation knowledge, while lacking a persistent mechanism for cross-task knowledge transfer. To address this problem, we propose Decoupled Continual Distillation Learning (D-CDL), which introduces persistent Knowledge-Distillation prompts (KD-prompts) and a dedicated KD branch to explicitly decouple distillation from task adaptation. The proposed KD-prompts are propagated across tasks as a global carrier of teacher knowledge, while the original prompts remain responsible for continual learning. D-CDL is simple, general, and can be integrated into various prompt-based continual learning frameworks. Extensive experiments on Split CIFAR-100 and Split ImageNet-R across four representative continual learning methods show that D-CDL consistently outperforms existing distillation baselines and substantially improves student performance under different teacher-student settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无排练的基于提示的类增量学习（rehearsal-free prompt-based class-incremental learning）提出新的知识蒸馏设置 Continual Distillation Learning (CDL)，并观察到更大的 Vision Transformer (ViT) 主干持续带来更好的增量学习性能。作者提出 Decoupled Continual Distillation Learning (D-CDL)，引入持久化的 KD-prompts 和专用 KD 分支，将蒸馏知识与任务适应解耦，在 Split CIFAR-100 和 Split ImageNet-R 上优于现有蒸馏基线。
Motivation: 在基于提示的持续学习中，更大 ViT 主干表现更好，但如何将这种能力从大模型迁移到小模型的蒸馏机制尚未被充分研究。现有蒸馏方法在 CDL 中收益有限，因为任务特定提示被迫同时编码持续适应与蒸馏知识，且缺乏跨任务知识传递的持久机制。
Method: 提出 Continual Distillation Learning (CDL) 这一新设置，并给出 D-CDL 方法：引入持久化的 Knowledge-Distillation prompts (KD-prompts) 和专用 KD 分支，将蒸馏与任务适应显式解耦；KD-prompts 作为教师知识的全局载体跨任务传播，而原始提示仍负责持续学习。
Result: 在 Split CIFAR-100 和 Split ImageNet-R 上，跨四种代表性持续学习方法的大量实验表明，D-CDL 一致优于现有蒸馏基线，并在不同教师-学生设置下显著提升学生模型性能。
Conclusion: 作者强调 D-CDL 简单、通用，可集成到多种基于提示的持续学习框架中；其核心在于用持久机制解耦蒸馏知识与任务适应，从而改善无排练蒸馏场景下的知识迁移。

papers.title: Harmonizing Safety and Speed: A Human-Algorithm Approach to Enhance the FDA's Medical Device Clearance Policy
papers.abstract_en: The United States Food and Drug Administration's (FDA's) 510(k) pathway allows manufacturers to gain medical device approval by demonstrating substantial equivalence to a legally marketed device. However, the inherent ambiguity of this regulatory procedure has been associated with high recall among many devices cleared through this pathway, raising significant safety concerns. In this paper, we develop a combined human-algorithm approach to assist the FDA in improving its 510(k) medical device clearance process by reducing recall risk and regulatory workload. We first develop machine learning methods to estimate the risk of recall of 510(k) medical devices based on the information available at the time of submission. We then propose a data-driven clearance policy that recommends acceptance, rejection, or deferral to FDA's committees for in-depth evaluation. We conduct an empirical study using a unique dataset of over 31,000 submissions that we assembled based on data sources from the FDA and Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Service (CMS). Compared to the FDA's current practice, which has a recall rate of 10.3% and a normalized workload measure of 100%, a conservative evaluation of our policy shows a 32.9% improvement in the recall rate and a 40.5% reduction in the workload. Our analyses further suggest annual cost savings of approximately $1.7 billion for the healthcare system driven by avoided replacement costs, which is equivalent to 1.1% of the entire United States annual medical device expenditure. Our findings highlight the value of a holistic and data-driven approach to improve the FDA's current 510(k) pathway.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in Management Science
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对美国 FDA 510(k) 医疗器械上市前审查路径，提出一种人工-算法结合的决策框架。作者先基于提交时可获得的信息用机器学习估计器械的召回风险，再提出数据驱动的放行政策，建议接受、拒绝或转交 FDA 委员会深入评估。基于约 31,000 份提交记录的实证研究表明，与 FDA 现行做法（召回率 10.3%、标准化工作量 100%）相比，该政策的保守评估可改善召回率 32.9% 并降低工作量 40.5%。
Motivation: 510(k) 路径的实质等同（substantial equivalence）判定存在固有模糊性，与通过该路径获批器械的高召回率相关，引发安全担忧，同时给监管机构带来沉重工作量。
Method: 开发两阶段方法：先用机器学习在提交时点估计 510(k) 器械的召回风险；再构造数据驱动的清关政策，输出接受、拒绝或转交 FDA 委员会深入评估的建议。数据来自 FDA 和 CMS 整合的约 31,000 条提交记录。
Result: 保守评估中，新政策相比现状将召回率改善 32.9%（从 10.3% 降低），并将标准化工作量从 100% 减少 40.5%。分析还估计每年可为医疗系统节省约 17 亿美元的重置成本，相当于美国年医疗设备支出的 1.1%。
Conclusion: 作者强调，综合数据驱动与人类判断的整体性方法能改善 FDA 现行 510(k) 路径的安全性与效率，说明监管政策中数据驱动决策的价值。

papers.title: Evaluation Resolution Confounds Learning-Rule Comparisons in Model-Brain RSA of Early Visual Cortex
papers.abstract_en: Representational similarity analysis (RSA) is increasingly used to ask which learning rules give convolutional networks brain-like representations. Because biologically plausible rules such as feedback alignment, predictive coding and STDP do not scale, studies that include them train small networks on small images (typically 32x32 CIFAR) and then compare them to brain responses modeled at much higher resolution. We find that a common result in this setting, that untrained or locally trained networks rival or beat backpropagation at early visual cortex, depends strongly on the resolution at which the network is evaluated. The V1 gap between an untrained network and a backpropagation-trained one widens from -0.001 +/- 0.007 at the 32px training resolution to +0.044 +/- 0.006 at 224px, growing monotonically across six resolutions (n=5 seeds). It holds in human fMRI and, directionally, in single-seed macaque electrophysiology, along the training trajectory, and for an ImageNet ResNet-50 and a Swin-Tiny transformer trained at 224px. Four candidate mechanisms are tested and none accounts for it: train/eval resolution matching, low-level Gabor and pixel structure, the normalization state of the untrained baseline, and convergence of the pooled descriptor toward a global brightness statistic; three are excluded by interventions holding the convolutional weights bit-identical. A fifth experiment locates the effect: capping image detail at the training resolution while letting the pooled positions grow 12-fold removes about 90% of it, so the dependence is carried by image detail rather than by pooling. Separately, a single scalar luminance value per image reaches rho = 0.075 against the V1 RDM, essentially matching the untrained network's 0.076, which bounds what this style of comparison can resolve. The one learning effect that holds across resolution is backprop above untrained, at LOC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究早期视觉皮层模型-大脑 RSA 中学习规则比较的混淆因素，发现网络评估分辨率会显著影响结果。常见结论——未训练或局部训练网络在早期视觉皮层可与反向传播匹敌或超越——依赖于评估分辨率，V1 差距从 32px 训练分辨率下的 -0.001±0.007 变为 224px 下的 +0.044±0.006，并随六种分辨率单调增大。该效应在人类 fMRI 和单种子猕猴电生理中方向性成立，且对 ImageNet ResNet-50 和 Swin-Tiny transformer 均存在。多个机制检验均无法解释该效应，但限制图像细节的实验表明约 90% 的效应由图像细节而非池化承载。
Motivation: 在模型-大脑 RSA 中比较学习规则时，生物合理规则（如 feedback alignment、predictive coding、STDP）由于无法扩展，研究往往在小网络和小图像（如 32x32 CIFAR）上训练，再与更高分辨率建模的大脑响应比较。作者指出这种评估分辨率不匹配会混淆学习规则的比较，尤其影响“未训练或局部训练网络匹敌或超越反向传播”这一常见结论。
Method: 通过系统性改变评估分辨率（从 32px 到 224px，六种分辨率，n=5 seeds），在人类 fMRI 和猕猴电生理数据上比较未训练、局部训练和反向传播网络的 V1 表征；并设计干预实验（保持卷积权重逐位相同）检验四种候选机制，再通过限制图像细节同时扩大池化区域来定位效应来源。
Result: V1 差距从 32px 的 -0.001±0.007 单调增大到 224px 的 +0.044±0.006；效应在人类 fMRI、方向性上在单种子猕猴电生理、训练轨迹及 ImageNet ResNet-50 和 Swin-Tiny 中均成立。四种候选机制均被排除；将图像细节限制在训练分辨率同时池化位置增长 12 倍可消除约 90% 的效应。单个亮度标量达到 rho=0.075，接近未训练网络的 0.076。唯一跨分辨率稳健的学习效应是 LOC 中反向传播优于未训练。
Conclusion: 摘要强调评估分辨率是混淆学习规则比较的关键因素，且该分辨率依赖主要由图像细节而非池化承载；单个亮度标量即可接近未训练网络的 V1 RDM 匹配度，框定了此类比较可分辨的边界。唯一跨分辨率成立的学习效应是 LOC 中反向传播高于未训练。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Predictive Allostatic Organization in Recurrent and Spiking Agents Under Partial Observability
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive behavior under partial observability depends on internal organization that carries information beyond the current observation. Drawing on Barrett and Miller's account of categorization as predictive, compressive, functionally organized, and allostatically constrained, we test whether recurrent and spiking agents develop internal states with corresponding computational properties. Agents operate in an energy-constrained foraging task requiring resource acquisition, threat avoidance, contact-dependent consumption, and regulation of an internal energy variable. In a frozen benchmark, learned agents outperform random and heuristic baselines; the trace-augmented recurrent policy is strongest overall, while spiking variants show stress-specific differences. Early internal dynamics predict later full-safe-efficient success above permutation baseline, reaching a maximum ROC-AUC of 0.802. Reduced PCA subspaces retain behaviorally relevant information. Feature-family controls show that predictive signal is distributed across trace, policy-head, internal-dynamics, observation, and allostatic variables, and low-energy state remains strongly decodable after explicit energy-related features are removed. Evaluation-time perturbations to temporal state, sensory information, operating conditions, and allostatic mechanisms alter behavior and/or internal prediction. Seed-balanced event probes show weaker but measurable information about future contact, successful consumption, and threat events, alongside strong low-energy decoding. We interpret this pattern as a computational analogue of predictive allostatic organization: distributed control regimes that are predictive, energy-sensitive, action-relevant, and partly causally involved, without claiming biological validation or discrete symbolic categories.
papers.comment: 36 pages, 6 figures. Code and reproducibility materials: https://github.com/fehayes/predictive-allostatic-organization
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究部分可观测性条件下递归和脉冲智能体（recurrent and spiking agents）的内部组织是否具备预测性、压缩性、功能性组织和异体约束（allostatic constraints）等计算性质。智能体在能量受限的觅食任务中训练，冻结基准下学习到的策略优于随机和启发式基线，trace增强递归策略总体最强；早期内部动态对后期成功的预测达到最高ROC-AUC 0.802。作者将该模式解释为预测性异体组织（predictive allostatic organization）的计算类比。
Motivation: 在部分可观测性下，自适应行为依赖于承载超出当前观测信息的内部组织；论文借助Barrett和Miller关于分类的理论框架，检验递归与脉冲代理是否发展出具有相应计算性质的内部状态。
Method: 设计能量受限的觅食任务，要求代理同时处理资源获取、威胁回避、接触依赖消费和内部能量变量调节；通过冻结基准、早期内部动态对后期全安全高效成功的预测、PCA子空间约简、特征家族控制、评估时扰动以及种子平衡事件探针来剖析内部状态的预测性与可解码性。
Result: 冻结基准中学习代理优于随机和启发式基线，trace增强递归策略总体最强，而脉冲变体表现出压力特异性差异；早期内部动态预测后期成功达到最高ROC-AUC 0.802，低能量状态在移除显式能量相关特征后仍可强解码，未来接触、成功消费与威胁事件的信息较弱但可测量。
Conclusion: 作者认为结果构成预测性异体组织的计算类比：分布式控制兼具预测性、能量敏感性、行动相关性和部分因果参与性，但不主张生物学验证或离散符号类别的存在。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Black-Box Knowledge Transfer across Distinct Feature Sets
papers.abstract_en: Pre-trained black-box predictive functions encode knowledge distilled from massive datasets and extensive computation. However, when the available input features differ from those the black box expects, direct use is infeasible. We introduce a method for transferring predictive knowledge from the black box to a new, heterogeneous input space. Our approach decomposes the target regression function into a transferable component, which the black box can inform, and a non-transferable component, which captures information unique to the new space. We propose a two-step neural network procedure, estimating the transferable component from abundant unlabeled feature pairs that bridge the two input spaces and the non-transferable component from limited labels. We derive prediction risk bounds that improve on those of a non-transfer alternative when the non-transferable component is small or smooth, and the procedure adapts to either case. Under additional conditions, the worst-case risk of our estimator is of strictly smaller polynomial order than the minimax risk of estimation from the labeled data alone. We extend the framework to multiple black boxes, each on its own input space, and show that aggregation can reduce prediction error relative to the best single black box. Simulated and real data demonstrate the practical value of the method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种从预训练黑盒预测模型向新异构输入空间迁移知识的方法。作者将目标回归函数分解为可迁移组件与不可迁移组件，利用大量无标签特征对估计前者、用有限标签估计后者，并推导预测风险界。模拟与真实数据实验表明该方法具有实用价值，且可扩展到多个黑盒的聚合。
Motivation: 当可用输入特征与预训练黑盒模型所期望的特征不一致时，无法直接使用该黑盒；这要求在异构特征空间之间迁移预测知识。
Method: 提出两步神经网络程序：第一步借助连接两个输入空间的大量无标签特征对估计可迁移组件，第二步用有限标签估计不可迁移组件，并设计了能适应不可迁移组件大小或平滑性的自适应过程。
Result: 推导的预测风险界优于非迁移备选方案，条件是不可迁移组件较小或平滑；在额外条件下，估计量的最坏情况风险阶严格小于仅用带标签数据估计的 minimax 风险。多黑盒框架下，聚合多个黑盒可降低预测误差。
Conclusion: 摘要表明黑盒知识可以系统性地迁移到异构特征空间，且多黑盒聚合能带来收益；理论界与数值实验共同支持方法的实用价值。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: A Hierarchical Energy-Based Model for Multimodal Cognition
papers.abstract_en: We propose IM-LEPP (Integrated Multimodal Latent Energy-based Predictive Processing), a hierarchical, energy-based model of multimodal cognition that extends a previously proposed single-modality model (LEPP) to integrate vision and language. Following the view that generative neural networks are effective theories of cognitive dynamics, analogous to how statistical mechanics relates to thermodynamics, IM-LEPP models cognition as latent states flowing through learned energy landscapes rather than as an account of neural circuitry. The architecture is a hub-and-spoke hierarchy, grounded in the controlled semantic cognition framework of Lambon Ralph et al., in which predictive-coding pipelines for visual objects, scenes, and linguistic units converge on a shared amodal hub modeled on the anterior temporal lobe. Each pipeline's own prediction is conditioned by, rather than overwritten by, the current hub state, preserving pipeline-specific identity while letting every prediction reflect the full multimodal context. We show this architecture gives a mechanistic account of attentional phenomena such as inattentional blindness and Necker-cube bistability, and that its structure recovers or motivates independently established findings in psycholinguistics, including surprisal theory, the N400/P600 ERP components, and garden-path reanalysis, alongside a falsifiable contrast with transformer language models on trajectory-sensitivity in next-word prediction. We also discuss data-efficient language acquisition relative to LLMs, outline a semantic/episodic memory subsystem, situate the model against predictive coding, the free-energy principle, JEPA, and Hierarchical Temporal Memory, and propose concrete experimental predictions to test its central claims Key Words: predictive processing; predictive coding; energy-based models; diffusion models; effective theory; computational neuroscience.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IM-LEPP（Integrated Multimodal Latent Energy-based Predictive Processing），一个分层能量基 (energy-based) 多模态认知模型，将先前单模态 LEPP 扩展到视觉与语言整合。模型采用 hub-and-spoke 层次结构，视觉物体、场景和语言单元的预测编码 (predictive coding) 管线汇聚到以前颞叶为原型的共享无模态中枢 (amodal hub)，各管线的预测被中枢状态调节而非覆盖。摘要声称该架构能为非注意盲视和 Necker 立方体双稳态等注意现象提供机制解释，并重现或支持 surprisal 理论、N400/P600 ERP 成分和 garden-path 重分析等心理语言学发现。
Motivation: 作者认为生成式神经网络可视为认知动力学的有效理论 (effective theory)，类似统计力学之于热力学，因而把认知建模为潜状态在习得能量景观中的流动，而非神经回路刻画。现有 LEPP 仅覆盖单模态，本文旨在将其推广为视觉与语言整合的多模态认知模型。
Method: 架构是基于 Lambon Ralph 等人受控语义认知框架的 hub-and-spoke 层级：面向视觉物体、场景和语言单元的预测编码管线收敛至一个以前颞叶为模型的共享无模态中枢；每条管线依据当前中枢状态对自身预测进行条件化，而非被覆盖，从而保留管线特异性又整合多模态上下文。
Result: 摘要报告该架构给出非注意盲视与 Necker 立方体双稳态的机制性解释，并在结构上复现或启发 surprisal 理论、N400/P600 ERP 成分和 garden-path 重分析等心理语言学结论；还提出与 Transformer 语言模型在下一词预测轨迹敏感性上的可证伪对比，并讨论相对 LLM 的数据高效语言习得。文中未给出量化实验数字。
Conclusion: 作者将该模型与预测编码、自由能原理、JEPA 和层级时间记忆 (HTM) 进行定位，概述语义/情景记忆子系统，并提出具体实验预测来检验其核心主张。其定位是认知层面的有效理论，而非对神经回路的具体刻画。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Research Assistant: AstraZeneca's Agentic System for R&D
papers.abstract_en: We describe Research Assistant, an internal LLM-based system developed at AstraZeneca to help scientists and clinicians explore biomedical questions across a broad range of data sources. The system provides a chat-style interface that brings together evidence from scientific literature, knowledge graphs, chemistry, clinical trials, safety resources, expression data, and internal experimental systems. It supports both a fast mode for direct question answering and a multi-step mode for more complex research tasks. Responses are grounded in retrieved evidence and linked back to the original sources, allowing users to review and further explore the underlying data. In this technical note, we outline the system architecture, the main design choices behind the product, and lessons learned from deploying it at scale to support day-to-day R&D workflows across AstraZeneca.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是阿斯利康内部开发的基于 LLM 的 Research Assistant 系统的技术说明，旨在帮助科学家和临床人员跨多种数据源探索生物医学问题。系统提供聊天式界面，整合科学文献、知识图谱、化学、临床试验、安全性资源、表达数据及内部实验系统，支持快速问答模式和多步骤复杂研究任务。响应基于检索证据并链接回原始来源，供用户审查和进一步探索。
Motivation: 生物医学研究问题往往需要跨多个异质数据源（文献、知识图谱、临床试验、化学等）进行综合检索与推理，现有工具难以支持这种广覆盖、可追溯的问答流程。
Method: 系统采用聊天式交互架构，包含面向直接问答的快速模式和面向复杂研究任务的多步骤模式，所有响应都通过检索证据（retrieved evidence）进行 grounding，并回链到原始数据源。文章还总结了产品层面的主要设计决策与规模化部署经验。
Result: 摘要未报告具体的定量实验结果或基准数字，主要贡献是系统架构描述、设计选择和部署经验。
Conclusion: 作者认为该系统的核心价值在于将多源异构生物医学数据统一到可追溯、可审查的对话式界面中，并分享了在阿斯利康内部规模化支持日常 R&D 工作流时获得的经验教训。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Unified Multi-Dimensional Benchmark for Complex Graph Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Graph reasoning provides a promising testbed for evaluating the reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs), as graph instances can be programmatically generated, structurally controlled, and naturally scaled to long-input settings. However, existing graph reasoning benchmarks have limited coverage of data complexity, rely heavily on manual construction, and lack unified evaluation across text-based and code-based reasoning modes. To address these limitations, we propose {\dataset}, a five-stage \textit{semi-automatic} framework for constructing complex graph reasoning benchmarks. It expands benchmark coverage along five dimensions: \textit{Graph Size}, \textit{Task Complexity}, \textit{Task Description}, \textit{Graph Loading}, and \textit{Task Source}. The framework uses an LLM-based data generator to automatically produce task descriptions, graph data, reference solutions, graph-loading scripts, question forms, and evaluation scripts, while retaining human validation at key quality-control stages. Based on it, we construct a benchmark with $202$ tasks and evaluate LLMs under text-based, code-based, and augmented reasoning settings. Experiments show that the complexity dimensions reveal model limitations that are less visible in existing benchmarks; existing fine-tuned models struggle to generalize to GraphGym, whereas retrieval-augmented methods show scenario-dependent adaptability, improving textual reasoning but not consistently improving coding reasoning. These findings suggest that ours serves as a challenging and diagnostic benchmark for graph reasoning and provides empirical guidance for future enhancement methods. Code and dataset will be published soon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个五阶段半自动框架，用于构建复杂图推理基准，覆盖图规模、任务复杂度、任务描述、图加载和任务来源五个维度。基于该框架构建了包含202个任务的benchmark，并评估了LLM在文本、代码和增强推理设置下的表现。实验显示复杂度维度能暴露现有基准不易察觉的模型局限，检索增强方法对文本推理有改进但未一致提升代码推理。
Motivation: 现有图推理基准对数据复杂度覆盖有限，依赖大量人工构建，且缺乏在文本和代码两种推理模式下的统一评估。
Method: 提出五阶段半自动构建框架，使用基于LLM的数据生成器自动生成任务描述、图数据、参考解答、图加载脚本、问题形式和评估脚本，并在关键质量控制阶段保留人工验证。
Result: 构建了含202个任务的基准，并评估LLM在文本、代码和增强推理下的表现；复杂度维度揭示了模型局限，现有微调模型难以泛化到GraphGym，检索增强方法提升文本推理但未一致提升代码推理。

papers.title: Learning to Adapt Cross-Domain Preferences via Meta-LoRA for LLM Personalization
papers.abstract_en: Cross-domain zero- or few-shot personalization aims to generate user-preferred responses in unseen conversational domains from only a handful of target-domain interactions. Existing adaptation methods struggle to calibrate update magnitude under sparse evidence and thus overfit, whereas history-transfer methods often entangle user preferences with source-domain artifacts, yielding unreliable personalization priors and negative transfer. To calibrate adaptation to evidence quality, we propose PAC-Bayes-regularized Meta-LoRA, which uses a meta-learned LoRA initialization as both the adaptation start and prior center, while adjusting update strength according to support-set size and predictive uncertainty. This limits overfitting under sparse or ambiguous evidence while permitting stronger personalization as evidence grows. Controlled adaptation alone does not determine which preferences should transfer across domains or how they should be expressed. We therefore functionally decompose personalization priors into user and domain components, using a human-readable prompt for stable preferences and topology-preserving soft tokens for domain-specific hidden-space conditioning. Experiments across multiple benchmarks and personalization tasks show consistent gains over strong baselines. On HiCUPID, our method reduces cross-domain win-rate degradation by 47.9% relative to the best competing baseline and improves win rate by 110.2% under unseen-user cold start.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对跨域零样本/少样本 LLM 个性化问题，提出 PAC-Bayes 正则化的 Meta-LoRA：将元学习的 LoRA 初始化同时用作适应起点与先验中心，根据支持集大小和预测不确定性调节更新强度，并把个性化先验分解为用户与领域两个组件。在 HiCUPID 等基准上，该方法相对强基线将跨域胜率退化降低 47.9%，并在未见用户冷启动场景下将胜率提升 110.2%。
Motivation: 现有适应方法在证据稀疏时难以校准更新幅度，容易过拟合；历史迁移方法则会把用户偏好与源领域伪影纠缠在一起，产生不可靠的个性化先验并导致负迁移。
Method: 提出 PAC-Bayes 正则化的 Meta-LoRA，以元学习的 LoRA 初始化作为适应起点和先验中心，依据支持集规模与预测不确定性调节更新强度；同时将个性化先验功能性地分解为用户成分（人类可读提示表达稳定偏好）和领域成分（保持拓扑结构的软 token 用于领域隐藏空间条件化）。
Result: 在多个基准与个性化任务上相对强基线取得一致提升；在 HiCUPID 上，跨域胜率退化相对最佳竞争基线降低 47.9%，未见用户冷启动下胜率提升 110.2%。
Conclusion: 作者强调，根据证据质量校准适应强度并功能性地分离用户与领域先验，能在稀疏证据下限制过拟合，随证据增多加强个性化，并减少负迁移。

papers.title: A Bayes-Markov Neuromorphic Model of Cortical Orientation Selectivity: A Computational Re-implementation and Quantitative Simulation Study
papers.abstract_en: The emergence of orientation selectivity in the primary visual cortex (V1) remains a central question in computational neuroscience. Shirazi's Bayes-Markov model proposed a probabilistic explanation for how orientation-selective inhibition can arise from non-oriented lateral geniculate nucleus (LGN) inputs through local inference. In that formulation, the activity pattern of striate cortical inhibitory (SCI) cells is estimated from the LGN activity pattern by a maximum a posteriori (MAP) criterion over a two-layer hierarchical Markov random field, and the resulting inference is implemented through a local parallel relaxation algorithm. We provide a computationally explicit re-implementation and quantitative simulation study of this framework. We reconstruct the mathematical model, describe its fully LGN-driven update rule, and implement a vectorized simulation framework that preserves the original local clique operations while making systematic parameter sweeps feasible. We evaluate the model using orientation tuning curves, an orientation selectivity index (OSI), controlled LGN noise perturbations, contrast tests, and model-variant comparisons. We further add a spiking SCI-layer realization using leaky integrate-and-fire and Hodgkin-Huxley neurons to examine whether the rate-coded SCI field can be expressed through temporally explicit neural activity. The simulations support the central qualitative behavior of the Bayes-Markov framework: sharp orientation selectivity, robustness to moderate LGN noise, and a biologically interpretable proof-of-concept spiking realization of the inferred inhibitory field.
papers.comment: 24 pages. Computational neuroscience; orientation selectivity; neuromorphic modeling
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对 Shirazi 提出的 Bayes-Markov 模型进行了计算上显式的重新实现和定量模拟研究，该模型用两层层次马尔可夫随机场上的最大后验（MAP）推断解释初级视觉皮层（V1）方向选择性如何从非朝向性的 LGN 输入中涌现。作者重建了数学模型、给出完全由 LGN 驱动的更新规则，并实现了保持原始局部团（clique）操作的向量化仿真框架以支持系统参数扫描；评估包括方向调谐曲线、方向选择性指数（OSI）、受控 LGN 噪声扰动、对比度测试和模型变体比较，并额外用 leaky integrate-and-fire 和 Hodgkin-Huxley 神经元实现了一个 spiking 的 SCI 层。模拟支持该框架的核心定性行为：锐利的方向选择性、对中等 LGN 噪声的鲁棒性，以及推断抑制场的一种生物可解释的 spiking 概念验证。
Motivation: V1 中方向选择性的涌现是计算神经科学的核心问题，Shirazi 的 Bayes-Markov 模型对该现象提出了概率解释，但需要一个计算上显式的重新实现和定量模拟来验证其性质。
Method: 重建两层层次马尔可夫随机场的 MAP 推断模型及局部并行松弛算法，给出完全由 LGN 驱动的更新规则，并实现保持局部团操作的向量化仿真框架；随后用 LIF 和 Hodgkin-Huxley 神经元增加 spiking SCI 层实现。
Result: 模拟验证了模型的方向调谐曲线、OSI，在中等 LGN 噪声下保持鲁棒性，并通过对比度测试和模型变体比较展现了定量行为；spiking 实现提供了推断抑制场的生物可解释概念验证。
Conclusion: 作者认为结果支持 Bayes-Markov 框架的定性行为，即能产生锐利方向选择性和噪声鲁棒性，并给出 spiking 层次的可行实现作为证明。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Query Timing Produces Opposite Positional Biases Between LLMs and Humans
papers.abstract_en: Positional biases such as recency and primacy effects have been documented in large language models (LLMs), yet the underlying mechanism by which these models make their evaluations remains poorly understood. Both primacy and recency biases have been observed in human judgments in response to evidence, but recent work suggest that \emph{when} the listener updates their beliefs -- during the presentation of evidence or only at the end -- influences the presence of such effects. We investigate whether a similar phenomenon holds for LLMs, finding divergence from human behavior. These biases are more exacerbated in newer models compared to their predecessors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文考察大型语言模型（LLM）中的位置偏差（positional biases，如近因与首因效应）及其与人类判断的差异。近期研究提示，人类是在证据呈现期间还是仅在结束时更新信念，会影响这些效应的出现；作者对LLM进行类似检验，发现LLM的行为与人类相反，并且较新模型的这类偏差比旧模型更严重。
Motivation: LLM中已观察到近因和首因等位置偏差，但其评估机制仍不清楚；作者希望借鉴人类信念更新时机的研究，验证LLM是否也存在类似的现象机制。
Method: 通过对比LLM与人类在证据呈现过程中或仅在结束后进行判断的情形，检验位置偏差是否存在及其方向是否与人类一致。
Result: 摘要报告LLM表现出与人类相反的位置偏差，且该偏差在新一代模型中比前代模型更为加剧。
Conclusion: LLM的位置偏差机制与人类不同，且随模型更新而恶化；这一发现提示需要进一步关注LLM如何整合和评估证据。

papers.title: Dual-Flow Transformers: Decoupling the Primary Prefill Path from Additional Decode Computation
papers.abstract_en: As large language models serve more requests, cumulative inference cost is becoming increasingly important relative to one-time training cost. The two inference phases stress hardware differently: prompt prefill is parallel and typically compute-bound, whereas autoregressive decode is sequential and often memory-bandwidth-bound. Conventional width or depth scaling increases both costs together because every added layer is evaluated in both phases. We ask whether additional learned computation can instead be allocated to continuation prediction while preserving the prompt-wide primary computation and a single persistent key-value (KV) cache. We introduce the Dual-Flow Transformer. Its primary flow is a complete causal language model that processes the prompt and writes the KV cache. The auxiliary flow is omitted during prompt processing and activated only from the final prompt position onward, adding continuation-prediction computation without writing persistent state or influencing the primary flow. The two flows share major attention, MLP, and output matrices, while using separate token embeddings and lightweight coupling. Sharing weights and the primary cache also creates opportunities to reuse loaded weights and cached keys and values during grouped execution. Across matched-token comparisons, Dual-Flow achieves lower validation loss across architectures and data configurations. In MoE models, the separation makes primary and auxiliary expert fan-outs independent controls over prompt cost, continuation cost, and predictive quality. We study two regimes: increasing decode computation at fixed prefill expert computation, and reallocating a fixed decode expert budget between the two flows. These experiments expose a prefill-decode-quality trade-off and demonstrate the potential of phase-specific expert allocation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Dual-Flow Transformer：主流（primary flow）是一个完整的因果语言模型，负责处理 prompt 并写入 KV 缓存；辅助流（auxiliary flow）在 prompt 处理阶段被省略，仅从最后 prompt 位置起激活，为续写预测增加计算而不写入持久状态。摘要报告在匹配 token（matched-token）对比中，该方法在多种架构和数据配置下取得更低的验证损失；在 MoE 模型中，主/辅专家扇出可作为独立控制，实验揭示了预填充-解码-质量权衡。
Motivation: LLM 推理的累计成本日益重要，但传统宽度或深度扩展会让预填充和解码阶段的成本同时上升，因为每层在两个阶段都被计算。作者希望把额外的学习计算只分配到续写预测，同时保留针对整个 prompt 的主计算和单一持久 KV 缓存。
Method: 提出 Dual-Flow Transformer，主流程在预填充阶段正常处理 prompt 并写 KV cache，辅助流在解码阶段才激活以增加续写计算。两流共享主要 attention、MLP 与输出矩阵，但使用独立的 token embedding 和轻量耦合；在 MoE 模型中，主流和辅助流的专家扇出（expert fan-out）可分别控制预填充成本、续写成本与预测质量。
Result: 摘要称在 matched-token 对比中，Dual-Flow 在不同架构和数据配置下均取得更低验证损失。MoE 实验中考察两种 regime：固定预填充专家计算而增加解码计算，以及固定解码专家预算在两条流之间重新分配，结果显示存在 prefill-decode-quality trade-off 并展示了按阶段分配专家的潜力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将附加计算仅部署在解码阶段、并配合共享权重和主 KV 缓存，可以在不增加预填充主计算的前提下改善续写预测质量；摘要未涉及具体局限性。

papers.title: From Observation to Intervention: Memory in Brains and Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Brains and large language models (LLMs) are fundamentally different memory systems, but they can be compared through shared functional questions: where memory-related information is represented, how partial cues recover broader associations, how new information is written or updated, and how memory-related states can be perturbed. In biological systems, these questions span synapses, neuronal ensembles, hippocampal-cortical interactions, and plasticity; in LLMs, they span weights, activations, context windows, retrieval systems, and external stores. The comparison is therefore functional and experimental rather than anatomical. Human studies reveal sparse concept responses, temporal binding, rapid association formation, episode-specific coding, and recall-related reactivation, but selective intervention remains limited. Rodent studies provide more selective causal access to learning-related ensembles, whereas human and macaque interventions usually affect broader circuits. LLMs lack lived episodic memory, yet they permit unusually direct and repeatable manipulation of internal states and stored information. We argue that this asymmetry creates a new opportunity. LLMs are not ahead in memory itself, but in experimental access. Their tools may help turn broad questions about retrieval, updating, persistence, reversibility, and unintended effects into sharper biological hypotheses. The productive bridge is to transfer experimental logic, not anatomical parts.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇观点文章 (Perspective article)，提出从四个共享的功能性问题——记忆信息在哪里表征、部分线索如何恢复更广泛的关联、新信息如何写入或更新、记忆相关状态如何被扰动——来比较大脑与大语言模型 (LLM) 这两种根本不同的记忆系统。作者认为这种比较应是功能性和实验性的，而非解剖学对应；LLM 在记忆能力本身并不领先，但在对内部状态进行直接、可重复操纵的实验可及性上领先，因而可以把实验逻辑而非解剖部件迁移到生物学假设的生成中。
Motivation: 大脑和 LLM 是根本不同的记忆系统，缺乏一个统一的比较框架；现有人类研究受限于选择性干预手段，而啮齿类和灵长类干预通常影响更广泛的神经回路，需要一种能跨系统提出可检验问题的比较方式。
Method: 该文将记忆比较组织为四个功能问题，分别对应生物系统中的突触、神经元集合、海马-皮层交互和可塑性，以及 LLM 中的权重、激活、上下文窗口、检索系统和外部存储；并综述人类、啮齿类和灵长类干预研究的证据，论证 LLM 提供更直接可重复的状态操纵手段。
Result: 摘要的核心论点是：LLM 不在记忆本身领先，而是在实验可及性上领先，这种不对称性为将关于检索、更新、持久性、可逆性和意外效应的宽泛记忆问题转化为更锐利的生物学假设创造了新机会。
Conclusion: 作者强调，富有成效的桥梁是把实验逻辑从 LLM 迁移到生物记忆研究，而不是把解剖部件进行对应移植。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Are you Talking Logic to Me? Assessing Language Models Syllogistic Reasoning Capabilities
papers.abstract_en: Language models (LMs) struggle with logical tasks like reasoning on syllogisms. It has been shown that Knowledge Representation (KR) plays a crucial role in expressing input information to help models solve tasks. This observation motivates our study of the impact of different formal KR notations on syllogistic reasoning by extending the FOLIO and P-FOLIO datasets. Our experiments on Small Language Models (SLMs) in Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Zero-Shot (ZS) settings show that the choice of input notation can yield performances competitive with natural language while enabling faster inference. We also propose a syllogistic categorization method (SEF) and use it to enrich ZS prompts with logical definitions, which boost reasoning in small models. We open-source our framework, Common Logic Grammar Construction (CLGC), as the first Python library for automatically generating syllogisms in KR notations and defining their SEF categories.
papers.comment: Accepted to the International Joint Conference on Rules and Reasoning (RuleML+RR) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究形式知识表示 (KR) 记法对语言模型三段论推理 (syllogistic reasoning) 的影响，通过扩展 FOLIO 与 P-FOLIO 数据集，在小语言模型 (SLM) 的监督微调 (SFT) 和零样本 (ZS) 设置下进行实验。结果表明输入记法的选择可达到与自然语言相当的性能并加快推理；作者还提出三段论分类方法 SEF 用于丰富 ZS 提示，并开源了自动生成 KR 记法三段论的 Python 库 CLGC。
Motivation: 语言模型在逻辑任务（如三段论推理）上表现不佳，而已有研究显示知识表示 (KR) 对表达输入信息、帮助模型求解至关重要，但不同形式 KR 记法对三段论推理的具体影响缺乏系统评估。
Method: 扩展 FOLIO 和 P-FOLIO 数据集以覆盖不同 KR 记法，在 SLM 上比较 SFT 与 ZS 设置下的推理表现；提出三段论分类方法 SEF，将其用于在 ZS 提示中加入逻辑定义；并开发开源 Python 库 CLGC 以自动生成 KR 记法中的三段论及其 SEF 分类。
Result: 摘要报告输入记法的选择可以取得与自然语言竞争性的性能，同时实现更快推理；使用 SEF 丰富 ZS 提示能够提升小模型的推理能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为 KR 记法的选择对语言模型的三段论推理具有实际影响，并强调其框架 CLGC 是首个自动生成 KR 记法三段论并定义 SEF 类别的 Python 库。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Don't Want Your LLM to Recommend Nuclear Strike? Try Asking It in Japanese
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly used in strategic and advisory contexts, yet their safety alignment is typically evaluated in English only. We test nine models from six providers and ask whether the language of a prompt can change a model's decision in a high-stakes scenario. We use single-turn game-theoretic vignettes in which a model advises a nuclear-armed nation on whether to strike a defenseless opponent. The prompt is intentionally amoral and strategically identical across languages. We find that Japanese prompts reduce launch rates in the Claude model family: Claude Sonnet 4.6 drops from 40% to 0% in scenarios where the strike is unnecessary and from 93% to 17% in contested scenarios, with minimal effect when the strike is strategically rational. The effect extends to Gemini Pro 3.1 (53% to 13%). A cross-language experiment isolates the mechanism: when instructed to reason in Japanese in an English prompt, launch rates drop from 93% to 37%. It is the language the model is asked to reason in, not the language of the input, that drives the effect. When reasoning in Japanese, models spontaneously generate moral vocabulary (''moral cost'', ''millions of lives'') that is entirely absent from the prompt. Five other models show no language effect, but they launch in nearly every condition regardless of language. The effect requires a model that already hesitates in English. These results show that LLM safety behavior is language-dependent, and that evaluating in English alone can miss both risks and safeguards encoded in other languages.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 6th Workshop on Trustworthy NLP (TrustNLP 2026), Jul 2026, San Diego, United States. pp.489-502
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文考察 LLM 的安全对齐是否随提示语言改变：在单轮博弈论场景中让模型建议核武国家是否打击无防御对手。作者测试了六家提供商的九个模型，发现日语提示会显著降低 Claude 模型家族的发射率，且跨语言实验表明驱动效应的是模型被要求推理的语言而非输入语言。摘要认为仅用英语评估会同时遗漏其他语言中编码的风险与防护。
Motivation: 安全对齐评估通常只在英语下进行，而高风险战略咨询场景中语言是否改变模型决策尚不清楚；若语言可影响行为，英语单语评估会漏掉风险和已有的安全机制。
Method: 使用单轮博弈论小场景 (game-theoretic vignettes)，提示在道德上刻意中立且跨语言策略一致，测试六家提供商的九个模型；并设计跨语言实验，将日语推理指令嵌入英语提示，以分离推理语言与输入语言的作用。
Result: 日语提示使 Claude Sonnet 4.6 在非必要打击场景中发射率从 40% 降至 0%，在有争议场景中从 93% 降至 17%，在战略理性场景中影响很小；Gemini Pro 3.1 从 53% 降至 13%。当英语提示要求用日语推理时，发射率从 93% 降至 37%。其余五个模型无语言效应，但在几乎任何条件下都选择发射；该效应只出现在原本在英语下已显犹豫的模型中。
Conclusion: LLM 的安全行为是语言依赖的，仅用英语评估会遗漏其他语言中存在的风险与安全机制；效应需要模型在英语下已具备一定犹豫基础，因此不能简单推广到所有模型。
Relevance: 0
